records.name_zh: 阿勒泰市万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 阿勒泰市万豪万枫酒店，是万豪旗下精选品牌，坐落于阿勒泰市中心。毗邻阿禾公路入口，地理位置优越，交通便利，距阿勒泰站20分钟车程，阿勒泰雪都机场16分钟车程。12分钟车程亦可轻松抵达五百里风情街，桦林公园，将军山国际滑雪场等热门旅游打卡目的地。
description.textEn: The hotel is located in the downtown area of Altay City. It is an 18-minute drive from Altay Xuedu Airport, a 21-minute drive from Altay Railway Station, and a 14-minute drive from the Altay City Ski Resort. It takes approximately 3 hours and 30 minutes to drive to Kanas, Hemu, and Koktokay respectively. The Ahe Highway is just steps away, with the "Zero Kilometer" starting point only a 15-minute drive away. The hotel offers a variety of guest rooms in different specifications, along with multiple conference halls and multifunction banquet halls that can accommodate large-scale meetings and dining events. The Chinese restaurant features luxurious private dining rooms with distinctive styles. The surrounding area is equipped with comprehensive facilities, including restaurants, bathhouses, and KTVs. The entire hotel staff looks forward to your visit.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Altay City
records.name_zh: 阿勒泰市福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 从这里去探索阿勒泰如诗如画的风景，阿勒泰市福朋喜来登酒店将永恒经典的设计和当地元素细节相融。酒店位于阿勒泰市区, 将舒适与便利相结合, 是您商务出行或度假旅游的品质之选。酒店毗邻阿禾公路入口，地理位置优越，交通便利，距阿勒泰站20分钟车程，阿勒泰雪都机场16分钟车程。12分钟车程亦可轻松抵达五百里风情街，桦林公园，将军山国际滑雪场等热门旅游打卡目的地。酒店客房均配有智能家居，结合福朋轻奢简约的设计理念，为入住宾客提供都市旅居全新体验。宾客可在酒店玩啤食社享用中西融合佳肴，还有本地特色精选美食，开启满满活力一天。24小时的健身中心和配备先进洗烘设备的洗衣房，满足各类宾客多样需求。酒店一层集美食、咖啡、醇饮优选Best Brews精酿及休闲放松等生活方式于一体的多元社交空间，是旅享家商务休闲、移动办公的个性之选。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 浙江安吉 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 浙江安吉 JW 万豪酒店是中国地区的大型 JW 万豪品牌度假酒店，欢迎莅临下榻，探索碧绿的竹海和巍峨的青山。我们的酒店拥有舒适的客房，服务热情周到，还可欣赏高尔夫球场的迷人景致。在宽敞的客房中开启新一天，随后您可前去参观竹博园，尽情探索园内的博物馆和园林景观。您可于此尽情领略当地茶文化， 您也可携全家前往全新的凯蒂猫主题公园游玩，尊享天伦之乐。您还可在高尔夫球场尽情挥杆，在酒店室内泳池畅游，啜饮当地出产的白茶，或尊享放松身心的水疗服务，开启休闲之旅。同时，您可以随心选择一处酒店餐厅享用美食，或在精美迷人的酒廊中尽情放松。安吉既适合举办社交活动和商务会议，又适合休闲旅游。您可在酒店现代化的宴会厅或会议室中举办活动，并可邀请客人探索当地的自然风光和绿色生态工业。
description.textEn: Discover towering bamboo forests and green mountains during your stay at JW Marriott Hotel Zhejiang Anji, An Magnificent Resort JW Brand hotel in China. You will be warmly welcomed at our resort designed with comfortable guest rooms offering views of the golf course. Wake refreshed in your spacious room before exploring Bamboo Park, with its museum and gardens. Immerse yourself in the local tea culture. Or enjoy family attractions such as the new Hello Kitty Park. Start your leisure journey through playing golf, refreshing in our indoor pool or sipping locally white tea and relaxing in our soothing spa. Afterward, dining in one of our restaurants or unwinding in the stunning lounge. Anji is an inspired destination for social events and business meetings as well as leisure travel. Host your event in our modern ballroom or meeting rooms, and invite guests to explore natural wonders and ecologically friendly industries.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Anshun, Huangguoshu
records.name_zh: 安顺黄果树福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Anshun Huangguoshu located in Huangguoshu scenic area, Anshun City, Guizhou Province
description.textEn: The Four Points by Sheraton Huangguoshu Hotel is located at No. 230, Boyuan Road, Huangguoshu Tourist Area, Zhenning Buyi and Miao Autonomous County, Anshun City, Guizhou Province. It is adjacent to the Huangguoshu National Scenic Area and only 2 kilometers away from the core scenic area, with convenient transportation. The hotel is surrounded by green trees and mountains. The guest rooms offer views of the karst landform and the sunset. The hotel offers different experiences throughout the four seasons (enjoying flowers in spring, watching waterfalls in summer, tasting fruits in autumn, and enjoying health care in winter). The hotel is surrounded by rich tourism resources. Besides the Huangguoshu Waterfall, it is also convenient to visit the Stone Village Scenic Area, the 1000-year-old Buyi Ancient Village of Gaodang, and Loong Palace.

description.textZh: Enjoy free hot breakfast includes omelets, bacon and mini waffles along with other favorites like fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and free breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani Greek yogurt and bacon. Then add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Baoding High-Tech Zone

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Baoding High-Tech Zone is an intermediate business featured hotel of Marriott International Group, the hotel owns 153 guest rooms and 24h free self-service fitness center and unique restaurant.
description.textEn: As the first hotel with brand of Fairfield in Hebei province, Fairfield by Marriott Baoding High-tech Zone is always ready to provide the best and professional service to our guests. With spacious 153 guest rooms, each room features first-line brand facilities. 24h free self-service fitness center and unique restaurant to create valuable stays experience to our guests. Our hotel sits in a high-tech zone with excellent traffic conditions,make it an ideal place for guests to stay. It is only fifteen-mintue drive from our hotel to VANBO plaza and twenty-minute drive to local attractions, such as Baoding Ancient Lotus Garden,etc. We are looking forward to your arrival.

description.textZh: 雄安万豪万枫酒店是您旅途中不错的舒适栖身场所。酒店大堂创新布局，集前台、商务、社交、休闲等功能于一体，流畅的动线设计带来高效便捷的入住体验。酒店拥有设计感和功能性的客房，温暖的大地色系搭配自然风格装饰与现代化家具，营造温馨舒适的休憩氛围，精心调试的灯光为空间更添美感。客房均配备舒适床品、高清电视、高速无线网络、多种电源接口等便利设施，满足商务与休闲的多元需求。 酒店的万枫餐厅每天供应品种齐全的自助早餐。 24小时健身中心可助您时刻保持强健体魄。无论您是因商务出行或旅游休闲来访雄安, 雄安万豪万枫酒店友好且细心的员工们很高兴为您服务, 我们致力让您在雄安拥有一个愉快而难忘的经历。
description.textEn: The hotel lobby has been innovatively designed, featuring spacious and flexible spaces, while offering rich coffee and exquisite snacks, integrating business and social aspects. The hotel's 119 guest rooms combine design and functionality - the interior design is dominated by warm colors, the decoration uses natural style materials, and is complemented by modern furniture; the lighting and color schemes have been meticulously designed and adjusted by professional teams to create a warm and comfortable atmosphere for guests. Each room is equipped with a "Slede" brand mattress and the upgraded Wanfeng soft cotton bedding, creating a sweet dream bed; it also comes with a 55-inch LED TV, free high-speed wireless network, adjustable lighting and various power interfaces, meeting the diverse needs of modern guests.

description.textZh: 包头茂业万豪酒店是万豪在该地区率先开设的酒店, 致力于呈献轻松舒适、周到便利的旅行体验, 商务休闲两相宜。酒店距离包头火车站约 15 分钟车程, 乘车 35 分钟左右即可到达包头机场。包头茂业万豪酒店位于昆都仑区的商业中心地段, 步行约5分钟可达阿尔丁广场、步行约10分钟可达阿尔丁植物园或苏宁广场。驱车约15分钟即可造访北方兵器城、约20分钟车程可达赛罕塔拉城中草原。约1小时车程即可到达沙漠景区，畅享大漠美景。包头茂业万豪酒店设计时尚雅致, 设有 297 间客房和套房。三家时尚餐厅, 为您开启愉悦的美食之旅。酒店的会议室和宴会设施面积逾 2,000 平米, 是举办婚礼和商务会议的理想之选。酒店内设健身中心和恒温室内泳池, 舒适放松的休闲体验尽在此间。
description.textEn: Marriott makes its debut in the region with the Baotou Marriott Hotel, offering business and leisure travelers an outstanding combination of comfort, service and convenience. Only a 15-minute drive from the Baotou Railway Station, and a 35-minute drive from Baotou Airport. Located in the business center of Kundulun District, it takes only 5-minute to Aerding Square, and 10-minute to Aerding Botanical Garden or Suning Plaza by walk. The North Weapon Park and the Saihantala Inner City Grassland are within 20-minute drive. About one-hour drive to the desert attractions from the hotel. Contemporary and elegant in design, Baotou Marriott Hotel features 297 guest rooms and suites. A delightful gastronomic experience awaits at three stylish restaurants. With over 2,000 square meters of meeting rooms and banquet facilities, Hotel offers comprehensive venues for weddings and business meetings. Hotel also offers an onsite fitness center, heated indoor pool, provides guests with a comfortable and relaxing experience.

description.textZh: 酒店拥有303间海景客房及套房，4间各具特色的餐厅与酒吧；2,600平方米灵活多变的会议空间，其中包含1,000平方米的无柱式大宴会厅，160平方米的多功能厅和6间尺寸灵活的会议室，以及1,000平方米式户外草坪，是举办各类会议、婚礼及活动的理想之选。室外泳池可供畅享水的灵动与自由，配置丰富的健身中心可供旅行之余保持健康在线；儿童俱乐部可供享受温馨亲子时光，星空酒吧可在夜幕降临后领略迷人夜景及适口佳酿。
description.textEn: The hotel has 303 sea-view rooms and suites in total, along with four distinctive restaurants and bars. It offers 2,600 square meters of flexible conference space, which includes a 1,000 square meters grand ballroom, a 160 square meters Zhongda Function Room and six meeting rooms. Additionally, there is a 1,000 square meters garden-style outdoor lawn, making it a perfect place for romantic weddings and inspirational meetings.

description.textZh: 北海喜来登度假酒店是由万豪国际集团与广西旅游发展集团倾力打造的国际豪华滨海度假型酒店项目。酒店位于广西北海市冠头岭国家森林公园内，依山傍海，以得天独厚的优势为您打造一个享受绮丽风光的海滨休闲度假圣地。酒店交通便利，距离北海市区火车站约20分钟车程，距离北海福成机场约50分钟车程。酒店设有218间客房及套房，拥有中餐厅、西餐厅及咖啡吧，同时配备了健身中心、户外泳池、水疗中心和儿童乐园等丰富的休闲娱乐设施，以及1200平方米灵活多变的宴会及会议空间，融合喜来登品牌焕新元素设计，致力于为到访北海的商旅、休闲旅客以及本地宾客打造一处海滨度假风格的“会聚之所”。宾客可在此品味本地珍馐，广式风味等特色主题餐饮，也可参与喜来登“手牵手”家庭计划等活动，度过一段舒适、自在以及温馨的居停时光。
description.textEn: Sheraton Beihai Resort is located in GUANTOULING Forest Park and right beside the sea. Hotel has convenient location which only 20 minutes from Railway Station and 50 minutes driving distance from the Beihai Fucheng Airport, respectively. Sheraton Beihai Resort features 218 guest rooms and suites, two restaurants and one coffee bar, with leisure facilities including Fitness center, Outdoor swimming pool and Kids club, and 1,200 square meters of flexible spaces for banquets and conferences. Enjoying an unforgettable vacation experience, guests may revel in local delicacies or international gourmets here, and experience a variety of leisure facilities such as side by side family program etc.

description.textZh: 北京怀柔雅乐轩酒店坐落于以大科学装置集群和前沿科技交叉研究平台为核心的北京怀柔科学城内，周边旅游资源丰富，宾客仅需短途车程即可到达雁栖湖、红螺寺、慕田峪长城等著名风景名胜区。酒店设有243间兼具潮流科技和设计美学的“乐窝”客房，充能站(Depot by Aloft)全日餐厅供应西式佳肴和怀柔特色美食，能量站(Re:fuel)全天候供应外带简餐。活力涌动的W XYZ酒吧提供招牌鸡尾酒。此外，酒店还设有Splash泳池、全天候开放的健身站(Re:Charge)、适合孩子畅玩的儿童俱乐部，以及4间策略会议室。值得一提的是，北京怀柔雅乐轩酒店拥有独特的户外雅庭，让宾客尽情享受休憩放松的时光。北京怀柔雅乐轩将为热衷音乐、追求科技实验体验和设计感的旅客带来时尚创新、充满活力的下榻体验。
description.textEn: Aloft Beijing Huairou is located in the Huairou Science City of Beijing. The new hotel is surrounded by abundant tourist resources, and guests can easily reach famous scenic spots. Featuring 242 guestrooms, the hotel offers Western cuisines and Beijing's local cuisine at Depot by Aloft, its all-day dining restaurant, a selection of grab & go meals at Re:Fuel as well as signature cocktails at W XYZ Bar. Additional facilities include the hotel's Splash pool, 24/7 Re:Charge Gym, Kids Club for families traveling with childrens. Aloft Beijing Huairou will provide a fashionable and innovative stay experience full of vitality for music enthusiasts, as well as those who pursue high-touch, and design aesthetics.

description.textZh: 北京海淀雅乐轩酒店采用大胆的阁楼风格设计, 为充满活力的首都北京带来了新气象, 下榻期间, 您可于此尽情展现自我风格。酒店地处高科技机构和高等学府云集的城市中心地带, 可便利前往颐和园、奥运场馆等众多热门目的地！ 您可在我们的 w xyz(SM) bar 交朋会友, 在“雅乐轩能量：站”全日制餐厅品尝各式甜点、开胃品或健康小吃, 或于我们的“中转：站”休闲厅尽情休闲娱乐。此外, 还可通过酒店的免费有线和无线高速网络与世界联通！ 我们的快活乐窝客房配备舒适的特色睡床、步入式淋浴间等众多便利设施, 轻松愉悦的住宿体验尽在此间。即插即用型连接器可为所有电子设备充电, 并可连接 42 英寸液晶电视, 让您工作和娱乐更加便利。
description.textEn: Celebrate your style at Aloft Beijing, Haidian, where bold loft-inspired design enlivens China's vibrant capital. We're in the heart of the high-tech and university district, with easy access to the Summer Palace, Olympic Stadium, and more! Meet and mingle with friends at our w xyz(SM) bar, grab a sweet, savory or healthy snack from re:fuel by Aloft(SM), our 24/7 pantry or play in our re:mix(SM) lounge. Plus, you can always stay connected with hotel-wide wired and wireless High-Speed Internet Access! Breeze into one of our Aloft rooms, featuring our ultra-comfortable signature bed, walk-in shower and more. Our plug & play connectivity station charges all your electronics and links to a 42” LCD TV to maximize work and play.

description.textZh: 北京宝格丽酒店位于京城专属使馆区的核心地带，在酒店的整体设计上，与品牌旗下所有的宝格丽酒店及度假村一样，北京宝格丽酒店一如曩昔的选择了意大利久负盛名的建筑事务所ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel来共同打造北京宝格丽酒店。北京宝格丽酒店拥有119间典雅的客房及套房，其中包括一间宝格丽套房，所有房间均由意大利奢华家具品牌如Maxalto和B&B Italia打造而成。 占地1500平方米的宝格丽水疗中心拥有11间豪华私人理疗室，一个健身中心和一个从罗马卡拉卡拉浴场中获取灵感而设计的25米室内恒温游泳池，宾客可在此感受身心的复苏与重生，开启焕然舒缓的水疗与健身体验之旅。宝格丽酒店的意式珍馐素来受到饕客喜爱，北京宝格丽酒店在延续这一美食传奇的同时，亦是首家与米其林星级名厨Niko Romito合作的宝格丽酒店及度假村。宝格丽酒吧窖藏丰富，宾客可在全球宝格丽酒店及度假村标志性的椭圆形吧台品鉴各种鸡尾酒、红酒、香槟以及更具特色的宝格丽餐前酒，并可在户外露台饱览河畔私属花园美景，尽享非凡意式生活。
description.textEn: The Bvlgari Hotel Beijing is conceived as the ultimate Urban Resort: it rises within the Genesis Beijing, an oasis of tranquility that balances art and nature with sculpted gardens that extend along the Liangma River and include the Genesis Art Gallery. Designed with the contemporary style of the Italian architectural firm ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel, the hotel will feature 119 rooms and suites, including a 380-sqm Bvlgari Suite. The hotel offer the first Il Ristorante presenting the collaboration with Michelin-starred Italian chef Niko Romito, The Bvlgari Bar, a private park, a 1500-square-metre BVLGARI SPA, a 25-meter pool and a BVLGARI ballroom, establishing a new benchmark for enlightened luxury living and personalized services.

description.textZh: A Peaceful Retreat at the Foot of the Great WallCourtyard by Marriott Beijing Yanqing · A Restorative Mountain Journey for Body and Mind
description.textEn: Leave the bustle of the city behind and journey northwest to Yanqing, where verdant mountains embrace the landscape on three sides. Within easy reach of Beijing, this refreshing natural sanctuary offers a rare sense of stillness and space.Here, the rhythm of urban life gently gives way to the ease of mountain living. Courtyard by Marriott Beijing Yanqing is more than a place to stay — it is an inviting base from which to discover the natural beauty, historic landmarks and restorative landscapes at the foot of the Great Wall.

records.name_zh: 北京未来科学城万怡酒店

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun, Courtyard by Marriott Beijing Changping makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious, thoughtful guest rooms; a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive.
description.textEn: Located at north of the Future Science City in Changping District, Courtyard by Marriott Beijing Changping is adjacent to the Beijing-Chengde Expressway and Wenyu River Park. It is only 10 kilometers away from the Beijing Capital International Airport and approximately 800 meters from the Future Science City North Station of Line 17. Experience unparalleled convenience at Courtyard by Marriott Beijing Changping, guests can effortlessly reach Wangjing, Beijing workers stadium, Sanlitun and CBD. Courtyard continues to innovate the guest experience to meet the changing needs of today’s modern traveler. The hotel’s newly designed guestrooms feature solid colors with a warm and neutral palette, adding calm and sophistication to any stay, with subtle accents that add just a pop of color. 283 modern guestrooms, and suites are all located on the upper floors from 15-26, allowing guests to enjoy panoramic views of the Future Science City.

description.textZh: At Element Hotels you can stay relaxed and refreshed while away from home.Element ensures that you have everything you need to stay balanced and true to your values - whether your stay is a quick weekend getaway or a weeks-long trip.
description.textEn: Inspired by Westin Hotels & Resorts, Element Hotels encourages a sense of wellbeing through a nature-influenced environment. Intuitively constructed with an efficient use of space, and with a focus on sustainability,Element helps you stay connected, feel alive and balanced while you're away. Reflecting the smart design of urban residences, our guestrooms maximize space and enable you to use the room in multiple ways. Wake up to our complimentary Rise breakfast offering whole fruits,nourishing granola, a build-your-own-parfait Chobani Yogurt station, and hot items from the kitchen, where you can savor a healthy spin on breakfast favorites.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Beijing Capital Airport
records.name_zh: 北京首都机场万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 北京首都机场万豪万枫酒店坐落于首都机场交通核心区，距T3航站楼及新国展仅需8分钟车程，免费接送机服务无缝链接全球枢纽。酒店以木质灰调美学为灵魂，打造182间雅致客房及套房，配备舒达定制床垫、亲肤泡泡纱寝具及智能客房系统，于喧嚣空港中构筑静谧休憩空间。万枫早餐厅凭倚透明顶落地窗呈现中式庭院景观，每日供应新鲜烹制的健康早餐与本地风味。五间私密包房专注特色小火锅，以定制汤底与优质食材温暖商旅脾胃。24小时开放的健身中心配备专业器械，自助洗衣房提供便捷焕新服务，110m²多功能会议室搭载智能影音系统，全面满足高效差旅需求。万枫品牌秉承 “简约不简单” 的哲学，以可靠服务与简约设计，成就高效旅程的完美平衡。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Beijing Capital AirportStrategically positioned in Beijing Capital Airport's transportation hub, the hotel is a 8 minute drive to T3 and New China International Exhibition Center (CIEC). Complimentary 24-hour shuttles run exclusively between hotel and Terminal 3 and Terminal 2.182 wood-grey toned rooms feature Sealy® custom mattresses, breathable piqué bedding, and smart controls – creating serenity in the airport bustle.Start mornings in light-filled elegance, breakfast with courtyard views through skylight windows, serving freshly prepared local specialties. Five intimate dining rooms dedicated to hot pot with curated broths and premium ingredients.Embodying "Simple Made Perfect™", Fairfield delivers reliable comfort through its 24-hour fitness center, self-service laundry, and 110m² smart meeting room – all designed to empower productive stays with minimalist sophistication.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Beijing Daxing Airport
records.name_zh: 北京大兴机场万枫酒店

description.textZh: 北京大兴机场万枫酒店所在的多功能综合体还包含会议中心、企业办公室和零售中心，为旅客提供更加便利的住宿选择。酒店拥有 149 间客房，从标准客房到套房均配备灵活办公区、55 英寸 LED 电视、步入式淋浴间、免费高速 Wi-Fi 和新风系统。万枫餐厅位于一层，设有 60 多个座位，供宾客尽情畅享品类丰富的自助早餐。大堂是一处设计精美的公共空间，宾客可于此办理入住、进行社交或畅享上网接入。住宿期间还可畅享“自助”洗衣房、空中花园、万枫酒店便利店等设施。 7 天 24 小时开放的健身中心设施齐全，供您在旅行途中也能坚持锻炼。 丰富的设施与服务，为您缔造舒适高效之旅。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Beijing Daxing Airport is located within a multi-use complex consists of hotel, conference center, commercial offices and a retail center, offering travelers much more convenient accommodation options. The hotel features 149 guestrooms ranging from standard rooms to suites, all being equipped with flexible working space, 55-inch LED televisions, walk-in showers, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and air purification system. The Fairfield Restaurant located on 1st floor, more than 60 seats, guests can enjoy buffet breakfast with a wide food options. The lobby is a well-designed communal space allowing guests to check in, socialize and enjoy internet access. The “Self-Service” Laundry, Garden In The Air, Fairfield Market available during the accommodation stay. The 24/7 fitness center is well equipped, allowing guests to maintain their exercise routine while in traveling times. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_zh: 北京海淀万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fairfield By Marriott Beijing Haidian offers 188 technology-enhanced, elegantly designed guest rooms. Strategically located near Beijing Subway Line 16's Daoxianghu Station, the hotel provides parking services and conference facilities equipped with projectors, LED screens, video conferencing tools, and full-area high-speed Wi-Fi to support your mobile office needs. Rooms feature self-service laundry amenities and wake-up call services for added convenience. Designed for efficiency, the hotel ensures seamless productivity. The in-house buffet restaurant accommodates 60 guests, serving breakfast with carefully curated ingredients to energize your day.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Beijing Olympic Sports Center
records.name_zh: 北京奥体中心万枫酒店

description.textZh: 北京奥体中心万豪万枫酒店位于朝阳区安翔路，毗邻北四环，优越的地理位置为宾客探索北京的现代化魅力提供了便利。酒店距离国家游泳中心直线距离仅445米；距离国家体育中心直线距离仅850米；距离国家会议中心直线距离仅1.1公里；酒店出发，可便捷通达周边各商业中心及名胜古迹，是商务及休闲旅游的的居停优选。北京奥体中心万豪万枫酒店设有灵活的开放空间，精心设计的酒店大堂集前台、商务、社交等功能于一体，流畅的动线设计为宾客带来高效的出行体验。酒店共有175间兼具功能性和舒适度的现代化客房，客房采用干湿分离设计、智慧化控制系统，免费高速无线网络等设施，于细节处考究，满足当代宾客的多元需求。
description.textEn: Located on Anxiang Road in Chaoyang District, adjacent to the North 4th Ring Road, Fairfield by Marriott Beijing Olympic Sports Center is ideally located for guests to explore Beijing's modern charm. Adhering to the brand core value of "smooth, reliable and optimistic" and Marriott's quality standards, the hotel provides 24-hours 7-days service, focusing on bringing a new balanced and efficient lifestyle to the new generation of business travelers who pursue efficiency and pay attention to quality of life.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing Fangshan
records.name_zh: 北京房山福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing Fangshan is situated in the core area of Fangshan , with outstanding transportation convenience. The hotel provides comfortable guest rooms, a breakfast restaurant, a fitness center.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing Fangshan is situated in the core area of Fangshan , with outstanding transportation convenience. Adjacent to the subway station, the hotel allows easy access to the entire city, while an on-site parking lot is also available for guests traveling by car. Within a 5‑kilometer radius, a wide variety of shopping malls, local and international cuisines, cinemas and entertainment venues can be found, fully catering to both business and leisure demands. The hotel provides comfortable guest rooms, a dedicated breakfast restaurant, 24/7 fitness center, signature Best Brews craft beers and free high‑speed WiFi covering the entire property. With comprehensive facilities and attentive service, it delivers an efficient, convenient and comfortable experience for business and leisure travelers alike.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing Sanlitun Workers Stadium
records.name_zh: 北京三里屯工体福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店的新概念餐饮空间“玩啤食社”(The MESH)提供多样化餐饮体验。位于6层的全日制“玩啤食社· 餐厅”(The MESH Restaurant)氛围轻松休闲,提供中西式自助早餐、环球美馔及北京烤鸭、炸酱面、炙子烤肉等地道美味。“玩啤食社· 啤”(The MESH Bar) 位于酒店1层，从早到晚全时段的消费场景满足商务洽谈与休闲社交的多元需求。白天，宾客可享受品类丰富的香茗茶饮、醇香咖啡、环球佳饮及特色小食；夜晚则化身为动感活力的酒吧，宾客可品饮品牌标志性“醇饮优选”( Best Brews™)计划甄选的特色精酿啤酒，或品尝以老北京风味豆汁调配的创意鸡尾酒，沉浸于京城夜生活的魅力与惬意。
description.textEn: The hotel's new dining concept, The MESH, offers diverse experiences. The MESH Restaurant on the 6th floor serves Chinese and Western buffets, global cuisines, and local specialties like Peking duck.The MESH Bar on the 1st floor meets business and social needs all day. During the day, guests can enjoy teas, coffee, and snacks. At night, it becomes a bar where guests can sample Best Brews™ craft beers or Beijing - inspired cocktails made with fermented mung bean juice.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing West Station
records.name_zh: 北京西站福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻北京西站福朋喜来登酒店，这是一家现代化酒店，地理位置得天独厚，紧邻北京西站 —— 这座城市的主要交通枢纽之一。我们以热情的服务、舒适的设施以及便捷抵达核心景点和商业区的优势，迎接每一位宾客的到来。您可以在我们设施完善的客房与套房中放松身心，房间内配备现代化家具、高速 Wi-Fi 和舒适床品，为您带来安稳的睡眠体验。您也可以使用酒店内的健身中心，保持日常锻炼习惯；也能在自助洗衣设施处清洗衣物，让着装焕然一新。在酒店餐厅，您能品尝到各式美食，既有地道的本地特色佳肴，也有备受喜爱的国际风味；还可以在酒店酒吧享用精选精酿啤酒或特调鸡尾酒。无论您是出于商务出行、休闲度假，还是经火车站中转，北京西站福朋喜来登酒店都能为您在城市交通网络的核心地带提供一个便捷舒适的休憩之所。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing West Station, near Beijing West Railway Station (a major transport hub), offers warm service, comfy amenities, and easy access to attractions/business districts.Rooms/suites have modern furnishings, high - speed Wi - Fi, and cozy bedding. Use the fitness center or self - service laundry. Dine on local/international cuisines, enjoy drinks at the bar.Suitable for business/social events. Ideal for business, leisure, or transit travelers, it’s a convenient, comfortable haven in the transport network.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing Xidan
records.name_zh: 北京西单福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 北京西单福朋喜来登酒店是万豪集团旗下的一家高端商务酒店，地处北京市西城区核心商务区，地理位置十分优越。酒店配备全新现代化设施与综合型智能控制系统，致力为宾客打造舒适无忧的住宿体验。酒店拥有120间高雅智能客房及套房，配备前沿智能设施，可满足商务及休闲旅客的多元需求。酒店地理位置优越，步行约250米可直达西单大悦城，距天安门广场约2公里、故宫约4公里。酒店交通便捷，方便宾客轻松抵达各大城市地标，是商务出行、观光游览的理想下榻之选。酒店秉持“至诚至简”的品牌理念，服务贴心高效，为每位宾客打造高端惬意的居停体验。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing Xidan is a high-end business hotel of Marriott Group, strategically situated in the core business district of Beijing’s Xicheng District. It features brand-new modern facilities and comprehensive intelligent control systems, dedicated to delivering a comfortable and hassle-free stay for guests. The hotel offers 120 upscale smart guest rooms and suites equipped with cutting-edge smart amenities to meet the diverse needs of business and leisure travelers.Boasting an exceptional location, the property is just a 250-meter walk from Xidan Joy City, approximately 2 kilometers from Tiananmen Square and 4 kilometers from the Palace Museum. Benefiting from convenient transportation and easy access to major urban landmarks, it is perfect for business trips, sightseeing and other travel arrangements. Upholding the brand philosophy of "Sincerity and Simplicity", the hotel provides thoughtful, efficient services and creates a premium, cozy stay for all guests。

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing, Haidian Hotel & Serviced Apartments
records.name_zh: 北京海淀永泰福朋喜来登酒店及服务公寓

description.textZh: Refuel with supportive amenities at our hassle-free hotel in Beijing's technology district, minutes from famous sites and destination shops.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing, Haidian Hotel and Serviced Apartments offers luxury, comfort and style. This 4-star hotel is conveniently located in Beijing, just minutes from famous sites and destinations such as Olympic Stadium, Tiananmen Square, The Summer Palace, The Ming Tombs and the Mansion of Prince Gong. For the shopping enthusiasts, Huayu Fashion Mall is located less than 5 miles away. Refuel with supportive amenities at our hassle-free hotel in Beijing's technology district. Work out at our indoor gym, take a swim at our indoor pool, enjoy a nice meal at one of the two on-site restaurants and recharge with a good night's sleep in our signature, comfortable beds. Four Points by Sheraton Beijing, Haidian Hotel and Serviced Apartments will certainly provide a memorable and relaxing experience for every guest.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Beijing, South Railway Station
records.name_zh: 北京南站福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 北京 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 北京JW万豪酒店坐落于北京朝阳区CBD核心地段，近使馆区，步行3分钟即达北京SKP购物中心及地铁1号线与14号线大望路站，无缝衔接故宫、天安门、王府井、北京环球度假区等地标与文化胜地。距北京首都国际机场约45分钟车程，大兴国际机场约50分钟，旅程连接世界，亦畅达京城。酒店设有588间典雅客房与套房，呈现现代风格与静谧视野。入住行政楼层，可尊享餐前小食及精美甜点时光、下午茶与晚间鸡尾酒时光，从容满足每一段旅途的节奏。在户外匹克球场释放能量，于JW Garden绿意空间深呼吸，或于恒温泳池与健身中心中感受身心平衡。步入北京，也在这里找回生活的从容本真。JW万豪，心之所归，自在此间。
description.textEn: Located in China Central Place, Beijing CBD, JW Marriott Hotel Beijing is near the Embassy District and just a 3-minute walk from Dawanglu Station (Subway Lines 1 & 14). It offers direct metro access to the Forbidden City and Universal Beijing Resort, with both airports 45–50 minutes away by car.The hotel boasts 588 spacious rooms (starting from 42 sqm) with panoramic windows, marble bathrooms, rain showers, soaking tubs and signature bedding. Griffin-themed family rooms come with playful welcome gifts for kids.Guests can relax in the 1,000-sqm JW Garden, featuring a pickleball court, yoga lawn and fresh herbs. Asia Bistro serves Chinese and Japanese buffet with alfresco garden seating.Twelve event venues include a 1,230-sqm ballroom, Loong Gallery and outdoor lawn—ideal for weddings and meetings. An Executive Lounge and 24-hour gym blend business and leisure seamlessly.Where calm meets the capital—stay in the moment at JW Marriott.

records.name_zh: 北京粤财 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 北京粤财JW万豪酒店坐拥古都北京市中心宣武门黄金地段，遥望天安门、故宫、西单等多个名园胜景及繁华商业区。出行方便快捷，多条地铁线近在咫尺。酒店共有406间客房，房间宽敞舒适，设计现代时尚。60间套房中包括17间配备厨房的公寓套房及13间设有开放式景观阳台的空中花园套房。24小时“为您服务”专员为宾客提供全天候、高水准的个性化服务。酒店拥有2,500平方米先进的宴会与会议空间，800平方米无柱大宴会厅层高6.7米，配有30平米高清LED屏幕和投影仪，并且可分隔成三个小会议厅。300平方米的大客厅为公寓风格，设有多功能会议区域、就餐区和开放式厨房，使工作与娱乐无缝对接。酒店三间主题餐厅及一间酒吧提供当地及各国美食体验，顶层的豪华健身俱乐部设有24小时高科技健身房、按摩浴池、蒸汽室和桑拿房，以及玻璃屋顶标准恒温泳池，让宾客在此能够放松身心，享受一份恬静。为了给各位宾客带来更具个性化的视听体验，我们精心提供了包括中文和英文在内的多语言电视频道。酒店即将引入今日俄罗斯与俄罗斯环球等频道，进一步丰富我们的频道选择，确保所有下榻于此的客人都能感受到家一般的温馨与熟悉。
description.textEn: JW Marriott Hotel Beijing Central enjoys a prime location in Xuanwumen, the ancient heart of Beijing, ideal for both executive retreats and leisure travelers. The hotel features 406 luxuriously appointed guestrooms, including approximately 17 Residence Suites equipped with kitchens and 13 Sky Garden Suites. Three restaurants and one lounge provide a variety of local and international gourmet experiences. The top-floor health club offers guests exquisite experience of 24-hour full-quipped gym, whirlpool, steam, sauna and a swimming pool with abundant natural light. A dedicated event floor includes an 800 sqm Grand Ballroom, a 300 sqm residential-style Living Room and nine function rooms. To create a more tailored viewing experience, we provide multi-language TV channels including Chinese and English. We are excited to soon expand our selection with RT Russia Today TV and RTR Russsia Television and Radio-Planeta, ensuring all guests feel at home.

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels®, we thoughtfully consider each detail so you can feel at home as you explore the world. We invite you to unwind in sophisticated spaces thoughtfully designed to make you feel at home®.
description.textEn: At Marriott Hotels®, we know that our job is to stay one step ahead, always anticipating your needs. So, as you and your needs evolve, so do we. As masters of our craft, we believe our legacy is built with every stay®.

records.name_en: The Imperial Mansion, Beijing Marriott Executive Apartments

description.textZh: 开启迷人的北京之旅。北京这座拥有悠久历史的古城融合了时尚现代的风貌和历久弥新的文化古韵，现代化的建筑楼群与古代宫殿在这里交相辉映，别具风采。北京万豪行政公寓装修豪华，并紧邻王府井大街。 公寓拥有一居室，两居室，家庭套房、亲子套房和三卧室公寓式客房共220套，每套客房均提供设施齐全的厨房、用餐区、客厅、高速无线上网，这里是各种短期和长期住宿的理想之选。北京万豪行政公寓内设有健身中心和室内阳光泳池，可一览故宫景致。步行距离可轻松到达天安门广场及故宫博物院等名胜。宾客可前往位于二层的怡然居享用国际美食。 在这里，城市精彩触手可及。
description.textEn: Experience the ideal blend of location and welcoming services at The Imperial Mansion, Beijing Marriott Executive Apartments. Situated in Wangfujing, in the midst of Beijings business, entertainment and shopping area, our hotel is the ideal choice for every traveler to this exciting city. Feel at home in our generously-sized, one, two and three bedroom, family and kids apartments, each with a fully-equipped kitchen, a dining room, a living room, complimentary WiFi and great amenities. Take in views of the Forbidden City from the fitness center and our light-filled indoor pool with soaring skylights. Enjoy delicious dining in our Residents Lounge, where our hotel's chefs create tempting international cuisine. Nearby, you'll find Tiananmen Square and Forbidden City, Wangfujing Street, temples, parks and nightlife. Whether staying with us for vacation or an extended visit, we look forward to welcoming you to our Apartments.

records.name_en: The Sandalwood, Beijing - Marriott Executive Apartments
records.name_zh: 北京紫檀万豪行政公寓

description.textZh: 在繁华的中国北京，想寻找到能切合您每一个期望的豪华酒店式公寓吗？北京紫檀万豪行政公寓是不错的选择，紧邻四惠桥华贸商圈，莅临闻名遐迩的中国紫檀博物馆，中国早期开设规模宏大的私人博物馆，这里犹如喧嚣商业中心一片宁静的绿洲。酒店内宽敞的一居、二居、三居室套房，面积从108平米起至286平米不等，我们希望无论您是商务出行还是进行家庭旅行，娴静安谧方便的住宿环境都能给您别样的住宿体验。搭乘地铁很快便可到达繁华的华贸商务中心，北京朝阳区规模宏大且繁华的综合性购物中心，您可随时享受华美的都市景色或采购生活用品。几分钟地铁即可到达秀水市场，虹桥市场和众多北京热门目的地。酒店周围有北京规模宏大的美松高尔夫球练习场和绿意盎然的兴隆公园，您可享受城市别样的现代风情和广阔的城市美景。北京紫檀万豪行政公寓用优质服务和精良住宿环境为您在这个活力四溢的城市里创造一个非凡的休憩场所，希望我们能不断的带给您惊喜与鼓舞。
description.textEn: Besides being situated in one of the best locations in Beijing, ALL ROOMS at this Marriott property are larger than 100 square meters (over 1000 square feet) ALL equipped with separate bedrooms and independent living rooms, redefining how luxury travel should be. We are a 10-minute drive from the SKP Shopping Mall (Beijing’s most luxurious shopping district), China World Trade Center (the commercial hub inside the CBD), the CCTV building (Beijing’s poster construction), and much more. The Line 1 Subway nearby provides fast, direct access to the Forbidden City and other UNESCO sites, The Great Hall of the People, the National Center for Performing Arts, and Universal Studios Beijing. The adjacent China Red Sandalwood Museum allows a quick cultural experience when time is short. And the Beijing Capital International Airport (PEK) is only 30 minutes away.Welcome to convenient, new luxury living at The Sandalwood Beijing Marriott Executive Apartments.

description.textZh: 坐落于国家4A级旅游景区内的北京乐多港万豪酒店，紧邻京藏、京新两条高速公路，从市区开车仅需40分钟左右。周边自然风光秀美，文物古迹众多，距离居庸关长城、明十三陵等众多国家级景区仅十几分钟车程，距离八达岭奥莱仅5分钟车程。酒店拥有424间现代化的客房、套房以及6套隐秘性极强的宽敞别墅，部分房间更设有独立阳台可远眺燕山山景，更有部分房间与知名IP合作，打造了备受广大宾客热爱的家庭主题房。除此以外，酒店6,500余平米的万豪汤乐宫，打造了儿童戏水池、草本养生池等21个特色汤池。同时，酒店还配备了儿童俱乐部、台球室、弹球室和综合娱乐室供客人选择。万豪中餐厅主打粤菜和本地特色菜肴；臻厨餐厅奉上迷人西餐和亚洲美食。酒店拥有总面积约4,505平米的会议和婚礼活动空间，包括2个宴会厅和17个多功能厅，可容纳约12至1100名客人在此举办或参加活动。
description.textEn: Next to the Visionland Funcapital Park and leduogang WANDA Plaza, Beijing Marriott Hotel Changping welcomes travelers in China with modern rooms and numerous amenities. Relax in contemporary hotel rooms and suites, family suites or private villas. Many of the rooms enjoy balconies overlooking the mountains. Accommodation features include flat-screen TVs, sofas, large desks and WiFi access. Private villas offer open kitchens and access to an inviting courtyard hot springs pool. Resort guests can take a dip in the infinity pool and indoor and outdoor hot springs. Take advantage of our restaurants, day spa and gym. Sophisticated meeting and wedding venues are spread across nearly 48,500 square feet of space. Explore outlet shopping and the theme park or travel beyond Changping to sights including Beijing's Juyongguan Great Wall, Badaling Great Wall and Ming Tombs.

description.textZh: 北京怀柔万豪酒店坐落于怀柔科学城核心区域，毗邻雁栖湖国际会展中心，距市中心约60公里，坐拥静谧自然与科技氛围。酒店周边汇聚中科院物理研究所、中科院空天信息创新研究院等顶尖科研机构，并可轻松抵达雁栖湖风景区、红螺寺、慕田峪长城等自然与文化胜地，成就“科技+生态”交融的旅居体验。交通亦十分便捷，距怀柔北站约10分钟车程，首都国际机场约65分钟。酒店拥有1365平方米灵活多功能会议空间，包括565平方米无柱宴会厅及4间组合会议室，满足各类高端活动需求。272间客房以黄花城水纹为设计灵感，配备高端设施与定制用品，尽显现代雅致。贡厨全日制餐厅、万豪中餐厅、大堂吧与行政酒廊共同呈现多元美食体验，恒温泳池、24小时健身房与儿童俱乐部更为一站式旅居增添活力与惬意，是商务差旅、家庭度假与活动举办的理想之所。
description.textEn: Beijing Marriott Hotel Huairou is situated in the heart of Huairou Science City, adjacent to the Yanqi Lake International Convention Center. Surrounded by leading research institutions, it offers convenient access to attractions like Yanqi Lake, Hongluo Temple, and Mutianyu Great Wall, delivering a unique blend of technology and nature. The hotel boasts excellent connectivity, approximately 10 minutes from Huairou North Station and 65 minutes from Beijing Capital International Airport. The hotel features 1,389 square meters of meeting space, including a 565-square-meter pillar-free ballroom and four modular meeting rooms. Its 272 guest rooms blend modern elegance with design inspiration from the rippling waters of Huanghuacheng. Diverse dining options are available at GOJI, MOHAO, and the Lobby Lounge, while a heated swimming pool, fitness center, and kids' club complete the leisure experience. This makes it an ideal choice for both business travelers and family vacations.

records.name_zh: 北京海航大厦万豪酒店

description.textZh: 北京海航大厦万豪酒店是一家国际品牌商务酒店，地理位置得天独厚，位于朝阳中央商业区中心地带，毗邻北京第三使馆区。 酒店紧邻地铁 10 号线、机场快线三元桥站以及北京首都国际机场，交通便利。拥有311间豪华客房和套房，提供国际标准的舒适享受和高科技设施，房内配备 42 英寸液晶电视和高速上网，还可欣赏到周围的壮丽景观。会议与宴会设施面积总计达 1,600 平方米，更配有经专业培训的宴会策划专家，是婚礼庆典或商务会议的理想筹办之所。海航大厦万豪酒店坐拥朝阳中央商业区中心地带，内设健身俱乐部、室内恒温泳池以及三间餐厅和酒吧。
description.textEn: Beijing Marriott Hotel Northeast is an international business hotel ideally situated in Beijing's Chaoyang CBD, in close proximity to the city's Third Embassy District. Our hotel in downtown Beijing is close to Metro Line 10, Airport Express Sanyuanqiao Station and Beijing Capital International Airport for convenient access to transportation. Featuring spectacular views, our Beijing hotel offers deluxe guest rooms and suites meeting international standards of comfort and technology, including 42-inch LCD TVs, high-speed Internet access and premium amenities. With 1,600 square meters of meeting and banquet facilities, our hotel in downtown Beijing offers breathtaking spaces for weddings and business meetings, as well as the assistance of our well-trained event professionals. Our hotel also offers an on-site fitness center, heated indoor pool and three restaurants and bars. We look forward to greeting you soon at our upscale hotel in the middle of China's Chaoyang CBD District.

description.textZh: Enrich Your Senses at Beijing Marriott Hotel Yanqing, which is designed for both leisure and business purpose traveler, to creates a relaxing living environment and a space to inspire.
description.textEn: Beijing Marriott Hotel Yanqing is in the center of Yanqing CBD, only 4 kilometers (15-minute drive) away from Yanqing Railway. It is next to Beijing Badaling International Convention and Exhibition Center and Beijing Yanqing Wanda Plaza, creates a friendly business surrounding area especially for business travelers. Also, there are many different attractions to visit, such as Beijing Expo Park, only takes 12-minute by car, and Badaling Great Wall, Yudu Mountain Nature Reserve, Yongning Ancient City only about an hour trip.

records.name_zh: 北京北辰万豪侯爵酒店

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels®, we thoughtfully consider each detail so you can feel at home as you explore the world. We invite you to unwind in sophisticated spaces thoughtfully designed to make you feel at home®.
description.textEn: At Marriott Hotels®, we know that our job is to stay one step ahead, always anticipating your needs. So, as you and your needs evolve, so do we. As masters of our craft, we believe our legacy is built with every stay®.

description.textZh: 【北京富力万丽酒店】都市灵感新坐标，毗邻国贸核心商圈，步行可轻松到达地铁站，30分钟接驳首都机场专线。便利的出行交通为您的北京探索之旅带来别样体验与充沛灵感。酒店客房已焕新升级，云端景观房独揽国贸繁华、万丽客房明快与沉静并存、行政大床房包容家庭出游的所有温馨、精致套房以当代美学唤醒都市灵感；多种不同房型，满足您不同需求的入住体验。多个餐厅为商旅客人奉上寰宇风情：意大利餐厅烛光氤氲，演绎暗红光影中的罗马情调；雅苑中餐厅新中式装饰中名厨手造，镌刻舌尖上的东方美学；自然采光的BLD西餐厅，环球美馔在自助餐台翩然起舞。夜晚的灵感万丽活动，更可用一杯特调饮品来放松身心。超过2,300平米的多功能空间及配套设施，自然采光的大理石台阶，既是商务盛典的舞台，亦是梦幻婚礼的殿堂。24层行政酒廊以尊宠体验精英礼遇，27层天际恒温泳池，270°落地窗器械区，在CBD华灯流转中重塑身心平衡。
description.textEn: New inspiration hub in Beijing CBD, near Shuangjing Subway – convenient for every journey. In May 2026, all guestrooms are renovated. CBD View Executive Suites offer CBD scenery. Executive King Bed Rooms have a folding bed for families. Family Suites have a multi-room layout. Renaissance Rooms balance energy and calm.Multiple dining venues: The Garden Chinese Restaurant, BLD All-day Dining, Fratelli Fresh, and evening parties at The Lounge.Over 2,300 sqm of multifunctional space with a marble staircase for events & weddings, plus flexible meeting rooms. 24th-floor Executive Lounge (renovated) with CBD views, breakfast, quick check-in/out. 27th-floor Health Club: 270° views, heated pool. At Renaissance Beijing Capital Hotel, hospitality embodies companionship & discovery.

records.name_zh: 北京中关村东升科技园万丽酒店

description.textZh: 北京中关村东升科技园万丽酒店临近众多城市公园和北京的著名景点，能够满足商务、会议和旅游等各类住宿需求。该酒店巧妙地将传统的军事营地特色与现代高科技设计风格相结合，打造出具有当地特色的文艺复兴品牌，并以当地元素为灵感，创造出独特的餐饮风格和宾客体验，彰显文艺复兴品牌的独特地方特色，为宾客提供深刻且难忘的旅行体验。北京海淀文艺复兴酒店共有 321 间现代优雅的客房和套房，所有房间都将采用该品牌富有戏剧张力的现代设计风格。所有房间均配备有马鞍形座椅和通透的落地窗。
description.textEn: Renaissance Beijing Haidian Hotel is close to a number of urban parks and Beijing landmarks, and can meet the comprehensive accommodation needs of business, conference and tourism. The hotel ingeniously blends traditional military encampment features with modern high-tech design styles, crafting a unique Renaissance brand with local characteristics, and inspired by local inspiration to create a unique dining style and guest experience, cast a special local characteristic of the Renaissance brand, to provide guests with a profound and unforgettable travel experience. Renaissance Beijing Haidian Hotel features a total of 321 modern and elegant rooms and suites, all of which will adopt the brand's modern design aesthetic that is rich in dramatic tension. All rooms are equipped with saddle-shaped chairs and panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows.

description.textZh: 多年来，王府井大街一直是各种活动的中心，时至今日，步行街仍是深受外来游客和当地居民青睐的旅游、购物胜地。作为万豪国际集团旗下的五星级酒店，北京金茂万丽酒店闹中取静，提供豪华的设施设备和细致入微的服务，让宾客在繁华地段尽享商旅体验。酒店位于北京市中心，距离故宫约2公里，距离天安门广场约4公里，距离地铁8号线约400米，共有321间客房，其中包括16间套房，每间都融汇了时尚现代与温馨典雅的色调，其中西区客房可欣赏到紫禁城的美景。 宾客可以方便地前往附近的小吃街享用当地特色美食，也可以在酒店的餐厅和酒吧品尝来自世界各地的美食佳肴。近1000平米的宴会厅在王府井地区位列前茅，并设有五间可灵活布置的会议室，可满足您的不同需求。酒店设施时尚现代，室内泳池和健身中心，为宾客悉心打造健康生活方式。
description.textEn: Deftly combining traditional elegance and modern style as a Marriott Luxury and Lifestyle Hotel, the Renaissance Beijing Wangfujing Hotel delivers an enchanting experience in the heart of the city. Set against the backdrop of Beijing's lively Wangfujing Street, our hotel offers immaculately designed rooms and suites - many of which feature breathtaking views of the Forbidden City, one of China's most beloved landmarks. Iconic attractions including Tiananmen Square are just moments from our door, as are the local delicacies of Snack Street. As a guest at the hotel you will enjoy access to our fitness center as well as our serene indoor pool. Delicious onsite dining options abound, ranging from the seasonal tastes of China at Wanli to international fare and an exciting open kitchen atmosphere at Food Studio. Planning an event in Beijing book the impressive Jinmao Ballroom the largest of its kind in Wangfujing.
