description.textZh: Innovative, Modern Rooms for Every Stay
description.textEn: Business & Leisure Hotel That Inspires Connection

records.name_zh: 北京新青海喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 北京新青海喜来登酒店坐落于北京市区西南隅，是北京丽泽金融商务区的一部分。酒店西北方向是八达岭长城，东北方向是王府井购物大街、故宫和天安门广场，让您轻松探寻北京风貌。酒店地理位置优越，可便利前往北京大兴国际机场、北京丰台站、北京南站和西站。酒店拥有约 2,000 平米的多功能空间，可承办各类中小规模企业活动。酒店内设三间富有当地风情的餐厅，其中包含提供地道西北风味的青海餐厅。另外，酒店设有 361 间时尚客房和套房坐拥城市美景，配备免费 Wi-Fi，可提供 24 小时客房送餐服务。下榻北京新青海喜来登酒店，畅享元气满满的旅行生活。
description.textEn: Situated in the southwest corner of downtown Beijing, Sheraton Beijing Lize Hotel is part of the Lize Financial Business District. The Great Wall at Badaling to the northwest and Wangfujing Shopping Street, the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square to the northeast are all within reach, allowing leisure and business guests to experience the sights and spirit of Beijing. The location provides convenient access to the Beijing Daxing International Airport, Fengtai Railway Station, South Railway Station and West Railway Station. Combined with our hotel’s 2,000 square meters of function space, we are ideally positioned to meet the needs of any small to mid-sized events. Energize at our three locally inspired restaurants, including one Qinghai Restaurant offering authentic northwestern flavors. Our Beijing hotel in China allows guests to experience 361 contemporary guest rooms and suites with free Wi-Fi, 24 hour room service and city views. Feel empowered at Sheraton Beijing Lize Hotel.

records.name_zh: 北京金隅喜来登大酒店

description.textZh: 北京金隅喜来登大酒店坐落于北京市北三环路交通网络核心地带，毗邻地铁12号线安贞桥站（C出口），步行1分钟即可到达酒店，可便捷抵达王府井、鸟巢、水立方等现代地标，金融街、中关村等商业核心区以及故宫、雍和宫等历史文化景区。酒店拥有439间温馨宜人的客房，其中包含70间套房，面积43至240平米不等，可满足各类宾客的入住需求。酒店三个各具特色的餐饮场所精选了世界各地风味美食，盛宴自助餐厅、雅·觅餐厅和聚驿时光大堂酒廊。酒店全天24小时开放的健身中心，配备Wi-Fi无线网络与先进器材，采用专业设计方案，助力宾客通过高效健身快速取得成效，室内泳池高层落地窗环绕，让您随时焕活身心。酒店设有近3,000平方米的会议和宴会空间，涵盖大宴会厅与多功能厅，充满创意的会议空间为商务活动、社交宴会提供特色舞台，激发协作灵感。作为品牌精髓的延伸，酒店内设有喜来登开放式艺术画廊，以“社区共享”理念将艺术融入空间，定期呈现艺术家的创意作品，打造充满灵感的社交场所。无论是商务差旅、休闲度假，还是探索京城文化底蕴，这里都将成为您理想的下榻之选。 在这里，传统与现代交织，艺术与生活共鸣——北京金隅喜来登大酒店，开启您的京城聚享之旅。
description.textEn: Sheraton Grand Beijing Dongcheng Hotel directly connected to the Anzhenqiao Station on Metro Line 12 and Metro Line 5 which only takes 10 minutes’ ride to cultural landmarks like Lama Temple and Drum Tower for Hutong exploration. You may also connect further to Forbidden City, Wangfujing,Summer Palace, etc., all in 30 minutes’ metro ride while hotel is merely 30 minutes’ drive to Beijing Capital International Airport and 90 minutes’ drive to Beijing Daxing International Airport. Hotel features 439 stylish guest rooms with Sheraton's signature Sleep Experience bedding, guests can also enjoy 3 restaurants featuring Western, Itameshi and Lounge with 24 - hour Sheraton Fitness Center with sunlit indoor swimming pool for relaxation. A signature Sheraton Open Art Gallery also perfectly embodying the Sheraton DNA of the World’s gathering place. It brings art to the community with Sheraton Community mindset, we have everything you need to work, stay and play in Beijing.

description.textZh: 北京瑞吉酒店坐落于静谧优雅的使馆区核心地带，紧邻长安街，可快速直达北京首都国际机场或北京南站，与天安门、故宫等名胜古迹仅数街之隔。酒店步行约7分钟即可抵达建国门地铁站，乘地铁2号线可直达工人体育场，1号线则可轻松前往环球度假区站。作为奢华典范，我们传承纽约瑞吉酒店的百年传统，为您呈现标志性的管家服务、入夜仪式、经典下午茶，以及享誉全球的瑞吉血腥玛丽。漫步于著名的王府井大街后，您可前往铱瑞水疗中心尽享身心焕活之旅，这里拥有源自地下1500米的天然温泉。我们更以一系列奢华设施为您缔造非凡体验：自然采光玻璃幕墙泳池、约6000平方米的景观花园、三家风格迥异的特色餐厅及两间招牌酒吧，皆为您呈现无与伦比的栖居享受
description.textEn: The St. Regis Beijing is located in the heart of Beijings quiet, diplomatic compound in a noble setting only 400 meters away from a city highway leading you directly to Beijing Capital Airport or Railway South Station. It takes about 7 minutes to walk from the hotel to Jianguomen Subway Station, and Subway Line 2 will directly lead to worker stadium, Subway Line 1 will directly lead to Universal Resort Subway Station. Our luxury hotel offers many of the legendary St. Regis traditions created at The St. Regis New York, including our personalized Butler Service, Evening Ritual, Afternoon Tea and the St. Regis Bloody Mary. After a stroll along Wangfujing, a famous shopping street, indulge yourself at our Iridium Spa, complete with a natural hot spring that originates 1,500 meters below the surface. Let us pamper you with additional luxury amenities, such as a stunning glass walled swimming pool, a 6,000 sq meter landscaped garden, three exceptional restaurants and two signature bars.

records.name_zh: 北京金融街丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: Located on the legendary Financial Street, The Ritz-Carlton Beijing, Financial Street is one of the most luxury 5-star hotels in Beijing. Let us plan your stay, where you’ll discover untold luxuries and refined culture and history.
description.textEn: A contemporary design of glass and chrome defines the sparkling exterior, while inside, the hotel will exude elegance and warm hospitality in true Ritz-Carlton style. Two exceptional restaurants, a 1,500-square-meter/16,146-square-foot health club, and a choice of spacious meeting rooms will be among the Ritz-Carlton Beijing, Financial Street's many distinguishing features.

records.name_zh: 北京北辰丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: The Ritz-Carlton sets the standard in elegance for business and leisure travelers worldwide. We've been perfecting the art of hospitality and have developed an approach to luxury that has never been duplicated.
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton sets the standard in elegance for business and leisure travelers worldwide. We've been perfecting the art of hospitality and have developed an approach to luxury that has never been duplicated.

description.textZh: 北京丽思卡尔顿酒店位于北京的繁华商业区——华贸中心，地处北京中央商务区的中心地带，距离北京国际机场约 30 分钟车程，可便捷前往众多当地历史和文化景点。酒店由 HBA Design Consultants 担纲设计，拥有 305 间设施齐全的客房，处处体现丽思卡尔顿酒店经典雅致风范。酒店设有 Aroma 等两间备受认可的精致餐厅，全天供应全球美食；酒廊供应下午茶和西式美味。酒店建筑内还设有意大利餐厅 ATTA 以及米其林上榜的京季餐厅。其他专享设施包括水疗中心、健身中心、带阳台的室内泳池、约 1,100 平方米的会议空间、约 648 平方米的宴会厅以及一座室外花园。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Beijing, is centrally situated in one of Beijing’s most thriving business area – China Central Place, within the heart of the city’s central business district, the hotel is 30 minutes away from the Beijing International Airport and offers easy access to the city’s historical and cultural landmarks. In a classic Ritz-Carlton style, timeless and elegant, the hotel, designed by HBA design consultants, features 305 well-appointed guest rooms. Two exquisite award-winning restaurants including Aroma serving world cuisine throughout the day and The Lounge serving afternoon tea and western food. This building also includes Italian Restaurant ATTA, and Michelin star restaurant Jing Ji. Other exclusive facilities include Spa, fitness center, indoor pool with balcony, 1,100 square-meter meetings and conference space, 648 square-meter Ballroom and an outdoor garden.

records.name_zh: 北京金融街威斯汀大酒店

description.textZh: 经过整体焕新升级后的北京金融街威斯汀大酒店2020年耀目归来。酒店位于北京核心二环内的西城区金融街，邻近众多国际闻名的金融机构和购物中心，以及天安门广场、故宫博物院、中国国家博物馆、妙应寺白塔等城市文化地标景点。宾客步行可达4条地铁线路，乘坐1号线可直达北京环球影城，2号线直达雍和宫，4号线直达动物园、圆明园，19号线一站即达传统美食一条街——牛街；酒店距离北京南站约20分钟车程，距离首都国际机场约45分钟车程，距离大兴国际机场约60分钟车程，为休闲及商务旅客提供便捷的出行选择。升级后的酒店共有9个自然采光充足的会议室，总面积可达到1,618平方米。483间修饰一新后的客房，显得更为宽敞雅致，搭配特色威斯汀天梦之床和薰衣草睡眠精油，让每一位宾客更深刻地体会到威斯汀的酣然好梦。位于酒店五层的威斯汀健身中心和恒温泳池，让宾客在旅途中尽享活力运动的健康生活。一层Plush大堂吧通透的设计将自然光引入室内，是商务会谈和品味美味下午茶的理想之选；食集自助餐厅为宾客提供各种环球美食和本地精选美味；Prego地中海餐厅提供经典美味的地中海美食，让每一位宾客足不出户就能品尝到浪漫的美食。与此同时，酒店26层行政酒廊为每一位行政楼层的宾客在提供精致美食之外，更能一览北京繁华景致。
description.textEn: Newly renovated in 2020, The Westin Beijing Financial Street is located in the Financial Street of Xicheng District, close to many internationally renowned financial institutions and shopping centers, the city's cultural landmarks such as Tian'anmen Square, The Palace Museum, etc. Guests are able to walk to 4 subway lines, Line 1 to Beijing Universal Studios, Line 2 to The Lama Temple, Line 4 to The Old Summer Palace, one stop to the traditional food street - Niujie Street by Line 19; 45 minutes' driving distance to Beijing Capital International Airport and 60 minutes' to Beijing Daxing International Airport.Each spacious guest room is elegantly decorated and offers free Wi-Fi, TV and more, plus the signature Westin Heavenly Bed. Take a dip in our indoor swimming pool, get in some exercise at our Westin Workout. With three dining options on site offering a variety of cuisines, you won’t have to venture far to find extraordinary food. Enrich your mind with high-quality accommodations and instinctive services.

records.name_zh: 蚌埠龙子湖万豪万枫酒店
毕节越秀万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Healthy memory and enjoy for bloosom in your travel.Seat in Baili Alazea scenic,Baili is forest park as well as a national ecologic tourist demonstrasion area. Surrounding site include tourist center, PUDI scenic spot, Tiaohuapo Scenic spot, Jinpo Scenic,Huahai culture town. Easy travel for any spot.The property embraced 188 guest room,including 37 rooms overlooking mountain view. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, and fresh breakfast options. Chinese restaurant will feed your discovery for local food. 520 sqm meeting space and outdoor lawn offer multim option for customer event. 200 sqm indoor swimming pool and 25 hot spring pool make you relaxing and comfortable after the whold day travel.

description.textZh: 新疆赛里木湖AC酒店位于海拔2073米的“西域净海”-赛里木湖畔，坐落于景区东岸的天境里度假区，举步即达赛湖景区东门入口。天境里购物中心紧邻酒店，轻松悦享购物、娱乐、用餐一站式体验。AC酒店“少即是多”的设计理念于天山湖光中勾勒出“功能与美学共生”的旅居新典范，155间客房均配备55英寸高清液晶电视、步入式淋浴间、空调与暖气及免费高速Wi-Fi等设施。酒店共配备AC餐厅及AC咖啡吧，为宾客打造横跨欧亚风味的独特饮用餐体验。为全球旅行者带来一场“精简于形、细致于心”的沉浸式旅行体验。
description.textEn: AC Hotel by Marriott Xinjiang Sayram Lake is located beside the "Western Region's Pure Sea" – Sayram Lake – at an altitude of 2,073 meters. Nestled within the Paradise Town on the eastern shore of the scenic area, it is just steps away from the East Gate entrance of Sayram Lake. Adjacent to the hotel is the Paradise Town, offering effortless access to shopping, entertainment, and dining in a one-stop experience.Embodying AC Hotel's design philosophy of "less is more" amidst the Tianshan mountain and lake scenery, the hotel sketches a new paradigm of hospitality where "functionality and aesthetics coexist." All 155 guest rooms are equipped with 55-inch HD LCD TVs, walk-in showers, air conditioning and heating, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi.The hotel features both an AC Restaurant and AC Cafe, crafting a unique dining and drinking experience with flavors spanning Europe and Asia. It offers global travelers an immersive travel experience that is "The Perfectly Precise Hotel."

records.name_zh: 长白山万达喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: The hotel is located in the resort area where birch forests and cedars intersect. Most of the guest rooms are equipped with independent balconies, so you can enjoy the panorama of the Changbai Mountains or the ski resort landscape without leaving home.
description.textEn: The hotel is cleverly connected to the Westin hotel through a unique corridor bridge, allowing guests to enjoy the wonderful benefits of both brands at the same time. 292 exquisite and spacious guest rooms and suites with Sheraton's signature sleep experience, enjoy a good night's sleep. Caiyuexuan Chinese Restaurant provides guests with authentic and authentic traditional cuisine. The Feast Flag Restaurant offers Western and Asian cuisine, including buffet and à la carte services.The hotel has a total area of over 2400 square meters and 10 independent multifunctional halls, including a 1240 square meter pillarless banquet hall. The hotel gym provides advanced aerobic and strength training equipment. There are also rich parent-child activities and several cute Shiba Inu dogs interacting with customers in the store.

records.name_zh: 长白山万达威斯汀度假酒店

description.textZh: 长白山万达威斯汀度假酒店坐落于森林之间，紧邻亚洲几个规模宏大的滑雪度假村，距长白山机场 (NBS) 仅约十公里。长白山精彩纷呈的户外活动均近在咫尺。敬请前往威斯汀健身馆或宁静的室内泳池强身健体，或是通过时尚现代的威斯汀天梦水疗中心焕发活力。您还可在我们三间充满活力的餐厅及酒吧中享用新鲜烹制的国际、韩餐及当地美食。酒店所有 262 间时尚客房（包括 31 间套房）均设有威斯汀天梦之床、水疗式雨林淋浴间、iPod 基座、人体工学办公区（带高速上网接入）及落地窗，许多客房还可欣赏秀丽的山峦景观。
description.textEn: Next to some of Asia's largest skiing resort, The Westin Changbaishan Resort is also nestled into the forest and just ten kilometers from Changbaishan Airport (NBS). The many exciting outdoors activities on Changbai Mountain are all within easy reach. Recharge in our WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio or our serene indoor pool, and re-center in our contemporary Heavenly Spa by Westin™. Find delicious renewal in our three alluring bars and restaurants, offering freshly prepared international, Korean and local fare. All our 262 sleek guest rooms, including 31 suites, feature the Westin Heavenly® Bed and spa-like rain forest shower, plus an iPod docking station, ergonomic work space with high-speed internet access and floor-to-ceiling windows-many with mountain views.

description.textZh: Courtyard by Marriott Changchun is the first Courtyard Brand to be stationed in Changchun City.
description.textEn: Easy access to the Changchun West Railway Station and located in the Changchun Automobile Economic Development Zone close to FAW NBD. 286 Rooms, 5 Meeting Rooms, Pavilion All-Day Dining Restaurant and Chinese Restaurant.

records.name_zh: 长春朝阳万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Changchun Chaoyang Hotel is located on the city's central axis-Renmin Street in Changchun City. t is positioned as a 'City Collection' hotel offering guests the best value experience.
description.textEn: The hotel has a total of 127 guest rooms, all equipped with comfortable bedding, 55 inch LCD TVs, all day free high-speed wireless internet access and other convenient facilities, which can meet the different needs of contemporary guests

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Changchun Jingyue High-Tech Zone
records.name_zh: 长春伟峰万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 长春伟峰万豪万枫酒店坐落于净月开发区，坐拥得天独厚的生态资源，不仅是长春的“生态绿核”，更汇集了众多高品质的文旅资源；与有着天然氧吧之称的净月潭国家5A级森林公园、吉林省博物馆等20余处文旅地标紧密相邻。酒店周边交通便利，可步行至地铁6号线，直达多个著名景点及长春西高铁站；多个商业综合体亦可供选择，方便休闲购物需求。酒店拥有150间舒适的客房，采用简约而温馨的设计理念，去繁就简，让宾客感到轻松自在、宾至如归。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Changchun Jingyue Hi-Tech Zone sits in Jingyue Development Zone-a prime spot with unique ecological resources. As Changchun’s "Ecological Green Core," this area blends natural beauty and top cultural-tourism attractions, with the hotel near over 20 landmarks (e.g., 5A Jingyuetan National Forest Park, "natural oxygen bar," and JilinProvincial Museum). Transport is a key plus: it’s walkable to Metro Line 6, direct to famous spots and Changchun West High-Speed Railway Station. The hotel has 150 comfortable rooms, designed simply yet warmly. Stripping excess, each room offers a relaxed, welcoming vibe to make guests feel at home.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Changchun West
records.name_zh: 长春汽开区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于北国长春汽车产业开发区核心地带, 毗邻同心湖公园, 风景宜人。驱车前往长春西站仅4公里, 约10分钟车程, 前往长春火车站11公里，约20分钟车程。距离长春网红打卡地这有山5.7公里，约15分钟车程。前往龙嘉国际机场50公里, 约50分钟车程,。地理位置优, 交通便利。酒店配有172间舒适客房, 多房型的选择能够满足不同商务客人的住宿需求。另配有150平米会议室, 健身中心, 全日制餐厅等服务设施。为商旅客人提供优越的入住体验
description.textEn: The hotel is located in the core area of Changchun Automobile Industry Development Zone, adjacent to Tongxin Lake Park, with pleasant scenery. Drive to Changchun West Railway Station only 4 km, about 10 minutes by car, to Changchun Railway Station 11 km, about 20 minutes by car. It is 5.7 km from Changchun, about 15 minutes by car. To Longjia International Airport 50km, about 50 minutes by car. Excellent geographical location and convenient transportation. The hotel is equipped with 172 comfortable rooms, a variety of room types to meet the needs of different business guests. It is also equipped with 150 square meters meeting room, fitness center, full-time restaurant and other service facilities. To provide a superior stay experience for business guests.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Changchun, Hi-Tech Zone
records.name_zh: 长春高新益田福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 一天之旅结束后，不妨回到房间放松身心。酒店拥有 350间明亮宽敞的客房和套房，为您带来如家般的舒适。房间配备您所需的一切设施。您可躺在特色福朋舒适之床上，尽享酣甜睡眠；坐在纯平电视前，观看电影或喜爱的节目；或是使用每个房间都配备的高速无线网络，随心进行网上冲浪。此外，酒店还为您每日补充一次免费瓶装水。
description.textEn: ­After a long day, it`s a relief as you walk into your guest room. You will find all the comforts of home in one of our 350 bright and spacious guest rooms and suites. Our rooms have everything you need. Jump right into the plush goodness of the Four Points signature bed or explore all of what Changchun's Hi Tech Zone has to offer. Stay connected using our wireless HighSpeed Internet Access, available in all guest rooms. Free bottled water is replenished daily We like to keep it simple and leave the hassles of travel outside our hotel, so make yourself at home. We look forward to welcoming you so you can relax and enjoy a great stay at the right price.Offices and retail shopping mall are just steps away.Hotel is just 19 km to Changchun Railway Station.Hotel is just 48 km to Changchun Longjia International Airport, CGQ, just 40 minutes away by car.

records.name_zh: 长春净月潭益田喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店拥有345间面积舒阔的客房，每间均配有舒适喜来登睡床——喜来登特色睡眠体验、干湿分离的卫浴设施、高速上网接入和办公区域。入住酒店期间，还可乐享室内恒温泳池、专业的健身中心、水疗中心、行政楼层和喜来登俱乐部。酒店内设有2间餐厅和2间休闲酒廊，体验优质服务之余，更可感受到喜来登酒店对细节的关注。从国际美食，到精致餐饮，再到咖啡和鸡尾酒……全方位服务的餐厅将满足来自世界各地宾客对美食和环境的不同需要。我们提供各类餐饮选择与休闲设施，酒店完善的多功能会议设施可供举办公司活动或社交聚会。20多间多功能厅和会议室，总面积超过5,900平米。其中面积达1,730平米的益田会议中心尽显豪华高雅格调，层高9米尽显恢弘气势。
description.textEn: There are 345 spacious guest rooms, each with the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience Bed, rainforest shower, high-speed Internet access and ergonomic chair. The hotel also has an indoor swimming pool, professional fitness center, SPA, Club Floor and Sheraton Club. Enjoy Sheraton’s renowned attention to detail and great service at one of our hotel 3 restaurants and 2 leisure lounges. From casual to fine-dining to coffee and cocktail, our full service restaurants will meet all of your taste and environmental needs. We offer a range of dining options, leisure facilities and an adjoining Convention Center for corporate events or social gatherings. There are more than 20 function and meeting rooms and a combined space encompassing 5,900 square meters. Our 1,730-square meter Grand Ballroom lives up to its lofty billing, featuring soaring 9-meter high adorned ceilings.

records.name_zh: 常德武陵天济喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店拥有 289 间温馨迷人的客房和套房，设计以舒适为主，配备宽大的办公桌、符合人体工学原理的座椅、LED 电视和豪华特色喜来登甜梦之床（配有清爽洁白床单、柔软的羽绒被和鹅绒枕），让客人安享放松身心的住宿体验。所有客房及公共区域均有高速无线上网服务覆盖，助您与好友、家人和同事保持通畅联络。您可与好友或家人在 4 间餐厅和酒吧一起进餐，留下欢乐回忆。盛宴餐厅供应新鲜美味的自助餐和点菜，YUE Chinese Restaurant 则供应各种传统中国美食，包括地道粤菜、湘菜和当地特色菜，而在国际风味则可品尝传统美式休闲食品，让您好好犒劳自己。您还可以到大堂吧享受休闲茶歇时光或下班后的鸡尾酒时光。常德武陵天济喜来登酒店拥有 13 处场地，总面积近 3,000 平米，是您举办难忘聚会的理想之地。
description.textEn: Settle in for a relaxing stay in one of our 313 warm and inviting guest rooms and suites, designed with your comfort in mind and featuring a spacious work desk, ergonomic chair, LED television and the plush, signature Sheraton Sweet Sleeper™ bed, with its crisp white linens, soft duvet and plush down pillows. Stay connected to friends, family and colleagues with high speed wireless internet covered in all rooms and public areas.4 restaurants and bars will create happy memories by sharing a meal with friends or family. Treat yourself to a fresh and tasty buffet and a-la-carte at Feast, a burst of traditional Chinese favorites with authentic Cantonese food, Hunan cuisine and local specialties at YUE Chinese Restaurant, and traditional American comfort food at Someplace Else. Or enjoy a casual coffee break or an after-work cocktail at Lobby Lounge. Featuring twelve spaces totaling nearly 2,600 square meters of space, Sheraton Changde Wuling Hotel is the ideal venue for a memorable gathering.

description.textZh: Marking the first Courtyard branded property in Hunan, the hotel combines innovative technology, modern style and comfort, ensuring that business and leisure travelers alike have the space they need to make the most of their time while on the road.
description.textEn: Embrace a blend of contemporary hospitality and modern comfort at Courtyard Changsha South in China's scenic Hunan province. Located in the Zhongjian Plaza, our upscale Changsha hotel is just minutes away from major business locations, shopping, entertainment and a wealth of dining and nightlife destinations. After exploring the city's attractions, take time to discover our hotel's deluxe amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, 24-hour room service, delicious all-day buffet dining and an entertaining open kitchen concept in our on-site restaurant. In the evening, retire to beautifully-styled accommodations with elegant rooms, plush designer bedding, sleek modern bathrooms and complimentary Wi-Fi access. If visiting our Changsha hotel for event planning reasons, take advantage of our sophisticated venues featuring state-of-the-art technology and delicious catering options. Our contemporary hotel provides everything you need for an unforgettable stay at Courtyard Changsha South.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻宁乡万豪万枫酒店，探寻“青铜之乡、红色故里、温泉胜地”。酒店坐落于长沙宁乡经济开区核心区位，地段优越、畅达全城。距宁乡站约 3公里，驱车 6 分钟即达；距宁乡西站 7 公里，10 分钟轻松抵达，高效适配商务出行与休闲出游，出行换乘便捷无忧。酒店毗邻紫荆广场、宁乡步行街等繁华商圈，车程仅 10 分钟，吃喝玩乐购一站式配齐，解锁多元休闲生活。毗邻关山古镇与长沙方特东方神话，距关山古镇约 12 公里、车程 20 分钟，距长沙方特东方神话约 13 公里、车程 20 分钟，轻松衔接三国古韵与亲子欢乐时光。酒店精心打造 100 间雅致舒适客房，旅居体验匠心尽显。全屋标配丝涟品牌床垫、康乃馨亲肤臻选床品，柔软入眠酣然好梦；搭配 55 英寸智能投屏电视、高速 WiFi，兼顾休闲娱乐与办公需求。客房通透高层落地窗设计，开阔视野舒展身心，卸下旅途疲惫，静享静谧悠然时光。酒店万枫早餐厅融汇中西风味美食，大厨匠心烹制多款营养佳肴，鲜香美味唤醒整日活力，以舌尖美味开启惬意旅途。酒店配备24 小时自助健身房，随时焕活活力，挥洒运动热情；自助洗衣房区域，轻松打理出行衣物，周全细致的配套服务，全方位满足商务差旅、家庭出游等各类出行需求。
description.textEn: The hotel is centrally located in the core of Ningxiang Economic Development Zone, Changsha. It is 7 kilometers from Ningxiang West Railway Station, just a 10-minute drive away.Within a 10-minute ride lie Bauhinia Square and Ningxiang Pedestrian Street. It is also close to Guanshan Ancient Town and Changsha Fantawild Oriental Heritage, around 12 kilometers away with a 20-minute driving journey.The hotel features 100 elegant and comfortable guest rooms, all fitted with standard Sealy mattresses and Carees bedding, as well as 55-inch screen-casting TVs and high-speed WiFi.The Fairfield breakfast restaurant offers a rich variety of Chinese and Western cuisines. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour self-service gym and laundry room, perfectly meeting all demands for business trips, family getaways and other travel purposes.

description.textZh: Hotel is located at No. 368 Furong South Road, Tianxin District. The hotel features flexible open spaces and a well-designed hotel lobby that combines front desk, business, social and leisure functions.
description.textEn: The hotel has 112 guest rooms, which are designed in a fashionable, simple and pleasant style, reflecting the simple beauty of Fairfield. All guest rooms are equipped with Schuder Serte mattresses, Waffle skin-friendly series bedding, and the hotel adopts fresh air filtration system, water purification system, intelligent guest control system services to bring you a comfortable experience around the clock to meet the diversified needs of contemporary guests, Fairfield by Marriott Changsha Tianxin Hotel is an ideal choice for guests.

records.name_zh: 长沙岳麓万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店隶属于万豪国际集团万枫酒店品牌旗下。自 1987 年成立以来，公司一直以流畅、可靠和乐观的核心价值观为基础，为宾客提供温馨周到的服务体验。公司还为寻求平衡生活的商务旅客、休闲观光宾客提供更有价值、综合型的呵护。位置：位于长沙市岳麓区金星南路 36 号，梅溪湖公园入口，靠近汽车西站，设有众多商务旅行和旅游设施。酒店交通便利，宾客步行约 10 分钟可至梅溪湖，距长沙高铁站仅约 16 公里路程。
description.textEn: It belongs to the brand of Marriott international hotel - Fairfield by Marriott. Since its established in 1987, the company has been providing guests with a warm and meticulous service experience based on its core values of fluency, reliability and optimism, it also provides more valuable, comprehensive care for business travelers who seeks to maintain a balance life, the guests feel at ease and maintain efficient activities. Location: Located at No. 36 Jinxing South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, at the entrance of Meixi Lake Park, next to West bus station, has perfect business travel and tourism facilities. Convenient transportation, you can walk into Meixi Lake in only ten minutes, it's only 16km away from Chang Shame High-speed Railway Station.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Changsha, Meixi Lake
records.name_zh: 长沙步步高福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻长沙步步高福朋喜来登酒店，酒店位于长沙国家高新技术产业开发区中心地带。这家位于长沙的现代商务酒店，与步步高商业广场相连，出门即可享受购物、娱乐和餐饮体验。此外，酒店距离游乐园、蜡像馆仅咫尺之遥。步行约5分钟即可抵达地铁六号线，六号线可从梅溪湖直达黄花机场。搭乘地铁 2 号线可轻松前往长沙高铁站。酒店地理位置优越，邻近长沙高速公路，距长沙黄花国际机场仅约 40 公里。279 间客房内均设有 42 英寸平面电视，在此可尽享轻松惬意的休闲时光。您可在我们的室内泳池尽情畅游，或随时前往24 小时健身房酣畅锻炼。清晨，在宜客乐西餐厅享用丰盛早餐，开启美好的一天；晚上到聚味中餐厅享用经典湘菜和粤菜。如果您前来参加会议，功能设施齐全的会议厅和宴会厅可满足您的各种需求。长沙步步高福朋喜来登酒店，欢迎您的到来。
description.textEn: Experience an urban retreat in the heart of the new National High-Tech Industrial Development Zone at Four Points by Sheraton Changsha, Meixi Lake. Our upscale hotel in Changsha, China, connects with the BBG Commercial complex - step outside our doors for great shopping, entertainment and dining. Plus, we are conveniently located steps from an amusement park, wax museum and within easy reach of Changsha Huanghua International Airport via Metro Line 6. Our well-placed hotel is also close to Changsha Express Highway and just 40 kilometers from Changsha Huanghua International Airport (CSX). Relax in one of our 279 guest rooms with a 42-inch, flat-screen TV. Take a dip in our indoor swimming pool or work out anytime in our 24-hour gym. Start the day off right with breakfast at the Eatery and end it with a delicious meal at our China Spice restaurant. If you are here for a meeting, you will find a full business center with complimentary internet. We look forward to welcoming you to our modern Changsha, China, ho

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Changsha, Tianxin
records.name_zh: 长沙天心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: At Four Points® by Sheraton hotels, our guest rooms feature comfortable beds, productive workspaces and fast, free Wi-Fi. We offer delicious food, a pool and work-out room and everything you need to host business events and meetings.
description.textEn: The hotel is located in the central urban area of Changsha, surrounded by convenient transportation and delicious food. It is close to Exit 4 of Tiedaoxueyuan Station on Metro Line 1, 8 kilometers away from Changsha South Railway Station and 27 kilometers away from Huanghua International Airport. It takes only 4 subway stops to reach the venue of the large-scale concert - Helong Gymnasium, and 7 subway stops to reach Wuyi Square. It takes only 30 minutes by car to reach the famous tourist attractions and transportation hubs in Changsha. The hotel offers executive privileges to its distinguished Marriott members. It has two 400-square-meter multi-functional meeting rooms to meet various meeting requirements and banquet needs.

records.name_zh: 长沙建鸿达 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 长沙建鸿达 JW 万豪酒店位于长沙东南部。其整体的设计灵感源自湖南的壮美山河景观和社交洞见。酒店内的众多细节均来源于橘子洲、爱晚亭等地标，将丰富多彩的长沙故事融入艺术表达，让宾客在长沙风情中感知历史和文化内涵，获得美好体验。穿云台全日制餐厅、主打现代湘菜的皓羽轩中餐厅以及日式料理餐厅是酒店内的特色餐饮场所，让您沉浸在经典湘菜的火辣风味和世界各地丰富多彩的美食文化中，获得惬意的味蕾体验。宽敞泳池、特色水疗中心和设施齐全的健身中心坐拥壮美城景，将优美的都市风范和雅致的室内设计巧妙融合在一起，供您尽情放松身心，重焕活力。
description.textEn: The JW Marriott Hotel Changsha is located in the southeastern area of Changsha. Its overall design is inspired by the splendid mountains, rivers, and the social insight in Hunan. Inside the hotel, guests will find many details which come from famous landmarks such as Orange Island, Aiwan Pavilion and much more, which engage the story of Changsha with the combination of art. Also sense the historical and cultural significance, and the state of well being immersed with the style of Changsha. To delight your palate, three signature dining venues, Yun Kitchen International All Day Dining, Hao Yu Chinese restaurant boasting Hunan modern cuisine and a Japanese restaurant let you be immersed in the typical hot and spicy Hunan cuisine and the authentic worldwide food culture. Revitalize mind, body and spirit in the spacious swimming pool, relaxing Spa by JW and well equipped fitness center with a breathtaking view of the city, natu rally integrating the beautiful urban style with the elegant interior design.

records.name_en: Meixi Lake Hotel, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Changsha
records.name_zh: 长沙梅溪湖金茂豪华精选酒店

description.textZh: 长沙梅溪湖金茂豪华精选酒店位于历史悠久的长沙市中心地带，是一处依山（岳麓山）傍水（梅溪湖）的现代地标。当地优美的自然景观为这个富有创意的艺术和娱乐中心打造出一幅巧妙的天然背景。欢迎在面积逾 3,000 平米的灵活活动空间相聚，碰撞出丰富多彩的思想交流火花，远眺梅溪湖美景，或在我们的四家餐厅品尝当地精致美食。恒温泳池和宽敞的水疗中心为您提供多种机会，助您恢复良好身心状态。酒店设有 304 间客房，包括六间华丽套房和一间宽敞总统套房，均采用精心搭配的色彩设计，让人联想起传奇故事《桃花源记》，还可观赏从天际线到河畔的优美景观。配有诸多豪华设施，可焕活您的多重感官。
description.textEn: Situated in the heart of the ancient city of Changsha, Meixi Lake Hotel is a modern landmark surrounded by the Yuelu Mountains and Meixi Lake. The area's stunning natural landscape serves as the perfect canvas for this creative center for arts and entertainment. Gather for a dynamic exchange of ideas in over 3,000 square meters of flexible event space overlooking Meixi Lake, or taste local delicacies at our four restaurants. A heated swimming pool and expansive spa offer a myriad of opportunities to restore wellbeing. Colored with accents evocative of The Peach Blossom Spring-a legendary fable-our 304 guest rooms, including six opulent suites and an expansive Presidential Suite, present enchanting views that stretch from the skyline to the riverside. Luxurious amenities enliven the senses.

records.name_en: The Meixi Lake, Changsha Marriott Executive Apartments
records.name_zh: 长沙梅溪湖万豪行政公寓

description.textZh: 选择长沙梅溪湖万豪行政公寓，尽享居家般的舒适便利空间。我们坐落于风光旖旎的梅溪湖畔，下楼即达湖畔步道，让您在繁华都市中私享一片静谧水岸，将长沙“山水洲城”的独特韵味尽收眼底。同时，入住于此既能享受到非凡度假体验，还可轻松抵达长沙各大观光与游玩景点。公寓内超过80%的套房配置，确保了绝大多数宾客都能享受到宽敞如家的空间。每一间套房均配备设施齐全的厨房，让您轻松享有亲手烹饪的温馨乐趣；更贴心配备了嵌入式冰箱与独立洗烘一体机，真正实现“拎包即住”的无忧体验。房间内的全景落地窗，让梅溪湖的四季晨昏成为您房间内流动的画卷。无论是晴空下的波光粼粼，还是夜色中的城市灯火，皆是极佳的旅居背景。为了让小朋友们玩得更尽兴，我们的儿童俱乐部致力于为您的孩子打造一片自在天地，更能为您带来一段“解放双手”的惬意时光。我们诚邀您在此开启一段融合城市精彩与湖居安逸的非凡旅程。
description.textEn: Choose The Meixi Lake, Changsha Marriott Executive Apartments and enjoy a comfortable, convenient home-like space. Nestled by the scenic Meixi Lake, we are just steps away from the lakeside trail, offering you a tranquil waterfront retreat amid the bustling city while immersing you in the unique charm of Changsha – a city renowned for its "mountains, waters, and islets". With over 80% of our accommodations designed as suites, most guests can enjoy spacious, home-like living. Each suite features a fully equipped kitchen, allowing you to savor the warmth of home cooking. Thoughtfully appointed with built-in refrigerators and separate washer-dryer combos, we deliver a truly hassle‑free "pack and live" experience. To ensure our guests have even more fun, our Kids Club is dedicated to creating a carefree world for your children.We sincerely invite you to embark on an extraordinary journey that blends the vibrant energy of the city with the serene comfort of lakefront living.

description.textZh: Changsha Marriott Hotel West: Marriott's first showcase near 5A Yuelu Mountain. 283 rooms offer scenic views. 2 restaurants, a lounge guide food journey. more 2000㎡ event spaces. Skylit pool, 24/7 fitness center create an oasis.
description.textEn: Changsha Marriott Hotel West debuts as Marriott’s inaugural showcase, strategically positioned near 5A-rated Yuelu Mountain with swift access to Orange Isle and Yuelu Academy. 283 thoughtfully designed chambers frame living canvases of mountain silhouettes, lake reflections, and metropolitan energy, with contemporary spaces dialoguing with Hunan heritage in a “cultural gallery”. Two distinct restaurants and a signature lounge guide epicurean journey, and over 2,000㎡event precincts centered around a pillar-free 1,200㎡ ballroom adapts to diverse gatherings. The skylit heated pool harmonizes with daylight, and the 24/7 fitness center pulses with urban vitality, crafting an oasis of renewal.

description.textZh: 下榻长沙运达喜来登酒店，于这座新兴城市的中心地带畅享精彩旅程。 这家尊享酒店地处长沙中央商务区，坐拥优越便利的地理位置，可轻松前往市中心。 从位于市中心的酒店驱车或乘坐地铁，可轻松前往长沙热闹非凡的商业、购物和旅游景点。 入住尊贵客房，尊享大理石装饰的浴室、符合人体工学原理的办公区以及长沙市中心的迷人景色，满足您在中国的各类休闲和放松需求。 尊享酒店出众的餐饮选择，包括地道的湘菜和精致的意大利美食。 酒店拥有出类拔萃的活动空间，总面积逾 2,824 平米，是在中国举办高级商务会议的理想之选。 商务差旅或休闲娱乐，不论您因何来到长沙，我们的市中心酒店都将竭诚满足您的各项需求，助您畅享精彩旅程。
description.textEn: Place yourself at the center of one of Chinas rising cities at Sheraton Changsha Hotel. With a prime location in the Central Business District of Changsha, China, our 5 star hotel in Changsha offers unparalleled access to the city center. Travel easily from our downtown hotel location, by car or subway, to the premier business, shopping and tourist attractions in Changsha. Settle into 5 star accommodations featuring all you need to relax and recharge while in China, from marble-decorated bathrooms to ergonomic workstations and inspiring views of the Changsha city center. Take advantage of our excellent hotel dining options from authentic Hunanese cuisine to refined Italian fare. Our first rate event spaces, totaling over 30,400 square feet, make the perfect site for hosting high level business meetings in China. Whether you are visiting Changsha for business or pleasure our city center hotel provides all you need to go beyond and maximize your time in China.

description.textZh: 长沙瑞吉酒店拥有 188 间精致时尚的客房和套房，将长沙城市美景尽收眼底，让您在快节奏的都市生活中奢享片刻宁静。客房设计精美，装饰中融合了精妙的中国元素。在瑞吉酒店运动俱乐部或高级泳池内焕发活力和光彩。酒店设有六家精美餐厅和酒吧，厨艺精湛的厨师将为食客带来精致优雅的餐饮体验。约 2,000 平米的大宴会厅和其他 8 间雅致的会议室，布置华丽，非常适合举办商务和社交活动。室内装潢优雅华丽，且配有精致巧妙的中式装饰细节。瑞吉管家还将随时为您提供体贴周到的服务，从而提升您的每一次住宿体验。
description.textEn: The St. Regis Changsha offers 188 exquisitely styled guest rooms and suites, boasting sweeping views of the city, forming a luxurious respite from the frenetic pace of urban life. The rooms are beautifully designed and decorated with subtle Chinese touches. Rejuvenate in The St. Regis Athletic Club or the top level swimming pool. Accomplished chefs present exquisite dining experiences in six exceptional restaurants and bar. Spanning 2000 sqm Grand Ballroom and other eight elegant meeting rooms provide magnificent settings for business and social events. Expect sumptuous decor and high end amenities with subtle Chinese touches. Every experience is enhanced with St. Regis Butler Service available any time day or night.

description.textZh: 长沙W酒店坐落于“星城长沙”运达中央广场中心地带，将未来航行概念融入本土文化底蕴，打造绚耀奇幻的“星沙宇宙”之旅，为一众潮流先锋点燃探索未知的磅礴热情。酒店拥有 345间以太空幻境为灵感打造的客房及套房，开启别出心裁的星河穿梭般旅居体验。不论是激发活力的FIT有型健身中心、闲适宜人的WET®碧波泳池还是“星梦工厂”般的AWAY®水疗中心，都致力于让宾客摆脱日常烦忧，焕发活力精彩。TROPICS全日餐厅具有热带风情；灵感源自卡巴莱歌舞秀的星艳中餐厅，以及每一刻都焕然如“星”的RUNWAY酒吧，为您带来别出生面的深度沉浸之旅。超过1000平方米的活动空间，包括5间规模多样的会议室及多功能厅，均配有崭新前沿的会议设备与视听娱乐设施，是举办各类主题活动、大型会议、私人宴请或商务活动的理想之所。酒店提供24小时随时/随需®服务，带领宾客一同探索未知精彩，恣享W燃动“星”风尚。Insider时讯达人，对潮流动向、新锐资讯了然于胸，为您链接这座“娱乐之都”提供多维共振。
description.textEn: W Changsha located in Yunda Central Plaza, the “Star City” - Changsha, integrating the concept of future voyages in native culture to ignite the star power and create a gorgeous journey into “Starsand Galaxy”. W Changsha has 345 guest rooms and suites which are inspired by the galaxy and designed in avant-garde style, offering a unique interstellar experience. The invigorating FIT, relaxing WET®, and dreamlike AWAY® Spa are all dedicated to escape from daily life and being vibrant. All-day dining restaurant TROPICS with full of tropical flair, Chinese restaurant SHINN YEN inspired by Cabaret show and the Avenue of Stars – RUNWAY the destination bar, offer a fantastic and immersive experience. Over 1000m2 of 5 event spaces equipped with cutting-edge conference equipment and world-class audio-visual entertainment facilities, making them ideal for all kinds of meetings and social events. W Changsha offers Whatever/Whenever® service, leading guests to explore the wonder of unknown.

description.textZh: 长沙威斯汀酒店坐落于长沙核心地段，毗邻商业中心与地铁站，交通便捷，轻松通达岳麓山等著名景点。酒店拥有399间客房与套房 。您可在配备力健器材的24小时健身中心和玻璃穹顶恒温泳池中保持活力运动 (Move Well) 。两间特色餐厅与酒吧为您奉上贯彻 “Eat Well”健康理念的营养美味。长沙威斯汀酒店致力于确保宾客以比抵达时更好的状态离开 。
description.textEn: The Westin Changsha is ideally located in a prime downtown area near commercial centers and metro stations , providing easy access to famous landmarks like Yuelu Mountain. The hotel features 399 rooms and suites. You can stay active with Move Well in the 24-hour Fitness Center with Life Fitness equipment and the heated pool featuring a glass dome. Two distinctive restaurants and bars offer nourishing options following the "Eat Well" philosophy. The Westin Changsha is dedicated to ensuring every guest leaves feeling better than when they arrived.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Changshu Hi-Tech Zone

description.textZh: 隶属于万豪国际集团旗下品牌-万枫酒店，自1987年成立以来，以流畅、可靠和乐观的核心价值观为宾客提供热情细致的服务体验，为追求生活平衡保持节拍的商旅人士提供物有所值的全面贴心照顾，让宾客安心自在，保持高效活动。常熟高新区万枫酒店位于常熟高新区东南大道55-57号，拥有完善的商务和旅游设施。酒店地理位置优越，步行10分钟左右即可到达购物中心，5分钟左右可到达昆城湖畔，5分钟左右可到达昆承、常台高速公路。酒店采用简约而温馨的设计理念，去繁就简，让宾客感到轻松自在、宾至如归的体验。
description.textEn: The hotel is conveniently located with in10 minutes walk to the shopping center, 5 minutes drive to the Kuncheng Lake and 5 minutes drive to the Kuncheng and Changtai expressway.The hotel adopts simple and warm design concept to make guests feel relaxed and comfortable.

records.name_zh: 溧阳曲禅里酒店·傲途格精选

description.textZh: 溧阳曲禅里酒店·傲途格精选建筑与山水景致和谐相融，采用传统中式设计元素，与当地自然风光浑然一体。每间客房均可尽览竹林全景，供您沉浸式体验清幽静谧的自然环境。酒店内餐厅甄选时令新鲜食材，打造本地风味美食与环球料理，为食客打造愉悦味蕾体验。我们的度假酒店秉持可持续发展理念，从节能照明到废弃物减量，实行多项绿色环保举措。无论寻求静谧幽居，还是活力出游体验，溧阳曲禅里酒店·傲途格精选均可为您打造难忘旅居体验。
description.textEn: The QuchanInner Liyang, Autograph Collection architecture harmonizes with the surrounding landscape, featuring traditional Chinese design elements that blend seamlessly with the natural beauty of the region. Each guest room offers panoramic views of the bamboo forest, creating an immersive experience that connects visitors with the serene environment.For those seeking culinary delights, the on-site restaurant serves a fusion of local and international cuisine, with an emphasis on fresh, seasonal ingredients. The resort’s commitment to sustainability is evident in its eco-friendly practices, from energy-efficient lighting to waste reduction initiatives.Whether you are looking for a peaceful retreat or an active getaway, The QuchanInner Liyang, Autograph Collection provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable experience.

description.textZh: 常州万怡酒店地处常州、无锡、江阴三市交界的黄金地带，紧邻沪蓉、沪武高速，交通通达顺畅。 酒店距常州高铁站约20公里，距常州高铁北站约22公里，确保旅途出行更为高效便捷。 酒店拥有205间舒适现代的客房和套房，所有客房均设有露台，宾客可轻松饱览舜山怡人景致。 客房均配备舒适床品、步入式淋浴间、55寸高清电视、人体工学沙发、灵活便捷的办公区域及高速无线网络，部分房型还配有戴森高速吹风机，为宾客打造卓越入住体验。 所处的舜山小镇作为集文化、商业、游玩、住宿以及研学为一体的综合性文旅项目，巧妙将传统文化与现代格调相融合，成为当下游客造访常州的理想选择。
description.textEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests. With locally inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You will also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free WiFi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive.

It can be a hermitage of this place where guests will be able to quietly experience the tranquility of leisure, whether it’s for business or leisure traveler. The Qianzi Lake is only 2 kilometers from the hotel with its stunning view captives Jintan residentiaries. The scenic attraction attracts guests to evoke their interest to integrate into the local humanities and nature, which is an ideal and thoughtful place for balance seekers to enjoy their journey.

description.textZh: 常州溧阳万豪万枫酒店是万豪国际集团 旗下万豪万枫 品牌在溧阳地区打造的国际品牌酒店，融合了国际化的酒店管理标准与溧阳本地文化特色，致力于为商务及休闲旅客提供高效、舒适的高品质住宿体验。地处溧阳高新区核心商业区域，交通便利，周边商业配套齐全，毗邻天目湖、南山竹海等著名景点，是商旅人士及游客的理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: The Changzhou Liyang Fairfield by Marriott is an international hotel under Marriott International's Fairfield by Marriott brand in the Liyang area. It combines international hotel management standards with local Liyang cultural characteristics, dedicated to providing efficient, comfortable, and high-quality accommodation for both business and leisure travelers. Ideally situated in the core commercial district of Liyang High-Tech Zone, the hotel enjoys convenient transportation and comprehensive surrounding amenities. Its proximity to renowned attractions such as Tianmu Lake and Nanshan Bamboo Sea makes it an excellent choice for business and leisure visitors alike.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Changzhou Economic Development Zone
records.name_zh: 常州经开区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 常州经开区福朋喜来登酒店位于常州市经济开发区核心位置，距离常州站15公里，常州北站20公里，常州奔牛国际机场40公里。玩啤食社可以为您提供现磨咖啡，特色鸡尾酒以及特色小吃，堂吧供应精致下午茶、各种特色鸡尾酒和当地特色饮品，让您在繁忙的工作生活中能够享受片刻的美好时光。常州经开区福朋喜来登为寻求平衡的旅者提供轻松舒适的旅行体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beerson taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Deliciousbreakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Pointsworkouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personaltraining and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler inmind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻常州艾美酒店, 探索江苏“龙城”——常州的多彩魅力。常州艾美酒店位于新北区中华恐龙园板块, 车程约10分钟内即可抵达常州高铁站等主要交通枢纽。酒店提供多样的餐饮选择。宾客可于北纬31°啜饮艾美咖啡大师特调的illy咖啡, 去新食谱全日餐厅享用丰盛的国际自助早餐, 去东56小酒馆感受常州宵夜文化，亦或是到渔见中餐厅体验常州新菜的魅力, 聚会谈天, 尽享舌尖愉悦。酒店拥有263间客房和套房, 配备大屏飞利浦高清智能电视、独立浸泡式浴缸以及雨林式淋浴间。而席梦思特色睡床, 亦可让您在旅途中尽享一夜好眠, 用充沛活力迎接美好的每一天。酒店紧邻万达广场、江南环球港等大型商超, 地理位置优越。同时, 酒店配备了5间VIP多功能厅和1000㎡的无柱式宴会厅, 超千平的宴会及会议场地搭配自然采光给您足够的空间和高度释放思想, 满足您在繁华商圈中举办多种活动的需求。健身中心配备了专业健身器械、室内游泳池、瑜伽房、儿童乐园等让您充分享受运动带来的乐趣。酒店以艺术家的一天作为设计概念, 以当代设计演绎经典的龙城文化, 来强调人、艺术与自然的平衡, 启发宾客对于常州龙城雅韵的创意灵感。抵达艾美创驿大堂（Le Méridien Hub™）的那一刻起, 宾客沉浸于此, 探索当地文化。常州艾美酒店愿与您共同探索世界, 揭秘目的地。
description.textEn: Welcome to Le Méridien Changzhou and explore the charm of Changzhou, Jiangsu’s “Dragon City”.Located in Xinbei District near China Dinosaur Park, the hotel is a 10-minute drive from Changzhou High-Speed Railway Station. It offers diverse dining: illy coffee at Latitude 31° North, international breakfast at Latest Recipe, local snacks at East 56 Bistro, and New Changzhou Cuisine at Yujian Chinese Restaurant.The hotel features 263 rooms and suites with Philips smart TVs, soaking tubs, rainforest showers and Simmons beds.Close to Wanda Plaza and Jiangnan Global Harbor, it has 5 VIP function rooms and a 1,000 sqm column-free ballroom. Facilities include a fitness centre, indoor pool, yoga studio and kids’ zone.With the concept “A Day in the Life of an Artist”, the hotel combines modern design with Dragon City culture. Le Méridien Hub™ lets guests experience local culture.Le Méridien Changzhou looks forward to exploring the world with you.

description.textZh: 常州万豪酒店设有 263 间全景客房，设计典雅精致、宽敞舒适，可饱览绚丽的城市天际线景观。每间客房均配备先进的设施设备，包括 Wi-Fi 网络、配有羽绒被和纯棉床单的豪华床上用品，以及宽敞的大理石浴室和 42 英寸至 55 英寸的平面电视。酒店设有约 1,900 平方米的会议空间，其中包括面积约 800 平方米的大宴会厅和面积约 280 平方米的尊贵豪华宴会厅。酒店拥有都会尚膳餐厅、豪轩中餐厅、意大利餐厅及大堂吧等 4 间餐饮场所，宾客可尊享各式美味的当地及国际美味菜肴。常州万豪酒店设施齐全，为宾客提供多种健身选择，其中包括室内泳池和 24 小时开放的健身房。
description.textEn: Discover a blend of comfort and convenience in China at Changzhou Marriott Hotel, boasting 263 elegant rooms on the top floors of Changzhous iconic skyscraper. Our prime location is situated near the area's notable attractions, including China Dinosaur Park, Tianning Temple and Hongmei Park as well as many local transportation options. After a busy day in the city, explore the wealth of amenities at our hotel, including a 24 hour health center, an indoor pool and popular onsite restaurants. Unwind with delectable international cuisine in the City Bistro, The Hao Chinese restaurant, Tuscany Grill Italian restaurant and The Lounge. In the evening, retreat to spacious accommodations with WiFi access, marble bathrooms and comfortable bedding with cotton rich linens. If visiting Changzhou for business reasons, enjoy planning productive meetings in 20,623 square feet of modern venue space with hitech audiovisual equipment. We look forward to providing you with a memorable stay in our Changzhou Marriott Hotel.

description.textZh: Located in the heart of Jintan District, half an hour's drive away from Changzhou North Railway Station, Changzhou Marriott Hotel Jintan aims to provide guests with an exceptional and unparalleled service experience.
description.textEn: Located in the heart of Jintan District, half an hour's drive away from Changzhou North Railway Station, Changzhou Marriott Hotel Jintan aims to provide guests with an exceptional and unparalleled service experience. Standing in the commercial center of Jintan, the sophisticated hotel design will be a smart choice for both leisure and business traveler. Guests will enjoy the magnetic beauty of the surrounding scenery and landscape. The famous freshwater lakes in Jiangsu, Changdang Lake; the well-known Taoist cultural sanctuary, Mount Maoshan Scenic Area, the extraordinary destination experience will maximize the guests travel expectation.

description.textZh: 常州星河万丽酒店坐落于风景如画的西太湖，毗邻滆湖湿地公园、金沙湾高尔夫球场，景色秀美，风光旖旎。酒店以“探索新奇与发现美好”为品牌理念，演绎探险之旅，带您卓越体验生活的每一刻。酒店地理位置优越，25分钟车程可达常州市中心、常州高铁站，35分钟车程可达常州奔牛机场。冶艳山川合，风姿烟雨生。常州星河万丽酒店犹如一颗剔透晶莹的珍珠，优雅地倚立在西太湖岸畔，融入了这幅流动的水墨画中。酒店的设计融合了当地特色，极具江南风情，空间和材质的创新运用，以及对独特品质的不懈追求，使得常州星河万丽酒店迷人、奢华而不炫耀。酒店拥有339间别具特色的摩登客房和套房，每间房均坐拥令人惊叹的非凡湖景，并配备豪华的床上用品、高速上网、保险箱和迷你吧。集结中西式精致美馔：“燃”餐厅汇聚各国佳肴的自助餐以及别有情调的A LA CARTE零点，令您始终品尝心仪美味；万丽轩中餐厅提供原汁原味的精致淮扬菜，做工精细，色香味形俱佳。酒店还设有逾3000平米的宴会空间，包括1200㎡无柱大宴会厅、600㎡的多功能厅、以及四间多功能会议室及董事会议室，可为多至3000人提供理想的活动场地，一应俱全的会议及宴会配套服务，将为宾客带来丰富多元化的选择。另有酒吧、恒温泳池、多功能的健身中心、儿童乐园、VR影院等休闲娱乐项目，以及位于 43楼的行政楼层酒廊，其中顶楼还设有直升机停机坪。在此，西太湖碧水绿柳的如画景致尽收眼底。
description.textEn: Set by picturesque the West Taihu Lake where vibrant waters blend into piercing blue skies the Renaissance Changzhou Wujin Hotel opens its doors to a chic environment. The hotel is conveniently located about 40 minutes by car from Changzhou Benniu Intl Airport. There are 339 lakeview rooms with unique lighting layout, simple, and colorful guest room levels bring you extraordinary accommodation experience. The executive lounge on the 43rd floor offers panoramic views of the West Taihu Lake. Our restaurant is full service. You can dine with family and friends at any restaurant in the evening for a gourmet meal. We look forward to welcoming you to Renaissance Changzhou Wujin Hotel.

description.textZh: In the economic development zone and a short walk from ancient ruins, our hotel offers 302 guest rooms and a beautifully-landscaped garden.
description.textEn: In the economic development zone and a short walk from ancient ruins, our hotel offers 302 guest rooms and a beautifully landscaped garden. Sheraton Changzhou Wujin Hotel is located in the Changzhou Wujin District with easy access to shopping and business areas. We are located just 16 kilometers away from the Changzhou Railway Station and 30 minutes by car from Changzhou Airport.

description.textZh: 常州富力喜来登酒店专为当代旅客量身打造。酒店位于繁华的常州中央商务区，距万达广场仅数步之遥，毗邻中华恐龙园等必游景点，是您探索这座中国城市的理想下榻地点。所有客房和套房均设有充裕的放松空间，并辅以豪华床上用品、免费高速 WiFi、纯平电视、光洁迷人的大理石浴室、迷你冰箱和符合人体工学的办公区。此外，酒店配备室内恒温泳池、设施完备的健身中心与非凡的餐厅配套，近 2,137平米的精致场地空间适合举办各种规模的商务会议、婚礼或社交聚会；其中无柱式大宴会厅可容纳约 1,200人就坐，为活动提供别具一格的体验。欢迎莅临常州富力喜来登酒店，探索别样精彩。
description.textEn: Sheraton Changzhou Xinbei Hotel is designed for modern travelers. Boasting the location in the heart of Changzhous vibrant CBD steps away from plentiful shopping at Wanda Plaza and near noteworthy attractions like China Dinosaur Park, our hotel is your home base from which to explore the city during your time in China. All of our intelligently appointed rooms and suites boast plenty of space to relax, as well as plush bedding, complimentary high speed WiFi access, a flat-screen TV, a sleek marble bathroom, a mini-fridge and an ergonomic workspace. Guests can also take advantage of heated indoor pool, a well-equipped fitness center, exceptional onsite restaurant options and almost 23,000 square feet of sophisticated venue space for a business meeting, wedding or social gathering of any size here in the CBD, our pillarless Grand Ballroom, with seating for 1,200, offers a one-of-a-kind backdrop for an event. Discover the difference at Sheraton Changzhou Xinbei Hotel.

description.textZh: 成都AC酒店坐落于凤凰山体育公园内，一个融合体育、演艺、商业休闲的综合体，也是一个生态、开放、多元的城市公园。酒店楼体外立面设计灵感源于四川传统文化元素“蜀锦”，转折变化的曲面流畅优美，结合菱形穿孔铝板的交织错落，形成了独特的编织肌理。从酒店出发，步行5分钟可达地铁5号线，驱车15分钟内可前往成都大熊猫繁育研究基地，驱车约18分钟左右可抵达昭觉寺景区，驱车约20分钟左右可抵达宝光寺景区。距成都东站约30分钟车程，距成都双流国际机场约45分钟车程，便捷的交通可畅达成都各商圈及景点。成都AC酒店优越的地理位置将为宾客提供便捷无忧的旅行体验。
description.textEn: AC Hotel by Marriott Chengdu North in the Phoenix Hill Sports park, which is not only a multifaceted hub blending sports, performing arts, business, and leisure but also an ecological, open and diverse city park. The facade design of the hotel building is inspired by the traditional cultural element of Sichuan “Shu Brocade”. The curved surface with changing transitions is smooth and graceful, combined with the interweaving of the diamond-shaped perforated aluminum plate, creating a unique woven texture. 15-minute drive to Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding. With 5-minute walk to Metro Line 5,30-minute drive to Chengdudong Railway Station and 45-minute drive to Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport. AC Hotels By Marriott Chengdu North Chinas prime’ location that provide travellers with a seamless travel experience.

description.textZh: 成都天投万怡酒店地理位置优越，靠近成都天府新区中央商务区。酒店距离成都地铁 1 号线仅数步之遥，轻松可至成都市中心；距离成都东站和成都双流国际机场约 50 分钟车程，交通非常便利，可轻松前往中国各地，对于在此停留或途经此地的旅客而言，这里可谓理想下榻之选。酒店内设 312 间客房，融合现代美学风格，配备灵活的办公和休闲区，并配备免费 Wi-Fi、高清平板电视等各类设施。Pavilion 餐厅全天供应自助式早餐，午餐和晚餐则以川菜、粤菜和亚洲风味美食为主，可轻松容纳约 168 位食客。The Lounge 全天供应各种精选甜点、现磨咖啡和鸡尾酒。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Chengdu South occupies an excellent location near CBD of Chengdu Tianfu New Area. Only one step from the Chengdu Metro Line 1 allows easy access to downtown Chengdu, and a 35 minute drive to both Chengdu East Railway Station and Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport offers convenient transport to every corner of China making this hotel an ideal choice for guests and travelers staying within and passing through the area. The hotels 312 rooms are designed in a modern aesthetic and feature flexible areas for work and relaxation, as well as a full array of amenities including free WiFi and a flat screen HDTV to keep guests connected.The Pavilion, the hotel's all day restaurant, can accommodate 168 guests with a wide selection for buffet-style breakfast as well as lunch and dinner experience featuring Sichuan Cuisine, Cantonese and Asian fusion cuisines. The Lounge features an exquisite selection of desserts, freshly brewed coffee and cocktails throughout the day.
