description.textZh: 1.酒店客房不适用于接亲婚房，详情可咨询酒店市场销售部。2.酒店有专属宠物主题房间，每间客房可携带一只无攻击性且体重15公斤以下的宠物，宠物楼层为一号楼一楼，如不选择宠物房，每间房间需支付100元清洁费/间/晚，宠物不可进入各餐厅及泳池区域，不便之处敬请谅解，具体携带宠物事项可详询酒店(大型犬只不可入住酒店，如:金毛，罗威纳，拉布拉多等大型犬只)
description.textEn: The hotel rooms are not suitable for wedding rooms. For more details, please consult the hotel's marketing and sales department. 2. The hotel has dedicated pet-themed rooms. Each room allows one non-aggressive pet weighing less than 15 kilograms. The pet floor is on the first floor of Building 1. If you do not choose a pet room, a cleaning fee of 100 yuan per room per night will be charged for each room. Pets are not allowed to enter the restaurants and swimming pool areas. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. For specific matters regarding pets, please consult the hotel in detail. (Large dogs are not allowed to stay at the hotel, such as Golden Retrievers, Rottweilers, Labrador Retrievers, etc.)

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chengdu, Chunxi Road
records.name_zh: 成都春熙路福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 成都春熙路福朋喜来登酒店坐落于成都核心商业区-春熙路太古里商圈，是福朋喜来登品牌在成都市中心的地标店，酒店拥有322间雅致客房及套房。福朋喜来登的核心价值观是重新定义旅行，经典与现代元素完美融合的设计风格，舒适轻松的居住氛围。以真诚与个性化的服务满足新一代自由旅行客的需求。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chengdu Chunxi Road Hotel is located in the core business district of Chengdu - Taikoo Li Chunxi Road, and is the benchmark store of the Four Points by Sheraton brand in Chengdu. This boutique hotel features 322 modern industrial and fancy guest rooms and suites. A design style that seamlessly integrates classic and modern elements, resulting in a comfortable and relaxed ambiance. Serving the needs of the new generation of independent travelers with sincerity and a personalized touch.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chengdu, High-Tech Zone Exhibition Center
records.name_zh: 成都高新会展中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 成都高新会展中心福朋喜来登酒店是成都市高新区新入驻的首家万豪国际酒店集团旗下福朋喜来登酒店品牌，位于成都高新技术产业开发核心区域，毗邻成都新地标：双子塔，与交子商圈和大源商圈交汇，周边有环球中心、银泰城等大型商业综合体，与成都世纪城会展中心仅1.5公里。酒店周边配套齐全，停车场地充足便利。酒店大堂吧全天供应福朋喜来登品牌国际醇饮优选计划提供的精酿啤酒。酒店客房“金可儿”床垫给您带来舒适体验，同时酒店自助洗衣房配备LG洗衣烘干机，24小时健身房为您提供生活便利。福朋喜来登酒店作为BONVoY 万豪旅享家奖励计划参与品牌，会员卡积分为客人提供丰富的奖励项目。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beerson taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Deliciousbreakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifithroughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Pointsworkouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partner with Your Trainer to bring personaltraining and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler inmind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chengdu, Pujiang Resort
records.name_zh: 成都蒲江花样年福朋喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: Escape from the city, embrace the nature and relax in the Four Points by Sheraton Chengdu, Pujiang Resort, We are only less than an hour away from Chengdu Shuangliu Airport, and about 70km from the city center.
description.textEn: Travel in style, just the way you like it is right here with us at the Four Points by Sheraton Chengdu Pujiang Resort we advocate simplicity and homelike environments to sweep away those exhausting aesthesia from travelling. Situated in the Oxygen Bar Grand valley resort area, right beside the Cherry Hill with quiet and natural environment we are only an hour away from Chengdu Shuangliu Airport and about 70 km from the city center.

records.name_zh: 成都茂业 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: “成都的象征”天府广场旁，如今矗立着奢华新典范：成都茂业 JW 万豪酒店。欢迎八方宾客莅临中国西南的这座城市，尊享优雅时尚、充满文化气息的住宿及餐饮体验。酒店客房和套房休闲雅致，装饰现代典雅，配备宽大浴室，可欣赏市中心迷人景观。酒店拥有八处精致场地，包括约 988 平米的大宴会厅，设有迎宾前厅、户外屋顶花园，可多方位满足各位宴会需求。欢迎莅临设施齐全的健身中心、室内恒温泳池或豪华水疗中心，重焕身心活力。酒店环境现代，地理位置非常理想，毗邻宽窄巷子、文殊院、太古里和国际金融中心 (IFS)，方便您感受成都的悠久历史和摩登脉搏。欢迎莅临成都茂业 JW 万豪酒店，奢华由您定义，这就是JW非凡款待！JW万豪，心之所归，自在此间。 JW Marriott. Stay in the Moment.
description.textEn: Iconic Tianfu Square, the symbol of the city is now home to a symbol of luxury JW Marriott Hotel Chengdu. We welcome visitors to southwest Chinas city with refined style, culturally inspired dining and holistic wellbeing. Our casually elegant hotel rooms and suites boast warm, modern decor, spacious bathrooms and mesmerizing views of downtown. Our onsite restaurants celebrate the flavors of China, providing a modern twist on the traditional cuisine found along Chunxi Road, Chengdus busiest street. We feature eight sophisticated venues, including a 10,635 square-foot Grand Ballroom with a pre function foyer, a rooftop JW Garden and space for 800. Rejuvenate body and mind at our well-equipped fitness center, indoor swimming pool or luxury spa. We offer a contemporary setting from which to explore Chengdu, Chinas historic past, with ideal hotel placement near Kuan and Zhai alleys, Wenshu Yuan Monastery, Taikoo Li and IFS. Experience a new definition of luxury at JW Marriott Hotel Chengdu.

description.textZh: 成都首座万豪酒店位于天府大道，地处金融城腹地，与城中热门打卡地天府双塔隔街相望，距离地铁站仅300米。酒店拥有399间宽敞雅致的客房及套房，全景落地窗让您饱览城市繁盛街景。酒店内设有两家风格迥异的餐厅，为您缔造难忘的用餐体验。蜀锦嬉全日制餐厅空间开阔，可同时接待220位宾客，是城中食客口口相传的酒店自助餐厅。莲·中餐厅环境静谧幽雅，提供地道的川菜和粤菜，2020-2022年连续三年入围黑珍珠餐厅指南。酒店设有水疗中心、麻将室、健身房和室内恒温游泳池，您可以在闲暇时根据自身爱好进行选择，尽享闲适。酒店拥有逾2,500平方米的活动场所，配有超凡的现代化视听设备，LED大屏幕和全覆盖的Wi-Fi网络，是您举办宴会和召开会议的理想之选。
description.textEn: Set on prestigious Tianfu Avenue near Chengdu Financial City and its metro station, YinTai Centre and government agencies, Chengdu Marriott Hotel Financial Centre promises guests an extraordinary travel experience. Our hotel's lobby draws you in with its sleek, contemporary decor, natural surfaces and warm neutral tones. This chic, modernistic theme extends to our spacious guest rooms and suites, where large windows frame sweeping views of the city and marble bathrooms exude a sense of calm. Dining options are equally impressive, the expansive 220 seat Chengdu Kitchen features International offerings and a sumptuous buffet, while Lotus Chinese Restaurant serves authentic Sichuan and Cantonese delicacies in an intimate setting. Unwind in our relaxing spa, Mahjong room, fitness center and indoor pool. For social events and meetings, Chengdu Marriott Hotel Financial Centre boasts an array of modern meeting venues, all enhanced by full audiovisual services, LED screens and free WiFi Internet.

description.textZh: 在成都渊源流传的茶文化中，对细节的关注胜于一切。 成都首座万丽酒店不仅采用大胆时尚的设计风格，彰显现代审美的意蕴，更是处处追求细节，是宾客探索地道特色的理想之地。酒店位于人民南路的中心地带，地处天府立交桥北侧，距地铁仅数步之遥，邻近大熊猫研究中心、武侯祠和国际展览中心等热门景点。成都人崇尚“探索”精神，从丰盛的现场烹饪美食到传统建筑物，处处彰显无余，成都首座万丽酒店更是其中代表，各种精彩期待您的探索。酒店现代雅致，散发出微妙迷人的亚洲风情，置身于此，即可享受与众不同的景致。酒店内设两个别具特色的餐厅，不仅尊享环球佳肴，更可品味特色休闲鸡尾酒，不同需求轻松满足。成都首座万丽酒店提供多个活动空间，并拥有提供全方位服务的专家团队，帮助您打点好一切，留下美好回忆。
description.textEn: Renaissance Chengdu Hotel prides itself on its attention to detail. Ideally set on South Renmin Road, Sichuan, China begs exploration, from its rich culinary scene to traditional architecture. Hotel guests are just steps from the metro and near Chengdu attractions like Giant Panda Research Center, Temple of Marquis Wu and International Exhibition Center. Recharge in spacious rooms and suites that blend modern aesthetics with traditional design. Every accommodation offers premium pillowtop mattresses, marble bathrooms, relaxed seating, ample desks, free Wi-Fi and floor-to-ceiling windows revealing stunning nighttime views of the city. Club-level rooms grant access to Club amenities, including free breakfasts. Indulge at our tempting restaurants and lounge, pamper yourself at the hotel day spa. When planning downtown events, you will appreciate the expert assistance, custom catering and sophisticated event venues that await you at Renaissance Chengdu Hotel.

records.name_zh: 成都天府丽都喜来登饭店

description.textZh: 酒店于2022年完成翻新工程。成都天府丽都喜来登饭店地处成都市中心。成都是一座发展迅速的中国大都市，酒店所在地是市中心繁华的商务区。酒店邻近地铁站，距宏伟的天府广场仅数分钟行程，方便宾客前往商务会议、购物、娱乐和附近的热门旅游景点。豪华客房采用现代设计，坐拥市中心优美景色。酒店设有室内恒温泳池和健身中心，是在成都期间休闲放松的理想之选。酒店内设精致餐厅，供应正宗川菜、特色成都菜和自助早餐，您可于此尽享丰盛的中餐及国际风味美食。酒店拥有优雅先进的活动场地，是在成都举办婚礼、私人活动和各种会议的理想地点。成都天府丽都喜来登饭店将竭诚满足宾客的各种所需。
description.textEn: The hotel completed its renovation and refurbishment in 2022. Place yourself in the heart of Chengdu at Sheraton Chengdu Lido Hotel. Our hotel is located in the flourishing downtown business district of one of China's rising cities. Minutes away from majestic Tian Fu Square, our hotel location near the Chengdu metro is ideal for traveling to business meetings and shopping, recreation, and tourist hotspots nearby. Step into Deluxe accommodations featuring modern design and beautiful views of the downtown area. Our heated indoor pool and fitness center offer excellent ways to unwind and relax while visiting Chengdu. Enjoy the flavors of China and the world with our exquisite in-house dining options, including authentic Sichuanese, signature Chengdu dishes and a breakfast buffet. Our hotel offers elegant, state-of-the-art event venues that make it an ideal place for weddings, private engagements and meetings in Chengdu. Sheraton Chengdu Lido Hotel offers guests all they need to go beyond.

records.name_zh: 成都恒邦天府喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 作为万豪国际集团喜来登品牌焕新后入驻成都市的首家，也是天府西国际豪华酒店的新秀，成都恒邦天府喜来登酒店倚成都市郫都区公园城市新地标菁蓉湖而建，在成都通往都江堰、青城山景区的必经之路上，清水河生态艺术公园近在咫尺，隔湖相望是绵延的四姑娘山，地理位置得天独厚。酒店距离佛罗伦萨小镇约9分钟车程，距离望丛祠约12分钟车程，距离成都市区约50分钟车程，距离都江堰青城山约40分钟车程，距离成都市双流国际机场约60分钟车程。酒店拥有258间简约时尚的豪华客房及套房，专享尊崇的行政酒廊，五间餐厅及酒吧。行政酒廊为万豪旅享家精英会员及入住喜来登行政楼层的宾客打造私人、时尚、温馨的特有空间。&More by Sheraton咖啡吧致力于打造一个充满吸引力的共享空间，让宾客充分感受到轻松愉悦的社交氛围。大堂的面肆为往来旅人提供极具地方特色的面食。采悦轩中餐厅以成都漆器皿为灵感装饰，主营川菜，辅以经典粤菜，优雅的大厅空间及18个私享包间是与亲朋家人聚餐或商务宴请的上选。其中8个包间拥有令人陶醉的开阔景观，可远眺绵延山峦。食光以美食市集为创意灵感，设计现代时尚。餐厅拥有亚洲风尚美食时令海鲜、精美烘焙地方美食，为您提供特色自助餐与丰富零点菜单。秘境环境独特私人，提供来自全球的甄选威士忌、葡萄酒，精酿啤酒及创意鸡尾酒。酒店室内恒温泳池、24小时健身房及户外湖畔跑道是您繁忙旅程中欢畅运动的绝佳选择。2500平宴会会议场地，包括一间1500平无柱大宴会厅，一间375平多功能厅及三间会议室，配备全新且多功能的会议设施设备，满足您不同规模与形式的会议及宴会需求。
description.textEn: Sheraton Chengdu Pidu grandly opens in early 2022, is the first hotel of Marriott International Group after Sheraton brand transformation in Chengdu, as well as the newest star of international premium hotel in western Chengdu. A new landmark in Pidu district, Sheraton Chengdu Pidu is surrounded by Jingrong lake and in close proximity to Qingshuihe Eco-art Park and Florentia Village shopping outlets. It is designed by the world’s leading hospitality design firm, HBA. Taking inspiration from maker culture and inheritance spirit of Pidu and combining Sheraton’s brand features with Chengdu’s leisure culture, Sheraton Chengdu Pidu has 258 guest rooms and suites, Executive Lounge, 3 restaurants (Yue, Daily Social, Soo Noodles) and 2 bars (&More by Sheraton, Unspoken), with leisure facilities, the gym, swimming pool and kids area, creating an unforgettable staycation and gathering experience.

description.textZh: 成都瑞吉酒店所在紧邻天府广场和春熙路，尽显商务区中心地带的优雅繁华。酒店坐落于成都古城热闹非凡的黄金地段，地理位置便利，毗邻尊尚购物中心和知名餐厅。我们的地标性豪华酒店是闲逸休闲慢生活的缩影，如美食餐厅、室内及室外泳池、瑞吉健身中心和铱瑞水疗中心等非凡设施一应俱全。酒店拥有1,100平米左右的活动和会议空间，诚邀您光临体验。酒店内设282间客房，定制家具与先进技术设施有机结合，打造当代潮流风尚。宽大浴缸和别处难觅的卫浴用品营造无以言表的惬意享受。此外，酒店还提供24小时特色瑞吉管家服务，并可饱览非凡的市区美景或天府广场景观。现代化的成都瑞吉酒店以卓尔不群的特色品质敬候您来从容探索。
description.textEn: Defining elegance in the heart of the business district The St. Regis Chengdu is located steps from Tianfu Square and Chunxi Road. Boasting an iconic address in the ancient city of Chengdu, our hotel is conveniently located near premier shopping malls and renowned restaurants. The epitome of uncompromising living, our landmark luxury hotel presents epicurean dining alongside indoor and outdoor pools, The St. Regis Athletic Club and the Iridium Spa. Our hotel's visionary hospitality extends to 1,100 square meters of meeting and conference space. Meticulously decorated, our 282 guest rooms unite bespoke furnishings with state-of-the-art technology. Let exclusive bathroom amenities set the mood as you soak in your spacious tub. Our hotel offers unparalleled views of the city or Tianfu Square, along with our signature St. Regis Butler service, available 24 hours a day. Discover modern Chengdu and the quality that defines St. Regis.

records.name_zh: 成都富力丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: 酒店房间设计灵感源自成都传统老街院巷，将东方韵味巧妙融入摩登奢华当中。每间客房均配有入门走廊、步入式衣帽间，双人盥洗池、独立卫生间、浴缸和独立浴室等贴心设计，兼顾舒适与私密。酒店拥有五间独具风格的美食餐厅和酒吧，丽轩中餐厅供应传统的粤菜和特色川菜，香荟全日制餐厅提供各式国际美食，温馨的厅餐厅则可让您品尝地中海风味美食，Flair是入夜之后的休闲之地，位于25层的大堂吧则是您与朋友聚会、享受下午茶的上佳之地。酒店水疗中心拥有十间理疗室，提供舒缓身心的按摩护理服务。酒店健身中心配备意大利品牌Technogym健身器材，内有瑜伽馆和桑拿浴室，可满足健身的各项需求。设有水下音乐系统的室内恒温游泳池，可让您在轻盈乐曲与舒适水温中舒展身体。为让客人感受到独具成都气息的生活方式，酒店从产品设计，美食体验、服务特色等方面，用摩登现代方式诠释独具成都特色茶文化。行走在酒店中，不妨放慢脚步，感受天府之都慢生活。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Chengdu, overlooking the city's central Tianfu Square, offers guests an ideal base to explore the best of Chengdu. With guest rooms from the 28th to the 41st floor, this 350-room luxury hotel features unmatched views of downtown Chengdu paired with the comfort and personalized service. 105 Ritz-Carlton Club Level rooms and 54 suites feature dedicated concierge service and a host of thoughtful accouterments. Dining options include Li Xuan, an elegant Chinese restaurant with eight private dining rooms, FLAIR, the highest lifestyle restaurant and bar in town and SPICES, an international all-day dining restaurant. A contemporary lobby lounge offers signature English Afternoon Tea. Meeting spaces include a Grand Ballroom, Junior Ballroom and seven additional meeting rooms totaling 1716 square meters of function space. Guests will find relaxation and wellness within a full-floor luxury spa and an indoor swimming pool with underwater music.

description.textZh: 准备好一起耍出成都姿态！传统与现代、从容又热情、拼搏也耍乐，多维度的巧妙碰撞，成就蜀都耍在当下、纵情享受的潇洒。当你探索这座城市精彩非凡的川剧艺术及远溯至三国时代的人文历史时，你会发现麻辣鲜香的川菜百味更加令人着迷。璀璨的成都在经济及社会的飞跃发展下，庆祝着这种慢生活、快节奏的对比。这座闲适和谐的公园城市同时化身活力十足的动感空间，诠释着会耍且包容的成都姿态。成都W酒店位于繁荣的金融商圈、高新区精彩不夜城，创造集设计、音乐、时尚和活力为一体的新触点。热辣在此吸引所有舞台焦点。快跟随成都W酒店时讯达人感受城市脉搏，游走城市中的隐秘空间，深入了解这个文化大都市更新更潮的生活节奏吧！置身于LIVING ROOM潮堂的日夜场景转换之中，潮人、音乐和互动艺术体验在此混搭出各种场景。在活力随性的ZING型乐餐厅感受本地食材与国际风味擦出的创意火花，多重滋味触发味蕾活力。夜幕降临，沉浸于当地新兴艺术家及名DJ的节奏中，狂欢于SPARK燎屋顶酒吧的舞池中，成为全场瞩目焦点。来FIT有型健身中心为身体充电，荡漾在WET碧波泳池变换多彩的灯光中，或前往AWAY SPA水疗中心体验别具一格的压力释放，无论哪一种方式，都能让你释放活力，焕然一新。酒店颠覆传统设计的297间客房及套房，以机智有趣且突破边界的手法重新诠释成都的摩登现代。随时/随需满足你享受当下的狂热，无论所需、无论何时均可确保。认真耍，慢慢活。在成都W酒店耍出你的都态！
description.textEn: W Chengdu is located in the pulsating Gaoxin district. Soak up the pulse of the city and get Insider Access to the newest, eclectic lifestyle that beats through this cultural cosmopolitan. A never-ending flow of the like-minded entangled in music and interactive art will see the Living Room transform from day to night. Ignite your palate with an explosive interplay of Southeast Asian and Sichuan spices at ZING. See and be seen at SPARK while you get lost in the euphoric beats of local emerging artists and reputable DJs. Fuel your body at FIT, ripple through to the infinity of lights at WET and get your glow on at AWAY SPA. Then re-imagine witty interpretations of the endlessly playful Chengdu in one of the 297 rooms and suites. WHATEVER WHENEVER makes sure you have what you want, when you want it. Play hard, live easy. Show your Dutitude and turn up the spice at W Chengdu.

description.textZh: Hotel is infront of the Liberation Square. It features 289 modern guest rooms. The landmark view rooms offer a panoramic view of the Jiefangbei and provide a wide range of dining options, bringing a brand-new and luxurious experience to guests.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing is situated in the heart of Chongqing business district, featuring 289 modern guest rooms. The landmark-view rooms offer a panoramic vista of Liberation Square , complemented by an all-day dining restaurant, a lobby lounge, and a versatile 416-square-meter multifunction hall. Leveraging its prime location in Jiefangbei and backed by Marriott Bonvoy’s global membership system, the hotel delivers internationally standardized services with assured quality. Seamlessly blending business and leisure, it stands out with its core competitiveness—catering to high-end business needs while providing travelers with an immersive urban exploration experience.

description.textZh: 秉承万怡品牌 "便捷住宿，自在随心" 的核心理念，酒店团队以万豪标准的专业素养，为商旅散客与团队提供全流程贴心服务。从高效精准的客房预订，到细致周到的团队接待，每一处细节都旨在营造舒适宁静的休憩空间。客房内精心配置的现代化设施与人性化设计，更兼顾商务需求与居住舒适度，延续了品牌在 "睡眠质量" 与 "舒适度" 上的高分口碑。餐饮体验同样诠释着品质与匠心。酒店主厨领衔的专业团队，不仅每日呈现丰盛的自助早餐，更提供贴心房间送餐服务，让美味无需等待。针对商务宴请、私人聚会等多元需求，团队可依托江津本地食材特色与精湛烹饪技艺，量身定制自助午宴、主题晚宴等个性化餐饮方案，从健康营养的搭配到地域风味的创新，全方位满足味蕾期待。
description.textEn: Staying true to Courtyard’s core philosophy of "effortless stays, made personal," the hotel team delivers end-to-end thoughtful service for both business travelers and groups, upholding Marriott’s professional standards. From seamless room bookings to meticulous group arrangements, every detail is designed to create a tranquil retreat. Modern amenities and ergonomic touches in the rooms cater to both productivity and relaxation, reinforcing the brand’s acclaimed reputation for superior sleep quality and comfort. Dining here is a celebration of craftsmanship and quality. Led by expert chefs, the culinary team not only curates lavish daily breakfast buffets but also offers in-room dining for convenience. For business banquets or private gatherings, customized menus—from lunch buffets to themed dinners—highlight local Jiangjin ingredients and innovative regional flavors, balancing nutrition with creativity to delight every palate.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Chongqing Nan’an District
records.name_zh: 重庆南岸万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 重庆南岸万豪万枫酒店矗立于地标大厦 17–29 层，空中大堂更高达 31 层——置身云端，与山城霓虹天际线面对面。驱车 5 分钟即抵重庆国际会议展览中心，15 分钟直达解放碑与洪崖洞。182 间客房以落地窗将重庆 3D 赛博朋克江景尽收眼底，配备豪华床品、高速 Wi-Fi 与一应智慧设施。31 层 Fairfield 市场 24 小时供应咖啡、轻食与饮品；全天候健身中心随时点燃活力。出门即是南滨路江畔酒吧街，步行可至跨江 CBD。无论商务、家庭或周末小逃，这里都是您探索山城的理想起点。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Chongqing Nan'an District sits atop the 17–29 floors of a landmark tower, with its sky lobby on level 31—high above the clouds and face-to-face with the city’s neon skyline. Just 5 minutes by car to Chongqing Int’l Convention & Exhibition Centre and 15 minutes to Liberation Square & Hongya Cave, the 182 guestrooms put all of Chongqing’s 3D cyber-punk drama at your feet through floor-to-ceiling windows. Every room delivers premium bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi and intuitive amenities, while the 24-hour Fairfield Market on 31st floor keeps coffee, grab-and-go bites and drinks ready at any hour. Stay active in the round-the-clock fitness centre, then step out to Nanbin Road’s riverfront bars or the CBD across the bridge. Business, family or weekend escape—this is your launchpad to explore the mountain city.

records.name_zh: 重庆永川重宾万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 重庆永川万豪万枫酒店位于重庆永川区飞龙路，邻近兴龙湖公园，拥有完善的商旅及旅游配套设施。酒店交通便利，步行5分钟即可至永川里购物中心，驱车5分钟抵达永川中心商务区与永川高铁东站。酒店拥有207间设计舒适宜人的客房，分别包含大床、双床与家庭客房。客房内设施服务齐备，包含免费高速无线网络，55英寸液晶电视、迷你冰箱、独立淋浴设备等。同时通过备受信赖的服务与温馨舒适的住宿氛围，全心全意为宾客打造无微不至的入住体验。万枫餐厅位于酒店3层，提供品种丰富的特色早餐、晚餐，餐厅可容纳110人同时用餐，位于酒店大堂的万枫小铺提供24小时零售服务。酒店另配备总计400平的会议空间，包括可容纳120人的多功能会议厅与3个灵活多变的会议室，为商旅宾客打造流畅、高效的差旅体验。酒店另设有24小时健身房配备先进器材，让旅客在旅途中保持亦能保持健康节拍。
description.textEn: Located in Changzhou Avenue, Yongchuan District, Chongqing, adjacent to Xinglong Lake, Fairfield by Marriott Chongqing Yongchuan offers guests easy access in and out of the city with excellent business and tourism facilities, which is 5-minute walk from shopping mall, 5-minute drive from CBD of Yongchuan District and Yongchuan East Railway Station.

records.name_zh: 重庆渝北万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 重庆渝北万豪万枫酒店是万豪国际集团旗下备受信赖的商旅型酒店，坐落于渝北区宝圣湖街道宝石路466号 ，精准契合商务出行与休闲旅居的核心需求，以“自然简约之美”传递万豪家族传承的温暖待客之道。地理位置得天独厚，驾车约20分钟可达江北国际机场，距重庆北站亦十分便捷，周边公交线路密集，畅达主城各区 。商业与休闲资源环绕，临近爱琴海购物公园、力帆·红星国际广场等综合体，宝圣湖公园举步可至，棕榈泉国际中心等商务地标近在咫尺，兼顾购物娱乐、自然休憩与商务通勤需求 。从品牌传承的温暖服务到高效便捷的旅居体验，重庆渝北万豪万枫酒店以简约质感与精准配套，成为山城出行的可靠之选。
description.textEn: The Marriott Fairfield by Marriott Chongqing Yubei is a trusted business hotel under the Marriott International Group, located at No. 466, Baoshi Road, Baoshenghu Sub-district, Yubei District. It precisely meets the core needs of business travel and leisure stays, conveying the warm hospitality of the Marriott family through the beauty of simplicity and elegance.With a prime location, it takes about 15 minutes by car to reach Jiangbei International Airport, and it is also very convenient to get to Chongqing North Railway Station. It is surrounded by commercial and leisure resources, close to shopping complexes such as Aegina Shopping Park and Lifan · Hongxing International Plaza, with Baoshenghu Park within easy reach and business landmarks like Palm Springs International Center nearby, catering to the needs of shopping, entertainment, natural relaxation, and business commuting. with its simple and elegant style and precise facilities, is a reliable choice for travel in the mountain city.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Jiangjin
records.name_zh: 重庆江津福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Nestled in Shengquan Lake Park near Government Center and Wanda Plaza, Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Jiangjin features 121 garden-view rooms and curated dining options, offering an elevated experience.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Jiangjin is nestled in the heart of Binjiang New City, Jiangjin District, Chongqing, with a prime location adjacent to the Government Affairs Center and Wanda Plaza. The property features 121 well-appointed park-view guest rooms and suites, one all-day dining restaurant, a stylish lobby bar, and two versatile meeting rooms equipped with state-of-the-art audiovisual and multimedia facilities. Complemented by a 1,100 ㎡ lawn garden, it is an ideal venue for both business events and social gatherings. Emphasizing efficiency, convenience, and an artistic ambiance, the hotel is immersed within the natural oxygen-rich environment of Shengquan Lake Park. We seamlessly blend ecological aesthetics with modern travel spaces, offering business elites and leisure travelers a stay experience defined by our brand promise: “Relax. Enjoy.®”

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Jiulongpo
records.name_zh: 重庆九龙坡福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 重庆九龙坡福朋喜来登酒店坐落于城市发展核心区域——九龙坡商业区, 邻近重庆奥体中心，龙湖重庆星汇天街。酒店距离环线陈家坪轻轨站700米，距离1/5号线石桥铺900米。共拥有174间经典现代风格客房，一间全日餐厅和大堂吧，并配2个多功能会议室/宴会厅，可满足300人的会务需求，可承接各类宴会。依托九龙坡优越的商务与交通枢纽地位, 万豪全球会员体系支持,始终致力于为宾客提供国际标准的可靠服务与品质保障, 我们精准契合当代商旅人士的多元需求,既能高效承接高端商务活动，亦可作为探索山城脉络、体验本地人文风采的理想下榻之所。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Jiulongpo is situated in the core of the city’s development – Jiulongpo Business District, adjacent to Chongqing Olympic Sports Center and Longfor Chongqing Starlight Paradise Walk. It is 700 meters from Chenjiaping Light Rail Station (Loop Line) and 900 meters from Shiqiaopu Station (Lines 1/5).The hotel has 174 guest rooms in classic modern style, one all-day dining restaurant, a lobby lounge, and 2 multi-functional meeting/banquet halls that can accommodate 300 people for banquets.Leveraging Jiulongpo’s premium status as a business and transportation hub, and supported by Marriott’s global membership system, the hotel is committed to providing guests with reliable services and quality assurance up to international standards. It precisely meets the diverse needs of modern business travelers – efficiently hosting high-end business events while serving as an ideal accommodation for exploring the "Mountain City" and experiencing local culture.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Liangjiang New Area Jinkai Avenue
records.name_zh: 重庆两江新区金开大道福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于两江新区金开大道核心腹地，承袭万豪福朋喜来登“真诚、简约、舒适”的核心理念，为商务精英与城市旅人打造兼具国际标准与山城温度的理想居停。酒店毗邻轨道3/5号线，15分钟直达重庆北站，20分钟畅达江北国际机场，30分钟可达解放碑、观音桥等核心商圈；周边环绕照母山森林公园、爱琴海购物公园、金州商圈，一站式满足商务、购物、休闲需求。酒店拥有173间全景客房，配置65寸大屏、人体工学桌椅等设施，打造舒适旅居体验。「玩啤食社」奉上地道山城风味，用一杯本土精酿邂逅味蕾的激情，领略重庆麻辣江湖的清爽与鲜活。酒店24小时自助健身中心，洗衣服务，满足您的多元出行需求。
description.textEn: Nestled in Jinkai Avenue, Liangjiang New Area, the hotel upholds Four Points by Sheraton’s philosophy of Sincerity, Simplicity and Comfort, offering business and leisure travelers an ideal stay blending international standards with Chongqing’s unique warmth.Adjacent to Metro Lines 3 & 5, it is 15 minutes from Chongqing North Railway Station, 20 minutes from Jiangbei International Airport, and 30 minutes from Jiefangbei and Guanyinqiao. Surrounded by Zhaomushan Forest Park, Aegean Shopping Park and Jinzhou Business District, it meets all business, shopping and leisure needs.The hotel has 173 panoramic rooms with 65-inch screens and ergonomic furniture. The Eatery & Best Brews serves authentic local flavors and craft beers. A 24-hour fitness center and laundry service cater to diverse travel needs.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Nanchuan
records.name_zh: 重庆南川福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 重庆南川福朋喜来登酒店坐落于金佛山脚下——这里是重庆主城都市区的世界自然遗产地，驱车约28分钟即可探访喀斯特地貌的鬼斧神工。酒店周边自然景致丰富，30公里外黎香湖碧波荡漾，35公里处山王坪彩林绚烂，均可在45分钟左右车程内轻松抵达，让您悠然徜徉于湖光山色之间。酒店交通便捷，距南川汽车站约3公里、南川高铁站约6公里，前往重庆江北机场约102公里，顺畅衔接每一段旅程，无论是深入自然奇观，或是便捷往返都市，这里都是您自在奔赴诗意远方的理想落脚点。
description.textEn: Embracing a lodging philosophy of simplicity and comfort, the hotel features 139 well-appointed guest rooms and suites, The brand's innovative dining concept, "Brew & Bites," combines an all-day dining restaurant, Chinese restaurant with 9 private rooms,chess and tea house There are 3 wedding banquet hall and conference center with three meeting rooms,Four Points strives to deliver a considerate and seamless stay experience, positioning itself as a distinguished choice among regional hotels.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing North Railway Station
records.name_zh: 重庆北站福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 重庆北站福朋喜来登酒店坐落于重庆两江新区民安大道中段，交通便捷，出行通畅。酒店接驳地铁4号线，可一站直达重庆北站；5公里范围内覆盖朝天门、洪崖洞等热门网红景点；重庆江北国际机场距离酒店约18公里；酒店位于渝北两江新区财富广场和国博中心商圈，周边CBD聚集，白天朝气蓬勃的年青人在这里逐梦蓝图，资金流、信息流、人才流和商业流在这里合和，续写着精彩的城市传奇；夜晚川流不息的车流点亮都市璀璨霓虹，街边根须密织的大榕树，安静热烈的盛开，欢迎每一位旅途的归人。 酒店设计风格别具匠心，后现代工业风与时尚潮流交相辉映，宁静原木系元素与明丽的色带动静相宜，传统的石材工艺与艺术红墙炽烈碰撞，营造出惊艳的视觉冲击和独特审美韵味；酒店打造多元的社交空间，咖啡吧、商务办公、网红打卡、健身房等满足当代客群青春活力的出行需求。 酒店拥有各式高品质客房及套房共177间，客房创新的采用前瞻性的设计，秉承舒适旅居的人文理念，采用精致色调风格、配置有65寸的大屏LED电视、舒适的人体工学沙发、Type-c充电接口等设施，让每位旅客在旅途中享受到精致舒适的生活美学；全屋落地景观大窗，纵览迷人都市风光。 酒店为宾客提供多样用餐选择，满足宾客的不同饮食喜好。宾客可以在活力四射的全日制玩啤食社享用地道的重庆美食，在观赏开放式厨房的现场烹饪过程同时尽享味蕾美味时光；大堂吧提供种类繁多的中国茶、咖啡和“醇饮优选”精酿啤酒，收获悠闲时光。酒店与重庆啤酒有限公司携手推出麦作精酿系列，精心打造山城季节性特色精酿“醇饮优选”啤酒，为宾客带来原汁原味的本地风味，呈现福朋喜来登品牌标志性“醇饮优选”计划。宾客可以品味一杯醇香佳酿，收获闲适放松时光，为旅途再添滋味。 同时，酒店设有多个宴会会议空间，浪漫奢华的婚宴场景，沉浸式影音效果，配备专业细致的策划团队，个性订制，满足宾客多种宴会及会议需求。 重庆北站福朋喜来登酒店全体伙伴，恭迎品鉴！
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing North Railway Station is located in Liangjiang New Area.The hotel is connected to Metro Line 4, one stop directly to Chongqing North Railway Station; About 5 kilometers distance are Chaotianmen, Hongya Cave and other popular destinations ; Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport is about 18 km away. The hotel gathered around the CBD between Yubei Liangjiang New Area Financial Centers and International Exhibiton Center .Hotel has a total of 177 of high-quality rooms and suites , equipped with 65 inch large screen LED TV, comfortable ergonomic sofa, Type-c charging interface and other facilities,so that each passenger in the journey to enjoy the exquisite and comfortable life aesthetics.At the same time, the hotel has a number of banquet and conference Spaces, romantic and luxurious wedding scenes, immersive audio and video effects, to meet the needs of Variety guests .All partners of Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing North Railway Station, warmly welcome your arrivals.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Yuzhong Peninsula
records.name_zh: 重庆渝中半岛福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 重庆渝中半岛福朋喜来登酒店雄踞于“山城”核心——渝中半岛，坐拥得天独厚的地理位置，交通便利，毗邻重庆多个网红打卡景点（人民大礼堂、解放碑、洪崖洞、李子坝轻轨、观音桥等）。酒店共拥有215间客房，融合现代设计和贴心细节，助您卸下旅途疲惫，焕活身心。酒店内设施齐全，玩啤食社（全日制餐厅）、特色中餐包房、会议室、多功能厅等，场地灵活多变，配备齐全的现代科技设施，是您举办商务会议、大型庆典及私人宴会的理想之选。无论您因何到访重庆，重庆渝中半岛福朋喜来登酒店都将以真诚的服务伴您开启一段精彩纷呈的山城之旅。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Yuzhong Peninsula,stands at the core of the "Mountain City" - Yuzhong Peninsula. It enjoys an exceptional geographical location and convenient transportation, adjacent to several popular tourist attractions in Chongqing (such as the People's Grand Hall, Liberation Square, and Hongya Cave). The hotel features 215 guest rooms, integrating modern design and attentive details, allowing you to relieve your travel fatigue and rejuvenate your body and mind. The hotel is fully equipped with various facilities, including the Beer Bar (all-day dining restaurant), special Chinese banquet rooms, meeting rooms, and multi-function halls. The venue is flexible and versatile, equipped with complete modern technological facilities. It is an ideal choice for you to hold business meetings, large-scale celebrations, and private banquets. No matter why you visit Chongqing, we will provide sincere service to accompany you on an exciting journey through the mountain city.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing, Yongchuan
records.name_zh: 重庆永川重宾福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于永川商业、娱乐中心及各景点中间位置；毗邻兴龙湖公园，步行10分钟即可到达永川东站、永川国际会展中心；共拥有199间高品质客房、2间餐厅及‘玩啤食社’酒吧提供全天候中西式餐饮服务、24小时开放的健身房、布局灵活的会议和宴会空间；是您商务、休闲、会议及宴会活动的理想选择之地。
description.textEn: The first international upscale hotel with remarkable city views. Located in the commercial and entertainment area of this rapidly growing distrct, Four Points By Sheraton Chongqing Yongchuan is adjacent to the Xinglong Lake Park and a quick walk to office buildings, Yongchuan International Convention and Exhibition Center, malls and attractions. This contemporary hotel is only 10 minutes walk from East Yongchuan Railway Station, 1.5 hours drive from Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport and 40 minutes to Chongqing Railway Station West. Guests could easy access to Chongqing main urban area, with state-of-the-art meeting rooms, unrivalled Food and Beverage and fitness facilities, this contemporary hotel is the ideal choice for business and leisure travelers, tour groups and small to middle sized events.

records.name_zh: 重庆 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 时尚豪华的重庆 JW 万豪酒店，驻于海航保利国际中心大厦，地处重庆市中心繁华地段，地理位置优越，周边交通非常便利。酒店拥有 451 间宽敞的客房，环境装饰及设施用品时尚雅致，为您缔造轻松愉悦体验。酒店内设多间特色餐厅，供应重庆地方特色美食以及各式国际风味美食，全日提供餐饮服务。酒店拥有约 2,200 平米多功能活动空间，配备齐全的现代科技设施，是在重庆举办各种活动的理想商务酒店。酒店配备专业的活动保障团队，可提供卓越的活动策划和餐饮服务，从盛大婚礼到小型商务聚会均可胜任。此外，酒店还设有室内泳池、静谧水疗中心以及装备齐全的健身中心等设施。咫尺开外即是解放碑等热门景点，您可轻松开启探索之旅。
description.textEn: The contemporary, elegant JW Marriott Hotel Chongqing rising high near the prominent Chongqing People's Liberation Monument, welcoming you to the heart of Chongqing. Holding the distinction, providing curated amenities and sophisticated services, our hotel is catering to the wishes of distinguished and neoteric guests. Experience the comfort of the luxury, savor the delicacy of the world, your memorable and mindful escape inaugurates here.

description.textZh: 重庆富力艾美酒店坐落于万达广场，这里是重庆市新兴的住宅、购物及娱乐目的地。酒店位于市中心，距解放碑中央商务区仅约 10 分钟车程。附近还有星光时代广场和 3 号线地铁站，便捷接驳重庆悦来国际会议中心。我们的餐厅和公共空间无不体现出对创新的执着追求。您可尽情享受我们设施先进的健身中心和室内恒温泳池。重庆富力艾美酒店风格时尚优雅，采用超现代技术，拥有高品质住宿设施，共设 317 间精美客房和套房，室内艺术饰品别具一格，还可欣赏重庆市生机勃勃的繁荣景象。酒店提供卓越的抵达体验，旨在让宾客忘却素日平淡生活，从而感受焕然一新的美妙体验。
description.textEn: Le Meridien Chongqing, Nan’an is part of Wanda Plaza; a new residential, shopping and entertainment destination. The downtown hotel is a 10-minute drive from the Liberation Square CBD. Also nearby are Starlight Plaza and Metro Line 3, which runs to the Chongqing Yuelai International Convention Center. A sense of passion for innovation is evident in our restaurants and public spaces. Enjoy our state-of-the-art fitness center and indoor heated pool. Stylish and sophisticated with ultra-modern technology, Le Méridien Chongqing, Nan'an offers high quality accommodations with 317 refined rooms and suites featuring unique art pieces and showcasing views of the vibrant city. An arrival experience at our hotel aims to reset the guest’s mind, leaving everyday life at the door.

description.textZh: Located in the Jiefangbei central business district, Marriott Executive Apartments Chongqing is walking distance to two metro lines and offers a restaurant, gym, indoor pool, kid’s play area and apartments with full kitchens and washer/dryers.
description.textEn: The perfect choice for your stay in Chongqing, located just a stones throw away from the bustling Jiefangbei Central Business District. Marriott Executive Apartments Chongqing is within walking distance to famous attractions and easily accessible via the city's extensive road and rail network, including two nearby metro stations. Each of our apartment-style guest rooms is equipped with a fully equipped kitchen and washer and dryer. Hotel facilities include a restaurant, fitness center, indoor pool and childrens play area. Start a new exploration in a city full of unknown. In this unique city, we provide a comfortable and relaxing home-like accommodation experience, creating an ideal stay for families and business travelers alike from all over the world.

description.textZh: 重庆万豪酒店地处“重庆外滩”南滨路，紧邻南山风景区及南坪商圈，与渝中解放碑商务区隔江相望。酒店交通便捷，距离重庆国际会展中心仅约10分钟车程，驱车约30分钟即可到达重庆江北国际机场。酒店共有341间设计典雅的客房及套房，位于30-49层，高居云端之上，坐拥城市天际线。东北方俯瞰长江及重庆城景，西南方紧邻南山，依山傍水，可将山城重庆的绝美景致尽收眼底。所有客房均配备高品质床上用品，高速网络服务及其他个性化设施。酒店拥有三个不同风格的餐厅及2个酒吧。香港冰室供应享负盛名的港式茶点；万豪中餐厅主理地道的粤菜及巴渝名菜；都会尚膳全日制餐厅提供国际自助美食；大堂吧精致的下午茶是商务休闲的理想去处；云端酒吧位于酒店50层，享360度重庆美景，无论是私人小酌，还是公司派对，都是非凡的选择。灵活的会议空间共计1800平方米，配备高科技会议设施及超大嵌入式LED屏。休闲之余，您可以在位于27层的健身中心及室内游泳池放松身心，体验运动的魅力和乐趣。
description.textEn: Chongqing Marriott Hotel is the first ever newly established Marriott standard hotel in the Asia Pacific. Strategically located on Nanbin Road, across the Yangtze River from Jie Fang Bei, it is right near the Nanping Business Center and the Nanshan Mountain. It is also conveniently situated, with only a 10-minute drive from the Chongqing International Convention and Exhibition Center, and a 30-minute drive from the Chongqing International Airport and the Chongqing North Railway Station. This hotel features 328 elegant guestrooms with mountainous and river views so majestic, it seems as if the sky is within arm’s reach. To complement the guest rooms, there are three themed restaurants with each offering various famous Chongqing special delicacies, a pillar less ballroom with a massive 1800 square area, and six meeting rooms of different sizes perfect for hosting various business meetings and themed banquets. Offering high quality facilities and an exceptional level of service that travelers can expec

description.textZh: 酒店拥有360间现代化客房，以巧妙设计充分利用空间，使宾客可根据自身需求灵活调整房间布局。宾客可以享受房间内各种设计独到的设施和用品，豪华舒适的床品、尺寸灵活的工作台以及替代衣橱的钉物墙。每间客房均配有Moxy品牌标志性的可折叠办公桌椅、50~55 英寸纯平电视、床头 USB 接口、迷你冰箱、步入式淋浴间以及免费高速无线网络，让宾客能够全天保持畅联。宾客还可以使用万豪旅享家APP在移动端快捷办理入住、退房，并使用数码钥匙进入房间。
description.textEn: The hotel has 360 modern rooms, cleverly designed to make the most of the space, allowing guests to flexibly adjust the layout of their rooms according to their needs. Guests can enjoy a variety of specially designed amenities and amenities in the room, including luxurious and comfortable bedding, flexible work tables and studded walls that replace wardrobes. Each room features Moxys signature foldable desk and chair, 50 to 55-inch flat-screen TV, bedside USB port, mini refrigerator, walk-in shower and free high-speed Wi-Fi to keep guests connected throughout the day. Guests can also use the Marriott Bonvoy App to quickly check in and out on mobile and access their rooms with a mobile key.

description.textZh: 酒店位于美丽的长江之畔，地处便利的新南岸商业区，并可远眺解放碑的壮观美景。我们距拥有亚洲大型音乐喷泉的海棠烟雨公园也仅有咫尺之遥。在我们的怡聚大堂吧啜饮一杯鸡尾酒。在喜来登健身中心为健康充电，或在室内泳池享受阳光沐浴。我们还提供超过 1,900 平米的多功能会议空间。酒店的 371 间别致客房中包括 41 间套房，华丽的设计融入了从高清电视到高速上网接入等前沿科技设施。独立浴缸和雨林淋浴间。
description.textEn: Located along the banks of the Yangtze River, we are conveniently situated in the new Nan'an commercial district within view of Jie Fang Bei monument. We're also just steps from Yan Yu Park, boasting one of the largest musical fountains in Asia. Sip a cocktail in our lobby bar, ConneXions. Recharge at Sheraton Fitness or in our indoor pool bathed in natural light. We also offer over 1,900 square meters of versatile meeting space. In 371 chic guest rooms, including 41 suites, rich design blends with the latest technology, from HDTVs to high speed internet access. Separate bathtubs and rain forest showers soothe.

records.name_en: MajesTang Hotel, Chongqing, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 重庆开元名都臻品之选酒店

description.textZh: Located in Chongqing, which is known as the "Mountain City", hotel has 210 Tang style guest rooms and special catering options, bringing an elegant cultural experience to the guests of Monument to the people's Liberation and its surroundings.
description.textEn: MajesTang Chongqing, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel is located in the core area of Jiefangbei Central Business District, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is adjacent to landmark attractions such as Chaotianmen Square, Hongyadong. Hotel is the "Shan Cheng Tian Que" of "welcoming officials and saints," draws its design inspiration from the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty. It has 210 guest rooms and suites, each with floor-to-ceiling windows offering views of the two rivers’ confluence and the glittering city skyline. There are two unique dining options: Shanhai Jiyan All-Day Dining and Shengjian Lobby Lounge.Rooted in Tang Dynasty heritage, the hotel conveys Chongqing’s charm, builds a vibrant social atmosphere with premium service, and offers travelers accommodation combining Tang aesthetics and modern comfort.

records.name_zh: 重庆解放碑威斯汀酒店

description.textZh: 重庆解放碑威斯汀酒店位于解放碑中心，是山城时尚地标性酒店。酒店大堂设于51层，挑高10米，360°落地全景玻璃窗打造出200米高空的云端景观大堂，住客可俯瞰解放碑两江汇聚的山水风光，下楼即是繁华的解放碑商圈，长江索道、洪崖洞等热门景区。酒店拥有333客房及套房，配套威斯汀天梦之床，丹麦B&O液晶电视、符合人体工学的Herman Miller办公座椅等。53层锦肴轩·川上精攻二十四味型川菜，餐厅内的270度玻璃观景屋、54层天际泳池以及频出新意的停机坪创意都市系列亦是各大潮人山城必打卡之地。
description.textEn: Surrounded by popular shops, prestigious businesses and tourist attractions, The Westin Chongqing Liberation Square is a haven of wellness and renewal. Immerse yourself in a calming oasis in scenic hotel accommodations with modern technologies, LCD TVs, Dyson hair dryer, capsule coffee machine, high-speed Wi-Fi and signature Heavenly® Beds. Thrill your palate with distinctive culinary delights, including fresh seafood, bountiful buffets， signature Sichuan cuisine and local hot pot at our distinctive hotel restaurants. Explore the city's celebrated attractions including Jie Fang Bei, Hong Ya Cave and Chao Tian Men. Host flawless meetings, magical weddings and unforgettable social affairs in sophisticated event space, enhanced by custom catering and inspiring city views. Designed to ensure your comfort and elevate your well-being, our Chongqing hotel is a refreshing sanctuary in a legendary travel destination.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Chuzhou Railway Station

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.

Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

description.textEn: Sheraton Chuzhou Hotel has a advantageous geographical location. It is at the center of the business district and culture area. you can Overlook the scenery of Chuzhou in the hotel. Near Chuzhou government. It is only 5 minutes to Chuzhou High- speed railway station and 40 minutes to Nanjing.

description.textZh: Welcome to The Dali EDITION — a new, unique, original experience that combines luxury and lifestyle with authentic design, outstanding dining and entertainment as well as friendly and personalized service.
description.textEn: The Dali EDITION welcomes you to discover a refined retreat where luxury and natural setting meet. Nestled between Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake, home to 151 guestrooms and suites, four distinctive dining venues, and social spaces designed for connection and indulgence. A rare natural spring weaves through the grounds, shaping gardens and terraces that feel entirely of the land. From afternoon teas in the intimate Tea Studio to individualized spa treatments and elegant venues for celebrations, every detail reflects the spirit of EDITION Hotels — authentic, sophisticated, and effortlessly rooted in place.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Dali, Erhai
records.name_zh: 大理洱海福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 在大理，洱海畔，探索生活之旅大理洱海福朋喜来登酒店客房设计高雅，拥有220间舒适客房及套房。与洱海咫尺为邻，与苍山隔海相望，湿地公园环绕，自然环境得天独厚，坐享大理静谧与繁华。酒店房间大多面向洱海，尽览洱海风光。客房所提供的福朋舒适之床（Four Comfort Bed™）正如我们“简单快乐”的服务宗旨；通过细致入微的体贴服务给客人带来与众不同的全新体验，满足您的各项需求。酒店设3个会议室多功能厅，中餐包房以及咖啡、精酿于一体的大堂吧，24小时健身中心和自助洗衣房设施齐全，无论是商务之旅还是度假休闲，都将带给您便利、舒适与超值的享受。大理洱海福朋喜来登酒店坐落于历史文化名城大理，位于洱海东岸机场路旁的建投.洱海寰球时代，距离大理机场约15分钟车程，约15分钟可达大理火车站，地理位置优越，交通便利，可轻松前往周边景点。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Dali Erhai Lake offers 220 comfortable guestrooms and suites with elegant design. With Erhai Lake in close proximity, Cangshan Mountain across the sea, surrounded by wetland park, unique natural environment, enjoy the tranquility and prosperity of Dali.Most of the hotel rooms face Erhai Lake and have a panoramic view of the lake. The Four Comfort Bed™ in our rooms is true to our service tenet of "simple and happy"; Provide guests with a unique new experience through meticulous and considerate service to meet your needs. The hotel has 3 conference rooms, multi-function rooms, Chinese private rooms, lobby bar with coffee and craft brew in one, 24-hour fitness center and laundromat facilities, whether it is a business trip or a vacation, will bring you convenience, comfort and value.

description.textZh: 大连雅乐轩酒店坐落于中国东北地区风景非常优美的海港城市中心地带，是一家风格前卫的新型酒店。这座新潮、现代、浪漫的城市充满了多种多样的时尚商务区、缤纷的夜生活、丰富的娱乐选择和耐人寻味的旅游景点。您可在我们的 w xyz(SM) bar 交朋会友，在“雅乐轩能量：站”全日制餐厅品尝各式甜点、开胃品或健康小吃，或于我们的“中转：站”休闲厅尽情休闲娱乐。此外，还可通过覆盖全酒店的有线及无线高速上网接入与外界随时保持联系！ 我们的快活乐窝客房配备舒适的特色睡床、步入式淋浴间、Bliss 水疗中心定制用品等众多便利设施，轻松愉悦的住宿体验尽在此间。即插即用的连接站可为所有电子设备充电，并可将其连接到 42 英寸液晶电视，为工作和娱乐提供额外便利。
description.textEn: Aloft Dalian is a bold new hotel in the center of northeast China's most scenic seaport! This hip, modern romantic city is filled with a mixture of business and fashion districts, endless nightlife, entertainment options and intriguing attractions. Meet & mingle with friends at our w xyz(SM) bar, grab a sweet, savory or healthy snack from re:fuel by Aloft(SM), our 24/7 pantry or play in our re:mix(SM) lounge. Plus, you can always stay connected with hotel-wide wired and wireless High Speed Internet Access! Breeze into one of our Aloft rooms, featuring our ultra-comfortable signature bed, walk-in shower, custom amenities by Bliss® Spa and more. Our plug & play connectivity station charges all your electronics and links to the 42” LCD TV to maximize work and play.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Dalian Jinpu New Area
records.name_zh: 大连金普新区万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 大连金普新区万豪万枫酒店，坐落于这座充满活力的东北新兴经济引擎核心地带大连金普新区金马路CBD商圈。酒店与铜牛岭风景区，大黑山风景区相隔数分钟行程。我们深谙您的旅程所需：高效、可靠与片刻宁静。在万豪万枫，体验我们进口舒达睡床带来的深度睡眠以及智能马桶带来的深度清洁，提供当地特色早餐的万枫餐厅开启元气满满的一天，或在静谧性的客房高效工作, 自带LED的多功能会议室满足商旅会议的不同需求，在自助式健身房和洗衣房为您生活工作保驾护航。覆盖全酒店的免费高速Wi-Fi与灵活工作空间，助您随时与世界无线连接，无线式充电线可为您的电子设备提供高功率的充电，并可以投放连接至65寸液晶电视。洗个舒适的热水澡，在简约现代的空间中放松身心。万豪万枫酒店——专注核心所需，传达细节把控，让您的每一次停留都高效无忧。
description.textEn: Fairfield By Marriott Dalian Jinpu New Area is located in the CBD business district on Jinma Road in Dalian Jinpu New Area, the core area of this vibrant emerging economic engine in Northeast China. The hotel is just a few minutes' drive away from Tongniuling Scenic Area and Daheishan Scenic Area.We understand what you need during your journey: efficiency, reliability, and a moment of tranquility. At Fairfield experience a deep sleep on our imported Serta beds and a thorough clean with our smart toilets. Start your day full of vitality at the Fairfield Restaurant, which offers local - style breakfast. You can also work efficiently in the quiet guest rooms. The multi - functional meeting room with built - in LED can meet different needs of business meetings. The self - service gym and laundry room support your life and work.Fairfield Hotel focuses on your core needs and pays attention to details, ensuring that every stay of yours is efficient and worry free.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Dalian Donggang
records.name_zh: 大连东港福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 北方明珠滨城大连，位于辽东半岛南端，三面环海一面环山，四季分明，气候适宜，有着“时尚浪漫之都”的美誉。在大连东港旅游度假区，大连东港福朋喜来登酒店如同一颗镶嵌在黄海海岸的璀璨明珠优雅亮相，以熠熠光辉点亮城市的滨海天际线。酒店毗邻大连国际会议中心、威尼斯水城、东港音乐喷泉及东港游艇码头俱乐部，举步即达；距时代广场、友谊商城、网红打卡地港东五街、海之韵公园等多元胜地，仅需10分钟车程；距地铁2号线大连会议中心站仅100米，轻松抵达大连周水子国际机场、大连站、大连北站、大连星海广场等地，畅行全城无虞。另外酒店为住宿客人提供免费超大地下停车场，供您自驾停泊，自由出行。入住酒店为您褪去一天的风尘倦意，壮阔海景与璀璨城光奔涌而入，足不出户即可尽览迷人海滨风光与都市夜景的梦幻交融。
description.textEn: The hotel is conveniently located near the Dalian International Conference Center, Venice Water Town, Donggang Music Fountain and Donggang Yacht Club, all within walking distance. The viral check-in spot Gangdong Fifth Street and Haizhiyun Park are just a 10-minute drive away. With the Dalian Conference Center Station (Metro Line 2) only 100 meters away, guests can easily access Dalian Zhoushuizi International Airport, Dalian Railway Station, Dalian North Railway Station and Xinghai Square, ensuring seamless travel throughout the city.

description.textZh: 大连一方城堡豪华精选酒店俯瞰星海湾和浩瀚的黄海，是商务或休闲旅客的理想下榻之所。酒店距离星海广场仅咫尺之遥，与大连自然奇观、博物馆和历史遗迹相隔数分钟行程。富丽堂皇的巴伐利亚城堡和宁静的水疗中心、先进的健身中心、波光粼粼的室内泳池等豪华设施与酒店周围的自然风光相映成趣。酒店内的 Collections 特色餐厅温馨宜人，供应丰富的国际美食，进一步提升高雅风范。结束一天的大连探索之旅后，在客房和套房内使用各式设施，放松身心；所有客房均配备各种设施，包括豪华床品、平面电视，还可欣赏一望无垠的大海、山川或大连市景。大连一方城堡豪华精选酒店，豪华无止境。

We are steps from Xinghai Square and min from Dalians natural marvels, museums and historical sites. To complement our majestic environment we feature a palatial Bavarian castle facade and luxury amenities like a tranquil hotel spa, state of the art fitness center and a sparkling indoor swimming pool. Our signature restaurant Collections further enhances the grandeur with inviting ambiance and an extensive global menu. Rejuvenate with ease after your daily adventure in China in our well appointed rooms and suites all lodging showcases premium amenities such as plush bedding and a flat screen TV and sweeping ocean, mountain or city views of Dalian China. description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Danzhou is located in central business district of Danzhou, a western city in Hainan, that offer comfortable experience through Han and Tang Dynasty style, tasty local culinary and un-complicated service.
description.textEn: The Danzhou Four Points by Sheraton Hotel, situated in the commercial and political hub of Danzhou City, and adjacent to the Summer Business Plaza, boasts superior geographical location and convenient transportation. The hotel has 194 comfortable guestrooms, each meticulously designed reflecting the culture of Han and Tang Dynasty, and equipped with Four Points’ comfortable bed and related facilities, to ensure warm and comfortable living experience for you. Three restaurants and bars offer experience of taste buds in various flavors, while the 1800 m2 banquet hall and 11 separate multi-functional meeting rooms are tailored for different types of business meetings and wedding banquets.

description.textZh: 大庆富力喜来登酒店是当地率先开设的豪华国际酒店。大庆富力喜来登酒店位于中央商务区，地理位置优越，距离大庆火车站仅 6.2 公里左右，距离大庆萨尔图机场约 17.9 公里。酒店设有 290 间优雅客房，均可欣赏石油城的壮丽景致。酒店内设多间特色餐厅，从地道东北菜到国际佳肴均有供应。无柱式宴会厅面积约 1,187 平米，是您举办各种商务会议和主题宴会的理想选择。无论是豪华婚礼亦或商务聚会，我们的专家活动团队都将竭力为您提供专业的策划与餐饮服务。我们关注每个细节，追求卓越，力求满足每一位宾客的期待。
description.textEn: Sheraton Daqing Hotel is the first five-star international hotel in Daqing. Sheraton Daqing Hotel is well-placed in the Central Business District, about 6.2 kilometers from the Daqing Railway Station and 17.9 kilometers from Daqing Saertu Airport. This hotel features 290 elegant guestrooms with city views of this petroleum city. Guests are invited to explore our specialty restaurants, options from native Northeast China to international delicacies. A pillar-less ballroom with a massive 1187 square area perfect for hosting various business meetings and themed banquets. Our expert event team will ensure professional planning and catering services, whether you're organizing a wedding or an business gathering. We focus on every detail, pursue excellence only hope to meet the expectations of every guest.

records.name_zh: 大同同瑞里万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 中国古都，天下大同! 大同同瑞里万豪万枫酒店坐落于大同古城东侧，毗邻御河生态园，东邻大同大学与大同市五大场馆，交通便捷。距华严寺、善化寺、鼓楼、九龙壁等景区约15分钟车程，距云冈石窟21公里（约35分钟），距悬空寺及应县木塔59公里（约90分钟）；距离大同南站6.5公里（约15分钟），云冈国际机场14公里（约22分钟）。酒店拥有135间客房及套房，配备席梦思（万豪定制款）睡床，让您尽享好眠。万枫餐厅提供融合本地特色的中西自助早餐；24小时健身房、自助洗衣及万枫小铺服务一应俱全；多功能空间兼顾休闲、办公与私享洽谈。无论是休闲度假还是商务出行，大同同瑞里万豪万枫酒店都将为您打造舒适无忧的旅居体验。期待与您相约大同，相聚万豪万枫！
description.textEn: Welcome to the Fairfield by Marriott Datong hotel ！ The hotel is located on the east side of the ancient city of Datong. It takes no more than 15 minutes by car to reach famous tourist attractions such as Huayan Temple and Nine-Dragon Wall. The Yungang Grotto, is 21KM away from the hotel, the Xuankong Temple & Yingxian Wooden Pagoda, are 59 KM away from the hotel. At the same time, it is 6.5 KM away from the main transportation hub Datong South Station, The Datong Yungang International Airport is 14 KM away. The hotel features 135 guest rooms , all equipped with Simmons JW Marriott custom-designed mattress. Meanwhile, you can enjoy a variety of local and fusion cuisines at the buffet. Additionally, the hotel offers a 24-hour fitness center and self-service laundry, as well as a 24-hour self-service coffee bar and business space at the Fairfield Shop. Whether for leisure or business travel, the Fairfield by Marriott Datong hotel will provide you with a comfortable and worry-free stay experience!

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Datong Pingcheng
records.name_zh: 大同平城福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于大同古城东侧，毗邻御河生态园，东邻文瀛湖；西侧紧邻大同古城。区域交通便捷，10分钟内可至华严寺、善化寺、鼓楼、九龙壁、关帝庙等知名旅游景区；中国四大石窟之一的云冈石窟，距离酒店35分钟，距离大同南站16分钟车程，距离云冈机场30分钟。
description.textEn: The hotel is located in the east of Datong ancient city, adjacent to the Yuhe Ecological Park, east adjacent to Wenying Lake; The west side is close to Datong ancient city. Regional transportation is convenient, 10 minutes to the Huayan Temple, Shanhua Temple, Drum Tower, Kowloon Wall, Guandi Temple and other well-known tourist attractions; Yungang Grottoes, one of the four major grottoes in China, is 35 minutes away from the hotel, 16 minutes from Datong South Railway Station and 30 minutes from Yungang Airport.

records.name_zh: 东莞松山湖雅乐轩酒店

description.textZh: 东莞松山湖雅乐轩酒店坐落于松山湖科技产业园，现代设计融合轻快色彩，主打年轻化体验。地铁1号线松佛站步行800米即达，距深圳宝安机场约1.5小时车程，交通便捷。客房简约明快，部分落地窗可览湖景，配备舒适床品与Bliss沐浴品牌。聚聚乐餐厅提供中西式自助早餐，推荐广式米粉与手工肉松面包。酒店设172平米宴会厅及500㎡会议空间，2楼健身房免费开放，3楼24小时自助洗衣烘房，轻松兼顾商务休闲。 步行1分钟达万科生活广场，5分钟漫步“松湖烟雨”，周边汇聚万象汇、山姆会员店、悠兰里文化艺术街区及望野博物馆，畅享湖城相融的漫游体验。
description.textEn: Aloft Dongguan Songshan Lake is located in the Songshan Lake Tech Park, featuring modern design with vibrant colors. It's an 800m walk from Songfo Station (Metro Line 1) and a 1.5hr drive from Shenzhen Bao'an Airport.Rooms are sleek with lake views, comfy beds, and Bliss bath products. Nook Restaurant serves a breakfast buffet with local rice noodles and buns. The hotel offers a 172㎡ ballroom, 500㎡ meeting space, a free 2nd-floor gym, and a 24hr laundry on the 3rd floor.Vanke Life Square is a minute away; "Songhu Misty Rain" is a 5min walk. Nearby Mixc One, Sam's Club, and art districts offer a great city-meets-nature experience.

description.textZh: 拥有207间客房的东莞星汇广场万枫酒店是中国区第二家，广东省第一家万枫酒店，位于东莞市常平镇常马路星汇置地广场，紧靠常平火车站，酒店交通便利。距离深圳宝安国际机场约80分钟车程。酒店提供舒适的休息空间以及美式早餐，为您的出行提供便利。
description.textEn: Conveniently adjacent to Changping Railway Station, Fairfield by Marriott Dongguan Changping is located in Changping town in Dongguan. It features a 24-hour fitness centre and free WiFi access throughout the entire building. The rooms are fitted with a TV with satellite channels. All rooms have a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find bathrobes, slippers and free toiletries. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. Dongguan Central Square is 20 km away from Fairfield by Marriott Dongguan Changping, Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is 70 km from the property.

description.textZh: 东莞万豪酒店位于市中心东城中路，毗邻旗峰山公园，掩映于繁茂绿意之间。酒店交通便利，距离东莞站约15公里、深圳宝安国际机场约43公里、广州白云国际机场约60公里，尽享大湾区生活圈的高效便捷。酒店地理位置优越，可轻松前往东莞核心区域的多个繁华商圈，及虎英公园、可园博物馆、迎恩门等城市地标，畅享城市人文与自然美景交融的独特魅力。 东莞万豪酒店以自然敬畏的初心呼应自然本源，将岭南山水意境融入当代设计语言，构筑一处离尘不离城的静谧桃源。酒店2025年焕新启幕，262间客房及40间行政公寓以简约东方美学为底色，融入现代雅致格调。大部分客房配备观景阳台，或远眺旗峰山峦叠翠，或私享都市宁静绿洲。室外山景泳池、室内恒温泳池及健身房焕活身心；大堂吧及行政酒廊为旅居提供尊贵休憩享受；都会尚膳全日制餐厅呈现缤纷国际佳肴；万豪中餐厅匠心演绎地道粤式风味。 酒店配备2,246平方米会议及宴会空间，自然采光充足的多功能厅及会议室满足多样商务需求，宴会厅180度全景落地窗将葱郁山景映入室内，营造绿意环抱的视觉享受。此外，占地800平方米的户外宴会空间，更是举办草坪婚礼仪式、庆典酒会等的理想之所，于蓝天白云与繁花绿意间，见证非凡的人生重要时刻！以自然为幕，以文化底蕴为笔，重新定义大湾区都会旅居美学。在山水与城市的交响中，抵达身心归属的理想之境。身栖繁华，心泊云上！
description.textEn: Dongguan Marriott Hotel is located in the city center, adjacent to Qifengshan Park. Conveniently positioned, it is 15 km from Dongguan Railway Station, 43 km from Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport and 60 km from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, with easy access to core commercial districts and landmarks like Huying Park and Keyuan Museum.Inspired by reverence for nature, the hotel integrates Lingnan landscape aesthetics into contemporary design, offering a quiet urban retreat.Renovated in 2025, it has 262 guest rooms and 40 executive apartments with understated Oriental and modern styles. Most rooms have viewing balconies. Guests can enjoy outdoor/indoor pools, a fitness center, Lobby Lounge, City Breeze All-Day Dining and Marriott Chinese Restaurant.With 2,246㎡ of meeting/banquet space, it caters to business and events like lawn weddings, with the banquet hall boasting 180° mountain-view windows.Redefining Greater Bay Area urban hospitality, Dongguan Marriott is your ideal sanctuary.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻东莞喜来登大酒店，一处葱翠花园环绕的美丽目的地。酒店距虎门火车站约 20 分钟车程，距广州白云国际机场约 1 小时车程，距深圳宝安机场约 40 分钟车程。酒店提供前往香港城市、深圳湾和香港机场的 CTS 班车服务。酒店客房宽敞舒适，配备免费 Wi-Fi、设施齐全的浴室和喜来登特色睡眠体验之床。到室外泳池或 24 小时健身房惬意放松，保持身材。酒店可提供约 1,075 平米的活动空间，为您在广东筹办活动提供场地保障；酒店经验丰富的策划和餐饮团队值得信赖，可为您打理各处细节，确保活动圆满成功。东莞喜来登大酒店热忱期待您的光临！
description.textEn: Find space to thrive at Sheraton Dongguan Hotel a beautiful destination set among lush gardens in Dongguan China. Our hotel is just a 20 minute drive from Humen Railway Station and an hour by car from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport; Shenzhen Baoan Airport is 40 minutes away. The CTS shuttle bus service available from hotel to HK city, Shenzhen bay and HK airport. Make yourself comfortable in spacious hotel rooms, complimentary WiFi, well-appointed bathrooms and the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience Bed. Relax by the outdoor pool or maintain your fitness at the 24 hour gym. Those planning events in Guangdong Province can choose from 1,075 square meters off Ballroom space, trust our seasoned planners and caterers to manage every detail ensuring a successful occasion. We look forward to welcoming you to Sheraton Dongguan Hotel.

description.textZh: Hotel Architectural style blends modern elements with Han and Tang Dynasty. The main color tone of the building is desert yellow, reddish-brown and ochre. It creates an ideal vacation destination with modern construction techniques.
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 峨眉山恒邦艾美度假酒店

description.textZh: 峨眉山恒邦艾美度假酒店位于“四大佛教名山”之一的峨眉山景区入口处，距峨眉山旅游客运中心（峨眉山景区售票处）约800米。酒店拥有三百余间客房，每间房间均配备55英寸纯平电视、无线高速网络以及独立浴缸与淋浴间。别致客房，远眺峨眉金顶，可尽情饱览峨眉山重峦叠嶂的自然风光；探索套房，180度全景，既可远眺金顶美景，亦可欣赏艾美湖的波光粼粼；大使套房，带独立泡池，享湖畔花园；50间主题亲子客房，为您和家人编织亲情甜梦。酒店北纬29°大堂吧是您眺望峨眉山金顶不二的上佳选择，食在成都味在峨眉，位于酒店一楼的“新食谱”全日餐厅甄选新鲜食材提供特色全日环球自助美食。“艾美轩”中餐厅提供地道川菜与经典粤菜，享川粤之精髓。酒店拥有恒温游泳池、养生泡池、健身房、儿童乐园，让您及家人尽享闲适自在的度假时光。超过3,000平方米灵活多变的活动空间，其中800平方平米的宴会厅以及10间规模不一的多功能会议室均配以前沿技术设备满足不同的会议需求，两处户外草坪更是婚宴场地的倾心之选。卓越的服务包括先进的视听技术及高速网络接入，确保每一场会议活动的完美呈现。
description.textEn: Le Meridien Emei Mountain Resort offers a truly transformative experience for your visit to China's captivating Sichuan Province. Set against the backdrop of the majestic mountain in the ancient city of Emeishan.Our hotel features rooms and suites offering evocative perspectives of the lush green surrounds. All rooms offer contemporary design and amenities including a flat-screen TV, wireless high-speed internet access, a separate bath and a shower with Le Meridien bath amenities. Our signature bed with crisp linens provides an energizing night's rest.Le Méridien Hub is a gathering place for creative minds to converse, debate and exchange. Inspired dining choices are offered in our two hotel dining venues. A hot spring, a fully equipped fitness center and an indoor heated swimming pool offer stimulating options to restore balance after a busy day in Emeishan.Business meetings and social events are smoothly hosted in our 16,285 square feet of versatile function space with integrated service provided.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms;a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: The state-of-the-art lobby at Courtyard provides greater flexibility and choices for our guests. Courtyard by Marriott Shanghai Fengxian offers both Chinese and International cuisin. Pavilion, an all-day dining restaurant, your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, free Wi-Fi. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center, indoor pool will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be more comfortable, more productive and more enjoyable than ever before!

description.textZh: 佛山南海雅乐轩酒店位于狮山镇，地理位置便利，距离坐落着众多企业和大学的南海经济开发区仅一箭之遥。步行约两分钟即抵达和信广场及狮山广场的购物中心。在我们的酒店内酒吧与三五好友欢乐畅饮，或前往我们聚聚乐餐厅这一全日制餐厅，品尝甜蜜、美味或健康小吃。此外，还可通过覆盖全酒店的有线及无线高速上网接入与外界随时保持联系！我们的快活乐窝客房配备舒适的特色睡床、步入式淋浴间、Bliss 水疗中心定制用品等众多便利设施，轻松愉悦的住宿体验尽在此间。即插即用的连接站可为您的所有电子设备充电，并可将其连接到 42 英寸液晶电视，为工作和娱乐提供额外便利。还包括吹风机与免费卫浴用品。
description.textEn: Aloft Nanhai, Foshan is conveniently located in Shishan Town, just a stone's throw away from the Nanhai Economic Development Zone with many businesses and universities. We're also just a short two-minute walk from Hexin Plaza and Shishan Square's shopping mall. Meet and mingle with friends at our onsite bar, grab a sweet, savory or healthy snack from Nook Restaurant, our 24/7 pantry. Plus, you can always stay connected with hotel-wide wired and wireless High Speed Internet Access! Breeze into one of our Aloft rooms, featuring our ultra-comfortable signature bed, walk-in shower, custom amenities by Bliss® Spa and more. Our plug and play connectivity station charges all your electronics and links to the 42” LCD TV to maximize work and play. A hairdryer and free toiletries are also included.

description.textZh: 佛山万怡酒店坐落于著名岭南文化之乡—广东佛山，地处广东金融高新技术服务区及佛山南海区商业枢纽中心，同时和大型购物中心，服务公寓共同组成大型一体化商业综合体。是商务和休闲旅行的时尚住宿之选。340间客房及套房宽敞明亮，配备55英寸高清电视、智能便捷设施及高速WIFI网络连接，为客人缔造宾至如归的住宿体验。酒店为宾客提供丰富的用餐选择：全日制餐厅丽致餐厅精选全球原汁原味的新鲜食材，汇集丰富多样的中西方美食，开放式厨房为餐饮体验注入轻松与活力；万怡酒廊供应各式精美甜点、咖啡和鸡尾酒，提供商务会晤或社交聚会的理想去处。位于酒店十三层的健身中心为宾客提供全天候24小时健身服务和专业健身保障，让宾客随时保持健康体魄。欢迎莅临下榻佛山万怡酒店，开启缤纷多彩的佛山之旅。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Foshan Hotel is located in the Guangdong Financial High-Tech Service Zone-the center business hub of Nanhai district, Foshan. The hotel is also part of an all-in-one commercial complex project with upscale shopping mall in distinctive style, which is a contemporary haven for business and leisure travelers. Embrace effortless relaxation in spacious guestrooms and suites with 55-inch HDTVs, intelligent and convenient facilities, high-speed WI-FI. A blend of comfort and convenience can be found at our Courtyard by Marriott Foshan.

records.name_zh: 佛山高明联塑万怡酒店

description.textZh: Courtyard By Marriott Foshan Gaoming is located in gaoming District, Foshan city. Our hotel is just a stone's throw away from WinSun Plaza and is close to Xijiang New Town, as well as numerous shopping, dining and entertainment destinations.
description.textEn: Courtyard By Marriott Foshan is located in the heart of Gaoming District. Adjacent Gaoming Avenue is the main traffic hub through Gaoming. Meanwhile, the hotel is adjacent to Xijiang New Town and tram demonstration line, and it is about 2km away from Gaoming passenger station. Opened on August 9, 2022, the hotel is the first Courtyard by Marriott hotel in Gaoming, Foshan, with a total floor area of 36,000 square meters and 15 floors. The hotel has 245 bedrooms, a number of full day restaurants and private rooms, more than 1400 square meters of meeting and banquet space and perfect fitness facilities, providing a full range of services for customers who love work and life and pursue excellence, creating a quality hotel experience.

description.textZh: Located in Shunde which is known as the “City of Gastronomy”, the Courtyard by Marriott Shunde features 138 modern classic guest rooms and smart food and beverage choices, it inspires the guests with an elevating experience in Beijiao, Shunde.
description.textEn: The Courtyard by Marriott Shunde is located in the center of Beijiao, Shunde, where the Midea Group, one of the world top 500 enterprise, sets its headquarters with its major business units and plants in. The hotel sits between the Royal Orchid Golf Club and the Junlan Riverbank Park, with easy access from the neighbor cities of Guangzhou and Shenzhen through the high-speed train or inter-city metro. The Courtyard by Marriott Shunde showcases 138 modern classic guest rooms, one all day dining restaurant, one lobby bar and the meeting space of 380 square meters. Since the hotel connects local attractions such as He Art Museum and Lingnan He Garden as well, guests could enjoy a tranquil leisure-blended stay when they travel for business.

description.textZh: 顺德联塑万怡酒店坐落于中国家具之都——龙江镇核心商圈，坐拥繁华商业地标，紧邻大型商业集群，周边汇聚众多家具产业源头工厂，更与地道本地美食街区紧密相连，交通网络四通八达，出行便捷高效。酒店以时尚前卫为设计理念，融合轻质木作、大理石肌理与不锈钢艺术装置，打造独具格调的空间美学。一楼大堂酒廊氛围轻松雅致，是亲友小聚、商务洽谈或享用精致茶歇的理想之选；二楼配备约1,600平方米无柱大宴会厅，可灵活分隔为三个独立空间，搭载105平方米高清三分屏电子屏及专业级音响灯光系统，全方位满足商务会议、主题宴会等多元活动需求；三楼设有万荟轩西餐厅，每日供应健康早餐，为您注入活力元气；怡萃馆中餐厅则诚意呈现地道广式早茶与顺德风味珍馐，唤醒味蕾记忆。酒店拥有258间宽敞舒适的客房，均配全景落地窗，可将城市繁华尽收眼底。每间客房均设独立办公区，配备高速无线网络、42英寸液晶电视，以及现代大理石材质的干湿分离盥洗空间，细节处彰显品质。此外，24小时健身中心、室外恒温泳池、6片空中匹克球场等康乐设施一应俱全，为您的旅居时光增添多元乐趣。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Shunde Longjiang is situated in the core commercial district of Longjiang Town, known as the "Furniture Capital of China." The hotel features a contemporary design that integrates wood, marble, and stainless steel elements. It offers 258 spacious guest rooms with panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows, dedicated workspaces, high-speed Wi-Fi, 42-inch LCD TVs, and modern marble bathrooms with separate wet and dry areas. Dining options include the Pavilion restaurant and YiCui Chinese Restaurant, which specializes in authentic Cantonese dim sum and Shunde local dishes. For meetings and events, the hotel provides a 1,600-square-meter pillar-less grand ballroom on the second floor, divisible into three independent spaces and equipped with professional audio-visual systems. Leisure facilities comprise a 24-hour fitness center, an outdoor swimming pool, and recreational options such as pickleball courts.

Adjacent to c Shunde Polytechnic University and Wusha Industrial Area. Hotel features 133 thoughtfully designed guest rooms. The Fairfield Restaurant Fairfield Market (24-hour), a 24-hour fitness center and a self-service laundry. Beyond business travel, guests can easily explore nearby popular shopping districts and attractions like OCT Harbor PLUS and Shunfeng Mountain Park, savoring authentic Shunde cuisine at their leisure.

description.textZh: 作为在岭南文化之乡广东佛山市的地标性豪华酒店，佛山万豪酒店为客人提供丰富多彩的入住体验，将成为中国南区商旅新目的地。酒店地处广东金融高新技术服务区及佛山南海区商业枢纽中心，与广州共同构成广佛都市圈。同时与大型购物中心、服务公寓共同组成一座一体化商业综合体。是您尽情体验商务聚会和享有休闲度假便利的理想选择。酒店拥有约4,000平方米的会议及宴会空间，均配备高品质的会议视听设备。占地1,800平方米无柱式千灯湖宴会厅，层高13米，配备180平方米嵌入式LED巨幕，是举办各类大型会议、展会、婚礼、宴会的优选场地。270间优雅静谧的客房，尽览千灯湖中央公园景色，每间房均配有高速无线上网、符合人体工学设计的工作空间以及能带来优质睡眠的舒适床品。别具特色的万豪中餐厅及臻厨全日餐厅带您领略非凡的美食之旅。酒店备置设备先进、丰富的健身房和室内恒温泳池，助力宾客在旅居期间释放倦意，舒展身心。
description.textEn: Foshan Marriott Hotel is centrally located in Foshan, a city with rich Lingnan culture, a premium hotel to provide guests with a city retreat in Southern China. The hotel is situated at the Guangdong Financial High-Tech Service Zone in Nanhai district. The hotel is part of a commercial complex complete with an upscale shopping mall, enabling the hotel to be the ideal place for business and leisure travels. over 4,000 square meters of versatile event and meeting space, including a 1,800-square-meter pillar-less Grand Ballroom with a ceiling height of 13 meters that can be divided into three banquet halls and is outfitted with a 180-square-meter built-in LED screen. The 270 sophisticated guestrooms feature high-speed wireless, ergonomic workspaces and Marriott’s “Revive” bedding, guest could enjoy a scenic view of Qiandeng Lake. Guests looking for delectable dining can experience the unique flavors at our signature Man Ho Chinese Restaurant and all-day-dining restaurant.

description.textZh: 顺德美的万豪酒店位于佛山市顺德区大良东区美的广场，毗邻风景优美的顺峰山公园，环境宜人，交通便利，距顺德港仅约10分钟车程，去香港仅需2小时，距广州琶洲展馆，广州白云机场约60分钟车程。酒店拥有258间精致豪华客房及套房，可眺望顺峰山公园及城市美景。酒店同时配备超凡的配套设施：室内游泳池、休闲健身中心和水疗中心，是喧嚣城市中休闲放松的好去处。28层的行政酒廊专为尊贵及追求个性服务的宾客而设。与此同时，顺德美的万豪酒店拥有1,740平方米的会议及宴会空间，包括1,400平方米的无柱宴会厅及五个多功能会议厅，可充分满足各类会议活动的需求。而酒店的专属婚宴策划服务及超凡的设备，使其成为全城举办婚礼的优先选择场地。酒店设有别具风味的特色餐厅及酒吧，为当地及邻近地区带来全新餐饮选择，吸引本地居民及各地宾客。全日餐厅“贡厨”呈现丰富自助餐及高品质国际美食零点。万豪中餐厅以正宗粤菜享负盛名。大堂吧不仅是品味醇饮，悠享时光的理想之地，亦是会晤商业伙伴之选。
description.textEn: Shunde Marriott Hotel is conveniently located in the center of Shunde commercial and business district and is part of Midea Plaza, Daliang’s shopping and entertainment complex. Our hotel in Foshan, China, is on the doorstep of Shunfeng Mountain Park, with dedicated access to the expressway and just a one-hour drive from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. Our modern hotel showcases 258 tastefully decorated hotel rooms and suites, with Shunfeng Mountain Park or Foshan city views. Enjoy our welcoming amenities and services: take a dip in the indoor heated swimming pool, work out at the fitness center or relax in the Spa. High up on the 28th floor alongside the executive rooms and suites, the Executive Lounge offers personalized services and benefits for Executive Floor guests. The events and meetings space comprises of 1,740 square meters, including a 1,400-square-meter pillarless ballroom and five function rooms. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel in Foshan, China.

description.textZh: 中国顺德喜来登酒店提供智能服务与高品质设施，可承接各类活动，助您灵感焕发，纵享缤纷体验。宾客可在喜来登健身中心锻炼，到半室外半室内健身泳池畅泳重焕活力，或在酒店15层的行政酒廊欣赏德胜河美景。免费Wi-Fi、宽大的办公桌和灵活多变的会议空间助您高效办公。宾客可在Yue Chinese Restaurant餐厅体验经典顺德风味美食，或到Feast特色餐厅品尝国际佳肴。走出酒店，探索顺峰山公园的自然美景、陈村花卉世界或清晖园等热门当地景点。附近的顺德博物馆可助您焕发灵感创意。忙碌一天后，在喜来登特色睡眠体验之床上尽情休闲放松。
description.textEn: See more and do more at Chinas Sheraton Shunde Hotel where smart hacks and elevated amenities deliver inspired experiences for any occasion. Play hard with Sheraton Fitness, rejuvenate in our half outdoor, half indoor lap pool or take in views of the Desheng River from the hotels 15th-story Executive Club Lounge. Work smart with free WiFi, spacious work desks and dynamic meeting spaces. Recharge by experiencing our classic Shunde-style cuisines at Yue Chinese Restaurant or taste the international flare at our signature restaurant, Feast. Venture beyond the hotel to experience top local attractions like the natural beauty of Shunfeng Mountain Park, Chuncun Flower World or Qinghui Garden. Spark creativity at nearby Shunde Museum. When the day is done, rest and refresh with our Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience.

description.textEn: Midea Shunde, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel welcomes business and leisure visitors on a unique hotel journey inspired by nature. Our hotel is conveniently located in Foshan, China, known as the City of Gastronomy, and sits adjacent to a 18 holes golf course. We offer dedicated access to the expressway from our hotel, which is a 30-minute drive from Guangzhou South Station. Let us welcome you to our stylish lobby where guests gather to enjoy free Wi-Fi and comfortable seating. Satisfy your cravings at Zhen Kitchen, featuring lychee wood barbeque, or our hotel's inviting Lobby Lounge. Here, guests connect over a menu of curated beverages. Work out in our 24-hour fitness center or host an event in our 1,000-square-foot meeting room, which features natural daylight and stunning garden views through floor-to-ceiling windows. At the end of your day in Foshan, relax in one of 65 artistic guest rooms and suites overlooking the club house or hotel garden. Find modern luxury at Midea Shunde.

description.textZh: 福州台江万豪万枫酒店雄踞福州台江核心商务板块，坐拥便捷交通路网，轻松通达福州南站、长乐国际机场等交通枢纽，往来全城商圈与景点高效便捷。酒店承袭万豪万枫品牌简约舒适的设计理念，以 89 间现代雅致客房为核心，打造兼具高效办公与舒适休憩的理想旅居空间，为商务差旅与城市度假宾客，呈现万豪标准的贴心服务与自在体验。酒店周边配套醇熟，毗邻台江万达商圈、金融街 CBD，商务出行、购物休闲一步即达；步行可达鳌峰公园、闽江公园南园，尽览闽江一线江景与城市绿意；驱车短程即可抵达三坊七巷、上下杭历史文化街区、烟台山等福州核心文旅地标，轻松解锁闽都千年文脉与老城烟火。悠享旅居之余，宾客可一站式打卡台江特色美食、网红商圈与人文胜景，在商务与休闲间自由切换，沉浸式感受榕城的多元魅力。
description.textEn: Strategically located in Taijiang’s core business district, Fuzhou Taijiang Fairfield by Marriott offers easy access to Fuzhou South Railway Station, Changle International Airport, and major commercial areas.Embracing the brand’s simple, comfortable design, the hotel features 89 modern and elegant rooms, blending efficient work space with cozy rest for business and leisure travelers alike, delivering Marriott-standard attentive service.Adjacent to Taijiang Wanda and Financial Street CBD, the hotel is within walking distance of Aofeng Park and Minjiang River views. A short drive takes you to iconic landmarks including Three Lanes and Seven Alleys, Shangxiahang and Yantai Mountain. Guests can effortlessly explore Fuzhou’s culture, cuisine and city charm.

description.textZh: 福州晋安福朋喜来登酒店坐落于福州核心地带，交通便捷，近公交、地铁站，毗邻商圈及人文景点，是商务差旅与城市探索的理想起点。酒店提供快速入住及退房等多项服务，宾客可使用万豪旅享家APP（Marriott Bonvoy）便捷办理电子房卡、快速入住/退房。140间客房融合现代时尚的设计风格，配备65寸智能电视、高速网络及全景落地窗，兼顾办公与休闲。酒店设有宴会厅、多功能会议厅、全天24小时开放的健身中心及自助洗衣房，全新概念“玩啤食社”餐厅提供开放式厨房自助盛宴，大堂吧则依托“醇饮优选”计划，供应每日鲜酿及榕城风味下午茶，打造轻松社交场景。福州晋安福朋喜来登酒店以“放轻松，任享受”的理念，用国际品质标准与本地文化融合，邀您开启一段自在舒适的榕城之旅，感受“宾至如归”的真诚服务。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Fuzhou Jin 'an is located in the heart of Fuzhou, close to buses, subway stations, commercial districts and cultural attractions, making it an ideal starting point for business trips and urban exploration. Guests can use the Marriott Bonvoy APP for easy access to electronic room cards and express check-in/check-out. The 140 rooms are designed in a modern style with 65-inch smart TV, high-speed Internet access and floor-to-ceiling panoramic Windows for both office and leisure. The hotel has a banquet hall, a multi-functional conference hall, 24h fitness and self-service laundry service, a new concept of the "THE MESH" restaurant provides buffet feast, complemented by a lobby lounge featuring the "Best Brews™" serving daily fresh brews and afternoon tea for casual social gatherings. With the concept of "Stay Relaxed, Indulge Freely" and international quality standards and local characteristics, we create a sincere, comfortable and comfortable journey for guests.

description.textZh: 酒店秉持低调豪华的美学设计理念，拥有104间装饰雅致的客房。延续品牌惬意舒适的居停理念，每间客房环境静谧雅致，配备优质便利设施，为品味不俗的宾客打造精致悠然的休憩秘境。The Mesh餐厅位于酒店二楼，每日供应自助早餐，邀您尽情品尝地道福州捞化及琳琅满目的中西风味美食。大堂吧供应本地精酿啤酒、特色鸡尾酒及多款精选饮品。依托万豪国际的完善服务体系，酒店恪守全球高端待客标准，为世界宾客奉上贴心周到的礼遇，已然成为长乐区高端旅宿与商务待客的标杆之选。
description.textEn: The hotel offers 104 elegantly appointed guest rooms designed with understated luxury aesthetics. Upholding the brand’s philosophy of relaxed and comfortable stays, each room is fitted with premium amenities and embraced by a tranquil ambiance, crafting a refined and soothing retreat for discerning guests. Located on the second floor, The Mesh serves daily buffet breakfast featuring authentic Fuzhou Laohua noodles and an extensive assortment of Chinese and Western delicacies. The Lobby Bar presents local craft beers, signature cocktails and a fine selection of beverages. Backed by Marriott International’s comprehensive service framework, the hotel adheres to global upscale hospitality standards to deliver thoughtful courtesy to guests worldwide, establishing itself as a benchmark for premium accommodation and business hospitality in Changle District.

description.textZh: 福州东湖万豪酒店坐落于福州市长乐区东湖数字小镇内。酒店距福州数字中国会展中心仅5分钟左右步程，距长乐国际机场约20分钟车程。酒店共设有315间舒适温馨客房及套房。所有房间内均可远眺波澜壮阔的东海，亦或俯瞰风光旖旎的东湖。酒店内囊括多间餐厅、大堂酒廊、万豪贵宾廊和露芽台茶室，为宾客提供丰富的餐饮选择。设施齐全的健身房和室内恒温泳池，供您尽享悠闲时光。酒店还拥有约1,750平米的会议空间，其中包括约 1,050平米的大宴会厅以及五间多功能厅，所有会议空间均配有先进的会议设施。“海洋之心”户外婚礼礼堂秉持炫目钻石婚“永恒之爱”设计理念，亦是您举办婚礼的优选之地。
description.textEn: Fuzhou Marriott Hotel Riverside is situated inside the Donghu Digital Town, Changle district of Fuzhou City. Hotel is only 5 minutes’ walk to Fuzhou Digital China Convention & Exhibition Center,20 minutes’ drive to Changle International Airport. Hotel has a total of 315 elegant rooms and suites. All rooms allow you to either overlook the beautiful view of East China Sea or East Lake. Hotel provides different kinds of restaurants, The Lounge, M Club and Dew Bud Tea House which offer an exciting array of dining and drinking options for guests. Hotel possesses a well-equipped fitness center and an indoor swimming pool to fulfill your leisure and sports moments. It equipped 1750 sqm of meeting space with 1050 sqm grand ballroom and five function rooms. All meeting spaces are equipped with advanced meeting facilities. The outdoor Lawn and Heart of the Ocean wedding chapel are ideal wedding venue to create your your Diamond Marriage memory themed on Eternal Love.

description.textZh: 福州中庚喜来登酒店位于闽江之畔，可远眺鼓山，附近有温泉和高尔夫球场。充满活力的酒店拥有一系列场地，可供各种规模的团体举办会议或社交活动。这里有温馨的氛围、友好的员工和先进的设施，让休闲和商务旅客备感宾至如归。酒店提供众多客房选择，着力保障您入住心仪的房型，畅享便利体验。从酒店出发，还可轻松前往游览当地众多热门景点。·烟台山历史风貌区 ·林浦村 ·梁厝特色历史文化街区 ·福州花海
description.textEn: Sheraton Fuzhou Hotel is on the bank of Minjiang River, overlooking Gushan Mountain, with hot springs and golf courts nearby. Our dynamic hotel offers a range of venues for meetings or social events for groups of all sizes. The welcome ambiance, friendly staff and upscale amenities create a setting where both leisure and business travelers will feel at home. Between the numerous options in rooms, you'll be sure to find the one best suited for you and your convenience. It is also easy to travel to popular local attractions from the hotel.·Yantai Mountain Historical and Scenic Area·Linpu Village·Liangcuo Characteristic Historical and Cultural Block·Fuzhou Sea of Flowers

description.textEn: Overlooking the scenic Min River, The Westin Fuzhou Minjiang offers a rejuvenating retreat in the heart of the business district. Near premier shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment, our city center hotel is just minutes from historical sites, the Fuzhou Strait International Conference & Exhibition Centre, the airport and railway station. For those planning events in China, our Grand Ballroom and elevated function rooms transform any event or meeting into a memorable occasion. Restaurants like Seasonal Tastes, Five Zen5es showcase tempting Chinese favorites. With restorative rainforest showers, inviting Westin Heavenly® Beds, complimentary Wi-Fi and ergonomic work areas, our hotel rooms and suites promise a restful stay. Westin Executive Club Rooms provide additional comfort, as well as access to special amenities. Guests also can enjoy our indoor infinity pool and our WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio. We look forward to welcoming you to The Westin Fuzhou Minjiang.

description.textZh: This is a truly cosmopolitan hotel with an urban vibe. It is custom made for those seeking a new way to understand, live and Feel the City.
