They offer a unique combination of quality, timeless European design, comfort and true authenticity. It's a whole new way to travel. Stylish Hotels for Urban Spirits, a new way to connect to the city.

records.name_zh: 广州大学城雅乐轩酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎光临下榻广州大学城雅乐轩酒店，尽享轻松愉悦的住宿体验。我们的酒店位于小谷围岛广州大学城内，地理位置便利，距离众多校园及购物门店仅数分钟行程，客人还可轻松前往市内繁华的中央商务区和娱乐区。欢迎前往我们的 W xyz(SM) Bar 交朋会友。在雅乐轩“能量：站”全日制餐厅品尝诱人小吃，或在我们的特色餐厅享用美味佳肴。在我们的“中转：站”酒廊休闲娱乐，并通过覆盖全酒店的有线/无线高速网络与世界保持联通。酒店拥有 272 间客房和套房，均配有豪华的特色睡床、超大水疗淋浴间、Bliss 水疗定制用品以及众多其他便利设施。即插即用型连接器可为所有电子设备充电，并可连接 42 英寸液晶电视，让您在番禺区工作和娱乐更加便利。
description.textEn: An easy, breezy welcome awaits you in Guangdong at Aloft Guangzhou University Park. Our hotel is located in Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Center on Xiaoguwei Island, mere minutes from campuses and shopping choices, with the city's buzzing central business and entertainment districts within easy reach. Meet and mingle at our W XYZ® bar. Enjoy a snack from re:fuel℠ by Aloft, our 24/7 pantry, or a meal from our specialty restaurants. Play in our re:mix℠ lounge and stay connected with hotel-wide wired or wireless high-speed internet access. Breeze into one of our 272 rooms and suites, featuring our plush signature bed, oversized spa shower, custom amenities by Bliss® Spa and more. Our Plug and Play connectivity center charges all your electronics and links to the 42-inch LCD TV to maximize work and play in Panyu.

description.textZh: 广交会万怡酒店拥有316间精心设计的现代风格客房及套房，融合新中式格调与海洋元素设计，房内的挂画及陶瓷艺术品展现水的不同姿态，采用线条的形式传递轻松、舒适和自然之意。每间客房配备功能齐全的工作区，办公设施一应俱全，提供液晶平面电视与高速无线上网服务，充分满足商务旅客的需求。面积达103平方米的套房颇为引人注目，其270度全景落地玻璃可让宾客将城市天际线与珠江美景尽收眼底，为宾客打造了一处宁静惬意的休闲之所。此外，每间房间均配备了亲肤床品和宽敞的步入式淋浴间，力求为每位宾客带来高品质的入住体验。
description.textEn: Uncover the distinctive travel experience at Courtyard by Marriott Guangzhou Pazhou! From our hotel's ideal location, it's effortless for guests to explore the dynamic core of Guangzhou. Business travelers can enjoy direct connectivity to Canton Fair Complex and proximity to major corporate headquarters in Pearl River New Town and commercial districts. Whether it is engaging in invigorating workouts in the fitness center or the semi-indoor swimming pool, we ensure it's easy to rejuvenate and refresh during your stay. Savor delectable and boundless feast incorporating Cantonese elements, whether it's day or night. Discover residential comfort and captivating style in our 316 spacious hotel rooms and suites, each offering vistas of Pearl River or Guangzhou skyline. Courtyard by Marriott Guangzhou Pazhou is eager to offer you an unforgettable stay.

records.name_zh: 广州白云国际会议中心越秀源宿酒店

description.textZh: 广州白云国际会议中心越秀源宿酒店位于白云新城核心区域，紧邻广州地铁2号线白云文化广场站，毗邻广州白云国际会议中心、广州儿童公园，广州城市规划展览中心，距离白云山5A级风景区、广州体育馆、五号停机坪购物广场及凯德云尚仅需5分钟车程，是客人追求休闲娱乐的理想下榻之地。401间客房及套房配备了齐全的厨房设施和标志性“天梦之床”（Heavenly Bed®），让入住的客人时刻保持身心平衡、焕发活力。源膳餐厅为客人提供营养健康的早餐。酒店提倡绿色、健康的生活理念，为客人提供设备齐全的健身中心和自行车租赁服务，鼓励客人在入住期间绿色出行，倡导低碳生活新方式。
description.textEn: Element Guangzhou Baiyun is located at the center of Baiyun CBD, linked directly to Baiyun Culture Square Metro Station, conveniently connected to Guangzhou Baiyun International Convention Center, Guangzhou Children’s Park, Guangdong Art Academies, Guangzhou Urban Planning Bureau, 5-minute drive away from Baiyun Mountain, Guangzhou Gymnasium, Gate 5 and CapitalLand SKY+ shopping malls, creates a convenient and nature-influenced environment especially for family visitors. The 401 hotel rooms and suites are fully equipped with kitchens and the signature Heavenly Bed®, all arranged to help you stay connected, feel alive and balanced while you're away. Enjoy a trendy breakfast at Rise & Relax with healthy food options. Encouraging a sense of wellbeing and green lifestyle, the hotel includes Fitness Center and the Bikes to Borrow Program, which are designed for guests to stay invigorated.

records.name_zh: 广州花都万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 广州花都万豪万枫酒店坐落于花都区中心，地理位置 优越，毗邻花都区政府及花都广场，紧靠大型综合购物中心百业广场，让您在忙碌的行程随时可以享受购物的乐趣；毗邻风景优美的花都湖国家湿地公园，湖光山色，是您放松身心、亲近自然的好去处；与乐玩有趣的广州融创文旅城相邻，为您的旅程增添更多欢乐与精彩。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Guangzhou Huadu is located in the heart of Huadu District, adjacent to the Huadu District Government and Huadu Square. It is closely adjacent to Baiye Plaza, a large comprehensive shopping center, allowing you to enjoy the fun of shopping at any time during your busy schedule. The hotel is surrounded by the scenic Huadu Lake National Wetland Park, where the beautiful lake and mountain scenery provide an ideal place for you to relax and get close to nature. It is also adjacent to the fun-filled Guangzhou Sunac Cultural Tourism City, adding more joy and excitement to your journey. With a highly advantageous geographical location, the hotel is surrounded by an integrated three-dimensional transportation network that combines airports, high-speed railways, subways, and expressways, helping you fully explore the thousand-year-old commercial capital of Guangzhou.

records.name_zh: 广州空港万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于白云国际机场西南商务区，距白云国际机场T1航站楼直线距离1公里，提供定时穿梭巴士服务，与酒店实现直接接驳，一站到达白云国际机场。酒店共有 263 间客房，配备 55 英寸 LCD高清电视、步入式淋浴间和免费高速无线网络连接， 万枫餐厅设有 130 个座位。宾客可在此享用多种选择的自助早餐。大堂吧设有 60 个座位。客人还可在全天候自助式 "万枫小铺 "购买小吃和茶点。此外，酒店的全天候健身中心设备齐全，让客人在旅途中也能保持运动习惯；酒店还配备了 415 平方米的多功能空间，为中小型会议提供专业的会议服务。
description.textEn: The hotel features 263 guestrooms which equipped with 55 inch LED TVs, walk-in showers and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi to fulfill different needs of guests. The Fairfield Restaurant comes with 130 seats. Guests can enjoy buffet breakfast with a variety options. One lobby bar with a capacity of 60 seats. Guests can also purchase snacks and refreshments from the all-day self-service “24/7 Market”. Besides, hotel‘s 24/7 well-equipped fitness center allows guests to maintain their exercise routine even while traveling; Also, hotel is equipped with 415- square-meter function space to provide professional meeting service for small to medium scale meetings.

records.name_zh: 广州天河合景福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 广州天河合景福朋喜来登酒店位于天河区，于2018年焕新升级，以全新姿态为您呈现无与伦比的住宿体验。酒店可快速到达众多大型交易展览所在地的广交会展馆及广州金融城。交通便捷，毗邻宜家家居、山姆超市、保利鱼珠港等多个大型休闲购物中心。酒店共有296间简约典雅的客房与套间，可俯瞰广州城景及周边绿意。在这里，我们为您准备好福朋特色舒适之床（Four Comfort® Bed）、高速网络连接及精致的浴室配套设施等，营造安心休憩之所。近1,000平方米的无柱灵活宴会空间和自然采光的宴会前厅，是您会议及商旅活动的上佳之选。聚味轩中餐厅、宜客乐西餐厅提供高性价比的地道粤式风味及环球西式美馔；大堂吧为您呈献福朋特色精酿Best Brew™及多款特色饮品。此外，酒店还提供室内恒温泳池，助您一站式畅享美好惬意差旅。广交会期间，酒店为入住宾客提供往返于酒店和广交会展馆的免费穿梭巴士服务，并于酒店大堂设海外参展商办证处以及自助货币兑换机。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Guangzhou Financial City, Tianhe, fully renovated in 2018, greets you with a brand-new identity and unparalleled stays. Enjoy essentials like the Four Comfort® Bed, delicious breakfast, fresh coffee, and great local beer with Best Brews™. Our 296 spacious guest rooms feature free WiFi and flat-screen TVs, with 24-hour room service available. For meetings, weddings, or special events, we offer 854 m² of space including two pillar-less ballrooms (300 m² meters each). The two featured restaurants – China Spice and The Eatery – present authentic delicacies and global cuisines to satisfy your appetite. Recharge at our indoor fitness center and heated indoor pool, revitalizing your travel energy. The Canton Fair Complex is just an 18-minute drive away, and we offer complimentary shuttle service between the hotel and the Complex throughout official exhibition dates. Overseas exhibitors enjoy complimentary badge registration and self-service currency exchange in the hotel lobby.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guangzhou, Baiyun
records.name_zh: 广州白云国际会议中心越秀福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 拥有优越地理位置的广州白云国际会议中心越秀福朋喜来登酒店为宾客提供宾至如归的放松之旅。酒店位于白云新城核心地带与广州地铁2号线白云文化广场站相连，毗邻广州白云国际会议中心、大型综合购物中心及甲级写字楼，是商务和休闲旅行者下榻的现代化港湾。设计精致简约的350间客房和套房配有现代化的生活用品、设置齐全的娱乐系统，可助客人放松身心，恢复活力。多样的用餐选择，满足客人挑剔的味蕾：在满溢烧烤香气的玩啤食社中体验各式风味烧烤美食；或在内设台球桌的大堂吧中尊享“醇饮优选计划”提供的特选精酿啤酒。酒店配有室外游泳池和设施齐全的健身中心，为客人一天的工作画上圆满的句号。广州白云国际会议中心越秀福朋喜来登酒店位于白云万豪酒店群中与由万豪酒店团队管理的会议中心相连，提供多功能的活动空间，配上经验丰富的宴会策划服务团队是举办成功会议、典雅婚礼和社交活动的理想之地。
description.textEn: Experience the ideal blend of location and welcoming services at Four Points by Sheraton Guangzhou, Baiyun. Located in the center of Baiyun CBD, linked directly to Baiyun Culture Square Metro Station, nearby GZ Baiyun International Convention Center, shopping malls and office towers, the hotel is a contemporary hub for business and leisure travelers. Relax in 350 beautifully appointed hotel rooms and suites with modern amenities. Enjoy great craft beer with Best Brews™ at Lobby Bar or barbecue buffet at The Mesh. A stand-alone Convention Center managed by Marriott Hotel Team, providing a flawless meeting and social engagement in versatile event space, enhanced by custom catering and experienced planning professionals. Punctuate a day of work with a refreshing dip in our outdoor pool or a workout in Fitness Center. Centered amid popular attractions, our hotel is the home base for your visit to Guangzhou, China.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guangzhou, Huangpu New City
records.name_zh: 广州黄埔新城福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 本酒店位于广州 “东进” 战略核心腹地，坐拥黄埔临港经济区与穗港智造合作区交汇的枢纽位置，是连接广州主城、联动深圳与香港的重要门户。享有立体多维的路网体系，双地铁环伺，多条主干道与快速路贯通周边，快速通达珠江新城等核心商圈，轻松连接大湾区各主要城市。周边配套丰富完善，近百万方商业综合体、特色滨水古街满足消费休闲需求，更有十余座生态公园环绕，绿意盎然，营造宁静自然的居住环境。酒店内设 168 间雅致舒适的客房，并配备全日制餐厅 “玩啤食社”，提供丰富多样的美食；大堂吧 “醇饮优选” 精酿啤酒，是放松小酌的品质空间。此外，酒店还拥有 3 间配备先进视听设备的多功能会议室，以及全天候自助洗衣房与健身房，全面满足商务差旅与休闲住宿需求，是城市精英出行下榻的品质之选。
description.textEn: Located in Guangzhou's "Eastward Expansion" core, at the Huangpu Port and Sui-Hong Intelligent Manufacturing Zone intersection, it is a key gateway connecting Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. It enjoys excellent transport with two metro lines and major roads, offering 30-minute access to hubs like Zhujiang New Town for seamless Greater Bay Area connectivity. Surrounding features nearly one million sqm of commercial complexes, a waterfront ancient street, and over ten ecological parks for a tranquil, green environment.The hotel offers 168 elegant rooms. All-day dining at "The Mesh," the craft beer lobby bar "Best Brew Selection," three multi-function meeting rooms, a 24-hour laundry, and a fitness center cater to both business and leisure travelers, making it the top choice for urban elites.

records.name_zh: 广州白云国际会议中心越秀万豪酒店

description.textZh: 现代时尚与典雅的唯美融合，广州白云国际会议中心越秀万豪酒店将成为南中国区商旅新目的地。酒店坐落于中国广州白云新城核心区域，与广州地铁2号线白云文化广场站相连；邻近广州白云国际会议中心，距离广州体育馆仅需5分钟车程，为商务旅行的客人提供便捷、优越的商业环境。陶醉于8万平米的户外园林景观，大师糅合岭南园林故事谱写蕴含文化共融、宾客汇聚的寓意。流连于酒店餐厅的美食探索：领悟万豪中餐厅传承的精致粤菜。宽敞、典雅的贡厨餐厅提供丰盛的自助早、午、晚餐。酒店配备设施先进齐全的健身中心和室内恒温泳池、瑜珈室和干、湿蒸房，助宾客祛除一天的疲惫。850间糅合传统园林和现代美学设计的客房和套房，均配备齐全的设施和室内娱乐系统。酒店拥有私密格调的独立会议中心，提供高品质的视听会议设备。占地1300平米的无柱式大宴会厅是城中宴会庆典的理想之选。广州白云国际会议中心越秀万豪酒店，为您缔造卓越非凡的酒店体验。
description.textEn: Fusing contemporary stylish and incomparable elegance, Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Baiyun is a premium hotel to provide guests with a city retreat in Southern China. Located in the center of Baiyun CBD, linked directly to Baiyun Culture Square Metro Station, the hotel is also conveniently connected to GZ Baiyun International Convention Center, providing an impeccable and friendly business surrounding area for travelers. Explore a culinary journey at one of our restaurants and bars or take a vigorous workout at our hi-tech Fitness Center and refreshing pool. An impressive stand-alone Convention Center offers top-tier function facilities and the state-of-the-art technology. The expansive 1,300 sqm pillarless ballroom is set to become the perfect destination for celebration and events. Our 850 modern hotel rooms and suites are luxuriously appointed and equipped with sophisticated in-room entertainment systems. Elevate your experience at Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Baiyun.

records.name_zh: 广州南沙金茂万豪酒店

description.textZh: Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Nansha is situated in the heart of Nansha Free Trade Zone, with convenient access to Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. whether for business travel or staycation, let your mind travel.
description.textEn: Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Nansha is centrally located in Nansha Free Trade Zone, boasting superior connectivity across the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.It enjoys easy access to Line 4 Metro Station, Guangzhou South Railway Station, as well as Shenzhen Bao’an and Guangzhou Baiyun International Airports. Guests can take advantage of comprehensive facilities including a fitness center, free private parking, complimentary Wi-Fi and 6km-radius Robotaxi service.Three distinctive dining outlets are available, Lin Garden for authentic Cantonese dishes, Nansha Kitchen all-day dining and The Lounge, delivering rich culinary choices.Our 24-hour multilingual front desk team offers thoughtful service in Mandarin, Cantonese and English to guarantee a remarkable stay.

records.name_zh: 广州正佳广场万豪酒店

description.textZh: 广州正佳广场万豪酒店于2012年6月全新开业，地处市中心，地理位置得天独厚，邻近正佳广场以及广州的主要商业和交通枢纽，内设装潢时尚的客房和套房，为宾客缔造舒适难忘的住宿体验。酒店提供大理石浴室和平面电视等超凡住宿环境，从酒店内的众多客房均可欣赏到广州的迷人城景。广州正佳广场万豪酒店内还设有现代化健身中心、室内恒温泳池等贴心周到的设施。千万不可错过酒店内水疗中心的护理服务，它会让您的广州之行精彩无比。尽情享用Man Ho万豪中餐厅的中式美食和City Bistro都会尚膳的国际佳肴。在广州筹办活动？ 探索酒店的雅致活动空间，助您举办精彩难忘的活动。入住广州正佳广场万豪酒店，开启您的非凡之旅。
description.textEn: Captivating guests with style and innovation, the Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Tianhe is a sophisticated haven in the heart of the Tianhe business district. Experience effortless relaxation in elegantly styled hotel accommodations with marble bathrooms, 40-inch TVs, plug-in technology and city views. Thrill your palate with mouthwatering dim sum, delectable international fare and bountiful buffets at our distinctive restaurants. Enjoy a coveted location adjacent to Grandview Mall near Guangzhou's major business and transportation hubs. Host successful meetings, magical weddings and formal social engagements in sophisticated event space with, cutting-edge audiovisual services, custom catering and expert planners. When it’s all said and done, refresh in the sparkling waters of our pools, exhilarate your body at our health club or pamper yourself at our rejuvenating spa. Expand your horizons at our elegant hotel in the Tianhe District of Guangzhou, China.

description.textZh: 广州粤海喜来登酒店以喜来登全新理念于2022年完成焕新装修。地处广州中央商务区中心地带，酒店连通羊城购物翘楚天河城，临近天环广场、太古汇等高级商城。酒店距广州东站仅 10分钟车程，同时距离广交会展馆仅20分钟车程。酒店位于地铁一号线和三号线2条主要地铁线交汇处，可轻松直达广州白云国际机场。酒店拥有 445 间焕新装修的客房，房间宽敞明亮，整体更强调活力以及个性化体验。并设有盛宴全日自助餐厅、班妮意海鲜餐厅、采悦轩中餐厅以及酒店大堂吧。酒店还设有 13 处活动场地，其中包括一间大宴会厅。您可以在健身中心和行政酒廊享受舒适的自然光并俯瞰天河体育中心都会景致。酒店提供室外恒温泳池，是您放松身心或商务出行的理想之地。此外，酒店于广交会期间提供往返于酒店和广交会展馆的免费班车服务。
description.textEn: Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel completed an extensive renovation following the transformed Sheraton concept in 2022. Located in the heart of Guangzhou's CBD, the hotel is connected to shopping malls, such as TEEMALL, Grandview Mall, and Taikoo Hui. The hotel is right at the intersection of two major metro lines, Line 1 and Line 3, providing easy access to Canton Fair Complex and airport. The hotel's 445 newly renovated rooms are bright and spacious, with an emphasis on energy and personalised experiences. The hotel features an all-day-dining restaurant, Bene Italian & Seafood Kitchen, Yue Chinese Restaurant, and the hotel's lobby bar, &More by Sheraton. The hotel has 13 event venues, including a grand ballroom. Our valued guests can enjoy natural light in the fitness centre and executive lounge while overlooking Tianhe Sports Centre. The hotel offers a heated outdoor pool, making it the ideal place to relax. Free shuttle service between the hotel and Canton Fair Complex is offered during Canton Fair period.

records.name_zh: 广州南沙越秀喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻广州南沙越秀喜来登酒店，尽享非凡旅行体验。所有 291 间客房和套房，包括富丽堂皇的总统套房，均提供高效办公或休闲娱乐所需的各种设施及服务。明亮的落地窗将为您呈现南沙和蕉门河的优美景观。放眼酒店各处，当地设计元素与现代装潢和高科技设施和谐相融。客房配备平板电视，高速 Wi-Fi 确保您在住宿期间轻松保持在线。喜来登特色睡眠体验之床加上清爽棉质床单，将助您安享一夜好眠。浴室内设有步入式淋浴间和独立浴缸，为您呈献心仪沐浴体验。酒店设有 11 间布置精美的多功能厅，总面积逾 1,858 平方米。无柱式大宴会厅可分隔成三个空间，适宜举办婚礼和接待会。广州南沙越秀喜来登酒店热诚期待您的光临。
description.textEn: A remarkable visit to Guangdong, China awaits you at Sheraton Guangzhou Nansha Hotel. All of our 291 guest rooms and suites, including our stately Presidential Suite, have everything you need for productivity and relaxation here in China. Floor-to-ceiling windows offer wonderful views over Nansha and the Jiaomen River. Throughout our hotel, local design elements blend with contemporary decor and technology. Stay connected during your time in Nansha, Guangdong with high-speed Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV. Get a good night’s rest in the crisp cotton sheets of a plush Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience bed. Bathrooms are equipped with both walk-in showers and separate bathtubs for your preference. Our hotel's 11 beautifully appointed function rooms total more than 20,000 square feet of versatile space. Divisible into three sections, our hotel's pillarless grand ballroom provides an inviting setting for weddings and receptions in Guangdong, China. We can't wait to welcome you to Sheraton Guangzhou Nansha Hotel.

description.textZh: 广州奥园喜来登酒店地处番禺万博CBD核心位置，毗邻5A景区广州长隆度假区。拥有便捷的交通直达城市交通枢纽，步行约5分钟即可抵达地铁7号线、18号线南村万博站，约10分钟车程抵达长隆度假区，约20分钟到达广州琶洲会展中心；此外，广交会期间酒店内将设置境外采购商办证点，并为住店客人提供来回酒店和广交会展馆的免费穿梭巴士服务。周边餐饮购物娱乐一应俱全，步行即可抵达万达广场、番禺天河城、四海城等大型综合购物中心。酒店拥有两百余间宽敞舒适的客房和套房，分布在 30 到 41 楼，视野开阔，透过全景落地玻璃即可俯瞰城市繁华美景，匠心设计的空间可谓工作休闲两相宜，舒适睡床缔造喜来登闻名遐迩的标志性特色睡眠体验。位于41楼的行政酒廊，指定客人可享非凡礼遇，包括早餐和欢乐时光，专享行政酒廊待遇及特权。3家风格别致的餐厅汇聚中西美食，为您的味蕾带来奇妙的美食之旅。超过1375平方米的会议空间，包括一个820平方米的可分隔为两个区域的无柱式宴会厅以及8个可灵活使用的会议室及多功能会议厅，适合各种主题的会议、婚礼等。24小时开放的健身中心包含设备齐全的健身房以及室内恒温泳池。让您尽情放松、身心愉悦。
description.textEn: Gemstones and jewels are the visual and energetic inspiration at the Sheraton Guangzhou Panyu, located in the city’s central business district near Chimelong Resort. Sparkling stones cascade from the ceiling in the lobby, where a cozy lounge invites conversation and connection over coffee and cocktails, and glass and metal features, decorative panels and a carved ceiling create a gallery-inspired setting. This aesthetic carries into accommodations where large windows overlook the city from the 30th to 41st floors, spaces are dedicated to work and relaxation and beds are designed with Sheraton’s signature sleep experience. In the Executive Lounge, select guests enjoy dedicated benefits including complimentary breakfast and happy hours. The hotels jewel box opens to reveal even more beautiful spaces, a Chinese restaurant with private dining rooms, a pillar-free ballroom with built-in LED screen, an indoor infinity pool overlooked by lounge beds and an all-day cafe with international buffets.

records.name_zh: 广州富力丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: 广州富力丽思卡尔顿酒店地处广州中央商务区珠江新城的核心，临近珠江，毗邻广东省博物馆、广州大剧院、广州图书馆以及时尚新地标K11购物艺术中心，与广交会新馆和广州塔隔江相望。距离白云国际机场约有45公里，或30分钟的车程。 酒店拥有350间客房，90套豪华公寓。最基础的房型均以50平方米起步，每间客房均拥有入门走廊、步入式衣帽间等贴心设计。原木板搭配柔软细腻的羊绒地毯让旅途之家倍感温馨；全新「尊贵客房」，展现当代经典与丽思卡尔顿黄金标准的精彩结合。个性化的私密、舒适与尊享，是丽思卡尔顿行政楼层的代名词。位于33楼的行政酒廊尽揽270度珠江美景，在这里，行政楼层客人可以在每日五个时段享受多彩精致的餐饮及一系列的个性化服务。 酒店拥有以米其林一星餐厅丽轩为代表的五间特色餐厅及酒吧，既承传了“食在广州”的饮食精髓，又紧贴世界美食潮流：除了尊贵粤式餐厅丽轩，还有提供地道意大利罗马菜肴的意轩意大利餐厅，国际美食舞台FOODS，欧式大堂吧珍珠酒廊和英式威士忌雪茄吧邱吉尔吧。丽思卡尔顿水疗为客人量身订制个性化的水疗及健身体验：九间理疗房，美容沙龙和水疗精品店，还有专业的理疗师热忱为您服务；24小时健身中心配有瑜伽房及罗马式室外恒温泳池，是城中的一站式休息绿洲，为宾客提供个性化休闲体验；超过3,300平方米的宴会及会议空间，包括面积达1,209平方米的无柱豪华宴会厅，资深的宴会及会议服务团队，致力为客户提供仔细周到的个性化服务，成就每个难忘的聚会。
description.textEn: Located in the center of Pearl River New City, The Ritz-Carlton, Guangzhou is a luxury destination in the Southern China hub. Distinctive services and facilities include 350 guest rooms, with the Club Lounge and suites and guest rooms newly renovated, as well as five restaurants and lounges, including the signature Cantonese restaurant, Lai Heen, which has retained its Michelin star consecutively since the inaugural Michelin Guide Guangzhou in 2018. An extensive health club and The Ritz-Carlton Spa rejuvenate body and mind, while extensive catering and meeting facilities span over 3,300 square meters, including a large pillarless Grand Ballroom that measures 1,209 square meters. The Residences at The Ritz-Carlton, Guangzhou features 90 luxury serviced apartments of one to four bedrooms in size.

description.textZh: 广州 W 酒店坐落于欣欣向荣的珠江新城, 以生机勃勃的城市元素为经纬线, 汇聚一系列现代建筑、历史遗迹、豪华购物中心和娱乐场所, 织就一幅光彩夺目的锦绣画卷。酒店地处城市繁华中心地带, 步行可达多处历史景点以及地铁站和广州东火车站。酒店标帜餐厅, 全天候供应地道丰盛的中式佳肴和国际风味人气料理, 让广大美食爱好者一饱口福。您也可以前往 WOOBAR 酒吧小酌， 品赏特色酒饮。W 酒廊为酒店时尚现代的混搭风格锦上添花，而 FIT 健身中心， WET® 泳池和 AWAY® 水疗中心则可以助您放松身心、重焕活力。酒店 317 间客房（包括 32 间豪华套房）散发着传统与创新交相互融的魅力, 配备 W 睡床和按摩浴缸等别具特色的设施, 并采用先进的科技、华丽的装潢和气派的布局, 带给您非同凡响的住宿体验。在专业策划师的精心协助下, 酒店别具风格的会议场地可以让平平无奇的活动变得分外出彩。
description.textEn: Located in the city’s bustling Pearl River New Town District, W Guangzhou weaves the city's vibrant threads into a dazzling tapestry of modern architecture, rich history, luxury shopping and captivating entertainment. This city center hotel is steps from ancient sites, as well as the Metro and Guangzhou East Railway Station. All-day dining restaurant The Kitchen Table offering authentic Chinese and international cuisines to tempt every epicurean. After sampling those tantalizing tastes, discover signature sips in WOOBAR. W Lounge adds to the avant-garde mix, while FIT, WET and AWAY Spa fuse relaxation and rejuvenation. A magnetic intersection of heritage and innovation, our 317 hotel rooms, including 32 luxury suites, unite unique amenities, like our signature W Bed and indulgent jetted tubs, with top technology, glamorous décor and generous layouts. Our elevated, city center venues, supported by expert planners, take ordinary events and turn them into extraordinary productions.

description.textZh: 我们的酒店位于广州天河商务区的中心地带，邻近汇聚了广州市内大多数财富 500 强企业的中信广场和耀中广场。酒店地处市中心，位置优越，距高级购物中心和广州火车东站仅举步之遥。您可在我们的威斯汀健身馆畅快锻炼，在室内和室外泳池中尽情畅游，或享受按摩护理。还可前往我们的四家时尚餐厅和酒吧享用粤菜和意式料理等品类丰富的营养美食。酒店 444 间客房和套房均配备豪华舒适的天梦之床，室内采用挑高天花板设计，房间装饰色调柔和，助您保持心神宁静。宽敞整洁的客房内配备免费无线上网接入、平面电视，大型浴室内配有花洒和浸泡式浴缸。我们的活力客房致力于帮助您重焕身心活力，而威斯汀运动客房则可助您随心畅享健身之乐。
description.textEn: In heart of the Tian He business district, our hotel is adjacent to CITIC Plaza and China Shine, home to the majority of the Fortune 500 companies in Guangzhou. And our ideal City Center location puts you just steps from high-end shopping and the Guangzhou East Train Station. Stay fit at our WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio and in resplendent outdoor and indoor pools or reenergize with a sumptuous treatment. Enjoy delicious nourishment in our four chic restaurants and lounges, which feature a variety of cuisines including Cantonese and Italian. Our 444 hotel rooms and suites all offer the Heavenly Bed, high ceilings, and soft colors to keep you calm in spirit while in Guangzhou. Each immaculate and spacious room offers complimentary WiFi, flat-screen TVs and large bathrooms with rainfall showers and soaking tubs. Our Renewal Rooms are a mecca of complete rejuvenation while the WestinWORKOUT Room inspires workouts at your own pace.

description.textZh: 在广交会威斯汀酒店，您将领略与众不同的体验。酒店地理位置优越，商务旅客可轻松感受广州充满活力的城市核心氛围。从这里出发，可直接前往规模宏大的广交会会馆、珠江新城的各大企业办公室以及广州塔。在酒店的威斯汀健身中心进行活力满满的锻炼，或是在室内恒温泳池畅游，无论何时，都能让您在广州的时光中轻松恢复活力、焕发精神。无论白昼黑夜，您都可以一边享用精致美食，一边饱览琶洲的全景风光。我们的 325 间宽敞客房及套房兼具居家般的舒适与迷人格调。每一间都能欣赏到珠江或广州天际线的美景，并配备了贴心周到的设施。在我们酒店举办商务或社交活动，您将受益于灵活多变、现代时尚的场地，酒店内还提供专业的活动策划和餐饮服务，加之位于广州市中心的绝佳位置，定会让活动圆满成功。广交会威斯汀酒店期待为您带来一段难忘的入住体验。
description.textEn: Discover the difference at The Westin Pazhou.It’s easy to experience the vibrant heart of Guangzhou from our hotel’s prime location, providing business travelers with direct access to the expansive Canton Fair Complex, major corporate offices in Zhujiang New Town and Canton Tower.From invigorating workouts in our WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio to a heated indoor swimming pool, we make it easy to refresh and recharge during your stay in Guangzhou.Enjoy exquisite dining with panoramic views of Pazhou, day or night.Discover residential-style comfort and sophisticated design in our 325 spacious hotel rooms and suites, each offering views of the Pearl River or the Guangzhou skyline and thoughtful amenities.Host a business or social event at our hotel with versatile, modern venues, on-site planning and catering services, and a convenient location in the heart of Guangzhou.

description.textZh: 桂林中心万怡酒店坐落于桂林市七星区三金广场，是万豪国际酒店集团旗下精心打造的商务与休闲融合型酒店。酒店与著名景点“七星公园”仅数步之遥，距离桂林城徽“象鼻山”仅十分钟车程。周边商业配套成熟，毗邻甲天下会展中心、客世界广场、益华城广场，交通便捷，让您轻松饱览桂林山水与城市风光的双重魅力。酒店拥有133间精致客房，为商旅及度假宾客营造舒适高效的居停空间。餐饮休闲设施一应俱全：设有全日制餐厅，提供汇聚中西的特色美馔；大堂吧则是悠然小憩的理想之选。此外，酒店配备泳池、健身房以及24小时自助洗衣房，让您在旅途中亦能保持活力与便捷。酒店还设有儿童乐园，打造快乐的童趣时光。商务配套200平米的多功能会议室，可满足各类中小型会议、培训的需求，专业设施与服务团队将确保每一场活动圆满举办。选择桂林中心万怡酒店，即是选择国际品牌的安心保障与七星区的便捷地理优势，无论商务出行还是休闲旅游，这里都将成为您探索桂林的理想起点。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Guilin Downtown is located at SanJin Plaza in Qixing District, Guilin. As a meticulously crafted business and leisure hotel under Marriott International, it is just steps away from the renowned Seven Star Park and a ten-minute drive from Elephant Trunk Hill, the iconic symbol of Guilin. Surrounded by mature commercial facilities, it neighbors the Jiatianxia Convention Center, Ke World Plaza, and Yihua City Plaza. With convenient transportation, you can effortlessly experience the dual charm of Guilin's natural landscapes and urban scenery.

description.textZh: 阳朔万豪万枫酒店，位于广西壮族自治区桂林市阳朔镇千古情大道2号。在这里，可以去桂林千古情，《印象刘三姐》，领略阳朔的自然风光与文化底蕴；或者悠闲信步，在阳朔西街，在遇龙河畔；和家人一起去十里画廊，或世外桃源也很不错。酒店简约时尚的客房搭配现代风格的家具，开放式的室内空间设计让房间更显明亮宽敞。房内的设施兼具功能性、设计感和舒适度；舒适的床垫和华夫格亲肤的床品尽享安心睡眠。在健身中心保持您的健身习惯，然后去餐厅享用早餐开启活力满满的一天。放下繁复，归于简单，来阳朔万豪万枫酒店，体验“简约之美”。
description.textEn: The hotel is located in the Yangshuo Town, Guilin, next to the West Street, The Romantic Show of Guilin and many other attractions.It is only 11 minute drive from Yulong River scenic spot, 20 minutes drive from The Land of Peach Blossoms. Our 242 guest rooms are designed for maximum flexibility, with a minimalism look to ensure travelers of a flawless experience. Begin your morning with an energizing workout in our well-equipped fitness center, and enjoy a buffet breakfast before setting off.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guilin Central
records.name_zh: 桂林象山景区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Guilin Central is located in downtown Guilin, adjacent to iconic attractions such as Elephant Trunk Hill, Two Rivers and Four Lakes and East‑West Lane. Zhengyang Pedestrian Street and local food streets are within walking distance.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Guilin Central is situated in the prime downtown core of Guilin, surrounded by renowned cultural attractions, commercial districts and shopping malls. Adjacent to iconic sites including Elephant Trunk Hill, Two Rivers and Four Lakes, and EastWest Lane, the hotel is within walking distance of Zhengyang Pedestrian Street and local food streets. Approximately 3 kilometers from Guilin Railway Station, it offers seamless access to Guilin Liangjiang International Airport. Boasting an unbeatable location, it serves as an ideal starting point for business and leisure travelers to explore Guilin’s natural landscapes and urban charm.Its design blends contemporary light‑luxury aesthetics with Guilin’s natural charm. Embracing minimalist elegance and fluid lines, it balances modern style with comfort, making it ideal for business and leisure stays

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guilin, Lingui
records.name_zh: 桂林临桂花样年福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 1、商务休闲两不误 酒店位于桂林全新的商业及行政区，将为您带来高品质的舒适与便利体验。酒店所在的综合大楼设有一家零售商场，距行政机关和企业办事处也近在咫尺。2、丰富多彩的娱乐选择 您可跃入室内温水泳池尽情畅游，或是前往健身俱乐部为自己的健康充电。来到酒店大堂享受免费无线高速上网接入。还可光临大堂吧，畅饮醇饮优选™计划中的冰爽啤酒，或是品尝一杯新鲜现煮的香浓咖啡，放松身心。在全日制宜客乐餐厅以全套早餐开启美好的一天，然后在聚味中餐厅享用美味可口的午餐或晚餐。酒店拥有总面积超过1,600平米的灵活会议空间，均配有先进超凡的技术设施，是您举办成功商务活动的理想选择。3、 酒店拥有242间房，经过一整天的商务活动或观光之旅后，在舒适宜人的客房中放松休憩，尽情饱览壮观迷人的城市美景。房内的贴心设施包括无线网络、纯平电视和我们的福朋特色的“舒适之床”。
description.textEn: Business, Leisure or Both. The Four Points by Sheraton Guilin, Lingui offers uncomplicated comforts and a convenient location in the heart of Lingui, Guilin’s new business and administrative district. Our hotel’s complex includes a retail mall with administrative organization nearby. Plenty of Options. Take a dip in the indoor heated pool or work up a sweat in the health club. Enjoy wireless High-Speed Internet Access in our lobby. That’s also where you’ll find our lounge, where you can relax with a freshly-brewed coffee or sample the International beers in our selection of Best Brews™. Start your day with a full breakfast at the Eatery, our all-day dining restaurant and have a delicious lunch or dinner at China Spice.

description.textZh: 桂林喜来登饭店坐落在桂林市中心滨江路漓江畔，步行可达象鼻山、东西巷、逍遥楼、靖江王府、日月双塔等景点。东倚秀丽的漓江，南傍迷人的象鼻山，近览七星公园，北望伏波山、叠彩诸峰，地理位置优越。酒店距火车站仅约4公里，驱车约40分钟可抵达桂林两江国际机场，交通十分便利。酒店焕新客房已闪亮登场，全新客房融入淡雅的桂林山水元素，既拥有轻奢雅致的现代风格，又不失水墨丹青的意境，将给您带来活力焕发的入住体验。酒店曾成功接待外国总统、王子等重要贵宾，并获得了来自客人：“优秀的工作态度以及高尚的职业道德”的高度赞扬。
description.textEn: Transform your trip to China with a stay at Sheraton Guilin Hotel, an ideally located hotel in Guilin, on the banks of the Li River close to Zhengyang Walking Street, Elephant Trunk Hill and Fubo Mountain. Our family-friendly hotel boasts 408 newly renovated, well-appointed guest rooms, many of which overlook the beautiful Li River or garden and all offering complimentary Wi-Fi and Sheraton Signature beds for a good night's sleep. Upgrade to one of our spacious suites or Club level rooms to access the Club lounge with complimentary benefits. Guests can relax at our hotel's state-of-the-art leisure gym and outdoor pool, or experience a delicious meal at our restaurants, as well as in-room dining. For those wishing to host a meeting or special event in Guilin, China, our hotel has an array of inspiring spaces complete with smart technology and bespoke planning services to ensure a successful day.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit and special local dishes. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and free breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guiyang Guanshanhu
records.name_zh: 贵阳观山湖福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 贵阳观山湖福朋喜来登酒店作为万豪旅享家旗下以“舒适而简约，自在而真诚”为理念的精选服务酒店品牌，始终致力于为旅客提供轻松高效的旅居体验。贵阳观山湖福朋喜来登酒店延续品牌一贯的现代风格与贴心服务，结合本地文化与城市风貌，打造出一处既适合商务出行、又适宜休闲探索的高空驿站。酒店坐落于贵阳蓬勃发展的观山湖区核心位置，距离贵阳北站及国际会展中心仅约3公里，距离机场约20公里，交通便捷，助您高效连接城市动脉与重要场所。
description.textEn: The Four Points by Sheraton Guiyang Guanshanhu as a select service brands under the Marriott with the concept of "comfort and simplicity, freedom and sincerity", Four Points by Sheraton has always been committed to providing travelers with a relaxed and efficient travel experience. The hotel continues the brand's consistent modern style and attentive service, combining local culture and urban style to create a high-altitude station that is suitable for both business travel and leisure exploration.The hotel is located in the heart of the Guanshanhu district in Guiyang, only about 3 kilometers away from Guiyang North Station and the International Convention and Exhibition Center, and about 20 kilometers away from the airport. With convenient transportation, it helps you efficiently connect the city's arteries with important places.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guiyang Shilihetan
records.name_zh: 贵阳十里河滩福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 贵阳十里河滩福朋喜来登酒店位于贵州省贵阳市花溪区，周边旅游资源丰富毗邻十里河滩旅游度假区，孔学堂和青岩古镇。靠近万宜广场，花溪十字街及大学城融合商务与休闲区域。酒店拥有161间宽敞舒适的客房及套房所有房间均配备了品牌特有的福朋舒适之床为您营造良好睡眠环境。大堂吧拥有独具福朋品牌特色的“醇饮优选”计划是您集休闲、商务于一体的最佳选择玩啤食社西餐厅更可以让您品尝到世界各地精致美馔。作为万豪集团旗下一贯闻名的"舒适入住”酒店，将为全球商旅人士带来轻松惬意的入住体验。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Guiyang Huaxi Park is locatedin Huaxi District, with abundant tourism resources in thesurrounding area, it is close to Shilihetan Scenic Area,Confucius Institute,Qingyan Ancient Town. NearbyWan Yi Plaza and Cross Street of Huaxi,University Townblends business and leisure areas.We have 161 spacious and comfortable guest roomsand suites equipped with the Four PointsSignature Bed to create a good night's sleep.The Lobby Bar on 1F,with brand signatureBest Brews" program offering local craft beers,is the best choice for leisure and business.The Mesh of the hotel is 1F and you can enjoyall kinds of delicious food from all over the worldAs a well-known comfortable staybrand of Marriott Group, we are dedicatedto provide a matchless experience forglobal business and leisure travelers.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guiyang, Huaxi
records.name_zh: 贵阳花溪福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 贵阳花溪福朋喜来登酒店坐落于西南中心城市之一的贵阳，地处花溪区小河转盘商业中心。周边以优质商业为核心，集成多家品牌购物中心、优质写字楼、当地文化美食区等。酒店紧邻市内旅游景区花溪区，通达市内各行政区，方便快捷，地理位置优越。酒店将永恒经典与现代的细节交织，让宾客在繁忙的工作中与缤纷乐趣相遇。为寻求旅途平衡的独立旅行者们提供优质的休息和放松场所，让旅行者们获得满意的宾客体验。无论您旅行至此的目的是工作或是度假，您所想要的格调与服务均能满足。我们拥有272间典雅简约的客房，每间客房均可坐拥惊艳的城中美景。感受旅途中的自然奇趣，尽情享受福朋“舒适之床”的惬意温馨，畅饮醇饮优选（Best Brews™）的当地精酿啤酒。早晨用美味的“福朋特色早餐”唤醒沉睡的灵魂；再到24小时都开放的健身中心挥洒汗水，尽情释放；配备优秀的商务中心将提供免费的互联网服务。拥有开放式厨房的全日制宜客乐餐厅全天候开放，将舒适氛围与美味佳肴相辅相成，带来无可比拟的用餐体验。聚味中餐厅将为您呈现地道顺德粤菜、创意黔菜及江南苏帮菜等特色美馔。大堂吧的醇饮优选计划为您提供本地精酿啤酒及种类繁多的小食，是您聚会聊天场所的理想之选。
description.textEn: When visiting Guiyang, China for work or play, settle in for a relaxing stay at Four Points by Sheraton Guiyang, Huaxi. From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program featuring locally sourced craft beers on tap, every detail of our hotel shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. A delicious breakfast to start the day right and casual and modern dining options in the evening showcase the flavors of Guiyang. Free wifi throughout the hotel enables guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to the gym, we have partnered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points by Sheraton Guiyang, Huaxi offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax during your next stay in Guiyang.

description.textZh: 贵阳万丽酒店位于贵州省贵阳市观山湖区核心位置，紧邻观山湖湿地公园、贵阳市政府、贵阳市行政中心、贵州省博物馆及会展中心。交通便利，地铁和机场快线均有站点可抵达酒店。酒店拥有336间现代化客房，BLD全日制餐厅、新满福楼中餐厅、百味川黔餐厅、大堂吧逸庭和行政酒廊等优质食肆。在这里，我们提供1230平方米的灵活创意活动空间，其中包括700平方米的无柱式宴会厅、九间会议室、一间贵宾室及多功能商务中心；更有经验丰富的活动策划团队，精心为您打造出成功的会议。无论您是因何而来，您总会发现一些美妙新颖的事物。
description.textEn: Designed for Social Discoverers, Renaissance Guiyang Hotel is located in the Guanshanhu District, the fast-developing political center of China's Guizhou Province. The Municipal Government Administration Complex is situated directly in front of the hotel, and the lush green Guanshan Park is just next door. Our 336 rooms and suites offer chic decor, deluxe bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi and views of the Guiyang skyline. Reserve a Club level room to enjoy access to the Club Lounge, located on the top floor of the hotel and offering a range of extra perks. Sample Chinese and international cuisine at one of our three restaurants. If you're hosting an event in Southwest China, we offer several flexible venues, including a striking ballroom with space for over 500 seated guests. Should you wish to explore, attractions including Guizhou Provincial Museum are easily within reach. Your getaway awaits at Renaissance Guiyang Hotel.

description.textZh: 贵阳喜来登贵航酒店坐落在美丽的南明河畔，位于大南门商务区。酒店距贵阳龙洞堡国际机场仅约 15 分钟车程，约 5 分钟可达火车站。酒店位于贵阳市中心，从酒店出发步行约 5 分钟可达闻名遐迩的甲秀楼。步行只需约 3 分钟即可抵达筑城广场，这里可通往沃尔玛超市。酒店拥有 2,496 平米左右的多功能空间，提供超凡的餐饮和策划服务，适合举办聚会。酒店尽显时尚现代风范，设有室内泳池、健身中心以及配备先进设施的现代化客房。酒店位于贵阳，拥有 343 间客房和套房，不论是家庭逍遥游还是商务住宿，这里均是理想目的地。特色睡床将您旅途的疲惫一扫而空，智能设施助您放松休闲，高速上网让您保持通畅联络，更提供各种必需设施与服务，让您在充满活力的贵阳市中心愉悦下榻。
description.textEn: Sheraton Guiyang Hotel is located in the Dananmen business area, beside the beautiful Nanming River. Our hotel is only a 15-minute drive to Guiyang Longdongbao International Airport and five minutes to the main train station. The famous Jiaxiu Pavilion is only a five-minute walk from our downtown Guiyang hotel. Walk to Zhucheng Square, which also has access to the Wal-Mart supermarket, in just three minutes. Host a gathering in our 26,866 square feet of function space, complemented by superb catering and planning services. Our modern hotel houses an indoor swimming pool, a fitness center and contemporary accommodation with premium amenities. Featuring 343 guest rooms and suites, our hotel in Guiyang, China, is the ideal destination for every occasion, from family getaways to business stays. Recharge in our signature bed after your travels, kick back with smart amenities and stay connected with high-speed internet – all the essentials for an effortless stay in the vibrant city center of Guiyang, China.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_zh: 海口美兰万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 海口美兰万豪万枫酒店交通便捷，地理位置优越，地处美兰区政务中心和国兴CBD，紧邻省委省政府，省博物馆，省歌剧院，省图书馆，日月广场免税中心，步行10分钟至桫椤湾艺术风情街，雅乐里商业街；驱车约25分钟至海口美兰国际机场，20分钟至海口高铁东站，20分钟至秀英港渡轮码头。距离海南岛大河流南渡江约1.5公里，南渡江设有步道和骑行道，是海口上佳的骑行和徒步路线。周边五公里内有著名景点五公祠，海口骑楼老街，海瑞故居，琼台书院。酒店兼具奢华与质感，独栋建筑的安排让您能享受舒适与安静，仿若置身世外桃源；酒店105间精致客房，均配备65寸全高清可投屏电视、TOTO马桶、Moen恒温卫浴、Nirvae洗护产品和环保级客用品，为客户提供安心奢享的入住体验；酒店健身设备采用国际一线品牌Matrix，提供理想的健身体验。酒店设有145平多功能会议室和西餐厅满足专业、高效的商务需求。无论您是旅途劳顿，还是商务出行，海口美兰万豪万枫酒店都将为您提供便捷且舒适的住宿体验。万千枫景无限好，我们在海口等您！
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Haikou Meilan hotel is located in the government affairs center of Haikou Meilan District, with convenient transportation, about 13 km from Haikou Meilan International Airport, about 5.5 km from Haikou East Railway Station, about 5 km from Shophouse Old Street, about 2 km from Riyue Square Duty Free Shop, Suoluo Art Style Street business Circle is just 10 mintutes by feet; The residents' life is rich, original and simple ,Dady tea, Coconut chicken, the endless coconut forest , as traveling indifferent time and space. The quality of the hotel shows luxury and texture. The hall reprints the classic in the modern fusion, luxury stone and geometric simplicity collision; The hotel's 105 exquisite rooms are equipped with 65-inch LEDTV, TOTO toilet, Moen thermostatic bathroom, eco-friendly guest products, providing guests a quiet and luxurious stay experience. All the partners of Hotel will accompany you to spend an unforgettable trip with sincere service. Welcome to Hainan!

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Haikou International Airport
records.name_zh: 海口国际机场福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 海口国际机场福朋喜来登酒店坐落于海口美兰国际机场周边，交通便捷，为商务及休闲旅客提供舒适高效的住宿体验。酒店拥有149间现代简约风格的客房及套房，布局规整，空间明亮，其中高级房型面积约40平方米，配备福朋喜来登品牌特色的舒适睡床、灵活办公区及高速网络，满足差旅与度假的双重需求。酒店临近机场及海口市区主要商圈，兼顾出行便利与城市探索的可能。无论是中转停留，还是深度体验海口的热带风情与滨海活力，这里都以标志性的“简约自在”服务，为宾客打造轻松可靠的旅居选择。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Haikou International Airport Hotel is located in the vicinity of Haikou Meilan International Airport, offering convenient transportation and providing comfortable and efficient accommodation experiences for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel features 149 guest rooms and suites with a modern and minimalist style, boasting regular layouts and bright spaces. Among them, the superior rooms cover an area of approximately 40 square meters, equipped with Four Points by Sheraton's signature comfortable beds, flexible work areas, and high-speed internet, catering to the dual needs of business trips and vacations.Situated close to the airport and Haikou's main commercial districts, the hotel provides easy access to transportation and urban exploration. Whether for a transit stay or an in-depth experience of Haikou's tropical charm and coastal vibrancy, the hotel delivers its signature "Simple Made Perfect" service, creating a relaxed and reliable stay for guests.

description.textZh: 海口万豪酒店位于海口市美丽的西海岸，紧邻海南国际会展中心、五源河体育场、海口国际免税城、远大购物中心、海口火车站、新海港码头、五源河湿地公园、海南长影奇幻乐园及假日海滩，坐拥非凡的地理位置，凭海临风，拥有不同凡响的人文气韵。180°全海景超大阳台客房，可饱览海天一色迷人风景。东方韵味的海岸行宫，8栋中式宫殿式建筑组成，气魄恢宏，格调高迈，三进式大堂挑高20米，诠释中国传统文化沉淀之美。入住即可尊享国风旅拍，带您探究属于东方古典美学。大型生态泳池，成人泳池和儿童泳池、漂流河道兼具，6眼天然温泉采自1000米深层地下温泉水，另配备干湿蒸房、按摩池、健身房、水疗中心、棋牌室，为宾客提供多重休闲服务。酒店专为儿童开放室内儿童俱乐部和室外宠物喂养体验。椰叶编织、赶海捕蟹、自然美育、披萨制作等每日多项自然森活亲子活动等你解锁。酒店拥有完备的会议和宴会设施，大气磅礴的室内宴会厅和美丽优雅的户外草坪，总使用面积可达近4000平米。无论千人盛宴、大型会议和小型会议，亦或梦幻婚宴，均可满足需求。
description.textEn: Escape to a relaxing haven where azure waters and warm sandy beaches await your arrival at Haikou Marriott Hotel in China. Situated on a scenic shoreline, our spectacular hotel offers everything you can imagine in a beachfront getaway. Spend your days lounging on sun-soaked beaches, swim in one of our pools or indulge in spa treatments while your kids play in the Kids’ Club or swim in the dedicated children's pool. Or, explore Haikou's natural attractions and entertaining destinations located within minutes of our luxurious hotel. In the evening, dine in one of our delicious restaurants or retreat to spacious guest rooms with ocean views. If planning business events or social gatherings, take advantage of our hotel's stylish venue spaces and expansive seaside lawn. Business travelers will love our business facilities just steps away from the Hainan International Exhibition Center. Whatever your reason for visiting, we look forward to welcoming you to a memorable vacation at Haikou Marriott Hotel.

description.textZh: 海南高尔夫酒店-海口万丽酒店,地理位置优越，环境优雅舒适，风格别致而富有创意妙趣。酒店拥有 283 间风格典雅的客房与套房，配备现代化设施及大理石浴室，点缀精致的设计元素，铺陈蓬松柔软的寝具，让您悠享时尚休闲时光。酒店餐厅环境宜人，全天供应当地精选美味佳肴，以及各式国际风味经典美食。酒店比邻众多热门打卡点，如电影公社、深圳免税海口观澜湖免税城。在波光粼粼的泳池中清爽畅游，或在优雅的逸庭酒吧 (R Bar) 享用手工调制的鸡尾酒，让轻松休闲的度假生活更添意趣。于热带海岛之上，邻观澜湖高尔夫球场而居，宁静悠然的氛围、经典风格及高雅品味交相互融，舒适惬意的度假村体验尽在此间。
description.textEn: Where distinctive style flirts with touches of whimsy, Renaissance Haikou Hotel offers sophisticated comfort in a coveted location. Find a stylish respite at Renaissance golf resort, featuring 283 elegant rooms and suites, appointed with contemporary amenities, marble bathrooms, refined design elements and plush bedding. Ignite your senses with an all day selection of local tastes and treats, along with distinctive global favorites at our inviting hotel restaurants. Explore the area's compelling attractions including TIMESDF Haikou Mission Hills Duty Free Complex, Movie Town. Punctuate a relaxing day with a refreshing swim in our sparkling pool or hand crafted cocktails at our sophisticated R Bar. Located in Hainan, adjacent to Mission Hills Champion Golf Courses, Renaissance Haikou Hotel offers resort-style comfort where serenity intersects with timeless style and sophistication.

description.textZh: 海口喜来登酒店位于椰林婆娑的西海岸，紧邻五源河湿地公园，远离城市喧嚣。酒店园林与沙滩相连，穿过美丽的热带花园，便可来到滨海沙滩远望壮阔海景，聆听微风海浪细语。酒店距海口市中心商业区10分钟车程，距海南省国际会展中心5分钟车程，临近2个国际标准高尔夫球场，毗邻五源河文化体育中心和长影环球100奇幻乐园，是您高效商务旅程和休闲度假舒缓身心的理想之地。酒店拥有341间宽敞舒适的客房和套房，每间客房都有超大私人观景阳台，可欣赏葱郁且典雅的热带景观。喜来登甜梦之床依照人体工学设计，带来无比轻松惬意的体验。酒店拥有直面西海岸广阔海景的滨海无边泳池和700米深的火山地热天然温泉池，配有24小时健身房、台球桌、篮球场和私人麻将室。酒店原生态的自然环境经多年精心养护，吸引许多可爱的小松鼠在此驻留安家。4间汇聚东西方美食且风格独特的餐厅及酒廊，提供精致传统的粤菜、潮州菜及本地珍馐以及环球美食荟萃，为您带来丰富的舌尖体验。酒店提供免费停车场，拥有超过1,300平方米的会议及宴会场地，可承办从10人至600余人的不同规模的活动。入住海口喜来登酒店，与大自然近距离接触，尽情体验舒适放松，焕发活力的惬意旅程。
description.textEn: Sheraton Haikou Hotel, a beachfront retreat 10 minutes from downtown and 40 minutes from the airport, blends convenience with luxury. The hotel features 341 elegantly appointed rooms with spacious work areas. Guests can unwind in natural hot spring pools fed from 700 meters underground, an outdoor pool, or enjoy water sports, a games room, basketball, and a fitness center.Dining options include authentic Cantonese at Jade, international cuisine at Breeze, curated wines at Pinot Noir Lounge, and ocean-view gatherings at &MORE by Sheraton. With over 1,300 sqm of event space including two pillarless ballrooms, it accommodates 10 to 600 guests. Perfectly located on the west coast, it’s an ideal choice for both leisure and business stays.

description.textZh: 海口丽思卡尔顿酒店位于观澜湖旅游度假园区，毗邻深圳免税海口观澜湖免税城、以及占地350英亩的黑石球场，赫赫有名的观澜湖高尔夫球会环绕四周，建于火山喷发形成的基岩之上，集嶙峋的岩层地貌、丛林植被、广袤的湖泊及大片湿地于一体，以其绚丽多姿的壮美景观著称。酒店共设有190间客房，其中包括16栋别墅及15间套房，下榻海口丽思卡尔顿的客人可在任意一间客房内欣赏窗外的秀美风光，感受大自然的杰作与馈赠。富丽豪华的海口丽思卡尔顿酒店共有占地3,500平方米的宴会场地，可供客人举办会议或庆祝活动。宴会设施包括1座占地1,350平方米的大宴会厅、2座小型宴会厅（各占地275平方米）、7间会议室，以及1间董事会议室。酒店坐拥修剪整齐的草坪球道以及大片绿地，婚礼策划师将在此为客人缔造如梦似幻的活动体验。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Haikou is located in the volcanic region of Haikou city on the exotic Hainan Island of China. The 190-room, 16-villa and 15-suite hotel enjoy year-round tropical sunshine for perfect days on the legendary 350-acre Blackstone Course that weaves its way around the world-renowned Mission Hills Golf Club. Built on top of a bedrock of ancient lava from extinct volcanoes, the dramatic landscape features rocky outcrops with striking variations of jungle vegetation, expansive lakes and wetlands which can be viewed from every room. The luxury golf resort features 3,500 sqm of banquet facilities for conferences and celebrations. Spaces include a 1,350 sqm Grand Ballroom, two Junior Ballrooms (275 sqm each), seven Meeting Rooms and one Boardroom. With a manicured Fairway Lawn and vast expanses of greenery, The Ritz-Carlton, Haikou wedding specialists can create a memorable experience to perfection.

description.textZh: 酒店的 291 间现代客房和套房采用舒适设计, 配备特色威斯汀天梦之床和天梦之浴设施, 着力缔造惬意休憩体验。酒店提供多种餐饮和娱乐选择, 供您随心探索。六间非凡的餐厅酒吧为您呈献富有创意的健康美食。宾客可在我们的室外泳池内清爽畅游。到我们的威斯汀 WORKOUT 健身馆挥汗锻炼, 畅享丰富的自由重量器械和有氧运动设备, 尽情焕发身心活力。为您的未来商务会议、婚礼或社交活动寻找灵感启迪。酒店拥有 11 处独立的会议和多功能空间以及一处大型迎宾区。总面积约 2,045 平米的会议区, 刷新您的会议标准。无论您因何旅行, 我们都将热诚欢迎您在海口威斯汀酒店度过难忘的假期。
description.textEn: Each of our 291 contemporary guestrooms and suites have been designed with your comfort in mind, and all offer the signature Westin Heavenly Bed and the Heavenly Bath to let you get an amazing night’s rest. Our dining and entertainment options are yours to explore. Five exceptional restaurants and bars presents nourishing and imaginative menu creations. Guests can take a refreshing dip in our outdoor swimming pool. Recharge with a session on our Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio, complete with all your fitness requirements including free weights and cardio equipment. Find inspiration for your next business meeting, conference, wedding or social occasion. We offer eleven individual meeting and function spaces, as well as a large pre-function area. A total meeting area of 2,045 square meters will redefine your standards. Whatever your reason for visiting, we look forward to welcoming you to a memorable vacation at The Westin Haikou.

description.textZh: 杭州AC欧轩酒店位于杭州余杭区未来科技城中心区域，地处繁华商业与购物核心区。酒店毗邻地铁枢纽，可快速通达杭州西站与杭州萧山国际机场，高效连接长三角城市群。同时可便捷通达西溪湿地、西湖、良渚古城遗址公园等自然与人文地标，轻松实现商务出行与休闲旅居的自由切换。酒店拥有212间客房，设计灵感汲取自杭州山水意境，并巧妙融入当代艺术元素。每间客房配备全景落地窗，未来科技城天际线尽收眼底；灵活规划的办公区域兼顾商务效率与舒适休憩。24小时开放的健身中心焕活身心；AC Kitchen供应缤纷自助早餐与西班牙特色菜肴；AC Lounge以开放布局实现昼夜场景切换，成为涵盖休闲与社交的活力空间。此外，酒店还设有两处灵活会议空间，适配多种规模的商务会议与社交活动。在此，每一处设计都化身为与艺术的无声对话，让灵感安放于此刻，开启高效自在的相逢。
description.textEn: AC Hotel by Marriott Hangzhou is located in the heart of Future Sci‑Tech City, Yuhang District, surrounded by a dynamic business and commercial center. Adjacent to a metro interchange, the hotel provides seamless access to Hangzhou West Railway Station and Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, ensuring efficient travel throughout the Yangtze River Delta. It is also close to natural and cultural landmarks such as Xixi Wetland, West Lake, and the Archaeological Ruins of Liangzhu City, making it easy for guests to shift between business and leisure.

records.name_en: AC Hotels by Marriott Hangzhou Binjiang

description.textZh: 杭州滨江 AC 欧轩酒店坐落于滨江核心商务区，滨和路商圈、滨江天街等配套环伺，轻松满足商务出行与休闲旅居双重需求。酒店将欧洲简约美学与钱塘江潮起意境相融，188 间客房配备全景落地窗，可尽览城市景观；智能化设施、高品质寝具与定制化服务，为商务旅客打造高效舒适的工作与休憩环境。酒店配套齐全：AC 餐厅与 AC 咖啡吧打造横跨欧亚风味的餐饮体验；24 小时健身中心与自助洗衣房，让宾客在旅途中也能保持生活节奏；灵活的会议空间，适配多种规模的商务洽谈与小型活动。在这里，以精简设计与贴心服务，为全球旅行者带来一场 “洽然之道” 的自在旅居体验。
description.textEn: AC Hotel by Marriott Hangzhou Binjiang is located in the central business district of Binjiang, surrounded by commercial areas including Binhe Road and Riverside Paradise Walk, easily meeting both business and leisure travel needs.The hotel blends European minimalist aesthetics with the artistic charm of the Qiantang River’s tides. It features 188 guest rooms, each with panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows offering sweeping city views. Smart amenities, premium bedding and personalized services create an efficient, comfortable working and resting environment for business travelers.Comprehensive facilities include AC Kitchen and AC Café offering cross-continental culinary experiences, a 24-hour fitness center and self-service laundry to help guests maintain their daily routines, and flexible meeting spaces for various business discussions and small events. Here, streamlined design and attentive service deliver a carefree travel experience defined by "the art of effortless living" to global travelers.

records.name_zh: 杭州钱江新城万怡酒店

description.textZh: 杭州坐拥海湾沿岸的优越地理位置，周边林立自然美景，过去一千年来一直是中国繁华的城市之一。随着城市工业的不断发展，杭州仍吸引着络绎不绝的旅客前来游览，醉人西湖、千古名塔以及众多知名景点使这座城市无愧为中国备受欢迎的旅游目的地之一。杭州钱江新城万怡酒店地理位置优越，地处钱江新城中央商务区的中心地带，地铁4号线城星路B1出口，可便利前往萧山国际机场和高铁车站。酒店不仅提供超凡的舒适住宿体验，还提供配备落地玻璃窗的三间现代风格会议室和水晶宴会厅，是筹办活动的理想之选。杭州钱江新城万怡酒店内的每间餐厅都提供包厢，是举办私人聚会的非凡之选。客房提供免费无线高速上网、24小时客房送餐服务和1台液晶电视，带来如家般舒适便捷的住宿体验。
description.textEn: With an enviable position on the bay and surrounded by natural beauty, Hangzhou has spent the last thousand years as one of China’s most prosperous cities. While its industries continue to grow,it remains country's beautiful destinations, drawing visitors with West Lake. To meet the needs of both business and leisure travelers, Courtyard by Marriott Hangzhou Qianjiang was created, offering an upper-moderate experience in the heart of the CBD. Easy access to Metro Line No. 4 (Chengxing Road Stop, Exit B1), Xiaoshan International Airport and the high-speed train station make this the perfect choice for events, with three modern meeting rooms and the Crystal Ballroom, featuring floor-to-ceiling glass. For more intimate gatherings, each of the hotel’s restaurants offers private dining. Convenience and style share a home in the guest rooms, with complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service and an LCD TV.

description.textZh: 注：酒店已取消行政酒廊，但因官网更新需要时间，烦请谅解。官网预订的行政房型仍享有其它行政礼遇，谢谢您的入住。杭州西溪万怡酒店是万豪集团旗下品牌酒店，紧邻杭州西溪国家湿地公园，地铁直达杭州东站、杭州西站、萧山国际机场，距西湖、灵隐寺约7公里，毗邻阿里巴巴西溪园区、未来科技城等区域。酒店拥有160间宽敞的客房及套房，客房均配备席梦思床垫和亲肤床品照顾宾客整晚安心睡眠。设万荟轩餐厅、西溪晴雪包厢，提供特色杭帮菜以及酒水饮料。 酒店附带3个会议室，包括1个300平米的宴会厅、1个140平米会议室、1个70平方多功能厅满足您的多样会议需求。 西溪湿地国家公园空气清新, 享有城市“绿肺”的美称。
description.textEn: The new state of the art lobby at Courtyard provides greater flexibility and choices for our guests. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, free WiFi throughout and easy access to the latest news, weather and airport conditions via our Lobby display screen. Plus, our well equipped fitness center, indoor pool will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be more comfortable, more productive and more enjoyable than ever before.

description.textEn: JW Marriott Hotel Hangzhou welcomes you to China with a prime location in the heart of the city center. Brimming with luxury amenities, every hotel room is designed for comfort and convenience; a variety of room and suite layouts are available to meet your needs. Overlooking iconic West Lake, our stylish Executive Lounge boasts spectacular city views of downtown Hangzhou, China and serves a full breakfast, snacks and refreshments throughout the day and cocktails and light meals in the evenings. Our four restaurants, including a signature steakhouse, allow you to savor unforgettable cuisine without leaving our luxury hotel. We also provide a heated pool and an advanced fitness center. Thanks to almost 20,000 square feet of versatile venue space and a stately grand ballroom, we're an ideal destination for business meetings and social events in downtown Hangzhou. No matter your reason for visiting China, JW Marriott Hotel Hangzhou will provide you with a distinctive luxury experience.

description.textEn: At Marriott Executive Apartments®, you'll enjoy the convenience of a hotel, with the space, ambience and privacy of home living. Our completely furnished apartments come with a fully equipped kitchen, housekeeping services, storage and 24-hour staffing.

records.name_zh: 杭州余杭万豪行政公寓

description.textZh: 杭州未来科技城作为科创和商业综合体的集聚区吸引了来自全球各领域的出色公司和企业。而坐落于此的杭州余杭万豪行政公寓则是为需要在外长住的商务旅行者而精心设计的豪华公寓。舒适温馨的居住环境，焕然一新的办公设施及体贴入微的服务为到来的每位宾客提供家一般的温馨体验。公寓临近阿里巴巴总部，步行可至未来科技城国际会议中心及商业区，并配备了专用停车位，为长住商旅及休闲客人提供了非常高的生活便利性。从开放式公寓到三卧室公寓均配备齐全的设施设备，以及厨房用具和洗衣烘干一体机。公寓还拥有24小时健身房，室内泳池，瑜伽室，儿童游戏房。您可以和朋友相约在公寓的酒廊或迷你剧院，正式的会面也可选择使用公寓的会议室。
description.textEn: Future Sci-Tech City in Hangzhou China is a complex constructed to attract worldwide industries. Set within this exciting venture is the Marriott Executive Apartments Hangzhou, serviced apartments designed for long-term business travelers. The comforts of home, office-inspired facilities and thoughtful services make residents, and their families, feel at home in our extended accommodations. An address near Alibaba headquarters, the International Conference Center and business parks means the commute from home to office is never long, and guests have access to our dedicated parking. Serviced apartments are available with up to three bedrooms and feature full kitchens and washer/dryer setups. The Health Club includes a 24-hour gym, indoor pool and yoga room, and families enjoy access to our kids club. The hotel lounge, restaurant and mini-theater offer opportunities to socialize, while two meeting rooms are ideal for more formal gatherings. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel in Hangzhou China.

description.textZh: 杭州临安万豪酒店坐落于杭州青山湖科技城，以葱郁森林为背景，是您工作或休闲娱乐的理想之选。酒店的293间客房和35间套房均为现代设计风格，并配备了各类先进设施，旨在缔造舒适愉悦的住宿体验。所有客房均配备平面电视、免费Wi-Fi、迷你冰箱和人体工学办公区等设施。酒店设有12间活动室以及约3,252平米的活动空间，可为您在杭州举办卓有成效的会议或社交活动提供卓越的场地保障。您可在酒店特色餐厅，享用手工烹制的中餐，或品味各类精致美食；在专业健身中心挥汗锻炼，保持良好状态；亦或前往酒店水疗中心，惬意开启重焕活力的一天。酒店地理位置优越，坐拥秀美的杭州自然风光，不远处即是青山湖和狮山公园。杭州临安万豪酒店热诚欢迎您的光临。
description.textEn: Set against a lush forest backdrop in Hangzhou Qingshan Lake Science and Technology City Hangzhou Marriott Hotel Lin an is an ideal choice for work or play. Our 293 hotel rooms and 35 suites boast contemporary design touches and first rate amenities ensuring a comfortable and pleasant stay. All guest accommodation boasts a flat screen TV, free WiFi, a mini fridge an ergonomic workspace and more. If you are seeking a distinctive venue for a meeting or social event in the Hangzhou China area our hotel provides 12 event rooms and over 35000 sq ft of event space. Indulge in handcrafted Chinese or fine dining at our signature restaurants, stay in shape at our fitness cntr or enjoy a day of rejuvenation at our hotel spa. You will be delighted with our pristine location we are surrounded by Hangzhous immaculate natural landscape adjacent to Qingshan Lake and a short walk from Lion Mountain Park. No matter what brings you to China we cannot wait to welcome you to Hangzhou Marriott Hotel Lin'an.

records.name_zh: 杭州钱江新城万豪酒店

description.textZh: 杭州钱江新城万豪酒店位于素有“人间天堂”美誉的杭州，坐落于杭州市钱江新城CBD中央商务区的天际线之间，拥有得天独厚的地理优势。酒店临近杭州大剧院、奥特莱斯及市民中心，与购物中心万象城数步之遥。酒店设计时尚新颖、设施齐全，将当地文化注入其中，处处展现别具一格人文风情。同时酒店交通便利，邻近地铁4号线，至杭州东站约20分钟车程。348间别致客房和套房，其中284间客房可俯瞰钱塘江的迷人美景。3间风格迥异的餐厅及大堂吧，宾客可前往室内或室外用餐区域，欣赏迷人美景之余，亦可轻松享用美味佳肴及茶饮。此外，酒店设有近1,800平方米的宴会活动空间。其300平方米可容纳200位宾客的户外滨江草坪露台更是举办西式婚典仪式、鸡尾酒等活动的理想场所！
description.textEn: The skyline of Qianjiang New Town CBD from the moon inspired Grand Theater is a clear sign that the city is moving forward. The Hangzhou Marriott Hotel Qianjiang is part of that changing landscape, offering style, service and amenities that seamlessly layer modern needs upon a traditional foundation. Next to the No. 4 metro line and convenient reach to Hangzhou East Station by 20 minutes and 33 minutes to Xiaoshan International Airport, the hotel offers 348 guest rooms and suites, 284 guest rooms can overlooking the Qiantang River. Guests can also enjoy the view from the indoor-outdoor Lounge, one of three dining options. Within walking distance of shopping, dining and entertainment at MixC shopping center and near the Hangzhou Civic Center, the hotel is the ideal venue for meetings and events with nearly 20,000 square feet of event space, including a 200-capacity balcony and lawn.

records.name_zh: 杭州临安青山湖科技城万丽酒店

description.textZh: Located in the Shishan Park, the hotel is inspired by the ancient charm of the Song Dynasty, blending traditional elegance with modern comfort.
description.textEn: Located in the Shishan Park, the hotel is inspired by the ancient charm of the Song Dynasty, blending traditional elegance with modern comfort. There are 296 comfortable guest rooms, and the hotel is also equipped with an all-day dining restaurant, Chinese restaurant, R Bar, fitness center, swimming pool, banquet hall and meeting rooms. Here, guests can savor modern luxury in the aesthetics of Song style, enjoy peaceful moments in the embrace of nature, and experience an elegant journey through the past and present.

description.textZh: 将中国戏曲的独到魅力巧妙地融合以时尚风范，饱含设计感的杭州临平万丽酒店带您感受古今中外的艺术韵味。坐落于临平区核心区域，便捷抵达地铁、高铁站以及各大交通枢纽。开启一段非凡的商务之旅，抑或探索这城市别具一格的人文风情，杭州临平万丽酒店都将丰富您的体验。两间餐厅与一间酒吧呈现美馔珍酿：万丽轩中餐厅，传承传统的烹饪手法并度以创新来演绎菜品意蕴；燃餐厅，带来琳琅满目的自助之选与快乐欢聚时刻；逸庭，迸发时尚、活力与动感，聆听现场DJ音乐再轻啜一杯特调鸡尾酒或香槟，趣意横生！透过落地玻璃窗将城市街景尽收眼底，于宽敞舒适的客房享受专属您的静谧空间。置身于16层的行政酒廊，在轻松的氛围里品香茗美酒、享下午茶时光，以及多重尊贵礼遇。一个无柱式宴会厅和五个多功能会议室，典雅的格局与华丽的设计并配备完善的技术设施，将令您的活动成为难忘的回忆。
description.textEn: Business-friendly with a designer touch, Renaissance Hangzhou Northeast Hotel blends elements of current fashion trends with those of Chinese opera. Located in Hangzhou's vibrant Linping District, our hotel is moments from the city's attractions and near many ancient landmarks in Zhejiang Province. Our two dining options make it easy to satisfy your cravings here in Hangzhou. Wan Li Restaurant highlights the diverse flavors of China, Food Studio serves a global buffet. R Bar boasts a vibrant atmosphere, craft cocktails; we provide a stylish backdrop for relaxation after a day in Zhejiang. Our modern yet whimsical rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows with scenic city views, while our Club-level accommodation offers Lounge access and additional amenities. Select our hotel to host your event, and enjoy 12,000 square feet of space, a ballroom and on-site planning and catering.

records.name_en: Renaissance Hangzhou Qianjiang Century City Hotel
records.name_zh: 杭州钱江世纪城万丽酒店

description.textZh: 杭州钱江世纪城万丽酒店以蝴蝶翩跹之姿为灵感，宛如都市丛林中一抹跃动的亮色，在钱塘江畔优雅起舞。酒店枕江而居，与奥体中心隔街相望，步行数分钟即达地铁站，30分钟车程可抵高铁站与萧山国际机场，商务出行与城市探索皆从容便捷。酒店拥有 409 间多元房型，每一间皆配备智能起居系统，搭配高端沐浴系列，让指尖触碰与肌肤感知都浸润在细腻关怀中。内设万丽轩中餐厅，荟萃中式经典珍馐；全日餐厅则全天候供应环球风味，悦享舌尖之旅。拾级至28层行政酒廊，开阔城景在眼前铺展，钱塘江的粼粼波光与奥体中心的流线轮廓交织成画，上好视野尽收眼底。90 米高空恒温泳池，更让您自在畅游，尽享惬意。酒店拥有设施先进的会议和活动场地，赋能每一场高效会议与精彩活动。12米层高的无柱大宴会厅定义奢阔空间新维度，视野无界，灵感无限，为创意布置预留无限可能。
description.textEn: Fluttering by the Qiantang River and facing the Olympic Sports Center, this vibrant hotel dances along the urban skyline. Steps from the metro, it’s 30 mins from the High-Speed Railway Station and Xiaoshan Airport, offering effortless connectivity.Among its 409 smart guestrooms, each features intelligent systems and luxury baths, immersing guests in comfort. Savor culinary excellence at Wan Li Xuan (Chinese classics) and the All-Day Dining Restaurant (global flavors).Ascend to the 28th-floor Executive Lounge for panoramic views of the river and stadium. The 90-meter heated sky pool invites serene swims. For events, the 12-meter column-free grand ballroom and flexible venues redefine luxury, blending unobstructed views with tech-enabled efficiency. Here, inspiration takes flight amid Hangzhou’s most stunning vistas.

records.name_zh: 杭州滨江银泰喜来登大酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于杭州滨江区的中心地带，地理位置优越，是商务旅行或探索城市的理想下榻之选。您可轻松前往被列入世界遗产名录的西湖，探索当地丰富多彩的历史底蕴。展览中心和丝绸市场也在酒店附近。您可在宽敞的会议空间或无柱式大宴会厅举办精彩会议与活动。也可在喜来登行政酒廊放松休息，俯瞰钱塘江的动人美景。喜来登健身中心和室内恒温泳池，可为您在旅途中健身提供便利；餐饮选择琳琅满目，国际美食让您心满意足。我们的 266 间舒适客房和 35 间套房可欣赏引人入胜的天际线和江河景观。高速上网接入和平面电视让您时刻联通世界。我们的喜来登特色睡眠体验之床和夜床服务助您舒享一夜酣眠。雨林淋浴间为您缔造身心清爽体验
description.textEn: Centrally located in the heart of Hangzhou Binjiang District, the hotel is ideally situated for business or exploring the city. Discover the area's colorful roots with easy access to West Lake, a world heritage site. The Exhibition Center and Silk Market are also nearby. Gather in our expansive meeting spaces or pillar-less grand ballroom. Relax in the Sheraton Club Lounge, overlooking the Qiantang River. Sheraton Fitness and an indoor heated pool supports your well-being while on the road and dynamic dining options offer satisfying international cuisine. Our 266 guest rooms and 35 suites offer alluring skyline and river views. Stay connected with High Speed Internet Access and flat screen TVs. Our Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience with nightly turn down service encourages restful sleep. A rain forest shower refreshes the senses

records.name_en: Sheraton Grand Hangzhou Wetland Park Resort
records.name_zh: 杭州西溪喜来登度假大酒店

description.textZh: 杭州西溪喜来登度假大酒店坐落于杭州西溪国家湿地公园东南角，距西湖、灵隐寺仅约5公里。380间宽敞的客房及套房，均带观景阳台，足不出户即可饱览湿地园林优美景观。所有客房均配备有口皆碑的喜来登特色睡眠体验。 4家餐厅和酒吧，包括盛宴（互动式全日制餐厅，提供包含亚洲美食在内的国际美食）、萨婷（现代时尚法餐厅）、采悦轩（新派中餐厅，提供特色杭帮菜）以及大堂吧。 喜来登水疗提供各式水疗项目，帮助您除去身心疲惫。同时您可以在喜来登健身中心和室内恒温游泳池中锻炼体魄。14个多功能会议厅和1个大宴会厅独立建于花园中心，其中包括一个1080平米的宴会厅，可容纳1600名客人同时开会，以及一应俱全的商务中心，均配备前沿科技设备满足客人的商务需要。西溪湿地国家公园是集城市湿地、农耕湿地和文化湿地于一体的湿地，也是全国首个国家湿地公园。湿地空气清新, 享有城市“绿肺”的美称。每年在湿地都会举办各类特色节日如：花朝节（每年4-5月左右）、西溪龙舟胜会（端午节）、西溪火柿（每年9月至10月左右）、探梅节（12月-2月左右）等其它精彩盛会。
description.textEn: Welcoming and modern, Sheraton Grand Hangzhou Wetland Park Resort provides travelers with a serene and lush escape overlooking China's famed Xixi National Wetland Preservation Area. From this enviable location—which is also a short drive away from West Lake, Lingyin Temple and the Alibaba Xixi Campus—guests can enjoy the many charms of our hotel. Stay in our spacious guest rooms and suites, all outfitted with a private balcony from which to take in sweeping views of the Xixi Wetland. Dine in our restaurants, offering modern French cuisine and authentic Chinese fare. Reboot and relax in Shine Spa or make a splash in our sparkling indoor pool. A leading meeting and events destination in Hangzhou, our resort boasts an array of venue spaces, including an elegant ballroom which can be divided into three separate spaces. Come discover it all at Sheraton Grand Hangzhou Wetland Park Resort—we look forward to hosting your visit.

description.textZh: 杭州富阳喜来登酒店，位于以黄公望先生创作《富春山居图》而闻名的杭州富阳。同时它是万豪国际集团率先在富阳区建立的豪华型酒店，南临富春江，东连东吴公园，北靠富春山馆，位于集旅游休闲、商务购物为一体的鹿山时代广场，是您探索城市的理想下榻之处。酒店拥有230间豪华客房及套房，60％的房间拥有一线江景。置身于酒店12层，在环境典雅宁静的采悦轩中餐厅享用风味俱佳的地道杭帮菜和粤菜，感受美食的碰撞；或于全日制餐厅体验自助早餐以及丰盛美味的西式午餐和晚餐。亦可前往宽敞舒适的大堂酒廊，与亲朋好友欢聚一堂，尽情享受惬意时光。酒店拥有共计近2000㎡的聚会空间、喜来登健身中心、室内游泳池，还设有别具特色的童趣乐园，致力于为您打造与众不同的会聚之所。
description.textEn: Sheraton Hangzhou Fuyang, located in Hangzhou Fuyang, which is famous for Huang Gongwang's painting “Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains”. Which is the first hotel by Marriott International in Fuyang District, with Fuchun River in the south, Dongwu Park in the east and Fuchun Mountain Pavilion in the north. It is located in Lushan Times, which integrates tourism, leisure and business shopping, is the ideal base to explore the city. The hotel has 230 deluxe rooms and suites, more than 60% of which have a river view. On the 12th floor of the hotel, enjoy the authentic Hangzhou food and Cantonese food in the elegant environment of YUE Chinese Restaurant; Or experience buffet breakfast and delicious Western lunch and dinner at the Daily Social Restaurant. Enjoy a relaxing time with family and friends at the comfortable Lobby Lounge. The hotel is equipped with nearly 2000m² banquet space, Sheraton Fitness, Swimming Pool, and Kid's Club, committed to creating a unique meeting place for you.

records.name_en: Grand New Century Hotel, Hangzhou Boao, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 杭州博奥开元名都臻品之选酒店

description.textZh: 杭州博奥开元名都臻品之选酒店地处萧山区与滨江区的交界处，与杭州地铁5号线博奥路站无缝对接，距离杭州萧山国际机场约25分钟车程，杭州火车东站约30分钟车程，杭州火车南站约15分钟车程。
description.textEn: The Grand New Century Hotel, Hangzhou Boao, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel in Hangzhou is located at the junction of Xiaoshan District and Binjiang District, offering seamless access to Boao Road Station on Hangzhou Metro Line 5. It is approximately a 25-minute drive from Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, a 30-minute drive from Hangzhou East Railway Station, and a 15-minute drive from Hangzhou South Railway Station.

records.name_en: Wonderland Resort, Hangzhou Jiande, A Tribute Portfolio Resort
records.name_zh: 杭州富春芳草地臻品之选度假酒店

description.textZh: 杭州富春芳草地臻品之选度假酒店 一个人与自然生态的融合生活圈，可游可居的文旅综合体选址于富春江畔，将富春江七里泷景区的山水长廊、历史长廊，原汁原味地展现给中外宾客。酒店坐拥220亩天然林场，配套住宿202间/套以特色小木屋，度假式别墅排屋为主，辅以少量特色水上船屋;在鸟鸣中晨醒，自然芳华推窗而入。从农场到餐桌，饮食优选当季新鲜食材。拥抱天与地，尽享天地自然乐趣。芳草地它蕴藏着人们心底原舍、原乡的田园情结立意于全新引导都市人接触自然、回归自然、体验自然。在山幽鸟鸣间，不必费力的遇见山水、遇见芳草，遇见自然!
description.textEn: The hotel is rich in natural style, built around the mountains and holding water, with dense vegetation and forest land, excellent water quality and fresh air in the area.

records.name_zh: 杭州转塘万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: - Close to Xitou Yintai City, enjoy the convenience of one-stop shopping, dining and entertainment.- Close to Yunqi Town, just a stone's throw from Yunqi Town.- Close to the Qiantang River, enjoy the unique natural charm of Hangzhou.
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Hangzhou Zhijiang New Town is located in the heart of the picturesque Zhijiang New City of Hangzhou, not only with the convenience of a bustling city, but also close to natural beauty and cultural treasures. Adjacent to the famous Yintai City business City, set fashion shopping, food exploration, leisure and entertainment in one comprehensive commercial landmark; Close to Zhejiang Provincial Museum, it is an excellent place to learn more about Zhejiang's long history and rich culture. Not far from the Songcheng scenic area, you can watch the performance of "Song City through the Ages" and experience a shocking journey of vision and soul; After a short drive, you arrive at Yunqi Town, a characteristic town that integrates high-tech industry and natural ecology; Some rooms also enjoy a view of the Qiantang River, adding a touch of unforgettable natural scenery to the journey.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hanzhong Riverside
records.name_zh: 汉中滨江福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 汉中滨江福朋喜来登酒店坐落于汉江之滨，依偎滨江生态景观带，将 “汉家发祥地” 的文化底蕴与福朋喜来登的国际品质巧妙相融，成为衔接城市自然与人文的高端旅居地标。酒店延续品牌标志性的醇饮优选，特别甄选陕南本地精酿啤酒、汉中仙毫等特色茶饮，搭配融合热面皮、褒河鱼鲜、核桃馍等本地风味的精致餐饮，让味蕾沉浸式感受陕南烟火。空间设计萃取汉江流水、汉隶书法等元素，公区陈列的本地非遗手工艺品与客房的舒适配置相得益彰，尽显 “汉风雅致” 的质感美学。全覆盖免费高速 Wi-Fi、灵活多元的会议场地，满足商务出行与休闲度假的双重需求。从酒店出发，便捷可达古汉台、石门栈道、武侯祠等文化地标，步行即可漫步滨江绿道，沉浸式体验 “天府之国” 的自然灵秀与历史厚重。我们以真诚待客之道，将国际标准服务与汉中本地特色深度融合，为每一位旅人打造 “居汉江之畔，品汉家风情” 的高品质旅居体验，成为汉江之滨传递汉风魅力的温暖驿站。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 哈尔滨城市中心万枫酒店

description.textZh: Fairfield Harbin Downtown is a selected service hotel under the Marriott International. It is located in the core business district of Harbin, close to Harbin Railway Station, with complete surrounding facilities and convenient transportation.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Harbin City Center
records.name_zh: 哈尔滨城市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于哈尔滨市道里区尚志大街40号，地处美丽的冰城核心商业区域，比邻著名的中央大街，地理位置极为优越。从酒店步行至中央大街仅需约5分钟，交通十分便利：距哈尔滨站约1公里，距哈尔滨西站约9.5公里，距哈尔滨太平国际机场约37公里。酒店正对面即是地铁2号线出入口，周边还有众多公交线路环绕。绝佳的地理位置使住客能轻松享受周边完善的配套设施，无论是休闲娱乐还是医疗资源都一应俱全，为宾客的出行与生活提供了极大便利。酒店将严格按照星级标准精心打造，并深度融合万豪国际集团先进的管理模式与服务理念。酒店拥有144间高级客房和套房，同时配备了多功能会议室、西餐厅、大堂吧、健身中心和洗衣房等设施，旨在全方位满足宾客的商务洽谈、休闲度假与娱乐放松等多方面需求，致力于为每一位宾客带来高品质的入住体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_en: JW Marriott Hotel Harbin River North
records.name_zh: 哈尔滨 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 哈尔滨JW万豪酒店屹立于松花江北畔，紧邻哈尔滨市政府，距哈尔滨冰雪大世界仅需五分钟路程。哈尔滨以冰城夏都而闻名，具有悠久历史的建筑和丰富多元的文化，酒店具有现代典雅风尚。客房和套房均配有宽大的落地窗，松花江及城市全景尽收眼底。夏季自然美韵的一湖三岛绿水盈盈，野趣横生，周边秀美的湿地公园环伺，原生态美景与怡人的爽夏温度，让人流连忘返。如需用餐，酒店内设两间间风格迥异的美食餐厅，提供中式菜肴餐和国际自助。与此同时，酒店还有别具一格的酒廊，为您奉上精酿啤酒、季节性鸡尾酒和下午茶服务。哈尔滨 JW 万豪酒店拥有各类活动场地，宛若一块空白画布，方便量身打造会议和活动，对于在正寻求难忘目的地的活动策划者而言，这里是非常理想的筹办地之选。
description.textEn: Just five minutes from Harbin Ice and Snow World’s vibrant ice sculpture village, JW Marriott Hotel Harbin River North stands above the majestic Songhua River in the district of Harbin municipal government. Harbin, a landmark ice city with its historic architecture and local culture, inspires the modern elegance of this hotel. Guest rooms and suites feature expansive floor-to-ceiling windows for panoramic views of the river and city. During the winter season, vistas of the city’s illuminated buildings carved from ice light up the night sky with a magical touch. For dining, the hotel brings culinary worlds together with three restaurants offering guests Chinese, authentic local cuisine and international flavors. There are also two distinct lounges featuring light bites, seasonal cocktails and afternoon tea service. For event planners looking for a memorable destination, JW Marriott Hotel Harbin River North offers a variety of venues that provide a blank canvas to customize meetings and events.

records.name_zh: 哈尔滨香坊永泰喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 哈尔滨香坊永泰喜来登酒店将中国艺术形式、欧式经典设计和当地住宅风格优雅融合，复古而闲适。酒店建设耗资约十亿元，占地逾 70,000 平米，拥有宽敞的客房和活动空间，提供高品质餐饮服务，时尚与传统风情交相互融。哈尔滨香坊永泰喜来登酒店拥有 397 间宽敞客房、3 间特色餐厅、面积合计达约 4,200 平米的两间庞大宴会厅，旨在成为东北地区较大的商务、会议和休闲度假酒店。
description.textEn: Sheraton Harbin Xiangfang Hotel is an elegant fusion of Chinese art forms, European classic design and local residential touches, embodying the vintage storming and relaxation. Spread over a spacious 70,000 sqm, invested one billion, the hotel features generously sized guestrooms and events areas, high-end dining options and a combination of modern and tradition style. Sheraton Harbin Xiangfang Hotel has 397 spacious guestrooms, three special restaurants, two enormous sized Ballrooms which are 4200 sqm, aimed at becoming the largest business, meetings and casual resort hotel in Northeast area.

records.name_zh: 哈尔滨富力丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: 哈尔滨富力丽思卡尔顿酒店居于 57 层的哈尔滨地标性建筑富力中心高层，坐拥松花江的迷人景色，冬季可纵览冰雪胜境。酒店融汇豪华住宅区和购物中心，带来超凡卓越的哈尔滨豪华旅居体验，旨在为城市旅客打造新地标，缔造精致豪华的非凡入住体验。酒店环境时尚现代，共设 366 间非凡的江景或城景客房。四间餐厅位于酒店高层，宾客可一边畅享丰富美食，一边欣赏松花江的眩目美景。另设有约 3530 平米的活动空间，才华横溢的酒店活动策划和餐饮团队提供周到服务，为您打造令人陶醉的精彩庆典活动。
description.textEn: Perched on the upper levels of the 57-floor Harbin R&F landmark tower, The Ritz-Carlton, Harbin overlooks the stunning view of Songhua River and allows guests to enjoy the winter wonderland. Integrated in the most luxury residential area and shopping mall, it offers an unprecedented luxury experience in the local market, with the aim to be a new landmark destination for travellers seeking the most sophisticated and luxurious urban accommodation. Contemporary accommodations with a total of 366 extraordinary guest rooms offer river and city views. Four outlets located on the upper floor of the building embrace the dazzling view of the Songhua River while offering a variety of experiences. A further 38,000 square feet of event space allows you to revel in endless opportunities to create bold and brilliant celebrations, fully supported by our talented event planning and catering teams.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hefei High-Tech Zone
records.name_zh: 合肥高新福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: In Hefei High-Tech Zone's core, this hotel fuses industrial-modern design with refined service for seamless business stays. Steps from tech parks & commercial hubs, it plugs you into the city's innovation pulse for strategic agenda control.
description.textEn: Nestled in Hefei High-Tech Zone's core, this hotel blends industrial-modern design with refined service for seamless business stays. Features 216 rooms, diverse dining, gym & meeting spaces. Adjacent to tech corridors. Enjoy Dashushan Park views and Shuxi Lake access—effortless urban-nature transitions revitalize your journey.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hefei, Baohe
records.name_zh: 合肥包河福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 合肥包河福朋喜来登酒店是前往合肥的客人的理想下榻之选。酒店于2017年开业, 地理位置优越, 可轻松前往合肥南站、合肥新桥国际机场、合肥东南部以及商务和休闲旅客乐于前往的众多地点。酒店服务多样、设施齐全, 坐拥包河工业园的优越地段。如果您想要参与健身活动, 可随时前往我们先进的健身中心或在我们的室内恒温泳池尽情畅游。我们拥有261间客房, 所有客房均配备免费Wi-Fi、平面电视、带淋浴/浴缸组合以及淋浴喷头的私人浴室以及其他更多设施, 以提升您的住宿体验。您还可以前往酒店内的两间餐厅, 或在客房内直接拨打电话享受客房送餐服务。我们的员工训练有素, 随时准备为客人服务, 全力为客人提供舒适愉快的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Four Points By Sheraton Hefei BaoHe is the ideal hotel for guests staying in Hefei. Having opened in 2017, the hotel boasts a location convenient to Hefei South Railway Station, Hefei Xinqiao International Airport, southeastern Hefei and many locations popular among both business and leisure travelers. Enjoy our many services, plenty of extras and a great location in Baohe Industrial Park. If you're looking for some stimulating activity, make use of our state-of-the-art fitness center or take a dip in our indoor heated pool. Each of our 261 guest rooms boasts free WiFi, as well as a flat screen TV and a private bathroom with shower/tub combination and rainfall showerhead among other ammenities that are sure you enhance your stay. Take advantage of the two restaurants located on the property, or stay in and call for room service. Our excellent staff are equipped and ready to assist our guests to make their stay here as pleasant and relaxing as possible.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hefei, Feidong
records.name_zh: 合肥琪瑞福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 万豪国际集团旗下福朋喜来登酒店——合肥肥东福朋喜来登酒店坐落于合肥东部新中心核心地段，周边永辉超市安徽旗舰店、龙湖天街、龙湖龙誉中心、吾悦广场、禹悦汇等繁华商业街、美食小吃街环绕。毗邻环合肥高速龙塘出入口、紧靠裕溪路高架大众路出口旁，地理位置优越，交通便利，距合肥南站/合肥站均只需20分钟车程，距合肥新桥国际机场1小时车程，20分钟车程亦可轻松抵达机器人小镇、撮街文化旅游中心、青年创意田园、肥东循环经济园等热门商业旅游目的地。酒店客房均配有智能家居，高空全景落地窗结合福朋轻奢简约的设计理念，为入住宾客提供都市旅居全新体验。宾客可在酒店四层的玩啤食社享用中西融合佳肴，还有本地特色精选美食，开启满满活力一天。24小时的健身中心和配备LG先进洗烘设备的洗衣房，满足各类宾客多样需求。酒店集美食、咖啡、醇饮优选 Best Brews精酿及休闲放松等生活方式于一体的多元社交空间大堂吧，是旅享家商务休闲、移动办公的个性之选。
description.textEn: The Four Points by Sheraton Feidong, a subsidiary of Marriott International Group, is located in the core area of the Hefei eastern new center. Adjacent to the entrance and exit of the Hefei Ring Expressway, and adjacent to the exit of the Yuxi Road elevated public road, it has a superior geographical location and convenient transportation. All hotel rooms are equipped with smart homes. The high-altitude panoramic french window, combined with the simple design concept of Four Points, provide guests with a new experience of urban living. Guests can enjoy a fusion of Chinese and Western cuisine at the beer restaurant on the fourth floor of the hotel, as well as locally selected specialties, to start a vibrant day. A 24-hour fitness center and a laundry room equipped with LG advanced washing and drying equipment meet the diverse needs of various guests. The lobby bar of the hotel is a diverse social space that combines food, coffee, and premium drinks with Best Brews craft beer and a relaxing lifestyle.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hefei, Shushan
records.name_zh: 合肥蜀山福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于合肥政务文化新区，地理位置便利。酒店距合肥高铁南站仅 15 分钟左右行程，是开启合肥探索之旅的理想出发点。270 间舒适客房，提供福朋特色睡床、免费高速上网接入和品质卫浴用品。酒店设有宽敞明亮的健身馆、室内泳池、舒适宜人的水疗中心，让您放松身心，享受便利。酣甜舒睡一晚之后，前往 The Eatery 享用特色早餐，开启活力满满的新一天。晚间，我们备受赞誉的醇饮优选计划为您呈献精选啤酒，美妙的一天就此划上句点。福朋酒店让您感受宾至如归的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Conveniently located in Hefei New Municipal and Cultural District. With the Hefei High Speed Rail South Station just 15 minutes away, explore and discover everything Hefei has to offer. Settle into our 270 comfortable guest rooms with Four Points Signature Bed, free-HSIA and great bathroom amenities. We created a bright fitness facility, indoor swimming pool, pleasurable SPA for your relaxation and convenience. After a good nights rest, we prepare our signature breakfast at the Eatery to refresh a new day. The enjoy a selected beer from our highly acclaimed Best Brews program to end a perfect day.Four Points can be your home away from home.

records.name_zh: 合肥新站利港喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店地理位置优越，毗邻合肥火车站，与合肥生态公园和站北文化广场仅一街之遥。巨大中国结树立在广场中央，是新站区的地标性建筑之一。酒店拥有405间与徽文化结合设计的客房及套房，酒店一楼的3间特色餐厅及优雅大堂吧均颇具风格，为宾客提供多重国际化餐饮体验。酒店二楼拥有3000平方米灵活多变的会议室与多功能厅是举行各种规模的婚礼，会议和展览的优质之选。酒店的各方面设计都充分考虑到了客人的需求。室内泳池、健身中心及舒适宜人的水疗中心可让客人享受属于自己的闲暇时光。
description.textEn: The hotel is conveniently located, adjacent to Hefei Railway Station, nearby Hefei Ecological Park and Zhanbei Cultural Square. A huge Chinese knot is erected in the center of the square, which is one of the landmark buildings of the Xinzhan district. The hotel has 405 guest rooms and suites, was designed in accordance with Anhui culture. The hotel's 3 characteristic restaurants and elegant lobby bar all have unique styles, providing guests with multiple international dining experience.The hotel has 3,000 square meters of flexible meeting room, perfect for all types of weddings, conferences or exhibitions. All aspects of the hotel design take into account the unique needs of guests.

description.textZh: 合肥富力威斯汀酒店位于繁华的合肥市中心，坐拥秀美的包公园，地理位置优越。酒店毗邻合肥南北一号高架，步行5分钟即可至合肥地铁一号线，直达合肥火车站和合肥高铁南站，方便您探索城市的每个角落。酒店紧邻成熟商圈，银泰中心、淮河路步行街等城市商业综合体，是您商务出行或休闲度假的理想选择。酒店拥有298间优雅而时尚的客房和套房，配备威斯汀品牌标志性的天梦之床、天梦之浴和高速网络，让您远离都市喧嚣，尽享一夜酣然好梦。威斯汀品牌独具特色的健身中心，倾力为您打造精彩活力的旅程体验。知味餐厅、中国元素中餐厅和威斯汀扒房配以高品质服务，使您足不出户也可大饱营养美味。
description.textEn: A meaningful experience awaits you at The Westin Hefei Baohe in Anhui Province China. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers our 5 star hotel is located in the city's vibrant business district just a short distance from local subway and railway stations. Notable tourist attractions such as Baohe Park, pedestrian thoroughfares and shopping malls are also close by. Connect with colleagues in the Lobby Lounge or enliven your taste buds at one of our five dining venues. The Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio and Bo SPA help you to move well and keep your mind and body in balance during your stay. Each of our 296 hotel rooms and suites are designed to evoke a better you. Sink into an oasis of comfort with our signature Westin Heavenly Bed, revive your senses in the rain forest shower and discover elevated productivity with complimentary high speed internet access. If you are planning an event in Anhui, we offer a range of adaptable venues as well as delicious catering with SuperFoodsRx ingredients.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hengyang Zhengxiang
