records.name_zh: 衡阳蒸湘福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Hengyang Zhengxiang is located in Huaxin Development Zone, Zhengxiang District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province. Zhengxiang District has obvious
description.textEn: geographical advantages. The main party and government agencies such as the Hengyang Municipal Party Committee and the Municipal Government are located here. It is the political, economic and cultural center of Hengyang City.Hotel has 149 guest rooms, There is beautifully decorated All Day Dinning restaurant, The Lounge / bar，and 2 multi-functional meeting rooms and recreational facilities. Unique geographical location, professional management, and intimate service, Four Points by Sheraton Hengyang Zhengxiang will create a high-quality Marriott guests To the Journey experience.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Guangdong, Heshan
records.name_zh: 广东鹤山方圆福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 广东鹤山方圆福朋喜来登酒店坐落在大雁山风景区山脚，欢迎莅临下榻，尊享宁静休闲时光，尽情放松休息。酒店设施齐全，位于中国沿海省份广东省的南部，位置便利，邻近闪闪发光的山湖，可轻松前往当地景点。酒店地理位置优越，距鹤山市中心仅数分钟左右行程，距江门仅约 31 公里，乘车很快可达。在探索完当地的自然景点之后，可返回酒店现代化客房内放松休息，客房配备福朋特色睡床，提供免费瓶装水、免费高速 Wi-Fi 和 49 英寸液晶电视。当饥饿来袭，可在酒店内的热门餐厅之一享用美味可口的国际佳肴与正宗粤菜。如果是为活动策划而来，则酒店装饰时尚且配备先进科技的现代化场地将是您的理想之选。广东鹤山方圆福朋喜来登酒店是位置优越的山地酒店，可满足您的各种需求，给您带来难忘体验。
description.textEn: Unwind in our peaceful retreat nestled into the base of Da Yan Mountain Scenic Spot at Four Points by Sheraton Guangdong, Heshan. Located in the southern portion of China’s coastal Guangdong Province, our well-appointed hotel is conveniently situated next to a shimmering mountain lake and offers easy access to local attractions. Downtown Heshan is only minutes away and Jiangmen is just a quick 19 mile drive from our ideal location. After exploring the area's natural attractions, unwind in our contemporary hotel accommodations with Four Points signature beds, free bottled water, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and 49-inch LCD TVs. When hunger strikes, dine in one of our popular onsite restaurants for delicious International and Cantonese fare. If visiting for event planning reasons, take advantage of our modern venues with stylish decor and advanced technology. We offer everything you need for an unforgettable experience in our ideally-located mountain hotel at Four Points by Sheraton Guangdong, Heshan.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Heyuan Resort
records.name_zh: 河源巴伐利亚庄园福朋喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于广东省河源市源城区高埔岗万洞旅游区，位于美丽的巴伐利亚庄园内，是一家国际品牌度假村酒店，拥有高雅设施，以及提供超凡服务和各种休闲活动的巴伐利亚庄园，庄园内设施丰富齐全，是结合吃住行游购娱为一体的一站式旅游目的地，使得无论是家庭出游、朋友聚会、公司团建等都能在此探索旅行的新乐趣。距离埔前高速公路交汇处仅 500 米左右，方便住客轻松前往广州、惠州、深圳和中国香港等城市（到惠州约 1 小时，到广州和深圳约 2 小时，广深港高铁香港西九龙站直达河源东站路程仅60分钟）。酒店交通位置便利，可轻松到达河源市以及河源市周边的旅游景点，如万绿湖、桂山风景区和恐龙博物馆。
description.textEn: This international brand resort in Heyuan, with its high-end facilities, first-class service and Bavarian manor with diversified recreational activities, will lead the market for the local conference team, tourist team and leisure and holiday crowd. The hotel is located in the beautiful Bavarian manor of Gaopugang Wandong Tourism Zone, Yuancheng District, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province. It is only 500 meters from the intersection of Po Qian Expressway and easily accessible to cities such as Guangzhou, Huizhou, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, 1 hour to Huizhou, 2 Hour to Guangzhou and Shenzhen, Direct trip from Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Heyuan East just 60 minutes. Convenient traffic location, but also easily reach the Heyuan city and tourist attractions around Heyuan, such as Lake Wan, Guishan Scenic Area and the Dinosaur Museum.

description.textZh: 呼和浩特喜来登酒店位于市中心，地理位置优越。从酒店驱车到最近的草原约1.5小时，酒店距呼和浩特白塔国际机场仅约20分钟车程，步行约10分钟即可抵达火车站，处于地铁1号线和2号线交汇处，是商务和休闲旅游的理想下榻之选。酒店拥有350间多款房型的舒适客房，可一览城市美丽的风景。酒店设有中餐厅、西餐厅、大堂吧和行政酒廊，8个宴会厅及会议场地，为您打造精彩纷呈的活动和特别庆典。另外酒店的健身中心和室内游泳池也可让您享受全身心的放松。
description.textEn: The Hohhot Sheraton Hotel is located in the city center with an excellent geographical location. It takes about 1.5 hours to drive from the hotel to the nearest grassland. The hotel is only about a 20-minutes drive from Hohhot Baita International Airport and a 10-minutes walk from the train station. It is located at the intersection of subway Line 1 and Line 2, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel has 350 comfortable guest rooms, with various room types that offer a warm and comfortable stay and provide a beautiful view of the city. The hotel features a YUE Chinese restaurant, a Feast signature restaurant, a lobby lounge, an executive lounge, and 8 meeting venues to create a variety of exciting events and special celebrations. Enjoy a full-body relaxation at the fitness center and indoor swimming pool.

records.name_en: The Park Lane Hong Kong, Autograph Collection
records.name_zh: 香港柏宁酒店，傲途格精选

description.textZh: 位於香港岛铜锣湾繁华的中心地带，柏宁酒店地理位置优越，客人可轻松抵达市内高级购物中心丶餐饮和娱乐胜地。酒店拥有820间舒适丶时尚的客房和套房，适合商务和休闲旅客。客人可尽情享受一系列设施，包括配备齐全的健身中心丶尊贵的行政酒廊以及多样化的餐饮选择，满足各种口味。柏宁酒店以知名的自助餐厅PLAYT而闻名，客人还可在着名的天台酒吧SKYE 或舒适的Ebb & Flow大堂酒廊放松身心，享受美好时光。酒店设有宽敞的会议及活动空间，适合各种场合，是在香港其中一个举办聚会的首选之地。入住柏宁酒店，为您在香港繁忙的城市风景中提供一段难忘的旅程。
description.textEn: Located in the vibrant heart of Causeway Bay on Hong Kong Island, The Park Lane Hong Kong, Autograph Collection offers unparalleled access to the city's top shopping, dining, and entertainment destinations. With 820 guestrooms and suites tailored for both business and leisure travelers, guests can indulge in amenities like a well-equipped fitness center, an exclusive executive lounge, and diverse dining options to satisfy every palate.The Park Lane hotel in Hong Kong Island is home to the popular buffet restaurant PLAYT. Guests can also unwind at the renowned rooftop bar SKYE or the inviting lobby lounge, perfect for relaxation and drinks. The hotel features spacious event spaces suitable for various occasions, making it a prime choice for gatherings in one of Hong Kong's most iconic neighborhoods.Experience luxury and convenience at The Park Lane Hong Kong, where sophistication and comfort blend seamlessly to offer a memorable stay in the heart of Hong Kong's bustling landscape.

description.textZh: 香港万怡酒店紧依维多利亚港，位于香港商业区的心脏地带。想轻松从酒店抵达熙来攘往且多姿多彩的核心商业，例如中环、金钟等地段也不成问题。酒店位置便利，邻近多个交通枢纽，步行约6分钟即可抵达港铁西港岛线香港大学站，同时亦可乘搭酒店免费穿梭巴士前往多处商务区，便捷宾客出行；酒店离香港国际机场也只需约40分钟车程；约10分钟亦即可抵达西九龙高铁站往返国内。设计时尚的客房可将周边美景尽收眼底，内设万豪经典床上用品、液晶电视、免费高速上网、会议设施和豪华的大理石浴室等，商务休闲两相宜。 入住香港万怡酒店行政客房及套房的住客即可享有舒适的行政酒廊待遇。 同时，更可前往24 小时健身中心锻炼身体，或在备受认可的 MoMo Café 享用美食.
description.textEn: Whether you are visiting Hong Kong for business or pleasure, Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong helps you move forward. Strategically nestled near the bustling Central Business District and the HKU station on the Island Line of the MTR subway, our hotel in Hong Kong, China offers unparalleled convenience. With our complimentary scheduled hotel shuttle bus service and excellent access to various public transportation options, your daily commute becomes effortless. Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) is a mere 40-minute drive away, while the West Kowloon High Speed Rail Station, connecting you to Chinese Mainland, is just 10 minutes away. Intuitively designed, our Sai Ying Pun hotel offers a 12-person event room, Hong Kong travel packages and everything you need to stay ahead in Hong Kong Island, China. Rooms and suites include plush Marriott bedding, flat-screen LCD TVs, marble bathrooms and scenic views of Victoria Harbour. Upgrade to an Executive Level room for exclusive access to an Executive Lounge.

records.name_en: Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong Sha Tin

description.textZh: 坐落于城门河畔，香港沙田万怡酒店融合现代风格与贴心设计，尽览迷人河景与城市景观。酒店距离石门港铁站仅步行五分钟，交通便捷，可在30分钟内轻松抵达启德体育园及香港会议展览中心等主要目的地。宾客亦可便捷前往区内顶级购物商场、香港中文大学及沙田马场。酒店提供卓越的餐饮体验，从 MoMo Café 的国际自助餐，到 LEVELthirty Lounge & Bar 的精致美馔与创意鸡尾酒，满足不同味蕾。宾客可于24小时健身中心随时锻炼、在户外泳池放松身心，或于园景区域体验匹克球运动。针对商务旅客，酒店设有灵活多变的会议及活动场地，包括无柱式宴会厅及先进的视听设备。香港沙田万怡酒店为您提供一切所需，成就顺畅而难忘的入住体验。
description.textEn: Situated on the banks of the Shing Mun River, Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong Sha Tin blends modern style with thoughtful design, offering stunning riverside and cityscape views. Just a five-minute walk from Shek Mun MTR Station, the hotel provides seamless connectivity to major destinations—including Kai Tak Stadium and the HK Convention and Exhibition Centre, both reachable in under 30 minutes. Guests enjoy easy access to premier shopping, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and Sha Tin Racecourse. Indulge in exceptional dining, from an international buffet at MoMo Café to refined cuisine and cocktails at LEVELthirty Lounge & Bar. Stay active in our 24-hour gym, relax by the outdoor pool, or play pickleball at the landscaped area. For business travelers, our versatile event venues feature pillar-less ballrooms and advanced audiovisual technology. Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong Sha Tin delivers everything you need for a seamless and memorable stay.

records.name_en: Mira Moon Hong Kong, a Member of Design Hotels™
records.name_zh: 香港问月酒店（Design Hotels™设计酒店成员）

description.textZh: 问月酒店是 Mira 酒店系列旗下的精品酒店，由名家设计师 Wanders & YOO 领衔创意设计。酒店拥有 88 间别具特色的客房和一间顶层套房，提供五种客房类型，以现代形式演绎中国中秋节神话。所有客房配备免费 Wi-Fi、内置 Chromecast 娱乐系统、包含国际标准插座、S-Video 和 HDMI 的多媒体接口、HEPA 过滤空气净化、高清 LED 网络电视、奈斯派索咖啡机和胶囊咖啡。豪华精品问月酒店位于香港岛繁华的铜锣湾中心位置，是充满活力的娱乐区的一部分，附近有时代广场、崇光百货和希慎广场等景点。问月酒店也是香港会展中心步行范围内仅有的一间设计酒店。
description.textEn: Mira Moon is a boutique hotel within the Mira Hotel Collection conceived under the creative direction of the famous design guru – Wanders & YOO. Equipped with 88 one-of-a-kind guestrooms and a penthouse suite, all five guestroom types of Mira Moon are the modern rendition of the Chinese Mid-Autumn Festival mythology. All rooms are equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, Built-in Chromecast Entertainment System, Multi-media connectivity includes international plug sockets, S-Video Jack and HDMI, Hepa filter air purification, HD LED IPTV, and Nespresso coffee machine with capsules. Located at the heart of bustling Causeway Bay on Hong Kong Island, the 5-star boutique hotel Mira Moon is part of the vibrant entertainment district with landmarks like Times Square, Sogo and Hysan Place. Mira Moon also boasts as the only Design hotel within a few minutes’ walk from Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

records.name_en: The Mira Hong Kong, a Member of Design Hotels™
records.name_zh: 香港美丽华酒店（Design Hotels™设计酒店成员）

description.textZh: 香港美丽华酒店（Design Hotels™设计酒店成员）是万豪旅享家的合作酒店，位于香港购物、餐饮和娱乐区尖沙咀的中心位置，俯瞰郁郁葱葱的九龙公园，堪称现代都市隐居胜地。酒店装饰时尚现代，提供个性化服务，拥有 492 间无烟客房，其中含 56 间套房，配备崭新科技设施，如可随身携带并提供不限流量 4G 连接的小型 Wi-Fi 设备、音响系统和覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi，确保宾客每次住宿都尽享豪华体验。酒店拥有六间别致的概念餐厅（其中有 2 间米其林点赞餐厅），以及备受认可的 MiraSpa 水疗中心（内设 21 世纪健身设施、室内无边泳池和 24 小时健身房），欢迎前来体验。
description.textEn: The Mira Hong Kong is a member of Design Hotels™, a partner hotel of Marriott Bonvoy ®, and a contemporary urban retreat overlooking lush Kowloon Park in the heart of Hong Kong’s shopping, dining and entertainment district, Tsimshatsui. Modern interiors, personalized service, and 492 smoke-free guestrooms with 56 suites bristling with latest tech-friendly features, such as pocket WiFi device for use on the go with unlimited 4G connectivity, sound system and free Wi-Fi across the hotel, define each luxurious stay. Six chic dining concepts with 2 Michelin-recommended restaurants and the award-winning MiraSpa housing 21st century wellness facilities, indoor infinity pool and 24/7 gym, add to the experience.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hong Kong, Tung Chung
records.name_zh: 香港东涌福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 香港东涌福朋喜来登酒店致力于为商务和休闲宾客呈献惬意的休闲住宿体验。酒店地处东涌商住区的中心地带，距离大屿山知名的远足步道和景点（例如东荟城名店仓，昂坪 360 缆车和香港迪士尼乐园）仅数分钟路程，距离香港迪士尼乐园也仅需十几分钟车程。此外，由酒店出发可轻松前往亚洲国际博览馆AWE、香港国际机场、港珠澳大桥和深圳湾口岸。酒店提供免费穿梭巴士服务，来回于香港国际机场（每一小时一班）及东涌地铁站（每半小时一班）。在大型活动或展览期间，酒店会增派来回亚洲国际博览馆（AWE）的免费穿梭巴士，具体时间请咨询酒店。经历一整天的玩乐与探索后，宾客可以在时尚别致的客房中放松休憩重焕活力，准备好第二天再启探索旅程。同时欢迎联系我们的专业宴会团队计划安排完美难忘的活动。如宾客希望享受更全面的酒店住宿体验，可预订毗连的香港东涌世茂喜来登酒店，酒店内设有多个康乐设施，包括喜来登健身中心、室外恒温游泳池、桑拿及儿童游戏室。
description.textEn: Find serenity at Four Points by Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung. Ideal for business and leisure travelers, our Lantau Island, HK, hotel offers the local Best Brews craft beer program. Enjoy Tung Chung Kitchen's flavors or quick bites at The Harbor Lounge. Explore Lantau Island's trails, Citygate Outlet Mall, Hong Kong Disneyland and the Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car, Big Buddha and Tai O, all just minutes away. Easy access to Asia World-Expo, Hong Kong International Airport, Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge and Shenzhen Bay simplifies travel even more for business and leisure guests. Rest comfortably in our hotel rooms or suites after a day of adventure. Host memorable events with the help of our meeting planners. Discover travel reinvented at Four Points by Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung. Your unforgettable stay and extraordinary journey is made even more unforgettable and extraordinary when you take advantage of our exclusive hotel in Lantau, Hong Kong, deals and vacation packages.

records.name_zh: 香港 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 入住豪华的香港 JW 万豪酒店, 追随心之所向, 获享精彩体验。酒店坐落于高雅时尚的香港金钟区太古广场, 与金钟港铁站相连, 可供四线转乘, 无缝接驳中国深圳福田及罗湖口岸。 从酒店出发, 可便利前往香港中环的各大名店、餐厅及办公楼；此外, 酒店还紧邻兰桂坊和太平山。酒店客房温馨雅致, 提供免费 Wi-Fi, 配备豪华寝具和现代设施, 宾客还可在房内饱览维多利亚港、翠绿山峦或璀璨闪耀的天际线景观, 是理想的度假酒店。酒店餐饮选项丰富, 从米其林星級粤菜餐厅、配备现场烹饪站且氛围欢快的全日餐厅, 到海鲜餐厅和时尚酒廊, 您可随心挑选。酒店场地富有特色, 包括无柱式宴会厅、露天场地和现代会议室, 您可在此规划您在香港的下一场会议或社交活动, 获得悦心体验。酒店优越的地理位置可便利前往周边地区, 满足您的探索乐趣。欢迎入住香港五星级酒店 JW 万豪酒店, 悦享尊贵度假体验。
description.textEn: Revitalize body, mind and spirit when you stay at the 5-star JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong. Located above Pacific Place and connected directly to the Admiralty MTR station with four-line interchanging, our downtown hotel offers easy access to the shops, dining and businesses of Hong Kong Central along with Victoria Peak and Lan Kwai Fong. Warmly designed, sophisticated hotel rooms feature complimentary WiFi, deluxe bedding, modern amenities and views over Victoria Harbour, the scenic mountains or the glittering downtown skyline. Dining venues range from a Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant and an all-day restaurant with live kitchens to an alfresco seafood bar and a stylish lounge. Plan your next meeting or social function in Hong Kong and be delighted with distinctive venues including a pillarless ballroom, outdoor spaces and contemporary conference rooms. If you are interested in exploring, our prime location makes it easy to discover the city. Your 5-star escape awaits at JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong.

description.textZh: Le Meridien Hong Kong, Cyberport, is an urban resort hotel on Hong Kong Island, with sophisticated accommodations offering beautiful ocean views. This pet-friendly hotel in Hong Kong also features excellent dining, a pool and indoor, outdoor event venues
description.textEn: Le Meridien Hong Kong Cyberport is a chic modern lifestyle hotel providing an authentic and elevated discovery experience. This pet-friendly hotel in Hong Kong has a mid century modern aesthetic emphasizing natural materials contrasted by darker tactile design features creating a fresh and welcoming ambiance. Its the perfect option for rejuvenating stays, memorable meals, motivating meetings and engaging events, catered to individual needs, complemented by technology, sustainability and innovation. With 170 spacious rooms and suites, 4 distinctive dining options including Al Fresco a pet friendly environment a stunning outdoor swimming pool, 2 gyms and surrounded by verdant nature Le Meridien Hong Kong Cyberport stands out in Hong Kong. The hotel is close to a range of cultural, historic and entertainment destinations with a complimentary shuttle service ensuring seamless exploration and discovery.

records.name_en: Hong Kong Ocean Park Marriott Hotel
records.name_zh: 香港海洋公园万豪酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻香港亲子酒店 - 海洋公园万豪酒店。酒店位于美丽的香港岛南岸，地理位置优越，四周自然风光优美，客房风格优雅，配备一系列令人印象深刻且贴心的设施，是商务与休闲旅行者的理想住宿之选。步入酒店大堂，率先映入眼帘的是约16米高的水族景观，壮观非凡，惹人赞叹。酒店设有简约现代的客房、套房及三个独立主题的房型，入住部分套房更可尊享万豪贵宾廊礼遇。此外，酒店内还设有自助餐餐厅、酒吧、中菜厅以及特色牛排餐厅，酒店设有中央礁湖主题游泳池、氛围宁静的水疗中心以及大型无柱式宴会厅，是举办商务活动或社交聚会的理想选地。酒店距离适合全家畅玩的海洋公园仅数步之遥，且紧邻水上乐园及浅水湾等知名景点。选择香港海洋公园万豪酒店，享受更加卓越的旅行体验。
description.textEn: Choose Hong Kong Ocean Park Marriott Hotel for your next getaway. Boasting a pristine location on the island's southern coast, our resort hotel in Hong Kong​ treats travelers to impressive sights and amenities. Enjoy bridge access to Ocean Park, free shuttles to Water World and a 50-foot-tall aquarium of island flora and fauna in our hotel lobby. When you're ready to unwind, our Ocean Park hotel in Hong Kong features spacious accommodations with three different room themes and some suites offering M Club Lounge access. Enjoy one of our many on-site restaurants, bistros, lounges or bars, with 24-hour room service also available for all-day dining. Our lagoon-style pool and tranquil spa rethink relaxation, while our pillarless ballroom reinvents meetings, weddings and events. Chic designs and catering make us the right destination for teambuilding exercises, breakout sessions and more. Offering a wide range of services and facilities, Hong Kong Ocean Park Marriott Hotel caters to short and long-stay guests.

description.textZh: 坐落于大屿山航天城内的香港天际万豪酒店，是商务和休闲旅客的理想下榻之选。酒店位置优越，距离香港国际机场和港珠澳大桥香港口岸仅五分钟车程，并与亚洲国际博览馆相连。从博览馆站出发乘坐「机场快线」列车，25分钟可到达九龙站转乘香港西九龙高铁 ; 乘车经屯门赤鱲角隧道，约需30分钟可抵达深圳湾口岸，出行便捷高效。客房面积从377平方尺起，宽敞舒适，配备现代化设施，让宾客尽享惬意居停。五间餐厅及酒吧提供精彩纷呈的餐饮体验，满足不同口味的需求。宾客亦可在「泉水疗」放松身心，或在室内恒温泳池畅游。此外，酒店设14个多功能会议场地，总面积超过13, 000平方尺，适合举办各类大小规模的活动。酒店提供往返机场和东涌港铁站的免费专车服务，為宾客增添便利。以这里作为旅程据点，轻松探索大屿山的名胜，包括香港迪士尼乐园、东荟城名店仓、昂坪360缆车、天坛大佛、大澳渔村，以及即将开幕的11 天空。
description.textEn: Located within SKYCITY on Lantau Island, the Hong Kong SkyCity Marriott Hotel is a premium destination for business and leisure travel. Just five minutes away from the Hong Kong International Airport and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge (HZMB)-Hong Kong Port, the hotel directly connects to AsiaWorld-Expo. Our spacious room accommodations, starting from 377 sqft, feature modern amenities to enhance your comfort. Savor delectable cuisine at one of our five on-site restaurants, rejuvenate your senses at our Quan Spa, or take a refreshing swim in our heated indoor pool. An ideal setting for events of any scale, the hotel’s 14 versatile meeting venues span over 13,000 sqft. Our prime location allows easy exploration of Lantau’s attractions, including Hong Kong Disneyland, Citygate Outlets, Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car, The Big Buddha, Tai O Fishing Village, and the soon-to-open 11SKIES. For added convenience, complimentary shuttle service to and from the Airport, and Tung Chung MTR Station is provided.

records.name_en: Renaissance Hong Kong Harbour View Hotel

description.textZh: 香港万丽海景酒店坐落于湾仔海滨，紧邻香港会议展览中心，坐拥维多利亚港美景。酒店位置优越，距离港铁会展站仅约3分钟路程，步行可前往湾仔天星渡轮码头，直达尖沙咀购物商场；邻近中环商务区及铜锣湾购物区。客房宽敞舒适，配备齐全的商务设施，并设有广达11,000平方米的平台花园，为客人提供多种康乐活动设施，包括户外恒温泳池、健身中心、网球场及缓跑径等。会议设施总面积达1,300平方米，配有LED屏幕墙迎合各种活动需要。食客可于备受认可的满福楼品尝地道粤菜或是在Mirage Bar & Restaurant细味东西「丰」味美馔。无论是商务出差或休闲港游，皆为旅客居停之首选。
description.textEn: Step into Renaissance Hong Kong Harbour View Hotel where every moment transforms into an extraordinary experience. With a great location in vibrant Wan Chai our hotel places all of Hong Kong Island at your fingertips for a business trip or family holiday. We are also attached to the Convention and Exhibition Centre. Settle into your modern hotel room or suite with a view of either our lush gardens, our shimmering outdoor pool or famous Victoria Harbour. Enjoy thoughtful perks like complimentary WiFi, comfortable bedding, a flat-screen TV and a marble bathroom. You will be delighted by our fantastic hotel amenities such as exquisite cuisine at the award-winning Dynasty restaurant, a tennis court and a 24 hour fitness center. Select our hotel to host your event in Wan Chai and benefit from stately ballroom venue space, seasoned planning and catering teams and an accessible location. Trust Renaissance Hong Kong Harbour View Hotel to provide you with what you need for a memorable experience.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻静谧优雅的香港喜来登酒店，探索缤纷多彩的九龙。我们酒店位于香港九龙繁华的尖沙咀，地理位置优越，邻近尖沙咀地铁站、高铁站和渡轮码头等公共交通枢纽，与海港城、K11人文购物艺术馆和众多商业中心仅隔咫尺之遥。下榻期间，您可畅享健身俱乐部和桑拿房以及屋顶泳池，调适身心，欣赏维多利亚港的迷人风光。当饥饿感来袭，不妨前往我们精致优雅的餐厅，享用正宗中餐、日本料理和国际美食。酒店客房和套房设计巧妙，配备现代科技设施、名品家具和落地窗，行政客房更可尊享喜来登行政礼遇，供您尽享九龙闲适放松时光。我们的香港尖沙咀酒店提供众多优惠和套餐，热诚期待您的到来，无论出差或度假皆是合宜之选。
description.textEn: Discover the many sides of Kowloon from the refined serenity of Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers. Enviably located in the bustling Tsim Sha Tsui, our Hong Kong hotel in Kowloon is near Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station is steps away from premier public transportation options, such as Express Rail Link and the ferry terminal, as well as Harbour City, K11 Musea and commercial hubs. Make time for yourself in our health club and sauna, including a stunning rooftop pool with views of Victoria Harbour. When hunger strikes, dine in sophisticated restaurants, serving authentic Chinese, Japanese and International fare. Unwind in Kowloon in our thoughtfully designed rooms and suites, each featuring modern technology, designer furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows, or reserve one of our club accommodations to enjoy our Sheraton Club. Enjoy our hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, offers and packages, and whether you are here for work or play, we look forward to hosting you at Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers.

records.name_en: Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung Hotel
records.name_zh: 香港东涌世茂喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻中国香港东涌世茂喜来登酒店, 于大屿山上感受绿意盎然风情。我们的豪华酒店位于住宅区和商业中心内, 是您商务或休闲出行的理想下榻之选。酒店邻近迪士尼乐园, 四周山峦叠翠, 海景辽阔, 附近还有美景步道等您探索。从我们的豪华酒店出发搭乘地铁可直达国际机场、进出境口岸以及市中心, 交通非常便利。到宽敞的健身房锻炼, 面向大海, 重焕活力；在迷人的泳池尽享惬意休闲时光；还可以到顶层扒房品尝风味美食。饭店内亦有其他餐厅提供现代中餐、国际风味自助餐饮及精致蛋糕。我们的活动场地面积逾3,400平米, 包含室内外空间以及当地大型宴会厅, 是商务旅客的理想之选。酒店设有218间客房, 皆配有落地窗, 可欣赏优美景色, 供您在结束大屿山一日行程后惬意放松休憩。
description.textEn: Discover a greener side to Hong Kong on Lantau Island from Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung Hotel. Located in a residential community and commercial hub, our luxury hotel in Hong Kong is perfect for your next business or leisure escape. Lush landscapes await, as our hotel near Hong Kong Disneyland showcases scenic mountain and sea views with renowned trails nearby. With access to the international airport, the China border and the city via MTR, this Hong Kong five-star hotel makes traveling easy. Stay active in our extensive gym, relax on our inviting pool deck and dine on island-inspired fare at our rooftop grill. Other sophisticated restaurants at hotel include a modern Chinese eatery, Sheraton Patisserie and international all-day dining. Business travelers in Hong Kong appreciate our event venues that offer 3,400 sqm of indoor and outdoor space, including one of the area’s largest ballrooms. After a fun day on Lantau Island, return to one of our 218 rooms featuring full-length windows with scenic views.

description.textZh: 香港瑞吉酒店反映了香港知名室内设计师傅厚民（André Fu）的愿景，融合瑞吉品牌经典元素与时尚精致格调于一体，巧妙地彰显了香港的多元文化与典雅韵味。酒店共设有 127 间装饰考究的客房与套房，并辅以东西方文化元素，提供理想入住体验；同时，品牌标志性的管家服务精雕细琢每一个细节，悉心照顾客人的需求。香港瑞吉酒店拥有两间米其林星级餐厅 — 由法籍主厨Olivier Elzer执掌的米其林二星L’Envol法国餐厅和洪志光师傅主理的米其林二星「润」中餐厅。 The Drawing Room大堂酒廊供应全天国际美食和别具特色的下午茶，瑞吉酒吧则提供 14 款灵感源自香港和纽约的招牌鸡尾酒。
description.textEn: Reflecting the unique vision of St. Regis through the eyes of interior designer André Fu, our hotel on Hong Kong Island is a curated mansion in the heart of Wan Chai district that masterfully blends creative architecture, diverse cultures and timeless elegance. Our luxury hotel is home to a two-MICHELIN-starred French restaurant helmed by Chef Olivier Elzer and a two-MICHELIN-starred Chinese restaurant headed by Chef Hung Chi-Kwong. The Drawing Room hosts traditional Afternoon Teas with all-day international dining while The St. Regis Bar crafts signature cocktails inspired by a tale of two cities Hong Kong and New York. East meets West in our thoughtfully designed, five-star hotel rooms while panoramic views of the harbor are available to those who upgrade to our select hotel suites. At The St. Regis Hong Kong, discerning expertise and bespoke indulgence provide you with the key to an exquisite stay in Wan Chai district.

description.textZh: 香港丽思卡尔顿酒店耸立于繁华的尖沙咀地区，雄踞环球贸易广场及圆方购物中心之上，坐拥102至118层。酒店位于西九龙文化区，毗邻M+博物馆和香港故宫文化博物馆等文化地标，以及举办演唱会与国际盛事的启德体育园區。高速铁路站及机场快线近在咫尺，仅需21分钟即可抵达机场。步入云端，来到距离海平面490米高处，尽揽香港天际线与维多利亚港壮丽景致。酒店汇聚五间各具特色的餐厅及酒吧，包括极具品味气派的米其林星级意大利餐厅 Tosca di Angelo、二星米其林中菜食府天龙轩、全日供应国际美馔的大堂酒廊、供应自助餐的Café 103，以及在118楼的顶层酒吧 OZONE。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Hong Kong stands majestically in Tsim Sha Tsui, within the vibrant West Kowloon District. Perched atop the International Commerce Centre and Elements Shopping Mall, the hotel is just steps from notable cultural landmarks such as M+ and Hong Kong Palace Museum, as well as the Kai Tak Stadium for concerts and world-class events. With convenient access to the High-Speed Railway Station and Airport Express, reaching the airport in just 21 minutes. Occupying floors 106 to 118, all rooms and suites feature breathtaking views of the Hong Kong skyline and Victoria Harbour from 490 meters above sea level. The hotel boasts five dining venues, including Michelin-starred dining experience from authentic Cantonese cuisine at Tin Lung Heen, innovative Italian fine dining at Tosca di Angelo, exquisite lunch and dinner buffet at Café 103, delightful afternoon tea at The Lounge and Bar, and lively nightlife at Ozone on level 118.

description.textZh: 香港，繁华的摩天都市，现代化的高楼矗立于迷宫般的大街小巷，都市人穿梭其中，到处都充斥着跃动急速的生活节拍。香港W酒店，其设计呼应着璀璨中别具个性的都市色彩，让宾客犹如置身在魔法森林里。酒店的设计由两位非凡的室内设计师，包括日本Glamorous的Yasumichi Morita和澳洲g+a的Nic Graham一手操办，特意打造W的醉人体验。393间客房皆充满着艺术意味，在这活力都市中，展现生活的时尚。魔法森林里，香港W 酒店非凡闪烁，精彩体验，在这里展开。
description.textEn: Go further at W Hong Kong. Our West Kowloon hotel in Hong Kong redefines how you spend your time on the road. With our location near Kowloon Station, you have easy access to Airport Express, mainland China and Hong Kong's best sites and bites. Experience the city center at Tsim Sha Tsui or Central with a short drive or station stop. Connect with trendy destinations such as West Kowloon Cultural District, and when you return to our Kowloon luxury hotel, fuel up at KITCHEN with sumptuous worldwide cuisine or take a sip at our social hub WOOBAR. One of the highest rooftop pools in Hong Kong is our WET Pool and Deck boasting electrifying views of the city and Victoria Harbour. For meetings, weddings and special events with extra punch and pizzazz, book our Great Room. Award-winning Bliss Spa is our five-star amenity waiting to sweep you off your feet, while our rooms and suites do the same but in a different way. Keep it fun for the whole family with a pet-friendly hotel room at W Hong Kong.

description.textZh: 淮安市中心万枫酒店位于清江浦区中心地带，是于江苏省北部地级市——淮安市率先设立的万豪酒店。酒店位于市中心，靠近闻名遐迩的新亚购物广场和金鹰广场购物中心。酒店餐厅坐拥优美城景，供应品类丰富的精选早餐，包括煎蛋卷、培根、当地风味面条以及新鲜水果、酸奶和甜面包，让您畅享美味。酒店拥有约 40 平米多样化活动空间，深受商务和休闲旅客喜爱，您可在此举办各种会议和培训活动。充实忙碌的一天结束后，到我们的现代健身中心畅快锻炼，尽情放松身心。酒店客房布置时尚精致，配有舒适的万枫酒店特色睡眠体验等现代化用品，您可在此逸享舒适住宿，饱览迷人城景。欢迎莅临下榻淮安市万枫酒店，尽情探索淮安这个充满传奇色彩的旅游目的地。
description.textEn: Located in the heart of Qingjiangpu District Fairfield Huaian is the first Marriott Hotel in Huai'an City which is the prefecture-level city in northern Jiangsu province. Our hotel sits in downtown area, placing you near famous Xinya plaza shopping mall, Gold eagle plaza shopping mall. Sample delicious breakfast at our hotel restaurant, including Omelets, bacon,local noodles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, yogurt and sweet breads and overlooking the city. Business and leisure travelers appreciate our 40 square meters of dynamic event space for conferences and training. Wind down a satisfying day in downtown area with an exhilarating workout in our modern fitness center. Discover refined function in stylishly appointed hotel rooms featuring contemporary essentials like the ultra-comfortable Fairfield Signature Sleep Experience and striking views of the city. Experience the storied travel destination of Huai’an when you stay at Fairfield Huaian.

records.name_zh: 花莲洁西艾美度假酒店

description.textZh: 花莲洁西艾美度假酒店是位于花莲市中心地带的一家豪华都市温泉度假酒店，为台湾地区东部带来别致的欧式魅力。酒店拥有 252 间客房，设有两间餐厅和两间酒吧，多个私人及公共温泉，还有一间水疗中心，为您带来超凡焕活体验。酒店地处历史悠久、富有文化活力的商业区，坐拥广阔的山海美景，是隐匿于繁华都市中的一处静谧逍遥之所。
description.textEn: Le Méridien Hualien Resort, a luxury urban hot spring resort situated in the heart of Hualien City, introduces distinctive European charm to eastern Taiwan. The resort features 252 guest rooms, two restaurants and two bars, private and public hot springs, and a spa for the ultimate rejuvenation. Situated in a historically rich and culturally vibrant commercial district, yet having uninterrupted views of the ocean and central mountain range, it is truly a serene escape amidst the urban bustle.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Huangshi Development Zone
records.name_zh: 黄石开发区万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 我们的惠州度假酒店地处大亚湾海滨，驻于公园巷海港综合大楼之上，坐拥壮丽的大亚湾风光，您可于此出发开启现代古城探索之旅。您可走出酒店，探索当地的艺术、建筑和美食以及数千年历史遗迹。亦可纵身跃入我们的室内或室外泳池畅游一番，便利前往海滩感受细腻柔软的沙滩，或前往洄水疗中心寻找身心慰藉。还可租赁自行车骑行游览惠州，或到健身中心保持身心活力。酒店内还设有三家餐厅、艾美家庭儿童俱乐部和宽敞的活动空间。我们所有 296 间设施齐全、布置精美的客房和套房，均设有可一览中国南海壮阔海景的私人阳台。温馨的木质元素与现代家具，特色艾美睡床以及先进的科技设施（包括 55 英寸纯平网络电视），巧妙配搭，相得益彰。
description.textEn: Nestled on the beach overlooking Daya Bay as part of the Park Lane Harbour Complex, our Huizhou resort is the gateway to discover a distinctive blend of ancient and modern China. Explore art, architecture and cuisine, with a historical heritage dating back thousands of years. Take a dip in our indoor or outdoor hotel pools, put your toes in the sand with direct beach access or find solace at Ocean Spa. Stay active in our Fitness Centre or with bicycle rentals for touring Huizhou. Three dining venues, Le Meridien Family Kids Club and ample event space are also available. Each of our 296 well-appointed hotel rooms and suites boasts a private balcony with breathtaking views of the South China Sea. Warm wood accents and contemporary furnishings complement our signature Le Meridien BEDs and state-of-the-art technology, including 55-inch flat-screen IPTVs.

description.textZh: 惠州富力万丽酒店坐落于城市商业中心，坐拥西湖和东江的迷人美景，是商务和休闲旅行的理想栖身之所。酒店地处商业区，周围环绕精品写字楼和大型购物商场；地理位置优越，交通便利，可轻松抵达高铁站、机场、公交站或地铁。酒店内设333间风格时尚的客房和套房，房内公共娱乐区域面积至少也有47平方米，同样房内配备豪华床上用品、独立控温器和互联 网接入口。在我们的室内游泳池和24小时健身中心，您可随时来此游泳健身放松身心。酒店内精品餐厅提供国内外美食，满足您不断变化的味蕾需求；同样，您可在酒店怡廊品尝一杯精心调配的鸡尾酒，结束漫长一天。酒店拥有11个不同规模，总面积超过2288平方米宽敞的会议设施。坐拥非凡江景，配备豪华璀璨的灯光和专业超凡的音效设施，定能满足不同的宴会及会议需求。轻松满足您婚礼或商务会议的各种需求。惠州富力万丽酒店热情友善的员工随时为您服务，优越的地理位置及豪华的室内设备随时满足您的各种需求。
description.textEn: Discover the ideal blend of a prime location with upscale amenities at Renaissance Huizhou Hotel. Situated in the center of Jiang Bei Central Business District, with direct access to Huizhou's major shopping areas, tourist attractions and commercial centers, our contemporary hotel is the ideal choice for every traveler. Throughout our modern Guangdong Province hotel, you'll find upscale amenities, spacious rooms and suites with stunning river views, a full-service spa, an indoor, glass domed pool, international restaurants and much more. Our extensive selection of dedicated meeting rooms and event spaces are complemented by our expert planning and culinary teams, ensuring that your business events, weddings and social galas are a great success. When it is time to explore, Huizhou railway station is just minutes away, with trains to take you to Beijing, Hong Kong and beyond. Whether traveling for business or enjoying a vacation, we look forward to welcoming you to our Huizhou hotel.

records.name_zh: 惠州白鹭湖雅居乐喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 惠州白鹭湖雅居乐喜来登酒店坐拥迷人的水滨景观，并提供贴心服务和周到设施，热诚欢迎您光临下榻。酒店客房和套房面积宽敞，各类设施配备齐全，包括喜来登甜梦之床、平面电视、设有人体工学座椅的宽大办公区以及免费 Wi-Fi，您可于此尽情放松身心、重焕活力。客房还设有阳台，可欣赏花园美景或水滨景观。欢迎前往华美的室内外泳池畅游一番，畅玩精彩纷呈的水上乐园，在酒店健身房挥汗锻炼，酒店内还设有孩子们喜欢的儿童俱乐部。开始探索之旅前，不妨在酒店餐厅享用中式和国际美味佳肴。我们的水滨酒店邻近泗州塔、惠州体育公园以及西湖风景区。酒店拥有迷人的宴会厅、现代会议室，以及包括户外婚礼证婚场地在内的精美户外活动场所，是举办各类活动的理想选地。我们热诚期待您光临下榻惠州白鹭湖雅居乐喜来登酒店。
description.textEn: Sheraton Huizhou Bailuhu welcomes those traveling through China with friendly service, thoughtful amenities and impressive water views. Relax and recharge in spacious hotel rooms and suites filled with amenities, including Sheraton Sweet Sleeper Beds®, flat-screen TVs, ample workspaces with ergonomic chairs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Rooms also feature balconies which reveal garden or water views. Relish the gorgeous indoor and outdoor pools, experience the water park, break a sweat in our gym and bring your children to our Kids Club. Sample delicious Chinese and international favorites at our hotel restaurants before going out to explore the area. Our waterfront hotel is near the Sizhou Tower, Huizhou Sports Park and West Lake Scenic Area. Event planners will appreciate our stunning ballrooms, modern meeting rooms and beautiful outdoor event venues, including the outdoor wedding chapel. We look forward to your visit to Sheraton Huizhou Bailuhu.

description.textZh: 雅乐轩酒店在空间外设与格调塑造上秉承开放性原则，环境布设雅致清新而又别有深意，活动空间处处充满活力。我们是新一代的潮流酒店，凭借科技和设计追随客人的快步节奏，竭力呈献不断优化的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Aloft Hotels is open in space and spirit, offering Fresh, purposeful environments and vibrant spaces that bring people together. We are the next generation of hotel, using technology and design to enhance experiences and move at the fast pace of our guests.

description.textZh: 安吉万怡酒店地理位置得天独厚，距安吉站约22.5公里，紧邻及购物和餐饮于一体的浙北购物中心，生活娱乐配套齐全。入住期间，宾客可以便捷前往竹博园、中南百草园、中国大竹海等周边景区，在壮观幽深的景观中沉浸式体验江南竹文化。酒店拥有 234 间宽敞现代的客房，透过客房内的全景落地窗，宾客可远眺安吉秀美的绿水青山。所有客房均配备舒适的床品和典雅的木制家具，营造舒适宁静之感；另有灵活便捷的办公区高速网络和免费高速无线网络，为宾客提供商旅共融的入住体验。酒店的全日制餐厅以健康生活为核心概念，精选各地新鲜食材，汇集丰富多样的中西美食，可供160余位宾客同时用餐；开放式厨房为餐饮体验注入轻松与活力。位于一楼的大堂酒廊是商务会晤或社交聚会的理想场所。
description.textEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests. With locally inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You will also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free WiFi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive.

description.textZh: The hotel was designed by TDG and adheres to brand tagline - The Beauty of Simplicity. Its design inspiration uniquely incorporates four local elements: plant sprouts, morning dew, lush forests, and lake fishing net.
description.textEn: Fairfield By Marriott Deqing was designed by TDG (Touchdesigngroup) and adheres to brand tagline - The Beauty of Simplicity. Its design inspiration uniquely incorporates four local elements: plant sprouts, morning dew, lush forests, and lake fishing net. Fairfield By Marriott Deqing is dedicated to providing guests an inviting and effortless experience.

records.name_zh: 湖州南浔万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Huzhou Nanxun，is located at 1881 Nanlin Middle Road, Nanxun District, Huzhou City, adjacent to Nanxun Ancient Town. The hotel has 240 carefully crafted guest rooms.
description.textEn: The hotel has convenient transportation. It takes 10 minutes by car to reach the shopping center, about 10 minutes by car to get to Nanxun Ancient Town, and 6 minutes by car to arrive at Huzhou Nanxun Station.

description.textZh: 毗邻湖州高铁站（6 公里直达）与市中心（3 公里即达），酒店以得天独厚的区位优势，为商务差旅与亲子出游提供高效便捷的出行体验。无论是洽谈公务还是探索湖城，皆能快速抵达，从容开启旅程。精心打造 189 间雅致客房及套房，现代简约的空间设计搭配舒适寝具，为住客构筑温馨旅居港湾。客房可将城市璀璨景致尽收眼底，让湖城的日升月落成为居停时光的动人背景。在餐饮体验上，「玩啤食社」是不容错过的亮点 —— 这里不仅供应本地精酿啤酒，更汇聚湖州地道风味、经典粤菜及创意江浙融合料理，让舌尖在传统与创新间自在游走。此外，国际风味佳肴与特色饮品全天候供应，多元选择满足不同味蕾期待。24 小时免费开放的健身中心配备先进器材，助您在旅途中保持运动习惯，随时焕活身心。而对于会议及活动需求，酒店拥有 4 间多功能会议室及 3 个恢弘宴会厅，专业策划团队全程跟进，从定制餐饮到流程设计皆精益求精，确保每一场活动圆满举行。无论商务公干还是休闲度假，下榻湖州福朋喜来登酒店，皆能在此邂逅舒适与惬意：亲子家庭可畅享便捷出行与贴心服务，商旅人士能高效平衡工作与生活。我们以细节雕琢旅居体验，让每一次停留都成为 “旅・获自在” 的难忘记忆。
description.textEn: The hotel offers high-quality rooms & executive suites, delivering an exceptional Marriott experience through its prime location, sophisticated management, & heartfelt service that feels like home. Just a 10-min drive from Huzhou High-speed Railway Station & 20 mins from Taihu Lake Scenic Area, all rooms feature Serta mattresses as standard, paired with smart sleep systems to redefine rest—exploring comfort innovations for AlwaysComfortable nights.Led by China’s top Cantonese chefs & Black Pearl-awarded masters, the Chinese restaurant blends global vision with local flavors, using standardized techniques to highlight ingredient purity, guiding guests on a "fresh" business dining journey. The 5th-floor all-day restaurant serves hearty breakfasts, while The Mesh Bar offers specialty beers. An insta-worthy outdoor garden pool adds to the experience, ensuring relaxation & enjoyment for every stay.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Huzhou, Nanxun
records.name_zh: 湖州南浔福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 湖州南浔福朋喜来登酒店坐落于南浔新城核心腹地，三面环水、景致怡人。酒店毗邻慈善公园与金象湖公园，交通十分便捷，临近南浔高铁站，驱车约 10 分钟即可抵达南浔古镇。酒店拥有 234 间格调雅致的经典现代客房及套房，配套完善考究，坐拥城市或河景视野，让宾客卸下疲惫、安享惬意休憩时光。玩啤食社提供丰富多元的美食，从轻简餐点到精酿小食，满足不同时段的味蕾需求。酒店配备 1816 平方米多功能会议空间，包含 570 平方米豪华大宴会厅、200 平方米多功能会议室及 300 平方米户外草坪。专业宴会团队全程贴心服务，致力打造圆满会务与宴席体验，是举办各类活动的理想之选。
description.textEn: Located in the heart of Nanxun New Town, Four Points by Sheraton Huzhou, Nanxun is surrounded by scenic waterways. It sits close to Charity Park and Jinxiang Lake Park. Boasting convenient transportation, the hotel is near Nanxun High-Speed Railway Station, while Nanxun Ancient Town is only a 10-minute drive away. The hotel offers 234 classic yet modern guest rooms and suites with well-appointed amenities and stunning city or river views, perfect for guests to relax and enjoy a soothing stay. The MESH serves a diverse selection of delicacies, ranging from light meals and casual bites to craft beer and snacks, satisfying your taste buds throughout the day. The hotel provides 1,816 sqm of flexible event space, including a 570-sqm grand ballroom, a 200-sqm multi-function meeting room and a 300-sqm outdoor lawn. Our professional catering team is committed to providing exceptional service to ensure successful meetings and gatherings, making the hotel an ideal venue for all types of events.

description.textZh: Deqing Marriott Hotel was designed by TDG (Touchdesigngroup), based on the concept of ‘The Silhouette and Reflection of the Nature’. Integrating local culture and natural elements, the hotel features modern design and a heartfelt approach to hospitality.
description.textEn: Deqing Marriott Hotel is a classic premium hotel under Marriott International.Newly opened in 2025. It is nestled at the foot of the picturesque Mogan Mountain in Deqing, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Located in the Geographic Information Town, it is adjacent to the Deqing International Conference Center (the venue of the United Nations World Geographic Information Conference). It is close to shopping centers, offering unparalleled convenience for shopping and dining. Whether you are on a business trip or traveling to enjoy the beautiful scenery in China, it is an excellent choice for accommodation.

description.textZh: 湖州南浔万豪酒店坐落于南浔城市新区，酒店外部建筑设计以大象为灵感，与南浔特有的“四象八牛”财富文化相互呼应，成为湖州南浔的城市新地标。酒店地理位置优越，交通便捷，距离湖州南浔高铁站仅2公里，距离著名的南浔古镇景区仅5.5公里。酒店拥有259间精致典雅的客房，设有别具特色的象顶中餐厅，贡厨全日餐厅和大堂酒廊，为宾客呈现非凡的味蕾盛宴。酒店的24小时健身中心、室内恒温泳池将为宾客提供更多轻松休闲的居旅体验。此外，湖州南浔万豪酒店拥有多元化的宴会会议活动空间，能够满足婚礼庆典、商务会议、私人派对等多种活动需求。作为各类聚会的理想之选，湖州南浔万豪酒店将为您的旅程增添华彩篇章。
description.textEn: Huzhou Marriott Hotel Nanxun, situated in Nanxun District, Huzhou. The hotel's striking elephant-inspired architectural design, nestled in Nanxun's emerging district, is poised to become the city's newest landmark. Boasting a convenient transportation, the hotel is only 2 kilometers away from Huzhou Nanxun High-speed Railway Station and 5.5 kilometers away from Nanxun Ancient Town. The hotel features 259 exquisitely appointed guest rooms and an array of distinctive dining venues, including Goji Kitchen+Bar and Xiang Ding Chinese Restaurant, offering guests an exceptional gastronomic experience. Additionally, leisure amenities include a 24-hour fitness center, indoor heated pool. Whether you're look for an appropriate venues for business meetings, banquets, or weddings, our hotel offers versatile event spaces to suit every occasion.

records.name_en: Sheraton Huzhou Taihu Lake Hot Spring Resort & Spa
records.name_zh: 湖州太湖喜来登温泉度假酒店

description.textZh: 湖州太湖喜来登温泉度假酒店位于风景优美的浙江省，欢迎莅临下榻，探索身心放松的美妙度假体验。酒店采用别具匠心的环形设计，共 27 层，矗立在太湖之畔，附近有着古老的水乡、石桥、重建的历史街区以及从大运河引水的水道，堪称一处理想的旅行目的地。探索完这片区域之后，可以惬享酒店的精选设施，包括酒店内日间水疗中心、无边泳池、沙滩，以及延伸进太湖的定制婚礼小岛。一边品尝手工鸡尾酒一边欣赏美丽湖景，或是在酒店的水滨餐厅享用休闲美食。优雅的客房内配备时尚大理石浴室和免费无线网络，助您尽情放松身心。酒店拥有宽敞的大宴会厅和先进的会议设施，适宜举办各种活动。不论您缘何至此，我们都热诚期待您的光临！
description.textEn: Find the relaxing vacation experience at Sheraton Huzhou Taihu Lake Hot Spring Resort and Spa our revolutionary new hotel in Chinas scenic Zhejiang Province. Featuring a unique ring shaped 27 story structure placed over the waters of Tai Lake, our specially designed hotel boasts an ideal destination near ancient water towns, stone bridges, restored historic districts and waterways fed by the Grand Canal. After exploring the area, discover our hotel's premium amenities, including an onsite day spa, an infinity pool, a private beach and a custom wedding island that extends into Tai Lake. Experience beautiful water views as you sip on handcrafted cocktails or enjoy a leisurely meal in one of our waterfront restaurants. Unpack in elegant rooms with sleek marble bathrooms and complimentary WiFi. If visiting for event planning reasons, take advantage of our spacious Grand Ballroom and state of the art meeting facilities. Whatever your reason for visiting we look forward to welcoming you.

records.name_en: Grand New Century Resort, Changxing, A Tribute Portfolio Resort
records.name_zh: 长兴开元名都臻品之选度假酒店

description.textZh: 长兴开元名都臻品之选度假酒店，由长兴煤山持恩青年科技创业园发展有限公司旅游分公司投资兴建，由万豪国际集团管理的高端度假酒店，是集客房、餐饮、会议、休闲娱乐、户外运动于一体的高端度假酒店。是集客房、餐饮、会议、休闲娱乐、户外运动于一体的高端度假酒店。酒店坐拥400亩私享北湖和南湖 ，优越的自然环境让你感受「采菊东篱下 ，悠然见南山」 的生活意境。
description.textEn: Integrating accommodation, dining, banquet facilities, entertainment, and outdoor activities, the hotel occupies 400 acres of mountainous terrain with exclusive access to two lakes and bamboo forest. Nestled along the lakeshore and nestled against mountain slopes, the architecture blends Jiangnan water-town aesthetics with local cultural motifs. hotel has 152 guestrooms in wide variety of size and themes catering different needs. Selected rooms feature oversized courtyards, private terraces, and hot spring pools. Hotel offers wide variety of entertainment options including indoor playroom, outdoor adventure playground, KTV rooms, mahjong rooms, pets park, and hot springs. Hotel also has a variety of venues for events - outdoor 2,000㎡ lawn, a multifunctional banquet hall (325㎡ pillar-free design) and three auxiliary function rooms suitable for conferences, weddings, birthday celebrations, and themed parties.‌

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: 吉安福朋喜来登酒店坐落城市核心，以现代旅居美学延续庐陵风华, 交通便利, 地理位置优越。酒店拥有 136 间舒适且装饰典雅的客房、配备两间设施齐全的多功能会议室、全新“玩啤食社”融合古庐陵今吉安的特色美食及当地精选啤酒为您定制惬意的味蕾享受。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi可助您轻松社交、云速办公。酒店还设有 24 小时健身房、自助洗衣房, 提供便利的停车服务, 拥有大型地面停车场、新能源充电桩及地下停车场。秉承 “简而不凡” 的品牌承诺, 吉安福朋喜来登酒店将是您旅途下榻的理想之选！
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Ji'an is situated in the city's core. It carries forward the timeless charm of Luling through modern hospitality aesthetics, boasting convenient transportation and a prime location. The hotel features 136 comfortable and elegantly decorated guest rooms, along with two fully-equipped multi-functional meeting rooms. Its brand-new "The Mesh" blends the distinctive cuisines of ancient Luling and contemporary Ji'an with locally selected beers, crafting a delightful taste experience tailored just for you. Complimentary Wi-Fi, available throughout the entire hotel, enables easy socializing and efficient online work. The hotel also offers a 24-hour fitness center, a self-service laundry, and convenient parking facilities, including a large ground parking lot, new energy vehicle charging piles, and an underground parking lot. Upholding the brand promise of "Simplicity with Distinction", Four Points by Sheraton Ji'an is your ideal choice for accommodation during your travels!

records.name_zh: 吉安安福万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Located in Ji 'an Anfu which is known as the "A blessed land in central Jiangxi",the Fairfield by Marriott Ji 'an Anfu features 108 elaborately designed guest rooms and buffet breakfast，it inspires the guests with an elevating experience in Ji 'an Anfu.
description.textEn: The Fairfield by Marriott Ji 'an Anfu is located in the historic Anfu County of Ji 'an City, Jiangxi Province. It is close to the Dongshan Wenta and near the bustling business district, with convenient transportation. The hotel offers a variety of flexible open Spaces for guests' business travel experiences. The hotel has a total of 108 elaborately designed guest rooms, ranging from 35 to 50 square meters. The interior design features warm earth tones and a modern, simple style, creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere for guests. The addition of freehand and abstract wall paintings not only enhances the simplicity of the rooms but also adds a sense of design.

records.name_zh: 台山昌大昌万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店拥有191间装修简约时尚的客房，房型覆盖大床房、双床房和套房。超高层的大堂装修风格、线条流畅，极速网络全覆盖。同时配有万枫小铺，实现随时便携购物的乐趣。万枫餐厅位于酒店3楼，享有130个可同时就餐的餐位，提供品类丰富的中西式美食，满足宾客每日能量。位于3楼24小时开放的健身中心，双面自然采光全落地窗，配备高科技健身设备，让出行在外的您无时无刻体验健康活力的生活。同层设有自助洗衣房，配置多台快速洗衣干衣设备，助您旅途无忧。酒店拥有200平方多功能宴会厅，位于3楼，配备先进的视听设备，无柱空间设计，可分隔为2个不同面积的会议室，满足不同的会务需求。
description.textEn: Hotel have 191 rooms with a modern and simple design, covering king rooms, twin rooms, and suites.A modern and minimalist lobby with smooth lines, featuring a self-service kiosk and high-speed internet access throughout all public areas.The Fairfield Restaurant on the third floor with 130 dining seats offering a rich variety of Chinese and Western cuisines.A fitness center on the third floor with natural light from full-length windows, high-tech fitness equipment, and 24-hour availability.A self-service laundry room on the third floor with multiple high-speed washing and drying machines.A multifunctional banquet hall on the third floor with advanced audio-visual equipment and a 200-square-meter pillar-free space that can be divided into two conference rooms of different sizes.These facilities and equipment are designed to provide guests with a comfortable and convenient stay, ensuring that every aspect of their experience is taken care of.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Jiangmen Downtown
records.name_zh: 江门市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: The Courtyard by Marriott Jiangyin features modern design and decor, as well as a simple and elegant atmosphere. All stylish contemporary guest rooms are equipped with user-friendly work areas, high-speed Internet connections, and high-definition TV.
description.textEn: The Courtyard by Marriott Jiangyin features modern design and decor, as well as a simple and elegant atmosphere. All stylish contemporary guestrooms are equipped with user-friendly work areas, high-speed Internet connections, and high-definition television to make guests feel right at home. Cheng Café all-day dining restaurant and a contemporary lounge provide guests with authentic local flavors and extensive international gourmet options. The Lounge located on the first floor, is an ideal place for business meetings or relaxation, with a selection of teas, coffees and sweets during the day and savory snacks at night.

description.textZh: 江阴黄嘉喜来登酒店位于无锡，提供宽敞的客房和套房、热门餐饮选择和温馨服务，欢迎商务和休闲宾客莅临入住。这家尊尚酒店客房配有精致非凡的床上用品、迷你冰箱、宽大的办公桌、免费 Wi-Fi 和 24 小时客房送餐服务。行政楼层客房和套房则配备免费饮料等特别设施。许多客房都可饱览广阔花园的优美风景。酒店宾客可随意使用我们的迷人泳池、现代化健身房和放松身心的水疗中心。我们的餐厅备受欢迎，供应品类丰富的美味佳肴，包括地道的中式、日式和国际风味美食。该酒店也是一个国际化会议中心，内设超过 2,787 平方米的会议空间和多功能厅，还有雅致的活动草坪。专业的活动团队可确保每次聚会圆满成功。如果您想恣意探索一番，我们无锡的酒店邻近江阴的夜生活场所、黄山湖公园和江阴中山公园，可为您提供诸多便利。
description.textEn: Located in Wuxi, Sheraton Jiangyin Hotel welcomes business and leisure guests traveling in China with spacious rooms and suites, popular dining options and warm service. Recharge in 5-star accommodations that feature premium bedding, mini-refrigerators, ample desks, complimentary Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service. Club-level rooms and suites benefit from special amenities, including complimentary beverages. Many rooms feature gorgeous views of our expansive gardens. Hotel guests can take advantage of our impressive pool, modern gym and relaxing spa. Our popular restaurants feature an array of culinary options, including authentic Chinese, Japanese and international fare. The hotel is an international conference center with more than 30,000 square feet of meeting space and function rooms, in addition to our graceful event lawn. The professional events team can make every gathering a success. When you are ready to explore, our Wuxi hotel is near Jiangyin nightlife, Huangshan Lake Park and Jiangyin Zhongshan Park.

description.textZh: 嘉兴福朋喜来登酒店位于嘉兴市中心，地理位置优越，邻近江南年华商业中心、八佰伴、万达广场、运河公园和三塔公园。驱车十余分钟即可抵达南湖景区、月河历史街区等热门景点。面向京杭大运河自然景观，同时提供游船服务，一览京杭大运河、南湖沿线美景。酒店拥有242间宽敞的客房，每间面积超过45平方米，为您提供宽敞的住宿空间，饱览京杭大运河和城市美景。每间双床房皆搭配两张1.5米宽的“福朋舒适之床”。餐厅设施包括宜客乐全日餐厅、禾果蔬食餐厅和中餐包厢，满足您多样化的用餐需求。与三五好友相聚大堂吧，畅饮醇饮优选（Best Brews™）计划的当地精酿啤酒, 小酌一杯，微醺一刻。此外，酒店还提供包括健身中心、室外游泳池等康体设施，给您非同凡响的入住体验。酒店还拥有800平米无柱式宴会厅及8个大小不同的多功能厅，满足不同的活动需求，是举办商务会议及大型宴会的理想之地。嘉兴福朋喜来登酒店将便捷、时尚与贴心的服务融合，是您的理想下榻之地。
description.textEn: Strategically located in the heart of Jiaxing, Four Points by Sheraton Jiaxing offers easy access to landmarks such as Yaohan Mall, Wanda Plaza, Canal Park and Three Towers Park. South Lake and Yuehe Street are merely ten minutes away from the hotel. Overlooking the Grand Canal, the hotel also provides an opportunity for guests to enjoy scenic cruises.The hotel features 242 rooms, each measuring over 45m². Twin rooms are equipped with two signature "Four Points Comfort Beds," each 1.5 meters wide. Culinary enthusiasts can indulge cuisines at the Eatery or Root Restaurant(Vegan), where diverse menus cater to all tastes. After a busy day, guests may unwind at the Lobby Bar, savoring local craft beers from the Best Brews™.The hotel boasts a fitness center and an outdoor swimming pool, providing ample opportunities for relaxation. Additionally, the pillarless ballroom spanning 800m², along with eight multifunctional rooms of varying sizes, makes the hotel an ideal venue for business conferences and banquets.

description.textZh: 嘉兴万豪酒店拥有 347 间舒适的现代客房，均配有全景落地窗。半数酒店客房朝向中央商务区或大型湿地公园。每间客房均配有非凡的设施用品，从 Wi-Fi 到长绒毛床罩和棉质床单等豪华床品等非常齐全。还配有宽敞的大理石浴室和高清平面电视。酒店由闻名的酒店设计公司 PLD Consultants Hong Kong Co. Ltd.担纲设计，融汇万豪现代设计美学，同时突出别具一格的地方特色。酒店位于南湖区，地理位置优越；拥有面积超过 2,200 平米的会议空间，包括 2 间无柱式宴会厅和 7 间多功能厅，可分成 15 间会议室，满足您的不同需求。酒店 5 楼的室外露台为您的私人活动或精致婚礼提供更多场地选择。
description.textEn: Jiaxing Marriott Hotel in China offers 347 comfortable and modern guest rooms, all equipped with panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows. Half of our hotel guest rooms face the CBD, our biggest wetland park. Each room is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities and amenities ranging from WiFi to luxurious bedding with down comforters and cotton-rich linens. Our stunning accommodations in Jiaxing also boast spacious marble bathrooms and HD flat-panel TVs. Designed by the renowned hospitality architect PLD Consultants Hong Kong Co. Ltd., the hotel integrates Marriott Modern Design aesthetics while highlighting distinctively local touches. Located in the Nanhu District, the hotel is home to a total of 2200+ square meters of meeting space including 2 pillarless ballrooms and 7 function rooms that can be divided into 15 rooms to meet your different desires. The hotel's outdoor terrace located on the 5th floor provides more options for your private activities or an elaborate wedding in China.

description.textZh: 揭阳万豪酒店坐落于榕江新城核心地段，近赏榕江临水而居，遐观黄岐山依山纳翠。毗邻万达广场，距揭阳潮汕国际机场仅19公里，是商务出行和休闲旅游的理想之选。酒店拥有260间客房及套房，设计从潮汕文化中汲取灵感，岭南风情碧瓦朱甍，“潮”韵天成。满足休闲宾客对在地文化的探索需求。海内外宾客可前往具有潮汕风味的“万豪”中餐厅、中西融合的“贡厨”全日餐厅+酒廊，体验“潮”韵珍馐。1800㎡的可进车宴会厅及多功能会议室完善的商旅配套将成为揭阳豪华会务、宴会体验的不二之选。江景室内泳池及健身房，是自然与现代的完美交融，这里可遍赏江畔风光，焕新健康活力，亦是重塑揭阳生活方式的“潮”玩目的地。
description.textEn: Jieyang Marriott Hotel, nestled in Rongjiang New City, offers stunning views of Rongjiang River and Huangqi Mountain. Adjacent to Wanda Plaza and just 19 km from Jieyang Chaoshan International Airport, it's perfect for business and leisure travelers. Featuring 260 rooms blending Chaoshan culture with Lingnan style, it combines tradition with modern elegance.Ideal for cultural exploration, dining options include "MAN HO" for Chaoshan cuisine and "Goji" Kitchen & Bar for Eastern-Western fusion.With an 1800 sqm banquet hall, versatile meeting rooms, an indoor pool with river views, and a fitness center, it's the ideal venue for luxury events and relaxation.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Jinan, High-Tech Zone
records.name_zh: 济南高新区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: The hotel is located in Jinan, the "City of Springs," and features 218 well-appointed guestrooms with diverse styles. Combined with its distinctive dining services, it offers guests a high-quality hospitality experience.
description.textEn: Inspired by the "elegance of the Spring City and the vitality of modernity," the Four Points by Sheraton Jinan High-Tech Zone,dedicated to offering business and leisure travelers a delightful experience that combines humanistic warmth with contemporary style. Nestled in the heart of Jinan’s eastern new urban center, the hotel boasts convenient transportation, with just 30-minute drive to iconic attractions like Baotu Spring and Daming Lake. Its proximity to the Olympic Sports Center and the central business district makes it an ideal starting point for exploring the "mountain-water-spring city."The 218 guest rooms embody the "Ink-Wash Spring Rhyme" design theme, artfully integrating Jinan’s spring water elements with an industrial modern aesthetic. Floor-to-ceiling windows offer stunning views of the high-tech zone’s glittering skyline, while the interplay of wood textures and metallic lines within the rooms echoes the timeless dialogue between the old city’s cobblestone paths and modern skyscrapers.

description.textZh: 济南喜来登酒店坐落于济南中央商务区核心地带，地理位置非常优越，步行可达奥体中心，周边配套齐全包括万象城、融创茂、山东博物馆及美术馆，是商务出行与休闲度假的理想之选。酒店拥有410间客房，包括48平方米的宽敞客房与96平方米的豪华套房。每间房均配备甜梦之床、干湿分离卫浴及浴缸，全景落地窗可尽览璀璨灯光秀。您亦可在22楼行政酒廊享受欢乐时光的同时俯瞰“泉城”繁华城景。酒店设有室内外双泳池、24小时健身中心以及一个静谧户外草坪让您畅享休闲时光。更有正宗中餐、豪华自助餐与精致日料等多元餐饮选择。1200平方米无柱大宴会厅及灵活多变的多功能厅，是您举办会议、婚礼及各类活动的优选之地。
description.textEn: Sheraton Jinan Hotel is located in Jinan’s CBD, within walking distance of the Olympic Sports Center and surrounded by MixC, Sunac Land, Shandong Museum and Art Museum – ideal for both executive retreats and leisure travelers. The hotel offers 410 rooms, including 48 sqm spacious guest rooms and 96 sqm luxuriously appointed suites. All feature the Sweet Sleeper™ bed, a separate wet‑dry bathroom with bathtub, and floor‑to‑ceiling windows showcasing stunning light shows. You can also unwind with happy hour at the 22nd floor Executive' Lounge, overlooking the vibrant cityscape. Unique highlights include indoor and outdoor pools, a 24‑hour fitness center and a tranquil outdoor lawn. Savor an array of culinary delights, including authentic Chinese cuisine, sumptuous buffets and refined Japanese fare. A 1,200 sqm grand ballroom and versatile function rooms make it a premier venue for conferences, weddings and special events in Jinan.

description.textZh: As the first hotel with the brand of Fairfield By Marriott in Jingdezhen, we are always ready to welcome you to our thoughtfully designed guest rooms with plenty of room to work and relax.
description.textEn: As the first hotel with the brand of Fairfield By Marriott in Jingdezhen, the hotel not only provide outstanding service for an easy and comfortable stay at an exceptional value and also we are always ready to welcome you to our thoughtfully designed guest rooms with plenty of room to work and relax. Free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel will keep you connected during your stay and our fitness center will help you stay on track. Spread out in our vibrant lobby with spaces to gather, relax and work. Jump-start each day with our breakfast. You will always find the courteous service you deserve plus all the little things you expect from Fairfield by Marriott during your stay.

records.name_zh: 西双版纳福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 澜沧江畔，雨林里，凤凰于飞，西双版纳福朋喜来登酒店作为度假型酒店，位于西双版纳景洪市清泉路，周边配套齐全，附近景点林立，交通便捷，且拥有极佳的地理位置，15分钟车程便可到达西双版纳高铁站及市中心，20分钟车程便可到达嘎洒机场，距离告庄西双景、星光夜市车程10分钟。福朋喜来登酒店将高端理念、文化艺术植于空间万象之中，开启以雨林为幕与空间对话的旅程，打造符合时代潮流生活方式的城市地标级艺术空间。酒店拥有198间客房及套房，客房内，现代时尚的设计风格与经典实用的设施巧妙融合，营造出轻松舒适的氛围。每间客房均配备舒适床品、55英寸液晶电视、独立淋浴间，以及免费高速无线网络，满足当代宾客的多元需求。宾客还可通过万豪旅享家手机应用程序（Marriott Bonvoy APP）办理电子房卡、快速入住及退房等多项便捷服务，尽享舒适高效体验。酒店的餐饮设施致力于为宾客的旅途增添地道风味。位于一层的玩啤食社 (THE MESH)全日制餐厅提供一系列西式及亚洲风味自助美食，宾客可以在此品尝环球海鲜及时令美馔、 咖啡、小食以及由品牌标志性的“醇饮优选(Best Brews®)”计划甄选的当地精酿啤酒，尽情享受轻松惬意的休闲时光。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 西双版纳云投喜来登大酒店

description.textZh: 西双版纳云投喜来登大酒店坐落于嘎洒温泉小镇的核心地带，周围环绕着郁郁葱葱的热带花园。门前古寨，门后山河，佛寺与酒店毗邻，可方便抵达各个文化、娱乐和知名景点，如原始森林公园、基诺山寨、野象谷、流沙寨、曼弄枫等自然景观与民族风情两优融合的风景胜地。这里是您惬意感受热带雨林风光，体验傣寨风情的理想之地。酒店距离景洪市中心约11公里, 距离西双版纳国际机场约6公里。酒店拥有326间宽敞的客房和套房，视野开阔，纵览美景。两间餐厅和一间大堂吧提供中外美食及本地饕餮，犒赏食客的味蕾。酒店还设有2,478平米的多功能会议空间，其中包括面积1,070平米的大宴会厅，10个独立的会议室，还有一个婚庆亭，灵活契合会议客户的所有需求。此外，酒店还设有健身中心和室内外游泳池。西双版纳云投喜来登大酒店定能让您收获精彩旅程。
description.textEn: Located in the heart of the Hot Spring district of Gasa Town which is surrounded by lush tropical garden. The Dai ancient village in front of the hotel, the mountains and rivers behind the hotel, the Buddhist temple and the hotel are adjacent, Sheraton Grand Xishuangbanna Hotel provides effortless access to the city’s cultural, entertainment and famous attractions such as the Primitive Forest Park, Kino Village, Wild Elephant Valley, and the scenic spot of Liushazhai, Mannongfeng, where the fusion of natural beauty and ethnic charm is remarkable. It is an ideal place for you to enjoy the tropical rainforest scenery and well experience the charm of the Dai ethnic village. It is about 11 kilometers from downtown Jinghong and approximately 6 kilometers from Xishuangbanna International Airport. Featuring 326 spacious guest rooms and suites, which boasts great views and natural sunlight. Guests can embark on a culinary journey, choosing from 2 restaurants & lobby bar serving authentic Chinese & Foreign cuisines.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Xuancheng, Jingxian
records.name_zh: 宣城泾县福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 宣城泾县福朋喜来登酒店坐落于景⾊优美的皖南地区，酒店地处泾县核心城区，紧邻泾川大道及桃花潭路。酒店距泾县⾼铁站仅5公⾥，优越的地理位置为宾客创造便利的出⾏条件。从酒店出发，宾客可以快捷前往桃花潭风景区，领略诗仙流连的桃花潭风光；亦或前往皖南川藏线自驾，感受皖南天险的沿途美景；或者前往宣纸博物馆，感受人类非遗带来的震撼。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Xuancheng Jingxian provides 195 well designed guest rooms, including various types such as comfortable premium king rooms, twin rooms, and suites for different guests. We provide 780 m² Grand Ball Room,540m² Function Room and 3 meeting rooms. Hotel provides 2 restaurants, The MESH & TaoJing Chinese Restaurant. The Fitness Center provides Matrix™️ fitness equipment.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Jingzhou Downtown
records.name_zh: 荆州城市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsa to sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Hengdian embodies the brand's philosophy of "simple sophistication," seamlessly blending Rothenburg-inspired German themes with the needs of modern business travelers to create a uniquely stylish and comfortable retreat for guests.
description.textEn: The Fairfield by Marriott Hengdian Hotel draws inspiration from the quaint German town of Rothenburg, incorporating classic architectural elements such as half-timbered structures and arched windows to create an immersive German-style streetscape. Located within Hengdian World Studios—a national 5A-level tourist attraction—the hotel is adjacent to Highway 40-S, facing Bamian Mountain. Its strategic position ensures easy access within the four-hour economic zone of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Fujian, and Jiangxi, making it ideal for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel features 343 guest rooms that embody Fairfield’s "simple sophistication" philosophy, with oak-toned interiors, Serta mattresses, smart entertainment systems, and multi-functional furniture. The LOFT duplex suites enhance the stay experience with their spacious high-ceiling design.

records.name_zh: 浦江鑫广万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Invested by Shanghai Xinguang Technology Development Group Co., LTD., operated and managed by Marriott International Group，Bring extraordinary travel experience to guests.
description.textEn: The hotel has 216 rooms and suites, each equipped with high-definition LCD TV, high-speed wireless network and other facilities, making you feel convenient and comfortable. Wanfeng Restaurant provides a healthy and rich breakfast to help you wake up an energetic day. You can also help yourself to buy snacks and drinks as a takeaway light meal in the all-weather Wanfeng shop. The fitness center is a 24-hour system, with stretching area, functional area, aerobic area and strength area. It is equipped with advanced fitness equipment from American Lijian Life Fitness to help you stay active during the journey.

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels & Resorts®, it's our mission to make every business trip a pleasure and every vacation the trip of a lifetime. Enjoy amenity-filled guest rooms, superb dining, exemplary meeting facilities and our time-honored 'spirit to serve®'.
description.textEn: At Marriott Hotels & Resorts®, it's our mission to make every business trip a pleasure and every vacation the trip of a lifetime. Enjoy amenity-filled guest rooms, superb dining, exemplary meeting facilities and our time-honored 'spirit to serve®'.

description.textZh: 酒店的198间客房和套房优雅舒适，供您畅享一夜酣眠。两间无柱式宴会厅面积分别为1,588平米和950平米左右，可分别容纳约1,200人和900人，还有六间不同大小的会议室，供您惬意欢聚。随着一杯香浓的咖啡滑入喉中，在从白天到黑夜的时光流转中，&More by Sheraton大堂吧在咖啡吧、酒吧和市场的不同角色中灵活转换。这间全日西餐厅供应各式中西美食，为您打造丰富多彩的餐饮体验。Yue中餐厅设有13间中式包厢，无论是地道粤菜还是雅致的淮扬菜，均秉承中餐文化的精髓，为您打造浦江风情的质朴纯味体验。
description.textEn: The hotel has 198 rooms and suites, which are elegant and comfortable, and have a good sleep. Two pillarless banquet halls, 1588m² and 950m², can accommodate 1200 people and 900 people respectively, and have six meeting rooms with different specifications, so that you can get together without worry. Set coffee bar, bar and market as one &More by Sheraton lobby bar, from day to night, time passes, a cup goes down your throat, and it turns a thousand times. Full-time western restaurant, a delicious blend of Chinese and western food, experience diversified dining. Yue Chinese Restaurant and 13 Chinese private rooms, whether authentic Cantonese cuisine or elegant Huaiyang cuisine, are all inherited from the essence of Chinese food culture, creating a pure taste with ingenuity, with a taste of Pujiang on the tip of the tongue.

description.textZh: 晋中喜来登酒店落子晋中市榆次区核心商圈，融国际奢雅与三晋古韵，为商旅菁英和旅行爱好者打造高品质旅居体验。酒店拥有 236 间精致客房与套房，全系配备汉斯格雅卫浴及 Gilchrist & Soames 高端洗护，以细节诠释品质。餐饮涵盖食光全日餐厅、悦厨中餐厅、&more by sheraton咖啡吧与23楼行政酒廊，满足多元味蕾需求。近2000 平米灵动宴会空间含 680平米无柱宴会厅，搭配高清 LED 屏、高端音响设施及专业会务团队，一站式承接商务会议、婚宴等各类活动。
description.textEn: Sheraton Jinzhong is located in the core business district of Yuci District, Jinzhong City, integrating international luxury and elegance with the time-honored charm of Shanxi. It is dedicated to creating a high-quality accommodation experience for business elites and travel enthusiasts.The hotel features 236 exquisitely designed guest rooms and suites, all equipped with Hansgrohe sanitary ware and premium Gilchrist & Soames bath amenities, embodying superior quality in every detail. Its dining options include the Sunshine All-Day Dining Restaurant, a specialty bar and the Executive Lounge on the 23rd Floor, catering to diverse culinary demands. Boasting a flexible 2,000-square-meter banquet space with a 700-square-meter pillarless grand ballroom, the hotel is furnished with high-definition LED screens, top-tier audio equipment and a professional conference service team, providing one-stop services for various events such as business conferences and wedding banquets.

description.textZh: In downtown with easy access to the Central Business District, our hotel offers comfort and convenience for business and leisure travelers.
description.textEn: Sheraton Jinzhou Hotel is located in CBD of Jinzhou, close to Jinzhou International Exhibition Center and commercial institutions. The advantage of transportation convenience gets you to Jinzhou airport and every station.

description.textZh: 酒店拥有 187 间舒适雅致的湖景、城景客房及套房，其中大床房 126 间、双床房 50 间、套房 11 间，凭窗尽揽南湖旖旎风光与浔阳繁华城景。酒店设有 1 间精致西餐厅、1 间格调大堂吧及 1 间喜来登行政俱乐部，为商务洽谈、休闲小聚与贵宾礼遇提供雅致之选。酒店更配备 逾 2000 平方米灵动宴会空间，可灵活承接高端婚宴、社交盛典与各类商务会议。酒店以豪华、舒适与温馨的旅居环境，为眼光独到的商旅及度假宾客提供细致入微、贴心周到的个性化服务。宾客在畅享现代便捷设施的同时，亦可沉浸于浔阳古城意蕴悠长的优雅氛围之中。
description.textEn: Sheraton Jiujiang features 187 spacious guestrooms and suites, most featuring spectacular lake views through floor-to-ceiling windows, Each room enhances guests' experience with premium sleep and bath amenities. 55"LCD televisions and high-speed Internet access.

description.textZh: 九寨沟万怡酒店拥有330间客房及套房，秉承万怡品牌舒适时尚的理念，为热情进取的宾客打造富有活力和创造性的入住空间，帮助宾客激发热情、保持连接。所有房间均配备了灵活便利的工作与休闲空间，无线网络覆盖、高清电视以及符合人体工程学设计的沙发等， 宾客可以在宽敞的客房尽享放松休息时光，再次活力满满地进行旅途，或是尽情探索自然风光的特殊魅力。九寨沟万怡酒店为宾客提供丰富的用餐选择， 全日餐厅万荟轩为宾客提供品种多样的自助早餐，可同时容纳188人用餐；午餐及晚餐时段则成为融合世界各地美食的时尚餐厅，提供川菜、地方才及独具主厨特色的美食，通过应季的食材和厨师的技艺，为宾客提供美食的盛宴。大堂吧供应各式精美甜点、咖啡和鸡尾酒，是商务会面及休闲社交的理想选择。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Jiuzhaigou is located in the core of Jiuzhaigou County, adjacent to Jiuzhaigou National Park, Huanglong Scenic and Historic Interest Area and other world-famous scenic spots. Its wise andenergetic brand culture, modern and simple quality design, meticulous and thoughtful humanized service, for leisure and unique travelers to provide a unique stay experience.The hotel has 330 elegantly designed guest rooms with modern aesthetic style, flexible leisure area and responsive guest control to awaken your infinite vitality during your stay. Guests can dine at the hotel's all-day restaurant, Pavilion and lobby Bar, or relax in the state-of-the-art fitness center.

description.textZh: As the first Marriott brand in Jiuzhaigou County, Its wise and energetic brand culture, modern and simple quality design, meticulous and thoughtful humanized service, for leisure and unique travelers to provide a unique stay experience.
description.textEn: Delta Hotel by Marriott Jiuzhaigou is located in the core of Jiuzhaigou County, adjacent to Jiuzhaigou National Park, Huanglong Scenic and Historic Interest Area and other world-famous scenic spots. As the first Marriott brand in Jiuzhaigou County, Its wise and energetic brand culture, modern and simple quality design, meticulous and thoughtful humanized service, for leisure and unique travelers to provide a unique stay experience. The hotel has a total of 268 elegantly designed guest rooms, a perfect fusion of Tibetan style and modern simplicity. The choice of wood veneer and stone on the wall, as well as Tibetan patterns in visible places, all highlight the Tibetan and Qiang customs, conveying the wish of maintaining local peace and protecting natural ecology.

records.name_zh: 日赛谷丽思卡尔顿隐世酒店

description.textZh: 日赛谷丽思卡尔顿隐世酒店邻近九寨沟联合国教科文组织世界遗产，是一处超凡脱俗的庄园酒店，在这里，每个角落都流露着发自内心的真诚关怀与匠心巧思。酒店坐落在九寨沟群山之中，酒店建筑由 WATG 设计，室内设计由 Jaya Ibrahim 操刀，景观设计由 John Pettigrew 担纲。酒店建筑与周边环境巧妙融合在一起，用材、配色、效果、配件和古玩等选择均能体现当地特色文化。酒店拥有 87 间设计精美的独栋别墅，周边有众多藏族古寨和壮美森林山川，酒店设有多处观景点，供宾客一年四季畅览谷中迷人景色。酒店设有众多水疗设施，为您打造静谧闲适的宜人氛围。
description.textEn: Rissai Valley, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, a magnificent rare estate situated in close proximity to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou, at the ends of the earth, protected and unspoiled, where the heartfelt care and craft of individuals is felt at every turn.Nestled amid in the rolling mountains of Jiuzhaigou, the building is designed by WATG while the late Jaya Ibrahim crafted the interior designs and John Pettigrew oversees the landscape design. Blending the architecture into the surrounding environment, the Reserve expresses a strong local connection in the selection of materials, colors, finishes, accessories, antiques etc. Featuring well designed 87 stand-alone villas which are overlooking the surrounding forest mountainous sceneries and steps away from ancient Tibetan villages, the Reserve offers plenty of lookout points for our guest to enjoy the stunning view of four seasons in the valley has to offer. Our extensive SPA facilities provide a serene environment of tranquility.

description.textZh: 开封大宏喜来登酒店坐落于古都开封，位于城市新区核心位置。高铁开封北站及城市轻轨宋城路站分布酒店附近。酒店以168米建筑高度刷新城市天际线，荣获开封“十大新地标”称号。滨湖公园一街之隔，与万达广场交相辉映，靠近开封博物馆、美术馆等城市文化地标。去往清明上河园、大宋武侠城等热门景点交通便捷。开封大宏喜来登酒店共设231间/套客房，由豪华客房到尊豪套房共7种房型组成，客房设计突显宋风新韵，全部房型均配备独立浴缸，套房内更有临窗圆形浴缸，42m²至128m²的酒店客房，均设落地大窗，凭窗远眺即可欣赏滨湖公园绮丽湖景或开封新区繁华城景。下榻即可免费体验的室内恒温泳池位于5层，自然采光且视野开阔，健身中心配备有氧与力量型训练器材，瑜伽房等康体设施让您在此舒展身心。盛宴标帜餐厅提供国际化的自助美食与开封本地菜品，琳琅满目的特色档口让您感“味”世界。采悦轩中餐厅擅长本地豫菜、新派川菜与精致粤菜，为您提供各式佳肴美馔与绿色料理。大堂酒廊供应现磨咖啡、鲜榨果汁以及各类酒精饮料，美味的甜品，精致的下午茶，优雅的环境为您创造旅途中的会聚之所。开封大宏喜来登酒店共拥有近1,500平米灵活多变的会议与多功能空间。其中1,100平米的挑高7米无柱大宴会厅，可同时容纳1,000位宾客。酒店还拥有其他6个大小规模不等的会议室，以满足不同需求的会议与宴会。
description.textEn: Sheraton Kaifeng Hotel provides 236 Guest Rooms, 42 ㎡ deluxe Room overlooks breathtaking new city view or lake view, brings you wonderful Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience.The Feast which is on the the floor serves international favorites and local dishes 24/7.Guests can enjoy the Hangzhou cuisine or local dishes in our YUE restaurant. The lobby lounge is a elegant gathering spot for you to try some fresh coffee, cocktails, delicate dessert and light meals. Guests will be able to relax in our fully equipped Gym, Yoga Room, and an indoor heated swimming pool. The Sheraton Lounge with lake view is an ideal place for honored bonvoy members to enjoy exclusive check-in experience, special afternoon tea and happy hour, and make your stay more fulfill.

records.name_en: THE AMNIS, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Kaohsiung
records.name_zh: 高雄然一翡世之选酒店

description.textZh: 高雄然一翡世之选酒店由御盟集团携手台湾、日本与德国顶尖设计团队匠心打造，秉承豪华精选酒店品牌对在地精神与珍稀体验的追求，旨在演绎极致的旅行体验，并通过建筑与艺术语言，重新定义奢华酒店的无限可能。酒店仅接待十岁以上宾客入住与用餐，是全台首选的艺术奢华酒店，以水为灵感核心，从室内水景的声响到静谧的空间设计，打造出一处融合舒适、疗愈与重生意象的心灵寓所。酒店共设有146间宽敞客房，客房空间自18坪起，全景落地窗引入高雄城景光影。房内备有Mini Bar，细致呵护旅客的每一刻需求。墙面选用安格拉灰大理石，低调的灰韵映衬光影流转，勾勒出沉稳雅致的空间气韵；地坪铺设北美实木，赤足行走间感受质地与自然交织的静好时光。单层仅规划6至10间客房，兼顾隐私与宁静，更提供包层与包栋服务，满足对生活品质有所坚持的品味之选。值得一提的是，高雄然一翡世之选酒店是全台唯一艺术内容由独立策展机构——ALIEN Art Centre 金马宾馆当代美术馆所规划，致力于呈现艺术家的独特视野。 静谧而充满张力的惬意氛围，让旅人在疗愈的场域里感受艺术的自由与活力，展开一段艺术与自我发现的旅程。公共走道铺设时尚大师Giorgio Armani钟爱的瑞典Bolon编织地毯，步履其上轻盈宁静，行李滑行亦从容顺畅。全栋楼层采用25公分厚的隔音墙体设计，隔绝都市喧嚣，只为室内留住一片静谧。
description.textEn: Reserved exclusively for guests aged 10 and above, THE AMNIS is Taiwan’s foremost art-inspired luxury hotel, shaped by the essence of water—from the gentle murmur of indoor water features to the tranquil poise of its thoughtfully crafted interiors. As a Kaohsiung hotel, it offers a serene retreat where comfort, renewal, and quiet reflection naturally converge. Uniquely, THE AMNIS is the only Kaohsiung Taiwan hotel with its artistic content curated by contemporary art museum – The ALIEN Art Centre, dedicated to presenting the artist’s unique vision. A serene yet tension-filled atmosphere of ease invites the audience to experience the freedom and vitality of art within a healing space, making it an exceptional hotel in Qianzhen district, where guests embark on a journey of artistic and personal discovery.

description.textZh: 高雄万豪酒店耸立于爱河之心旁，傲视北高雄，是市区内一座魅力新地标。酒店地理位置优越，距离高雄国际机场约30分钟车程，与左营高铁站距离约15分钟车程，搭乘捷运也能轻松到达。绿意盎然、幅员辽阔的凹子底森林公园也在步行距离之内，堪称酒店的后花园。酒店拥有 700 间典雅宽敞的客房，为来到这个海洋之都的宾客提供温暖的避风港，安心休憩。选择多样的餐厅利用优质食材，在精致优雅的环境提供珍馐佳肴，一饱口福。全馆会议及宴会空间共 8,518 平方米（约 2,577 坪），设施设备齐全先进，无论是举行国际会议与浪漫婚礼，空间都可依活动需求灵活配置，事半功倍。健身中心配备最新的运动器材，另有室内温水游泳池、水疗池、维琪浴以及顶级 SPA，焕发身心。秉持优质服务，高雄万豪酒店投入了南台湾的热情与友善，为宾客传递如和煦阳光的待客之道。
description.textEn: Step into Kaohsiung Marriott Hotel in downtown and start your memorable adventure in the city. Our hotel in Kaohsiung Taiwan​ promises "Wonderful Hospitality. Always®" with 700 amenity-filled rooms, diverse on-site dining options, the largest banquet venues in Taiwan, outdoor wedding halls, a fitness center, a spa and indoor swimming pools. Our iconic venue space with capacity up to 2,000 participants is the largest banquet venue of Taiwan and perfect for business or social events. Guests will find themselves adjacent to the shopping mall, near the Sinshang Elementary School Station of Light Rail Transit (LRT) and Aozihdi MRT station. For those traveling abroad or from other cities, our Kaohsiung hotel is conveniently located just 30 minutes away from Kaohsiung International Airport and 15 minutes from Taiwan High-Speed Rail Zuoying Station. Make memories that will last a lifetime at Kaohsiung Marriott Hotel.

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms; a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests. With locally inspired three-meal-a-day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free Wi-Fi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive!

description.textZh: 库尔勒绿发万丽酒店坐落于古丝绸之路的繁华枢纽，位于发展迅速的鸿雁新区，交通便捷，距库尔勒机场约15分钟车程，距高铁站及市中心仅数公里，是通往罗布泊大峡谷、博斯腾湖和塔克拉玛干沙漠的理想驿站，更是探索这片多元土地的灵感起点。白天，在酒店领航员的引领下走进库尔勒的街巷深处，邂逅城市的在地魅力；夜晚，于万丽点亮的空间中展开即兴探索之旅。每一处设计、每一项体验，皆为你准备不期而至的灵感时刻。
description.textEn: Renaissance Hotels embody an inspired fusion of sophisticated style and immersive experiences, inviting guests into a world brimming with discovery. The brand’s design philosophy blends contemporary elegance with curated local character—where sleek lines, rich textures, and expressive materials set the tone. Every space features layered storytelling: modern artworks converse with handcrafted decor, and architectural gestures echo the heritage of their surroundings. Guests are not merely accommodated—they are sparked with curiosity, encouraged to pause, look closer, and uncover the unexpected in every detail.

description.textZh: 昆明德尔塔酒店的盛大启幕，标志着万豪德尔塔酒店品牌率先亮相中国云南的省会城市——昆明。酒店位于昆明经济技术开发区的核心商业区，驱车约40分钟即可抵达昆明长水国际机场和昆明南站。昆明德尔塔酒店秉承德尔塔品牌承诺，专注于宾客所需的核心设施与服务，为宾客带来轻松舒心的旅程。酒店设有639间精心设计的客房，处处展现品牌标志性的简洁美学理念，核心设施和用品配备齐全，包括免费Wi-Fi和便捷高效的工作空间。昆明德尔塔酒店的特别之处在于，它与昆明喜来登酒店邻近。两个万豪品牌的融合，让宾客能够享受额外的服务设施，比如餐厅、健身中心、游泳池、水疗中心和会议空间。
description.textEn: Delta Hotels by Marriott Kunming’s opening marks the debut of Delta Hotels by Marriott in the capital city of China’s Yunnan province. It is located in the commercial hub of Kunming Economic & Technology Development Zone and takes 40 minutes to drive to Kunming Changshui International Airport and Kunming South Railway Station.
