Delta Hotels by Marriott Kunming is determined to deliver the Delta Hotels’ promise to offer guests a frictionless journey by laser focusing on the truly meaningful elements that guests need during their stays. The new hotel features 639 thoughtfully designed guestrooms equipped with the brand’s signature clean aesthetics, as well as essential amenities including free Wi-Fi and productive workspaces. This new hotel is unique in that it is connected and shares facilities with Sheraton Kunming. The fusion of these two Marriott brands allows guests to take advantage of extra amenities such as the Sheraton Kunming’s restaurants, fitness center, swimming pool, spa and event space.

records.name_zh: 昆明新迎万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani Greek yogurt and bacon. Then add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_zh: 昆明西山万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 昆明西山万豪万枫酒店位于昆明西山区大商汇核心商圈的商鼎大厦，是万豪国际旗下中高端精选服务品牌，以“简约之美”为理念，为商务及休闲宾客打造高效、高性价比的旅居空间。酒店拥有186间现代经典客房，配置舒适床品、人体工学办公区与高速网络，满足差旅核心需求。配套聚焦高频刚需，设24小时健身中心、自助洗衣房及多功能会议室，契合商务出行与轻旅行节奏。每日提供中西式自助早餐，特设万枫小铺满足全天候补给，延续品牌标准化品质与便捷服务。地处广福路与前兴路交汇处，周边商业与交通便捷，快速可达滇池、西山森林公园等景点，轻松串联城市商务与自然体验。依托万豪旅享家会员体系，可享积分兑换与专属礼遇，是昆明城西兼具品质与效率的优选下榻之所。
description.textEn: It focuses on high-frequency essential services and is equipped with a 24-hour fitness center, a self-service laundry room and a small multi-functional meeting room, catering to business travel and light travel schedules. Daily, it offers Western and Chinese-style buffet breakfasts, and specially sets up the Wan Feng Shop to meet all-day supply needs, continuing the brand's standardized quality and convenient services. Located at the intersection of Guangfu Road and Qianxing Road, it enjoys convenient commercial and transportation facilities. It is easily accessible to scenic spots such as Dianchi Lake and Xishan Forest Park. It seamlessly connects urban business with natural experiences. Relying on the Marriott Rewards Club membership system, you can enjoy points redemption and exclusive benefits. It is the preferred accommodation choice in the west of Kunming, combining quality and efficiency.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Changshui Airport
records.name_zh: 昆明长水机场福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 在旅途的起点或终点，在商务与度假的间隙，您是否渴望一方既能抚慰身心、又能步履从容的天地？昆明长水机场福朋喜来登酒店距机场仅10-15分钟车程，专属接送机服务。步行3-5分钟可抵达美食与超市，人间烟火触手可及。50亩私密花园，四季如诗，避开了飞机航道，四季花木与果树交织成画。 曲径回廊、流水蜿蜒，嫩绿草坪和山石景观将尘嚣隔绝于外，独留一方静谧绿洲。私密空间，静谧至臻，能够进入房间的，唯有阳光，贝克洛高性能系统隔音窗搭配静音门和实体墙，阻隔了喧嚣，于无声处望云卷云舒。天然高端石材与木质家具奠定雅致基调。汉斯格雅卫浴，方寸间流淌着奢适的品质细节。心归自然，静谧栖息，无论您是商务客还是度假者，在这里，你能获得的是久违的松弛感，你能感受到的是自己很重要。昆明长水机场福朋喜来登酒店— 让每一次抵达，都成为身心的美好归处。
description.textEn: During the interval between business and vacation, do you long for a place that can soothe both body and mind while allowing you to move at a leisurely pace? The Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Changshui Airport is only a 10-15 minute drive from the airport, with exclusive pick-up and drop-off services. A 3-5 minute walk takes you to gourmet food and supermarkets.The 50-mu private garden is a poetic haven throughout the seasons, avoiding aircraft flight paths.Flowers and fruit trees interweave into a painting throughout the seasons.Only sunlight can enter the room. Beckelow high-performance soundproof windows, allowing you to watch clouds roll by in silence. Natural high-end stone and wooden furniture set an elegant tone. Hansgrohe bathroom fixtures exude luxurious quality details in every inch. Here you can regain the long-lost sense of relaxation and feel that you matter. The Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Changshui Airport let every arrival be a beautiful homecoming for body and soul.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Chenggong
records.name_zh: 昆明呈贡福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 昆明呈贡福朋喜来登酒店坐落于昆明市呈贡区春融街2030号春融锦苑C栋，拥有116间设计现代典雅的客房，为宾客提供舒适宜人的居停体验。酒店地理位置优越，交通便利。距离昆明高铁南站仅约5公里，毗邻地铁1号线支线的春融街站及市级行政中心清风站，步行约8分钟即可抵达，轻松实现双地铁便捷出行。酒店与吾悦广场仅一街之隔，充分满足宾客购物、餐饮与娱乐等多种消费需求。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming ChenggongLocated at Building C, Chunrong Jinyuan, 2030 Chunrong Street, Chenggong District, Kunming, features 116 modern and elegantly appointed guestrooms, offering a comfortable and pleasant stay for every guests.Benefiting from a prime location, the hotel ensures excellent connectivity. It is approximately 5 kilometers from Kunming South High-Speed Railway Station and provides easy access to two metro stations—Chunrong Street Station (Line 1 Branch) and Municipal Administrative Center Qingfeng Station—both within an 8-minute walk, allowing convenient travel via dual subway lines. Just across the street, Wuyue Plaza offers a variety of shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Dongfeng Square
records.name_zh: 昆明东风广场福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 昆明东风广场福朋喜来登酒店位于繁华的昆明中心区, 邻近恒隆广场、万象城、顺城等核心商务与休闲商圈, 坐拥城市景观。酒店拥有128间宽敞舒适的客房及套房, 内饰设计采用原木、大理石、皮革、金属等不同质感的材料, 并配以定制家具与灯饰造型, 营造出悠闲惬意又充满活力的空间感。每间房间均配备品牌特有的福朋舒适之床, 为您营造良好睡眠环境。大堂吧拥有别具福朋品牌特色的“醇饮优选”计划, 为您的休闲聚会提供宽敞雅致之所。玩啤食社全日制餐厅更可以让您品尝到世界各地精致美馔。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Dongfeng Square is located in the vibrant central area of Kunming, close to key business and leisure districts such as Henglong Plaza, MixC, and Shuncheng. The hotel offers stunning city views and features 128 spacious and comfortable rooms and suites. The interior design incorporates materials like wood, marble, leather, and metal, complemented by custom-made furniture and lighting, creating a relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere. Each room is equipped with the signature Four Points bed, ensuring a restful sleep environment. The lobby bar offers a unique "Best Brews" program, providing a spacious and elegant venue for your leisure gatherings. The All-day Dining Restaurant offers exquisite cuisine from around the world for you to enjoy.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Guandu
records.name_zh: 昆明长晟福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 昆明长晟福朋喜来登酒店位于昆明市官渡区CBD核心商务地段, 得益于“万紫千红花不谢，冬暖夏凉四时春”的历史渊源。 酒店将传统元素与现代简约设计融为一体，150间全景客房配备品牌卫浴及舒适床品，让您尽览水碧山青的旖旎风光。 别具福朋特色的“醇饮优选”计划，为独立旅行者提供一尝本地精酿放松身心的环境。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming Guandu is located in the core business area of the CBD in Guandu District. It benefits from the historical origin of "flowers blooming all year round, warm in winter and cool in summer, like spring all the time". The hotel integrates traditional elements with modern minimalist design. The 150 panoramic guest rooms are equipped with branded bathroom facilities and comfortable bedding, allowing you to enjoy the charming scenery of green waters and mountains. The unique Four Points by Sheraton "Best Brews" program provides independent travelers with an environment to relax and taste local craft beers.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming, Downtown
records.name_zh: 昆明城市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 昆明城市中心福朋喜来登踞守春城心脉，坐拥金马碧鸡坊地标景观，下楼即达南屏步行街与昆明老街。186间全景客房配备福朋舒适床品及高速网络，客房可俯瞰千年古迹与现代霓虹交织的城市画卷。四维立体的"玩啤食社"重新定义社交场域，将精酿工坊与创意餐厅融为一体，本地鲜酿与环球美食在此碰撞出独特滋味。交通枢纽无缝链接，酒店距离地铁3号线360米，更以15分钟高铁圈、30分钟航空圈编织效率网络，让差旅成为从容的时间艺术，坐享城市动脉的便捷与市井烟火的温度，为商旅客群打造"出则繁华，入则静好"的沉浸式旅居体验。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming,Downtown Central Kunming occupies a prime location near Jinma Biji Arch, steps from Nanping Pedestrian Street and Kunming Old Town. Its 186 panoramic rooms feature signature bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi, and vistas showcasing the city’s blend of ancient heritage and modernity. The "Brew & Bites Social Hub" innovates hospitality with a craft brewery-creative dining hybrid, where local brews and international flavors offer unique fusion. With seamless transport links, the hotel sits 360m from Metro Line 3 and ensures 15-minute high-speed rail/30-minute airport access, streamlining business travel while connecting guests to urban efficiency and authentic local culture. Tailored for professionals, it balances vibrant city immersion with sanctuary-like serenity-"bustling energy beyond, tranquil refinement within."

description.textZh: 昆明喜来登酒店的盛大启幕，标志着喜来登酒店品牌首次亮相中国云南的省会城市——昆明。酒店位于昆明经济技术开发区的核心商业区，距离昆明长水国际机场和昆明南站25公里，驱车40分钟即可抵达。昆明喜来登酒店拥有427间精致宽敞的客房，以刺绣工艺制成的少数民族图腾和茶马古道沿途风景为特色。每间客房均配备精美舒适的床品、周到体贴的设施和别具创新的服务。多间别具特色的餐厅和一间行政酒廊，为您奉上匠心烹制的珍馐美馔，这里是休闲放松、宴请宾朋的理想会聚之所。此外，昆明喜来登酒店设有3,000平方米的会议及宴会空间，可举办各类活动。旅途期间，宾客亦可移步健身中心，恒温无边泳池或水疗中心，轻松享受健康愉悦的生活方式。
description.textEn: Sheraton Kunmings opening marks the debut of Sheraton Hotels in the capital city of Chinas Yunnan province. It is located in the commercial hub of Kunming Economic and Technology Development Zone and takes 40 minutes to drive to Kunming Changshui International Airport and Kunming South Railway Station. All 427 spacious and well-appointed guestrooms feature embroidery craft with decorative patterns of ethnic minority totems and the sceneries along the ancient Tea Horse Road. Each room is equipped with exquisite bedding, thoughtful amenities and services. Diverse restaurants and an executive club provide guests with exquisite delicacies, providing an ideal gathering place for enjoyment and entertainment. Sheraton Kunming also boasts 3,000 square meters of conference and banquet spaces that cater to all type of events. Equipped with Sheraton Fitness Center, a heated infinity swimming pool and a spa, the hotel promises a healthy and pleasant stay.

records.name_zh: 昆山淀山湖雅乐轩酒店

description.textZh: 昆山淀山湖雅乐轩酒店位于潋滟粼粼的淀山湖畔，是淀山湖度假区首家万豪旗下精选品牌。酒店紧邻上海青浦水上运动中心,朱家角古镇和华为练秋湖研发中心。昆山淀山湖雅乐轩酒店拥有189间现代化的舒适客房及套房，让您180度饱览潋滟湖景与都市绿洲。设有2个餐厅：W XYZ酒吧、充能站全日制餐厅，让您味蕾恣享潮酷世界~酒店配套24小时健身房等娱乐设施让您慢享惬意此刻。了解我们Arf宠物友好计划，与爱宠尽享舒适与轻松！
description.textEn: Located near the sunlit Dianshan Lake, Aloft kunshan dianshan lake is close to Shanghai Qingpu Water Sports Center, Zhujiajiao Ancient Town and Huawei Lianqiu Lake R&D Center. With 189 modern and comfortable rooms and suites, the hotel offers 180-degree views of the sunlit lake and lush forest. With 2 restaurants: w xyz bar and Re:fuel full-time restaurant, taste buds enjoy the cool world~The hotel offers recreational facilities such as a 24-hour gym. Get together at this moment and connect to our dynamic music to open your dynamic social life. Immerse yourself in Dianshan Lake, learn about our ARF, and enjoy comfort and relaxation with your pet!

description.textZh: 昆山万怡酒店地处昆山经济技术开发区黄金地段，轻松可达开发区众多国内外知名企业。交通便捷，毗邻昆山中环高架出入口，距离昆山南高铁站20分钟车程；距离苏州工业园区30分钟，距离虹桥国际机场45分钟车程，距离浦东国际机场90分钟。而周庄、千灯、锦溪等多座知名古镇和阳澄湖风景同样近在咫尺。昆山万怡酒店配备时尚现代的装修风格，拥有豪华客房、行政客房和行政套房等多种住宿设施。行政酒廊位于酒店 27 层，一览市中心迷人夜景。丰味坊供应充满国际风味的早餐及晚餐，您可邀约家人或同事来此共享美好时光。24 小时健身中心确保您在旅途之中也能随时保持强健体魄。昆山万怡酒店超凡的餐饮服务团队时刻竭诚效劳，让您的旅程更为难忘。
description.textEn: Set in the center of Kunshan Economic and Technological Development Zone, Courtyard Kunshan offers business and leisure travelers in China excellent service, thoughtful amenities and a prime location. The hotel is conveniently near major companies such as Samsung, Tetra Pak and Tokyo Electron, as well as Kunshan South Station (Shanghai-Nanjing high-speed railway) and Hongqiao International Airport. Hotel guests can also easily visit Kunshan International Convention Center and Yangcheng Lake during their stay. Relax in contemporary hotel rooms and suites with deluxe bedding, marble bathrooms, comfortable sofas, large desks and free Wi-Fi. Executive-level rooms and suites have exclusive access to the 27th-floor Lounge and its amenities, including complimentary afternoon tea and dessert. Indulge in delicious buffets and a la carte options at MoMo Cafe, and stay fit in our 24-hour gym. For those planning events in Kunshan, China, our sophisticated venues and first-class catering team make every event memorable.

description.textZh: The hotel is located in the middle of Shanghai and Suzhou, near Yangcheng Lake, convenient transportation and pleasant climate is a good choice for your travel.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and hot breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, sweet breads, milk and bacon.Located in the lobby of the hotel, Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.Fairfield Market offers snacks and drinks throughout the day as a light takeaway meal, providing guests with a wide selection of meals.

description.textZh: The hotel is located in the Kunshan Economic Development Zone, situated in the city center area! The hotel features 150 modern and classic guest rooms, and offers convenient dining options, providing guests with a brand-new experience!
description.textEn: The Fourpoints by Sheraton Kunshan is located in the urban area of Kunshan, adjacent to the Kunshan Financial District and the National Economic Development Zone. It is only about two kilometers away from Wanda Plaza, Jinying Plaza and Kunqu Art Center. Right outside the hotel is the Jinpu Bridge Station of Suzhou Metro Line 3 (11). It only takes 30 minutes by subway to reach Oriental Gate. Yangcheng Lake, Qianling Ancient Town and Zhouzhuang can all be reached within 40 minutes by car.

records.name_zh: 昆山淀山湖喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 昆山淀山湖喜来登酒店拥有210间现代化的舒适客房及套房，让您饱览潋滟湖景与葱郁之林。餐饮区设有3个餐厅：＆More by Sheraton咖啡吧、采悦轩中餐厅和食光全日制餐厅，为您提供摩登惬意的用餐体验。酒店拥有2000平米的多功能宴会空间及3000平米户外草坪空间。同时配套室内恒温游泳池、24小时健身房、儿童中心等娱乐设施让您慢享惬意此刻。
description.textEn: Sheraton Kunshan Dianshan Lake offers 210 modern and comfortable rooms and suites overlooking the sunlit lake and lush forest.The dining area has 3 restaurants: &More by Sheraton coffee bar, YUE Chinese Restaurant and Daily Social All Day Restaurant, providing you with a modern and comfortable dining experience.The hotel has 2,000 square meters of multi-functional banquet space and 3,000 square meters of outdoor lawn space. At the same time, it is equipped with indoor heated swimming pool, 24-hour gym, children's center and other recreational facilities for you to enjoy the moment.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms; a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Langfang is located in the Langfang section of the Beijing Daxing International Airport Economic Zone. The hotel boasts a prime location with convenient transportation: just a 20-minute drive to Beijing Daxing International Airport, 35 minutes to Langfang Railway Station, and 25 minutes to the Unioue Dream of Red Mansion .Featuring 234 modern and smart-designed guest rooms with scenic views, the hotel offers a relaxing and enjoyable private retreat. Pavilion all day dining restaurant has nearly 150 dining seats, along with several elegantly decorated Chinese dining private rooms, provides an excellent choice for fine dining and business gatherings. With approximately 800 square meters of event space, including banquet halls and meeting rooms equipped with advanced audiovisual facilities, the hotel is well-suited for various occasions. Additionally, the 24-hour fitness center allows guests to unwind and rejuvenate during their busy travels.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Langfang, Guan
records.name_zh: 廊坊固安福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 廊坊固安福朋喜来登酒店坐落于固安新城规划的社区之中，是商务和休闲旅客眼中的现代热土。酒店格调时尚的客房设有特色舒适设施，采用精致的设计元素，配有带精选卫浴产品的宽敞私人浴室，称心惬意的轻松休闲体验尽在此间。酒店内设多间别具特色的餐厅，精心料理的特色中式美食为您缔造非凡味蕾盛宴。酒店地理位置优越，久负盛名的商务区和热门旅游景点，以及北京野生动物园和固安中央公园云集四周。距北京大兴国际机场约 30 分钟。酒店的多功能活动空间拥有专业策划员，并配有先进的视听技术设备，提供定制餐饮服务，是成功举办会议、婚礼和社交活动的理想选择。在波光粼粼的室内泳池中畅泳一番恢复活力，或者到设施齐全的健身中心酣畅锻炼，为一天难忘的工作、购物或观光之旅划上完满句号。欢迎莅临下榻我们在廊坊的现代化酒店，发现精彩纷呈的中国河北。
description.textEn: Situated amid the planned community of Gu'an New Town, Four Points by Sheraton Langfang, Guan is a contemporary haven for business and leisure travelers. Experience effortless relaxation in sophisticated hotel accommodations with signature comforts, refined design elements and large private bathrooms with premium bath products. Ignite your senses with expertly prepared Chinese cuisine at our distinctive hotel restaurants. Enjoy a coveted location amid prestigious businesses, celebrated tourist attractions, Beijing wildlife park and Guan Central Park. Beijing Daxing International Airport is 30 minutes away. Host successful meetings, weddings and social engagements in versatile event space with expert planners, cutting-edge audiovisual technology and custom catering. Punctuate an unforgettable day of work, shopping or sightseeing with a rejuvenating swim in our sparkling indoor pool or an exhilarating workout in our well-equipped fitness center. Enrich your visit to Hebei, China at our modern hotel in Langfang.

records.name_zh: 廊坊潮白河喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临廊坊潮白河喜来登酒店，感受北京附近的民族文化。廊坊潮白河喜来登酒店位于蒋谭路，处于潮白新城的商业中心地带。距工业园、住宅办公室、展览中心和休闲设施均只有数分钟行程。距北京首都国际机场 (PEK) 约 45 分钟车程。酒店邻近众多热门运动和休闲场所。位于北京东燕郊经济开发区的燕龙马术俱乐部已举办过多场重要的国内及国际赛事。酒店位于大厂回族自治县，拥有自身的特色文化。距离酒店约 14 公里的北坞清真寺占地约 85 亩左右，是河北省超大的清真寺之一。享受入住廊坊潮白河喜来登酒店的难忘体验。
description.textEn: Soak up the national culture near Beijing at the Sheraton Langfang Chaobai River Hotel. The Sheraton Langfang Chaobai River Hotel is located on Jiangtan Road, within Chaobai New Citys commercial center. Industrial parks, residential offices, exhibition centers and leisure facilities are all just minutes away. Beijing Capital International Airport (PEK) can be reached by car in approximately 45 minutes. The hotel is close to many renowned sports and leisure venues. Yanlong Equestrian Club, located in the East Beijing Yanjiao Economic Development Zone, has hosted several esteemed local and International events. Dachang Hui Autonomous County, where the hotel is located, has its own special culture. Approximately 14 kilometers from the hotel, Beiwu Mosque is one of Hebei province largest mosques, spanning 14 acres. Enjoy a stay at Sheraton Langfang Chaobai River Hotel for a memorable experience.

description.textZh: 兰州众邦喜来登酒店位于兰州安宁区核心地带，紧邻黄河岸边，周围环境优美。酒店设计融合了喜来登品牌焕新理念与丝绸之路及黄河文化元素。354间时尚舒适的客房为您提供温润典雅的居家之感。在我们的&More by Sheraton咖啡吧、食光全日餐厅、悦厨中餐厅、面肆特色餐厅和秘境酒吧尽情享用精致丰盛的珍馐美馔。共计1900㎡的活动空间包括1间1200㎡无柱喜来登大宴会厅和1间国贸宴会厅及5间会议室，所有场地均配备前沿设备和高速Wifi，是举办商务宴会、浪漫婚礼和社交聚会的理想场所。您还可以在喜来登健身中心和泳池中畅快锻炼， 放松身心，尽情激发潜力。
description.textEn: Why Go? Sheraton Hotels & Resorts continues its transformation journey with the opening of Sheraton Lanzhou Anning, offering its signature community spaces in the city’s core Anning District. The hotel has an advantaged location, close to metro station, with Yellow River in a very short distance away and Yellow River Tower across the river. Ideally located just 150 meters walk away from the nearest station exit and 5.5 kilometers from the Lanzhouxi Railway Station, the 353-room hotel is in accessible reach for both business and leisure travelers. Guests will also be delighted by the hotel’s signature culinary offerings of &More by Sheraton, a combination of bar, coffee bar, and a market, all-day-dining restaurant Daily Social, Unspoken Bar, Soo Noodles, and Chinese restaurant Yue. Additional facilities include the Sheraton Club for Marriott Bonvoy elite members, a 1,900 square meters of flexible meeting and banquet space, and leisure spaces such as a fitness center and an indoor swimming pool.

description.textZh: 乐山福朋喜来登酒店定位“区域商务枢纽与本地生活服务”，坐落于“中国绿色硅谷”乐山市五通桥区域，以品牌标志性的“简约、舒适、高效”理念，结合本地特色与需求，为商务人士、休闲游客及周边居民提供高质量的旅居体验。酒店紧邻岷江、王爷庙、菩提山公园，是集休闲、娱乐、商务为一体的悠闲舒适之地。距离五通桥区政务中心、工业园区约5-10分钟车程，驾车前往乐山大佛景区仅需30分钟，距离乐山高铁站（乐山站）约25分钟，90分钟可抵达成都双流国际机场。乐山机场将于2025年下半年正式运行，酒店距离乐山机场仅20分钟。酒店211间雅致时尚客房及套房将为您送上舒适无比的住宿体验，房间宽敞明亮，配备“甜梦之床”、高清液晶电视、高速无线网络及高端洗浴用品，全景落地窗一览岷江景观；酒店配备健身房和大堂吧，提供咖啡、茶饮、鲜榨果汁、精酿啤酒及轻食甜点。全日制餐厅提供中西式早餐，不但包括乐山本地小吃、更云集中式川粤经典菜系和各类西式国际美食，让您尽享休闲和快乐，收获身心愉悦的体验。乐山福朋喜来登酒店将国际品牌标准与本地生活特色、地域文化结合，为商务人士、本地居民及休闲游客提供高效、舒适的旅居体验。
description.textEn: The hotel offers 211 elegant and stylish guest rooms and suites, providing you with an extremely comfortable accommodation experience. The rooms are spacious and bright, equipped with "Sweet Dream Beds", high-definition LCD TVs, high-speed wireless internet, and premium toiletries. The panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows offer a view of the Minjiang River. The hotel also features a gym and a lobby bar, serving coffee, tea, fresh juices, craft beers, and light snacks. The all-day dining restaurant offers both Chinese and Western breakfasts, including local Sichuan snacks, as well as central Sichuan and Cantonese classic dishes and various Western international cuisines, allowing you to enjoy relaxation and happiness and gain a pleasant experience of both body and mind.

description.textZh: 拉萨瑞吉度假酒店坐拥古老八廓区亘古不变的繁荣盛景之中，于富有传奇色彩的旅游目的地，缔造一处非凡豪华住宿佳选。酒店可俯瞰西藏的奇妙景观和宏伟的布达拉宫，激动人心的感受带来焕活身心的震撼体验。酒店客房和套房布置时尚、装饰现代，各类豪华设施一应俱全，迷人美景一览无遗，并饰以灵感源自附近色拉寺的特别图案，缔造轻松愉悦的住宿体验。酒店还设有别具特色的餐厅，可在此品尝令人垂涎的中餐和美味可口的国际美食，精彩纷呈的感官盛宴尽在此间。探索闻达四海的景点，包括大昭寺、八廓街和富有传奇色彩的布达拉宫。活动空间典雅高贵、设计脱俗，是欢庆成功会议、高雅婚礼和难忘社交活动的理想之选。一整天繁忙工作和充实观光之余，在我们度假酒店水疗中心惬意享受焕活神采与活力的护理。我们风景优美的酒店位于具有浓厚传奇色彩的“世界屋脊”，是您造访西藏时的理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: Set amid the timeless splendor of the ancient Barkhor area, The St. Regis Lhasa Resort offers luxury accommodation in a legendary travel destination. Discover a rejuvenating respite overlooking the wondrous Xizang landscape and magnificent Potala Palace. Embrace effortless relaxation in stylishly appointed hotel rooms and suites with contemporary essentials, luxury amenities, stunning views and motifs inspired by the nearby Sera Monastery. Ignite your senses with delectable Chinese cuisine and flavorful international fare in our distinctive restaurants. Explore storied attractions including Jokhang Temple, Barkhor Street and the legendary Potala Palace. Celebrate and succeed in sophisticated event space, masterfully designed for flawless meetings, elegant weddings and memorable social engagements. Punctuate a full day of work or sightseeing with a rejuvenating treatment at our resort spa. Situated at the legendary "Roof of the World," our hotel is a scenic haven for your visit to Xizang.

records.name_en: The ArcadiaPlace, Lugu Lake, a Member of Design Hotels
records.name_zh: 凉山文旅泸沽湖隐奢逸境酒店（Design Hotels设计酒店成员）

description.textZh: Adjacent to two ancient Mosuo villages, with commanding views of Gemu Goddess Mountain and Houlong God of Men Mountain, The Arcadiaplace, Lugu Lake presents ethereal dawns, golden sunsets, and starry nights in an unforgettable setting.
description.textEn: Perched on an Alpine lake in Sichuan, China, embraced by breathtaking mountains, and recognized by Prix Versailles as one of “The World’s Most Beautiful Hotels 2026”, this stunning village gem immerses itself effortlessly into a picture-postcard setting and the ancient culture of the local Mosuo people. The west-facing lobby opens to a full wall of glass, capturing the vast expanse and shifting light of Lugu Lake. Sunlight floods spaces that are composed of warm stone, dark wood, and refined lines. A restrained palette evokes calm and clarity, offering a tranquil atmosphere that breathes in rhythm with nature. The structure’s cascading look ensures that every room has a balcony—a panoramic viewfinder to the mountain and lake that fully immerses guests in their surroundings.

records.name_zh: 连云港福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于连云港第一高楼·阳光自贸中心的56-60楼，以208米高空瞰景优势，将黄海浩渺风光、自贸片区蓬勃活力、港城烟火气息尽收眼底。酒店122间客房均自带瞰景视野，凭栏远眺连岛风姿绰约、云台山脉苍翠连绵，连云港港口的巨轮穿梭、集装箱林立清晰可见，山、海、港、岛四色景致完美交融，解锁港城专属高空全景体验，成为港城兼具商务格调与度假诗意的旅居优质之选。酒店设有122间客房，设计简约大气、格调雅致，搭配高品质床品与洗漱设施，精心打造静谧舒适的休憩空间；同时配套1个全日制餐厅、1个大堂吧、1个专业健身房、1个自助洗衣房，1个多功能会议室，2个高空中餐包厢，完善的业态布局与专业服务，既能满足商务洽谈、会议举办的核心需求，也能兼顾休闲放松、日常起居的便捷体验。
description.textEn: Nestled on Floors 56 to 60 of Sunshine Free Trade Center, the tallest building in Lianyungang, the hotel boasts a stunning viewing height of 208 meters. From this vantage point, guests can feast their eyes on the vast beauty of the Yellow Sea, the dynamic vitality of the Free Trade Zone, and the authentic local charm of the port city.All 122 guest rooms feature exclusive scenic views. The perfect integration of mountains, sea, harbor and islands presents a one-of-a-kind high-altitude panoramic experience exclusive to the port city, making the hotel an ideal accommodation choice that blends business sophistication with resort-style tranquility.It offers 122 guest rooms,Facilities include an all-day dining restaurant, a lobby lounge, a fitness center, a self-service laundry room, a multi-functional meeting room, and two Chinese private dining rooms. It deliver convenient experiences for leisure stays and daily relaxation.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Lianyungang Downtown
records.name_zh: 连云港城市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店设计延续福朋喜来登品牌经典摩登风格，融入现代时尚元素，营造独具格调的居停空间。171间客房及套房配备舒适床品、65英寸液晶电视、独立淋浴间与高速无线网络，兼顾高效工作与舒享休憩。客房观景窗以城市为画卷，将车流地标与天际线尽收眼底。多元餐饮体验包括一层大堂吧「D BY THE MESH」，提供香茗咖啡、零点小食及品牌「醇饮优选」本地精酿啤酒；全日制餐厅「玩啤食社」汇聚国际美食与连云港特色，供应小鱼煎饼、豆腐卷、大刀面等经典早餐。24小时健身中心配备有氧与力量训练器械，助力宾客旅途间保持活力。
description.textEn: The hotel extends Four Points by Sheraton's classic modern design with contemporary accents across 171 guestrooms and suites. All rooms feature premium bedding, 65-inch LCD TVs, walk-in showers and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Panoramic windows frame dynamic views of the city skyline.Dining options include the lobby lounge D BY THE MESHserving teas, coffee, snacks and the brand's Best Brews™local craft beers, and all-day restaurant THE MESHoffering global dishes and Lianyungang specialties like fish pancakes and broad noodle soups.A 24/7 fitness center with cardio and strength equipment is available for workouts. The hotel combines style, comfort and local flavors for business and leisure stays.

records.name_zh: 聊城东昌府万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 116间客房提供智能的现代设计，配有LED电视，高速无线网和舒适的家具，满足宾客的不同需求。每间客房还配备设计周到的工作区，配备可调节灯具和多个电插座，满足宾客的各种需求。室内设计采用温馨的大地色调和耐用天然材料，款式现代简约；开放空间设计让客房更加宽敞明亮；采用舒达品牌床垫和华夫格亲肤纯棉床品，为宾客带来舒适睡眠体验。酒店供应品类丰富的中西式热早餐，“24/7 Market”全日自助便利店可购买小吃茶点等方便外带的简餐。24小时健身房可以帮助宾客在旅行中进行日常的锻炼。
description.textEn: All 116 guestrooms offer smart contemporary designs, and are equipped with LED TVs, high speed Wi-Fi and comfortable furniture to fulfill different needs of guests. Each room also includes a well-designed work area with adjustable lighting and multiple electrical outlets to facilitate the needs of today’s guests. The interior design adopts warm earth color system and long-lasting natural materials, with modern and simple style; Open space design makes the room spacious and bright; The well-known brands of Serta mattress and waffle skin friendly pure cotton bedding provide guests with a comfortable sleep experience.Guests can enjoy a hot breakfast with a wide selection of Chinese and western characteristic, guests can also purchase snacks and refreshments from the all-day self-service “24/7 Market” for easy meals on-the-go. The hotel’s 24-hour gym also allows guests to maintain their exercise routine even while traveling.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Lijiang Ancient Town
records.name_zh: 丽江古城万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于丽江古城香格里拉大道1273号，面对神圣的玉龙雪山，临近丽江闻名旅游景点大研古城和商业区七星街，距丽江东站仅8.5公里，15分钟车程；距丽江三义国际机场仅28.5公里，30分钟车程，交通便利，是休闲旅客来此魅力之城的理想下榻选择。我们的128间客房设计均具灵活性，美观简约，以确保旅客畅享舒适美妙的入住体验。您可在我们设施齐全的健身中心畅快锻炼，然后去餐厅享用美味早餐，开启活力满满的新一天。酒店还设有自助洗衣设施，带来轻松便捷体验。放下繁复，回归简单，来丽江古城万豪万枫酒店，体验“简约之美”， 一切一如预期。
description.textEn: The hotel is located in Shangri Avenue, the ancient town of Lijiang, facing the sacred Jade Dragon Snow Mountain; Adjacent to Lijiang's famous tourist attractions Dayan Ancient City and shopping district Qixing Street; 8.5km from Lijiang East Station, 15 minutes by car; Only 28.5 km from Lijiang Sanyi International Airport, 30 minutes by car, convenient transportation, is the leisure travelers to this charm a great choice for the City of Power.Our 128 guest rooms are designed for maximum flexibility, with a minimalism look to ensure travelers of a flawless experience. Begin your morning with an energizing workout in our well-equipped fitness center, and enjoy a buffet breakfast before setting off.

description.textZh: 香水湾万豪度假酒店座落在风景如画的海南香水湾洁净阔美的原始公共沙滩上，毗邻热带自然景点分界洲岛和南湾猴岛，酒店饱览南中国壮丽的全广角海景，宾客可尽情欣赏日落美景和热带岛屿景观。酒店提供舒适的入住体验，448间客房可一览香水湾的美景，免费WIFI，24小时客房服务，完善的科技设备，加上舒适豪华的床上用品。宾客可漫步在4千米延绵的原美沙滩，享受迷人的海风吹拂，尽览南中国海的绮丽风光。各种家庭活动包括儿童俱乐部，让您的入住充满惊喜和欢乐。3间风格迥异的餐厅及酒吧为宾客奉上别出心裁的佳肴美馔。室外游泳池供您畅游玩乐。想拥有惬意难忘的度假体验，尽在香水湾万豪度假酒店。
description.textEn: The ultra-modern, high-style Xiangshui Bay Marriott Resort in Lingshui showcases a panoramic ocean view with incredible sunsets and spectacular tropical landscape. Set on Hainan Island, the resort hotel has a pristine stretch of beach for a peaceful walk in the sea breeze, and a wide selection of amenities including a spa, several outdoor adult pools, a kids pool with waterslides and a kids club filled with activities. Spacious guestrooms offer deluxe amenities including WiFi, comfortable bedding, private balconies and breathtaking views. Plan meetings with ease in our 26,640 square feet of flexible function space. Dine on-site at one of several options including an upscale Chinese restaurant with an elegant private room. We look forward to helping you create lasting memories of your stay in China at Xiangshui Bay Marriott Resort and Spa.

records.name_en: The Westin Blue Bay Resort & Spa
records.name_zh: 蓝湾绿城威斯汀度假酒店

description.textZh: 蓝湾绿城威斯汀度假酒店坐落于中国海南岛的一处美丽社区，是您通往三亚热带天堂的大门。酒店距南湾猴岛和陵水火车站仅约数分钟行程，距海滨和鉴湖蓝湾高尔夫球场仅咫尺之遥，宾客可方便地前去参加海滨活动和水上运动。宽敞的酒店客房和套房配备天梦之床、雨林淋浴间、液晶电视、大办公桌和免费 Wi-Fi，您可在此放松休息，恢复体力。所有客房均带有摆放着室外沙发的阳台，宾客可饱览中国南海的美丽风景。您可跳入酒店无边泳池畅泳，到波浪泳池冲浪，在健身房锻炼或到海滩漫步。到威斯汀天梦水疗中心享受水疗按摩，在夕阳下的大堂吧露台上品饮鸡尾酒，或到酒店三间热门餐厅享用美味佳肴。精致优雅的室内场地和充满活力的绿色草坪，备受活动策划者喜爱。蓝湾绿城威斯汀度假酒店殷切期待着您的光临！
description.textEn: Nestled in a beautiful community on Hainan Island, China, The Westin Blue Bay Resort & Spa is your gateway to a tropical-style paradise in Sanya. Hotel guests are steps from beachside activities, watersports and Jian Lake Blue Bay Golf Course, as well as minutes from the famous Nanwan Monkey Island and Lingshui railway station. Recharge in spacious hotel rooms and suites which feature Heavenly® Beds, rainforest showers, LCD TVs, large desks and free Wi-Fi. Every accommodation enjoys a balcony with an outdoor sofa and impressive views of the South China Sea. Take the plunge in our hotel's infinity pool, surf in the wave pool, work out in our gym or walk on our private beach. Get a healing massage at our Heavenly Spa by Westin™, sip cocktails at sunset on the terrace of the Lobby Lounge or savor the delicious cuisine at our three popular restaurants. Event planners will appreciate our sophisticated indoor venues and vibrantly green lawns. We look forward to welcoming you to The Westin Blue Bay Resort & Spa.

description.textZh: 临海市位于浙江省东部沿海。有2100多年的悠久历史和独特的自然环境，三面环山，一面环海，有丰富的自然和人文景观。酒店所处临海市中心地段，周边集旅游、购物、美食与一体。福朋喜来登酒店会让来往的商旅体验到国际化酒店的卓越服务。酒店拥有177间客房，一间全天候餐厅和一间酒吧，能满足来自国内外客人的多种需求。
description.textEn: Linhai is located in the east coast of Zhejiang Province. With a long history of more than 2,100 years and has a unique natural environment, surrounded by mountains on three sides and by the sea on one side, with rich natural and cultural landscapes .The hotel is located in the old city street, which in the center of the city. Surrounded by tourism, shopping malls and food streets. Four Points by Sheraton Hotel will bring travelers and business guests the experience of excellent service from world-class hotels.It has 177 rooms in total including suites, fitness center, all day dining restaurant and lobby bar which can meet the needs of domestic and overseas guests.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Linyi Beicheng New District
records.name_zh: 临沂北城新区万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 临沂北城新区万豪万枫酒店秉承“简约之美, 自在之道”的品牌理念, 致力于为商旅及休闲客人提供高效、舒适的核心服务。酒店拥有139间宽敞舒适的客房, 配备万枫品牌标志性的舒适床品, 为您提供一夜酣眠。酒店紧邻奥体中心核心商圈，地理位置优越:信步可达临沂奥体公园，住店宾客可畅享各类精彩赛事与演出活动。55英寸液晶电视、高速 Wi-Fi、USB 充电口、手机无线充电和保险柜等设施, 以满足客人的不同需求。万枫餐厅有80个座位, 提供丰富健康的早餐, 帮助客人唤醒精力充沛的一天。自助服务的“24/7万枫小铺”全天候提供零食和饮料。此外, 酒店的全天候设备齐全的健身中心, 让客人保持锻炼。酒店周边交通便利、距离临沂北站和启阳机场分别约为10公里和18公里，为旅途出行带来高效便捷体验。
description.textEn: All guest rooms are equipped with iconic, time-honored Serta mattresses, skin-friendly bedding, 55-inch LCD TVs, high-speed Wi-Fi, USB charging ports, wireless phone chargers, safes and other amenities to cater to guests’ diverse needs. The Fairfield Restaurant features 80 seats and serves a rich, healthy breakfast to energize guests for a vibrant day ahead. The self-service Fairfield Market is open 24/7, offering an array of snacks and beverages. In addition, the hotel’s 24-hour fully equipped fitness center allows guests to keep up with their workout routines and stay energized and motivated even while traveling; the 24-hour self-service laundry facility further provides guests with added convenience and flexibility.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Linyi Hedong
records.name_zh: 临沂河东福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Nestled in the prime location of Hedong District, Linyi, this new hotel will deliver the tailored travel experience that business and leisure guests need on their journey, with its timeless design, comfortable amenities and genuine hospitality.
description.textEn: The hotel is approximately 12 kilometers from Linyi North High-speed Railway Station and 14 kilometers from Linyi Railway Station, and about 11 kilometers from Linyi Qiyang International Airport. It features 158 modernly designed guest rooms and suites, creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere with the brand's iconic stylish design style.In the guest rooms, a modern and fashionable design is cleverly integrated with classic and practical facilities. The minimalist design, paired with warm neutral tones, fosters a relaxed and cozy ambience. Each room is equipped with comfortable bedding, a 65-inch LCD TV, a private shower room, and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Some rooms also offer a panoramic view of the Yi River, catering to the diverse needs of contemporary guests.

records.name_en: ​Four Points by Sheraton Linyi City Center
records.name_zh: 临沂城市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Linyi City Center Hotel, a shining presence in the North City CBD, inherits the cultural heritage of Langya, combines vintage charm with modern style, captures the elegance of the calligraphy sage.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Lin Yi City Center is located at No. 80, Xiaohe road, Lanshan District. The hotel is inspired by the concept of "retro-modern & Langya cultural heritage". It inherits the roots of the Dongyi tribe and incorporates the elegance of Wang Xizhi, the Sage of Calligraphy, continuing to write a new chapter of the millennium - old humanistic history in the capital of logistics.

description.textZh: 智能、鲜活、平衡，是丽水银泰源宿酒店的核心理念，旨在为宾客提供独特 而舒适的居住体验。酒店拥有158间客房，融合了简约格调与自然美学，强调 绿色环保理念。在这里，每位宾客都将找到一个身心放松的实用性居家空间 ，无论是商务出行还是休闲度假，都能得到灵活满足。源膳全日制餐厅为宾客提供健康环保的乐起早餐(Rise® breakfast)，以及供应 精选⻝材烹制的无国界和本地美⻝。 焕发活力的方式多样，除源动健身中心区分有氧及力量训练区域外，酒店的 自行车租借计划还提供了优选骑行路线，提倡绿色环保出行。 源宿酒店致力于宠物友好，完善配备标志性的宠物床具，饮用器具，清洁品 等，与爱宠同行，温馨旅途。
description.textEn: Smart, Live and Balanced are the core concepts of Element Lishui, aiming to provide guests with a unique and comfortable living experience. With 158 guest rooms, the hotel blends a simplistic style with natural aesthetics to emphasise the Green Environment. Every guest will find a practical living space for physical and mental relaxation, with flexibility for both business trips and leisure holidays. The Rise & Relax all-day Dining restaurant offers a healthy and environmentally friendly Rise® breakfast, as well as borderless and local dishes made with selected ingredients. Refresh and rejuvenate in a variety of ways. In addition to the cardio and strength-training areas in the Motion Fitness Centre, the hotel's cycle rental programme bring preferred cycling routes to promote green travel. Committed to pet-friendliness, Element Lishui is well-equipped with signature pet bedding, drinking utensils, cleaning products and more for a warm journey with your beloved pet.

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Qingtian is nestled in the hometown of Qingtian stone carvings, masterfully blending modern comfort with local cultural charm. It is truly an ideal retreat for relaxation and cultural exploration.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton invites you to embark on a comfortable vacation experience!​Nestled in a convenient location, this hotel boasts both exquisitely designed elegant spaces and abundant local charm — the lobby is filled with the aroma of freshly crafted craft beer, and the restaurant serves delicious dishes infused with local flavors. Whether it’s a business light meal or a casual gathering, it perfectly caters to your taste buds.​For a relaxing escape, free high-speed WiFi is available anytime, ensuring smooth work and communication; the smart fitness area is equipped with professional equipment to help you keep up an active routine. When the weather is nice, take a stroll along the pleasant nearby trails or enjoy the sunshine on the cozy terrace — every moment feels utterly carefree.​From attentive detailed services to distinctive experiences, Four Points by Sheraton infuses warmth and comfort into every journey with its thoughtfulness and quality. We’re waiting for you to visit! #FourPointsBySheraton

description.textZh: 丽水银泰万豪酒店坐落于丽水银泰城豪华商圈，酒店以山水情怀美学设计为理念，巧妙地平衡了空间实用性和居家⻛格，为宾客营造出启发灵感的空间。酒店共计205间客房，均配备高速无线网络和舒适客用设施。 餐饮选择丰富多样，包括万豪贵宾廊、万豪中餐厅、贡厨全日制餐厅和大堂酒廊，满足宾客不同的口味需求。同时，酒店拥有1058平方米的无柱式豪华宴会厅，790平方米的会议前厅和三个多功能会议室，配备智能设施，是举办各类商务聚会和社交活动的理想场地。康乐中心设有25米长的室内泳池和173平方米现代化的健身中心，提供多种健身设备，满足宾客的健身需求。
description.textEn: Located in the business centre of Lishui Yintai City, the Lishui Marriott Hotel is designed with the aesthetic of landscape in mind, skillfully balancing the practicality of the space with the homey style to create inspiring spaces for our guests. The hotel's 205 guest rooms have high-speed Wi-Fi and comfortable guest amenities.Food and beverage options include the M Club Lounge, Man Ho Chinese Restaurant, Goji All-Day Dining and The Lounge, offering various dining options to satisfy guests' diverse tastes. Meanwhile, the hotel has a 1,058-square-metre pillar-less Grand Ballroom, a 790-square-metre Banquet Foyer and three multi-functional meeting rooms equipped with intelligent facilities, making it an ideal venue for all kinds of business gatherings and social events. The Recreation Centre features a 25-metre-long four-season heated swimming pool and a 173-square-metre modern fitness centre providing diverse fitness equipment to meet guests' fitness needs.

records.name_zh: 六盘水福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 六盘水福朋喜来登酒店位于红桥新区的凉都大道，邻近红桥新区行政机构办公楼和旅游景点，地理位置非常便利。六盘水月照机场 (LPF) 距酒店仅约 15 分钟车程。酒店还邻近杭瑞高速公路，地理位置便利。从我们酒店出发，可方便地抵达重庆和贵阳等大城市，酒店有 295 间客房和宽敞的套房以及三个各有特色的餐厅：The Eatery 、China Spice 和 The Lounge 。酒店设有共 2,000 平米左右的多功能空间，其中包括约 800 平米的大宴会厅和约 500 平米的宴会厅，以及 1,200 多平米的室外婚礼空间，可根据您的需求进行布置。我们还有室内泳池、健身房、麻将室和由第三方管理的 KTV 服务。无论您前来六盘水商务洽公或休闲娱乐，都将享受到舒适放松的非凡住宿。
description.textEn: The Four Points by Sheraton Liupanshui is conveniently located in Hongqiao New District, on the Liangdu Avenue nearby Hongqiao New District Government offices and magnificent attractions. Liupanshui Yuezhao Airport (LPF) is only a 15 min drive from the hotel. We’re also conveniently located near major Hangrui Highway. The major cities of Chongqing and Guiyang are both within easy reach.Our hotel have 295 guest rooms and spacious suites and three different characteristics restaurants, the Eatery, China Spice and the Lounge. Hotel function space totally 2,000 square meters and including our 800sqm Grand Ballroom and 500sqm Ballroom, Also have more than 1,200sqm space for outdoor wedding, can be styled to suit your needs. We also have indoor swimming pool, gymnasium, and mahjong rooms and KTV managed by the third party to provide service. Whether you’re in Liupanshui for work or just fun, you’re in for a great stay with us.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms;a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Liuzhou Sanjiang located beside the Xunjiang River on Dazhou Island of Sanjiang Dong Autonomous County, covering an area of 52,000㎡. The distinctive Dong culture-themed building, in the center of verdant trees, incorporates 305 comfortable rooms, indoor and outdoor swimming pools and fitness facilities. Far from noisy, it owns the landscape of Guangxi, Hunan, and Guizhou provinces. And natural scenery with Rongjiang River, Xunjiang River and Rongjiang River.Courtyard by Marriott Liuzhou Sanjiang features the immersive “Dong Style Traveler" Butler Service, which offers considerate customized check-in assistance, delicious new-style Guangxi & Guangdong cuisines, fresh and carefully-cooked Japanese cuisine, international catering experience and rich activities. In appealing nature on and outside the island, guests can avail this opportunity to explore the secrets of mountains and rivers.

description.textZh: The first Marriott Hotels property in Liyang, with 325 guest rooms, 4 restaurants and bar, over 2,600 square meters of event space, Liyang Marriott Hotel is set to enable guests to spark brilliant ideas.
description.textEn: The first Marriott Hotels property in Liyang, Liyang Marriott Hotel is set to upgrade hospitality experience in the area to enable guests to spark brilliant ideas and embrace the possibilities that come from travelling. 325 guest rooms showcasing the Marriott Modern style philosophy, 4 restaurants and bar satisfying expectations of whether Chinese or Western gourmet. With over 2,600 square meters of event space and 5D projection system, Liyang Marriott Hotel is suitable for a fascinating wedding and all kinds of events and meetings.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Luoyang Central Business District
records.name_zh: 洛阳中央商务区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 洛阳中央商务区福朋喜来登酒店位于洛阳市洛龙区核心区位，高耸于商务及购物中心之巅，是城市天际线上的一道璀璨地标。酒店毗邻开元湖，周边三大商场环绕，距离洛阳龙门高铁站仅10分钟车程，距离洛阳北郊机场25分钟车程;驱车前往龙门石窟、洛邑古城等热门景点仅需18分钟。酒店拥有232间复古摩登的客房，间全日制餐厅和大堂吧，配有健身中心和自助洗衣房为您带来便利的居留体验，另有360平米灵活多变的会议空间为您的商务活动保驾护航，快来和我们一起探索这个具有丰富历史底蕴的千年古都吧。
description.textEn: Perched atop the commercial and shopping center in the core area of Luolong District, Four Points by Sheraton Luoyang Central Business District stands as a dazzling landmark on the city's skyline. Overlooking Kaiyuan Lake and surrounded by three major shopping malls, the hotel is just a 10-minute drive from Luoyang Longmen High-speed Railway Station and 25 minutes from Luoyang Beijiao Airport. Popular attractions such as the Longmen Grottoes and Luoyi Ancient City are only 18 minutes away by car. The hotel features 232 retro-modern guest rooms, an all-day dining restaurant, and a lobby lounge. Guests can also enjoy the fitness center and self-service laundry for a convenient stay. With 360 square meters of flexible meeting space to support your business events, come and explore this millennia-old capital rich in history with us.

records.name_en: Yong Le Lukang, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 鹿港永乐酒店, 臻品之选

description.textZh: 鹿港永乐酒店座落鹿港老城区，邻近龙山寺、摸乳巷、意楼、十宜楼、九曲巷，是百年鹿港最繁华的古迹保存区域。我们致力将鹿港丰厚的文化底蕴，转化为深刻且独特的个人体验，您可以悠闲地坐在大厅，啜饮一杯香醇咖啡；亦可到餐厅，细细品味道地鹿港美食，经典滋味一入口，直抵味蕾深处，唤醒记忆中的感动。全馆共62间客房，温润木质设计与柔和光线搭配，营造出舒适静谧氛围。每间客房皆选用台湾顶级特制床垫和柔软寝具，伴您一夜好眠；宽敞的干湿分离卫浴空间，洗涤旅程中的疲惫，带来全面放松的身心体验。在鹿港层层堆叠的历史底蕴中，提供一处现代、静谧且个人化的休憩空间，让您的灵魂和小镇连结，远离尘嚣、重拾自我，充电再出发。
description.textEn: Nestled in the heart of Lukang’s old town—home to Longshan Temple, Breast-Touching Lane, Yi Lou, and Nine-Turns Alley—Yong Le Lukang stands amid a century of preserved heritage and timeless charm. Here, hospitality flows gently like the town’s winding alleys. Enjoy a quiet moment with a cup of aromatic coffee or savour authentic Lukang delicacies that awaken cherished memories. Each of our 62 guest rooms, adorned with warm wood tones and soft light, offers a serene sanctuary with premium Taiwanese bedding and spacious bathrooms. Blending history and modern comfort, Yong Le Lukang invites you to slow down, reconnect, and rediscover yourself within the soul of this ancient town.

records.name_zh: 漯河建业福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Located in Songjiang New District,right beside the Luohe Education, Culture and Arts Center and just 10 minutes from Luohe city center.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Luohe is situated in Songjiang New District, adjacent to Luohe Education Culture and Arts Center. It enjoys convenient transportation, a 10-minute drive from Luohe city center, easy access to business districts, scenic spots and transportation hubs. We provide spacious guest rooms, professional conference banquet services and thoughtful 24-hour services, being an ideal choice for business travel, events and leisure vacation.

description.textZh: 洛阳万怡酒店作为城市C位打卡建筑, 地理位置优越，地处新区体育场旁，距洛阳龙门高铁站仅需10分钟的车程，是文化、金融、政治交汇核心区域。酒店共有220间客房，每一间都可以饱览城市景观。酒店内将历史文化与现代美学完美融合，有多个热门打卡点可供宾客拍照，轻松拍出高级感大片，每一帧都值得被留存。行政酒廊可供宾客免费体验商务设施以及小食软饮，并可于酒廊一览开元大道的壮阔街景。在这座历史悠久的城市, 我们将竭诚为您创造精彩住宿体验, 并与我们的宾客一道“燃情并进”。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Luoyang is strategically located next to the New District Stadium and only a 10-minute drive from Luoyang Longmen High-speed Railway Station, which is the centerpiece of the city's cultural, financial and political area. The hotel has 220 rooms, each with a city view. The overall style of the hotel perfectly integrates history, culture and modern aesthetics, there are a number of popular spots for guests to take photos, easy to take a high-class sense of blockbuster, every frame is worth being saved. The Executive Lounge offers complimentary business amenities, snacks and soft drinks, as well as a breathtaking view of Kaiyuan Avenue. We will spare no effort to create a passionate stay experience in this historic city and 'PASSION MOVES US FORWARD' with our guests.

description.textZh: 洛阳万豪酒店作为城市中轴线地标, 地处洛阳新区政治经济核心地带, 毗邻洛阳开元湖音乐喷泉及兴洛湖湿地公园。酒店地理位置十分便利，紧邻泉舜购物中心，距离洛阳龙门高铁站10分钟车程，洛阳博物馆10分钟车程，洛阳北郊机场20分钟车程，龙门石窟景区20分钟车程, 步行373米即可到达地铁二号线开元湖站，酒店楼下1.8公里慢跑乐道可快速消除一天疲劳。酒店客房及套房位于15-26层，设计致敬唐宋皇家园林的造园艺术, 追寻古时名园印记。每间客房均为落地窗,配备优质睡眠的舒适床品, 在城市的忙碌中, 为住客打造一方静谧之地。
description.textEn: The Luoyang Marriott Hotel is located in the political and economic core area of the Luolong District, facing the Kaiyuan Lake, backed by the Xingluo Lake, located on Luoyang Metro Line 2, only 3KM away from the Longmen High-Speed Railway Station and 17KM away from Luoyang Beijiao Airport, where leisure and business travelers can efficiently and quickly reach.298 exquisite rooms and suites situated from 15th to 26th floors feature ergonomic workspaces, luxury bedding and floor-to-ceiling windows, which combine modern and Luoyang's ancient charm to achieve a complete and perfect balance between space design and practicality.Over 2,000 square meter of versatile event and meeting space, including 750 square meter Grand Ballroom and 600 square meter Pavillion with ceiling height of 6.5m and built-in LED screen, which can host conferences, exhibitions and banquets for various needs.

records.name_zh: 澳门 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 选择澳门 JW 万豪酒店，尽享五星级酒店的豪华体验。酒店客房装饰考究、空间宽敞，五星级豪华酒店设施配备齐全，坐拥澳门银河综合度假城黄金位置，周遭遍布全球知名的购物、餐饮和娱乐设施。客房和套房为您营造时尚现代的卓越环境，惬意体验尽在此间。每个房间均配备品质超凡的精美设计，包括豪华床上用品、纯平电视、大理石浴室、迷你冰箱和免费 Wi-Fi 网络，全景式落地窗可将澳门迷人风光尽收眼底。于此下榻期间，您还可以畅玩让人流连忘返的“天浪淘园”水上乐园。超长空中激流冒险水道刺激非凡，铺有白沙的空中冲浪泳池美轮美奂，园内还有专门的儿童嬉戏区域。其他酒店内设施包括两间精致的餐厅、健身中心和水疗中心。我们的五星级酒店设有 4,552 平米多功能场地空间和一间豪华气派的大宴会厅，是您举办商务会议或社交活动的理想之选。更多精彩，只等您来！
description.textEn: Luxury knows no bounds at JW Marriott Hotel Macau. Enjoy tastefully-decorated accommodations, a wealth of 5-star amenities and unbeatable placement within Galaxy Macau™, home to world-class shopping, dining and entertainment. Unwind in 5-star style from our modern Macau hotel rooms or suites; each boasting top-quality amenities like luxury bedding, flat-screen TVs, marble bathrooms, mini-fridges, free Wi-Fi and floor-to-ceiling windows, which provide sweeping panoramic views of Macau. Visit our award-winning hotel's spectacular Grand Resort Deck, where you can enjoy the world's longest Skytop Aquatic Adventure Rapids, a breathtaking white-sand Skytop Wave Pool and a dedicated kid's zone. Additional resources include two exquisite on-site restaurants, a 24-hour fitness center and a spa. Select our 5-star Cotai hotel​ to host your business meeting or social event to make use of 49,000 square feet of versatile venue space and an opulent Grand Ballroom. It's all waiting for you at JW Marriott Hotel Macau.

records.name_en: Londoner Grand, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Macao
records.name_zh: 澳门伦敦人名汇豪华精选酒店

description.textZh: 伦敦人名汇邀请宾客步入英伦奢华生活的空间。以久负盛名的伦敦梅费尔区为灵感，为旅行者打造兼具奢华气派与贴心细致的住宿体验。伦敦人名汇设有2,405间客房，由知名的Peter Silling & Associates设计事务所担纲设计，重新诠释英伦美学，以强调比例及自然光的玩味个性凸显乔治式建筑的宏伟。精心设计的一系列客房及套房以现代家居装饰和典雅宅邸氛围为特色，是休闲和放松的理想之选。卓越的服务团队让宾客体验更上一层楼。伦敦人名汇设有多座游泳池、24小时健身中心及水疗中心，体贴注重健康的宾客。餐饮选项包括喜公馆。宾客亦可漫步于150 间国际品牌名店，或于表演场地欣赏精彩演出。
description.textEn: Londoner Grand welcomes guests into the exclusive world of British luxury living. Inspired by London’s prestigious Mayfair district, it provides the modern traveller with an exceptionally grand and personal stay. Designed by renowned Peter Silling & Associates, the 2,405-key property features a reinterpreted British design aesthetic, evoking Georgian architecture grandeur with playful expressiveness that emphasises proportion and natural light. Its curated collection of rooms and suites are perfect for entertaining and relaxing, with contemporary furnishings and an elegant townhouse ambience. Complemented by our outstanding guest experience team, the A Team. For wellness there are swimming pools, a 24-hour gym and pampering spa. Enticing dining includes The Conservatory. Guests can also enjoy 150 global retailers and world-class entertainment venues. The possibilities are endless at Londoner Grand.

description.textZh: 澳门瑞吉酒店位于澳门路氹金光大道, 这里是娱乐和购物中心, 汇集超过 850 家豪华商店和众多优质餐饮场所。雅舍餐厅从全球各地精选优质可持续食材烹制美味, 是您在澳门聚会、庆祝或打造新记忆的理想选择。或者, 还可以前往瑞吉酒吧小酌一杯血腥玛丽鸡尾酒, 感受我们酒店对血腥玛丽的别致诠释。到瑞吉水疗中心或我们的室外泳池畅享惬意休闲体验。艾斯特宴会厅等活动空间布置精美, 总面积约 1,300 平米, 是您在澳门举办优雅会议或社交活动的理想选择。400 间豪华客房或套房均采用传统中式元素进行装饰。酒店各间客房均可欣赏路氹金光大道的繁华景致, 大理石浴室内提供来自 SACHAJUAN、Sodashi 和 REN 护肤的非凡定制产品系列。酒店为所有宾客提供瑞吉特色管家服务。
description.textEn: The St. Regis Macao is situated on Macau's Cotai Strip, a centre for entertainment and shopping that boasts more than 850 luxury stores and an array of premier dining options. Sample some of the finest sustainably sourced ingredients from around the world at The Manor restaurant, an ideal venue in which to gather, celebrate and make new memories at our Cotai Strip Macau hotel. Sip on a Maria do Leste, our hotel's unique interpretation of the Bloody Mary at The St. Regis Bar. Find sanctuary at the St. Regis Spa or outdoor pool. Host elegant meetings or social events from our Cotai hotel in Macau with 1,300 square metres of event space, including the Astor Ballroom. Step into one of 400 luxury hotel rooms or suites fitted with traditional Chinese elements, each boasting dramatic views of the Cotai Strip and marble bathrooms with a bespoke amenity collection featuring best-in-class product lines from SACHAJUAN, Sodashi and REN skincare. The St. Regis signature Butler service is available to all hotel guests.

description.textZh: 丽思卡尔顿酒店以卓越服务誉满全球，中国澳门丽思卡尔顿酒店也将继续秉承这一优良传统。酒店位于世界闻名的娱乐和休闲目的地——中国澳门银河的顶层区域，我们的中国澳门豪华酒店让经验丰富的旅行者也一见难忘。230间华美套房，坐拥中国澳门路氹的壮丽景色。住宿期间，欢迎畅享酒店内餐饮、室外泳池和豪华水疗中心等各种贴心便利设备。我们的中国澳门路氹酒店还设有6间活动室，供您举办多达780人的会议或婚礼。中国澳门丽思卡尔顿酒店荣膺《福布斯旅行指南》酒店和水疗中心五星大奖，在餐饮方面更有米其林殊荣加身。我们热切期待您的光临。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Macau offers the impeccable levels of service for which the brand is famous around the world. Set within the top floors of one of the world’s most spectacular entertainment and leisure destinations, Galaxy Macau, our Macau five star hotel is sure to impress even the most seasoned of travelers. Choose from over 230 grandiose suites that overlook inspiring views of Cotai Macau. During your stay, utilize a variety of thoughtful amenities including on-site dining, an outdoor swimming pool and a luxury spa. Our Cotai hotel in Macau​ also offers 6 event rooms for meeting or weddings of up to 780 guests. The Ritz-Carlton, Macau holds the distinct honor of being rated among Forbes Travel Guide for garnering Five Star awards in hotel and spa and Michelin Star award in dining. We look forward to welcoming you.

records.name_zh: 澳门新濠影汇 W 酒店

description.textZh: 澳门新濠影汇 W 酒店属新濠影汇大型综合度假村的一部分，坐落于路凼金光大道。酒店拥有557间时尚客房，均可饱览迷人的城市景观或繁华的路凼景色。宾客在客房内的W迷你吧调制鸡尾酒之同时，亦可通过蓝牙无线连接配备，于客房内尽情享受自己钟爱的音乐。澳门新濠影汇 W 酒店提供多种餐饮选择，包括提供全日餐饮服务的餐厅、咖啡和鸡尾酒吧，提供现代风味粤菜的特色餐厅，以及紧邻其旁的特色酒吧。位于顶楼层的特色酒吧坐拥路环的迷人景观，其复古的设计结合以地区风情为灵感的鸡尾酒及美食，诠释澳门的特色文化。酒店提供先进的健身设施和一个室内恒温游泳池。WET游泳池营造了温暖又热情的氛围，绚丽多彩的设计打造出轻松又有趣的环境，是酒店内的必到景点。AWAY®水疗中心设有两间提供速效护理服务的房间及五间护理室，您可于此探索感官愉悦，享受独处时光，或享用速效护理服务，放松身心。
description.textEn: W Macau - Studio City is part of an integrated resort of Studio City and situated on Cotai Strip, the complex includes a variety of leisure elements such as an outdoor and a newly built indoor waterpark, theatre and more. W Macau - Studio City features 557 stylish guest rooms, each offering charming city views or the bustling Cotai view. The interior design of rooms and suites is inspired by the 1950s films shot in Macau, in which the city was first really shown on the world stage, all aspects and devices of Hollywood and cinema - be it costuming, cameras, theatres, stages, props, etc - to explore, reveal, and interpret the culture of Macau in an exciting contemporary context.

description.textZh: 澎湖福朋喜来登酒店是一家国际品牌酒店。澎湖福朋喜来登酒店地理位置优越，位于马公市，俯瞰马公海港三号港，从马公国际机场驱车约 15 分钟即可抵达酒店。这里有着晴朗的天空、蔚蓝的大海、洁白的沙滩、迷人的风景和引人入胜的台湾传统文化。在这里，工作或娱乐需求轻松满足。欢迎前往无边泳池畅游一番，尽情沐浴在和煦阳光之下。于健身中心挥汗酣畅锻炼，然后尽享桑拿或蒸汽浴。The Eatery 和 China Spice 餐厅供应当地鲜嫩海鲜和国际美食，而大堂吧则是品饮啤酒的理想去处。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Penghu is an International branded hotel in Penghu. Strategically located Magong and overlooking Magong Harbor #3, the hotel is 15 minutes drive from Magong International Airport. Your breath will be taken away by its sunny skies, blue sea, white sand beaches, glorious sceneries and touching traditional Taiwanese culture. Work or Play. Go for a swim or soak up the sun at our zero-edge swimming pool. Work out in the fitness center, then enjoy a sauna or steam session. Savor fresh local seafood and international cuisines in The Eatery and China Spice, or stop by the lobby lounge for a beer.

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: 茂名喜来登温泉度假酒店位于国家AAAA级旅游景区茂名御水古温泉度假区内。它是位于华南和粤西的国际前沿品牌温泉度假酒店，也是集休闲度假、温泉体验、商务会议、团队建设等为一体的温泉度假目的地。酒店拥有230间客房和套房，195间客房配有超大露台，并配有一个私人温泉泡池，该泡池拥有一系列全新的现代喜来登品牌标准设施，包括一个180度的阳台，可观看风景，可调节的多功能圆桌和一台55英寸的电视。日常社交餐厅经过精心设计。我们提供全天候的餐饮服务。在日常社交餐厅，所有食材都是新鲜优质的。我们的厨师渴望将国际美食带到客人的餐桌上。& More的大堂酒吧位于一楼，提供咖啡和小吃。
description.textEn: Sheraton Maoming Hot Spring Resort is located in Maoming ancient royal hot spring resort, which is a national AAAA tourist attraction. It embraces an International famous brand hot spring resort hotel at the South China and West Guangdong, and it is also a hot spring resort destination with leisure vacation, hot spring experience, business conference, team building and so on. The hotel offers 230 rooms and suites, 195 rooms have oversized terraces and outfitted with a personal hot spring dipping pool which feature a range of new and modern Sheraton brand standard amenities, including a 180- degree balcony with view, adjustable multi-functional round table, and a 55-inch television. Daily social restaurant has been carefully designed. We provide a round-the -clock dining service. In Daily social restaurant, all ingredients are sourced fresh and of top-quality. Our chefs aspire to bring international cuisine to guests’ table. & More Lobby Bar located on the first floor, provides coffee and snacks.

description.textZh: 绵阳高新区福朋喜来登酒店是万豪国际酒店集团在绵阳的第二个品牌。距市政府、绵阳高铁终点站与万达商圈交汇处，与绵阳高新区国际会展中心仅8分钟车程。酒店周边地区设施齐全，停车位充足且方便。酒店大堂酒吧全天供应来自福朋喜来登品牌国际饮品偏好计划的最佳精酿啤酒。酒店客房设有“美国舒达”床垫，为您提供舒适的体验，同时酒店的自助洗衣房设备齐全，24小时健身房为您提供便利。福朋喜来登是万豪旅享家奖励计划的参与品牌，会员卡积分为客人提供丰富的奖励项目
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Mianyang High-Tech Zone is the second brand of Four Points by Marriott International Hotel Group in Mianyang. It municipal government, Mianyang high-speed rail terminal and the intersection of Wanda business district, and Mianyang high-tech zone international convention and exhibition center 8 minutes by car. The surrounding area of the hotel is well equipped and the parking space is ample and convenient. The hotel lobby bar serves craft beers served throughout the day from the Four Points Sheraton brand's international drinking preference program. The hotel rooms have "American Shuda" mattresses to provide you with a comfortable experience, while the hotel's self-service laundry room is equipped and the 24-hour gym provides you with convenience. Four Points by Sheraton is a participating brand in the BONVOY Marriott Traveler Rewards Program, and Member Card points provide guests with a wealth of rewards items.

description.textZh: 绵阳首开喜来登酒店由绵阳首开兴泰置业有限公司投资兴建，是万豪国际亚太区第一家融入品牌焕新设计元素的喜来登酒店，也是一家汇聚绵阳历史人文与湖畔自然悠闲的会议度假目的地高星级国际品牌酒店。酒店坐落于绵阳市仙海旅游度假区的核心位置，设有 338 间客房，拥有共计 1,200 平方米灵活的会议及宴会使用空间，及2个匠心独运的餐厅和 1个大堂吧与1个特色酒吧，并配备健身中心，儿童乐园等休闲设施，致力于为到访绵阳的商旅和休闲旅客以及本地宾客打造一处迷人的“会聚之所”。宾客可在此品味本地珍馐，西式美馔等特色主题餐饮，也可体验帐篷露营，场地CS等缤纷活动，度过一段舒适、 自在以及温馨的居停时光。
description.textEn: Sheraton Mianyang is located in the heart of the Xianhai Scenic Area in Sichuan, a China national AAAA tourist attraction which consists of 46 islands and stunning mountains. The magnificent natural landscape acts as a backdrop for the hotel, enabling guests to immerse themselves in nature by hiking in the mountains, and cruising and kayaking in the crystal clear waters. Travelers can easily access the cosmopolitan city of Mianyang via a 40 minute train from Chengdu or a 40 minute drive from the Mianyang Nanjiao Airport and Mianyang Railway Station.

description.textZh: 南昌喜来登酒店位于全新的中央商业区-红谷滩区，毗邻众多金融、商业与政府机构以及零售和休闲娱乐中心，东临赣江与拥有1300年历史的我国古代四大名楼之一的江南名楼“滕王阁”隔江相望。酒店交通便利，可轻松抵达火车站、高铁站和长途汽车站，距离昌北机场仅30分钟左右车程，地铁2号线红谷中大道地铁站2号口设于酒店正门外。酒店设有347间装潢精美且可欣赏壮丽城或江景的客房和套房。喜来登特色睡眠体验是您忙碌一天之余的理想归宿，予您一夜好眠。酒店拥有4个特色餐厅和2个时尚酒吧，从休闲餐饮到国际风味美食，南昌喜来登酒店提供丰富的饮食体验。从早餐到晚餐，美食爱好者可在盛宴标帜餐厅品尝自助美食，在雅•日式料理餐厅臻享地道日式料理,亦可在羲和雅苑尽享地道北京烤鸭及官府菜。南昌喜来登酒店拥有2300平方米灵活多变的多功能会议空间，包括一个内嵌100屏㎡P3高清LED屏幕的1200平方米的无柱式豪华大宴会厅、9个多功能会议室、1间贵宾厅及贵宾休息室，是各类商务会议的理想选择。更有贴心周到的会议服务团队稳妥地跟进所有细节，确保您每一次的活动都取得圆满成功。位于酒店6层的喜来登健身中心配有先进的健身设备以及各种力量训练器械，为您体能、调节和伸展在内的多种健身选择。清晨或夜晚，没有什么比跃入活力泳池中尽情畅游一番更加令人舒心惬意的享受了。无论您是想在泳池中畅游，还是想在宁静氛围中放松身心，六楼的室内恒温泳池都将是您的理想选择。
description.textEn: Located in the center of the Hong Gu Tan district at the Gan riverfront, Sheraton Nanchang Hotel is an ideal choice for business and leisure. The hotel offers 347 beautifully appointed guest rooms and suites with spectacular city or river views. Stay connected with High Speed Internet Access at the spacious work area or with the 42-inch LCD flat screen TV. And the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience ensures a blissful night’s rest. Totaling 4 signature restaurants and 1 bar in Sheraton Nanchang Hotel, guests can enjoy a wide variety of culinary options, ranging from casual dining to international delicacies. Sheraton Nanchang Hotel is the ideal location for meetings and events of all sizes, with 2,300 square meters of multi-functional conference space, including a 1,200 square meter deluxe grand pillar-less ballroom, 9 multi-purpose function rooms, a VIP room and boardroom.

description.textEn: Nanjing, Jiangning, Autograph Collection,It has 110 rooms, some of which are equipped with private hot-spring tubs, 4 restaurants and bars, 1 multifunctional room, a fitness center and a spa. Inspired by the unique local natural landscape and historical background, the hotel design draws on the strong creativity of the cement factory to develop a tension between industry and nature. History, nature and culture are intertwined, and the hotel uses cement as the clue of experience to bring people a vibrant and inspirational journey.

records.name_en: The Sifang Hotel Nanjing, Autograph Collection
records.name_zh: 南京四方酒店，傲途格精选

description.textZh: 南京四方酒店，傲途格精选的每个角落都彰显着鲜明个性和自我表达。酒店由 24 位国际和国内建筑师精心设计打造。主建筑采用“一分为二，化整为零”的策略，将公共空间隐藏在山谷之内，使山脊的客房零星分布。整座建筑群依地势而建，与四周环境巧妙融合。运用黑白灰混凝土砌块和村镇常见的传统水泥材料，打造出一片现代中式山水建筑群，设计方案由家琨建筑设计事务所经验丰富的建筑设计师刘家琨倾情提供。
description.textEn: The Sifang Hotel Nanjing, Autograph Collection showcases self expression and individuality at every turn. Conceived and designed by 24 international and domestic architects. The Main building takes the strategy of breaking one into two whole into parts conceals the public spaces down to the valley and breaks the guest rooms of ridge into small volumes. The whole building cluster consequently gets used to the terrain and fairly integrates with the environment. Concrete blocks of black, white and gray are applied where a contemporary Chinese water mountain cluster is created with the common cement products widely used in small village and towns and conceived and designed by Liu Jiakun, who is a Chief Architect in Jiakun Architects.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻南京金轮万怡酒店，尽享舒适新体验。酒店交通便利，距离南京南站约10分钟车程，与地铁一号线河定桥站无缝衔接。便捷通达百家湖公园、牛首山、夫子庙等各大景点名胜。酒店拥有229间隽雅舒适的客房，包含12间套房，客房均设有灵活的工作和休闲空间，配备包括高速互联网连接、平板高清电视、万豪集团豪华床品等，为宾客打造“家外之家”惬意温暖的入住体验。万荟轩全日餐厅含多个独立包间，提供丰富的全新主题自助早、晚餐及亚洲精选和本地风味菜肴。24小时健身中心，让宾客随时开启高效且充满趣味的健身时光，激发身心活力。酒店拥有灵活多变的活动场地及细心专业会议团队的服务，是举办各类婚宴、宴会、会晤商谈的理想之所。无论商务出行或个人旅居探索，我们都将永葆热情为追求至臻体验的宾客开启怡然焕活之旅。
description.textEn: Experience a new kind of comfort at Courtyard Nanjing Jiangning. Conveniently located 10-minute from Nanjing South Railway Station and connected directly with Metro Line 1, our hotel can easily access the notable local destination like Baijia Lake Park and many other attractions such as Niushoushan Cultural Park, and Confucius Temple. Our hotel features 229 contemporary guest rooms including 12 elegant suites. Accommodations are also equipped to meet your upscale lifestyle and include complimentary Wi-Fi, large work desks, flat-panel TVs. Satisfy your appetite at The Pavilion, our onsite restaurant and lounge serving savory breakfast and specialty dinner options, authentic Asian & local food and drinks. Maintain your exercise routine at our 24-hour fitness center. Host a productive meeting or intimate social event in one of our event rooms featuring AV equipment and custom catering options. Whether you're in Nanjing for business or pleasure, enjoy a memorable stay at Courtyard Nanjing Jiangning.

records.name_zh: 南京鼓楼区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 南京鼓楼福朋喜来登酒店，落址鼓楼主城芯，揽山水城林之胜，承六朝风雅气韵，以万豪国际新一代福朋喜来登之姿，为金陵再添商旅新境。酒店取复古摩登之韵，融东方雅致之美，通透明朗的公区空间，浅木温润，光影流转，标志性 The Mesh 玩啤食社，将轻食、醇饮、社交与办公相融，自在从容。百余间现代客房开阔通透，舒达床垫、全景采光与智能卫浴兼具舒适与质感，于细节处尽显妥帖。全日制餐厅荟萃中西美味，亦藏金陵本味，晨起食人间烟火，入夜品环球醇饮。24 小时健身中心、灵动会议空间，适配各类商务会晤与出行所需。居鼓楼而望金陵，近地铁通达全城，邻商圈尽揽繁华，玄武湖、阅江楼等胜景咫尺可达。以国际标准为基，以金陵温情为韵，南京鼓楼福朋喜来登，于古今交融之处，为每一位旅人敬献恰到好处的居停时光。
description.textEn: Nestled in the core of Gulou District, this next-generation Four Points by Sheraton under Marriott International blends modern business elegance with Jinling cultural charm.Designed in vintage-modern style, the hotel features a bright lobby with warm wood tones and refined metallic accents. The Mesh acts as a social hub offering coffee, craft drinks, light meals and flexible workspaces. It has over 182 stylish rooms and suites from 30㎡, equipped with Marriott-standard mattresses, panoramic windows, smart bathrooms and efficient work areas.Guests can enjoy craft beers via the Best Brews program and taste Chinese, Western and local Nanjing cuisines at the all-day dining restaurant. A 24-hour fitness center, business center and versatile meeting spaces are also provided.With convenient access to metro lines, transport hubs and scenic spots including Xuanwu Lake and Yuejiang Tower, the hotel combines international quality with thoughtful local service, delivering a balanced experience for modern travelers.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻南京景枫万豪酒店，尊享超凡住宿体验。酒店有着优越的地理位置，地处繁华的江宁区科技商务区，毗邻众多企业目的地，步行约500米可至地铁一号线百家湖站，距南京高铁南站约6公里，驱车30公里即达南京禄口国际机场。酒店拥有315间客房和套房，设计均时尚现代，提供一系列超凡礼遇，如免费 Wi-Fi、平面电视、迷你吧和落地窗等，是到访中国的商务旅客及休闲旅客的理想之选。两间酒店内餐厅供应精心烹饪的全日制餐饮或中国风味美食；此外，别致的大堂酒廊是您在江宁区开始或结束一天的理想地点。酒店提供健身中心，带有桑拿室、蒸汽室以及室内恒温泳池。酒店拥有超2000平米的场地空间，包括两间无柱式大宴会厅，欢迎莅临举办您的会议或社交活动。
description.textEn: Treat yourself to an exceptional stay at Marriott Nanjing South Hotel. A fantastic choice for both business and leisure guests visiting China we feature contemporary guest rooms and suites and great location in the bustling Jiangning District tech and business zone near a variety of corporate destinations. Our hotel rooms provide locally inspired design accents and a host of outstanding perks like complimentary WiFi access, a flat-screen TV, a mini-bar and floor-to-ceiling windows. Savor expertly prepared all-day dining, or the sample flavors of China at our two onsite restaurants. In addition, our chic Lobby Lounge is the good place to begin or end your day in the Jiangning District. Make use of our fitness center with a sauna and steam room as well as a heated indoor pool. Select our hotel to host your meeting or social occasion to enjoy 27,000 square feet of venue space including two pillarless grand ballrooms. Marriott Nanjing South Hotel is excited to welcome you.

records.name_zh: 南京江宁 Moxy 酒店

description.textZh: 南京江宁Moxy酒店是国内首批、江苏首家Moxy品牌酒店。位于江宁开发区、高新区和东山老城区的交汇处，地理位置优越，地铁1号线与5号线双地铁，15分钟可抵达南京南站，30分钟可抵达禄口机场。Moxy 是一家注重社交的酒店，拥有176间现代风格客房，精巧的客房鼓励客人在大堂结交更多朋友，吃喝玩乐，而不是窝在房间里打游戏、刷手机、或者发呆。公区呈现强烈的Moxy特色工业风格。一体式酒廊大堂兼具前台和吧台的功能，办理入住便会获得一杯欢迎鸡尾酒。开放式社交餐厅，南京特色小吃搭配西餐的组合，一切皆有可能。休闲书吧与会议室、让创意和头脑风暴在这里发生。拥有24小时健身房，探索有趣打卡点， MOXY定位年轻有趣的千禧一代。与南京厚重的历史文化相遇，便诞生了南京江宁Moxy酒店。酒店的设计以“卡通鸭”为IP、“摄影”为主题，探索镜头下的南京。整体设计融入“明城墙”、“云锦”、“雨花石”、“金陵女子大学”、“江宁爱情隧道”等南京历史元素，挖掘南京当地市井文化特色，通过MOXY镜头，开启一场穿越南京历史时空的旅行。
description.textEn: Moxy Nanjing Jiangning is the first Moxy Hotels in China. Owned by Nanjing Jingyuan Co., Ltd, the 176-room Moxy Nanjing-Jiangning features the brand’s DNA with stylish decoration and fun collaborative spaces. The hotel is located at the intersection of Jiangning Development Zone, Hightech Zone and Dongshan Old Town. The location has a supporting commercial complex, We have easy access to subway line1 and line 5. It is adjacent to a number of popular tourist destinations, including Usnisa Palace, Gingko Lake, etc. It can reach Nanjing South Railway Station in 15min, and Nanjing Lukou Airport in 30min.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻南京华泰万丽酒店，探索中国四大古都之一。南京作为重要的内陆港口，在中国历史上具有举足轻重的地位，而随着整座城市的蓬勃发展，更快速奠定了南京在未来的地位。我们的现代化酒店坐落于建邺区河西商圈，邻近国际博览中心和众多商业园区，地理位置优越。咫尺开外即是拉德芳斯风情街，那里餐厅、商场、夜生活场所林立，热闹非凡。酒店提供宽敞时尚的客房，配备现代浴室和豪华设施。升级客房可享行政楼层待遇和额外礼遇。酒店拥有多间餐厅、24 小时健身中心、室内泳池、超过 2,299 平米的活动空间，是国内外商务旅客的理想下榻之选。欢迎莅临下榻南京华泰万丽酒店，开启难忘住宿之旅。
description.textEn: Discover one of the four great ancient capitals of China at Renaissance Nanjing Olympic Centre Hotel. Nanjing has a firm place in the country’s history as an important inland ports and is quickly securing its status for the future with exciting growth in the city. Set in the Jianye District’s Hexi business circle, our modern business hotel boasts a prime location near the International Expo Centre and multiple industrial parks. The neighborhood is also offers shopping, dining and vibrant nightlife on La-Defense Street. Unpack in spacious accommodations with stylish decor, sleek bathrooms and deluxe amenities. Elevate your stay with an upgraded room for Club Level access and extra perks. Boasting multiple restaurants, a 24-hour fitness center, an indoor pool and more than 24,750 square feet of event space, our hotel is the ideal choice for both international and domestic business travelers. We look forward to providing you with a memorable experience at Renaissance Nanjing Olympic Centre Hotel.

records.name_zh: 南京金丝利喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 南京金丝利喜来登酒店地处六朝古都南京金融商贸中心新街口，紧邻地铁二号线上海路、汉中门站。酒店拥有350间全落地景观式客房，Wi-Fi全面覆盖，其中29-31层为重装升级城景豪华间，25-28层为全新喜来登品牌精选豪华间，17-24层为新启豪华客房。江海缘宴会厅和8个多功能厅适合各类商务会议和宴请活动的需求；位于酒店大堂的&More by Sheraton咖啡吧白天提供星巴克服务™咖啡，夜晚供应各类特色鸡尾酒；二楼全新升级的Daily Social食光全日制餐厅汇聚全球特色美食及南京本地特色小吃；采悦轩中餐厅主打以“不时不食”为烹饪理念的创意苏浙菜；在“丹尼”爱尔兰餐厅酒吧您可品尝到经典“健力士”黑啤；雪茄吧汇集了世界各国的葡萄酒和顶级雪茄；贵宾楼层里可享受专为商务人士设计的特色管家服务。无论您来到南京休闲度假或商务出行，酒店的设施和服务都会令您的旅程舒适难忘！
description.textEn: Sheraton Nanjing Kingsley Hotel & Towers opened in 1998.350 spacious guest rooms with panorama windows allowing great views of the city, and also equipped for you every need. Guests in Towers Room enjoy a host of additional benefits especially tailors to the needs of the business traveler. We have a wide selection of facilities in our fitness center. You can swim at indoor heated pool with panorama view, relax in the sauna and Jacuzzi or play billiards after a long and tiring work. A variety of restaurants and bars cater to every culinary whim, offing a mouth-watering array of international favorites. Include Danny’s Irish pub & restaurant-Nanjing’s first and only Irish bar; Daily Social Restaurant enjoys a good reputation of dinner buffet with international food and Nanjing local snacks.

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于南京新街口繁华街区，以崭新视角重塑历史经典，为具有鉴赏力及文化阅历的精英人士打造理想旅行体验。汲取十朝都会之精粹，酒店占据62层的德基广场二期大楼高层，室内设计展现了东方美学和西方经典风格的巧妙结合。无论身处雅致的客房与套房，5家别具一格的餐厅包括顶层FLAIR，还是开阔的会议空间，宾客皆能饱览紫金山玄武湖胜景或城市天际美景。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Nanjing reimagines the legendary history of Nanjing, China through a luxury lens, with hotel accommodation rising 62 stories above the central business district. Inspired by the Chinese capital’s 10 dynasties, the hotel features decadent details and views of Xuanwu Lake and Purple Mountain. Opulent hotel rooms, five dining venues and more than 23,000 sq. ft. of event space set the backdrop for a memorable stay in Nanjing.

records.name_zh: 南京威斯汀温泉度假酒店

description.textZh: 南京威斯汀温泉度假酒店位于江苏园博园旅游度假区内，请阁下于完成预订后，致电联系025-87126666与我们确认您的行程信息及入园凭证领取方式；酒店拥有247间客房，其中部分客房配备私汤温泉，超290平米的儿童俱乐部，1,700平米会议场地，3个餐饮场所，其中包括全日制餐厅，中餐厅及大堂吧。气派超然的建筑，因地制宜结合中式传统建筑元素并融入现代感的设计理念，开阔的视野催化着古今碰撞的化学效应全新演绎金陵生活方式，同一众追求掌控自我和健康生活理念的成就者共同在威斯汀成为最好的自己。
description.textEn: Located in Jiangsu Horticultural Exposition Park, Our delegated concierge will pick you up at Jiangsu Horticultural Exposition Park Gate 2 and 3. Please contact 025-87126666 after making your reservation to receive your entrance ticket(s) for the Park. The Westin Nanjing Resort and Spa becomes a new destination for well-being getaway within the proximity of the city renowned hot-spring tourism resort, Tangshan. Inspired by Westin well-being pillars and the natural surroundings, the hotel features numerous natural elements and ensures greenery at sight. Each of the 247 guest rooms and suites, overlooking the great scenery of the park, is equipped with Westin’s signature Heavenly Bed and some selected rooms are equipped with private hot-spring tubs. Over 18,000 sq. ft. of meeting space includes a massive, pillar-free ballroom, a separate foyer and 2 meeting rooms. Dining includes 3 restaurants.

records.name_zh: 南京金茂威斯汀大酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻中国南京金茂威斯汀大酒店，在尊贵典雅的环境中体验卓越服务。我们备受认可的豪华酒店位于中央商务区，坐拥玄武湖和紫金山的迷人美景，是造访这座历史文化名城的每位旅行者的理想下榻之选。我们每间客房和套房都尽显摩登风范，营造舒适惬意的放松空间，还提供特色威斯汀产品和设施。您可以到我们的室内恒温泳池惬意畅游，或在威斯汀健身馆畅快锻炼。在我们酒店的餐厅乐享美味餐饮，或选择 24 小时客房送餐服务，在安静的客房内悠闲享用私人晚餐。酒店的优雅活动场地座落在湖光山色间，提供定制餐饮服务，还有专业团队全程为您提供紧密协助，让您信心满满地筹办商务会议、社交活动或婚礼。咫尺之外满蕴秦淮古风，您可尽情开启探索之旅。无论公务差旅或休闲度假，我们都将竭诚为您打造难忘的入住体验。
description.textEn: Experience brilliant service in a prime setting at The Westin Nanjing, China. Located in the central business district, with stunning views of Xuanwu Lake and Nanjing's skyline, our 5 star hotel is the ideal choice for every traveler to this historic city. Each of our modern rooms and suites offers room to relax as well as our signature Westin products and amenities. Go for a swim in our indoor heated pool, work out in the WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio. Savor delicious dining in our hotel's restaurants, or enjoy a quiet dinner in the privacy of your room with 24-hour room service. If a business meeting, social event or wedding brings you to our hotel, you'll discover elegant venues highlighted by inspiring mountain and lake vistas, custom catering and a team of experts who will work with you from start to finish. When it's time to explore, Nanjing's history is just minutes away. Whether staying with us for work or vacation, we look forward to making your stay here memorable.

description.textZh: 五象万怡店拥有226间时尚清新、独具设计感的客房，包括温馨舒适的万怡客房、宽敞豪华的套房等多种房型，以满足不同宾客的个性化需求。每间客房均配备了高品质的床品，让宾客在疲惫的旅途中能够尽享舒适的睡眠。房间内还设有现代化的设施设备，高清液晶电视、免费高速无线网络、迷你吧等，为宾客营造一个温馨、舒适且便捷的居住环境。 特定的餐饮选择使我们能够满足宾客的需求。周到、高效、友好的服务是打造卓越宾客体验的关键。为宾客打造温馨宜人的空间，搭配诱人的食物选择，让宾客选择我们，让万怡酒店脱颖而出。酒店主打美味扒类及主题海鲜自助餐的全日餐厅，欧式的开阔空间提供国内外经典风味，致力于为南宁带来一个新颖的美食社交场所，成为旅途中注入新鲜活力的会聚之所。餐厅拥有室内外厅，室外是创造主题派对等食光惊喜的社交选择。在这慢品好时光。提供全天候零点及主题自助餐，让宾客在品尝美味的同时，观赏主厨们精湛技艺，增加互动体验感。
description.textEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests. With locally-inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free Wi-Fi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive!

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Nanning, Wuxiang
records.name_zh: 南宁五象福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 福朋喜来登作为全球领先的商务酒店品牌，秉承“轻松旅行”的理念，致力于为商务出行及休闲度假的宾客提供舒适、便捷且愉悦的住宿体验，让每一次旅行都充满轻松与惬意。南宁福朋喜来登酒店位于中国东盟自由贸易试验区，繁华商业CBD核心。良庆区飞龙路6号，4号线地铁站飞龙路E出口直达；休闲散步可到邕江畔、体育中心、总部基地；驾车10分钟抵达5A级青秀山风景区；毗邻广西文化艺术中心，商贸综合体宜家家居、龙光蓝鲸天地，为宾客的商务出行与休闲娱乐提供了极大的便利。酒店拥有141间精心设计的品质客房，涵盖舒适大床房、双床房及行政套房，全方位满足商务人士的差旅及家庭出行需求。客房配备高速Wi-Fi、独立办公区，打造高效办公环境。高品质床品与隔音系统保障深度睡眠，行政楼层迷你吧、智能家电等设施完善您的入住体验。此外，还配备了多样化的设施与服务，全日制餐厅、披萨红酒吧、健身中心、自助洗衣房、600㎡空中花园、多功能宴会厅、120㎡豪华茶室以及萌宠乐园，全方位满足宾客的不同需求。酒店以年轻时尚，现代潮流的设计元素，为全球商旅客户提供高效的旅居体验，酒店将成为南宁五象新区高端商旅宾客的首选。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Nanning is located in the China-Asean Pilot Free Trade Zone, Liangqing District Feilong Road No. 6, Line 4 subway station Feilong Road Exit E direct access; Leisure walk to Yongjiang River, Sports center, headquarters base; 10 minutes drive to 5A Qingxiu Mountain Scenic spot; Adjacent to Guangxi Culture and Art Center, the business complex IKEA and Longguang Blue Whale World provide great convenience for guests' business travel and leisure and entertainment.The hotel has 141 rooms, including comfortable queen room, twin room and executive suite, with high-speed Wi-Fi, high-quality bedding and soundproofing system to ensure deep sleep, executive floor minibar, smart appliances and more. The hotel is also equipped with a variety of facilities and services, all-day restaurant, pizza bar, fitness center, laundromat, 600 square meters sky garden, multi-functional ballroom, 120 square meters luxury tea room and pet park, to meet the different needs of guests.

records.name_en: Na Lotus Hotel, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Nanning
records.name_zh: 南宁龙光那莲豪华精选酒店

description.textZh: 南宁龙光那莲豪华精选酒店，坐落于南宁市东盟商务区高层地标建筑-龙光世纪A塔，开业于2019年9月6日，设计灵感取自于月妹的故事（深受广西壮族欢迎的传奇故事）。酒店拥有290间客房和套房，3间餐厅和1间酒廊。开阔的空中视野和舒适的天际体验。逾1700平方米的宴会空间，为高端商旅宾客提供卓越的会议服务。酒店毗邻龙光蓝鲸天地，步行五分钟可到达地铁站，驱车五分钟可到达南宁国际会展中心。作为南宁标志性的万豪集团旗下豪华品牌酒店，那莲酒店将邀请旅行家们探索南宁独特璀璨的魅力。
description.textEn: Set as the high-rise landmark in the ASEAN Business District in Nanning, opening on 6 September 2019, Na Lotus Hotel offers distinctive Chinese experience with captivating grandeur. The indigenous design of the hotel pays homage to the legend of Zhuang minority – Yuemei. For those in search of luxury and space, Na Lotus Hotel has a wide range of 290 rooms and suites, all of which are elegantly presented with panoramic views. No Epicurean Journey is complete without a feast inspired by local traditions. Yun Yue serves fresh Cantonese Dim Sum and delicious hot pot. While Na Lian, the Chinese restaurant offers authentic Guangxi and Cantonese cuisine. Spend an evening under the stars at Sky Lounge and enjoy a drink with the transcendent skyline view of Nanning. The Clouds presents a worldly dining venue featuring international cuisine. With over 1,700 square meters of banquet space including one pillar-less Grand Ballroom, the hotel is ideal for guests who are planning a meeting, conference or any special event.

description.textZh: 南宁鑫伟万豪酒店位于广西南宁市中心东区，距南宁吴圩国际机场约 35 分钟路程，距南宁火车东站约需15分钟，位于南宁地铁1号线会展中心站，交通便利。南宁鑫伟万豪酒店设于航洋国际城，距南宁市政府和大型购物中心咫尺之遥。酒店斜对面即是南宁国际会展中心，该中心是一年一度的中国-东盟博览会的固定会址。酒店拥有 328 间客房及套房，均能欣赏迷人的城市景观。所有客房的装饰均采用国际标准，配备纯平电视、高速上网接入及其它众多先进设施，融舒适性与功能性于一体。酒店拥有1230平方米的会议活动空间，大宴会厅面积为704平方米，可分割成三个单元，4个多功能会议厅，面积由40平方米至70平方米不等，场地配备全套音频/视频设备，所有会议场地提供高速互联网连接。
description.textEn: Nanning Marriott Hotel is ideally located in the eastern area of Nanning City Center in China's Guangxi Region 35 minutes from Nanning Wuxu International Airport and 15 minutes from Nanning East Railway Station. Our hotel is part of Hangyang International Center, within walking distance of Nanning Municipal Government Office and the MixC mall. Nanning International Convention & Exhibition Center, the permanent seat for the annual China ASEAN Expo is just diagonally across from the hotel. Enjoy modern comforts in our 328 rooms and suites, some of which offer spectacular city views. All accommodations are furnished with technology including a flat-screen TV and high-speed internet access as well as a full array of home-like amenities. Savor a meal at one of our two onsite restaurants. With 1,230 square meters of meeting and banquet facilities we offer a space that is just right for any event in downtown Nanning.

description.textZh: 南宁万丽酒店地处五象新区，是前往中国-东盟金融城游览和参加活动期间的理想下榻之选。酒店大堂洋溢着热情的广西壮族文化，并巧妙融入雨季、露台、休闲、集市、民歌等五大引入入胜的主题，生动展现出这座现代都市的迷人风情。雅致迷人的 R Bar，供应咖啡、自制烘焙糕点和手调鸡尾酒。步入时尚的客房和套房，乐享静谧舒适的空间，体验宽敞浴室和众多贴心周到的用品。而在万丽水疗中心，则以同样安静祥和的氛围传递愉悦人心的健康理念。还有超大的泳池和健身中心，让您尽情焕发身心活力。酒店提供丰富多彩的餐饮选择，包括洋溢全球美食灵感的 Commissary Pantry 餐厅、供应美味牛排和薯条的 Maison Ribeye 餐厅、万丽轩中餐厅，客人更可前往装潢精美的 Mill & Co and Floral Studio 餐厅，一边乐享精致下午茶和糕点，一边参与别开生面的插花课程。
description.textEn: Set in Wuxiang New District, the new Renaissance Nanning Hotel introduces a journey of discovery and noteworthy events to China-ASEAN Financial Town. The lobby is designed to reflect the modern city that surrounds it, warmed by a sense of the cordial Guangxi Zhuang culture and five evocative local themes – rainy season, terrace, rest, market and folk song. This is where guests can find the R Bar, a refined space to connect and enjoy coffee, home-baked items and crafted cocktails. Modern guest rooms and suites are steeped in serenity and style, with spacious bathrooms and thoughtful appointments. This sense of calm flows to The Spa at Renaissance and its blissful passage to wellness. And to enliven, a large swimming pool and fitness center await.
