Dining options abound, including the globally-inspired Commissary Pantry Restaurant; Maison Ribeye Restaurant for luscious steaks and fries; Wan Li Xuan Restaurant; and the beautiful Mill & Co and Floral Studio for afternoon tea, pastries and flower arranging class.

description.textZh: 南通万怡酒店坐落于南通市崇川区核心地段，紧邻山姆会员商店、宜家家居、万达广场和万象城，地理位置优越。可轻松驱车前往市内各大商业、工业园区及热门旅游景点——濠河风景名胜区、狼山国家森林公园、南通野生动物园等。酒店拥有各式客房和套房共266间，以及原味坊、大堂吧、健身房和4间会议室，满足各地旅行者的需求。无论是商务出行还是休闲度假，南通万怡酒店都将提供灵活空间和经典风格，致力于为宾客提供支持并保持他们不断前进。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Nantong is located in the heart of Chongchuan District, Nantong. It is adjacent to Sam’s CLUB, Wanda Plaza, MIXC and other large - scale commercial complexes. Within 20 minutes, guests can reach Nantong Airport, the railway station and other major transportation hubs. The location is superior, making it convenient for guests to travel.The hotel features 266 guestrooms and suites, along with Pavilion, Lobby Lounge, a fitness center, and four meeting rooms to cater to travelers’ needs. Whether for business or leisure, Courtyard by Marriott Nantong offers flexible spaces and timeless design, dedicated to empowering guests and keeping them moving forward.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Nantong, Haimen
records.name_zh: 南通海门福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: The hotel has 183 spacious and comfortable rooms, including Standard rooms, Superior rooms, Premium rooms,Premium suites. Ambasador suite and Accessible room.
description.textEn: 36F has 1 board meeting room, 3 function rooms, sound audiovisual equipment, high-speed network, to create flexible meeting and banquet activities, bring unforgettable experience for every participant. The lobby bar offers exquisite afternoon tea, a variety of specialty cocktails and local specialty drinks. The unique "Best BrewsTM" brand plan offers local craft beer. Spacious and elegant social space, become the ideal place to relax, full range of meet your travel needs, is the best choice for business, leisure and travel.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻南通艾美酒店，探索“江海明珠”——南通市的多彩魅力。南通艾美酒店位于南通市核心地段, 车程约20分钟内即可抵达南通机场、高铁站等主要交通枢纽。酒店提供多样的餐饮选择。宾客可于北纬32啜饮艾美咖啡大师亲手奉上的illy咖啡, 去咖啡馆66享用丰盛的国际自助晚餐, 亦或是到乐美中餐厅体验淮扬美食与融合菜的魅力, 聚会谈天, 尽享舌尖愉悦。酒店拥有278间客房和套房，配备大屏华为高清智能电视、独立浸泡式浴缸以及雨林式淋浴间。而席梦思特色睡床, 亦可让您在旅途中尽享一夜好眠, 用充沛活力迎接美好的每一天。酒店紧邻山姆会员商店、宜家家居、万达广场、万象城等大型商超，地理位置优越。同时，酒店配备了6间VIP多功能厅和520㎡的无柱式宴会厅，近千平的宴会及会议场地搭配自然采光给您足够的空间和高度释放思想，满足您在繁华商圈中举办多种活动的需求。健身中心配备了专业健身器械、室内游泳池、智能按摩池、瑜伽房、儿童乐园等让您充分享受运动带来的乐趣。酒店以艺术家的一天作为设计概念, 以当代设计演绎经典的江海文化, 来强调人、艺术与自然的平衡, 启发宾客对于南通江海港湾意境的创意灵感。抵达艾美创驿大堂（Le Méridien Hub™）的那一刻起, 宾客沉浸于此, 探索当地文化。南通艾美酒店愿与您共同探索世界，揭秘目的地。
description.textEn: Welcome to Le Meridien Nantong, located in the core area of Chongchuan District, Nantong. Adjacent to Sam’s CLUB, Wanda Plaza, MIXC and other large supermarkets. Within 20 minutes to reach Nantong Airport, railway station and other major transportation hubs, it is superior and convenient for guests to travel. The design idea of 'A Day Being the Artist' is framed by modern design to stress the delicate balance between human, art, and nature, as well as to pleasure in the inexhaustible inspiration of the Nantong canal conception. With landmark views situated at the confluence of five canals, Le Méridien Nantong has 278 bedrooms and suites. All guestrooms have high-speed Wi-Fi, large-size HUAWEI HD Smart TV, a separate and relaxing deep-soaking tub, and a rainforest shower. Awaken from the hotel’s Le Méridien bed with Simmons to feel energized for the stimulating delights of the day ahead. Le Méridien Hub™ offers a unique sensory experience that encourages guests to explore the local culture.

description.textZh: 南通万豪酒店位于南通“城市新中心”，紧临被誉为南通城的“翡翠项链”的紫琅湖，一侧的南通国际会议中心和南通国际会展中心承办各类高规格国际会议、展览及论坛。万豪酒店便镶嵌在这片卓越的建筑群中,拥有卓越的位置和视野。作为城中新晋地标，地理位置便利，可便捷前往南通兴东国际机场、南通火车站、南通西站等地，以及轻松抵达周边知名景点，如：南通濠河风景区，南通海底世界，南通博物苑，南通森林野生动物园，张謇文化旅游景区等，充分满足商旅及休闲宾客的旅游需求。 酒店划分为六大功能区域，共配备420间客房及套房。气派典雅的万豪中餐厅饱含缤纷创意又不失中国传统美食的风采；贡厨全日制餐厅秉承 “由此归家”理念，着力打造珍馐佳肴与舒适氛围相互交融的就餐体验，提供丰富多样的寰宇美食，畅飨味蕾狂欢；紫琅院子特色餐厅格调舒心，为宾客呈现细腻而精致的匠心美馔；大堂酒廊及M Club行政酒廊风格各异，为宾客缔造视觉与味觉的双重享受。多达1500平方米的会议及宴会场地融合前沿科技的先进设施，其中无柱式780平方米的大宴会厅挑高7米，240平方米的多功能厅及各种规格的会议室，让您的活动策划充满更多灵动性。行政酒廊的设计充满了现代的美感与诗意，临水而坐，沐风观景，紫琅湖的美景近在咫尺，邂逅丰富多彩的舒心商旅。
description.textEn: Near to Nantong International Conference Center Nantong International Exhibition Center, Nantong Grand Theater and Nantong Art Museum. Nantong Marriott Hotel is embedded in this remarkable cluster of buildings with excellent location and views.As a new landmark in the city, it is conveniently located and accessible to Nantong Xingdong International Airport, Nantong Railway Station, Nantong West Railway Station and other places, and easy access to the surrounding famous scenic spots, such as: Nantong Hao River Scenic Spot, Nantong Sea World, Nantong Museum, Nantong Forest Wildlife Park, Zhang Jian Cultural Tourism Scenic Spot, etc., fully meet the tourism needs of business and leisure travelers.The hotel is divided into six functional areas with a total of 421 rooms and suites. 1500㎡ banquet halls equipped with top facilities and the 780 square meters astylar ball hall has 7 meters in height. The 240㎡ multifunctional conference hall and other meeting rooms of different size.

records.name_zh: 林口亚昕福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 林口亚昕福朋喜来登酒店所在的高层建筑物与众不同，其设计灵感源自于树叶，使酒店成为新北市一处时尚的非凡下榻之地。精美的酒店客房兼具现代格调与舒适之感，配有 55 英寸智能电视和免费高速 Wi-Fi，更因雅致的设计元素而与众不同。酒店内餐厅供应可口的中式和国际风味美食，精彩纷呈的感官盛宴尽在此间。步行片刻即可抵达 A9 地铁站，不远处便是桃园国际机场、大湖纪念公园、竹林山佛寺以及林口备受欢迎的奥特莱斯购物中心 — 三井奥特莱斯购物城。精致优雅的活动空间和专业的活动策划者及定制餐饮服务助您圆满举办庆典和活动。在约 25 米无边泳池的清澈池水中畅游一番，焕发奕奕神采，使惬意的一天更趋圆满。作为在台北率先开业的国际酒店，林口亚昕福朋喜来登酒店邻近新北市的各大景点，不失为一处温馨的休憩之所。
description.textEn: Located in a distinctive leaf inspired high-rise building, Four Points by Sheraton Linkou is a stylish haven amid the best of New Taipei City. Experience contemporary comfort in beautifully designed hotel accommodations with 55-inch smart TVs, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and refined design features. Ignite your senses with delectable Chinese and international fare at our restaurants. Stay within steps of the A9 metro station, near Taoyuan International Airport, Dahu Memorial Park, Zhulin Mountain Buddhist Temple and Mitsui Outlet Park, Linkou's most popular shopping outlet. Celebrate and succeed in sophisticated event space, enhanced by custom catering and expert event planners. Punctuate a satisfying day with a refreshing swim in our sparkling, 25-metre infinity pool. The city's very first international hotel, Four Points by Sheraton Linkou is a welcoming sanctuary near the most celebrated attractions in New Taipei City.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Taipei Bali
records.name_zh: 台北八里福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: At Four Points® by Sheraton hotels, our guest rooms feature comfortable beds, productive workspaces and fast, free Wi-Fi. We offer delicious food, a pool and work-out room and everything you need to host business events and meetings.
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program featuring locally sourced craft beers on tap, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfasts to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening plus free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. At Four Points®, workouts are not confined to just to the gym. We have partnered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points® by Sheraton offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 台北板桥馥华艾美酒店

description.textZh: 坐落于繁华的新板特区，台北板桥馥华艾美酒店是探索新北市历史文化与现代活力的理想起点。旅人可漫步前往林家花园等文化景点，亦能轻松感受周边商圈的丰富娱乐与购物选择。酒店汇聚多元餐饮体验，包含融合在地风味的中式料理、风格独具的全日餐厅，以及以创意调饮见长的高空酒吧。室内游泳池、健身中心及大厅酒廊，为旅程提供自在愉悦的休憩时光。236间高楼层景观客房以中世纪现代设计为灵感，配备舒适床铺、明亮淋浴空间与大尺寸萤幕，呈现优雅而兼具品味的入住氛围。多功能会议空间与可容纳400人的宴会厅，亦能满足各类型活动需求，在此体验现代舒适的入住旅程。
description.textEn: Located in the vibrant Xinban Special District, Le Méridien Taipei Banqiao serves as an inviting starting point for discovering both the cultural heritage and modern energy of New Taipei City. Guests can explore nearby landmarks such as the Lin Family Mansion and Garden or enjoy the lively shopping and entertainment district. The hotel features Chinese cuisine inspired by local flavors, a stylish all-day dining restaurant and a bar offering creative cocktails. An indoor swimming pool, fitness center and lobby lounge provide relaxing spaces throughout the day. Our 236 high-floor guest rooms reflect mid-century modern design, featuring plush bedding, well-lit shower areas and large display screens. Flexible meeting rooms and a grand ballroom for up to 400 guests accommodate a wide range of events. Experience a contemporary and comfortable stay in the heart of New Taipei City.

description.textZh: 酒店位于新庄中心地带，信步可达新庄地铁站和新北产业园区机场地铁站。作为万豪国际旗下一员，酒店秉持喜来登品牌“世界在此汇聚”的理念，提供贴心服务和热情待客之道，带您领略当地文化风情。酒店拥有146间现代客房和套房，配备高速网络和智能设施，隔音效果非凡。部分客房坐拥城市全景。酒店内的食光全日餐厅供应国际佳肴和台湾风味美食，&More by Sheraton咖啡吧供应手调咖啡和烘焙美食。酒店内设有健身中心、室外泳池、桑拿室和儿童玩乐区等休闲设施。新北新庄喜来登酒店在新北市为您打造舒适、时尚和难忘的住宿体验，是商务和休闲旅客的理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: Located in the heart of Xinzhuang, within walking distance to Xinzhuang MRT Station and the Airport MRT New Taipei Industrial Park Station. As part of Marriott International, the hotel embodies Sheraton’s spirit of “Where the world comes together”, offering confident service, warm hospitality, and a connection to local culture.The hotel features 146 modern guestrooms and suites with high-speed internet, smart amenities, and excellent soundproofing. Select rooms provide panoramic city views. Dining choices include Daily Social, an all-day restaurant blending international and Taiwanese flavors, and a Coffee Bar , &More by Sheraton with handcrafted brews and baked treats.Leisure facilities include a fitness center, outdoor pool, sauna, and children’s play area. Sheraton New Taipei Xinzhuang will be the ideal destination for both business travelers and leisure guests, offering comfort, style, and memorable experiences in New Taipei City.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and free breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

description.textZh: 在众多的宁波酒店之中，宁波万豪酒店为商务和休闲旅客提供不同凡响的住宿体验。宁波万豪酒店位于市中心，坐落在美不胜收的姚江河畔，靠近中山公园、天一购物广场，是周末逍遥游的非凡选择。酒店设有可观赏河畔景观的宽敞客房、无线高速上网、客房内保险箱、迷你吧、液晶电视、智能插座以及茶水/咖啡服务，是宁波优质酒店之一。该精美酒店配备超凡设施，您可畅游于室内泳池、在桑拿中心休息放松、到健身中心锻炼、在泉水疗恢复活力。 宁波万豪酒店内设三间餐厅，供应多种精致美食。活动空间面积总计达 1,188 平方米，辅之以品质卓越的餐饮服务和值得信赖的活动筹办团队，非常适宜筹办各类商业或宴会活动。
description.textEn: Equally suited to business and leisure travel, the 5-star Ningbo Marriott Hotel is dedicated to making your visit to Zhejiang Province, China memorable. We're located in vibrant area of Ningbo city center, alongside the breathtaking Yao Jiang River, Zhongshan Park and Tian Yi Square. Make yourself comfortable in spacious hotel rooms with river views, complimentary Wi-Fi access, an in-room safe and a mini-bar. Stretch out in front of your LCD TV, or take advantage of a plug-in connectivity panel and an ergonomic workspace. Additional amenities for your Ningbo visit include a heated indoor pool and a sauna, as well as a modern fitness center. Satisfy your appetite at one of four on-site restaurants, where you can sample the flavors of China and the world. Those planning events in Ningbo will appreciate our over 12,000 square feet of event space, complemented by delicious catering and a reliable planning team. We know you're going to enjoy your stay at Ningbo Marriott Hotel.

records.name_zh: 宁波老外滩 Moxy 酒店

description.textZh: 这里没有西装革履的"酒店NPC"，只有随时和你击掌的玩乐特工。在工业风混搭霓虹光影的异度空间里，藏着这些秘密武器：聚会空间里的人体工学椅扭成你的电竞王座，55寸巨幕随时开启游戏直播模式，涂鸦墙恭候你的灵魂画作。深夜爆米花+特调饮料车已就绪，谁说凌晨三点不能开即兴派对？床头自带USB能量补给站，Wi-Fi信号强到能穿越次元壁，投影仪秒变私人影院——当代青年的续命三件套，我们懂。拒绝标准化模板！这里每寸空间都在叫嚣着潮流精神，连空气都飘着自由因子。来和全世界最酷的野孩子相遇，把酒店住成大型真人社交游戏现场才是正经事！
description.textEn: No stuffy "hotel NPCs" in suits here—just high-five-ready Play Agents waiting to squad up with you! Step into our neon-drenched, industrial-chic wonderland and unlock these secret weapons: Gamer’s Paradise: Foldable chairs transform into battle stations, a 55-inch mega-screen fuels your livestream glory, and blank walls become your creative canvas. Midnight popcorn carts + mixology rides? Let’s turn 3 AM into spontaneous party o’clock! Survival Kit 2.0:Bedside USB charging docks, Wi-Fi that laughs at lag, and a projector doubling as your private cinema—because adulting shouldn’t mean compromising on fun. We’ve shredded the hospitality rulebook! Every inch here radiates rebellious charm, and even the air tastes like freedom. Come crash with the world’s coolest misfits—where checking in means leveling up your social game IRL!

description.textZh: 宁波东港喜来登酒店坐落于宁波市中心，是波特曼中心的重要组成部分，由全球知名机构波特曼建筑事务所设计。酒店地处三江口附近，位置优越，风景宜人。酒店周边，餐厅酒吧鳞次栉比，商铺林立，咖啡馆飘香，水疗中心放松身心，KTV会所风光旖旎，令酒店生活多彩多姿。著名景点如七塔寺、甬宁天地、鄞州花园里等，信步可达。酒店共有378间客房，包括33间套房，全部配备喜来登特色睡眠系统和汉斯格雅雅生系列浴室设施，令您的住宿舒适愉快。套房及行政楼层客人更有行政酒廊特权，可尊享从早餐到欢乐时光的各种礼遇。对于繁忙的商务客人，酒店提供的有线及无线互联网连接、语音留言系统、全服务商务中心，以及可为笔记本电脑充电的保险箱，将全方位满足他们的需求。酒店有五家风格迥异餐厅，令人尽享饕餮之欢，大饱口腹之欲。临水而居的大堂酒廊，和纵览大堂的格拉帕酒吧，则是与三五知己浅斟慢饮的理想所在。
description.textEn: Sheraton Ningbo Hotel, nestled charmingly in the heart of Ningbo, is an integral part of the splendid Portman Plaza, designed by the global icon of architecture: John Portman & Associates. Its prime location near the three-river confluence is truly a delight.Surrounding it are a diverse array of establishments, from inviting restaurants and lively bars to alluring shops, cozy cafes, relaxing spas, and fun KTVs, offering great convenience for various pursuits. Notable tourist attractions like the Seven-pagoda Temple, The Park by K11 Select are also close by.The hotel features 378 guest rooms, including 33 luxurious suites. Each accommodation is equipped with Sheraton's Signature Sleeping System and fine Hansgrohe (AXOR) bathroom fixtures, ensuring a pleasant stay. Club Floor and suite guests enjoy exclusive privileges and can relish treats in the Club Lounge.For busy business guests, there's seamless Internet, a well-equipped business center, and laptop-recharging safes to meet their needs.

records.name_zh: 宁波象山绿城喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: The hotel has 271 elegant rooms, 5 meeting rooms, 1 multi-function hall, YUE Chinese restaurant, Daily Social all-day restaurant and so on, providing you with a variety of food and beverage options.
description.textEn: The hotel has 271 elegant rooms, 5 meeting rooms, 1 multi-function hall, YUE Chinese restaurant, Daily Social all-day restaurant and so on, providing you with a variety of food and beverage options. Sheraton Ningbo Xiangshan Resort is the perfect choice for you to experience this charming coastal city, whether for a vacation, a family getaway, a business meeting or a romantic wedding.

description.textZh: 宁波鄞州喜来登酒店坐落于宁波鄞州区南部核心繁华地段, 紧邻鄞州万达广场、印象城购物中心、宁波博物馆及罗蒙环球乐园等城市地标,。酒店紧邻地铁3号线, 距离宁波栎社国际机场约20分钟车程, 宁波火车站约15分钟车程, 东钱湖旅游度假区约20分钟车程。酒店拥有246间视野开阔的全落地窗景观客房, 于云端之上俯瞰都市律动。超过1,200平方米的灵动活动空间, 700平方米无柱式大宴会厅8米挑高视野，为宾客带来非凡与会体验。位于酒店顶层的喜来登行政俱乐部视野开阔, 可将城市风光一览无余。无论是商务出行还是休闲度假, 这里都是探索魅力“港城甬都”宁波的理想下榻之所。
description.textEn: The Sheraton Ningbo Yinzhou is strategically located in the bustling core area of southern Yinzhou District, Ningbo. Close to urban landmarks such as Yinzhou Wanda Plaza, Ningbo Museum, and Romon U-park. The hotel is conveniently adjacent to Metro Line 3 and is approximately a 20-minute drive from Ningbo Lishe International Airport, a 15-minute drive from Ningbo Railway Station, and a 20-minute drive from Dongqian Lake. Featuring 246 elegantly appointed floor-to-ceiling window rooms with expansive views, With over 1,200 square meters of flexible event space, including a column-free grand ballroom spanning 700 square meters and featuring an impressive 8-meter-high ceiling.delivering an unparalleled meeting experience. Whether visiting for business or leisure, guests will find the Sheraton Ningbo Yinzhou the perfect base for exploring the captivating charm of Ningbo, the renowned "Port City"

description.textZh: Sheraton Ninghai creates an environment where guests feel comfortable, natural beauty and culture essence are also incorporated into the space, to create a multifunctional base where guest can relax, connect, and feel at ease.
description.textEn: Sheraton Ninghai is located in the central business district of Ninghai, embraces beautiful scenery with the graceful Tianming Lake nearby, and easily accessible from major regional destinations. The 321-room new property reflects Sheraton worldwide transformation, showcasing its new signature design elements. Featuring a layered design that balances a sense of timelessness with a fresh and contemporary updates, the hotel creates an environment where guests feel comfortable, natural beauty and culture essence are also incorporated into the space, to create a multifunctional base where guest can relax, connect, and feel at ease.

description.textZh: 酒店地处宁波市中心地带，位于中央商务区，距天一广场的餐饮、娱乐及购物场所仅数步之遥。从卓尔不凡的美食餐厅到当地特色购物店，缤纷体验等您领略。酒店拥有约 6,000 平米的精致会议及宴会空间，适宜举办各类活动，为与会嘉宾留下深刻的印象。而后前往每天 24 小时开放的威斯汀健身馆畅快运动。酒店内设中国元素经典中餐厅等多间餐厅和酒吧，供应各种健康美食。我们的现代化酒店拥有 308 间时尚客房，其中包括 33 间套房，所有客房均配备 LED 电视和高速上网接入，着力缔造轻松愉悦的住宿体验。威斯汀天梦之床及带窗户的浴室，助您休元复神重焕活力。
description.textEn: Situated in the heart of Ningbo, China, our hotel is located in the central business district, just steps from Tianyi Square's dining, entertainment and shopping. From gourmet restaurants to unique local shops, a remarkable experience awaits. Impress attendees with our nearly 6,000 square meters of refined meeting and banqueting space, suitable for all occasions. Then get moving in our Westin WORKOUT® Fitness Studio, open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Dine in our restaurants and bars serving delectable, nourishing cuisine including our classic Chinese restaurant Five Sen5ses. Our modern hotel comprises 308 stylish guest rooms, including 33 suites, all with LED TV and high-speed internet access for great leisure. The Westin Heavenly® Bed and bathroom with windows ensure you always feel your best.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms; a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests. With locally-inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free Wi-Fi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive!

records.name_zh: 宁德霞浦万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店地理位置优越，可便捷抵达霞浦各大标志性景点。北岐滩涂距此仅5公里，作为全县标志性摄影胜地，退潮时会露出虎皮纹理的滩涂与纵横交错的紫菜架，被日出的金光温柔笼罩。驱车15分钟可达小皓沙滩，这片被誉为“上帝的调色盘”的沙滩上，细碎沙粒折射出斑斓光影；而车程20分钟的东壁村，是观赏日落的绝佳去处，橘色霞光铺满海面，渔船划过留下雅致剪影。沙江S湾与杨家溪景区亦近在咫尺。沙江S湾因蜿蜒的竹架景观亮相里约奥运会宣传片而声名远播，杨家溪景区则坐拥千年古榕与充满田园意趣的晨雾景致。酒店被500公里蜿蜒的海岸线环抱，是追逐霞浦滩涂变幻光影的理想据点，完美融合了自然奇观与底蕴深厚的海洋文化。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Xiapu is located at No.266 Houdun, Xinlong Shengshi Xintiandi, Xiapu County, Fujian Province, steps away from China’s most beautiful mudflats—a top destination for light-and-shadow photography.As a trusted Marriott Bonvoy brand hotel, we offer sleek, cozy guest rooms with premium bedding and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a tasty daily breakfast and grab-and-go treats at Fairfield Pantry. Our versatile meeting space and well-equipped gym cater to both leisure and business travelers.Ideal for exploring Xiapu’s coastal wonders, Fairfield by Marriott Xiapu is your reliable, warm haven for a memorable stay.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms;a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Pinghu features a relaxed and elegant ambience with its design absorbing the essence of traditional Chinese garden culture and selecting a palette of gray and white, where Jiangnan Garden Landscape characteristic including Green Pine stone wall, bamboo forest are thoughtfully integrated into the design of outdoor patio. The new hotel boasts a total of 80 bright and comfortable guest rooms and suites, which come with balconies allowing guest to take in either pleasant lake views or garden views. Each room is thoughtfully designed, featuring elegant French windows along with light and wooden furniture as well as a window side lounger. Guests can also enjoy amenities including LCD TVs, high-speed WiFi and an ergonomic work area.

records.name_en: Gloria Manor, a Member of Design Hotels
records.name_zh: 华泰瑞苑，设计酒店（Design Hotels）成员

description.textZh: Set amid a mountainous swathe of forestland in Kenting National Park, on Taiwan’s Hengchun Peninsula, with nearby beaches perfect for surfing and snorkeling, Gloria Manor is both a picture of modernist design and a progressively eco-friendly escape.
description.textEn: Inside a former presidential guesthouse in Taiwan’s Kenting National Park, Gloria Manor is a beautiful retreat sandwiched between a mountain and a beach. Built in 1958 as a Forestry Bureau building, the newly renovated structure is now an impressive work of white modernism. Home to such indulgences as Mu Restaurant and Mu Lounge, the hotel also presents a therapeutic yoga program and pool, which allow guests to bask in Taiwan’s natural beauty. Gloria Manor works closely with local ecological studios and residents in designing a series of in-depth explorations off property.

records.name_zh: 绿城千岛湖喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: 酒店拥有 249 间客房和套房，每间均配有甜梦之床、雨林淋浴间、液晶电视、高速免费 Wi-Fi 和一个大型私享阳台。所有套房均设有私享泳池和豪华景观阳台。豪华宴会厅包括 10 间会议及多功能厅，可容纳多达 600 位客人，适宜举办各种活动。设有十间会议室和多功能厅。配备高速网络和视听设备的商务中心。美丽的千岛湖是布置室外鸡尾酒会或私人派对的理想场地，我们专业的宴会团队随时效劳，为您竭诚服务。绿城千岛湖喜来登度假酒店内设三间餐厅和两间酒廊，为您提供餐饮服务。本地特色菜、经典西餐或正宗粤菜美食，无论您偏爱哪种美食，在这里都将获得美妙难忘的用餐体验。我们的服务贴心周到，您只需轻松享受精彩难忘的住宿体验。
description.textEn: 249 guest rooms and suites each with the Sweet Sleeper Bed, rain forest showers, LCD, high speed free WiFi and a large private balcony. All suite rooms are with private swimming pool and luxury landscape balcony. A luxurious ballroom that accommodates functions up to 600 guests will meet all of our different needs and special requirements. Ten meeting and function rooms. A Business Center with high speed internet access and audio visual equipment. The beautiful Qiandao Lake is the good venue to set up an outdoor cocktail party or a private party our professional banquet team is ready to serve you at all time. Treat your palate to a diverse spectrum of tastes at Sheraton Qiandao Lake Resorts three restaurants and two lounge bars. Whether you crave local specialties, classic western cuisine or authentic Cantonese dishes we have got you covered. We have thought of the big and little things to make your stay with us an unforgettable one.

records.name_en: Flow and Co. Qingdao, Autograph Collection
records.name_zh: 青岛福楼安可·傲途格精选

description.textZh: 青岛福楼安可·傲途格精选坐落于青岛市崂山区海龙路12号，依循山前海后的自然脉络，以环形围合的楼体，北高南低顺势而筑，在总建筑面积约20000㎡空间里践行全然·无双的美学哲思。步入酒店大堂，跃然而起的鲸尾艺术品打破陆海边界，与流动的音乐设计文化共同谱写空间即兴乐章。135间复古艺术风格的客房将浮山岚色与岛城街景框成四季变化的立体画作，海洋风格与创新布置交相互融散发独特魅力，配备席梦思甜梦系列床垫、马歇尔音响及特色MINIBAR等设施，带给您非同凡响的住宿体验。茂茂餐厅（THE MOSS），展示西方地道经典的多元化食谱，用新鲜风味解锁社交关系。800平方米的舒适灵活会议空间衔接中庭花园，使商务活动亦能沐浴自然光影，重新定义工作与品味生活。Muscle Bay以1200平方米专业空间打造活力健身聚集地：泳池采用水立方同款硅藻土反渗透过滤系统；集结悍马、力健全套进口设备，配备乔山系列器械，以人体工程学设计精准锻造每寸肌肉，独立普拉提私教区引进美国原装设备，优雅私密的健身环境，独立的锻炼区域营造宁静专注氛围，助力您放松身心、重焕活力。青岛福楼安可·傲途格精选以“全然・无双”的哲学静候每一位旅行者书写属于自己的海洋章节。
description.textEn: The Hotel occupies an area of around 20,000 square meters and boasts an enclosed and north-to-south-downwards-sloped building inspired by the nature force. The Moss restaurant showcases diverse Western classic recipes, unlocking social relationships with fresh flavors.The thoughtfully designed garden and atrium embody the concept of natural laws. Muscle Bay, with 1,200 square meters of professional space, creates a vibrant fitness gathering place: the swimming pool uses the same water cube silicon dioxide reverse osmosis filtration system; it gathers Hummer and Lifefitness imported equipment, and is equipped with the Johnson series of equipment.The independent Pilates private training area introduces American original equipment, creating an elegant and private fitness environment.Elements of ocean and music are intertwined to evoke an 'Exactly Like Nothing Else' style, creating an ideal open space for visitors and residents to explore, share and interact.

description.textZh: 「源」生万物。青岛，一座向水而生的滨海城市，源于水而诞生，源于水而繁荣，源于水而伟大。五月的风撒下种子，燃起火苗，最终生根发芽。青岛金茂源宿酒店坐落于青岛高新区，距青岛北站25分钟车程，40分钟可达青岛胶东国际机场，秉承源宿品牌的绿色环保理念，为宾客营造自然有机、舒适、富有生命力的全新生活方式。以种子启示录、生活体验馆、仲夏夜之梦的设计故事赋予宾客别开生面的酒店空间体验。酒店拥有210间客房，设施齐全、舒适自然的旅居空间，成就休闲度假以至商务差旅的理想之选。此外，源享空间、源莱多功能区、源膳餐厅、源趣儿童娱乐区及源庭户外庭院给宾客提供与亲朋好友一起共享体验的多功能空间场景与生活。源宿是一粒种子，如梦般，它发了芽，成就了青岛的乌托邦。在青岛金茂源宿酒店，商务差旅及休闲度假也可贴近生活，拥抱自然，乐享活力，为宾客呈现务实、体贴、洁净之美。
description.textEn: Element Qingdao, located in the Qingdao High-tech Zone, takes 25 minutes drive from Qingdaobei Railway Station and 40 minutes from Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport. It embraces the Element brand's eco-friendly philosophy, creating a natural, organic, comfortable, and vibrant lifestyle for its guests. Inspired by the design stories of the Seed Apocalypse, Life Experience Pavilion, and Midsummer Night's Dream, the hotel offers guests a unique spatial experience. The hotel features 210 rooms, providing well-equipped, comfortable, and natural living spaces, making it an ideal choice for leisure vacations and business trips. Additionally, the E-SPACE, RISE&RELAX-BAR LOUNGE, RISE&RELAX, FUN ORIGINES, and ELEMENT GARDEN offer multifunctional spaces for guests to share experiences with family and friends.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Qingdao West Coast
records.name_zh: 青岛西海岸万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 青岛西海岸万豪万枫酒店诚挚欢迎追求简约品质与自在体验的宾客。酒店秉承“简约之美，自在之道”的品牌理念，致力于为商旅及休闲客人提供高效、舒适的核心服务，成就物超所值的下榻体验。酒店拥有114间宽敞舒适的客房, 配备万枫品牌标志性的舒适床品，为您提供一夜酣眠。酒店地理位置优越，5分钟可达大珠山风景区，尽览大珠自然与人文景观，6分钟可达青岛中铁世界博览城，30分钟可达青岛西站。周边约10分钟车程内可到达漾时代、悦和花街、西海岸牛街、欢乐海湾等商圈项目。青岛西海岸万豪万枫酒店期待您的莅临，开启一段自在无忧的西海岸旅程！
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Qingdao West Coast warmly welcomes guests who seek simplicity with quality and effortless comfort. Embracing the brand philosophy of “Beauty in Simplicity, Freedom to Be”, we are dedicated to providing efficient, comfortable core services for both business and leisure travelers, delivering exceptional value for your stay. The hotel features 114 spacious and comfortable guest rooms, equipped with Fairfield’s signature bedding for a restful night’s sleep. Prime Location Highlights: - Within 5 minutes' drive: Dazhu Mountain Scenic Area*(natural and cultural landscapes) - Within 6 minutes' drive: Qingdao China Railway World Expo City - Within 30 minutes' drive: Qingdao West Railway Station - Within 10 minutes' drive: Vibrant districts including Young Times, Yuehe Flower Street, **West Coast Niu Street, and Huanle Bay We look forward to welcoming you and kick-starting your carefree journey along the West Coast!

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Qingdao, Chengyang
records.name_zh: 青岛城阳宝龙福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店提供设备齐全的客房，配有空调和平面电视。客人可以充分放松身心，在健身房锻炼身体或在网球场练习挥杆。酒店距离青岛宝龙城市广场100米，距离世纪公园600米。青岛城阳福朋喜来登酒店时尚的客房配有现代的装修，并提供休息区、迷你吧和保险箱。部分浴室提供免费桑拿用品、吹风机和拖鞋。礼宾服务可安排旅行安排、汽车租赁和班车服务。24小时前台的工作人员可为客人提供洗衣房、货币兑换和行李寄存服务。酒店还配有会议设施和商务中心。聚·味中餐厅供应来自青岛本地特色的中餐。客人可以在宜客乐餐厅的各种菜单中选择美味佳肴。大堂酒廊提供小吃和饮料。
description.textEn: The hotel offers well appointed rooms with air conditioning and a flat screen TV. Guests can unwind with massage treatments, work out at the gym or practice a swing at the tennis court. The property is 100 meters from Qingdao Baolong City Plaza and 600 meters from Century Park. Fitted with modern decor, stylish rooms at Four Points by Sheraton Qingdao come with a seating area, a minibar and a safety deposit box. Free toiletries, a hairdryer and slippers are included in an en suite bathroom. Travel arrangements, car rentals and shuttle service can be organized at the concierge service. Staff at the 24-hour front desk can help guests with laundry, currency exchange and luggage storage. The property is also equipped with meeting facilities and a business center. China Spice serves authentic Chinese cuisine from Qingdao region. Guests can select a Wonderful dish from a varied menu at Eatery. Light snacks and beverages are offered at the lobby lounge.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Qingdao, Chengyang East
records.name_zh: 青岛北岸瑞明福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 青岛北岸瑞明福朋喜来登酒店坐落于城阳核心区域，以现代工业风融合海洋灵感设计，打造出一处远眺尘嚣、拥抱灵感的理想下榻地。酒店拥有198间舒适雅致的客房，不仅是探索青岛的绝佳起点，更是一家欢迎宠物同住的友好型酒店。客房内特设贴心的宠物设施，确保您与毛茸家人共度温暖舒适的旅居时光。酒店内的「醇饮优享」餐厅是品味啤酒艺术的绝佳空间，提供金黄透亮的黄啤、醇厚丝滑的黑啤、清新爽润的白啤以及品牌特色精酿，每一杯都蕴藏着青岛百年的酿造灵魂。酒店周边体验丰富多元：信步可达的青岛网红吕家庄夜市，灯火流转，人声鼎沸，弥漫着市井的烟火气；毗邻的国学公园清幽宁静，是与爱宠散步嬉戏的理想场所；与家人探访城阳博物馆，可感受千年文脉的沉淀；驱车片刻即可抵达崂山北九水，置身于山水画卷，欣赏碧波映天的自然诗意。夏秋之际，还可前往城阳乡野葡萄园，体验采摘之乐，共赏田园晚照。在这里，啤酒氤氲、宠物随行、人文与自然和谐相融，诚邀您写入一段属于青岛的诗意旅途记忆。
description.textEn: The FOUR POINTS BY SHERATON QINGDAO, CHENGYANG EAST is located in the central of Chengyang Distict, which is designed blends modern industrial and nautical that create an ideal place to stay away from the bustle and embrace inspiration.Hotel Features 198 comfortable and elegant guest rooms, a self-service laundry room and a 24-hour fitness center. It is an excellent starting point for exploring Qingdao.The Mesh presents handmade craft beer with its "best brew".The hotel has nearly 1,000 square meters of event space. The pillarless grand ballroom with area of 508 square meters and 3 multi-function rooms can adapt to event needs of different scales. The hotel is also surrounded by a rich and diverse range of destination experiences. Such as Lujiazhuang Night Market, Chinese Culture Park, Chengyang Museum, and Laoshan North Nine Water scenic area.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Qingdao, West Coast
records.name_zh: 青岛西海岸隆和福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻青岛西海岸隆和福朋喜来登酒店，享受时尚格调、舒适氛围和非凡服务交相辉映的美妙体验。这家现代化酒店地理位置优越，位于中国青岛灵山湾的美丽海滩之上，氛围不同一般，可饱览迷人海景。酒店客房设施齐全，配备有平面电视、免费 Wi-Fi 等，结束一天的工作或娱乐后，您可在宽敞精致的客房内放松休息，恢复精力。您可以前往酒店内设的餐厅品尝美食，也可以获享客房送餐服务，在酒店客房内舒适地享用餐点。酒店还设有健身中心、恒温室内泳池和儿童泳池。此外，酒店还提供优雅的宴会厅和会议室，是在美丽的中国青岛海滨举办商务会议或社交活动的理想选择。无论您是商务旅行还是休闲度假，酒店都能满足您的各种需求，竭尽所能为您缔造超乎寻常的舒适住宿体验。
description.textEn: Experience comfort, style and superb service at Four Points By Sheraton Qingdao, West Coast. Ideally located on the outstanding beach of Lingshan Bay, in Qingdao, China, our modern hotel boasts dazzling ocean views and a unique atmosphere. After a long day of work or play, relax in your spacious, meticulously decorated guest room, fully equipped with a flat-screen TV, complimentary Wi-Fi and more. Take advantage of our on-site hotel dining options and dine in style, or order room service and enjoy your meal from the comfort of your guest room. Our hotel also features a fitness center, a heated, indoor swimming pool and a children's pool. Elsewhere in the hotel, discover our elegant ballroom and meeting rooms, ideal for a business meeting or social event here in beautiful seaside Qingdao, China. Whether you are visiting for business or leisure, our Qingdao hotel has what needed to make your stay as comfortable as possible.

description.textZh: 青岛富力艾美酒店坐落于前景广阔的青岛商务区，距热门旅游景点约 10 分钟行程，是一处充满时尚气息的非凡目的地。这家位于山东的酒店，精致优雅充满时尚气息，精心满足宾客所需，着力为宾客呈献休闲、高效、圆满的旅程。客房时尚宁静，配备豪华床品、雨林淋浴间、高速 Wi-Fi 以及可俯瞰青岛市景的落地窗。酒店内健身中心配备恒温室内泳池，让您重新焕发饱满活力。在青岛旅行一天后，可到酒店特色健康目的地水疗中心，享受按摩，焕发活力。欢迎莅临体验酒店别致的餐饮目的地，品尝自助式美食以及地道中餐特色菜。酒店还拥有一系列非凡场地，提供先进设施和周到服务，是在山东举办活动的理想选地。
description.textEn: Nestled within Qingdao's up and coming business district, just ten minutes away from premier tourist attractions, lies Le Meridien Qingdao, a 5-star destination brimming with style. Sleek and sophisticated, our Shandong hotel offers guests everything they need to enjoy a relaxing, productive and successful visit. Find tranquility in our contemporary accommodations, which boast plush bedding, rainforest showers, high-speed Wi-Fi and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city. Reboot and recharge at our on-site fitness center, replete with a heated indoor swimming pool. For those seeking a rejuvenating massage after a day of travel to Qingdao, visit SPA, our hotel's signature wellness destination. Sip and savor at our chic dining destinations, serving everything from buffet-style fare to authentic Chinese specialties. An ideal events destination in Shandong, our hotel also features an array of unique venues, enhanced by cutting-edge amenities and thoughtful service.

records.name_zh: 青岛西海岸隆和艾美酒店

description.textZh: 青岛西海岸隆和艾美度假酒店拥有217间设计精巧的绝妙客房，套房以及总统套房。 酒店的室内设计风格是以“度假”为导向的，同样也可作为商务酒店来承接各类公司活动及会议，二者相辅相成。无论是对于来此度假的人们而言还是商旅客人和企业高管，成年人还是青少年，外国宾客还是本地旅客，它都是多元化的且舒适的上佳居所。整体设计理念以及灵感源于中国的黄海以及它独具特色的海洋生物。酒店的户外整体设计布局与超凡的地理位置优势相融合-坐拥青岛西海岸国家第九个经济开发区，而呈现了别致的现代建筑风尚格调。酒店的室内设计共由三个主题区域构成，分别为: “海滩” “浅海”以及“深海”。设计灵感除海洋元素外，也充分融合了来自三个文化领域的精湛设计，包含来自东方世界的文化气息，西方的欧式文化设计底蕴以及地道的中东风情，为酒店的宾客们带来一种上岸后即可感受到全世界的文化冲击探索体验。来自东方世界的文化气息由乐美中餐厅的设计陈列以及装饰布局而体现的淋漓尽致，通过整体设计陈列，中国牡丹花卉艺术墙，传统的包房标识式样以及各种各样的东方设计元素而不断的诠释着来自东方世界博大精深的丰厚文化底蕴。 拥有现代西方经典设计的宴会厅和会议室区域充分体现出西方世界的欧式别致风格，通过打造欧式的现代灯光美学，优质的理石花纹地毯以及优雅的现代暖灰色调 ，为宾客们展现出来自西方现代世界的瑰丽文化与魅力艺术。 泳池的精巧设计为您呈现别样的中东风情文化精髓，通过标志性的中东风情亭台以及巧夺天工的异域格调花纹为您揭开神秘的中东文化探索之旅。
description.textEn: Situated on one of Qingdao's beaches, Le Méridien Qingdao West Coast Resort is a sea-side sanctuary in a stunning travel destination. Experience a refreshing retreat in stylish hotel accommodations with views of the sparkling sea and majestic mountains and revitalizing amenities such as our signature LMBED, freestanding soaking bathtubs and oversized walk-in showers. Ignite your senses with three distinct dining venues, enhanced by show kitchens and live cooking stations. Elevate your stay in China with thoughtful resort features including direct beach access, a sparkling indoor pool, a well-equipped fitness centre and our Le Méridien Kids Club. Celebrate and succeed in more than 2,900-square-meters of European-inspired function space, including our Grand Ballroom. Just steps from the beach, near Mt. Dazhu and the two-thousand-year-old Langyatai, Le Méridien Qingdao West Coast Resort is a rejuvenating haven designed for today's creative and inspired traveler.

description.textZh: 青岛胶州万豪酒店落址于素有“青岛城市客厅”美誉的胶州，少海南湖与北湖 的交界处，周边林立自然美景，宾客在酒店可360度环绕式饱览整个湖面景致及周边湿地风光。同时酒店交通便利，从酒店出发仅需15分钟车程抵达青岛胶东国际机场。 酒店拥有272间客房和套房，将胶州的自然生态和历史脉络巧妙地糅合于室内空间设计，水、影、鱼与中国文化交融不偏不倚，为整个空间增添了一份灵动性。酒店围绕本地特色和万豪标志性待客艺术打造全方位宾客体验，为商旅和休闲宾客提供一处舒适的栖居之所。
description.textEn: Qingdao Marriott Hotel Jiaozhou is located in Jiaozhou, known as the "Qingdao City Living Room", at the junction of South Lake and North Lake, surrounded by natural beauty, guests can enjoy a 360-degree panoramic view of the entire lake and the surrounding wetlands. At the same time, the hotel has convenient transportation, only 15 minutes' drive from the hotel to Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport. The hotel has 272 guest rooms and suites, which skillfully integrate the natural ecology and historical context of Jiaozhou into the interior space design, and the water, shadow, fish and Chinese culture are blended impartially, adding a sense of flexibility to the whole space. The hotel offers a holistic guest experience built around local flair and Marriott's signature art of hospitality, providing a comfortable retreat for both business and leisure travelers.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻青岛金茂万丽酒店，开启岛城探索之旅。诗画青岛，山海神韵，于万国建筑中触摸历史脉搏，在海天一色处扬帆乘风破浪。青岛金茂万丽酒店位于青岛高新区核心地段环湾城市形象带的关键节点，距青岛北站25分钟车程，40分钟可达青岛胶东国际机场。酒店设有279间客房，从崂山、海浪、电影、帆船、异国建筑等青岛独特“城市印迹”中汲取设计灵感，将传统与时尚相融合，重构城市酒店的空间体验。您可在“燃”全日制餐厅尽享万国美馔，在“韶舞”中餐厅做潮玩美食品鉴家，相约“R吧”觥筹交错间开启万丽之夜，在健身中心挥洒汗水在室内泳池逐浪，在行政酒廊感受摩登夜行客的潇洒，在天际吧观景露台远眺城市天际线。逾1200平金茂大宴会厅、800平户外草坪及灵活多变的组合会议室等特色场地为您打造别开生面的企业盛会或唯美婚宴，R.E.N.会议为您的盛事赋予更多目的地特色与体验感。青岛金茂万丽酒店以便捷的交通、别具设计感的舒适客房、完善的配套及全方位周全服务，为商旅宾客解锁非凡旅居体验，打造城市度假的理想目的地。
description.textEn: Renaissance Qingdao Hotel is a key point on the coastal urban image belt. It's a 25-minute drive from Qingdaobei Railway Station and 40 minutes from Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport. The hotel features 279 guest rooms, the design inspiration is drawn from Qingdao’s unique “city imprints” such as old houses, beer culture, Badaguan, and the architectural complex of various countries. At Food Studio all-day dining restaurant, enjoy a variety of international cuisine. At Shao Wu Chinese restaurant, become a connoisseur of Cantonese and Shandong cuisine. Join us at "R Bar" to enjoy the Evenings at Renaissance amidst clinking glasses. The Executive Lounge provides a chic nightlife experience the indoor pool, the fitness center, or gaze at the city skyline from the Sky bar viewing terrace.with over 1,200 square meters of the JinMao Grand Ballroom, the 1000 square meters outdoor lawn, provide distinctive venues for corporate events or fantastic weddings. and an immersive experience to your grand occasions.

records.name_zh: 青岛胶州绿城喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Jiaozhou City Hall is across the street and Qingdao's attractions are close to our hotel, which offers 9 function rooms, an indoor pool, an outdoor pool and more. The distance from Qingdao Jiaodong airport to hotel is only 17 kilometers.
description.textEn: Jiaozhou City Hall is across the street and Qingdao's attractions are close to our hotel, which offers 9 function rooms, an indoor pool, an outdoor pool and more. The distance from Qingdao Jiaodong airport to hotel is only 17 kilometers, convenient for airline passengers to travel.

records.name_zh: 青岛李沧绿城喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于青岛李沧区的时尚街区、崂山脚下。青岛李沧绿城喜来登酒店可提供现代与自然交融的各种体验。从酒店出发，步行即可抵达大型娱乐购物综合体绿城天地。大型购物广场、KTV、桑拿和一系列餐饮场地距酒店仅 2 分钟。酒店靠近万达广场和 Rock City，周围有众多品牌商店、超市、电影院和 KTV。我们是青岛市中心率先开业的喜来登酒店，也是李沧区少有的国际高级酒店。酒店拥有 259 间设计现代的宽敞湖景和山景客房与套房，带入户空间，面积 50 平米起，146 间豪华双床客房可满足所有类型的会议需求。
description.textEn: The hotel is situated in the upcoming trendy area of Qingdao Licang, located at the foot of Laoshan Mountains. Sheraton Qingdao Licang Hotel offers a blend of modern and natural experiences. We are accessible on foot to Greentown World, a large scale entertainment and shopping complex. The major Shopping Mall, KTV, Sauna and an array of dining options only need 2 minutes. Close to the famous Wanda Plaza and Rock City surrounding hotel with full of brand stores, supermarkets, cinemas and KTVs. We are the first Sheraton hotel in Qingdao downtown and only international upscale hotel in Licang district. The hotel has 259 modern designed and spacious guest rooms and suites with lake and mountain views, entry room type, starts at generous size 50 sq m 146 Deluxe Twin Bed Room to suit all types of meetings.

records.name_zh: 青岛西海岸喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Explore vibrant Qingdao from Sheraton Qingdao West Coast. Enjoy modern, spacious rooms and suites, each with views of the sea, in addition to quality on-site restaurants, a stylish lobby lounge, a heated indoor pool and 40,000 square feet of event space.
description.textEn: Intelligent travelers choose Sheraton Qingdao West Coast. Whether you are in China for business or leisure our hotel welcomes you to Qingdaos vibrant west coast with exquisitely appointed, spacious guest rooms, an abundance of premium onsite amenities and a pristine location in Huangdao just a short distance from many celebrated attractions. Each of our 350 hotel rooms and suites provides floor to ceiling windows and picturesque views of the sea as well as a vast range of great perks. Sample the diverse flavors of China at our signature restaurant, or stop by our eclectic international buffet before exploring Qingdao. We also feature a light filled lobby lounge with panoramic sea views, a 24 hour fitness center and a heated indoor pool. Boasting 40,000 square feet of flexible, well designed event space including a pillarless Grand Ballroom, we are an ideal venue for a business meeting or social gathering here in Qingdao China. A sensational stay awaits you at Sheraton Qingdao West Coast.

description.textZh: 青岛瑞吉酒店坐落在青岛市南区高约 369 米的地标海天中心内。酒店毗邻浮山湾，西望八大关文化建筑群，东望五四广场、奥林匹克帆船中心和香港路商业圈，带您尊享精致优雅的沉浸之旅。酒店采用灵感源于自然的艺术设计，配备精致非凡的设施及贴心周到的瑞吉管家服务，于山海之间、云端之上为您带来新意十足的住宿体验，您可尽情领略拥有百年历史的阿斯特家族待客之道。身处辉煌富丽的标志性建筑中，宾客可饱览迷人全景，逸享住宿中的每个时刻。青岛瑞吉酒店是您启迪灵感的理想之选。
description.textEn: The St. Regis Qingdao dwells in the iconic building - Haitian Center, a tower of 369 m in Shinan District, Qingdao. Adjacent to Fushan Bay, the hotel overlooks Badaguan cultural building cluster in the west, and the May Fourth Square, Olympic Sailing Center and Hong Kong Road business circle in the east, inviting distinguished guests to embark on a delicate and elegant immersive journey. The hotel features artistic design inspired by nature, exquisite and remarkable facilities, meticulous and considerate St. Regis Butler Service, and the century-old hospitality of the House of Astor, and offers an emerging experience amid mountains and seas and beyond the clouds. From the resplendent iconic building, the guests can enjoy a panoramic view of the fascinating scenery and indulge in every moment of the stay. The hotel is a choice of luxury to reap inspiration and enlighten each other.

description.textZh: 青岛威斯汀酒店是一家注重健康的酒店，地处这座中国高速发展城市的优越位置，提供时尚现代的住宿环境和美味可口的特色佳肴。步入简洁清新的客房和套房，享受充满活力的住宿体验，在耸入云霄的酒店客房内饱览青岛市中心美景。欢迎前往酒店餐厅，乐享风味正宗的健康餐饮体验，从新鲜海鲜和传统中餐，到自助早餐现场烹饪台美食，品类非常丰富。酒店设有室内恒温泳池和威斯汀健身馆，助您在旅途中保持更佳健康状态。作为猫途鹰年度卓越奖入选单位，我们的酒店坐拥市中心优越位置，毗邻青岛海边，距离五四广场和奥帆中心等知名景点仅数分钟路程，提供逾 2000 平米雅致活动场地，是举办婚礼、会议和会展活动的理想之选。
description.textEn: Rise above the fray and find all you need for an empowering stay in Qingdao China. The Westin Qingdao is a wellness focused hotel with modern accommodations, delicious dining and a convenient location in the urban center of one of China's fast rising cities. Step into intuitive rooms and suites designed to keep you fresh and energized during your stay and inspired by our high-rise hotel's soaring views of the Qingdao city center. Enjoy healthful, authentic dining at our hotel restaurants, from fresh seafood and traditional Chinese to live cooking stations at our breakfast buffet. Enhance your well being in Qingdao, China by visiting our heated indoor pool or WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio. Our hotel, winner of Trip Advisor's Certificate of Excellence, offers over 2,000 square meter of elegant, chic event venues ideal for weddings, meetings or MICE events all with a city center location just minutes from Qingdao sights like May Fourth Square and the Olympic Sailing Center.

records.name_zh: 青岛西海岸威斯汀酒店

description.textZh: 青岛西海岸威斯汀酒店地处西海岸新区，邻近海滩，提供贴心周到的服务和齐全的设施，欢迎莅临下榻。现代化的酒店客房和套房配备天梦之床、天梦淋浴和天梦之浴等特色设施，助您重焕身心活力。客房配备平面电视，你可尽情欣赏心仪的电视节目；人体工学办公区助您高效办公，免费 Wi-Fi 让您轻松保持在线。酒店套房设有独立起居空间，入住套房可享行政酒廊礼遇。酒店内设先进的健身中心和室内泳池，提供装备租借服务，供您畅享健康运动生活。在酒店内的创意餐厅品尝可口美食，然后出门探索葱翠的当地景致，包括大珠山和唐岛湾等闻名的景点。酒店拥有逾 5,203 平米的精致活动空间，是您筹办会事活动、贸易展和社交庆典的理想之选。酒店邻近青岛世界博览城，是青岛现代会议综合体的一部分。
description.textEn: Located near the beach in the West Coast New Area, The Westin Qingdao West Coast welcomes guests traveling in China with caring service and thoughtful amenities. Recharge in our modern hotel rooms and suites which feature Heavenly® Beds, Heavenly® Showers and Heavenly® Baths. Relax while watching your favorite programming on the flat-screen TV, and stay connected using the ergonomic workstations and complimentary Wi-Fi. Suites enjoy separate living spaces and Club access. Take advantage of our state-of-the-art fitness center, gear lending program and indoor pool. Sample the delicious cuisine in the hotel's innovative restaurants before exploring the lush local scenery and attractions, including Dazhu Mountain and Tangdao Bay. For those planning events, our hotel has more than 56,000 square feet of sophisticated event space, ideal for the MICE market, trade shows and social celebrations. The property sits adjacent to Qingdao World Expo City and is part of the modern convention complex in Qingdao.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Qingdao, Jiaozhou
records.name_zh: 青岛胶州福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 青岛胶州福朋喜来登酒店是万豪国际旗下的一家高端酒店，拥有139间客房，配套健身中心等系列商务、休闲、餐饮及娱乐设施。酒店兼顾商务与休闲旅客需求，融合文旅与商务资源，提供多元高品质服务，致力打造一处城市全新地标。福朋酒店以旅客为中心，提供各项所需设施及服务，供您自在放松、悠然居停。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Jiaozhou Qingdao, an upscale hotel under Marriott International, offers over 139 guest rooms and a full range of business, leisure, dining and entertainment facilities including a fitness center. It caters to both business and leisure travelers, and aims to become a new urban landmark, integrating cultural, tourism and business resources to provide diversified and high-quality services.Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 清远狮子湖喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: With stunning Arabian architecture and a great golf course nearby, the lakefront Sheraton Qingyuan Lion Lake Resort is an ideal venue to enjoy nature and relax.
description.textEn: Welcome to Sheraton Qingyuan Lion Lake Resort. The resort is ideally situated right beside the scenic Lion Lake. While staying at the unique Arabian themed hotel, you may not only appreciate the distinctive building, but also the picturesque Lion Lake view or charge yourself on the 27-hole golf course. No matter for your MICE activity, leisure vacation or business trip, the resort will be your wish choice.

records.name_zh: 秦皇岛和信基业万怡酒店

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need, spacious,thoughtful guest rooms, a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Qinhuangdao West is located at No 36 Qiyunshan Road, Qinhuangdao Economic and Technological Development Zone, close to Qinhuangdao Economic and Technological Development Zone Management Committee and Qinhuangdao Garden Expo Park. It is 15 minutes drive from hotel to Beijing Harbin Expressway. Beidaihe Railway Station can be reached within 20 minute drive and Beidaihe Airport is 35 minutes drive.

records.name_zh: 秦皇岛海港万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Qinhuangdao Haigang located at the intersection of Hebei street and Youyi Road. It has 159 rooms, 24-hour opening fitness center, 24-hour service Fairfield Mart,and offers rich Chinese and Western breakfast cuisine.
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Qinhuangdao Haigang located at the intersection of Hebei Street and Youyi Road. It has 159 rooms, 24 hr opening fitness center, 24 hr service Fairfield Mart and offers rich Chinese and Western breakfast cuisine. The hotel is only 4.5 kilometers away from Qinhuangdao Railway Station which provides easy access to the citys major transportation hubs. It is surrounded by a strong commercial atmosphere and located in the city center adjacent to Maoye Shopping Mall, Wanda Shopping Plaza and The Peoples Park only 15 minutes drive from Qinhuangdao Wildlife Park and The New Australian Underwater World and only 4.5 kilometers from Dongshan and West Beach Bathing Place. It is an ideal place for business travel, traveling and shopping.

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels and Resorts, its our mission to make every business trip a pleasure and every vacation the trip of a lifetime. Enjoy amenity-filled guest rooms, superb dining, exemplary meeting facilities and our time-honored spirit to serve.
description.textEn: Providing 283 stylish guest rooms and suites exactly demonstrate how unique the Marriott modern aesthetic is. Every guest room features the signature bedding of Marriott Hotels and high-speed WiFi, full of spaciousness and leisure elements to offer a great choice for both of business and recreation.

records.name_zh: 秦皇岛北戴河喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻秦皇岛北戴河喜来登酒店，体验宽敞的客房和贴心的设施，以及专业工作人员的热情服务。酒店到秦皇岛奥林匹克公园和当地海滩均可步行抵达，邻近众多餐厅、主题公园和北戴河高铁站，还可便利前往其他当地景点。酒店客房配备豪华设施用品，您可在此惬意放松舒展。所有客房均配备平面电视、光线充足的书桌、免费Wi-Fi以及通往私人阳台的法式窗户。入住期间，您可以在室内泳池惬意畅游，或前往健身中心畅快锻炼，还可享用自助早餐。此外，您还可在酒店盛宴标帜餐厅享用国际美食、本地特色佳肴等。酒店拥有卓越的活动场地，配备先进的视听技术设施，提供专业策划和定制餐饮服务，是您举办活动的理想之选。秦皇岛北戴河喜来登酒店热诚期待您的光临！
description.textEn: Sheraton Qinhuangdao Beidaihe Hotel welcomes you with professional, friendly staff, spacious rooms and thoughtful amenities. Located walking distance from Qinhuangdao Olympic Park and area beaches our modern hotel is also near restaurants, theme parks and Beidaihe bullet train station making it easy to visit other attractions in China. Relax in upscale hotel rooms. Every room features Flat screen TVs, well lit desks, free WiFi and French windows leading to private balconies. Swim in the indoor pool, work out in the fitness center and take advantage of the buffet breakfasts. You also can indulge in delicious international and local specialty cuisine at our Feast restaurant. The hotel offers elevated venues with advanced audio visual technology, expert planning assistance and custom catering for your next event. We look forward to your stay at Sheraton Qinhuangdao Beidaihe Hotel.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hainan, Qiongzhong
records.name_zh: 海南琼中福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: At Four Points® by Sheraton hotels, our guest rooms feature comfortable beds, productive workspaces and fast, free Wi-Fi. We offer delicious food, work-out room and everything you need to host business events and meetings.
description.textEn: At Four Points by Sheraton hotels, form follows function and timeless classics are interwoven with modern details in every guest room. Enjoy stylish spaces, comfortable beds, productive workspaces and fast, free WiFi. We offer delicious food, work out room and everything you need to host business events and meetings.

records.name_zh: 泉州丰泽万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 距离华侨大学约1公里的泉州丰泽万豪万枫酒店，位于泉州市丰泽区鹤山路333号奇龙数字园内。在泉州，你可以去西街、钟楼、开元寺品味世界文化遗产泉州的历史气息或者悠闲信步，漫步于蟳埔渔村，身临其境感受蟳蜅女的民俗文化，亦或者爬爬清源山，走走洛阳桥，体验泉州“半城烟火半城仙”。酒店简约时尚的客房搭配现代风格的家具，开放式的室内空间设计让房间更显明亮宽敞。房内的设施兼具功能性、设计感和舒适度;舒适的床垫和五星级酒店同款床品尽享安心睡眠。酒店拥有98间，万枫餐厅，万枫小铺，24小时健身中心，24小时自助洗衣房。酒店客房为客人提供便利的设施以及免费的高速WiFi。万枫餐厅每日提供健康的早餐，为宾客繁忙的一天注入活力。24小时健身中心的无氧及有氧设备满足客人的健康需求。24小时的自助洗衣房提供免费的自助洗衣房以及烘干服务。放下繁复，归于简单，来泉州丰泽万豪万枫酒店，体验“简约之美”，一切一如预期。
description.textEn: The hotel has 98 guest rooms. Fairfield restaurant, Fairfield Market, 24-hour fitness center, and 24-hour self-service laundry room. The hotel rooms offer convenient facilities and free high-speed WiFi. Fairfield restaurant provides a healthy and nutritious breakfast every day. Injecting vitality into guests' busy schedules. The 24-hour fitness center's anaerobic and aerobic equipment meet with guests' health needs.24-hour self-service laundry room provides free self-service laundry and drying services.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Quanzhou Huian
records.name_zh: 泉州惠安福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 泉州惠安福朋喜来登酒店位于惠安螺阳镇世纪大道市中心位置，毗邻惠安体育馆、大型综合购物中心, 距离惠安高铁站车程15分钟， 地理位置优越。交通便利, 从酒店出发可前往泉州第三大海湾、洛阳桥、崇武古城景区等热门目的地。酒店整体设计融合当代艺术轻奢的创意元素, 倾情打造新锐旅者的理想之选。酒店拥有170间典雅客房和套间，可俯瞰惠安城景，客房配备了福朋高端“席梦思”床垫和舒适床品，为您营造宾至如归的住宿体验。在全日制餐厅-玩啤食社酒吧可体验世界各地精致美馔。让您尽享轻松愉悦的美好时刻。福朋喜来登以永恒经典、现代细节, 致敬新征程上的光明, 为商务出行及休闲旅客带来至臻难忘的城市回忆。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Huian sits in the downtown of Century Avenue, Luoyang Town, Huian. Adjacent to Huian Gymnasium and large - scale shopping malls, it’s a 15 - minute drive from Huian High - speed Railway Station, boasting a prime location and easy transport. From here, you can reach Quanzhou’s third - largest bay, Luoyang Bridge, Chongwu Ancient City Scenic Area and other hot spots.The hotel blends contemporary art - light luxury elements in design, an ideal pick for trendy travelers. It has 170 elegant rooms and suites with city views. Fitted with high - end Simmons mattresses and cozy bedding, they offer a homey stay. At The Eatery & Bar, savor global delicacies for a relaxed time.With timeless classics and modern touches, Four Points by Sheraton honors the new journey’s brightness, creating unforgettable memories for business and leisure guests.

description.textZh: 曲阜绿发JW万豪酒店是中国地区的大型 JW万豪品牌度假酒店，立足于品牌价值，提供齐全出色的服务、精心打造的现场体验和文化风情的餐饮体验。客房采用中式风情装饰，设有室外空间和先进的浴室设施。室内恒温泳池透过穹顶天花板自然采光，而健身中心和水疗服务则是保持健康、休闲放松的上佳之选。酒店拥有 JW Kitchen 和 Residence 两间餐厅，均设有精致包厢。宴会厅面积约为 800 平米，毗连前厅，配有巨大的高清液晶屏幕和专业的聚光灯，非常适合承接各类正式聚会。The Lounge 提供丰富的饮品，每周安排精彩纷呈的活动；嘉木馆茶室供应特色国际茶饮、茶风味饮品和诱人甜点，可谓休闲聚会和休闲放松的理想去处。世界文化遗产孔庙和孔府就在酒店附近，可便利前往游览。
description.textEn: JW Marriott Qufu Luneng is the largest JW Marriott brand resort hotel in China. Upholding its brand values, the JW Marriott Hotel Qufu offers seamless, anticipatory service alongside carefully orchestrated experiences and culturally rooted dining. Accommodations offer outdoor space, Chinese-inspired décor and state-of-the-art bathroom features. Natural light streams over the indoor heated pool through a domed ceiling, and the fitness center and spa services encourage wellness and relaxation. Formal gatherings can be hosted in the private dining rooms at JW Kitchen and Residence, the hotel’s two restaurants, or within the 800 square meters. ballroom featuring a massive HD LED screen, professional spotlights and an adjoining foyer. For casual get-togethers or down time, The Lounge offers an extensive beverage menu and weekly activities, and the Tea Library highlights international teas, tea-inspired beverages and tempting desserts. Next door, explore the World Heritage Confucius Temple and Confucius Mansion.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms; a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests. With locally-inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free Wi-Fi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive!

description.textZh: 日照福朋喜来登酒店位于山东省日照市东港区文化综合体广场，毗邻海曲公园，酒店位置优越，城市风景宜人。酒店以“竹节形象构造”，打造日照城市形象界面为目标，融入永恒经典与现代工业风格元素，提供国际知名的睡眠系统和沐浴系统，高效的办公与独特的餐饮文娱体验服务，致力于满足全球旅行者的切实需求。 福朋喜来登品牌特色“玩啤食社”旨在为独立旅行者平衡工作和生活，在这里宾客可以放松身心，尽享 “醇饮优选”计划，体验当地真实而亲切的环境氛围，致力于打造华北地区“一节复一节，千枝攒万叶”的实践者和探索者。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Rizhao is situated in the Cultural Complex Square of Donggang District, Rizhao, Shandong Province, adjacent to Haiqu Park. With the design of ‘Bamboo Structure’, which combines eternal classic and modern industrial style in to construction elements, the hotel aims to create a modern city image of Rizhao. It is equipped with internationally renowned brand from bedroom amenities to bath facilities, offers unique catering and entertainment services and is dedicated to meeting the practical demands of global travelers.The brand feature ‘THE MESH’ of Four Points by Sheraton aims to balance work and life for independent travelers. Here, guests can unwind, enjoy the ‘Best Brews’ program, experience the local authentic and intimate environment, and strive to become practitioners and leaders in North China.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Rizhao Central Activities Zone
records.name_zh: 日照中央活力区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Occupies the prime location at the golden convergence of Resort Area, University Town & Living District, directly linked to Outlets & Wanda Plaza. Advanced fitness center. Meticulous service.
description.textEn: Located at the golden convergence of Rizhao Resort Area, University Town, and Living District, the Four Points by Sheraton Rizhao Central Vibrant Zone is directly connected to Outlets Plaza and Wanda Plaza, and only 1.9 kilometers from the Yellow Sea coastline.The hotel offers 153 guest rooms, providing a high-quality accommodation environment, comfortable room facilities, and a rich selection of dining and entertainment options, aiming to help independent travelers balance work and life. Experience the brand's signature "THE MESH™", featuring various international buffets to exquisite afternoon teas, immersing you in a truly authentic and welcoming local atmosphere. The hotel houses an advanced fitness center for you to enjoy a healthy and active lifestyle. Meticulous and thoughtful service is provided to meet all your needs.The hotel is an ideal base for both business exploration and coastal leisure.

description.textZh: 日照喜来登酒店是万豪国际位于山东日照的第一家酒店，是这座城市的新地标，与海洋公园、奥林匹克水上公园及海水浴场等景区共拥海岸线，步行可抵达万平口景区。酒店拥有333间宽敞舒适的客房，配以宽阔的观海阳台为您展开一览无余的海景视野。同时，酒店拥有超3343平方米的会议空间，包括1个1200平方米的无柱式宴会厅，2个多功能厅以及5个大小各异的会议厅。还拥有三大特色餐厅及两间酒吧，为您奉上舌尖饕餮盛宴。健身中心、特色水疗中心、室内恒温泳池，配备齐全的凯知乐儿童乐园，为您打造商务出行与休闲娱乐“拼“在一起的欢乐时光。
description.textEn: Sheraton Rizhao Hotel offers 334 spacious and comfortable guest rooms, including 22 suites and 1 presidential suite. With direct seaside views and spacious balconies, the guest rooms are equipped with high-quality facilities and popular Sheraton bedding to provide you with a warm and cozy living experience.Sheraton Rizhao Hotel offers a total of 3343 square meters of meeting space, with 1 elegant 1200-square-meter grand ballroom, 2 function rooms, and 5 meeting rooms. Professional audiovisual equipment and a dedicated event service team will ensure that your meeting or event is memorable. With four distinguished restaurants and bars, Sheraton Rizhao Hotel is always welcoming guests with fine dining and delectable cuisine.

records.name_en: The Shanhaitian Resort Sanya, Autograph Collection
records.name_zh: 三亚绿发山海天酒店·傲途格精选

description.textZh: 三亚绿发山海天酒店·傲途格精选位于有中国“东方夏威夷”之称的海南岛大东海。大东海水清沙幼、风光秀丽，是紧邻市中心的热带天堂。酒店有着迷人以及别具一格前卫的设计，为宾客呈献一场别具特色的时尚创意盛宴。 靠近三亚市中心，位于宁静的海边，客人可在约60分钟内抵达大部分风景区。酒店拥有齐全，品质代表的设施，可满足各年龄段宾客的需求:户外泳池、The SPA Collection 水疗中心、健身中心 、儿童俱乐部和商务中心。客房由泰国知名设计事务所P49 Design & Associates担纲设计，以非凡时尚为灵感，借鉴当地知名设计师们常用的别具一格色调，荟萃意式优雅、法式时尚、英式华丽和美式经典四款鲜明风格，彰显四大设计之都的划时代美学。酒店设有199间客房和17间套房，面积从62平方米到348平方米不等，共有8种房型可供选择。房内浴室设有在窗边的浴缸并配有APPELLES卫浴套装；室内设有迷你酒吧。酒店设有礁、居、映、廊、聚五个用餐地点。酒店提供的服务设施包括：有线/无线高速上网的视听设备、专业的宴会/会议服务人员，以及婚礼策划专家团队。无论是商务之旅或休闲旅行，酒店都是您的理想下榻之选，让您尽享舒适、旅获精彩。
description.textEn: Treat yourself to a stay on the stunning shores of the China Hawaii of the East at The Shanhaitian Resort Sanya Autograph Collection. Located on Hainan island our oceanfront hotel boasts views of pristine white sands, crystal clear waters and stunning tropical vistas from every window. Take just steps from our upscale accommodations to relax under the sun on Dadonghai Bay beach or drive just 5 minutes to entertaining attractions, fine dining and shopping in Sanyas city center. If relaxing at our hotel take the time to explore our deluxe amenities including a fitness center, multiple pools and full service spa. Dine in our popular hotel restaurants featuring freshly prepared cuisine or retire for the evening in modern guest rooms with sleek decor, plush bedding and complimentary WiFi. If planning events, you will appreciate our sophisticated venue spaces with state of the art technology and premium services. We look forward to welcoming you at The Shanhaitian Resort Sanya Autograph Collection.

description.textZh: Inspired by the sea, The Sanya EDITION is located in Haitang Bay, in Southern China. Find a truly unique hotel experience, where relaxation comes naturally. Features include a "private ocean," luxurious suites, villas and rooms and dynamic dining.
description.textEn: Nestled in Haitang Bay The Sanya EDITION is a distinctive destination offering unexpected experiences for the next generation of luxury travelers. Water, a source of vitality and serenity, plays a central role in our resort which features a spectacular private ocean replete with a charming floating table and secluded cabanas. This sense of elevated luxury and indigenous beauty is established at our hotels reception area where a pool and live bamboo grove serve as a counterpoint to a curated art gallery displaying the work of renowned artists. All of the 501 guestrooms in the horseshoe shaped hotel and most of them have ocean views. At the meeting center, the separation between outside and inside disappears with teak floored rooms, a sunken courtyard and a lush garden area. Set amid 50 acres, our hotel is 40 minutes from downtown Sanya and is also a short trip away from attractions like the China Duty Free Complex.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Hainan, Sanya

description.textZh: Located at Sanya Bay, opposite the beach. Convenient location offers easy access to all the local sightseeing and walking distance to the city center, shopping, nightlife and the popular night markets. The airport is just 10 kilometers away.
description.textEn: Welcome to the Four Points by Sheraton Hainan Sanya. Here you can get what you are looking for with the style and service you want. We have what matters most to you like a comfortable bed, 180 degrees Ocean view, a delicious breakfast and fresh coffee. You will also find free Internet in the hotel, free bottled water in your room, great local beers with Best Brews and much more. Whether you are in the area for work or just fun, you are in for a great stay with us.

records.name_en: JW Marriott Hotel Sanya Dadonghai Bay
records.name_zh: 三亚绿发山海天JW万豪酒店

description.textZh: 三亚绿发山海天JW万豪酒店周边群山环绕，热带植物郁郁葱葱，坐拥壮丽的山峦和海洋美景,更可欣赏到唯美的日出景观。酒店地理位置得天独厚，驱车约10分钟即可达市中心，驱车约35分钟即可达三亚凤凰国际机场。酒店设有435间宽敞舒适的客房及套间。酒店会议设施设备齐全，会议区域面积达4,000平方米，其中包括一个916平方米的大宴会厅、1000平方米的海滨草坪、婚礼堂及多个小型会议厅和多功能厅。酒店拥有包括中餐、西餐及韩日式餐厅在内的三间餐厅，包含行政酒廊在内的四间酒吧酒廊及一间烘焙店，可为宾客提供丰富的餐饮体验。24小时开放的海景健身房、台球室、JW万豪水疗中心等为宾客提供舒适的休闲娱乐体验。此外酒店还设有2个室外泳池及室外面积达2850平方米的小龖人儿童乐园和室内面积700平方米的星奇宝贝儿童俱乐部令全家尽享各种乐趣。无论是休闲或商务之旅，酒店都是您的理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: Experience 5-star luxury in a prime Sanya location at JW Marriott Hotel Sanya Dadonghai Bay. Surrounded by lush tropical mountains and the ocean on Hainan Island, our resort offers spectacular sunrise and views, just moments from downtown shopping, dining and nightlife. Maritime Coral Reefs Natural Reserve adjoins our hotel. Settle into one of 435 modern hotel rooms in our West or East Tower, many with ocean views. Enjoy memorable dining experiences in JW Kitchen, Man Ho and Smoki Moto restaurants. Relax with express treatments or full-service indulgences in our luxurious Spa by JW. Take a dip in our two outdoor pools or workout in our modern 24-hour fitness center. Host a social or business gathering in our 10 sophisticated venues, including the largest ballroom in Dadonghai Bay. When you are ready to explore Sanya, visit Lu Hui Tou Mountain and Lu Hui Tou Park, or shop at City Center Mall and the China Duty-Free Shop nearby. An unrivaled resort destination experience awaits you at our 5-star Sanya hotel.

records.name_en: JW Marriott Sanya Haitang Bay Resort & Spa
records.name_zh: 三亚海棠湾 JW 万豪度假酒店

description.textZh: JW Marriott Sanya Haitang Bay, located on the Haitang Bay, the National Coast of China, marks JW Marriott’s eighteenth hotel in Greater China, with the lush landscape of Haitang Bay and illustrating the beguiling charm of the entire coast.
description.textEn: JW Marriott Sanya Haitang Bay, located on the Haitang Bay, the National Coast of China. A 40-minute drive from Sanya Phoenix International Airport. The propertys 141 guestrooms and 19 villas, ranging from 735 sq ft to 7,180 sq ft., feature private balconies and combine modern designs with genuine aesthetics to create the optimum sense of relaxation. Two exquisite dining facilities ensure the ultimate epicurean experience for travelers. Guests can enjoy live cooking presentations in JW Kitchens all-day open-kitchen restaurant or relax in the tropical ambiance of the JW Lounge, featuring signature cocktails and wines from around the world. Additionally, JW Marriott Sanya Haitang Bay highlights its commitment to naturally-inspired dining through its JW Garden to offer fresh, local ingredients for authentic farm-to-table dining experiences.Guests also can rejuvenate at the fully-equipped Health Club featuring over nine different-sized pools, or enjoy pampering at the luxurious Spa by JW.

records.name_en: Sanya Marriott Yalong Bay Resort & Spa
records.name_zh: 三亚亚龙湾万豪度假酒店

description.textZh: 三亚亚龙湾万豪度假酒店于2020年年底焕新，坐落于亚龙湾延绵约7公里长的海岸线上，这里海清沙幼、椰影婆娑，生长着众多奇花异草和原始热带植被，酒店拥有452间豪华舒适的客房，辅以先进的空气净化处理技术保障宾客安心入住。在时尚简约的客房内，您可将亚龙湾的美景尽收眼底。您可徜徉于我们的洁白海滩，或漫步于10公顷的热带花园，任海风轻抚。三亚亚龙湾万豪度假酒店距离三亚凤凰国际机场约30分钟车程，距离亚龙湾火车站仅约10分钟车程；二个锦标赛级标准高尔夫球场与酒店仅是几步之遥。无论是在备受认可的日本料理餐厅享用地道美食还是在百幕大草坪散步，三亚亚龙湾万豪度假酒店定能让您收获精彩旅程。
description.textEn: Nestled on a pristine sweeping crescent of white sand beach, encircled by rainforest and caressed by calm and crystal-clear waters, newly renovated in 2020, the Sanya Marriott Yalong Bay Resort and Spa offers 452 spacious, modern rooms and suites equipped with advanced air-purifier with elevated amenities and commanding views of the famous Yalong Bay, the mountains or the tropical gardens. Once in a lifetime memories happen at the elegant Ocean Front Wedding Chapel and meetings accommodating up to 900 attendees have every advantage for success. Numerous activities abound for families from our dedicated Kids Club, that newly renovated in July 2023, to beach days, multiple pools and more. Book a spa treatment to instill a sense of tranquility and restore balance. Dine onsite at our all-day restaurant or have a gourmet experience at Edogin. When you are seeking a true resort experience in China, the 5-star Sanya Marriott Yalong Bay Resort and Spa is the preferable choice for a safe and comfy pure beach holiday.

records.name_zh: 三亚海棠湾万丽度假酒店

description.textZh: 入住三亚海棠湾万丽度假酒店，可观赏美丽的日出景色、感受热带园林的活力和体验原生态海滩的魅力。在客房内，您可观赏到美丽的海景，同样，为了宾客的方便，每间客房都配有空调、室内保险箱以及豪华床上用品。无论您想品尝国际美食还是本土菜肴，无论您想体验海鲜大餐亦或食用快餐汉堡，我们的餐厅都可满足您；我们致力打造非凡的饮食氛围来满足宾客不断变化的味觉需求。酒店14万平米的热带园林内，拥有超过200种植物。茂盛的植被以及高覆盖率，使得整个园林富含负氧离子，空气清新宜人。适宜的负氧离子有益健康，唤醒身体活力。漫步其中，使人神清气爽，身心愉悦。三亚海棠湾万丽度假酒店的其他设施包括健身中心、环礁湖游泳池、带有滑梯的儿童游泳池和儿童俱乐部，在我们的保龄球馆您可开展许多休闲运动。酒店内设可容纳900人且装饰精美的宴会厅。当您想进行一次家庭度假、蜜月之旅或商务会议，这里是理想选择，酒店距离位于海棠湾规模宏大的免税商场仅约10分钟车程。三亚海棠湾万丽度假酒店位置优越，设施齐全，将为您带来难忘的住宿享受。
description.textEn: Discover incredible sunsets, spectacular tropical landscaping and pristine beaches at Renaissance Sanya Haitang Bay Resort a sophisticated hotel located at Haitang Bay on the South China Sea. Guest rooms offer breathtaking views, air conditioning, an inroom safe, an iPod docking system and deluxe bedding. From International and Chinese dining to seafood and burgers our restaurants provide the ideal atmosphere for meeting up with family or friends. Other amenities include a fitness center, a lagoon pool, a kids pool with slide, a kids club and recreational activities such as a bowling alley. Our event facilities are highlighted by an exquisite grand ballroom that accommodates more than 900 guests. Visit the world's largest duty free mall in Haitang Bay only a 10 minute drive away. When planning a family holiday, honeymoon or conference, our hotel will exceed your every expectation.

records.name_zh: 三亚海棠湾喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: Offering a selection of well-appointed hotel rooms and suites, Sheraton Sanya Haitang Bay Resort has a variety of family-friendly activities on offer, including watersports, as well as 5 pools, complimentary 718 ㎡ kids club, fitness center and spa.
description.textEn: Experience effortless service and smart solutions at Sheraton Sanya Haitang Bay Resort. Located on the beachfront at Haitang Bay, Sanya, our family-friendly resort provides a variety of hotel rooms and suites, all with private balconies or terraces, offering stunning garden or ocean views. All rooms feature stylish finishing touches to help you stay connected, such as flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi. Cool off after trying out watersport activities with a swim in one of our resort's 5 pools, or recharge at the spa. Other leisure facilities include an outdoor tennis court, a 24-hour state-of-the-art fitness center and a biking trail. After a busy day exploring Haitang Bay, hotel guests can select from a variety of international and local food options, including alfresco restaurants, all-day buffet dining and 24-hour room service. For those wishing to host a meeting or special event, our hotel has an array of inspiring spaces complete with smart technology and bespoke planning services to ensure a successful day.

description.textZh: 全家一起入住三亚喜来登度假酒店，尊享宁静的海岛逍遥游体验。这家尊尚度假酒店位于热门的海滨城市三亚，可俯瞰美丽的亚龙湾，服务体贴周到，让您尽情体验充实而清新的海岛之旅。客房宽敞舒适，提供豪华睡床、现代化的浴室和娱乐系统，可欣赏酒店及大海美景。从正宗的当地菜和粤菜到丰富多彩的国际及泛亚美食，这家位于三亚的尊尚度假酒店为家庭用餐提供理想的精致餐饮体验。设有两座恒温泳池、24 小时健身中心和私人度假酒店水疗中心，尽享休闲放松体验。我们的三亚酒店还提供一系列非凡的活动场地，从优雅的大宴会厅到美丽的荷园和僻静的海滩均一应俱全，是举办婚礼与私人聚会的理想之所。无论您到访三亚是为了浪漫逍遥游还是家庭度假，欢迎预订住宿三亚喜来登度假酒店，尊享超凡体验。
description.textEn: Enjoy a serene island getaway with the whole family at Sheraton Sanya Resort. Located in the popular seaside city of Sanya and overlooking gorgeous Yalong Bay, our 5 star resort offers all you need for a fulfilling, refreshing island visit. Spacious, comfortable accommodations offer plush beddings, modern bathrooms and entertainment systems and beautiful views of our hotel property and the sea. Choose from exquisite family-friendly dining options at our 5 star Sanya resort from authentic local and Cantonese fare, to dynamic international and pan Asian cuisines. Relax and unwind with our two heated pools, 24 hour fitness center and private resort spa. Our Sanya hotel also offers an extraordinary array of event venues ideal for weddings and private gatherings from our elegant Grand Ballroom venue to our lovely Lotus Garden and secluded beaches. Whether you're visiting Sanya for a romantic escape or a family vacation, reserve your stay at Sheraton Sanya Resort for an experience that goes beyond the ordinary.

records.name_en: The St. Regis Sanya Yalong Bay Resort
records.name_zh: 三亚亚龙湾瑞吉度假酒店

description.textZh: 在三亚亚龙湾瑞吉度假酒店，凝望波光粼粼的碧蓝海水、郁郁葱葱的棕榈树以及线条柔和的山丘，您很快便会发现自己置身于一片天堂之地。三亚位于海南岛南端，素有“东方夏威夷”之美誉。位于亚龙湾的瑞吉度假酒店被原始红树林保护区所环绕着，具有浓厚自然气息的迷人环境。宁静的海滩上设有多座泳池和一间酒廊，是您休闲放松的好去处。四间餐厅和一间酒吧，风味正宗，氛围休闲。酒店设有 396 间客房，其中包括 37 间套房和 28 座俯瞰亚龙湾的海滩别墅。铱瑞水疗中心雅致非凡，提供定制护理体验。瑞吉管家将为您提供完善的个性化服务，悉心为您解答所有疑问，竭力满足您在三亚期间的各种需求。
description.textEn: Gazing upon glistening blue waters, lush green palms and gentle mountainsides, you will soon discover that you have found a little piece of paradise at The St. Regis Sanya Yalong Bay Resort. As Hainan’s most southern tip, Sanya is often referred to as the “Hawaii of the East”. A marina and a protected mangrove forest surround the hotel, immersing you in natural beauty. Enjoy a dip in one of the pools.Culinary experiences await you in each of our three restaurants and two bars, with authentic flavors and relaxing ambiences. The hotel's 396 rooms include 38 suites and 28 beach villas overlooking Yalong Bay. Iridium Spa offers distinctive elegance, delivering customized experiences. St. Regis Butlers provide flawless, personalized attention during your stay in Sanya - offering one point of contact to answer all of your questions and meet all of your needs.

records.name_zh: 金茂三亚亚龙湾丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: Explore the true nature of Southermost China at The Ritz-Carlton Sanya, Yalong Bay. With a private beach on Yalong Bay, the region’s largest Ritz-Carlton Spa and exceptional accommodations, this Sanya luxury hotel is an unforgettable retreat.
description.textEn: Lying on the southernmost tip of Chinas Hainan Island, the city of Sanya become a premier location for memorable celebrations, business conference and incentive program travelers, because of its unique ambiance and unsurpassed environment. 446 well-appointed, over-sized guestrooms at over 65 sqm, 42 rooms and suites on Club level with distinctive amenities, 19 suites and 33 private villas with individual plunge pools. More than 1700sqm, 18282 square feet of meeting and banquet space including an oceanfront wedding chapel at the beachside. With an abundance option of unique dining experiences in 7 restaurants and bars. A luxurious Ritz-Carlton Spa, 5 swimming pools and nearby world-class golf course provide a rich variety of activities to participate in.

records.name_en: The Taikang Sanya, a Tribute Portfolio Resort
records.name_zh: 三亚泰康臻品之选度假酒店

description.textZh: The Taikang Sanya, a Tribute Portfolio Resort, located in Haitang Bay, is a high-end hotel developed by the Taikang Insurance Group, a Fortune Global 500 company, and managed by Marriott International, Inc. Designed by the globally known Neri&Hu Design.
description.textEn: The Taikang Sanya a Tribute Portfolio Resort located in Haitang Bay is a high-end hotel developed by the Taikang Insurance Group a Fortune Global 500 company and managed by Marriott International,Inc. Designed by the globally known Neri&Hu Design and Research Office, the hotel features a total construction area of nearly 80,000m2 and a greening rate of 50 percent. The hotel promises an unparalleled resort experience with the state-of-the-art service and unique products in a pristine and serene natural environment. The hotel is equipped with 337 guest rooms and 4 restaurants and bars, offering the best in leisure and entertainment. Our thoughtful design ensures our facilities can be accessed by guests of all ages so they can enjoy an incredibly comfortable and pleasant stay. The design of the astylar banquet hall that covers 1,000m2 and our 5 meeting rooms of different sizes is sure to meet all of your conference and wedding ceremony needs. We also invite you to indulge your senses in our Xanadu-like garden.

records.name_en: The Westin Sanya Haitang Bay Resort
records.name_zh: 三亚海棠湾民生威斯汀度假酒店

description.textZh: 三亚海棠湾民生威斯汀度假酒店紧邻cdf三亚国际免税城，酒店内设有步行通道让海岛度假和免税购物无缝衔接。酒店拥有453间宽敞的客房、套房与别墅，宽阔迷人的园林错落在12,000平方米丰富的水系中，特色河道泳池、空中海景无边泳池、沙滩泳池等别致的泳池设计打造出一个奇趣缤纷、活力焕发的水上乐园，为宾客开启热带海岛的精彩度假体验。酒店的餐饮种类丰富，知味西餐厅提供威斯汀营养美味菜单和自助早餐；中国元素餐厅可品味地道海南菜、粤菜以及全国各地经典菜肴；舞·日本料理餐厅采用不同新鲜食材打造日式美馔；水汀沙滩餐厅，拥有浪漫优雅的户外就餐环境，星空下品尝海鲜烧烤和琳琅满目的中西式美食。位于酒店顶层的拾楼·餐厅及酒吧，室内设有格调优雅的私密包厢及酒廊，室外配备空中海景无边泳池和露台酒吧。融合无边海景、美食美酒及音乐表演等元素打造出一个独特活力的多元化餐饮空间。酒店还设有10个总面积达 2,700 平米的会议与多功能空间，其中包括面积1, 200平米的大宴会厅，同时拥有超8,800平米的户外草坪，灵活契合团队会议及活动客户的需求。
description.textEn: Adjacent to Sanya International Duty Free Shopping Complex, The Westin Sanya Haitang Bay Resort features an exclusive pedestrian walkway, blending island vacation with duty-free shopping seamlessly. It offers 453 spacious guest rooms, suites and villas. Over 10,000㎡ of pool water systems are scattered in tropical gardens, with distinctive river pool and infinity pool creating a vibrant tropical water park.Diverse catering options are available, including Seasonal Tastes All Day Dining, Five Sen5e Chinese Restaurant, Mai Japanese Restaurant and Splash Beach Restaurant, covering global flavors and local Hainan cuisine. The Upper Room Restaurant & Bar, with elegant style, combines infinity sea views, food and live music.There are 10 multi-functional meeting spaces (total 2,700㎡) and an 8,800㎡ outdoor lawn, perfectly meeting the needs of team meetings and events.

description.textZh: 上海虹桥雅乐轩酒店位于上海虹桥商务区核心枢纽，毗邻国家会展中心，无缝衔接地铁2号线、17号线，13号线（在建）即将解锁，多维交通网络瞬息之间速通虹桥枢纽及上海高光地标。295间“乐窝”客房融入当代元素，以时尚格调迸发出灵感火花。WXYZ 酒吧沉浸在音乐与灵感之中，下班后啜饮特调鸡尾酒畅享欢愉，在Re:Fuel by Aloft品尝精致小食，开启味蕾的满足体验。酒店拥有约1000平方米的多功能空间，可通过灵活组合轻松满足各类需求，400㎡无柱创意空间以9米挑高打破思维边界，高清LED显示屏带来震撼视觉，开启沉浸式决策。更配有车辆直达通道可驶入策略室，为活动呈现耳目一新的视觉体验。Depot by Aloft设有130个座位及3间贵宾包房（共40个座位），呈现多元风味的早餐，为新的晨光注入满满活力，同时为您补充每日所需的蛋白质、维生素与碳水。全天开放的Re:Charge健身房唤醒活力脉搏，随时燃动身体。在上海虹桥雅乐轩酒店，尽情探索未知精彩，定义旅居新体验。
description.textEn: Aloft Shanghai Hongqiao located in the center of Hongqiao Business District as neighbor of National Exhibition and Convention Center, Near Metro Line 2/17 and upcoming Line 13; instant access to city landmarks via multi-dimensional transport. 295 “Aloft” rooms infused with contemporary factors, icon with stylish and inspiring sparks. WXYZ bar, fills you with joy while sipping unique cocktail, enjoy dedicate finger-snack at Re:Fuel after work.1000sqm function spaces, with flexible combination to meet demands, includes 390sqm ballroom featuring stunning HD LED screen, and unique drive-in tactic room presenting new different vision. Wake up, start day with diversified breakfast in Depot by Aloft, venue with 130 seats and 3 private dining rooms (total 40 seats) where you gain daily protein, vitamins & carbohydrates. Power up pulse at Re:Charge to keep body burning anytime 24/7. Put yourself to explore unknown, define your stay.

records.name_zh: 上海张江海科雅乐轩酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻上海张江海科雅乐轩酒店，从容体验上海精彩生活。酒店设计时尚，富有都市风情，地理位置便利，位于上海张江科技园这一重要战略区域，邻近众多制药、生物技术、高科技、电气和IT企业。酒店距新国际博览中心和上海迪士尼乐园仅约10分钟车程，距上海浦东国际机场仅25公里左右，步行5分钟左右即可抵达地铁13号线中科路站。酒店客房尽显现代风范，配备高速免费Wi-Fi、落地窗和超舒适床品。在设施齐全的健身中心畅意锻炼，之后可前往酒店餐厅用餐，或在能量：站选购便捷外带小吃。酒店活动场地空间灵活，配备先进的视听技术设施，是举办各类聚会的理想之选。从酒店驾车出发可轻松抵达上海大部分热门景点，包括豫园、外滩和上海博物馆，供您尽情探索。
description.textEn: Experience the city from Aloft Shanghai Zhangjiang Haike. Urban-inspired and stylishly designed, our hotel is conveniently located in Shanghai Zhangjiang Tech Park, an important strategic area adjacent to many pharmaceutical, biotech, high-tech, electric and IT companies. We're only a 10-minute-drive from both the New International Expo Center and Shanghai Disneyland, just 25 kilometers away from Shanghai Pudong International Airport, PVG, and within five minutes’ walking distance of Metro 13 of ZhongKe Road Station. Unwind in modern hotel rooms with fast and free WiFi, French windows and ultra-comfortable bedding. Break a sweat in our well-equipped fitness center, followed by a meal in our hotel restaurant or a grab-and-go snack from our Re: Fuel. Host your next gathering in our flexible spaces, equipped with the latest audiovisual technology. In the mood to explore, many of Shanghai's most famous attractions are an easy drive from the hotel, from Yu Garden and The Bund to the Shanghai Museum.

description.textZh: 宝格丽酒店及度假村桂冠上第六颗宝石—上海宝格丽酒店，坐落于拥有丰厚历史人文背景的苏河湾，它将惬意的自然景观、当代的设计风格以及经典的历史建筑精妙平衡。精心保护及修缮后的上海历史保护建筑—上海总商会大楼，与环绕着盎然自然景观的48层宝格丽大楼巧妙融合，共同组成了上海宝格丽酒店。酒店的室内设计，一如曩昔的选择了意大利建筑事务所ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel 来共同打造。置于宝格丽大楼顶端8层的上海宝格丽酒店，可俯瞰外滩美景和观赏壮观的上海天际线、传奇浦江和蜿蜒苏河。拥有82间典雅的客房及套房，其中包括19间酒店甄选套房，房间面积均逾60平方米，为宾客打造沪上罕见的宽敞空间。酒店提供多处餐饮选择，包含47层 Il Ristorante – Niko Romito 由当代知名的烹饪大师之一Niko Romito主理；宝格丽酒吧标志性的椭圆形吧台，是精英人士聚会的理想之地。宝格丽水疗与健身中心拥有25米室内恒温泳池，更有美甲美发沙龙及男士理容室，为您打造美好体验。
description.textEn: Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai is located just 3 minutes from the iconic Bund, yet enjoys a tranquil and exclusive setting amongst private gardens, historic buildings and art galleries. Occupying the uppermost 8 floors of a 48-storey tower, the hotel offers stunning views of The Bund and Shanghai's dramatic skyline. With just 82 rooms and suites, guests can look forward to an intimate ambience and highly personalized service, yet the hotel provides some of the most extensive facilities in the city, including 6 restaurants and bars, a 2,000 square meter spa and fitness center, and state-of-the-art meeting facilities. The hotel rooms will be contemporary, glamorous and exceptionally spacious, with panoramic views from every window. Magnificent suites will include the extraordinary 570 square meter BVLGARI Suite.
