Adjoining the hotel tower is the historic former Chamber of Commerce Shanghai, originally built in 1916 and now completely restored to evoke memories of its glorious past.

description.textZh: 酒店地处于上海繁华的市中心，毗邻人民广场和静安寺商区，位于闹中取静的恒丰路。酒店前方50米为地铁1号线汉中路站，以及法国、瑞士、荷兰和德国的签证中心。酒店配有451间客房，设有室内恒温游泳池和健身中心。全酒店无线网络覆盖。热门的南京路商区（梅陇镇广场，恒隆广场，中信泰富）、静安寺商区、淮海路商区及人民广场商区酒店距离约不到9分钟车程。知名旅游景点豫园，外滩，田子坊，东方明珠，海洋馆驱车约20分钟内方可到达。上海迪士尼乐园驱车约40分钟内方可达到。世博展览中心，新国际展览中心以及国家展览中心约30分钟车程可到达。迁址后的上海自然博物馆距离酒店步行仅需约10分钟。无论是商旅出差，观光旅游，参展布展，还是亲子游，上海浦西万怡酒店均是不二选择。酒店距离虹桥国际机场约30分钟车程，距离浦东国际机场约1小时车程。酒店拥有各式舒适客房，客房面积从38-58平方米不等，设计时尚。配有隔音落地窗，确保客人可享受宁静的夜晚，更配备了37英寸液晶电视和卫星频道、保险箱、符合人体设计的书桌和椅子、沏茶/咖啡设施和冰箱。315平米现代典雅大宴会厅，拥有自然采光，会议场地总面积达500平方米，4间多功能会议室。24小时健身中心免费为住店客人服务。客人也可以选择在MoMo Café餐厅内品尝丰盛美食。
description.textEn: The hotel is located in the commercial centre of Shanghai Jingan District, the Jingan District is an ideal destination for business and leisure. The Metro line 1, 3, 4, 12, 13 just 200 meter from hotel, take you to the Shanghai Railway Station, Yu Garden, Xin Tian Di, Tian Zi Fang, Shanghai Museum of Natural History, Nanjing Road West, Jing An Temple, and People's Square. In addition, hotel is just 30 minutes from Hongqiao International Airport and 50 minutes from Pudong International Airport. Guests will enjoy spacious accommodations featuring well-lit desks, high-speed Internet, in-room safes and mini-bars, as well as a 30th-floor Executive Lounge with panoramic skyline views. To satisfy your craving, our MoMo cafe, MoMo 2 Go and lounges offer coffee, cocktails and casual dining throughout the day. Jump-start your day in our 24-hour fitness center, unwind in our indoor heated pool. To meet with clients in our state-of-the-art event facilities will lead you to focus on a successful session.

records.name_en: Courtyard by Marriott Shanghai Changfeng Park
records.name_zh: 上海苏宁环球万怡酒店

description.textZh: 苏州河畔的上海苏宁环球万怡酒店，位于普陀区长风生态商业园区的核心位置——苏宁·天御国际广场。上海跨国采购会展中心及国家会展中心近在咫尺，东临上海长风海洋世界，乐高探索中心和长风大悦城商场。其222间装潢典雅的客房，均配备人性化周到的现代化设施，并可饱览窗外新古典主义欧式庭院的静谧舒适。庭院不仅令旅客尽享散步的闲适，更能提供欧式草坪婚礼，为良缘缔结承诺。约730平方米的多功能会议空间，包括一间约368平方米的无柱宴会厅并配备全彩LED高清显示屏，无论商务会务还是私人宴会，其震撼的视听效果尽显豪华。6间功能齐备的会议厅和便捷的商务中心，专业的会议及宴会策划团队，缔造定制化品质会务服务。万荟轩餐厅，集烹饪匠心、安全优质的食材、惬意的用餐空间、私人雅致的包房，不断将美食理念推陈出新，演绎美味经典，传承美食文化。别具格调的大堂吧，以其简约布局和舒适宽敞的环境，欢迎着来自五湖四海的商旅客人，而提供的精致下午茶和醇厚口感的酒水，为客人们减轻旅途和工作的疲劳，为唤醒饱满精神带来周到的呵护。24小时的健身中心、礼品店、礼宾部、洗熨服务及停车场等服务，让每一位入店体验的客人，享受宾至如归的欣喜。
description.textEn: Experience the stylish comfort of Courtyard Shanghai Changfeng Park during your travels through China. This modern Putuo District hotel is conveniently near Changfeng CBD, Shanghai Convention & Exhibition Center of International Sourcing, the Suning Art Museum and Changfeng Park. Inside, the hotel offers 222 rooms and suites boasting exceptional views of our classical European courtyard. Recharge in new rooms and suites that offer indulgent bedding, flat-screen TVs, cozy reading chairs, marble bathrooms, ample desks and free Wi-Fi. Savor delicious, globally-inspired restaurant cuisine, and work out in the 24-hour fitness center. Event planners will appreciate our more than 9,000 square feet of elevated venues, including private dining rooms, a pillarless ballroom ideal for high-impact presentations and a picturesque lawn. We look forward to welcoming you to Courtyard Shanghai Changfeng Park.

description.textZh: 酒店毗邻复旦大学、上海财经大学、同济大学等知名学府，距离北外滩仅 10 分钟车程，距离虹口体育场及五角场商圈 8 分钟车程。酒店配备 120 个停车位，步行 6 分钟即可抵达地铁 3 号线。酒店共设有 328 间客房，所有客房均配备全新设施，包括液晶电视与高速上网服务，酒店健身中心 24 小时开放。
description.textEn: Located next to renowned universities including Fudan, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, and Tongji, the hotel is a 10-minute drive from North Bund and 8 minutes from both Hongkou Stadium and the Wujiaochang commercial area. It offers 120 parking spaces and is a 6-minute walk from Metro Line 3. With 328 guest rooms, all equipped with new amenities such as LCD TVs and high-speed internet, the hotel also features a 24-hour fitness center

description.textZh: 上海中建万怡酒店坐落于上海虹桥CBD核心地段，邻近虹桥天地商业中心、上海蟠龙天地、国家会展中心及“首位SHOWAY”奥特莱斯，涵盖集办公、购物、餐饮、娱乐、展示为一体的国际化生活街区。酒店周末提供班车至蟠龙天地、首位奥特莱斯、虹桥天地与夏都小镇。周边地铁2号线、17号线、13号线（规划获批）三条地铁交汇。与虹桥火车站、虹桥机场紧密相连，10分钟车程即可到达。东有嘉闵高架、南有沪渝高速、西有沈海高速、北有崧泽高架，交通非常便利。是商务人士和城市旅行家的优选下榻之地。酒店共拥有212间客房，房内均配以现代化设施设备，简约大气，素雅且怡人。此外，宾客还可在万荟轩全日餐厅或大堂吧品味美食。也可漫步于酒店外部都市庭院，尽享城市天然氧吧。
description.textEn: Located conveniently in Hongqiao Business District, Courtyard Shanghai Hongqiao offers contemporary comfort for business and leisure travelers. Find a relaxing retreat in spacious hotel accommodations with modern essentials, thoughtful amenities, ergonomic workspace and plush bedding. Delight your palate with bountiful breakfast buffets and an upscale multi-cultural dining experience for lunch and dinner at our hotel restaurant. Stay within moments of the National Exhibition Convention Center and just a 10-minute walk from the Metro Line 2 terminus. Discover the area's compelling local attractions via major transport hubs to and from Shanghai and the rest of mainland China. Reach your goals in sophisticated event space with versatile layouts for meetings, conferences, training seminars and presentations. Just minutes from Shanghai Hongqiao Airport (SHA), our hotel is a welcoming respite amid some of the beautiful attractions in China.

records.name_en: Courtyard by Marriott Shanghai International Tourism and Resorts Zone
records.name_zh: 上海国际旅游度假区万怡酒店

description.textZh: 拥有355间客房的上海国际旅游度假区万怡酒店坐落于上海迪士尼乐园主干道入口处，车程约5-8分钟，驱车前往上海浦东国际机场仅需约25分钟。酒店提供每日免费多班次往返迪士尼乐园、浦东机场、虹桥机场及虹桥火车站、外滩以及康新公路地铁站的定时定点班车接送服务。酒店班车注意事项：1、班车需提前预约，凭酒店订房确认信息上车，先到先得。2、班车准点发车。友情提示：逾时，超员的客人，您可等候下个时间段班车，或自行安排前往酒店（费用自理）。具体班车时刻可参考酒店公众号。酒店外观建筑为休闲度假的风格，结构简洁、色彩明亮；内部设计为现代禅意的风格，移步易景、怡韵游心。酒店客房面积由25至62平方米不等，包括舒适的豪华房、尊贵房和套房。此外，酒店专为家庭休闲游客提供亲子野营房和亲子家庭房。宽敞优雅的自助餐厅万荟轩全天候提供环球美食和零点菜单。惬意柔和的氛围、精心调制的饮料和鸡尾酒令大堂酒廊成为小型商务洽谈，朋友聚会放松的理想场所。上海国际旅游度假区万怡酒店共提供715平方米的宴会和会议空间，包括333平方米可容纳300人酒会的大宴会厅、廊厅以及四个多功能厅。酒店还提供配备先进器械和淋浴间的健身中心，全天免费开放，让宾客挥汗如雨，愉悦放松，让宾客尽享休闲度假之旅。
description.textEn: Located on Disney Avenue of Shanghai Pudong New District, the 355-room Courtyard by Marriott Shanghai International Tourism Resorts Zone is about 900 meters from Shanghai Disney Resort and 20-min from Shanghai Pudong International Airport. Hotel provides daily free shuttle bus to Disney, Pudong Airport, HongQiao Hub, The Bund, Kangxin Highway Station. Please call Hotel Concierge to make reservation in advance. The rooms range in size from 25 to 62 sqm and are available in deluxe, premier and suite offerings. Camping and balcony rooms are specially designed for families & leisure guests. The hotel offers a 333 sqm Grand Ballroom that can accommodate up to 300 people and 4 function rooms. Full-service Pavilion Restaurant can be enjoyed throughout the day and features an international buffet & a la carte selections. The Lounge with offering of refreshing beverages & snacks is ideal for meetings, socializing or relaxing.

description.textZh: 上海，这座以炫丽的天际线、悠久的地标建筑和蓬勃发展的经济而著称的东方明珠之城，是商务和休闲旅行的美好目的地。 当您来到中国内地这座繁华而充满生机的城市时，上海绿地万怡酒店是您的理想下榻之所。 上海绿地万怡酒店是嘉定区率先营业的国际品牌酒店，为您提供理想的住宿环境和超凡的宾客服务。 酒店座落于嘉定商业区的中心，邻近上海国际赛车场，知名的 F1 大奖赛举办地。 我们的宽敞客房包括行政楼层客房和套房，均配备液晶电视、高速上网、光线充足的办公区、客房内保险箱、迷你吧、冰箱和豪华床上用品。 MoMo Cafe 每天早晨精心烹制健康美味的早餐，令您充满活力开启美好一天。 健身中心是您放松身心、焕发活力的好去处，而商务中心则助您效率倍增。 旅行上海，入住上海绿地万怡酒店，领略历史积淀与时尚踪迹碰撞的东方魅力之都。
description.textEn: Known for its spectacular skyline, historic landmarks and growing economy, Shanghai is the perfect backdrop to business and leisure travel. When visiting our thriving city in Chinese mainland, choose the Courtyard Shanghai Jiading. The first international brand in the Jiading district, Courtyard by Marriott Shanghai Jiading offers ideal accommodations and first-class service. We're in the heart of the Jiading business district close to Shanghai F1 - the Shanghai International Circuit that is home to popular motor racing. Our spacious guest rooms, including executive floor rooms and suites, feature LCD TV, high-speed Internet, well-lit work area, in-room safe, mini-bar, fridge and luxurious bedding. Start your morning at the MoMo Cafe for a hearty breakfast. Rejuvenate at our fitness centre and stay productive at our business centre. When visiting Shanghai, stay at the Courtyard Shanghai Jianding, bridging the old and new of our charming city.

description.textZh: 上海紫竹万怡酒店坐落于活力四射的紫竹国家高新技术产业开发区，是商务和休闲旅行的时尚住宿之选。酒店客房宽敞舒适，配备 55 英寸高清电视、现代化设施和免费 Wi-Fi，并可欣赏如画般的美景。Pavilion 餐厅设有主厨餐桌和更为隐蔽的包厢，供应丰盛的国际美食和地方特色的美味佳肴，以非凡品质打造饕餮盛宴。众多知名景点云集四周，包括上海交通大学、七宝古镇等等。酒店提供多个多功能活动场地、先进的视听服务、定制餐饮及专业的活动策划者，是举办难忘会议、婚礼和社交活动的理想之选。入住期间，您可前往温馨的酒廊品尝下午茶和美味小吃，或在健身中心尽情锻炼，度过充实的一天。欢迎莅临下榻我们的闵行区酒店，开启缤纷多彩的上海之旅。
description.textEn: Centered amid the dynamic Zizhu National Hi-Tech Industrial Development Zone, Courtyard Shanghai Minhang is a contemporary haven for business and leisure travelers. Embrace effortless relaxation in spacious hotel accommodations with 55 inch HDTVs, modern amenities, complimentary Wi-Fi and inspiring views. Delight your palate with flavorful international cuisine and local signature selections at Pavilion Restaurant, featuring a chef's table and private dining room for more intimate occasions. Surround yourself with celebrated attractions, including Shanghai Jiao Tong University and historic Qibao Ancient Town. Host unforgettable meetings, conferences, weddings and social affairs in versatile event venues, enhanced by state-of-the-art audiovisual services, custom catering and expert event planners. Punctuate a satisfying day with afternoon tea and light snacks in our inviting lounge or an exhilarating workout in our fitness center. Enrich your visit to Shanghai at our hotel in the Minhang District.

description.textZh: 上海榕港万怡酒店深切了解商务人士的需求，酒店拥有精心设计的183间客房及套房，所有房间均以舒适时尚为设计理念，同时满足宾客对高科技生活的需求。酒店房间均提供灵活的工作及休闲空间，无线网络覆盖，接入卫星频道的55寸LED电视以及符合人体工程学设计得沙发等等。在我们宽敞的客房内休息放松，再活力满满地从事商务活动，或尽情探索城市的精彩魅力。这里的每一寸空间，都洋溢着舒适与热情活力，无微不至的贴心服务，为客人缔造宾至如归的住宿体验。位于酒店一层的全日餐厅-榕怡小厨，为宾客提供品种多样的自助早餐、本地佳肴和国际美食，全天提供欧陆式美食自助与零点服务，是您私享美食或商务款待的品质之选。舒适典雅的大堂酒廊供应精美甜点、咖啡、鸡尾酒以及各类饮品，是商务会谈或放松小憩的理想场所。酒店还设有贵宾行政楼层，满足客人的不同体验需求。行政酒廊，万豪旅享家打造的专属空间，安静的休息及洽谈环境，全天候提供的小食与软饮，专业定制的商务设施，尽显身份的尊贵。宾客可在此享受专属便捷的入住和退房手续，更有私密会议室满足不同客人的需求。酒店二十二层的健身中心为宾客提供全天候24小时健身服务和专业健身保障，为健身爱好者打造一片别致之地，让宾客随时保持健康体魄。
description.textEn: Conveniently located in Dongding Building, a landmark building in Dongding commercial district, Courtyard Shanghai Songjiang is within walking distance of tram stop. And it is just 3.2km from the Songjiang Xincheng Metro Station and 31km from Hongqiao International Airport. In addition, the hotel provides easy access to popular tourist resorts nearby including Sheshan National Forest Park, Shanghai Happy Valley, Guangfulin Ancient Relic Park, etc. A blend of comfort and convenience can be found at our bran-new Courtyard Shanghai Songjiang. There are 183 spacious guestrooms, each featuring stylish fashion design elements and panoramic city views. Enjoy your trip at our guest rooms with thoughtful amenities, remarkable restaurants, and well-equipped fitness center. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard Shanghai Songjiang is sure to be more enjoyable and memorable.

records.name_zh: 上海西藏大厦万怡酒店

description.textZh: 上海西藏大厦万怡酒店地处徐家汇商业和购物区的中心，毗邻港汇广场购物中心及写字楼、上海天主教教堂以及众多其他城市风景名胜。步行几分钟即可到达地铁1、9、11号线，轻松直达上海迪士尼度假区以及国家会展中心。酒店共设 364 间客房，所有客房均配备全新设施，包括液晶电视和高速上网等。华丽的屋顶设计采用传统的“金色宫殿”手法，是上海西藏大厦万怡酒店别具一格的特色之一。此外，宾客还可在酒店的特色餐厅丰味坊和大堂吧品尝丰盛美食，或在上海西藏大厦万怡酒店内部的罗马风格室内泳池和 200 平方米先进的健身中心尽享放松之乐。
description.textEn: Ideally suited for both business and leisure travelers, Courtyard Shanghai Xujiahui welcomes you to China with sophisticated accommodation, a host of terrific on-site perks and a peerless downtown location. Our hotel rooms and suites feature artful design touches and amenities like a flat-screen TV, deluxe bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi access, an ergonomic, well-lit workspace, a mini-fridge, a coffee maker and floor-to-ceiling windows which offer dazzling panoramic views of the downtown Shanghai, China cityscape. Maintain your workout routine at our state-of-the-art fitness center, take a refreshing dip in our Romanesque indoor pool or savor handcrafted international fare at our hotel's popular MoMo Cafe. Ideally situated in bustling Xujiahui commercial district, our hotel places you moments away from a wide range of prominent business destinations and we're within walking distance of downtown's most noteworthy shopping and dining. Elevate your experience at Courtyard Shanghai Xujiahui.

description.textZh: 上海宝山德尔塔酒店于2018年2月1日开始试营业，2018年8月1日正式开业。巴洛克风格的酒店坐落于北上海，位处黄浦江与长江汇流处，距离吴淞口国际邮轮港仅数分钟车程。酒店是亚太区首家德尔塔品牌酒店，拥有339间装饰典雅的客房，每间客房均配备TOTO卫洗丽，55寸飞利浦电视机，以及精选的客房用品，提升宾客的身体护理体验。酒店设有多家风格迥异的餐厅及酒吧，包括莲·全日制餐厅， 真味馆中餐厅以及格调别致的醉酒吧等。1,200平米豪华的宴会及会议场地便捷的坐落于同一楼层，是举办公司会议及大型活动的理想之选。酒店亦临近炮台湾湿地公园，风光旖旎的湿地公园是跑步爱好者理想休闲之地。
description.textEn: The hotel started trial opening on Feb 1,2018 and officially opened on Aug 1,2018. Nestled in Northern Shanghai, just minutes away from Wusongkou International Cruise Terminal, Delta Hotels Shanghai Baoshan is the first Delta hotel in Asia Pacific and provides guests with everything they need to enjoy a compelling urban escape. Relax in our sophisticated guest rooms and suites, boasting 55-inch LCD TVs, organic bath amenities, comfortable bedding and high-speed Wi-Fi; book one of our Club Lounge accommodations for access to our hotel's modern Club. Savor outstanding dining at our hotel, which showcases several restaurants, including authentic specialties at TRU Chinese Restaurant and buffet-style fare at The Lotus All Day Dining Restaurant. Work out in our 24-hour fitness center or make a splash in our indoor pool. Boasting comprehensive meeting and event facilities, including an expansive pillar-less Grand Ballroom, our hotel is also a desirable venue for meetings, weddings and special events in Shanghai.

records.name_en: Habo Hotel Shanghai, a Member of Design Hotels™
records.name_zh: 上海书香心泊酒店，Design Hotels设计酒店成员

description.textZh: This century-old structure captures the legacy of Shanghai’s golden age. Partnerships with nearby cultural venues, independent cafés, and local art galleries, as well as on-property programming, connects guests to the city.
description.textEn: This reborn, century-old structure carries forward the legacy of Shanghai’s golden age with timeless allure and direct ties to the city’s cultural and culinary scene. Mosaic-tiled corridors that echo local craftsmanship and custom-made furniture that blends Art Deco curves with minimalist Eastern silhouettes showcase a union of Eastern and Western cultures. The color palette is composed of warm earth tones, soft grays, aged bronze, and deep wood finishes, creating a sophisticated and layered atmosphere that complements the building’s historic architecture. description.textZh: 上海枫泾福朋喜来登酒店坐落于被誉为“中国历史文化名镇”的枫泾镇，为枫泾镇首家国际品牌酒店。枫泾镇位于上海西南、金山区西北部，与沪浙接壤。枫泾为典型的江南水乡古镇，成市于宋，元朝至元十二年（1275年）正式建镇，距今已有1500逾年历史，地灵人杰、名人荟萃，史料记载曾有3个状元、56个进士和125个举人。建筑多为明、清风格， 传统江南粉墙黛瓦。古镇水网遍布，镇区内河道纵横，桥梁众多，素有“三步两座桥，一望十条港”之称。沿河古街绿树成荫，古镇水巷幽静；39座古石桥横跨河上，其中元代建1座，明代建11座，清代建21座，现存最古的为元代致和桥，据今有近700年历史。
description.textEn: The first international hotel in cultural Fengjing Town. Explore interlacing lanes, centuries-old houses, carved stone-arch bridges from the Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties, especially the Zhihe Bridge, which can be dated back to the Yuan Dynasty with a history of 700 years. The 218 well-appointed guestrooms feature breathtaking lake view or rural scenery. Guests can enjoy a variety of local and international culinary delights at the 2 restaurants and 1 lounge located in the hotel. The largest pillar-less ballroom in Fengjing Area, three additional Function Rooms at nearly 100 square meters are equipped with state-of-the-art technology as well as huge lakeside lawns featuring natural landscape. Fully equipped 24-hour fitness center, indoor heated swimming pool with breathtaking lakeview outdoor terrace.

records.name_zh: 上海青浦新城福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai Qingpu New City, located adjacent to the National Exhibition and Convention Center (NECC) and Hongqiao Transportation Hub, offers a premium choice for business travelers, conference groups, and urban leisure guests.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai Qingpu New City located in the heart of Qingpu New City, offers immediate access to Huijin Road Metro Station, ensuring seamless connectivity to the Hongqiao Transportation Hub and the National Exhibition and Convention Center. Blending modern minimalism with local cultural elements, the hotel features guest rooms equipped with high-speed internet, premium bedding, and smart bathroom amenities. The all-day dining restaurant serves authentic local Shanghainese cuisine alongside international delicacies. Complemented by versatile meeting facilities, a fitness center, and a children’s playground, the hotel comprehensively caters to both business travelers and families.Guests can effortlessly explore the water-town charm of Zhujiajiao Ancient Town and other renowned attractions.Combining a prime location, convenient transportation, and exemplary service, the hotel stands as the ideal choice for those seeking to balance business efficiency with the leisurely beauty of Jiangnan.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai, Daning
records.name_zh: 上海大宁福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻上海大宁福朋喜来登酒店，开启一段轻松惬意的都市旅居时光。酒店坐落于上海市中心静安区大宁国际商业广场内，时尚现代的设计与便捷交通相得益彰：步行可达地铁1号线延长路站，轻松往来人民广场、上海火车站等核心地标，让您的出行高效从容。宽敞明亮的客房配备免费高速Wi-Fi、奢华床品与精致设施，部分房型可将繁华城景尽收眼底，为您营造宾至如归的舒适休憩空间。酒店内的The Eatery餐厅供应丰盛国际自助餐，满足您的味蕾探索；精致优雅的大堂吧则是与好友小聚、品鉴特调鸡尾酒的理想之选。闲暇时光，您可在室内泳池尽情畅游，或前往配备瑜伽室的24小时健身中心舒展身心，平衡工作与生活。酒店还拥有约1,735平方米的会议与宴会空间，专业配置可完美承载商务会议、庆典晚宴等各类活动。从酒店出发，步行即可抵达各大购物、餐饮与娱乐场所，亦可轻松前往上海马戏城、外滩、南京东路等知名景点，探索上海的多元魅力。我们诚挚期待您的莅临，在静安区中心，感受都市脉搏与贴心服务的完美融合。
description.textEn: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai, Daning. Set in Jing’an District, downtown Shanghai, our modern hotel is located within the Life Hub complex at Daning. Walk to Metro Line 1, Yanchang Road Station, People’s Square and Shanghai Railway Station from our hotel. Make yourself at home in our spacious guestrooms featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, plush bedding, city views and deluxe amenities. Join us for our delicious international buffet at The Eatery. Gather with friends or colleagues for cocktails in our sophisticated lobby lounge. Go for a swim in our indoor pool. Our hotel also offers a 24-hour Fitness Center with a Yoga room for your convenience. Elsewhere in the hotel, discover our 1,735 square meters of meeting and banquet space, ideal for your business event or celebration. Walk to shopping, dining and entertainment, or visit Shanghai Circus World, the Bund and East Nanjing Road nearby. We look forward to making you feel welcome at our hotel in Jing'an District, downtown Shanghai.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai, Kangqiao
records.name_zh: 上海万信福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到供应当地精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选计划，无不展现出我们对伟大设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。在福朋酒店，健身不仅仅局限于健身房。我们与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和专享健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From objects found and collected over time, to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on tap, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points, workouts are not confined to just to the gym. We've partnered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai, Pudong
records.name_zh: 浦东福朋喜来登由由酒店

description.textZh: 上海浦东福朋喜来登由由酒店位于陆家嘴金贸区中心地带，俯瞰风景迷人黄浦江。南浦大桥和复兴东路隧道亦相隔不远，驱车数分钟即可抵达外滩及其他热门景点。酒店距上海浦东国际博览中心仅约 10 分钟车程，距新天地娱乐中心仅约 15 分钟车程。酒店门前即有地铁 4 号线车站，周边遍布商务写字楼、购物中心、餐厅及酒吧。下榻我们宽敞的客房，体验温馨舒适的住宿，黄浦江和城市美景可一览无余。您可在我们的健身俱乐部和休闲娱乐场所放松身心。在忙碌一天之后，您可以尽情品尝我们的国际美食或小酌一杯喜爱的鸡尾酒。在我们 1,000 多平米的会议和多功能空间内发挥创意灵感。本酒店是您举办各种规模的会议、婚礼及社交活动的理想选择。
description.textEn: Overlooking the Huangpu River, Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai, Pudong is in the heart of the Lujiazui finance and trade district. The hotel is conveniently close to both Nanpu Bridge and Fuxing Road East Tunnel, and the Bund and other major attractions can be reached in a few minutes by car. We're just 10 minutes from the Shanghai International Expo Center and 15 minutes from the famous Xintiandi recreation center. A Metro Line 4 stop sits directly in front of the hotel, which is surrounded by office buildings, a shopping mall, restaurants and bars. Enjoy a friendly & comfortable stay is one of our spacious guest rooms, which feature views of Huangpu River or the beautiful city. Kick back and relax in our health club and recreation facilities. After a busy day, feast on international cuisine or wind down with your favorite cocktail. Get inspired by our over 1,000 square meters of meeting and function space. Our hotel is an ideal choice for meetings, conferences, weddings and social events of all sizes.

records.name_zh: 上海东方美谷 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: JW MARRIOTT HOTEL SHANGHAI FENGXIAN Inspired by the Jinhai Lake, the hotel features a dramatic atrium that plays with light and color. This sense of creativity is carried throughout the experience, where further investigation unveils after layer.
description.textEn: JW MARRIOTT HOTEL SHANGHAI FENGXIAN Inspired by the Jinhai Lake, the hotel features a dramatic atrium that plays with light and color. This sense of creativity is carried throughout the experience, where further investigation unveils layer after layer. Each of the 261 guest rooms and suites, modern and beautiful, overlooks Jinhai Lake or our atrium garden. More than 1,800 sq. ft. of meeting space includes two, pillar-free ballroom, revealed through smoked glass, to engage and entertain.

records.name_en: JW Marriott Hotel Shanghai at Tomorrow Square
records.name_zh: 上海明天广场 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: JW Marriott Hotel Shanghai is a 5-star Shanghai hotel near historic attractions and Shanghai business centre. Luxurious hotel rooms & suites with great hotel deals. Onsite dining and health club. Spacious conference centre & meeting facilities.
description.textEn: JW Marriott Hotel Shanghai at Tomorrow Square rises 60 stories above downtown Puxi and is located in the heart of the Shanghai commercial and shopping district and within easy reach of the city‘s many leisure attractions such as Shanghai Museum, Shanghai History Museum, Shanghai Grand Theatre and the Bund. JW Marriott Hotel Shanghai at Tomorrow Square's 333 hotel rooms offer captivating views of the city, enveloping guests in the lavish appointments and business-savvy amenities. While here, guests can embark on a culinary journey, with a choice of fine restaurants serving authentic Chinese cuisine and contemporary specialties. Fully-equipped gym and indoor/outdoor swimming pools with beautiful views of the city that offer rejuvenating wellness experiences. For intimate weddings to dynamic conferences, this luxury hotel on Nanjing Road also offers over 1,630 square meters of spectacular function spaces, which boasts great views and natural sunlight.

records.name_en: JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Shanghai Pudong
records.name_zh: 上海绿发JW万豪侯爵酒店

description.textZh: 与迪拜哈利法塔师出同门，上海绿发JW万豪侯爵酒店堪称新的地标性建筑，为市中心天际线划出一道靓丽的风景。酒店从黄浦江汲取设计灵感，它那颇具特色的中庭风格令人印象深刻，充满了光线和色彩的变化。这里富有创造力的氛围弥漫在你的四周，每次更深入的探究都会得到新的感受。514间客房和套房，每一间都富有现代气息，赏心雅致，可以饱览城市景观或者江景。拥有超过3,200平方米的会议场地，其巨大的无柱式宴会厅和带有烟色玻璃的烹饪厨房，是举办活动或接待客人的理想之选。酒店共设有4间风格迥异的特色餐厅，包括FLINT扒房，时尚烧烤酒吧；航迹厨房（Merchant Kitchen）餐厅提供特色国际菜肴的精美自助餐；JW酒廊提供下午茶、美食和现场音乐，以及带有法式风情的三层菱餐厅（Le Manoir Ling）主理精致粤菜，并设有露台酒吧，卡拉OK和私人包厢。酒店特别推出“JW家庭计划”，创造乐趣难忘的亲子时光。JW家庭计划包括PAPAHUG亲子楼层，JW蔬苑趣味采摘，小小厨师烹饪课堂，侯爵宝宝萌趣互动，更有为小客人们量身定制的童趣乐园，充满了玩偶与小帐篷，趣味游戏机，动画片放映机，让萌宝们徜徉在梦幻童话乐园里，尽情释放活力。
description.textEn: From the architectural minds behind Dubai’s Burj Khalifa, JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Shanghai Pudong has added a new landmark to the downtown skyline alongside Huangpu River. Each of 514 guest rooms and suites, modern and beautiful, overlooks Shanghai or the river. More than 33,000 sq. ft. of meeting space with pillar-free ballroom and a culinary theater, revealed through smoked glass, to engage and entertain. Dining includes four restaurants, a stylish bar and grill at Flint; elaborate buffets featuring international dishes at Merchant Kitchen; afternoon tea, live music at JW Lounge and the three-story Le Manoir Ling offering Cantonese cuisine in a French setting, a rooftop bar, karaoke and private dining. "Family by JW", where children and their parents enjoy an unforgettable time together, introduces PAPAHUG family floor, JW Garden and cooking class. New Kids Land tailored for children, where they can play with dolls, small tents and game machines, enabling them to linger in a wonderland of fairy tales.

records.name_zh: 上海佘山世茂艾美酒店

description.textZh: 上海佘山世茂艾美酒店提供时尚现代的住宿和备受认可的卓越服务, 更坐拥非凡美景, 热忱欢迎商务和休闲旅客莅临下榻。这家备受认可的豪华酒店地处佘山国家旅游度假区宁静的湖畔, 信步可至上海月湖雕塑公园, 以及地铁站, 佘山自然森林公园，上海欢乐谷和迷人的佘山大教堂亦在附近。超大客房和套房配备豪华寝具、时尚浴室和私人阳台。在御珍轩中餐厅享用美味特色中餐, 或到荟聚西餐厅用餐小饮, 休闲享受。度假酒店提供各种户外活动选择, 您可在泳池畅泳一番, 或在萌宠小牧场与小动物亲密接触。抑或信步走到湖边, 在沙滩上尽情放松。酒店提供灵活多变的室内和室外场地, 以及理想的策划和餐饮服务, 是您在上海举办活动的理想之选。
description.textEn: The Le Meridien Shanghai Sheshan welcomes business and leisure visitors with contemporary accommodation, extraordinary views and award-winning service. Our hotel benefits from a tranquil lakeside location in the Sheshan National Tourism Resort, within driving distance of the Metro station; Sheshan National Forest Park and Shanghai Moon Lake Sculpture Park are close by, as is Happy Valley Shanghai and the stunning Sheshan Basilica. Oversized rooms and suites are designed with plush bedding, sleek bathrooms and private balconies. Sample tasty Chinese specialties at Yu Palace, or relax with a meal and a drink at Le Cafe. There are plenty of opportunities to enjoy the outdoors at our resort - from swimming in the outdoor pool to playing a beach volleyball. You can also stroll down to Moon Lake and relax on the sandy beach. If you're in Shanghai to host an event, our hotel offers adaptable indoor and outdoor venues and comprehensive planning and catering services.

records.name_zh: 上海闵行宝龙艾美酒店

description.textZh: 上海闵行宝龙艾美酒店邻近七宝古镇，地处热门旅游目的地，带来非凡舒适体验。 酒店客房时尚别致，配备特色舒适设施和现代化用品，并设有落地窗，可一览七宝地区美景，欢迎莅临下榻，尽情休闲放松。 酒店餐厅风格多样，提供丰盛自助餐和国际美食，让您乐享味蕾之旅。 酒店邻近众多景点，数分钟左右可达上海国家会展中心、虹桥火车站、上海动物园和虹桥国际机场。 丰富多样的会议和活动空间，辅之以专业策划者和定制餐饮专业人员，将您的奇思妙想化为现实。 在波光粼粼的泳池中畅泳，或者到设施齐全的健身中心奋力锻炼，为一天难忘的商务行程或观光之旅划上句号。 酒店地理位置优越，位于中国上海闵行区，是卓越非凡的时尚度假酒店。
description.textEn: Situated near Qibao Ancient Town Le Meridien Shanghai Minhang offers stylish comfort in a legendary travel destination. Find your respite in contemporary accommodations with signature comforts, modern essentials and floor-to-ceiling windows with sweeping views of the Qibao Area. Delight your palate with bountiful buffets and delectable international fare at our distinctive hotel restaurants. Stay with moments of an eclectic array of attractions within minutes of the National Exhibition and Convention Center Shanghai, Hongqiao Train Station, Shanghai Zoo and Hongqiao International Airport . Bring your big ideas to life in dynamic meeting and event spaces, enhanced by expert planners and custom catering professionals. Punctuate an unforgettable day of business or sightseeing with a refreshing swim in our sparkling pool or an exhilarating workout in our fully equipped fitness center. Perfectly placed in the Minhang District, our hotel is a stylish retreat in Shanghai China.

records.name_en: The Hongta Hotel, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Shanghai
records.name_zh: 上海红塔豪华精选酒店

description.textZh: 上海红塔豪华精选酒店位于浦东的商务中心，邻近外滩和世纪公园，城市的深厚文化底蕴与华贵气息在此动感交融。从酒店可轻松前往上海的主要地铁站点，这意味着宾客仅需 15 分钟左右即可抵达迷人的浦西。探索上海的美好，从景点到美食，在我们的餐厅享用美味的国际美食。使用我们的行政会议设施。在我们的健身俱乐部来一次振奋精神的锻炼，然后享受舒适的水疗。酒店拥有 316 间优雅的客房和套房，可欣赏令人惊叹的上海全景，满足您的各种愿望。
description.textEn: Located in Pudong's business center, close to the Bund and Century Park, The Hongta Hotel embraces a vibrant mix of culture and luxury. Easy access to the city's major tunnels means guests can be in charming Puxi within 15 minutes. Explore the best of what Shanghai has to offer from attractions to eateries, enjoy delectable international cuisines in our restaurants. Make use of our executive meeting facilities. Have an invigorating workout in our Health Club, then pamper yourself at the Spa. Enjoy the breathtaking panorama of Shanghai from our 316 elegant rooms and suites to any wish you may have.

records.name_zh: 上海张江万豪行政公寓

description.textZh: At Marriott Executive Apartments®, you'll enjoy the convenience of a hotel, with the space, ambience and privacy of home living. Our completely furnished apartments come with a fully equipped kitchen,housekeeping services, storage and 24-hour staffing.
description.textEn: Marriott Executive Apartment Shanghai, Zhangjiang, is located in the core area of Pudong District, where technology and life blend together - adjacent to the Zhangjiang Science Gateway, it enjoys convenient transportation.The design style embodies the ups and downs of Jiangnan residential architecture over the past century, extracting the skills of carved patterns and layered shadows. Culture and heritage are all integrated into the light of Zhangjiang technology.With 250 rooms of various styles, it offers comprehensive services for guests, including office, reading, fitness and entertainment.Morning jogging by the Chuan Yang River, the exquisite morning meals at Resident Lounge, fully enjoying a life like home, all for you, an extraordinary experience.

description.textZh: 上海康桥万豪酒店邻近上海张江高科技园区和上海迪士尼®度假区附近，可谓是休闲工作两相宜。酒店位于浦东周康地区，设有符合人体工学的办公区、无线网络和餐厅，宾客可在餐厅享用会议早餐或商务晚餐。酒店还拥有约 1,100平方米的活动空间，可供举行大型宴会和董事会议等活动，因此备受商务旅客青睐。行程自由的客人可前往以自助餐为主的贡厨餐厅悠闲享用美食，在健身中心保持强健体魄，于珑锦轩中餐厅以传统粤菜招待亲朋好友、意大利餐厅享用传统意大利美食，在酒店的儿童俱乐部享受午后亲子时刻。或者，可探访附近的上海迪士尼主题乐园、邵家楼水乡古镇、周浦花海或佛罗伦萨小镇购物中心。
description.textEn: Relax with friendly service & upscale amenities at our Shanghai Marriott Hotel Kangqiao. Our stylish hotel is located in the ZhouKang area of Pudong, near Shanghai Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park and Shanghai Disney® Resort. Enjoy our contemporary rooms and suites, with high-speed Wi-Fi, soaking tubs, sofa beds and advanced in-room technology. Dine in our popular hotel restaurants, including an international buffet at Goji Kitchen Bar, traditional Cantonese at Jade Pavilion, and Italian cuisine at D.O.C.G. Enjoy our hotel’s complimentary kids club, 24-hour fitness center and sparkling indoor pool. Those looking to host a meeting or special occasion will appreciate our brand-new Great Room and more than 1,100 square meters of event space, with superb catering and planning services. Take our complimentary shuttle to Shanghai Disney® Resort, explore the Pudong District, or visit the water town of Zhao Jia Lou and Florentia Village shopping center. A refreshing stay awaits you at our modern hotel in Shanghai.

description.textZh: 上海宝华万豪酒店坐落于静安大宁国际社区，直面规模宏大的大宁郁金香公园。繁华都市中的清幽之地，释放怡人自然景观带来的无限生机。酒店拥有317间风格现代且融合典雅装饰的客房，每间客房均配备高速上网设施及多媒体播放器，席梦思床垫，高雅装饰，万豪独特寝具打造尊贵的睡眠享受，为商旅宾客带来舒适难忘的住宿体验。会议空间总面积逾2,800平方米，包括两个无柱豪华宴会厅，一个1,400平方米的百宴厅及一个1,000平方米的宴会厅，是举办大型展会、公司会议、社交活动、梦幻婚礼的理想场所。别具特色的万豪中餐厅、炎川日本料理及都会尚膳全日餐厅带您领略非凡美食之旅。亦可在上海宝华万豪酒店大堂吧享受经典下午茶或午夜醇饮放松身心。
description.textEn: Situated next to the Shanghai Multimedia Valley, neighboring the Daning Park, the largest central greens in downtown provides a tranquil environment surrounded by nature trails. Our 317 contemporary-designed guest rooms combine style with elegance, offering you a comfortable and memorable stay. Each sophisticated room is sure to exceed your expectations featuring available high-speed internet, multi-media player, plush Simmons® Mattresses, and tasteful decor. The impressive 2,800 sqm of meeting space including 2 pillarless ballrooms, one 1,400 sqm grand ballroom and another 1,000 sqm ballroom are catering to a variety of conferences, meetings, social events, and weddings.Guests looking for delectable dining can experience the unique flavors at our restaurants, the signature Man Ho Chinese Restaurant, Tatsumi Japanese Restaurant and all day dining Shanghai City Bistro. Or, drop-by for afternoon tea or a late-night drinks at The Lounge.

records.name_zh: 上海金桥红枫万豪酒店

description.textZh: 上海金桥红枫万豪酒店位于浦东金桥自由贸易试验区，这里是享有“绿色城市”美誉的碧云国际社区，地理位置优越。酒店毗邻风景优美的公园和河流，周围云集了 众多的美食餐厅、酒吧和商店；距陆家嘴、外高桥自由贸易区和张江高科技园区均不到15分钟车程。距离上海新国际博览中心15分钟车程，距离上海迪士尼乐园20分钟车程。酒店距浦东国际机场约30公里，25到30分钟的车程便可抵达 ; 距虹桥国际机场约26公里，车程约45分钟。上海金桥红枫万豪酒店拥有装修典雅现代的客房，餐饮场所包括万豪中餐厅、卡萨琳戈意大利餐厅、枫味豪厨全日制餐厅以及大堂酒廊。配有10间独立会议室，设有各类先进设施，面积总计达1,050平方米，辅之以655平方米的豪华宴会厅，堪称各类活动的理想筹办之选。
description.textEn: Shanghai Marriott Hotel Pudong East is ideally located in Jinqiao Pilot Free Trade Zone, also renowned as the “Green City” of Biyun International Community. Nestled beside a beautiful park and canal, the neighborhood offers a diverse array of restaurants, bars, and shops. It is approximately a 15-minute drive from Lujiazui, Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone, Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park, and Shanghai New International Expo Centre. Shanghai Disneyland is about a 20-minute drive away. Pudong International Airport lies 30 kilometers distant, requiring roughly 30 to 35 minutes by car; Hongqiao International Airport is 30 kilometers away, with a driving time of around 45 minutes. The hotel has 324 stylish guest rooms, 67 apartments, and 4 Food and Beverage outlets of Man Ho Chinese Restaurant, Casalingo Italian Restaurant, Gourmet House and The Lounge. The event facilities feature a magnificent 655 square meters Grand Ballroom and an additional 841 square meters of state-of-the-art event space in 10 separate rooms.

records.name_zh: 上海中优城市万豪酒店

description.textZh: 上海中优城市万豪酒店坐落于中优城市广场商业综合体内，距离浦东新区保存完好的千年古镇-新场古镇仅咫尺之遥，便利的地理位置可便捷抵达野生动物园、迪士尼乐园、浦东国际机场等。酒店共设235间舒适典雅的客房，并配备先进的设施设备和高速全覆盖无线网络。4家各具风格的特色餐厅，供应当地与世界各地受欢迎的美食，丰富您的味觉享受。2,650平方米的会议宴会空间，为您提供多样化的场地选择，无论是大型商务会议，抑或订制婚礼与社交聚会，都将为您配备高水准的宴会服务团队，满足您的每一处细节需求。24小时开放的健身中心，可让您在繁忙之余依然保持活力充沛。
description.textEn: No matter business travel or staycation, Shanghai Marriott Hotel Pudong South welcomes will set a great tone for a fantastic visit. Unwind with ease after an exhilarating day in nearby attractions in your spacious, contemporary accommodation; our 235 hotel rooms and suites feature an impressive assortment of useful amenities and many boast picturesque views of natural landscape. Indulge in the distinctive flavors of Shanghai with expertly crafted fare at our signature restaurant, stay fit and focused at our well-equipped hotel gym. Boasting 2,650 square feet of venue space, including a lavish pillarless Grand Ballroom, we can provide you with what you desire for a remarkable business or social gathering here in Shanghai. In addition, our unparalleled location places you close to the Pudong International Airport. Allow us to redefine the stay experience when you visit Shanghai.For epidemic situation, the Executive Lounge will be suspended, while The Lounge on 1st floor will provide lounge services.

records.name_zh: 上海松江临云万豪酒店

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels®, we thoughtfully consider each detail so you can feel at home as you explore the world. We invite you to unwind in sophisticated spaces thoughtfully designed to make you feel at home®.
description.textEn: At Marriott Hotels®, we know that our job is to stay one step ahead, always anticipating your needs. So, as you and your needs evolve, so do we. As masters of our craft, we believe our legacy is built with every stay®.

records.name_zh: 上海杨浦滨江万豪酒店

description.textZh: 上海杨浦滨江万豪酒店坐落于杨浦滨江，毗邻黄浦江畔，与杨浦大桥比肩而立，可俯瞰浦江旖旎。酒店都以其便捷的交通连接浦东与浦西两大区域，确保旅客的每一次出行都轻松自如。宾客信步可至附近景点世界技能博物馆，打卡连接城市与江岸的“绿之丘”景点。酒店拥有556间设备完善的客房及套房，纵览杨浦滨江百年工业城的新活力与城市天际的摩登江景。三家风格迥异的餐厅及酒吧：贡厨、中餐厅及大堂吧，提供多元化的餐饮选择，敬邀宾客邂逅舌尖至味。近2,000平方米的无柱多功能会议及活动场地适合举办各种庆典、晚宴和商务活动。此外，酒店包含健身中心、室内泳池等康乐设施，可助宾客在尽享悠闲时光。上海杨浦滨江万豪酒店将为宾客带来精彩纷呈的旅居新体验。
description.textEn: Shanghai Marriott Hotel Yangpu Riverside is located in the Yangpu Riverside area, adjacent to the Huangpu River and standing alongside the Yangpu Bridge, offering a picturesque view of the Huangpu River and connecting Pudong and Puxi. The hotel features 556 well-equipped rooms and suites, showcasing the vibrant new life of Yangpu's century-old industrial city and the modern skyline views. Three distinctive restaurants and bars, Goji, Shang Rong Fu and the Lounge, offer a diverse range of dining options, inviting guests to experience exquisite culinary delights.With nearly 2,000 square meters of pillar-less multifunctional meeting and event space, the hotel is ideal for hosting various celebrations, banquets, and business events. Additionally, the hotel includes a fitness center, an indoor swimming pool, and other recreational facilities, ensuring guests enjoy their leisure time to the fullest. Shanghai Marriott Hotel Yangpu Riverside provide guests an exciting and memorable travel experience.

records.name_zh: 上海雅居乐万豪侯爵酒店

description.textZh: 上海雅居乐万豪侯爵酒店坐落于繁华的西藏中路，毗邻人民广场，可方便抵达各个文化、娱乐和购物场所。紧邻寰图综合办公空间，步行可至南京路步行街、人民公园、外滩和人民广场地铁站(地铁1、2、8号线的交汇站)。上海雅居乐万豪侯爵酒店为宾客提供舒适的休憩环境和便捷的设施。720间宽敞的客房配备高速的无线和有线网络、符合人体工学设计的工作空间以及能带来优质睡眠的舒适床品。宽敞的大理石浴室拥有全身浴缸和独立的淋浴房。酒店设施丰富，包括25米长的室内游泳池、桑拿房、按摩池、蒸汽室和多种设备的健身房以及水疗中心。酒店还额外提供礼宾服务、24小时送餐服务、客房洗衣、停车场以及万豪个性化服务“为您服务”专线。酒店设有多间餐厅提供中外美食及本地饕餮，犒赏食客的味蕾。上海雅居乐万豪侯爵酒店另一大特色为完善的会议及活动设施。超过21,000平方英尺的会议宴会场地配备2个无柱式宴会厅及7间独立会议室，是选择举办宴会的优质选择。
description.textEn: Ideally located on Xizang Road (Middle), close to People’s Square – the official geographic centre of the city – Shanghai Marriott Marquis City Centre provides effortless access to the city’s cultural, entertainment and shopping attractions, adjoining to ATLAS Workplace. Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, People’s Park and the Bund, plus the People’s Square metro hub (connecting lines 1, 2 and 8) are within close walking distance. The 720 spacious guestrooms feature laptop connectivity, wireless and wired internet, ergonomic workspaces and Marriott’s “Revive” bedding. Large marble bathrooms have separate power showers and a comfortable bathtub. Modern amenities include a 25-metre indoor swimming pool, sauna, jacuzzi, steam room, fully-equipped fitness centre and spa. Additional guest services include Concierge, 24-hour Room Service, in-house laundry, on-site parking and Marriott’s personalised “At Your Service” for guest assistance anytime at a touch of a button.

records.name_zh: 上海虹桥国家会展中心 Moxy 酒店

description.textZh: 地处虹桥中央商务区徐泾地区，邻近国家会展中心以及上海虹桥国际机场和虹桥火车站。简约而不简单的卧室，配有 55 英寸纯平电视、床头 USB 接口、自储迷你冰箱、电子保险箱、步入式雨林淋浴间以及免费高速 WiFi。Moxy 酒吧是您结交当地朋友放松身心的好去处。在中国大陆的 Moxy 酒店，宾客可以选择各式即食方便面，在调味品站制作符合自己口味的“拉面”。在 Moxy 酒店，我们为您提供的不仅仅是客房， 更是充满逸趣的玩乐空间。
description.textEn: Located in Hongqiao CBD Xujing Area, neighborhood with National Exhibition and Convention Center, SHA International Airport and Hongqiao Railway Station, the main gateway for exploring China. Our bedrooms are minimalist yet multifunctional with 55 inches flat screen TVs, bedside USB ports, self stocked mini fridge, electronic safety box, walk-in rain showers and furiously fast and free WiFi. Relaxing yourself at our Moxy bar to meet some local pees .Moxy hotels in China Mainland, guests can ‘pimp their noodles’ with a selection of instant noodles and condiment stations to customize their own flavors. Moxy gives you more than a room. We give you room to play.

description.textZh: 上海普陀Moxy酒店的设计灵感源自上海独特的石库门建筑风格。酒店外观以经典的青砖红瓦为主色调，融入现代简约线条，营造出复古与时尚交织的视觉冲击。步入酒店大堂，仿佛穿越时空，来到了上世纪老上海的石库门里弄。设计师巧妙地将石库门元素融入空间设计，细节之处尽显海派风情。酒店选址于普陀区苏州河畔，周边环绕上海造币厂、啤酒厂、纺织厂等工业旧址，巧妙呼应Moxy的工业风设计语言。酒店内的砖墙、抛光混凝土地板与霓虹灯元素交织，既保留了历史痕迹，又注入了摩登活力。酒店位于上海市中心，地理位置优越，十五分钟内即可到达静安寺、南京路步行街、外滩等上海著名景点。酒店距离上海站仅5分钟车程、30分钟可到达上海虹桥火车站及机场，50分钟达到上海浦东机场。
description.textEn: The bright and open lobby layout is paired with contemporary furniture.The Plug and Meet gathering areas provide modern ergonomic seating,large writing walls and 56 inch televisions for presentation projection.The lobby also boasts a state-of-the art video wall and 24/7 Food & Beverage offering a wide selection of snacks and drinks. Other hotel amenities include healthy continental breakfast, an evening bar featuring wines by the glass and local brews. All bedrooms are equipped with 55 inch flat screen televisions, build in USB ports and free Wifi.

records.name_zh: 上海徐汇 Moxy 酒店

description.textZh: 酒店大堂设计宽敞通透，配备现代化家具，尽显精美雅致的格调。“Plug and Meet”聚会区提供时尚的人体工学座椅和超大书写墙，还设有 56 英寸电视供宾客投影演示。大堂还设有摩登艺术风格的电视墙，全天 24 小时供应品类丰富的小吃和饮品。此外，酒店还供应营养健康的欧陆式早餐，晚间酒吧供应各类杯装美酒佳酿和当地啤酒。酒店所有卧室均配有 55 英寸平面电视、固定式 USB 充电接口，并提供免费 Wi-Fi。
description.textEn: The bright and open lobby layout is paired with contemporary furniture. The ''Plug and Meet'' gathering areas provide modern ergonomic seating, large writing walls and 56 inch televisions for presentation projection. The lobby also boasts a state-of-the art video wall and 24/7 Food & Beverage offering a wide selection of snacks and drinks. Other hotel amenities include healthy continental breakfast, an evening bar featuring wines by the glass and local brews. All bedrooms are equipped with 55 inch flat screen televisions, build in USB ports and free Wifi.

description.textZh: 上海漕河泾万丽酒店隶属于万豪国际集团，酒店位于上海漕河泾新兴技术开发区，毗邻徐家汇和虹桥商业区。从酒店出发，步行约五分钟可至地铁9号线‘漕河泾开发区站“或地铁12号线”虹梅路站“，驱车约40分钟可至上海浦东国际机场，约20分钟可至虹桥枢纽。上海漕河泾万丽酒店地理位置优越，打造精彩的出行之旅。别具格调的灯光布局和简约而华美的客房层次，演绎出别具一格的温馨感，为酒店的商务旅行客人带来丰富多彩的不同感受。在客房内，各类优质商务休闲设施供您使用，您可在万豪特选的舒适大床上观看液晶电视和独立的影碟播放机所播放的精彩节目。行政楼层酒廊位于第26层，优美全景尽收眼底，堪称闲暇之余的理想去处。
description.textEn: Renaissance Shanghai Caohejing Hotel welcomes you to China with sophisticated style and award-winning service. You will find our hotel in the vibrant Xuhui district within the Caohejing New Technology Development Zone, the National Exhibition and Convention Center NECC is close by as is the Hongqiao business district and the ancient town of Qibao. Eclectically designed yet functional rooms and suites offer touches of whimsy and perks like complimentary high speed WiFi and marble bathrooms as well as views of Shanghai. Elsewhere at the hotel you can enjoy local and global cuisine at one of our several restaurants, work out in the fitness center, swim in the indoor pool or indulge in a treatment at Touch Spa. If you are planning an event in Xuhui district our hotel boasts a range of adaptable venues including a pillarless ballroom and a modern boardroom. We hope you will discover the city while you are here too, our Navigator is on hand with tips to help you experience Shanghai like a true local.

description.textZh: 上海虹桥万丽酒店，位于虹桥高端住宅核心区域，毗邻虹桥国际交通枢纽及国家会展中心。酒店拥有321间客房，焕然一新的客房融入了时尚设计的理念，打造精致的空间，让您平衡高效、思维敏锐、灵感涌动。您可在“燃”全日制餐厅尽享万国美馔，相约“R吧”觥筹交错间开启万丽之夜, 在健身中心挥洒汗水在室内泳池逐浪, 在行政酒廊感受摩登夜行客的潇洒,逾2300平万丽殿及灵活多变的组合会议室等场地为您打造别开生面的企业盛会或唯美婚宴, 为您的盛事赋予更多目的地特色与体验感。上海虹桥万丽酒店以便捷的交通、别具设计感的舒适客房、完善的配套及全方位周全服务, 为商旅宾客解锁非凡旅居体验。
description.textEn: Renaissance Shanghai Hongqiao is located in Hongqiao high-end residential core area, close to the Hongqiao International Airport & High Speed Train Station and the National Exhibition & Convention Centre –NECC Shanghai. The hotel has 321 guest rooms which incorporate the refreshed design concept delivering sophisticated spaces and experiences that keep the mind balanced, sharp and inspired. At Food Studio all-day dining restaurant, enjoy a variety of international cuisine. Join us at "R Bar" to enjoy the Evenings at Renaissance amidst clinking glasses. The Executive Lounge provides a chic nightlife experience the indoor pool, the fitness center. with over 2,300 square meters of the Grand Ballroom and an immersive experience to your grand occasions.

description.textZh: 上海淳大万丽酒店座落于活力四射的浦东商业新区，周围环境繁华热闹，真正商务休闲两相宜。上海淳大万丽酒店毗邻浦东世纪公园及上海新国际博览中心，步行五分钟可至地铁18号线及9号线杨高中路站，步行即可抵达集休闲、购物和娱乐为一体的大拇指广场和联洋广场。作为万豪国际集团旗下酒店,热情洋溢的待客之道令人倍感温馨，先进的设备更可轻松承办各种规模的活动或宴会。上海淳大万丽酒店融合中式传统元素和西式设计手法在现代中演绎昔日上海的繁华浪漫，在和谐中体会新与旧、中与西的交汇。
description.textEn: Curated for the adventurous who see every journey as a chance to be inspired, the 5 star Renaissance Shanghai Pudong Hotel offers contemporary accommodation styled with indigenous design accents. Located near the Shanghai New International Expo Centre, Century Park and Shanghai Science and Technology Museum, the hotel is an ideal choice for both business and leisure. Discover the neighborhood with easy access to the Bund, Oriental Pearl Tower, Luijiazui financial district and People Square via the nearest Metro rail, Line 2. Our hotel features a full array of amenities and services comprising of culinary, entertainment, and wellness experiences. Celebrate and socialize in our dedicated event space with exquisite catering offerings and state-of-the-art technology.

description.textZh: 作为万豪国际集团旗下酒店，在上海明捷万丽酒店，不经意处，灵光闪现！酒店位于铜川路50号，真如副中心，一座集高端住宅、办公楼、酒店、商业于一体的大型多业态的都市综合体。与地铁七号线岚皋路站直接毗连，可直达静安寺，上海世博展览馆，浦东新国际展览中心等，距离上海火车站仅需约10分钟车程，驱车约15分钟可至上海跨国采购会展中心，约25分钟可至上海虹桥机场，约45分钟可至上海浦东国际机场，交通便捷，地理位置优越，缔造精彩的出行之旅。杰出的服务和先进的设施带给您不凡的住宿体验。您可以在上海明捷万丽酒店内的四间餐厅品尝创新美食，于先进的会议空间会见同事及客户，前往波光粼粼的室内泳池欢快畅游，或者在客房或套房内领略旖旎风光。我们的礼宾人员竭诚为您效劳，助您轻松选择活动，让您不虚此行。生活在于发现，随心发现灵感，体验多姿多彩的商务逍遥游！
description.textEn: Renaissance Shanghai Putuo Hotel, a Marriott Luxury & Lifestyle Hotel, you'll find a place where simple delights become memorable moments. Thoughtfully renovated and upgraded in 2024. The hotel is ideally located on the Tongchuan Road, directly connected to Metro Line 7 Langao Road Station which can directly access to the Jing’an Temple, Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center, National Exhibition and Convention Center, etc. It takes 10 minutes from the hotel to Shanghai Railway Station, 15 minutes to Shanghai International Sourcing Promotion Center, 25 minutes to Hongqiao International airport, 45 minutes to Pudong International Airport. Indulge in inspired cuisine at one of four delectable restaurants, meet with colleagues and clients at our state-of-the-art meeting space, dive into our sparkling indoor swimming pool or take in the view from your room or suite. We look forward to welcoming you to Renaissance Shanghai Putuo Hotel.

description.textZh: 上海豫园万丽酒店座落于市中心，邻近知名的豫园和老城厢，距外滩、新天地及其它旅游景点仅数分钟路程。酒店环境温馨惬意，为宾客提供如家般舒适的商务和休闲体验。酒店拥有时尚的客房和套房，并配备豪华床上用品、高速上网、保险箱和迷你吧。上海豫园万丽酒店设施超凡，包括一个商务中心、四间活动室和宴会厅。更在 17 楼提供行政楼层酒廊，让您可以欣赏一望无垠的城市天际线景观。我们的餐厅提供全方位服务。您可以在晚上于任一间餐厅同家人或同事聚餐，享用美食，闲话家常。欢迎莅临亚洲文化中心上海，并享受上海豫园万丽酒店的超凡住宿体验。
description.textEn: Renaissance Shanghai Yu Garden Hotel a Marriott Luxury and Lifestyle Hotel located downtown near the famous Yu Garden and Old Town. It is just minutes away from the Bund, Xintiandi and other tourist attractions. Whether staying for business or leisure you will be right at home at the Renaissance Shanghai Yu Garden Hotel. Accommodations feature contemporary guest rooms and suites with luxurious bedding, high speed Internet, sofa and mini bar. Top notch facilities include a business center, four event rooms and banquet halls and a 17th floor Club Lounge with expansive views of the city skyline. In the evening dine at one of our full service restaurants while catching up with family or colleagues. When visiting our cultural center of Asia enjoy the accommodation at the Renaissance.

description.textZh: 上海龙之梦万丽酒店地处长宁商圈，直接与轨道交通2、3、4号线中山公园站相连接，乘坐地铁2号线途径陆家嘴、南京路步行街、人民广场、静安寺等热门地点；同时，也可便捷前往浦东国际机场、虹桥机场、虹桥火车站、上海火车站及上海南站。 这座与众不同的建筑融合了一家大型复合式购物中心，便利的地理位置能让您在旅程中发现惊喜。 酒店位于60层大厦的25层以上，并拥有一个令人惊叹的空中大堂。客房包括：豪华房、高级豪华房、行政房、行政套房、复式豪华套房等，拥有非凡的城市景观。会议总面积逾2,200平方米，可灵活分割以迎合不同会议及活动的需求。祖蓝餐厅、择咖啡廊带您领略饕餮美食。
description.textEn: Plan your visit to the Renaissance Shanghai Zhongshan Park Hotel. With a unique location over the Zhongshan Park Station Metro Line 2, 3, and 4, directly to popular destinations including Lujiazui, Nanjing Road, People Square, Jin’an Temple, Hongqiao Railway Station, Shanghai Railway Station, Shanghai South Railway Station, Pudong International Airport, and Hongqiao Airport. It is integrated a large shopping mall complex, offering guests easy access to many recreation opportunities. Total guest rooms occupying on the 25 floor and above of the 60-storey building with a breathtaking Sky Lobby, including Deluxe Rooms, Premium Rooms, Club Rooms and Club Suites and signature Duplex, offer panoramic views. An impressive 2,200 square meters of meeting space which can be combined for various event set-ups. Delectable dining options include Azur, Zpark Coffee.

records.name_en: Sheraton Grand Shanghai Pudong Hotel & Residences
records.name_zh: 上海浦东喜来登由由大酒店及公寓

description.textZh: 上海浦东喜来登由由大酒店及公寓地处浦东新区的中心地带，可便利前往上海中央商务区和众多旅游景点，并可饱览美轮美奂的黄浦江胜景。宽敞明亮的酒店大堂热忱恭候您的光临。当您在 24 小时前台办理登记入住手续时，请放心将行李交由我们的行李员处置。我们的 525 间客房和 141 间公寓式套房均设计精美、温馨宜人，并配有超舒适的喜来登特色睡眠体验之床、32 英寸液晶纯平电视及其他多种便利设施。商务旅客将在此尽享舒适安逸的工作环境，所有客房均配有高速上网接入，此外，酒店还设有专用商务中心。酒店拥有逾 2,400 平米功能灵活的会议空间，包括无柱式大宴会厅，是在上海举办各种规模的会议、婚礼及活动的理想之选，备受商旅宾客青睐。
description.textEn: Sheraton Grand Shanghai Pudong Hotel & Residences is situated in the heart of Pudong New District, we provide easy access to Shanghai's central business district and places of interest as well as fabulous views of the Huangpu River. Our spacious lobby warmly welcomes you into our hotel. Let our bellmen handle your luggage as you check in at our 24-hour front desk. Warm and cozy, our 525 beautifully appointed guest rooms and 141 apartment suites each boast the ultra-comfortable Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience, a 32-inch LCD flat screen TV, and a host of other features. Our business travelers will be taken care of with a comfortable working area and High Speed Internet Access in all rooms, as well as a dedicated Business Center. If business brings you to Shanghai, our enormous meeting/function space of over 1,500 square meters, including our pillar-less Grand Ballroom, provides great versatility and makes us the ideal choice for meetings, conferences, weddings and events of any size.

records.name_zh: 上海崇明由由喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 上海崇明由由喜来登酒店是远离城市喧嚣和匆碌的精致休闲之所，酒店设施配备齐全，于此休闲放松、专注工作或社交聚会皆宜。我们的288 间宽敞的客房、套房和2座别墅均配备有LED 电视、私人浴室、免费 Wi-Fi 等丰富设施。我们提供多种多样的活动，让您的入住体验丰富多彩，同时还有非凡的设施让您尽享舒适。前往配备室内恒温泳池的喜来登健身中心尽情锻炼，或体验酒店内设的游戏房，抑或租辆单车畅游周边地区。如果休闲体验太美，不想离开客房，您可以拿起电话呼叫我们的 24小时客房送餐服务。酒店内的两间餐厅供应国际美食，或者您还可前往附近的市中心寻觅其他美食，满足用餐需求。酒店拥有的室内儿童俱乐部，备受孩子们青睐，是家庭出游的理想之选。酒店拥有约 1,000 平米的多功能会议空间，是举办各类商务活动的理想之选。
description.textEn: A sophisticated retreat from the crowed and hectic pace of Shanghai city, Sheraton Shanghai Chongming Hotel is well equipped to keep you relaxed, focused and in touch. Each of our 288 spacious guest rooms, suites and 2 villas features an LED TV, private bathroom, free WiFi and more. We offer many activities to help you stay busy during your stay, as well as quality amenities for your comfort. Make use of our Sheraton Fitness Center with an indoor heated swimming pool or on-site game room, or rent a bike and tour the surrounding area. If it is relaxation you seek, stay in and call our 24-hour room service. When you're hungry, stop by one of our 2 restaurants with international cuisines, or venture out to the nearby city center. For those traveling with family, know your kids will have fun in our indoor Kids Club. Our versatile function space is perfect to accommodate any of your business needs; with 1,000 square-meters of meeting space.

description.textZh: 上海宝华喜来登酒店提供贴心周到的设施及服务，工作娱乐两相宜，休闲海滩与古雅街区共同构筑成美轮美奂的迷人天堂。酒店客房配备舒适睡床、现代科技设施、带独立浴缸的宽敞浴室，以及 Le Grand Bain 芳香卫浴用品。部分宾客还可尊享行政酒廊礼遇，使用酒廊休闲空间并享受免费服务。到 Yu 中餐厅和优雅包厢享用淮扬菜，或于 S厨房西餐厅体验互动式烹饪和自助早餐。酒店拥有当地超大的宴会厅，面积逾 1,078 平米，配备先进的视听设备，更可灵活分为两个独立空间，满足不同需求。靠近上海，古老村落、绿色公园等景点美不胜收，精彩活动轮番上演，另外，您也可以在酒店的室内恒温泳池或健身中心放松休憩。
description.textEn: Relaxing beaches and a quaint charm are hallmarks of the neighborhood surrounding the Sheraton Shanghai Fengxian, where guests will find amenities to balance the demands of work and the need for relaxation. Our hotel's accommodations feature cozy beds, desired technology and spacious bathrooms with a separate tub and aromatic amenities from Le Grand Bain. Select guests enjoy access to the Executive Lounge and its relaxing spaces and complimentary services. Dining includes elegant private dining rooms and Huaiyang cuisine at Yu Chinese Restaurant and interactive cooking and a breakfast buffet at S Kitchen. The hotel’s Ballroom is among the largest in the area at more than 11,600 sq. ft. and is outfitted with state-of-the-art audiovisual features and the flexibility to offer two separate spaces. The area near Shanghai, China offers an array of attractions and activities, including ancient villages and green parks, but guests may choose to relax at the hotel’s indoor heated swimming pool or fitness center.

description.textZh: 上海嘉定喜来登酒店是远离城市拥挤和匆忙步履的精致休憩之地，完善的内部设施使您能充分地放松、恢复和连接。我们提供全方位的娱乐设施和服务，为您打造温馨、舒适和便利的下榻体验。步行约十分钟可达地铁11号线嘉定北站，上海的 F1 赛车场和上海国际汽车城分别距离酒店约 20 分钟及 30 分钟车程。此外，酒店距上海虹桥国际机场（SHA）仅约 30 分钟车程，距上海浦东国际机场（PVG）仅约 75 分钟车程。酒店拥有面积超过 3,200 平米的多功能会议空间，每间均布局灵活、设施先进，是您在上海举办难忘活动的理想之所。我们拥有一间 1,050 平米的无柱大宴会厅、一间 478 平米的精致宴会厅和另外 15 间会议厅——任君选择。我们热情友好、服务高效的策划及餐饮团队将为您精心打造一场与众不同的会议、培训活动、婚礼或社交聚会。
description.textEn: A sophisticated retreat from the crowds and hectic pace of the Jiading District, Sheraton Shanghai Jiading Hotel is well equipped to keep you refreshed, relaxed and totally in touch. It is only a 10 minutes' walk to Metro 11 which takes you to downtown Shanghai and a 20 minutes' drive to Shanghai International Circuit, which lets you experience the real fast and furious. In addition, our Jiading hotel is just 30 minutes from Hongqiao International Airport and 75 minutes from Pudong International Airport. Stage an unforgettable Shanghai event in our more than 3,200 square meters of multifunction conference space, featuring flexible setups and advanced meetings technology. Choose from our 1,050-square-meter pillarless Grand Ballroom, 478-square-meter Junior Ballroom and 15 other meeting rooms. Our friendly, efficient planning and catering teams are at your disposal to arrange the perfect meeting, training session, wedding or social gathering. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel in Shanghai, China.

records.name_zh: 上海浦东滨江喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 上海浦东滨江喜来登酒店地处浦东滨江带，与杨浦大桥毗肩相邻，位于陆家嘴商业区和金桥地区交接处，城市主干道浦东大道和万德路交叉口的东南处。酒店大门正对着滨江绿化带，距离黄浦江仅有三百米之遥；造型壮观的杨浦大桥紧临酒店西北面，蜿蜒盘旋的引桥直达酒店正门。酒店交通及其便捷，毗连内环高架，由浦东大道地道至陆家嘴商业及观光区只需8分钟，距离人民广场也仅需15分钟，酒店门口即可搭乘地铁14号线。此外，酒店距陆家嘴国际金融区仅有5公里；距上海浦东新国际博览中心7公里；距五角场商务圈8公里；距浦东国际机场30公里。酒店建筑总面积68,000平米，总高度为129.90米。上海浦东滨江喜来登酒店集住宿、餐饮、会议、及休闲娱乐为一体。562间豪华雅致客房及套房将黄浦江美景一览无遗。酒店设有全日制餐厅、中餐厅、堂吧、健身中心等餐饮及休闲设施，此外还配备大、中、小型会议室，是各种行业年会、董事会、高级别培训的理想场所。上海浦东滨江喜来登酒店引进世界著名的万豪国际集团酒店管理模式，利用现代化设备和先进的管理手段，并紧密结合上海国际大都市的特点，打造一个豪华的品牌休闲娱乐场所。
description.textEn: Located at the intersection of the Lujiazui commercial district and the Jinqiao area, on the main urban road Pudong Avenue. The Facing the riverside green belt, only 300m away from the Huangpu River; Yangpu Bridge is close to the northwest of the hotel. Convenient transportation and is adjacent to the inner ring elevated road. Only takes 8 min to Lujiazui commercial area, and 15 min to People's Square. Take the subway line 14 at the entrance of the hotel. Only 5 km away from the Lujiazui International Financial District; 7 km away from Shanghai Pudong New International Expo Center; 8 km away from Wujiaochang Business Circle; and 30 km away from Pudong International Airport.542 luxurious and elegant rooms and suites, showcasing beautiful scenery of the Huangpu River. Equipped with restaurants ,bars and leisure facilities, as well as meeting rooms of different specifications, as an ideal place for various industry annual meetings.

records.name_zh: 上海外高桥喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 上海外高桥喜来登酒店位于中国（上海）自由贸易试验区，距浦东中央商务区（CBD）约 15 公里。地理位置优越，近在咫尺的地铁轨道交通及若干条城市高速路将酒店与陆家嘴金融区、浦东国际机场、虹桥国际机场及上海迪士尼度假区轻松联通。酒店拥有四百余间装饰典雅的客房及套房，可饱览迷人港口景色。喜来登行政贵宾厅及配备升级设施的行政客房亦为宾客带来多姿体验。 酒店其他便利设施包括餐厅、酒吧及设施完善的健身中心。奉上中、日、国际盛宴的三个餐厅及酒廊为您打造难以抗拒的厨艺盛宴和饕餮体验。超过2600平方米会议空间包含了1000平方米8.6米高的无柱大宴会厅为您的活动无论是晚宴、婚宴还是各类会议或是国际大会提供理想场所。 毗邻长兴岛、崇明岛等沪上热门度假之地，足不出沪，即可在外高桥体验惬意别样的文化之旅。荷兰式建筑的荷兰小镇带你领略异国风情，占地300公顷的上海滨江森林公园是个天然氧吧，驱车半小时内亦可直达共青国家森林公园、吴淞口炮台湾国家湿地公园，让您尽享自然。这里也是购物者的天堂，集合了山姆会员旗舰店、盒马X会员店、欧尚大型超市、星美国际电影院及众多一线品牌、占地6万平方米的森兰国际商都满足您各种购物需求。同时，距酒店仅需几分钟车程的外高桥进口商品直销中心，为您提供超4000种进口食品及商品。
description.textEn: Welcome to Sheraton Shanghai Waigaoqiao Hotel. Strategically situated in the Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone of Pudong New District, our hotel is conveniently connected via express highways and city metro lines. The hotel is also one of the closest international hotels to Shanghai Disneyland. Our luxurious property features an indoor pool, a golf course, a wellness center and more. Guests can relax in our sauna or enjoy a soothing massage at our spa, or check emails and work in our well-equipped business center. Each guest room is spacious and elegantly decorated, offering beautiful river views and large windows that provide plenty of natural light. Our rooms also feature free WiFi, a flat-screen TV and more, as well as a large private bathroom. Our on-site restaurants offer delicious creative dishes to satisfy your appetite, including the option of breakfast. Whether business or pleasure brings you to this area, you will be able to relax and connect with what’s important to you.

description.textZh: 上海静安瑞吉酒店地处北京西路，坐落在当地文化和商业中心静安区的中心地段。酒店内部装潢典雅精致，传统英伦韵味和中式华美风格巧妙融合，书法、手工金箔画等中国艺术和文化作品为之画龙点睛，宛若别致静谧的休闲绿洲。酒店公共空间内矗立着由世界有名艺术家Dale Chihuly倾情创作的五座玻璃雕塑，视觉效果非常惊艳。上海静安瑞吉酒店拥有491间精致时尚的客房，内设六间特色餐厅及酒吧、瑞吉品牌特色水疗中心及健身中心。同时，约1,400平米的艾斯特宴会厅配有约90平米的LED墙面投影系统，缔造非同凡响的活动体验。
description.textEn: The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan is situated on West Beijing Road in the heart of Jingan District, Shanghai’s cultural and business center. The hotel’s elegant interiors create an oasis of calm, blending traditional English and Chinese palatial styles with elements of Chinese art and culture, such as calligraphy and handcrafted gold foil paintings.Adding to its visual appeal, the hotel’s public spaces showcase five glass sculptures by world-renowned artist Dale Chihuly.The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan features 491 exquisitely designed guest rooms, six distinctive restaurants and bars, the St. Regis brand’s signature Spa, and a fitness center. Its 1,400-square-meter Astor Ballroom includes a 90-square-meter LED wall projection system, offering guests an unparalleled experience during their stay.

records.name_en: The St. Regis on the Bund, Shanghai

description.textZh: 上海外滩瑞吉酒店坐落于摩登繁华的上海外滩，尽览黄浦江潋滟波光与浦东天际线交相辉映的壮丽画卷。酒店拥有189间客房，包含20间套房，配备精致非凡的设施及贴心周到的瑞吉管家服务，拥有2个餐厅和1个瑞吉酒吧。酒店运用玉兰花刺绣与艺术辉映的奢华融合，宾客置身在这座璀璨富丽的标志性建筑里，体验深厚底蕴的阿斯特家族待客之道，感受令人迷醉的外滩风光。上海外滩瑞吉酒店，融合东西方文化，启迪艺术魅力的理想选择。酒店拥有近 1,100平方米的会议空间，饱览外滩长廊景致。配备先进设施，空间更可灵活多变，以满足各种不同形式的宴会和会议活动的需要。专属瑞吉会议管家更贴心为会议组织者提供 24 小时服务，确保每一场会议顺利进行。
description.textEn: The St. Regis on the Bund, Shanghai is nestled in the modern and bustling Shanghai Bund offering breathtaking views of the stunning panorama where the shimmering waves of the Huangpu River and the skyline of Pudong complement each other. The St. Regis Shanghai on the Bund has 189 guest rooms, including 20 suites, all equipped with exquisite facilities and thoughtful St. Regis Butler service. It also features two restaurants and one St. Regis Bar. The hotel blends the luxury of magnolia embroidery with art, allowing guests to immerse themselves in this dazzling and magnificent landmark building, experience the profound heritage of the Astor family's hospitality, and enjoy the enchanting views of the Bund. The St. Regis Shanghai on the Bund is the ideal choice for those seeking to blend Eastern and Western cultures and inspire artistic charm.

records.name_zh: 上海波特曼丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: Discover The Portman Ritz-Carlton, Shanghai - an unforgettable luxury hotel surrounded by a city rich in history and cosmopolitan delights. With impeccable service and exclusive amenities, the luxury Shanghai hotel is an exceptional retreat.
description.textEn: The award-winning 593-room Portman Ritz-Carlton, Shanghai is a landmark located in a retail, dining and entertainment complex on the famous West Nanjing Road. Situated in the heart of the commercial, shopping and entertainment district of the city, our luxury hotel features unparalleled service, exquisite dining experiences and spacious accommodations. Business center and extensive health club with swimming pool and 24-hour gym are also featured at our downtown Shanghai hotel. The Club Level features relaxed lounging, internet connection and sumptuous delicacies served throughout the day.

records.name_zh: 上海浦东丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: NESTLING AT THE HEART OF SHANGHAI FINANCIAL DISTRICT AND OFFERING SWEEPING VIEWS ACROSS SHANGHAI VIBRANT HUANGPU RIVER AND HISTORICAL BUND, THE RITZ-CARLTON SHANGHAI, PUDONG GUARANTEES GUESTS AN UNFORGETTABLE SHANGHAI VISIT.
description.textEn: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic experience within a vibrant city at The Ritz-Carlton Shanghai, Pudong, where Art Deco elegance beautifully merges with contemporary design. Nestled on the upper levels of a stylish 58-floor tower in Lujiazui, the bustling epicenter of Shanghai's commercial, financial, and upscale retail scene, this luxurious hotel offers breathtaking views of the Bund and the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower. It's just one of the unforgettable moments that guests will cherish from their time in Shanghai.

records.name_en: Aqua Caeli Hotel, Shanghai Fengjing, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 上海枫泾水济天心酒店·臻品之选
上海外滩 W 酒店

description.textZh: 上海外滩W酒店是一家坐落于北外滩的奢华酒店，与浦西的繁华都市交相辉映，融合自然、历史和传统海派文化元素，兼具历史独特韵味与先锋潮酷的非凡格调。374间精心设计的客房和套房既蕴含了老上海风情，也彰显了W的时尚风潮。酒店拥有逾5,800平方米的活动空间，配备灵活多变的设备与视听设施，是您举办惊艳四座的会议的上佳场所。5个餐厅和酒吧，全力满足不同宾客对美食的需求：现代纽约风格浓郁的标帜餐厅，全天供应国际佳肴；跃层设计空间的艳中餐厅，呈现新式江南料理与粤菜相结合的特色美食；一同与艳汁酒吧追溯到上海鸡尾酒盛行的黄金年代；风格多变的WOOBAR®酒吧，随着日夜交替呈现不同风貌；热带风情的WET®池畔酒吧更是众多社交达人尽情玩乐的好去处。宾客更可轻松享受一系列实用设施与定制化的服务，如激发活力的FIT健身中心、舒缓身心的AWAY®水疗中心、闲适自在的WET®室内碧波泳池和可饱览上海浦东地标天际线的WET®室外碧波泳池。从白天直至深夜，上海外滩W酒店精彩持续上演，让您沉浸在传统东方古韵与现代西方文化的交融和碰撞，恣享生活。
description.textEn: W Shanghai - The Bund is a luxury hotel located on the up-and-coming North Bund in glamorous Shanghai. Wake up to views of the Huangpu River from 374 supremely chic hotel rooms and suites that fuse sophisticated Mandarin designs with playful twists. Innovative decor and 5,800 square meters of event space ensure your meetings are anything but ordinary. Taste the flavors at our five restaurants and bars, including The Kitchen Table, a modern New York City-style bistro; YEN, celebrates contemporary Jiangnan and Cantonese cuisine mixed in with some Shanghainese favorites; LIQUID, a Golden Age-inspired cocktail bar; WOOBAR®, a playground that spotlights world-renowned DJs and crafted concoctions on The Bund and WET® Bar, a perfect place for cocktails, light fare and finger food. Unwind in spectacular style at our hotel's FIT gym, then pamper yourself at AWAY® Spa. Take a swim in our outdoor and indoor WET® pools with a playful WET® Deck that faces Shanghai's iconic skyline.

description.textZh: 上海威斯汀大饭店坐落于繁华的上海市中心，距人流如织的外滩滨江步道仅有两个街区之遥，是一家地理位置优越的 5 星级商务酒店，酒店周边名品店及餐厅云集，入住尽享便利。入住酒店，您不妨在清晨选择酒店恒温泳池畅游一番，或走进威斯汀健身中心，尽情挥汗，开启充满活力的一天。饭店配有 568 间华贵典雅的客房和套房。舒适的威斯汀天梦之床助您安享一夜好眠，客房内可欣赏美不胜收的黄浦江和外滩景观，或观赏上海城市美景和豫园古朴景致。上海威斯汀大饭店集商务酒店与亲子酒店于一身，是商务旅行与休闲旅游的理想选择。
description.textEn: Located in dazzling downtown Shanghai two blocks from the vibrant promenade on the Bund waterfront The Westin Bund Center Shanghai is a conveniently situated 5 star hotel in a neighborhood of luxury brand shops and celebrated restaurants. Enjoy easy access to major business districts as well. While at the hotel, jump start your day in our beautiful heated pool or the WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio. Enjoy delectable Eat Well breakfast buffets and surrender to pampering treatments in the ISpa Shanghai. Two architecturally dazzling 26 story towers with 568 hotel rooms and suites surround you in sumptuous style and 5 star amenities. Sink into a plush Westin Heavenly Bed, enjoy high tech amenities and superb views of the Huangpu River and the Bund or the Shanghai cityscape and Yu Garden.

records.name_zh: 上饶信州万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 上饶信州万豪万枫酒店位于市中心解放路59号，毗邻万达广场、步行街及信江河，前往三清山、婺源便捷，距上饶站及机场约9公里。秉承万枫“简约之美”理念，以“蓝岭山脉、庄园美学”为基调。大堂融合前台、商务、社交、休闲等功能，打造共享空间。万枫会客厅配备标志性壁炉与艺术陈设，聚谊长桌满足办公与交流需求，私密洽谈室助力商务时刻。拥有125间现代化客房及套房，原木色调搭配复古台灯与抽象画，温馨舒适。配备舒适床品、65寸电视、智能客控、电动窗帘、无线蓝牙音箱、手机投屏、智慧洗衣、高速网络及USB接口。江景房可远眺信江美景。5F万枫餐厅供应中西式健康早餐，含本地美食、时令水果、鲜奶、咖啡及香茗。另设两间中餐包房，以健康融合菜为特色。酒店拥有220平米会议空间，配备先进设施与专业团队。健身中心24小时开放，配备高档器械；全天候自助洗衣服务为宾客提供便利。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Shangrao Xinzhou is a select brand under Marriott International. The hotel offers excellent and professional services for both business and leisure guests, ensuring an unforgettable residential experience. It features 125 guestrooms equipped with Sealy mattresses, skin-friendly bedding, 65-inch LCD TVs, high-speed WiFi, USB charging ports, wireless charging for mobile phones, and safes to cater to the diverse needs of guests.The Fairfield Restaurant has 96 seats where guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast with a variety of options. Additionally, snacks and refreshments are available for purchase at the all-day self-service "24/7 Market." The hotel’s 24/7 well-equipped fitness center allows guests to maintain their exercise routines while traveling; the 24/7 self-service laundry also provides guests with more convenience and flexibility.

description.textZh: Experience modern comfort and local charm at Four Points by Sheraton Wuyuan. Located near ancient villages and scenic landscapes, our hotel offers stylish rooms, warm service, and authentic flavors in the heart of China’s most beautiful countryside.
description.textEn: Ideally located just 100 meters from Wuyuan High-Speed Railway Station, Four Points by Sheraton Wuyuan offers unmatched convenience for travelers. Surrounded by lush mountains and overlooking a scenic public park, the hotel boasts sweeping views from its upper floors. Whether you’re here to explore the nearby ancient villages or simply relax in nature, our modern comforts, thoughtful amenities, and genuine service ensure a warm and effortless stay in one of China’s most picturesque destinations.

description.textZh: Located in the center of Zhugang New Town, Shantou Marriott hotel has 315 well designed guest rooms and suites, 4 different style restaurants, lobby lounge and bakery shop, as well as over 3,400 square meters of banquet and conference space.
description.textEn: Shantou Marriott Hotel is the first Marriott brand hotel in eastern Guangdong, located in the center of Zhugang New Town, Longhu District, the hotel is located in an advantageous location with convenient transportation, 38 floors high as the city s new landmark, with 315 well-designed guest rooms and suites, 4 different style restaurants, lobby lounge and bakery shop, as well as over 3,400 square meters of banquet and conference space. Shantou Marriott Hotel inherits the excellent management culture and service concept of Marriott International hotels. With excellent facilities and world-renowned Marriott service, Shantou Marriott Hotel provides exceptional quality experience for each guest.

description.textZh: 汕头龙光喜来登酒店凭借优越的地理环境及完善的管理服务，赢得广大旅客的一致好评，汕头龙光喜来登酒店始终让每位下榻酒店的旅客高品质的体验。在汕头龙光喜来登酒店，您将感受到别具一格的非凡人生。汕头龙光喜来登酒店热切期待您的光临——无论您是商务旅行还是休闲度假，温馨宜人的汕头龙光喜来登酒店都能让您尽情放松并随时跟进重要事宜。汕头龙光喜来登酒店位于市中心与长平路购物区的黄金地段，周边街区一切十分齐全——您只需短途步行，即可抵达行政机关和会展中心，同时还紧邻人民广场和时代广场绿化带。汕头龙光喜来登酒店的便利设施和服务在此随处可见，我们的 330 间客房（包括 24 间套房）采用别具一格的潮州风格装潢，配有舒适宜人的家具陈设，必将为您带来一次轻松惬意的住宿体验。您可通过房内的高速上网接入和 42 英寸纯平电视与外界随时保持联系。利用我们特色的喜来登特色睡眠体验尽享一夜酣眠，而配有一系列精美用品的雨林淋浴间则为您送上清爽沐浴体验。精美卫浴用品将让您倍感宾至如归！汕头龙光喜来登酒店大堂内的“随心连动@喜来登，体验在微软” ，让您尽情放松并随时跟进重要事宜，是您工作、放松和与他人保持联系的非凡之地。我们的室外泳池、喜来登健身中心可为您带来愉悦身心的美妙体验。
description.textEn: Sheraton Shantou Hotel offers all the familiar Sheraton comforts to make it easy to stay connected to work or relaxed from business stays to family getaways. Be at your peak at all times and let Sheraton Fitness be your solution to a healthy lifestyle while on the road. Take a break with a refreshing dip in our outdoor swimming pool or work smart with Wi-Fi and dynamic meeting spaces. After a long day of exploring, tantalize your taste-buds and enjoy a memorable dining experience at our Feast Signature Restaurant or YUE Chinese restaurant, and find it an ideal meeting place for family and friends.

description.textZh: 汕尾海丰万怡酒店是东维亚集团联袂万豪集团在海丰县开设的高端国际品牌酒店，酒店毗邻东维亚粤东总部、海丰影剧院，坐落于海城中心区域，是文化、金融、政治交汇核心之地。酒店以海丰当地人民劳作方式所造就的自然景观“耕海”为设计理念，采用纵横交错的简洁艺术线条进行空间与室内建筑的演绎，打造视觉、空间、流线、功能等多方元素的艺术佳作，淋漓尽致的展示不同方位的开放与分割，让来店的宾客深入感受海丰当地的特色文化和丰富的艺术底蕴，与万豪一同体验这场商务与文化的融合。万怡酒店共18层，同时拥有125间现代化高品质客房和套房，另配备128平方米的会议室、餐厅及特色大堂吧。汕尾海丰万怡酒店秉承万豪国际集团卓越的管理文化及服务理念，凭借享誉全球的万豪服务，将力求为每位来此的宾客奉献卓而不凡的品质服务，让来客尽情体验商务聚会和休闲度假的愉悦享受。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Shanwei Haifeng is a high end international brand hotel established in Haifeng County through a joint effort between Victori Group and Marriott International. The hotel is strategically located in the heart of Haichengs central area, adjacent to the Eastvia Guangdong Headquarters and the Haifeng Cinema, making it a hub where culture, finance and politics converge. This design artfully showcases openness and division from different perspectives allowing guests to deeply immerse themselves in the distinctive local culture and rich artistic heritage of Haifeng while experiencing the fusion of business and culture alongside the Marriott brand.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Shenzhen Shenshan Special Cooperation Zone
records.name_zh: 深圳深汕特别合作区万枫酒店

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and free breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shanwei Lufeng
records.name_zh: 汕尾陆丰福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Shanwei Lufeng offers 127 guestrooms and suites, along with on-site full-service restaurant and lobby bar boasts a signature 'Best Brews' craft beer selection, self-service laundry, 24-hour fitness center as well brings cozy trip.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Shanwei Lufeng is located in Donghai Town, Lufeng, Shanwei. The hotel's prime location ensures convenient access to key areas. Drive 15 minutes to Lufeng South Station; 15 minutes to Jinxiang Silver Beach; 40 minutes to Xuanwu Mountain Scenic Area, a national AAAA-level tourist attraction. The hotel offers 127 classical guestrooms and suites, providing a comfortable private retreat. The on-site full-service restaurant features an open kitchen, while the lobby bar boasts a signature 'Best Brews' craft beer selection. Self-service laundry is available, along with a 24-hour fitness center to rejuvenate during your travels.

description.textZh: 行走唐诗路·寻梦天姥山·有缘新昌·来了就好从天姥山到十九峰，从大佛寺到下岩贝，茶文化与佛道文化、唐诗之路、文化名人、新昌民俗形成一道别具特色的风景。大佛龙井、小京生、春饼、芋饺、炒年糕等特产与小吃，早已成为"舌尖上的新昌"代名词。作为新昌率先开设的国际品牌酒店，万豪国际集团旗下新昌万怡酒店共拥有197间客房，焕然一新的住宿环境，各类现代化设施均有配备，提供客房送餐服务和免费无线网络；近1000平方米的会议及宴会空间，适合举办大型会议，董事会议或婚宴，家庭庆祝活动；万荟轩餐厅提供国际风味自助早餐，午餐和晚餐主打粤菜和当地风味佳肴，大堂吧供应小吃、甜点、咖啡和鸡尾酒。下榻新昌万怡酒店，为您奉献舒适、惬意的住宿体验。此外，酒店距离杭州萧山国际机场约80分钟路程，距离宁波栎社国际机场约70分钟路程，距离嵊州新昌高铁站仅15分钟路程。乘高铁前往绍兴北站仅需23分钟，2小时内即可前往上海，南京，温州，1小时内可前往杭州，交通非常便利。
description.textEn: As the city's newly developed business district, it's only fitting that Xinchang has a new business-friendly hotel. At the Courtyard by Marriott Xinchang, a refreshing ambiance and modern amenities help guests focus and find balance. Each of the 197 guest rooms and suites features spaces to work, rest and relax, room service and free Wi-Fi. Dining includes Pavilion, with an international breakfast buffet and, for lunch and dinner, fusion cuisine that focuses on Cantonese and local dishes. Snacks, desserts, coffee and cocktails are on the menu at The Lounge. Five function rooms and a pillar-less ballroom can host large conferences, intimate board meetings or family celebrations. Our neighborhood is home to government and office buildings and near the Giant Buddhist Temple, Wozhou Lake and other sights. Only 1 hour from Shaoxing North Station by High-speed railway and easy access to Hangzhou within 1 hours and Shanghai, Nanjing and Wenzhou within 2 hours.

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于绍兴市越城区充满活力的智汇芯城，可轻松抵达城市各个交通枢纽及风景名胜。
description.textEn: The hotel offers 276 contemporary rooms and suites elegantly adorned with art deco accents in Klein Blue tones. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame dramatic vistas of winding canals or urban skylines, while specially commissioned artworks inspired by Shaoxing's topography reinterpret the city's water town heritage through a "map of Shaoxing" motif, immersing guests in the timeless allure of ancient Yue culture. Three distinct dining venues showcase global flavors with a local twist: Latest Recipe: A global buffet and à la carte restaurant fusing international cuisine with regional specialties. Le Mei: An elegant Chinese dining room celebrating Jiangnan’s “Land of Fish and Rice” heritage with seasonal Cantonese and Shaoxing classics.​Latitude 30 Lounge: A lively space offering artisanal Illy coffee, signature Le Scoop gelato, and creative cocktails by day, transitioning to a vibrant nightlife hub by evening.

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels & Resorts®, it's our mission to make every business trip a pleasure and every vacation the trip of a lifetime. Enjoy amenity-filled guest rooms, superb dining, exemplary meeting facilities and our time-honored 'spirit to serve®'
description.textEn: Shaoxing Marriott Hotel Shangyu is located in the west of Shangyu District, Shaoxing city. And nearby e-Games Town. The design language is extracted from local historical culture and geographical form. It perfect integrated localization and the quality of international brand hotel. It offering consumers a space of relax and enjoy humanity and nature in harmony.

description.textZh: 绍兴余坤喜来登酒店酒店设有335间宽敞舒适的客房和套房。现代时尚的建筑外观，全落地式的玻璃幕墙设计，房间视野辽阔，城市风光一览无余。每间房间配备优质的床品与沐浴设施、55寸高清电视以及全覆盖高速无线网络等其他多种便利设施设备。酒店行政酒廊为宾客打造静谧舒适的休息与放松环境，宾客可在此享受精致的小食与软饮，并可办理专属便捷的入住和退房手续。酒店拥有风格各异的中西餐厅，为宾客带来无国界特色美食。盛宴标帜西餐厅全天候提供美食零点及自助餐，让宾客在优雅舒适的环境中享受一场美味多样的环球佳肴之旅。甄选当季新鲜食材，采悦轩中餐厅别具匠心，提供地道的江浙美食及粤式菜肴。绍兴余坤喜来登酒店提供总面积超过2000平方米的会议与活动空间以及个性化的主题茶歇服务。超大面积的无柱宴会厅以及灵活的多功能会议厅，是宾客举办会议、婚宴以及社交聚会的理想之选。酒店位于风景如画的曹娥河畔，交通便利。宾客可轻松探索上虞之美，体验诗画曹娥江，虞味喜来登。
description.textEn: Sheraton Shaoxing Shangyu is located on the Bank of Cao'e River in Shangyu Economic Development Zone near the City Balcony and Music Fountain. The streamlined architectural appearance and glass curtain wall take the best lighting advantage of North-South sunshine. Sheraton Shaoxing Shangyu offers 335 rooms and suites that offer you an unforgettable stay. We offer a total meeting space of over 4000 m and the type of personalised service that you expect. With the largest ballroom in Shangyu District and seven adaptable function rooms, Sheraton Shaoxing Shangyu is an ideal location for events, conferences, weddings and other social gatherings. Coming back from the work, you can go to the Fitness Center on the third floor of the hotel to exercise and relax.

description.textZh: 沈阳和平艾美酒店位于沈阳市中心，距太原购物街仅几步之遥，轻松可至沈阳火车站，是您开启沈阳探索之旅的理想出发点。酒店内设 296 间雅致的客房和套房，配备高速宽带和 Wi-Fi、特色艾美睡床、55 英寸纯平电视、独立舒适的深泡浴缸和雨林淋浴间。除此之外，酒店还提供一系列非凡服务，例如艾美创驿大堂、两间特色餐厅和大堂酒吧。酒店入住期间，您可以尽情使用免费健身中心。9 间会议室、电话会议设施及多维视听设备，让您充分发挥想象力和创造力，打造富于革新的会议、婚礼或商务聚会。不论商务出行或旅游观光，沈阳和平艾美酒店都是您的理想下榻之所。
description.textEn: Located in the Centre of Shenyang, the Le Méridien Shenyang, Heping is the perfect base to explore the city as it is situated only steps away from Taiyuan Street and is easily accessible from Shenyang Train Station. Featuring 294 elegant guest rooms and suites with high-speed broadband and Wi-Fi access, signature LM bed and 55 inch flat-panel TV, with a deep-soaking tub and rainforest shower, and can use Marriott APP to realize mobile check-in for guest convenience. The room also offers a wide variety of extraordinary service such as Le Méridien Hub, two signature restaurants and Lobby Bar. When staying at the one of the hotels, make sure to utilize the free fitness center. Utilize our extraordinary meeting rooms by expanding your imagination and creativity for a transformative conference, wedding or business gathering with teleconferencing facilities and multi-dimensional audiovisual equipment. The Le Méridien Shenyang, Heping is the ideal place to stay when visiting or on business in Shenyang.

description.textZh: Shenyang Marriott Hotel is situated in the financial CBD center, adjacent to Shenyang North Railway Station, close to The Imperial Palace, Marshal Zhang's Mansion, Middle Commercial Street, and other scenic spots and commercial landmarks.
description.textEn: Shenyang Marriott Hotel is only 12 km away from Shenyang Taoxian International Airport, It is only a 5-minute drive from Shenyang North Railway Station to the hotel that is adjacent to Shenyang Palace Museum, Marshal Zhang's Mansion, Middle Commercial Street, and other scenic spots and commercial landmarks. Shenyang Marriott Hotel will inspire even greater brilliance in our guests through our enriching experience.

description.textZh: 沈阳太阳狮万丽酒店毗邻该市政治和经济中心，周边云集 2,000 多家企业；邻近地铁 1 号线站点，方便客人前往城市各个区域。活力与设计，酒店拥有近 3,200 平米的活动空间，配备万丽专业活动策划团队，卓越的设施服务与酒店非凡的地理位置相得益彰。餐厅主打东方美食，供应丰盛的的自助餐以及精心调制的鸡尾酒。客房装饰简约时尚，流行色调精美雅致，配备舒适的浸泡式浴缸和宜人的睡床。时尚的健身中心和室内泳池，内设休闲座椅和落地窗，宜人体验尽在此间。酒店距离沈阳纯室内全业态购物新地标杉杉奥莱仅3.8公里，距离沈阳国际泵道公园8公里，也可便利前往北陵公园和新乐遗址博物馆等目的地，尽情体验沈阳都市现代魅力和丰厚的历史文化风韵。
description.textEn: The Renaissance Shenyang West Hotel is next to the city’s political and economic center, home to nearly 2,000 businesses, and Metro Line 1, which carries riders across the city. This buzz of activity is weaved into the hotel experience, where vibrant energy and design are offered alongside familiar comforts and quiet. Meeting amenities cater to the location and include nearly 3,200 square meters of event space and R.E.N. planning experts. Restaurants highlight flavors from the East as well as the diversity of buffet-style dining. Accommodations are beautifully designed with modern, minimalist décor, pops of color, decadent soaking tubs and beds that entice guests to sleep in. Equally stylish are the fitness center and indoor swimming pool, where lounge seating and floor-to-ceiling windows add a residential touch.

records.name_zh: 沈阳新都绿城喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 沈阳新都绿城喜来登酒店紧邻辽宁省博物馆和辽宁省科技馆，距沈阳桃仙国际机场需10分钟车程。338间舒适的客房及套房，均配备喜来登特色睡眠体验床品，宽敞的工作区、有线和无线上网接入等便利设施为您带来宾至如归的温馨住宿体验。主理辽菜和粤菜的采悦轩中餐厅和汇聚世界各地美味的盛宴标帜西餐厅，为宾客提供美馔佳肴。2,000平方米的多样化会议设施，1,100平方米无柱式宴会厅可被分为三个小厅，另有8个多功能厅均配备视听设备。郁郁葱葱的后花园及特色户外泳池，是商务会议、社交聚会、举行婚礼的理想之选。
description.textEn: Conveniently located in the Hunnan New District, the hotel is in the new center of the Administrative and Culture hub of the city. Both Shenyang Taoxian International Airport (SHE) and the Shenyang Olympic Sports Center are only 10 minutes away by car. Unwind in one of our 338 contemporary and elegant guest rooms. All rooms feature the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience bed. A spacious work area, wired and wireless Speed Internet Access are just a few comforts of home. Enjoy some of the freshest and cuisines in our YUE Chinese and Feast Signature Restaurant. With extensive meeting facilities spanning approximately 2,000 square meters, the Sheraton Shenyang South City Hotel is an ideal venue for events. The 1,100-square-meter Grand Ballroom can be divided into three sections. All function spaces are equipped with state-of-the-art technology and backed by a dedicated team of planning and catering professionals.

description.textZh: 酒店位于城市中央商务区及休闲区的核心地带。交通便利，毗邻火车站、桃仙机场及地铁站。近邻沈阳故宫、张学良旧居及中街等旅游景点。酒店拥有446间客房、套房及多种不同面积及布局公寓式套房。房内配有65寸液晶电视可实现独立投屏、高速无线网络，可满足商务出行及家庭休闲之旅的客人需求。2间特色餐厅及大堂吧，为您呈现风味各异的特色美食体验。3500平健身区域，专业的健身设备和设施，包括健身房，宽敞的游泳池和篮球及壁球场地等休闲区域，助您精力充沛。多功能宴会厅缔造专属难忘的会议体验。
