description.textEn: The hotel is located in the heart of Shenyang’s CBD and shopping areas, conveniently situated, adjacent to Train Station, Taoxian Airport and Metro Station. It is close to tourist attractions such as Shenyang Imperial Palace, Zhang Xueliang's former residence and Shenyang Zhongjie. The hotel has 446 guest rooms, suites and a variety of residential-style suites of different sizes and layout. The rooms are equipped with 65-inch LCD TVs and high-speed Wi-Fi to meet the needs of guests on business trips and family leisure trips. Two specialty restaurants and lobby bar, presenting you with different flavors of special culinary experiences. 3,500 square meters of recreational and professional fitness equipment and facilities, including gymnasiums, spacious swimming pools, basketball, squash courts and other recreational areas, helping you to be energetic. The multi-functional banquet hall creates an exclusive and unforgettable meeting experience.

records.name_zh: 深圳联投东方万怡酒店

description.textZh: 深圳联投东方万怡酒店是首家在深圳开业的万怡酒店。酒店地处知名制造业和工业中心宝安松岗，位于一座现代化商务大厦的20至29层。酒店距高铁站及机场仅约30分钟车程，为在旅途中寻求工作与生活平衡的商务旅行者提供便利的设施和舒适的服务。客房充分利用自然采光，配有宽大的办公桌；宽敞明亮的28层行政酒廊配有一系列优质服务，为行政楼层住客及万豪礼赏会员提供专属体验；酒店餐厅万荟轩全日恭候您光临，我们在午餐时段提供中西结合的经典菜色，而晚餐时段则提供品种丰盛的海鲜自助晚餐。餐厅另设有四间豪华包房，是您款待宾朋、阖家相聚的理想之选。432平方米无柱大宴会厅和5个多功能会议厅融合潮流设计及先进设施设备，是举办时尚盛会、婚庆安排、商务会议的理想之地。
description.textEn: Courtyard makes its debut in this city with Courtyard by Marriott Shenzhen Bao'an. Set in Songgang in the manufacturing and industrial district, the hotel occupies the 20th to 29th floors of a glittering commercial building. Amenities speak to business travelers who seek work-life balance on the road, offering convenience and comfort. Guest rooms and suites boast natural light and large desks. At our hotel restaurant, Pavilion, lunch features traditional dim sum and private dining rooms can be reserved to host important clients. For larger events in Shenzhen, Bao'an, China, our hotel offers six venues, including a pillar-free ballroom with space for up to 400 guests. Access the high-speed railway and international airport in just 30 minutes from our hotel in Shenzhen, China.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻深圳湾万怡酒店，尽享舒适便利住宿体验。我们的酒店地处南山区，地理位置优越，离深圳湾超级总部基地和高新园地铁站仅咫尺之遥。酒店还邻近市中心众多热门景点。酒店拥有装饰雅致的宽敞客房和套房，配备平面电视、高速 Wi-Fi、大型办公区和迷你吧，客人可在其中尽情放松，欣赏深圳南山全景。下榻行政楼层客房还可尊享卓越的行政酒廊礼遇，小吃和饮品免费供应，花园般的环境让人心旷神怡。Pavilion 餐厅供应经典粤菜，酒廊供应定制鸡尾酒让您尽情放松身心，24 小时健身中心供您畅快锻炼。酒店地理位置优越，邻近高新园地铁站，可便利搭乘多种公共交通工具；拥有多处多功能活动场地，配备卓越的视听技术设施，提供专业活动策划服务，是您举办各类活动的理想之选。深圳湾万怡酒店，睿智旅行者的称心之选。
description.textEn: Discover an effortless blend of comfort and convenience at Courtyard Shenzhen Bay. Take advantage of our hotel's outstanding placement in Nanshan, moments from the Shenzhen Bay Super Headquarter Matrix and Hi-Tech Park station. We're also close to a range of notable attractions in downtown. Settle into our tastefully decorated, spacious hotel rooms and suites; enjoy panoramic views of Nanshan, Shenzhen, a flat-screen TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, a large workspace and a mini-bar. Elevate your stay in our Executive-level rooms to enjoy lounge access, free snacks and beverages and a scenic garden setting. Savor quintessential Cantonese dining at Pavilion, unwind with a custom cocktail at our hotel lounge or keep in shape at our 24-hour fitness center. Host an event to make use of versatile venues, superb A/V technology, expert planning and an impeccable hotel location near Hi-Tech Park station, as well as a variety of public transportation options. Courtyard Shenzhen Bay is designed for the intelligent traveler.

description.textZh: Courtyard Shenzhen Northwest is located near the city center, the airport and the new convention center. The hotel offers modern amenities including two restaurants, a lounge, a fitness center, meeting space, modern accommodations and an Executive Lounge.
description.textEn: In the center of the Shenzhen greater airport area, just moments from the new exhibition center, Courtyard Shenzhen Northwest offers convenient access to the city and beyond. Walk from our hotel to the Fuyong Metro Station, which takes you to the Qianhai Pilot Free Trade Zone or Futian Central Business District. Fuyong Wharf is only 15 minutes away, connecting you to Zhongshan, Macau and Hong Kong International Airport. Whether you're in Bao'an, Shenzhen for business or on vacation, you'll find convenience and comfort in guest rooms featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, modern decor, 24-hour room service and complimentary Wi-Fi. Executive-level hotel guests can enjoy access to a host of additional amenities in the Executive Lounge. Dining options include all-day international fare at Pavilion Restaurant and a Chinese eatery with private dining rooms. With easy access to the airport and more than 16,000 square feet of event space, our hotel is an ideal destination for meetings and business gatherings in Baoan.

records.name_en: NOA Hotel Shenzhen, a Member of Design Hotels
records.name_zh: 深圳NOA酒店（Design Hotels™设计酒店成员）

description.textZh: 深圳NOA酒店因现代工业设计而别具特色。它通过毛坯混凝土、石材和钢材等材料的相互作用，重现罗湖区活力四射的建筑传统，将粗犷与精致巧妙融合在一起。酒店名称及理念源自诺亚方舟的故事，旨在将一座旧工厂改造成属于深圳年轻创意人群的蓬勃新世界。酒店内Deck Coffee & Taproom全日餐厅供应创新融合菜品、精品咖啡和精酿啤酒；Anyu An水疗中心健康综合体提供众多令人放松的护理项目。酒店将眼镜精品店、NOA Design Store（NOA设计商店）及艺术展览整合在一起，营造出自由奔放的社交氛围。
description.textEn: NOA Hotel Shenzhen is distinguished by its contemporary industrial design. Through the interplay of materials like raw concrete, stone, and steel, it recreates the vibrant construction legacy of the Luohu district, balancing roughness with a sense of delicateness. The name and concept are derived from the story of Noah’s Ark, aiming to rebuild a former factory into a new world for the young, creative Shenzen crowd. Deck Coffee & Taproom, the hotel’s all-day restaurant, delivers innovative fusion cuisine alongside specialty coffee and craft brews, while the Anyu An·Spa wellness complex offers relaxing treatments for unwinding. The hotel integrates an eyewear boutique, the NOA Design Store, and art exhibitions, creating a free-spirited social atmosphere.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and free breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_zh: 深圳大梅沙万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 深圳大梅沙万枫酒店，作为万豪国际集团的一员，坐落于风景如画的大梅沙海滨区。仅需3分钟的步行，即可抵达大梅沙的金色沙滩，沐浴在海风的轻拂和细软沙滩的拥抱之中。酒店距离大梅沙地铁站也仅有2分钟的步行路程，方便您轻松前往市区或探索其他旅游景点。酒店拥有132间精心设计、通风良好的客房，每间客房都拥有开阔的视野，让您在享受舒适住宿的同时，也能饱览迷人的自然风光。此外，酒店还配备了无柱的灵活宴会空间，为您提供了举办各类会议和宴会活动的绝佳场地。酒店的厨师团队精心准备各式美食，让您在品尝精致佳肴的同时，也能体验到家的温馨与舒适。
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and free breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_zh: 深圳亚钢1号万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于风景优美的广东深圳龙岗区，融合优美简约与舒适便捷于一体。附设有万枫餐厅、咖啡吧及万枫小铺，配置先进而完善的健身中心。从细节之处，传递温暖，在繁忙拼搏的商旅路途中打造心安之所，成为伫于繁华之中的城市港湾。
description.textEn: The hotel features a total of 113 rooms and suites, seamlessly integrating elegance, simplicity, comfort, and convenience. It is equipped with the Fairfield Restaurant, a coffee bar, and the Fairfield Market, along with a state - of - the - art and well - equipped fitness center. The hotel conveys warmth through meticulous details, creating a haven of peace for travelers on their busy business trips. It stands as an urban oasis amidst the bustling cityscape.

description.textZh: 深圳福朋喜来登酒店地处中国广东省，地理位置优越，是适合商务和休闲旅客下榻的现代化港湾。酒店客房陈设精美，配备现代化生活用品、特色设施以及豪华双垫层床和优质寝具，更兼具休闲惬意的舒适氛围，助您轻松恢复身心活力。各具特色的餐厅供应新鲜的当地菜肴和风味国际美食，满足您的挑剔味蕾。酒店地处市中心，各大知名景点云集四周，包括深圳会展中心、市民中心以及皇岗和福田与中国香港的边境口岸。多功能活动空间提供定制餐饮及专业策划服务，助您举办卓越的会议、婚礼和社交活动。经历一天的工作、购物或观光之后，可在酒店波光粼粼的泳池畅泳一番，或到健身中心尽情锻炼。酒店位于市中心热门景点之间，是您造访深圳期间的理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: Ideally placed in Chinas Guangdong Province, Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen is a contemporary haven for business and leisure travelers. Relax and refresh in beautifully appointed hotel accommodations with modern essentials, signature amenities and plush pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Delight your palate with fresh local fare and flavorful international cuisine at our distinctive restaurants. Stay in city center amid celebrated downtown attractions, including the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center, the Civic Center and the Huanggang and Futian border crossings with Hong Kong. Host flawless meetings, weddings and social engagements in versatile event space, enhanced by custom catering and experienced planning professionals. Punctuate a day of work, shopping or sightseeing with a refreshing dip in our sparkling pool or a workout in our fitness center. Centered amid popular downtown attractions, our hotel is the home base for your visit to Shenzhen, China.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Airport
records.name_zh: 深圳机场福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 深圳机场福朋喜来登酒店，作为万豪国际酒店管理集团旗下成员，坐落于深圳大空港区核心位置，紧邻深圳国际机场和深圳国际会展中心，并与地铁12号线“怀德站”无缝接驳，轻松实现出站即达。宾客可快速前往机场东枢纽，轻松换乘其他线路；4站直达深圳国际会展中心,并与深圳怀德万象汇商业体直接连通，集交通枢纽与繁华生活于一体。与此同时，宾客亦可搭乘地铁12号线，直达南头古城、海上世界及文化艺术中心等深圳著名文化与休闲地标，尽享工作与生活的完美平衡。更为重要的是，酒店独特的地理位置为宾客往来香港、澳门提供多样化的高效出行选择：从深圳机场码头搭乘高速客轮，可便捷抵达香港国际机场及澳门码头，尽享大湾区一小时生活圈的极致便利。酒店拥有206间现代化舒适客房及套房，并设有200平方米、可容纳120人的专业会议空间，全面秉承万豪国际酒店管理集团的国际化服务标准，酒店以“创造美好生活”为设计目标，将永恒经典与现代细节巧妙融合，以舒适的设施与真诚的服务满足各地旅行者的切实需求。旨在为独立旅行者平衡工作和生活，在这里宾客可以放松身心，尽享福朋喜来登品牌特色的“醇饮优选”计划，体验当地真实而亲切的环境氛围，是您商旅深圳、往来大湾区的理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: Benefiting from a prime metropolitan location, the hotel ensures effortless access. It is conveniently close to Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport and directly integrated with Huaide Station on Metro Line 12. This provides swift, four-stop metro service to the Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center. Furthermore, the hotel offers versatile transit to Hong Kong and Macao via high-speed ferries from the adjacent Shenzhen Airport Ferry Terminal, placing guests within the renowned Greater Bay Area one-hour living circle.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Bao'an
records.name_zh: 深圳宝安福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 深圳宝安福朋喜来登酒店位于繁华的宝安中心区，邻近海雅缤纷城、宝安万达广场、壹方城购物中心等核心商务与休闲商圈，坐拥前海湾和珠三角美景。酒店外观设计巧妙独特—精巧的“钻石”切割造型矗立于宝安中心区，点与面的外墙灯设计构成了“钻石”阵列。酒店拥有208间宽敞舒适的客房及套房，内饰设计采用原木、大理石、皮革、金属等不同质感的材料，并配以定制家具与灯饰造型，营造出悠闲惬意又充满活力的空间感。每间房间均配备品牌特有的福朋舒适之床，为您营造良好睡眠环境。大堂吧拥有别具福朋品牌特色的“醇饮优选”计划，为您的休闲聚会提供宽敞雅致之所。玩啤食社全日制餐厅更可以让您品尝到世界各地精致美馔。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Baoan is located in the heart of Baoan District, surrounded by Qianhaiwan and the Pearl River Delta. Nearby Shenzhen Joy City, Hai Ya Mega Mall, Shenzhen Uniwalk Qianhai, blends business and leisure areas. The exterior design is the exquisite "diamond" cut shape building that stands in the central district of Bao'an. The point and surface light design constitutes the "diamond" array. We have 208 spacious and comfortable guest rooms and suites equipped with the Four Points Signature Bed to create a good night’s sleep. The interior is designed in wood, marble, leather, metal with customized furniture and lighting, creating a leisurely space. The Lobby Bar with brand signature Best Brews program offering local craft beers, is the best choice for leisure and business. At The Mesh you can enjoy all kinds of delicious food from all over the world.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Bay
records.name_zh: 深圳湾福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于深圳高新技术产业园（科技园）金蝶云大厦，毗邻深圳湾超级总部基地，周边汇聚欢乐谷、世界之窗等文旅地标，更与万象天地高端商圈隔街相望，商旅休闲皆享便利。全景落地窗客房，将深圳湾壮阔海景、大沙河生态水岸与沙河高尔夫球场绿茵尽收眼底。配备湾景全日制餐厅及大堂酒廊，特调“醇饮优选”精酿啤酒打造社交新场景。2间多功能会议室配备先进视听设备及LED。无论是商务差旅、会奖活动，还是城市微度假，深圳湾福朋喜来登酒店将以云端视角，伴您探索鹏城魅力。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Bay is located in Nanshan Science Park, known as China's Silicon Valley. From here, guests can easily reach commercial landmarks and entertainment attractions such as MixC, Shashan Golf Club, Happy Valley, and Window of the World, enjoying efficient and convenient business and leisure experiences. Guest rooms with floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows offer sweeping views of Shenzhen Bay, the ecological waterfront of Dasha River, and the lush greens of Shahe Golf Course.The Bay View All-Day Dining Restaurant and Lobby Lounge present a new social scene with specially crafted “Fine Brew Selection” craft beers. Three versatile meeting rooms are equipped with advanced audiovisual technology and LED displays.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Guangming
records.name_zh: 深圳光明福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 深圳光明福朋喜来登酒店位于光明区核心地段，毗邻各大交通枢纽、购物中心和人文景点。酒店距离凤凰城地铁站约1公里，光明城高铁站约5公里，优越的地理位置，是商务及休闲旅客探索光明的首要起点。酒店整体设计融合当代艺术轻奢的创意元素，秉承极具造型感与线条感的设计理念，倾情打造新锐旅者的理想之选。酒店拥有216间现代化客房和套房，均配备舒适床品、步入式淋浴间、65寸高清电视、符合人体工程学设计的沙发、灵活便捷的办公区，以及高速无线网络。全日制餐厅-玩啤食社为您打造高品质开放式盛宴，汇集中西美食，让您在舒适放松的环境里大快朵颐。大堂酒吧提供高端美酒佳酿与精品小食，切换舒适轻松时刻，是您商务聚会、静享悠然时光的理想之所。福朋喜来登以永恒经典、现代细节，致敬新征程上的光明，将为当代旅客带来至臻难忘的城市回忆。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Guangming located in the core of Guangming District, it is adjacent to major transportation hubs, shopping centers and humanistic attractions. The hotel is about 1 km from Phoenix Metro Station and 5 kms from Guangming City High Speed Railway Station. With its superior location, the hotel is an excellent starting point for business and leisure travelers to explore Guangming. The overall design of the hotel is a blend of creative elements of contemporary art and light luxury, adhering to the design concept of a great sense of shape and lines, and creating the ideal choice for emerging travelers. The hotel has 216 modern guest rooms and suites, all equipped with comfortable bedding, walk-in showers, 55-inch HD TV, ergonomically designed sofas, flexible and convenient work areas, and high-speed wireless Internet. The all-day dining restaurant, Play Beer Eatery, offers a high-quality, open-air feast of Chinese and Western delicacies in a comfortable and relaxing environment.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Longhua
records.name_zh: 深圳龙华福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Longhua is located in Lijincheng Technology Industrial Park, adjacent to many well-known enterprises, providing natural convenience for business exchanges. With an extensive and well-connected transportation network.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Longhua with an excellent geographical position. It is close to many well-known enterprises and shopping centers, and conveniently connected to Shenzhen North Railway Station, providing business and leisure guests with an efficient travel experience. We have 155 spacious guest rooms, featuring the brand’s signature industrial-chic design,and is equipped with modern amenities and comfortable bedding, aiming to create a peaceful and pleasant living space for you. During leisure time, you can enjoy the brand’s signature Best Brews program at the lobby bar, or savor a visual and gustatory feast at the open kitchen of “The MESH” all-day dining restaurant. In addition, the fully equipped fitness center is available at all times to help you maintain physical and mental balance and vitality during your journey.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Nanshan
records.name_zh: 深圳南山福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 位于南山区桃园路核心地段(地铁1号线桃园站)，对望南山区政府，毗邻深圳大学与荔香公园，城市绿意与学府人文在此交融。酒店国际化设计，开放式公共社交空间与精致服务，呈现年轻都会人群的高端旅居新方式。于此启程，可轻松抵达科技园、人才公园、沙河高尔夫球会、世界之窗等商圈地标与文娱景点，品牌特有的福朋舒适之床为您营造良好睡眠环境。大堂吧拥有别具福朋品牌特色的“醇饮优选”计划，为您的休闲聚会提供宽敞雅致之所。全日制餐厅更可以让您品尝到世界各地精致美馔。作为万豪集团旗下一贯闻名的“舒适入住”酒店，将为全球商旅人士带来轻松惬意的入住体验。
description.textEn: Hotel is located in the Taoyuan Road, Nanshan District (Metro Line 1 Taoyuan Station), facing the Nanshan Government, and neighboring Shenzhen University and Lixiang Park, where urban greenery and academic culture conThe hotel features an international design language, an open public social space, and refined services, presenting a high-end lifestyle for young urbanites. From here, you can easily reach business districts and cultural attractions such as the Science and Technology Park, Talent Park, Shekou Golf Club, and Window of the World. Each room is equipped with the brand's signature Four Points Comfort Bed, ensuring a restful sleep environment. The lobby bar offers the distinctive "Premium Drinks" program, providing a spacious and elegant venue for leisure gatherings. The all-day dining restaurant serves exquisite international cuisine. As a hotel under the Marriott Group, known for its "Comfortable Stay" concept, it brings a relaxed and pleasant experience for global business travelers.verge.

records.name_zh: 金茂深圳 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 金茂深圳JW万豪酒店位于福田商业区中心地段，邻近福田口岸、深圳会展中心和主要旅游景点，步行约200米即可到达深圳四线交汇的车公庙地铁站(J1出口)，交通便利，为商务和休闲客人的优选下榻之所。酒店客房已于2020年12月全维度翻新升级，全新雅致明亮的新客房，巧妙空间设计和布局，着力优化起居细节，全“新”为您服务。焕新升级后还增加了新房型--经典行政客房，内含百变灵动的第三空间--这是一个多功能的客房延伸空间，是您旅途中的静谧花园。入住金茂深圳JW 万豪酒店，体验 “随心所遇” 的礼遇，精致服务尽在于此。宾客还可前往SPA by JW体验各种水疗护理服务，还可享用 24 小时健身俱乐部和室外泳池。酒店拥有3个各具特色的餐厅及1个大堂酒廊以及总面积共约1,226平方米的会议设施，更辅以出色的活动筹办及餐饮服务，倾力打造令人难忘的活动。凭借非凡的服务，金茂深圳 JW 万豪酒店当属您商旅休闲住宿理想之选！
description.textEn: Experience the extraordinary JW Marriott Hotel Shenzhen, centrally located in the Futian Business District. Our International hotel in Shenzhen, China offers easy access to local landmarks such as the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center, Shenzhen Window of the World and Futian Checkpoint. While here, guests can enjoy the beautiful view of our golf course, spacious accommodations and comfortable bedding with plush beds. Our Shenzhen hotel offers 42 inch, flat-screen TVs, complimentary WiFi, a laptop-size safe, a mini-bar and rainforest shower. Envelope yourself in luxury with extensive spa treatments at Spa by JW, take a dip in our outdoor swimming pool and work out in our modern, 24-hour Health Club. With over 1,226 square meters of exceptional function space, event-planning and catering services, we commit to make your event unforgettable. Rest assured that our luxury hotel in Shenzhen, China, will exceed your every expectation.

records.name_zh: 深圳前海华侨城 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 深圳前海华侨城JW万豪酒店坐落于深圳宝安中心区，共配备463间客房、公寓和套房。酒店坐拥前海湾美景，紧邻欢乐港湾、“湾区之光”摩天轮、滨海艺术中心、“湾区之眼”书城等大型公共设施，邻近腾讯大铲湾企鹅岛。酒店交通便利，距离深圳宝安机场及深圳湾口岸约25分钟车程。酒店二期光之翼位于欢乐港湾3号，邻近地铁临海站，与湾区之光摩天轮隔窗相望，设有107间客房，包括28间公寓和10间套房，入住宾客均可享受行政酒廊礼遇。另设港湾尚膳餐厅、光之翼壹号多功能厅和健身房。酒店主楼拥有356间宽敞舒适的豪华客房和套房，设计风格融合中式典雅与时尚现代。室内外泳池、水疗中心和健身中心让宾客感受全身心放松的舒适体验。酒店提供精致多元化的用餐体验：全日制餐厅都会尚膳荟萃环球美食，让宾客尽享多元化的选择；大堂酒廊是放松休憩或洽谈商务的理想场所，可一边细呷香茗，一边享用当地滋味小食与精致小点，悠享午后仪式感。占地共2,600平方米的8间多功能宴会厅，是举办大型产品发布会、大小型会议、展览、婚宴及社交宴会的理想之所。
description.textEn: JW Marriott Hotel Shenzhen Bao’an is conveniently located in the heart of Bao’an District with 463 luxurious guestrooms, apartments and suites. Located in the Qianhai Bay, adjacent to city landmark Bay Glory Ferris Wheel, OH Bay, Bay Opera and “Eyes of the GBA” book store, and close to Tencent Dachan Penguin Bay. Main Tower offers 356 guestrooms and suites. It occupies a stunning modern landmark building and enjoys panoramic views of Qianhai Bay and the Pearl River Delta. Hotel dining options include The Lounge and The Shenzhen Kitchen. The hotel offers a luxurious spa, Fitness Center, Indoor heated and Outdoor Swimming Pools. Eight multi-function venues offer 2,600sqm of cutting-edge meeting and banquet space. Glory Tower, as an extension of JW Marriott Hotel Shenzhen Bao'an, features 107 guest rooms, apartments and suites that start at a spacious 50sqm. The guest rooms instill a fresh and appealing ambiance conducive to relaxation while enjoying the superb views over Qianhai Bay and Bay Glory Ferris Wheel.

records.name_zh: 深圳前海华侨城艾美酒店

description.textZh: 深圳前海华侨城艾美酒店作为艾美品牌首进深圳之作，通过艾美品牌“探索世界，揭秘目的地”的品牌理念以及独有的三重滤镜 — 目的地、文化及美食，为富有创意思维的宾客带来超乎想象的目的地探索体验。深圳前海华侨城艾美酒店坐落于宝安中心区，地理位置优越，毗邻湾区之光摩天轮和滨海艺术中心。拥有353间时尚典雅的客房及套房，1间新食谱全日餐厅及1间北纬22酒廊。配备超过2,000平方米的宴会空间，包括1,080平方米的大宴会厅、前海湾宴会厅及2间多功能会议室。
description.textEn: Le Méridien Shenzhen, Bao'an marks the first Le Méridien hotel in the city of Shenzhen. Through the distinctive Le Méridien ‘Destination Unlocked’ promise, and its distinct filters of discovery - Coordinates, Culture and Cuisine, Le Méridien Shenzhen Bao’an is set to present unexpected and engaging experiences to curious and creative-minded travelers. Le Méridien Shenzhen, Bao’an is located at the heart of Bao’an central district and nearby the Bay Glory Ferris Wheel and Bay Opera of Shenzhen. The hotel features 353 guestrooms and suites, offers two culinary venues that cater to the taste buds of the diners with a carefully crafted dining environment and specialties, including Latest Recipe and Lobby Lounge Latitude 22. The hotel provides over 2,000 square meters of meeting and function spaces, including 1,080 square meters Grand Ballroom with capacious foyer, 425 square meters Qianhai Bay Ballroom featuring abundant natural light and 2 meeting rooms.

records.name_en: The OCT Harbour, Shenzhen - Marriott Executive Apartments
records.name_zh: 深圳欢乐海岸万豪行政公寓

description.textZh: 有一种享受，来自于隐秘与尊贵的私人会所；有一种回归，承载于翱翔在红树林之上的白鹭；有一种品味，搭建于建筑与艺术之间；有一种空灵，驻足于这片海岸，这个如家一般的“安所”——深圳欢乐海岸万豪行政公寓。酒店坐落于地处深圳湾商圈核心位置——“都市娱乐目的地”华侨城欢乐海岸上，毗邻深圳CBD的福田经贸中心、深圳硅谷——南山科技园、蛇口现代化工业园区以及“特区中的特区”——前海合作区，坐拥中国目前罕有地处现代化大都市腹地——滨海红树林湿地，集自然景观，金融商务于一体。位于深圳华侨城主题公园群与滨海大道之间的深圳欢乐海岸万豪行政公寓，商圈路网通达全城，出行方便快捷，距深圳湾口岸约10分钟车程，距深圳机场约35分钟车程。在这片瑰丽静谧的美景簇拥下，欢乐海岸万豪行政公寓以提供非凡设施与优质服务，营造惬意的居家般住宿体验，为来自世界各地的旅客打造一个温馨、舒适的安心之所。
description.textEn: Experience modern hotel amenities and all the comforts of a cozy home at The OCT Harbor, Shenzhen - Marriott Executive Apartments. Choose from studio, one-, two- or three-bedroom serviced apartments with stunning views of the city and harbor, artful decor, modern furnishings, living and dining space, an office area and a fully-equipped kitchen. Our family-friendly hotel features a Resident's Restaurant offering delicious international dining, an outdoor pool and a kid's pool, a kid's play room and a 24-hour fitness center. When you’re ready to venture out and soak up the region’s charming spirit and vibrant culture, our Nanshan District hotel puts you within steps of the Shopping Mall, Wetland Park, Dream Aquarium, Qushui Bay's restaurants and bars and the Creative Exhibition Center. Nearby you'll find amusement parks, theaters, historical sites and much more. Whether joining us for work, a vacation or an extended stay, we look forward to introducing you to the charms of Shenzhen, China.

description.textZh: 深圳佳兆业万豪酒店坐拥"中国八大美丽海湾"之一金沙湾，步行五分钟可至中信金沙湾水世界。酒店拥有325间宽敞舒适的客房及套房，房间能欣赏海天一色的美景或雅致园景，先进的高科技设施及高速互联网接入。现代化室内设计灵感源自当地大鹏古城非物质文化遗产，并结合深圳渔家文化特色。酒店配有5间不同风格的餐厅及酒吧，可为宾客奉上别出心裁的当地美食和国际佳肴美馔。每间餐厅都将提供万豪酒店细心周到的服务以及活力用餐体验。酒店还为宾客提供了丰富的健身娱乐设施，如24小时健身中心、室内和户外露天泳池、贝趣屋以及私人水疗中心。深圳佳兆业万豪酒店的宴会与会议空间设计灵活多变，拥有3,000多平方米的先进的活动空间，其中包括1,000平方米的凯撒大宴会厅，可直接驶入豪华轿车，满足不同活动需求。2,000平方米的临海户外草坪，180度全海景尽揽山海壮美景致，可举办盛大而浪漫的凭海婚礼。
description.textEn: Shenzhen Marriott Hotel Golden Bay welcomes visitors with a prime beachfront location on Golden Bay – one of the top eight domestic bays in China. Our hotel features 325 spacious guest rooms and suites, featuring panoramic sea views, as well as free high-speed Internet access and the latest in-room perks. Modern interiors take cues from local culture, combining elements from the Dapeng Fortress as well as Shenzhen, China's storied fishing heritage. With three uniquely themed restaurants and a refined lobby bar, the hotel presents a curated journey through innovative Cantonese flavors and global culinary delights. In addition, we also provide a wide range of on-site amenities for hotel guests, such as a 24-hour fitness center, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a kids’ club and a tranquil spa. Designed with your flexibility in mind, our hotel proudly boasts over 30,000 square feet of state-of-the-art event space, on-site planning and catering teams and an easily accessible location in Shenzhen, China.

description.textZh: 酒店地处深圳市中心充满活力的南山中央商务区，位于南山区别具现代风格的地标大厦内，是商务和亲子旅行的理想住宿之选。酒店距华润深圳湾体育中心和深圳保利剧院仅数步之遥，紧邻知名购物餐饮商圈。酒店共设 340 间舒适客房与套房，在房内可以饱览迷人的港景和城景。酒店内共有六家餐厅，供应各式国际风味佳肴和饮品，方便您轻松用餐。酒店健身中心免费开放，您可在此坚持日常锻炼。酒店会议与宴会场地总面积约 1579 平米，提供美味餐饮服务，活动策划团队更是细致周到，竭力满足各种活动承办需求。无论您缘何来到深圳，选择深圳中洲万豪酒店，即可获享难忘居停体验，旅·获自在。
description.textEn: Housed in a contemporary landmark building and soaring above the Nanshan District's lively CBD, Shenzhen Marriott Hotel Nanshan is a unique destination for business and leisure visitors to southeastern China. CR Shenzhen Bay Sports Center and Shenzhen Poly Theatre are steps away and great shopping and dining is also nearby. Our hotel features 340 comfortable guest rooms and suites with captivating harbor and city views. Enjoy a bite to eat in one of our five on-site restaurants, which serve an extensive list of international cuisines and beverages. Maintain your workout routine at the fitness center, which is available free of charge. Our hotel can cater to all of your event needs with 17,000 square feet of meeting and banquet space — enhanced by delicious catering and the careful attention of our planning team. Whatever your reason for visiting, we're confident you will have a memorable stay at Shenzhen Marriott Hotel Nanshan.

records.name_zh: 深圳宝安 Moxy 酒店

description.textZh: 酒店大堂设计宽敞通透，配备现代化家具，尽显精美雅致的格调。“Plug and Meet”聚会区提供时尚的人体工学座椅和超大书写墙，还设有 86 英寸电视供宾客投影演示。大堂还设有摩登艺术风格的电视墙，全天 24 小时供应品类丰富的小吃和饮品。此外，酒店还供应营养健康的欧陆式早餐，晚间酒吧供应各类杯装美酒佳酿和当地啤酒。酒店所有卧室均配有 55 英寸平面电视、固定式 USB 充电接口，并提供免费 Wi-Fi。
description.textEn: The bright and open lobby layout is paired with contemporary furniture. The ''Plug and Meet'' gathering areas provide modern ergonomic seating, large writing walls and 86 inch televisions for presentation projection. The lobby also boasts a state-of-the art video wall and 24/7 Food & Beverage offering a wide selection of snacks and drinks. Other hotel amenities include healthy continental breakfast, an evening bar featuring wines by the glass and local brews. All bedrooms are equipped with 55 inch flat screen televisions, build in USB ports and free Wifi.

description.textZh: Situated in the heart of Nanshan CBD, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel invites you to discover this vibrant city with panoramic view of the city's "Oasis" and fabulous Shenzhen Bay view.
description.textEn: Situated in the heart of Shenzhen Bay Eco Technology Park, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel invites you to discover this vibrant city with panoramic view of the city's Oasis, vast expanse of waterfront promenade, and vibes of a dynamic and energetic metropolitan. The rooms are beautifully designed and decorated with encompassing Shenzhen elements to charm your stay. The hotel features four dining venues in unique styles, offering a feast on tastes from classic Cantonese cuisine to international flavors, romantic evening experience. Rejuvenate and get energized in our spacious gym, indoor pool and professional spa; get inspired and create unforgettable memories in a 3,000 square meters meeting space.

description.textZh: 酒店位于深圳罗湖核心商务区，距离罗湖口岸约1.5公里，通关便捷，毗邻金光华广场与罗湖万象城。步行约5分钟即可到达地铁1号线国贸站。酒店周边生活氛围浓厚，步行可达东门老街及向西村，近距离感受深圳本地烟火气与多元文化。酒店拥有397间舒适典雅的客房与套房，兼顾舒适与便捷的入住体验。云景轩旋转餐厅提供独特用餐体验，让宾客在用餐同时尽览深圳360°城市全景。酒店设有24小时开放的健身中心，满足宾客随时锻炼需求；户外泳池为宾客提供休闲放松空间（具体开放时间以酒店实际运营为准）。
description.textEn: Renaissance Shenzhen Luohu Hotel locates in heart of Luohu business district, approximately 1.5 km from Luohu Port, offering convenient cross-border access to Hong Kong SAR. It is adjacent to Kingglory Plaza and MixC Shopping Mall, and only a 5-minute walk to Guomao Station on Metro Line 1.The surrounding neighborhood features a vibrant local atmosphere. Guests can easily walk to Dongmen Pedestrian Street and Xiangxi Village to experience Shenzhen’s authentic lifestyle and diverse culture. The hotel offers 397 comfortable and elegantly designed guestrooms and suites, combining convenience with a relaxing stay experience.The Sky Paradise is a slow revolving restaurant offering a unique dining experience, where guests can savor delicious cuisine while enjoying the 360° panoramic view of Shenzhen's skyline.The hotel features a 24-hour fitness center to meet guests’ workout needs at any time, while the outdoor swimming pool offers a relaxing leisure space (opening hours are subject to hotel operation).

records.name_zh: 深圳大中华喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 深圳大中华喜来登酒店位于深圳商务和购物区的中心地带，无论差旅或休闲出行，均可便利前往城市各处。步行前往深圳会展中心仅约5分钟，步行前往福田高铁站仅约10分钟，从福田高铁站直达香港西九龙仅约15分钟。福田口岸距酒店仅约2个地铁站之遥，福田皇岗口岸和罗湖口岸距酒店仅约15分钟车程，可以无缝接驳、丝滑通关香港。酒店拥有354间设施齐全的客房和21间会议室，多功能空间面积达8,000平米左右。在怡聚餐厅享用各种自助式国际美食，或是在迩逅大堂吧享用清爽小食。您可在设施齐全的健身中心尽情锻炼，或在宽敞的室内室外泳池放松畅泳。欢迎莅临下榻深圳大中华喜来登酒店，尽情探索这座魅力之城！
description.textEn: Located in the heart of Shenzhens business and shopping district, Sheraton Shenzhen Futian Hotel is only moments away from your travel needs. Five minutes walk to Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center while 10 minutes’ walk to Futian High-speed Railway Station, from which only takes 15minutes to Hong Kong West Kowloon Railway Station. Futian Checkpoints, 2 subway station from Convention Center Metro Station , where hotel locates, while Huanggang Checkpoint and Luohu Checkpoint are both within a 15-minute drive away. Our hotel has 354 well-appointed rooms and 21 meeting rooms equaling up to 8,000 square meters of function space. Enjoy buffet-style dishes of international cuisines at The Exchange Restaurant and enjoy a refreshment from Afterwardz Lobby Bar. Boost yourself in our well-equipped Fitness Centre or relax in our spacious indoor and outdoor swimming pool. Discover the glamour of Shenzhen during your stay at Sheraton Shenzhen Futian Hotel

records.name_zh: 深圳博林天瑞喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 深圳博林天瑞喜来登酒店位于繁华的南山区，只需步行约 5 分钟即可抵达大学城地铁站, 酒店致力于满足您的各种需求, 缔造愉悦舒适的旅行体验。酒店拥有 307 间氛围宁静的宽敞客房, 配有喜来登睡眠体验睡床、Wi-Fi 和 50 英寸 LED 电视，所有客房均配备胶囊咖啡机。酒店的浴室彰显水疗风格灵感, 设有独立淋浴间、浴缸和优质卫浴用品。西丽尚膳餐厅供应丰盛的国际自助餐, 还设有室外露台和儿童角, 为您缔造难忘用餐体验。The Lounge 供应品类丰富的小吃及饮品, 并提供下午茶服务,是您与亲朋好友共度休闲时光的好去处。酒店拥有雅致灵活的室内外场地, 配备先进的科技设施, 还有专业的活动策划和餐饮团队提供保障, 是您在深圳南山区举办会议、活动或家庭庆典的理想之选。欢迎莅临下榻深圳博林天瑞喜来登酒店, 领略别具特色的探索体验。
description.textEn: Located in the bustling Nanshan District, just a five-minute walk from University Town metro station, the new Sheraton Shenzhen Nanshan provides you a pleasant hotel stay in Shenzhen. Designed with a sense of serenity, our 307 spacious hotel rooms feature the Sheraton Sleep Experience, Wi-Fi access and a 50-inch LED TV, capsule coffee machine. Spa-inspired hotel bathrooms boast a separate shower, a bathtub and premium bath amenities. For memorable dining in Shenzhen, China, stop by The Xili Kitchen to enjoy an outdoor terrace, an expansive international buffet and a kid’s corner. Reconnect with friends or family at The Lounge, featuring a menu of light snacks, a wide assortment of drinks and afternoon tea service. For meetings, events or family celebrations in Shenzhen, China's Nanshan District, our hotel offers tastefully appointed, adaptable indoor and outdoor venues with state-of-the-art technology and knowledgeable event planning and catering teams. Discover the difference at Sheraton Shenzhen Nanshan.

description.textZh: 深圳瑞吉酒店坐落于罗湖区地标性建筑京基一百大厦75至100层，共有290间客房，包括41间套房，以量身定制的管家服务与恒久传承的经典品味，吸引着全球眼光独到的名流雅士。位于96层的酒店大堂，可将深圳繁华都市城景、唯美海湾日落与香港远山翠色尽收眼底，令宾客在静谧云端中与都市脉络紧密相连。三间餐厅和一间酒吧，以壮阔天际线为幕，致力于缔造非凡云端飨宴。设施完善的健身房拥有引人注目的28米室内无边泳池——全景落地玻璃环绕，营造出凌空畅游的震撼视觉与私密体验。铱瑞水疗中心专注于提供健康舒适的护理体验，为客人打造焕发活力的生活方式。在深圳瑞吉酒店举办的每一场活动，皆承袭品牌传奇的管家服务精神。酒店拥有近2,100平方米的宴会厅及会议空间，搭配先进科技设备与灵活布局选择。专业的宴会管家团队将全程悉心统筹，以细致入微的服务，成就每一个难忘的经典时刻。
description.textEn: Nestled on floors 75 to 100 of the KingKey 100 landmark building in Luohu District, The St. Regis Shenzhen features 290 guest rooms, including 41 suites. With its bespoke butler services and timeless classic elegance, the hotel caters to luminaries from around the world. Located on the 96th floor, the hotel lobby offers a panoramic view of Shenzhen’s bustling urban skyline, stunning bay sunsets and the green hills of Hong Kong, allowing guests to stay closely connected with the city’s pulse while enjoying a peaceful retreat above the clouds. Three restaurants and one bar, set against the magnificent skyline, are dedicated to creating extraordinary sky-high dining experiences in the clouds.The well-equipped fitness center boasts a striking 28-meter indoor infinity pool. The Iridium Spa specializes in providing rejuvenating and relaxing treatments.The hotel offers nearly 2,100 square meters of banquet and meeting space, paired with advanced technical equipment and flexible layout options.

records.name_zh: 深圳前海华侨城瑞吉酒店

description.textZh: 深圳前海华侨城瑞吉酒店坐落于深圳宝安区的繁华核心地带，地理位置优越。酒店的289间精致客房与套房尽览城市天际线或海湾美景，为宾客打造优雅难忘的入住体验。四间餐厅和酒吧提供丰富的用餐体验，呈献瑞吉品牌标志性的优雅与本地美馔的活力风味。酒店还拥有超过1,000平米的多功能会议空间，包括696平米的阿斯特宴会厅和多个会议室，是商务与休闲的理想之选。配备定制化的瑞吉管家服务、先进的健身中心和豪华的水疗中心，深圳前海华侨城瑞吉酒店重新定义了奢华居停，带来优雅、服务与创新的美妙融合。
description.textEn: The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao’an enjoys a prime location in the heart of the thriving Bao’an District. Featuring 289 elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites, each offering breathtaking views of the city skyline or the bay, the hotel promises a refined and unforgettable stay. Guests can indulge in a variety of dining experiences across four exquisite restaurants and bars, each offering a harmonious blend of St. Regis’s signature elegance and the vibrant flavors of local cuisine. The hotel also boasts over 1,000 square meters of versatile event space, including the Astor Ballroom and several meeting rooms, making it the ideal destination for both business and leisure. With personalized butler service, a state-of-the-art Fitness Center, and a luxurious spa, The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao’an redefines the standard of luxury in Shenzhen, offering an exceptional fusion of elegance, service, and innovation.

records.name_zh: 深圳星河丽思卡尔顿酒店

description.textZh: The Ritz-Carlton, Shenzhen is located near the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center in the business district. This exceptional Shenzhen hotel is a blend of modernization and worldwide elegance echoing international culture.
description.textEn: Nestled amidst the bustling urban landscape of the city, The Ritz-Carlton, Shenzhen shines as a beacon of elegance and refinement. Having undergone a renovation of spacious guestrooms with city iconic elements of mountains, coastlines, shells and ripples, The Ritz-Carlton, Shenzhen enlivens the Elegant Oasis with the consistent personalized service, embodying the Greater Bay culture and urban life to influence the new smart city. Here, immerse yourself in the city's vibrant culture while enjoying the hotel's unique blend of luxury and sophistication, creating a new micro vacation lifestyle experience that is both inspiring and memorable.

records.name_en: The G Shenzhen, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 深圳星河吉酒店，臻品之选

description.textZh: “深圳星河吉酒店，臻品之选”距离深圳北站和福田中央商务区 15 分钟左右车程，是星河控股集团和万豪国际集团联合推出的独立酒店。酒店设有 248 间时尚现代的客房和套房，2 间多功能厅面积约 144平米。吉宴中餐厅、朵颐全日制餐厅和 BOND大堂吧为宾客奉上国际风味精选菜品和饮品。酒店设有 24 小时 ENER-G 健身中心、氛围悠闲的 BOND大堂吧和 MUSE灵感空间，让远道而来的商务旅行者和当地宾客皆可于此举杯“吉时享受”美好时刻。酒店步行可达星河 WORLD·COCO Park 购物中心和星河 IMAX 影院。
description.textEn: 15-minute driving distance to Shenzhen North Railway Station and Futian CBD, The G Shenzhen, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel is a independent hotel jointly brought by Galaxy Holding Group and Marriott International. The hotel has 248 modern and chic guest rooms and suites, 2 function rooms with area of 144 sqm. G-YAN Chinese Restaurant, MORII All-Day Dining Restaurant and BOND Bar serve an intensive list of international cuisines and beverage. The 24-hour ENER-G Fitness Center, the BOND Bar and the MUSE space jointly create a CHEERS NOW hotel experience for business travelers and local guests. GALAXY WORLD COCO Park Shopping Mall and Galaxy IMAX Cinema are within walking distance.

records.name_en: The Mercury Garden Shenzhen Nanshan, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 深圳南山水瑆花园臻品之选酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于素有“中国硅谷”美誉的深圳南山科技园核心地带，近深圳湾总部基地，步行可达购物餐饮商圈，紧邻深圳著名景点，尽享都市繁华与悠然魅力。酒店拥有160间舒适客房与套房，配备落地窗，可将城市美景尽收眼底；两间风格独特的餐厅，从经典粤菜到国际风味，再到轻食体验，为宾客呈现舌尖上的非凡盛宴。逾360平方米灵活活动空间，是打造难忘时刻的理想场所。配套24小时健身空间和自助洗衣房，贴心设计为每一位商务与休闲旅客提供便利。酒店以优越地理位置与优质服务，为您诠释为个性驻足与活力的完美融合。
description.textEn: The hotel is located in the heart of Shenzhen Nanshan, known as the "Silicon Valley of China". It is conveniently situated near Shenzhen Bay Headquarters Base and vibrant shopping and dining hubs, with iconic attractions close by. Immerse yourself in the city's serene charm and let your spirit roam free. The hotel offers 160 guest rooms and suites with floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing stunning city views. Two unique dining venues deliver a culinary journey, from classic Cantonese dishes to international flavours and creative light bites. Over 360 square metres of event space is perfect for memorable moments. A 24-hour fitness centre and self-service laundry provide convenience for business and leisure travellers, blending character and vitality effortlessly.

description.textZh: 深圳益田威斯汀酒店位于南山区高级购物中心综合体内，地处商业和休闲娱乐区的枢纽地带，地理位置非常优越，正对闻名遐迩的“世界之窗”，毗邻华侨城，欢乐谷和锦绣中华民俗文化村，并可直通地铁站点。在这里，您可尽情欣赏深圳湾之上大桥横跨的壮观全景。您可在我们的室外泳池清爽畅游，或前往威斯汀健身馆重焕身心活力。我们的 350 间客房和套房，均设有天梦之床、雨林淋浴间、42 英寸液晶电视等设施用品。我们的客房为您缔造精彩时尚体验，满足您的旅行休憩所需。
description.textEn: Opposite the famed Window of the World and part of an upscale shopping complex, with OCT, Splendid China, China Folk Culture Villages and Happy Valley surrounded, The Westin Shenzhen Nanshan is located at the nexus of business and leisure, with direct subway access. Enjoy panoramic views of Shenzhen Bay and the bridge to Hong Kong. Relax in our outdoor pool or exercise in the Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio. Each of our 350 guest rooms and suites comprises the Heavenly Bed and a rain forest shower, as well as a 42” LCD TV. Your room provides a wonderful contemporary experience and respite during your travels.

records.name_zh: 深圳北站 Moxy 酒店

description.textZh: 大堂区域完美融合了工业风与科技感，配备了一个带有入住功能的酒吧、先进的视频墙、供上网和阅读书籍的区域、一个有趣的娱乐游戏区以及独特的小型会议室。大堂内还有全天候的餐饮服务，提供营养丰富的自助早餐、精选的健康轻食午餐和晚餐、Moxy酒吧特制鸡尾酒以及精心制作的其他食品。其他设施包括一个充满活力的夜间酒吧、配有粉色拳击沙袋的健身房，以及色调协调的洗衣房。
description.textEn: The lobby area with perfect combination of industrial style and sense of technology is equipped with a bar with check-in function, the most advanced video wall, an area for Internet access and reading books, a fun game area, and unique mini meeting rooms. There are also all-weather dining in the lobby, providing nutritious buffet breakfast, selected healthy light food for lunch and dinner, Moxy Bar special cocktail and well-designed takeout food. Other amenities include a vibrant nighttime bar, a gym with boxing bags and pink bikes, and a tonal ironing room.

description.textZh: 石家庄雅乐轩酒店座落于天河方圆荟综合商圈，酒店拥有259间兼具潮流科技与设计美学的客房. 我们的客房配备舒适的特色睡床、步入式淋浴间等众多便利设施, 轻松愉悦的住宿体验尽在此间。即插即用的连接站可为所有电子设备充电, 并可将其连接至 55英寸液晶电视，为您的工作和娱乐提供额外便利。酒店提供全天免费的自助洗衣,全天候开放的健身站,让宾客尽情享受休憩放松的时光。充能站餐厅供应自助早餐和当地特色美食，活力涌动的WXYZ酒吧提供招牌鸡尾酒。酒店位于西北二环，地理位置优越，距离石家庄北站15分车程，距离石家庄高铁站20分钟车程，西北两条环城快速路覆盖全市，可便利前往河北博物院，正定古城等众多热门景点。
description.textEn: Located in the Tian He Fang Yuan Hui Mall, Aloft Shijiazhuang boasts 259 rooms with stylish technology and design aesthetics. All the rooms were equipped with comfortable feature beds, walk-in showers and other amenities to make your stay relaxing and enjoyable. A plug-and-play connection station charges all electronic devices and connects them to a 55-inch LCD TV, which added convenience for your work and play. Hotel offer all day free laundry service and In-door fitness center for guests to relax. Depot by Aloft serves a buffet breakfast and local specialties, while the vibrant WXYZ bar offers signature cocktails. The hotel is ideally located on the Northwest Second Ring Road, with a 15-minute drive from Shijiazhuang North Railway Station and a 20-minute drive from Shijiazhuang High Speed Railway Station. The two northwest Ring roads covering the city provide easy access to Hebei Museum, Zhengding Ancient City and many other popular attractions.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Shijiazhuang High-Tech Zone
records.name_zh: 石家庄高新区万枫酒店

description.textZh: 全景落地窗视野绝佳，环境静谧舒适，尽享惬意时光石家庄高新区万枫酒店位于高新区长江大道155号副1号，毗邻高新万象汇、天山海世界商圈，休闲娱乐的火炬广场，距离石家庄站12.9公里，石家庄正定国际机场27.7公里，石家庄东站1.3公里。酒店拥有165间温馨舒适的客房。客房内饰运用具有现代感的浅木色调，设施兼具功能性、设计感和舒适度于一体，配备高速无线网络连接，满足现代宾客入住所需。万枫餐厅为宾客提供品类丰富的健康中西式早餐及本地特色小吃。此外，设施齐全的24小时全天候健身中心，让宾客时刻保持充沛活力。经过一座城，寻觅一间房。万枫酒店，让每一程旅途，都像家一样温暖自在。
description.textEn: The hotel provides stable and reliable service quality for both official and leisure travel through modern design and convenient equipment. The hotel lobby is designed with the "modern and peaceful" aesthetic of Wanfeng Hotel as its feature, fully introducing natural light into the interior and integrating an open layout and multifunctional space. The hotel has 165 rooms. The interior of the guest room features modern light wood tones, with facilities that combine functionality, design, and comfort. It is equipped with high-speed wireless internet connectivity to meet the needs of modern guests. Fairfield Restaurant provides guests with a wide variety of Chinese and Western food options as well as local specialty snacks. In addition, a fully equipped 24-hour fitness center keeps guests energized at all times. Passing through a city, looking for a room to relieve your fatigue, we will provide enthusiastic service and comfortable rooms, looking forward to your arrival.

records.name_zh: 石家庄站万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店拥有118间客房，万枫餐厅，万枫小铺，24小时健身中心，24小时自助洗衣房。酒店客房为客人提供便利的设施以及免费的高速WIFI，万枫餐厅每日提供健康、营养的早餐，为宾客繁忙的一天注入活力.24小时健身中心的无氧以及有氧设备满足客人的健康需求。24小时的自助洗衣房提供免费的自助洗衣以及烘干服务。 交通：距离周边3条城市高速路，驾车5分钟。距离正定国际机场52公里，驾车50分钟。距离石家庄站3公里，驾车13分钟。商业：桥西勒泰中心步行10分钟。高教区商业街均距离酒店步行10分钟。周边1公里内分布多家银行。美食：众多特色小吃多家特色餐厅
description.textEn: The hotel has 118 guest rooms, Fairfield restaurant, Fairfield Market, 24-hour fitness center, and 24-hour self-service laundry room. The hotel rooms offer convenient facilities and free high-speed WIFI. Fairfield Restaurant provides a healthy and nutritious breakfast every day, injecting vitality into guests' busy schedules. The 24-hour fitness center's anaerobic and aerobic equipment meets the health needs of guests. The 24-hour laundry room provides self-service laundry and drying services.Transportation:5 minutes by car from 3 surrounding city highways.52 kilometers away from Zhengding International Airport, a 50 minute drive.3 kilometers away from Shijiazhuang Station, a 13-minute drive.Business:10 minutes' walk from Qiaoxiletai Center.The High Diocese Commercial Street is a 10 minute walk from the hotel.There are multiple banks distributed within a radius of 1 kilometer.delicious food:Numerous specialty snacksMultiple specialty restaurants

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shijiazhuang Downtown
records.name_zh: 石家庄城市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店拥有121间不同类型的客房和完善的设施， 有广阔的视野和充足的自然采光，客房配备多种智能设备系统，舒适柔软的睡床，免费⾼速Wi-Fi和55⼨液晶电视，热带⾬林花洒的步⼊式淋浴间。酒店为宾客提供耳目一新的休闲餐饮体验。位于酒店一层的“大堂酒廊”（The Lounge）作为品牌的新概念餐饮，集大堂酒廊、啤酒吧、下午茶等功能于一身，为你的旅途膳食及洽谈小酌提供理想的空间。位于酒店四层的全日制餐厅“宜客乐餐厅”(The Eatery)精选全球佳肴和燕赵特色美食，餐厅精选的食材与用心的烹饪，汇聚唇齿回味的新鲜美味。用中式经典与西式创新的舌尖美味治愈您旅途奔波的疲惫心灵。酒店共有4间配备齐全的会议厅，近1000平米会议空间
description.textEn: The hotel boasts 121 well-appointed rooms of various types and comprehensive facilities. With expansive views and ample natural light.The hotel offers guests a refreshing dining experience. Located on the first floor, "The Lounge" serves as a new concept dining venue that combines a lobby lounge, a beer bar, and an afternoon tea experience. It provides an ideal space for your dining needs and casual meetings during your journey.Located on the fourth floor of the hotel, "The Eatery" is an all-day dining restaurant that offers a selection of global cuisine and local specialties from Shijiazhuang. With carefully selected ingredients and meticulous cooking techniques, the restaurant brings together fresh and delicious flavors that will leave a lasting impression. Whether it's Chinese classics or Western innovations, the delightful flavors will rejuvenate your weary soul from your journey.The hotel features four fully equipped meeting rooms and nearly 1000 square meters of conference space

records.name_zh: 苏州阳澄湖喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 苏州阳澄湖喜来登酒店拥有162间现代雅致的客房及套房，让您饱览迷人的阳澄湖景致。餐饮区设有3个风格各异的餐厅与酒吧：供应自助早餐及零点，午晚间呈现精致淮扬风味的澄境餐厅、专注传统风味的元味餐厅、年轻休闲的&More by Sheraton咖啡吧、提供特色下午茶及晚间饮品的大堂吧，以及为行政楼层宾客专享的行政酒廊和5间中式包间，为您带来丰富多元的摩登用餐体验。酒店拥有逾1180平方米的灵活宴会及会议空间以及2000平方米户外草坪，满足多样活动需求。同时，室内恒温游泳池、24小时开放的健身中心、11片网球场地、KTV包间、棋牌室等丰富的休闲娱乐设施，让您与家人慢享惬意时光。
description.textEn: Hotel offers 162 modern, elegant guest rooms and suites with captivating views of Yangcheng Lake. Five distinct dining venues provide diverse culinary experiences:Azure Restaurant, Yuan Restaurant, More by Sheraton Café , and the Lobby Lounge . An Executive Lounge is exclusive to executive floor guests.The hotel features over 1,800 sqm of flexible meeting space and a 2,000 sqm outdoor lawn for events. Leisure facilities include an indoor heated pool, 24-hour fitness center, 11 tennis courts, game rooms, and more for relaxing moments with family.

description.textZh: 遂宁是心灵度假之所，佛教文化源远流长，素有“小成都”之称。遂宁首座万豪酒店位于“城市之心”圣莲岛内，欢迎八方宾客莅临，尊享充满人文情怀和自然诗意的住宿体验。酒店邻近万达商业中心及灵泉寺等知名景点，配有客房、套房及江畔独栋别墅，精致简约的室内装饰诉说着出水芙蓉的东方雅韵，全景落地窗将蜿蜒涪江的天光水色尽收眼底。酒店内设两家风格迥异的餐厅，莲-中餐厅融入了浓厚的中式情怀及观音文化的禅意氛围，结合遂宁当地美食文化精髓，推陈出新供应地道川菜及粤菜；街-全日制餐厅透露着老街商铺复古时尚的用餐氛围，传递川渝地道美食及异国料理的缤纷风情。酒店自营的音乐喷泉、儿童游乐园、棋牌室及周边的澜卡威假日水上休闲岛、百亩果园、游艇码头等娱乐项目，为宾客打造精彩纷呈且超凡出众的惬意体验。
description.textEn: Immerse yourself in the "City of Guanyin" at Suining Marriott Hotel. Our hotel is situated on the Shenglian island, in the heart of the Suining city; attractions including the Lingquan Scenic Area and Guangde Temple are moments away. Hotel offers 296 guest rooms and suites with captivating garden and river views,In the comfort of your stay we have amenities included such as complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and fitness center. Guests can choose from two restaurants and a lounge that serve up a variety of inventive local and international gourmet experiences. Event planners have more than 2000 square meters of space to consider. From boardrooms to exquisite ballrooms, our 12 venues can easily adapt to your needs.

description.textZh: 作为万豪国际集团大中华地区首家AC品牌，苏州AC酒店位于苏州姑苏区核心地段，距苏州站约20分钟车程，距苏州北站约40分钟车程，便捷通达各大景点名胜。酒店拥有135 间客房与套房，其中5间为庭院房。客房从苏州古典园林中汲取设计灵感，并以仿古城地图的丝绸画装饰，营造出一种优雅和谐的氛围。所有客房均配备55英寸高清液晶电视、独立淋浴间、免费高速Wi-Fi等设施。酒店的外观设计借鉴了传统苏州建筑中常见的白色泥墙、深灰色粘土制瓦片屋顶，以及起伏折叠的几何图形等特点，营造了一种宁静幽远的意境。在室内设计方面，酒店将现代与传统元素融合，各处都能见到凸显苏州元素的艺术作品，让宾客一迈入酒店便能感受到苏州的文化底蕴，呈现出独特的苏式待客之道。同时，酒店的多功能空间，可以根据宾客的需求在宴请和会议中随意切换；完善的健身配套设施可以帮助宾客放松身心，保持理想状态。酒店凭借多样化的空间转换、独特的人文体验以及对宾客需求的细致洞察，致力于让宾客沉浸在顺畅悦心的居停体验之中。
description.textEn: AC Hotel Suzhou is located in Gusu District, the city center with the most profound history and cultural heritage in Suzhou. The hotel has become a new landmark with its modern glass and stone elements mixed with the traditional Jiangnan water town’s architectural features of white walls and black tiles.With timeless design, unique cultural experiences, and attentive service, AC Hotel Suzhou is committed to creating a pleasant and comfortable stay.

description.textZh: This is a truly cosmopolitan hotel with an urban vibe. It is custom made for those seeking a new way to understand, live and Feel the City.
description.textEn: AC Hotels by Marriott hotels reflect the souls of the cities in which they reside. They offer a unique combination of quality, timeless European design, comfort and true authenticity. It's a whole new way to travel. Stylish Hotels for Urban Spirits, a new way to connect to the city.

records.name_en: Artik Suzhou, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy
records.name_zh: 苏州艺刻酒店·万豪旅享家公寓

description.textZh: 苏州艺刻酒店·万豪旅享家公寓，将陪伴宾客在姑苏城芯开启一段特色非凡而又充满惊喜和愉悦的灵感生活。酒店坐落于历史悠久的姑苏区，留园、山塘街苏州博物馆和寒山寺等知名景点近在咫尺，让宾客轻松感受苏州的诗意风光与人文气息。充满艺术灵感的一居室和两居室公寓套房，宽敞舒适更融入艺术家的巧思与灵感，带来如家一般的温暖与舒适。在这里，丰富多彩的社交活动让宾客及爱宠有机会在轻松互动中结识有趣的邻居与热情洋溢的艺术家。苏州的晨昏美景、古城街头巷尾的风味小吃将定格每一帧在苏州的美好旅程，激发旅人分享和创造一个又一个灵感时刻。
description.textEn: Artik Suzhou, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, nestles in historic Gusu District near core cultural landmarks, includes Lingering Garden, Shantang Street, Suzhou Museum and Hanshan Temple. The art-infused apartment-style accommodations include spacious one- and two-bedroom suites with full home facilities and practical residential layouts. Blending daily functionality, artist designs, bespoke cultural experiences, wellness services and pet-friendly perks, it brings immersive local living for every guest.

description.textZh: 苏州万怡酒店坐落于苏州工业园区 CBD ，踞守城市繁华之地，为宾客呈现焕新旅居体验。 酒店无缝连接地铁 1 号线星海广场站，步行可达东方之门、苏州中心广场，便捷抵达苏州国际博览中心、金鸡湖及古城热门景点，拙政园、平江路、苏州博物馆、观前街等近在咫尺，商务出行与休闲游玩皆从容自如。 酒店拥有262 间客房，设计兼顾舒适与实用，配备万豪高品质床品、专属办公区域、高速网络及开阔卫浴空间，满足商旅与度假需求。餐饮体验多元精致：MoMo 咖啡厅荟萃环球美味与本地时令佳肴，更呈现地道苏式汤面，彰显江南饮食文化；大堂酒廊宜品茗浅酌，静享惬意时光；万荟轩中餐厅设有雅致包厢，奉上苏式珍馐。 酒店全区域覆盖免费高速 Wi Fi，为住店及用餐客人提供免费停车。更设有位于 27 层的室内泳池，于畅游休憩间，欣赏城市壮阔景致，焕活身心。
description.textEn: Surround yourself with contemporary comfort at Courtyard Suzhou. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers to China, our hotel is situated in the heart of Suzhou Industrial Park's CBD, moments from renowned businesses, shopping and cultural destinations. All of our 262 hotel rooms and suites boast thoughtful perks like deluxe bedding, a flat-screen TV, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and floor-to-ceiling windows with mesmerizing views of the Industrial Park. We also feature a fully equipped hotel gym, a sparkling top-floor pool and superb on-site cuisine, including an inventive global buffet and an exquisite Chinese restaurant with private dining rooms. If you're seeking a venue for a business meeting or wedding here in China, our hotel boasts modern event space and skilled planning and catering teams. Along with placing you near attractions in the Industrial Park, we're close to Eslite Bookstore, Jinji Lake and an array of public transportation options. Choose Courtyard Suzhou for your visit to China.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻苏州合景万怡酒店，感受“东方威尼斯”的魅力风情。酒店位于充满活力的苏州吴中区，地理位置优越，四周环绕着中国丰富的文化遗产和标志性建筑，以及长江三角洲风景如画的小桥、运河和园林。此外，酒店还靠近主要商业目的地、大型企业和热门购物区。在苏州度过忙碌的一天后，返回酒店享受非凡设施。您可以在设施齐全的健身房强身健体，在味道正宗的中餐厅享用美食，亦或在大堂酒廊品尝美味鸡尾酒。如需筹办会议、婚礼和庆典，酒店提供精美的活动设施和约 1,277 平方米的现代化场地空间，堪称理想之选。夜晚，回到精美时尚的客房，畅享现代家具、免费网络、宽敞办公区，尽览优美的城市景观。难忘度假体验，尽在苏州合景万怡酒店。
description.textEn: Immerse yourself in the “Venice of the Orient” at Courtyard Suzhou Mudu. Located in the vibrant Wuzhong District of Suzhou, our ideally-located hotel is surrounded by China's immense cultural heritage and iconic landmarks as well as the picturesque bridges, canals and extensive gardens of the Yangtze Delta. Our prime location is also close to major commercial destinations, large businesses and popular shopping areas. After a busy day in Suzhou, return to our hotel to explore the premier amenities. Work out in our well-equipped gym, dine in our authentic Chinese restaurant or sip on tasty cocktails in our lobby lounge. For meetings, weddings and celebrations, take advantage of the 13,745 square feet of modern venue space in our sophisticated event facilities. In the evening, retreat to beautifully-styled accommodations with contemporary furnishings, complimentary Internet, spacious work areas and scenic city views. An unforgettable journey awaits you at Courtyard Suzhou Mudu.

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms; a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests. With locally-inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free Wi-Fi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive!

records.name_en: Element Suzhou Science and Technology Town

description.textZh: Discover comfort at Element Suzhou Science and Technology Town in Suzhou's High-Tech District. Our eco-friendly hotel offers modern rooms with well-equipped kitchenettes, complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site dining, a saline pool, fitness center and event space.
description.textEn: Discover sustainable design, eco-friendly practices and modern amenities at Element Suzhou Science and Technology Town. Our hotel is set within a smart eco-town in the heart of the Suzhou National New and Hi-Tech Industrial Development Zone, in the ancient city of Suzhou, known as the Venice of the East. Spanning five floors and 189 rooms, our modern hotel offers spacious accommodation with fully equipped kitchenettes, our signature Heavenly Bed®, rain showers and complimentary Wi-Fi. Keep fit in our saline pool and 24-hour Motion: Fitness Center. Savor healthy, delicious food in our on-site restaurants. If you're in Suzhou, China, to host an event, you'll appreciate our stylish event facilities, complemented by top-tier technology, modern decor, superb catering and planning services. When you're ready to explore, Ever-joy Hot Spring, Suzhou Amusement Land Forest Water World and Suzhou Taihu Lake Wetland Park are minutes away. A refreshing long-term stay awaits you at our eco-friendly hotel.

records.name_en: Fairfield Inn By Marriott Suzhou Xiangcheng
records.name_zh: 苏州相城万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: The hotel adopts a minimalist and warm design philosophy, eliminating unnecessary elements to create a relaxed, comfortable, and home-like atmosphere for guests.
description.textEn: As the second most globally distributed brand under Marriott International, the renowned Fairfield by Marriott upholds Marriott's consistent commitment to "comfort" and reliable brand service. Emphasizing simplicity and practicality, it is dedicated to providing a straightforward, friendly, and seamless stay experience for a new generation of business travelers.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Suzhou High-Tech Zone

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious and fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsa to sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Suzhou Jinji Lake

description.textZh: Adhering to the brand core value of "smooth, reliable and optimistic" and Marriott's quality standards, focus on new balanced and efficient lifestyle to the new generation of business travelers who pursue efficiency and pay attention to quality of life.
description.textEn: Fairfield of Marriott Suzhou Jinji Lake is located in Building 2, No.18 Jiarui Lane, Suzhou Industrial Park, Jiangsu Province. It is only 1.1 km away from Suzhou International Expo Center. The hotel has convenient access to the Eslite Bookstore, Yuanrong Shopping Center, Occupying superior resources in the east CBD of Industrial Park. The best choice for business and leisure travel. The hotel has modern rooms, with a modern and confortanble design style, showing the iconic simple beauty of Fairfield brand. All rooms are equipped with comfortable skin friendly bedding, 55-inch TV, free high-speed Wi-Fi and other conveniences to meet the diverse needs of contemporary guests.

description.textZh: 舒适时尚、温馨服务，尽在中国苏州福朋喜来登酒店。我们的湖滨酒店位于风景秀丽的江苏省苏州工业园区，邻近苏州博览中心、金鸡湖、拙政园、狮子林，地理位置便利。酒店邻近高品质购物商场、当地娱乐场所和诱人美食餐厅，地理位置优越。酒店装潢精美，提供各类豪华设施，例如健身房、室内泳池，以及供应国际美食和中国特色菜的酒店内餐厅。大堂吧临湖而设，供应诱人下午茶、醇饮优选和鸡尾酒。客房设施齐全，内设时尚优雅的浴室，并可饱览独墅湖美景。如欲在苏州筹办活动，可利用酒店的现代化活动场地和先进的技术。苏州福朋喜来登酒店位置优越，欢迎莅临下榻，尽享商务休闲旅行之乐。
description.textEn: Discover comfortable style and warm service at Four Points by Sheraton Suzhou in China. Our lakefront hotel in Suzhou Industrial Park is conveniently situated in the exquisite coastal province of Jiangsu near Suzhou Expo Center, Jinji Lake, the Humble Administrator’s Garden and the Lion Grove Garden. Our premier location is close to upmarket shopping, local entertainment and enticing fine dining. Inside of our fabulous hotel, you'll find deluxe amenities such as a hotel gym, an indoor pool and delicious onsite dining with International and Chinese specialties. Right by the Moon Bay, you can enjoy tempting afternoon tea, Best Brews, and cocktails in our Lobby Lounge. Retreat to well-appointed accommodations with sleek bathrooms and fabulous views of Dushu Lake. If planning events in Suzhou, take advantage of our hotel's modern event venues with advanced technology. Whether you’re in town for work or for fun, we look forward to welcoming you to our ideally-located hotel at Four Points by Sheraton Suzhou.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Suzhou Gusu
records.name_zh: 苏州姑苏福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于历史悠久的姑苏人民路沿线，紧邻繁华的平江万达商圈，步行两分钟即可到达地铁2号及6号线，乘坐地铁一站即达苏州站，两站到达山塘街，拙政园，苏州博物馆，三站到达观前街，四站到达虎丘等著名景区，距火车站直线距离1公里，距苏南硕放机场38公里，交通四通八达，让宾客在享受便捷购物、娱乐与餐饮的同时，也能轻松抵达苏州各大名胜古迹与商业中心。酒店在整体设计中融合中国传统色彩及苏州园林元素进行打造，细节中彰显出对传统文化的尊重与创新。
description.textEn: The hotel is situated along the historic Renmin Avenue in Suzhou (Gusu), adjacent to the bustling Pingjiang Wanda commercial district. It is within a two-minute walk from Metro Lines 2 and 6, offering swift access to major landmarks: one stop to Suzhou Railway Station, two stops to Shantang Street, the Humble Administrator’s Garden, and Suzhou Museum, three stops to Pingjiang Road, and four stops to Tiger Hill. Located just 1 kilometer from the railway station and 38 kilometers from Sunan Shuofang International Airport, the hotel provides exceptional transportation convenience, allowing guests to effortlessly enjoy shopping, entertainment, dining, and exploration of Suzhou’s iconic attractions and business hubs.The hotel’s design seamlessly blends traditional Chinese aesthetics with elements inspired by Suzhou’s classical gardens. Every detail reflects a harmonious balance of cultural reverence and contemporary innovation.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Suzhou South
records.name_zh: 苏州东吴福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 苏州吴中福朋喜来登酒店坐落于吴中区核心地段，地处东吴南路西侧、天灵路北侧。酒店交通十分便捷：步行可达公交站点，驱车 10 分钟抵达最近地铁站，25 分钟直达苏州古城中心与火车站，40 分钟便可抵达苏南硕放国际机场。酒店设有 160 间极具现代格调的客房与套房，整体采用工业风装修设计，色调温馨柔和，配备舒适床品、65 英寸液晶电视、独立淋浴间以及免费高速无线网络。宾客可通过万豪旅享家小程序使用电子房卡，还能办理快速入住与退房手续。酒店一楼设有品牌特色餐饮空间觅舍，依托精酿佳酿特色饮品项目提供本地精酿啤酒，同时供应环球海鲜、时令佳肴、咖啡及各类轻食小吃。四楼全日自助餐厅每日提供中西式自助早餐，还囊括多款本地特色风味美食。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Suzhou South is located in Wuzhong District’s core, west of South Dongwu Road and north of Tianling Road. It features convenient transportation: walkable bus stops, 10-minute drive to the nearest subway station, 25 minutes to Suzhou’s ancient city center and railway station, and 40 minutes to Sunan Shuofang International Airport.The hotel offers 160 modern guest rooms and suites with industrial-style decor, warm tones, comfortable bedding, 65-inch LCD TVs, separate showers, and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Guests can use the Marriott Bonvoy App for digital room keys and express check-in/out.THE MESH, the brand’s signature dining venue on the 1st floor, provides local craft beers via Best Brews™,coffee and snacks. The 4th-floor all-day dining restaurant serves daily Chinese and Western buffet breakfast with local specialties.Guests have access to the 24-hour fitness center on the 4th floor, which is equipped with high-end strength training and aerobic fitness equipment.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Suzhou, Wuzhong
records.name_zh: 苏州吴中福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 苏州吴中福朋喜来登酒店地处历史悠久，人文荟萃的吴中区中心地段，在苏州这座古典与摩登交汇的江南水乡，展现福朋喜来登品牌经典与现代的融合之美。酒店紧邻地铁3号线、4号线，可轻松前往四大名园之一的网师园，盘门景区，观前街等热门景点，尽情探索千年古城的多样魅力。酒店拥有175间精美的客房，现代简约的格调设计点亮每次入住的舒适心情。品牌专属福朋喜来登舒适之床让您安享一夜酣眠。每一次旅途中，酒店亦可为宾客提供多样用餐选择，满足宾客的不同饮食喜好。宜客乐全日制餐厅严选环球品质食材，匠心烹调将味蕾唤醒。与家人朋友们欢聚，共享舌尖上的美味佳肴。结束繁忙工作或观光旅途后，不妨进入大堂吧小酌一杯醇饮优选（Best Brews™）计划的精酿啤酒，享受片刻惬意时光。苏州吴中福朋喜来登酒店拥有1600平方的会议及宴会空间，可最多容纳880人，是举办会议、婚礼及其他特别活动的优选之地。所有会议室均配备了无线网络和全新视听设备，专业的宴会团队想你之所想，让每一次宴会的成功举办无后顾之忧。
description.textEn: The opening of Four Points by Sheraton Suzhou Wuzhong shows the beauty of the integration of Four Points by Sheraton brand in Suzhou, a city where classical and modern meet. Hotel located in the center of Wuzhong District with a long history and rich culture. You can easily go to popular scenic spots such as the Master-of-Nets Garden, Panmen, Guanqian Street, etc. The modern and simple design exquisite rooms will refreshes you at stay. Each room equipped with high-speed network, 55-inch LCD TV, the spacious working space, together with Four Points by Sheraton Four Comfort™ bed, allow you to work and relax with all the comforts. Locals and guests of the hotel can look forward to a variety of innovative dining and entertainment options at here. An area of 1600 square meters can accommodate conference and banquet of up to 880 people. It’s ideal for conferences, weddings as well as other special events. Whenever you go, just enjoy and explore the diversified charm of this ancient city.

records.name_zh: 太仓宝龙福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 太仓宝龙福朋喜来登酒店拥有 446 间宽敞客房，满足您的众多需求，缔造非凡住宿体验。 灵活会议及活动空间逾 2,200 平米，专为正式宴会和会议而特别设计，可接待多达 1,200 人的团体。 3 家餐厅满足您的用餐需求。 酒店设有设备齐全的健身中心、室内温水泳池和斯诺克台球桌，您和您的客人可在此尊享舒适放松的住宿体验。 酒店所在地段交通便利，驾车 45 分钟左右可达上海、同里和周庄。 无论商务差旅还是休闲出游，这里都是您的理想之选。
description.textEn: The 446 spacious guest rooms of Four Points by Sheraton Taicang will have everything you need for a great stay. Over 2200 square meters flexible conference and event space are special designed for formal banquets and meetings, which can handle groups of up to 1200 people. An appetite for good food can be satisfied across a medley of 3 restaurants . For you and your guest’s relaxation and comfort, there are a well equipped fitness center, in-door heated swimming pool and Snooker. Hotel is located in a convenient zone with only 45 minutes driving distance to Shanghai, Tongli Zhouzhuang. Here is the best place for you whether entertain yourself or have business trip.

description.textZh: 来苏州苏州湾艾美酒店近距离体验醉美太湖景观。酒店设有285间客房及套房, 包括3栋花园别墅。以苏州当地文化为设计灵感, 将“苏州园林”的特点巧妙融入设计, 并将太湖景观引入房间视野, 通过每一处匠心独具的巧思组合, 蕴刻出江南独有的雅韵。近4, 000平方米的宴会及会议设施, 2间无柱宴会厅( 1, 200平方米及600平方米）。独立的宴会厅出入口, 是举办车展的绝佳场地。1000平方米的户外草坪可举办如婚礼、鸡尾酒会、烧烤晚会等令人难忘的聚会。酒店还有3间独具风格的餐厅（新食谱全日制餐厅、浮玉台中餐厅及包厢）和北纬31大堂吧, 可满足多样化的用餐需求。此外, 25米的室内恒温泳池、健身中心、水疗中心及218平方米的儿童乐园等娱乐休闲设施一应俱全。
description.textEn: Experience lakeside charm at Le Meridien Suzhou, Suzhou Bay in China. Our hotel offers 287 stylish accommodations, including three villas exclusively equipped with plunge pool. Most rooms boast city or Taihu Lake views. Dine in our three modern restaurants. Relax in our lobby lounge with Taihu Lake views. If you are in Suzhou, China, to host an event, you'll appreciate our six meeting rooms, including two pillarless banquet halls. With an independent entrance, the 1,200-square-meter Grand Ballroom and 600-square-meter Junior Ballroom easily accommodate auto shows. Unforgettable gatherings, from weddings to cocktail parties, may be hosted on our lovely outdoor lawn. Our state-of-the-art Fitness Center offers an extensive range of facilities for your workout, or swim laps in our 25-meter indoor pool. The spa and yoga rooms ensure tranquil relaxation. We look forward to welcoming you to our modern Suzhou hotel.

description.textZh: At Marriott Executive Apartments®, you'll enjoy the convenience of a hotel, with the space, ambience and privacy of home living. Our completely furnished apartments come with a fully equipped kitchen,housekeeping services, storage and 24-hour staffing.
description.textEn: At Marriott Executive Apartments®, you'll enjoy the convenience of a hotel, with the space, ambience and privacy of home living. Our completely furnished apartments come with a fully equipped kitchen,housekeeping services, storage and 24-hour staffing.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻美丽典雅的苏州万豪酒店。酒店位于苏州古城中心, 是姑苏区地标建筑, 闹中取静。酒店地理位置优越, 交通便捷, 距离地铁一号线西环路站和桐泾北路站步行仅需10分钟, 距离西环高架入口8分钟车程, 距离苏州火车站10分钟车程, 距离苏州北站30分钟车程, 距离苏南硕放机场40分钟车程, 距离上海虹桥机场80分钟车程, 出行便利。酒店临近寒山寺、山塘街, 观前街、西园寺、留园、平江路、拙政园等经典景点, 临近新晋网红打卡地苏州博物馆, 博物馆西馆、淮海街等。酒店舒适典雅客房及套房位于酒店29-48层, 酒店客房面积40㎡起, 为您提供宽敞的住宿空间, 房间内可远眺虎丘塔和东方之门, 落日余晖撒入房内, 温暖舒适。酒店一楼300㎡优雅苏式花园是您组织各式活动的理想场所。小桥流水, 花园亭台, 在欣赏姑苏雅致风景的同时, 满足您的各种户外活动及搭建需求。酒店拥有4间时尚个性的餐厅及酒廊, 亚洲风尚自助餐厅、苏悦荟中餐厅、裕兴记·臻选、酒店大堂吧使您在酒店用餐成为不可错过的一场美食之旅。3楼的健身中心、瑜珈馆、SPA水疗、游泳池等各项设施, 自然采光, 可边欣赏窗外美景边健身休闲, 助您退去工作之疲。
description.textEn: Experience a beautiful and elegant stay at Suzhou Marriott Hotel. Find a scenic respite in thoughtfully appointed accommodations with contemporary amenities, high-speed internet, full-size desks and striking views of the surrounding cityscape. Indulge in delectable all-day dining at Asia Bistro, Joy Soo Chinese restaurant and Yu Xing Ji Premium, or sip fine wines and refreshing cocktails at The Lounge. Enjoy a prime location in the new high-tech development zone, adjacent to the Suzhou Government and Administrative Service Centre. Plan flawless gatherings in sophisticated event venues, enhanced by expert planners and custom catering professionals. Punctuate an unforgettable day of work, shopping or sightseeing in the Gusu District with a refreshing swim in our sparkling pool or exhilarating workout in our fitness center. With easy access to Suzhou International Expo Center and Suzhou Industrial Park, our hotel is a contemporary haven for today's business and leisure travelers.

description.textZh: 苏州太湖万豪酒店坐落于苏州太湖国家旅游度假区，浸蕴着古代吴地文化，信步可揽憩静恬美的太湖山色和风景名胜，酒店毗邻太湖国际会议中心、太湖国际高尔夫球场；驱车约 30 分钟可达苏州主要交通枢纽；距离上海虹桥国际机场仅约 50 分钟车程，是休闲游客和商务旅客的理想之选。酒店设施齐全，既适合休闲度假，也适合商务会展。酒店内有别具一格的餐厅和酒吧、四座泳池（其中一座为儿童泳池）、酒店拥有 415 平米的儿童俱乐部，包括室内娱乐区和室外花园、免费 Wi-Fi 网络、可眺望四周自然美景的现代化客房，以及 5,913 平米的会议和宴会活动空间。宴会活动空间直接连通花园和入口，非常适合举办车展。苏州太湖万豪酒店邀您尊享舒适的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Located next to picturesque Taihu Lake, Suzhou Marriott Hotel Taihu Lake is a modern resort hotel offering a variety of accommodation featuring stunning lake or mountain views. Stylish hotel rooms and suites come complete with thoughtful amenities, plush bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi and iPod docking stations. Stay, play and explore all the leisure facilities at our resort hotel, including indoor and outdoor pools, bowling alley, Kids Club, table tennis and state-of-the-art fitness center. After working up an appetite, choose from one of our hotel's many restaurants, ranging from Chinese and international, to all-day dining and room service. Take advantage of our hotel's close proximity to Suzhou Taihu International Conference Center to host a meeting or special event in one of our 21 versatile conference and wedding venues, including sizeable outdoor spaces. Whatever the occasion, ensure it is a success with our delicious on-site catering, modern technology and expert planning services.

records.name_zh: 苏州阳澄湖泰康万豪酒店

description.textZh: 苏州阳澄湖泰康万豪酒店是一家具有鲜明艺术特色的高端酒店，作为艺术的发生地，酒店秉承万豪品牌彰显现代设计和全心相待待客艺术的特色，为宾客创造兼顾优雅商务和精致休闲于一体的沉浸式旅居体验。酒店设有277间客房和6栋独立别墅，旨在为各个年龄段的宾客打造超乎想象的自在体验和舒适愉悦的旅居时光。3间定位鲜明的餐饮空间。均依托于浮生六记故事主线开展，个性鲜明，供应多元美食和饮品。酒店拥有超1,500平方米会议空间，可举办各种规模的会议、展览和宴会。超2000平方米的湖畔草坪，为各种室外活动提供了多样选择和无限可能。
description.textEn: Suzhou Marriott Hotel Yangcheng Lake, a place where exploring beyond art with distinct artistic features. The total construction area of the hotel reaches 47,700 square meters. Drawing inspiration from the life philosophy of Shen Fu and Yunniang in Six Records of a Floating Life, it injects "exquisiteness in plainness" into the spatial texture. The hotel has 277 guest rooms, including 14 family rooms and 13 suites, and 6 independent villas, aiming to create an unimaginable free experience and a comfortable and pleasant sojourn time for guests of all ages. There are 3 distinctively positioned dining spaces, all based on the storyline of "Six Chapters of a Floating Life", each with a unique personality and offering a wide range of food and beverages. The hotel has over 1,500 square meters of meeting space, suitable for hosting various-sized conferences, exhibitions and banquets. The over 2,000 square meters of lakeside lawn offers diverse options and unlimited possibilities for various outdoor activities.

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels®, we thoughtfully consider each detail so you can feel at home as you explore the world. We invite you to unwind in sophisticated spaces thoughtfully designed to make you feel at home®.
description.textEn: At Marriott Hotels®, we know that our job is to stay one step ahead, always anticipating your needs. So, as you and your needs evolve, so do we. As masters of our craft, we believe our legacy is built with every stay®.

records.name_zh: 苏州姑苏 Moxy 酒店

description.textZh: Contemporary design hotel featuring well-appointed chic bedrooms. The stylish, spacious lobby with free Wifi is the place to meet, greet and retreat.
description.textEn: Located at No. 568 Shizi Street, Moxy Suzhou City Centre is nestled between GuanqianCommercial District to the north and Shiquan Street Commercial Area to the south, makingit an ideal choice for those seeking a blend of bustling commerce and historical culture inthe heart of Suzhou.Within a 5-kilometer radius, it is surrounded by numerous Suzhou-style gardens such asthe Humble Administrator’s Garden, Master of Nets Garden, and Canglang Pavilion, as wellas cultural and historical attractions like the Suzhou Museum and Pingjiang Road HistoricDistrict。An unique and exclusive social space created for you!A blend of rich Gusu “talented scholars and beautiful ladies” elementswith MOXY’s unique industrial style, igniting a different spark of PLAY ON.

description.textZh: 苏州尼盛万丽酒店位置便利，地处工业园区，如同双面绣的精巧，串联起苏州古典与现代的版图。距金鸡湖仅 5 分钟路程，步行可至地铁站。乘车片刻即至苏州各大博物馆、寺庙及其它知名场所。 历经长达四年的改扩建，如今，苏州尼盛万丽酒店再次成为焕然如新及功能整体升级的国际酒店。步入酒店，简洁明快的设计中透露出苏州特有的书香雅韵。酒店内餐厅设计时尚现代，供应丰富多样的国际菜肴和亚洲美食，缔造愉悦的用餐体验。苏州尼盛万丽酒店客房宽敞舒适，配备高速上网以及设有独立淋浴间的大理石浴室。 忙碌一天后，欢迎前往逸庭或全天开放的健身中心，尊享休闲时光。无论举办鸡尾酒会、会议还是，我们的餐饮与活动筹办团队都能为您呈现。
description.textEn: Charmingly designed and conveniently located, Renaissance Suzhou Hotel provides an unforgettable backdrop for your next adventure. You will find us ideally placed within Suzhou Industrial Park moments away from Jinji Lake; the subway is just a few minutes away on foot, making it easy for Social Discoverers to explore. Settle into tranquil, contemporary rooms with pillowtop beds, marble bathrooms, ergonomic work areas with high-speed Wi-Fi and superb views over Suzhou Central Park. Sample Chinese and global dishes at our two restaurants, one of which offers a lively open kitchen, or sip a drink at R Bar. If you are hosting an event in East China, you have almost 19,000 square feet of versatile space at your disposal, including a ballroom that can accommodate 1,000 people. We hope you will explore your surroundings while you are with us as well Suzhou Museum is close by, as is Suzhou International Expo Center and other points of interest. We cannot wait to make you feel at home at Renaissance Suzhou Hotel.

description.textZh: 夕阳西下，苏州的渔民在宁静舒缓的氛围中满载而归。傍晚余晖斜洒，郁郁葱葱的茶园、浪漫的运河和仿若泛着金光峻岭，构成一幅如诗如画的美景。这座“东方威尼斯”拥有 2,500 年悠长的文化历史，古代艺术、古朴的寺庙和幽静的园林，静待您的探寻。苏州太湖万丽酒店面朝风景如画的太湖，坐拥水天相接的壮丽美景，欢迎莅临下榻，尽享迷人景色。酒店别具一格的现代装饰中融入当地石材和色彩。名家设计的客房、套房和别墅均采用熠熠生辉的绿松石，色调自然。房内提供免费 Wi-Fi 网络、舒适的床上用品和水疗浴室。五行屋顶酒吧及餐厅提供包厢，访客可一边欣赏苏州美景，一边享用日式铁板烧和招牌鸡尾酒。酒店拥有超过5,000平的户外场地，宽敞灵活，适合举行各类型的婚礼、社交活动及商务活动。
description.textEn: As the sun sets on Suzhou China the air fills with the melodies of fishermen returning with their daily catch. The day’s final light casts a glow on lush tea plantations, romantic canals and majestic mountains. In this Venice of the Orient, a 2,500 year old culture invites exploration of its ancient arts, temples and gardens. Set by scenic Taihu Lake where vibrant waters blend into piercing blue skies, Renaissance Suzhou Taihu Lake Hotel opens its doors to a chic environment. Local textures and colors are reflected in superb contemporary decor. Designer hotel rooms, suites and villas feature natural tones punctuated by flashes of turquoise and offer free WiFi, plush bedding and spa-inspired bathrooms. From the Wu Xing rooftop bar and restaurant with private rooms, visitors can indulge in panoramic views, Japanese teppanyaki and signature cocktails. For social or business events, over 75,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor space await. A stay at our hotel in Suzhou, China is truly remarkable.

records.name_zh: 苏州吴江盛虹万丽酒店

description.textZh: Renaissance Suzhou Wujiang Hotel offers contemporary accommodations with lake views, fine international dining, a fitness center, pool and sophisticated event space for meetings, conferences, weddings and social engagements.
description.textEn: The internationally branded hotel in Shengze Wujiang, Renaissance Suzhou Wujiang is a contemporary haven at the border of Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai. Immerse yourself in stylish comfort in beautifully appointed accommodations with luxury bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi, LED TVs and inspiring lake views. Delight your palate with distinctive international all-day dining at Food Studio. Explore celebrated attractions, including Qianlong Park, Si Bo Yuan, Xiancan Temple and Tongli. Celebrate and succeed in sprawling event space for meetings, conferences, weddings and social affairs. Enjoy dinner in one of the 11 private dining rooms at Wan Li Chinese restaurant. Punctuate a memorable day with an invigorating workout in our fitness center or refreshing swim in our sparkling pool. Enrich your visit to China at Renaissance Suzhou Wujiang Hotel.

description.textZh: 苏州丽思卡尔顿酒店位于苏州核心地段姑苏区的苏州华贸中心之中，毗邻姑苏古城，将古城精粹与现代奢华结合，展现江南水乡的雅致 魅力。酒店设有190间宽敞明亮的客房与套房，五个会议及宴会空间及三间特色餐厅，包括枫畔庭大堂吧、标霞中餐厅以及Alkanna特色餐厅，汇聚本地风味和西式美馔。丽思卡尔顿 行政酒廊设有精美餐食、户外园林景观及周到服务，为宾客打造独具江南风情的旅居奢享体验。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Suzhou is nestled in the heart of Gusu District, within the newly developed China Central Place Suzhou, adjacent to the historic Gusu ancient city. The hotel seamlessly blends the essence of the Suzhou culture with modern luxury, showcasing the elegant charm of Jiangnan water town. The hotel boasts 190 spacious and bright guestrooms and suites, five event and meeting venues, and distinctive dining venues, including Feng Pan Ting Lobby Lounge, Alkanna all-day dining restaurant, and Biao Xia Chinese restaurant, where guests can savor both local flavors and Western delicacies. The Ritz Carlton Club Lounge offers guests daily refreshments, along with serene views of the outdoor garden and exceptional services, ensuring a luxurious stay steeped in the unique ambiance of Jiangnan for the guests.

description.textZh: 苏州 W 酒店以充满趣味的玻璃、灯光及其他奇幻元素对这座城市的建筑和传统文化进行现代诠释, 如同一件璀璨的浮动艺术品。酒店客房以当地园林为启发, 采用充满活力的色调搭配, 同时配备 W 特色睡床、卫浴用品、高速 Wi-Fi 和宽大的办公区, 更可饱览金鸡湖美景和苏州城市景致。60 间服务式公寓均饰以缤纷色彩, 是您享受非凡长住体验的理想之选。AWAY 水疗中心、FIT 有型健身中心和 WET 碧波泳池在自然和谐的氛围中为您卸尽疲惫。精美的活动场地将您的活动举办水平从平凡提升至非凡。精致的美食与活泼的鸡尾酒文化更为您的酒店之旅锦上添花。苏州 W 酒店位于苏州中心 7 号楼, 邻近金鸡湖、时尚购物场所以及众多企业办事处。
description.textEn: Slip into a brilliant world of floating art pieces as W Suzhou offers a modern interpretation of the city’s architectural and verdant heritage through playful installations of glass, light and other fantastical elements. Filled with vibrant hues inspired by local opera and furnishings that appear to defy gravity, luxury hotel rooms dazzle with signature W beds, pampering bath products, high-speed WiFi and ample workstations, as well as delightful views of Suzhou and Jinji Lake. If you need to extend your stay in China, select one of our 60 serviced apartments, all accentuated with swirling color. Escapism entices with larger-than-life nature motifs at our indulgent AWAY Spa, FIT and WET pool. Our dazzling venues elevate your event from ordinary to extraordinary. Exquisite gastronomy and a vivacious cocktail culture complete this remarkable hotel narrative. W Suzhou is in Building 7 of Suzhou Center, near Jinji Lake, trendy shopping and numerous corporate offices.

description.textZh: Experience fresh, vibrant spaces designed for the modern traveler. We blend soulful environments with intuitive design to keep up with your lifestyle and bring people together.
description.textEn: Aloft Hotels is open in space and spirit, offering Fresh, purposeful environments and vibrant spaces that bring people together. We are the next generation of hotel, using technology and design to enhance experiences and move at the fast pace of our guests.

description.textZh: 台中万豪万枫酒店位于繁华的台中市，为游客提供贴心服务和周到设施。我们的商务酒店靠近台中高铁站，仅需短途车程即可抵达台中国际机场和台中工业园。惬意游览日月潭等自然景观，还有寺庙、博物馆、台中歌剧院和逢甲夜市等。返回西屯区办公、休闲、举办活动或惬意放松。我们台中酒店的每间客房均配备豪华睡床、迷你冰箱、平面电视、办公桌和落地窗。此外，酒店还提供免费高速Wi-Fi和免费停车服务。在我们的健身中心惬意挥汗，到餐厅品尝国际风味美食。我们的西屯区酒店设有温馨会议空间，是您举办商务聚会的理想选择。酒店提供“万豪万枫品质承诺服务”，竭诚为宾客提供非凡住宿体验。台中万豪万枫酒店值得您的信赖。
description.textEn: Located in bustling Taichung City Fairfield by Marriott Taichung welcomes travelers to Taiwan with caring service and thoughtful amenities. Our business hotel places you near HSR Taichung train station and is only a short drive from Taichung International Airport and Taichung Industrial Park. Explore the natural wonders of Taiwan such as Sun Moon Lake as well as temples, museums, National Taichung Theater and Fengjia Night Market. Return to Xitun District for work or leisure, activity or relaxation. Every room at our Taichung hotel features plush beds, mini-fridges, flat-screen TVs, desks and floor-to-ceiling windows. Plus, our high-speed Wi-Fi and hotel parking are free. Take advantage of our fitness center and savor dining serving international favorites. Our Xitun district hotel provides intimate meeting space for Taichung business gatherings. Ask us about The Fairfield 100 percent Guarantee where we promise you will be satisfied or we will make it right. Count on us at Fairfield by Marriott Taichung.

description.textZh: 台中李方艾美酒店位于台中市中心，兼具舒适性和便利性，真正商务休闲两相宜。酒店邻近台中火车站和汽车总站，可便利通达台中各地以及其他城市，并可直通高铁站。228 间雅致客房及套房均配有落地窗，纵览繁华都市全景之余，亦可惬意乐享安宁时光。两间美食餐厅及大堂吧奉上创意满满、馨香四溢的美食佳酿，任您尽情享用。与此同时，其内设有 1,600 平米左右的会议空间，包括两间无柱式大宴会厅和多功能厅，让构想宏大的非凡灵感变为称心现实。或可前往迷人的顶楼户外泳池、桑拿室和健身房，尽情放松休息，重焕奕奕神采。
description.textEn: Located in the city centre Le Meridien Taichung offers comfort and convenience to business and leisure travellers. Nearby Taichung Station and bus terminal, the hotel provides easy access to explore wider Taichung and other cities in Taiwan and directly links to High Speed Rail Station. Floor-to-ceiling windows in 228 guestrooms and suites frame a moment of calm with a panoramic view of the bustling city. Our two gourmet restaurants and lobby bar allow you to savour innovative pairings of flavours and aromas. Plus 1,600 sq metres of meeting space with two pillarless grand ballrooms and function rooms, offers the space to expand ideas. An amazing rooftop pool, sauna and gym help relax and revitalise.

description.textZh: 想要体验地道台湾风情？ 我们为您准备好了！想要体验国际酒店新概念？ 台中 MOXY 酒店为您准备了超多精彩体验。台中的逍遥夜生活，别具特色的槟榔文化，闪烁的霓虹灯，在这里都可以见得。从传统到创新，从文化到艺术，在台中 MOXY 酒店，我们将为您呈献精彩纷呈的猎奇体验。酒店拥有众多舒适的客房，配备智能电视和高压淋浴设施；还有各种富有趣味的公共区域和周末狂欢派对，等待您的到来！如果您喜欢玩乐，这里会让您流连忘返。
description.textEn: Want to experience 100% Taiwanese style? We've got you!The new global hotel concept? Moxy Taichung brings you more than that. No matter the famous nightlife in Taichung, unique Binlang Beauty, or flashing neon lights, there are all in it. From tradition to innovation, from culture to art, come to Moxy Taichung, we S H O W you all.We embrace all fun hunters to come here.
