There are cozy guest rooms, smart TVs and showers with high-pressure, as well as various fun-filled public areas and non-stop parties on weekends waiting for you to explore!If you love to play and get a kick out of it, there's no reason to leave.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻台南安平雅乐轩酒店，尽享时尚住宿和休闲体验。我们的台南酒店环境明亮、富有活力，以宽敞开放的空间、海纳百川的巧思设计迎接世界各地来宾。在我们充满活力的社交空间畅享爽口鸡尾酒和美妙音乐，惬意交朋会友；或在配备免费WiFi网络和先进的科技设施的客房放松身心。酒店周边有众多景点，供您惬意探索。惬意游览亿载金城、安平港和顽皮世界野生动物园等众多文化及历史地标。畅览渔光岛的优美自然风光，或从酒店信步前往台南当地市场。规划前往台南安平雅乐轩酒店的旅程时，别忘记咨询我们的专享酒店优惠，畅享卓越住宿体验。
description.textEn: Stay & Play in style at Aloft Tainan Anping in Tainan, Taiwan. Step into a bright, vibrant Tainan hotel designed for global travelers who love open spaces, open thinking and open expression. Connect in our lively social space over cocktails and music, or lounge in lodging with free Wi-Fi and the latest technology. All around the hotel, the attractions of Taiwan beckon you to explore. Visit cultural and historical landmarks like the Golden Castle Wanpi, Anping Harbor and World Safari Zoo. Take in the natural beauty of Yuguang Island, or stroll from the hotel to Tainan’s charming local markets. When planning your journey to Aloft Tainan Anping, be sure to inquire about exclusive hotel deals to enhance your experience.

description.textZh: 台北北投雅乐轩酒店是一处位于台北市中心的别致目的地，提供卓越服务和各类贴心设施。酒店附近有两个捷运站和多处热门温泉。酒店还邻近供应美味小吃的士林夜市和阳明山公园。我们的台北宠物友好酒店拥有别致的都市时尚装饰客房，配备迷你冰箱、即插即用连接面板、平面电视、特色睡床、宽大办公桌，坐拥北投区的优美景色。您可以使用酒店提供的免费 Wi-Fi，与亲朋好友保持顺畅联系。在酒店内的餐厅、自助熟食店和活力酒吧享用各色美食，或者在 24 小时充电：站健身房重焕活力。酒店的活动场地专门提供备餐饮和策划服务，以及先进的视听技术，举办私人婚礼乃至企业活动等均可胜任。欢迎下榻台北北投雅乐轩酒店。
description.textEn: Located near Taipei City in the bustling downtown area, Aloft Taipei Beitou is a unique destination with superb service and thoughtful amenities. Our Beitou hotel guests are steps from two MRT stations and popular hot springs. The property is also near the delicious delights of Shilin Night Market and Yangmingshan National Park. Recharge in our pet-friendly hotel in Taipei in rooms that offer a unique urban-chic retreat, sleek decor, mini-refrigerators, plug-and-play connectivity panels, flat-screen TVs, signature beds, ample desks and impressive views of the Beitou District. Stay connected with work, friends and family using our free Wi-Fi. Indulge in the tasty delights of our hotel's restaurant, self-serve gourmet deli and lively bar, or reinvigorate in our 24-hour re:charge gym. Organize anything from an intimate wedding to a corporate event in our venues, expertly supported by catering, planning services and cutting-edge A/V technology. We look forward to welcoming you to Aloft Taipei Beitou.

description.textZh: Breeze into Aloft for a whole new hotel experience, featuring loft-inspired designs in the heart of Taipei with easy access to the best food and fun spots.
description.textEn: Experience your unique style at Aloft Taipei Zhongshan, a vibrant and dynamic hotel located at the heart of an entertainment hub filled with theaters, shops, and dining options. Aloft provides seamless access to the city and beyond through nearby MRT metro stations and Taipei Songshan Airport TSA. Enjoy ultimate comfort in our Aloft rooms, featuring a luxuriously cozy signature bed, refreshing walk-in shower, high-speed internet across, and more.

description.textZh: 入住台北北门世民酒店，轻松探索台北繁华街道、历史景点和购物场所。酒店地理位置便利，约5分钟步程可抵北门地铁站，约8分钟可至台北车站，乘坐出租车短程可至西门町购物区。酒店内的智能客房，堪称集时尚与科技于一体的休憩空间：您可通过客房内平板电脑操控照明、百叶窗与温度，还能借助Chromecast播放个人喜爱的节目。在XL睡床上畅享一夜酣眠，于7天24小时开放的canteenM补充能量，使用免费高速Wi-Fi保持在线。酒店提供无接触式入住服务，设有时尚休闲厅，且整间酒店均以超凡卓越的艺术品装饰点缀。无论是商务出差、观光旅游或两者兼有，世民酒店都将为您打造轻松愉悦的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Taipei’s buzzing streets, heritage sights and shopping thrills are all within easy reach when you stay at citizenM Taipei North Gate. Just a 5-minute stroll from Beimen MRT and 8 minutes from Taipei Main Station, the hotel puts you right in the middle of the action – with Ximending’s retail paradise just a short taxi ride away. Inside, your smart room is a sanctuary of style and tech: controls for lighting, blinds and temperature, plus Chromecast for streaming your own shows all through your in-room tablet. Sleep like a boss on the XL bed, refuel 24/7 at canteenM, and stay connected with free high-speed Wi-Fi. There’s contactless check-in, a stylish living room, and world-class art throughout the hotel. Whether you’re in town for business, sightseeing, or a mix of both, citizenM makes every stay refreshingly easy.

description.textZh: 台北国泰万怡酒店位于活力四射的中山区，仅需步行约8分钟即可抵达行天宫地铁站，驱车约10分钟可至台北松山机场。酒店附近的行天宫是当地历史悠久的宗教景点，此外附近还有众多文化景点、商务区和购物街。每间客房均设有浴缸，并可欣赏城景，为您在城市上空营造一处静谧放松空间。MJ Kitchen是酒店的自助餐厅，供应众多国际佳肴和当地风味美食。Drift酒吧位于屋顶，这里景色优美，氛围闲适，是您小酌鸡尾酒的好去处。健身房面向宾客开放。酒店地处中心位置，以简约设计和可靠服务，为商务旅行者和自由探索全城的宾客提供理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: Located in the vibrant Zhongshan district, Courtyard Taipei Downtown places guests just an 8-minute walk from Xingtian Temple MRT Station and a 10-minute drive from Taipei Songshan Airport. The hotel is within walking distance of Xingtian Temple, one of Taipei’s most historic religious landmarks, and offers easy access to nearby cultural sites, business areas, and shopping streets.Each guest room includes a bathtub and city views, providing a quiet space to rest above the pace of the city. MJ Kitchen, the hotel’s buffet restaurant, serves a wide range of international dishes and Taiwanese specialties. On the rooftop, Drift Bar offers a relaxed setting for cocktails with a view. A fitness gym is also available for guests.With a central location, simple design, and reliable service, the hotel is well-suited for both business travelers and those looking to explore the city at their own pace.

records.name_en: Hotel Proverbs Taipei, a Member of Design Hotels™
records.name_zh: 台北赋乐旅居（Design Hotels™设计酒店成员）

description.textZh: 台北赋乐旅居位于台北中心地带的东区，是Design Hotels™设计酒店成员，也是万豪国际集团的合作伙伴。这间精品酒店由全球闻名的建筑师陈瑞宪倾情设计，以豪华、精致和热情呈现一处新颖的审美空间。与神秘的黑色钢网外观不同，酒店内部采用稳重大气的铜、温暖的木质、纹理皮革和精致面料进行装饰。贴心的管家服务进一步为该空间带来温情，同时“纵情享受！”的品牌理念传递着人们追求美好生活和现代审美的满腔热情。无论何时下榻台北赋乐旅居，美食爱好者都可乘兴而来，满意而归。台北赋乐旅居周边汇集众多非凡场所和美酒佳肴，我们已准备了一场调动五种感官的超凡盛宴，供四海而来的旅客齐聚一堂，分享自己的精彩故事，满足对美好生活的追求。
description.textEn: Located in the heart of Taipei’s East District, HOTEL PROVERBS Taipei is a member of Design Hotels™ and a partner of Marriott® International. This boutique hotel was designed by globally renowned architect Ray Chen, with luxury, sophistication and passion that represent a new aesthetic of space. Inside the mysterious black steel mesh exterior, the interior is contrarily constructed with sedate copper, mellow wood, textured leather and delicate fabrics. The delicate butler services furthermore bring warmth into the space, while “Indulge Yourself”, the brand philosophy, conveys the enthusiasm of people to pursue ultimate life and modern aesthetics. And food-lovers will not be disappointed either when they visit HOTEL PROVERBS Taipei. Surrounded by splendid space and delicious food and wine, HOTEL PROVERBS Taipei has prepared an ultimate feast of all five senses for all travelers to come share their stories and fulfill their pursuits and desires for better lives.

description.textZh: 台北寒舍艾美酒店位于活力非凡的中央商务区，是您探索台北期间的理想大本营之选。入住我们的台北市中心酒店，轻松游览酒店附近的迷人文化景点，包括雄伟壮观的台北101大厦和鳞次栉比的购物商场。从寒舍食谱颇具创意的粤菜佳肴和台式美食，到北纬25度的新式鸡尾酒，丰富餐饮体验尽在于此。我们台北酒店内设室内泳池、健身俱乐部和大堂咖啡吧，为您缔造休闲娱乐新体验。160间宽敞客房配备特色睡床、雨林淋浴间、大屏电视和紧凑的虚拟办公中心，尽显现代豪华与精致优雅风范。若想举办活动，酒店内设有灵活活动室，至多可容纳800人。无论商务出行或休闲度假，台北寒舍艾美酒店均可为您打造久久难忘的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Located in the dynamic central business district, Le Méridien Taipei is an ideal starting point for exploring this intriguing city. Discover nearby cultural attractions from our downtown Taipei hotel, including the impressive Taipei 101 and extensive shopping opportunities. A world of experiences beckons-from inventive Cantonese and Taiwanese cuisine at My Humble House to trendsetting cocktails at Latitude 25. An indoor pool, health club and lobby coffee bar round out the opportunities to unwind and enjoy every turn of our hotel in Taipei Taiwan. 160 spacious guest rooms redefine contemporary luxury and elegance with signature bedding, rain forest showers, large flat screen TVs and compact virtual office hubs. If you're looking to host an event, we offer flexible on-site event rooms with space for up to 800 guests. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, make lasting memories at Le Méridien Taipei.

description.textZh: 台北万豪酒店坐落台北城市绿洲，拥有简约时尚客房、精湛餐饮与高空酒吧，以及多功能宴会会议场域，并设有奢华芳疗中心与户外高空泳池。优越地利位置，可饱览大台北天际线与台北101等大都会景观。全新国际复合生活城提供国内外旅客品味生活及优质旅游新视野，邻近科技园区、国际会议中心、南港展览馆等重要商业中心，并可轻松抵达台北故宫博物院、士林夜市、西门町等知名文化景点。饭店紧邻各式购物中心、电影院、风格酒吧、高尔夫球场等多元城市体验与休闲服务，距离捷运站仅需步行6分钟，到达台北松山机场仅10分钟车程，轻松开启台北城市探索之旅。
description.textEn: Taipei Marriott Hotel, a premier urban landmark and a top MICE destination, caters to leisure and business travelers alike. Featuring modern guestrooms, five world-class restaurants and a vibrant sky bar, a luxurious spa, a rooftop pool, and advanced banquet and conference facilities, the hotel offers an unmatched blend of sophistication and comfort. Guests can enjoy breathtaking views of Taipei's skyline, including Taipei 101. Located in the heart of the city’s emerging commercial hub, our Taipei hotel is near major business districts, technology parks, and exhibition centers including Taipei International Convention Center and Taipei World Trade Center Nangang. It also provides access to cultural attractions such as the National Palace Museum, Shilin Night Market, and Ximending. The prime location offers convenient access within a short walk to shopping malls, cinemas, bars, golf driving range and diverse entertainment options. A 6-minute walk to the MRT and a 10-minute drive to Taipei Songshan Airport.

records.name_en: Madison Taipei, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 台北慕轩饭店，臻品之选

description.textZh: In the heart of Taipei, Madison Taipei, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, offers refined hospitality with timeless elegance — recommended by the Michelin Guide for three consecutive years. Just one MRT stop from Taipei 101 and steps from Xinyi Anhe Station.
description.textEn: Located in the heart of Taipei and along serene, tree-lined avenues, Madison Taipei, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, seamlessly blends timeless design with refined hospitality and recommend by the Michelin Guide and the World Luxury Hotel Awards."MADISON KNIGHT", the hotel’s concierge team deliver excellent service and trained by "Les Clefs d'Or" concierges. Whether savoring authentic Southern Italian cuisine at GUSTOSO, enjoying a special cocktail at URBAN331 Whisky Bar, or returning to the calming elegance of your guest room, each moment is thoughtfully crafted to be quietly memorable.Close to TlCC and the Xinyi commercial Centre, who offers a peaceful sanctuary in the heart of the city—ideal for both business and travelers seeking luxury and attentive service.

records.name_en: Suz & Catorze Taipei, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 台北宿之酒店·臻品之选

description.textZh: 下榻 Suz & Catorze 酒店，惬意探索西门町。 酒店可便利通达西门町时尚生活区，那里人流涌动、色彩缤纷、活力四射，遍布寺庙、购物和娱乐场所。走过该区域，还有众多台北精彩体验等您探索。 这场迷人的探索之旅才刚刚开始。
description.textEn: The Suz and Catorze is the gateway to the Ximending district. From the Hotel, the horizontal journey radiates outward into the Ximending lifestyle district: booming, colorful, crowded from temples to shopping and entertainments. Beyond the fray lies the even more fragmented experience of the capital Taipei. This fascinating journey of discovery has a beginning but no end.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻台北W饭店，惬意感受台北风情，留下难忘的回忆。台北W饭店位于台北市政站上方，紧邻地标台北101大厦和台北巨蛋。我们的台北市中心酒店附近汇集众多家庭友好景点、活力不凡的夜生活场所、时尚购物店、非凡餐厅等。欢迎莅临下榻我们酒店，开启精彩纷呈的逍遥之旅。不妨前往我们的YEN特色中餐厅大快朵颐，满足味蕾享受，欣赏迷人城市景观，或者在酒店内的时尚酒吧品饮创意鸡尾酒。在WET室外泳池畅游，抑或在FIT健身馆挥汗锻炼。结束一天充实的台北探索之旅后，您可前往我们惬意的Away水疗中心放松身心，或者留在舒适优雅的客房内静怡休憩，让舒适的W睡床带您进入甜蜜梦乡。若此处提供的信息不够详尽，无需担心，我们的随时随需服务将竭诚满足您的需求。
description.textEn: Stay fully in the Taipei scene at W Taipei, the kind of hotel you will never forget. Perched atop Taipei City Hall station next to iconic Taipei 101 and Taipei Dome. At our downtown Taipei City hotel, you will find family-friendly attractions, pulsating nightlife, fashionable shopping, fabulous restaurants and more. Stay at our hotel and you will never run out of things to do. To satisfy your cravings, try our signature YEN Chinese Restaurant with amazing city views or sip creative cocktails at our stylish bars. Get WET® in the pool or workout at FIT. After a long day of exploring Taipei, you can always pamper yourself at our relaxing AWAY® spa, or just stay in your cozy guest room and let your super comfy W bed charm you to sleep. Don’t worry, if we miss mentioning anything you want to know, our Whatever/Whenever® service is always there for you.

description.textZh: 台北六福万怡酒店座落于南港捷运、高铁、台铁及转运站四铁共构建筑7至30楼黄金地段上，距离南港展览馆仅需5分钟车程，邻近南港软件园区、内湖科学园区、信义区商圈、知名景点台北101、台北大巨蛋极具便捷交通优势，邻近新兴景点瓶盖工厂台北制造所、台北流行音乐中心。相邻的CITYLINK、唐吉轲德南港店、茑屋书店以及环球购物中心，丰富的商圈满足购物需求，更适合作为台湾自助游的第一站。四通八达的交通网，便于南来北往台湾各大知名景点，轻松连结世界及台湾脉络。台北六福万怡酒店汇聚文化艺术能量，推动台湾艺文发展，藉由国际文化交流及跨界艺术创作，国际艺术大师创作作品，在台北六福万怡酒店场域相互激荡，更特别邀请台湾新一代艺术家为酒店各空间进行专属创作，并于酒店内提供友善展示空间，让台湾本土艺术家的作品能够分享给予更多国际旅客，让旅客们感受到台湾艺术的创作力，传递美学思维，为旅人们增添乐趣感受。
description.textEn: The Courtyard hotels span nearly 1,000 locations around the globe. The Courtyard Taipei is built on top of the Nangang MRT, HSR, and train Station. We have 465 guest rooms with views to suit your stay. We offer an all day dining experience and are full of great food. The restaurants include Cantonese cuisine and a lounge bar to indulge in our seasonal selection and signature cocktails. Welcome to experience Courtyard Taipei. We serve in a fun, relaxing, and creative environment and better professional services.

description.textZh: The first Renaissance hotel in Taiwan is located in the Shihlin District,Taipei. A new hotel with 104 rooms along with multi functional function rooms, guest can feel a home away from home.
description.textEn: The first Renaissance hotel in Taiwan is located in the Shihlin District,Taipei. At Renaissance Hotels and Resorts, you will find a place where simple delights become memorable moments. Where distinctive style flirts with touches of whimsy. And where unparalleled service and uncommon sophistication always provide a unique experience.

description.textZh: Featuring Michelin star restaurants and multifunction meeting spaces, the 5-star Sheraton Grand Taipei Hotel is located nearly a 2-minute walk from MRT Station. The hotel offers an oasis of comfort and luxury in the vibrant center of Taipei.
description.textEn: The hotel in Taipei City is one of the established hotels on the island and has become so much a part of the local scene and such a popular meeting point with locals and foreign guests that it is common to hear “meet me at the Sheraton”. We have 683 luxury rooms and suites featuring Chinese Modern Decor. Choose from either our Superior King Room, Deluxe King Room or Deluxe Twin Room.

description.textZh: 莅临下榻台东桂田喜来登酒店，元气满满地探索台东市。 酒店位于城市中心地带，邻近历史人文、自然生态和谐交融的绿岛。 下榻期间，可轻松探索铁花村音乐聚落、Paposogan 海滨公园等台东特色目的地。 从酒店出发，举步可达众多当地景点和餐厅。 客房静谧舒适，提供羽绒床罩和棉质床品。 从舒适客房向外远眺，可一览城市天际线或蔚蓝大海的迷人风光，非凡休闲体验尽在此间。 所有客房均设有平板电视和雨林淋浴间。 下榻期间，可尽情畅享我们的泳池、健身房、电影院等酒店内设施。 屋顶露台缔造优雅之夜，而藏书丰富的酒廊则是乐享私人夜晚的理想去处。 酒店还提供温馨的礼宾服务，缔造宾至如归的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Soak up the vibrant energy of Taitung City at Sheraton Taitung Hotel. Centrally located in the heart of downtown, Nearby Green Island,connecting history and humanities, ecology and nature. This hotel is the perfect jumping-off point for discovering Taitung's iconic destinations, from Tiehua Music Village to the Paposogan Seashore Park. Essential local attractions and restaurants within walking distance. In your stay, rooms are quiet and comfortable with down comforters and cotton-rich bedding. Unwind and relax by overlooking the view of the city skyline or the beautiful ocean views in the comfort of your room. All guests will have complimentary flat-screen TVs and rain forest showers in their rooms. Included in your stay, enjoy our on-site facilities including a pool, gym and movie theater. Experience an elegant night out at our roof-top terrace or a private night in at our lounge filled with a library of books. The hospitality of our concierge will make your stay feel at home.

description.textZh: With great location high-end fashionable rooms, award-winning chef team and perfect surrounding facilities, Courtyard By Marriott Taiyuan Hotel is the ideal place for elites to handle their business, travel, and experience the latest trends in.
description.textEn: Courtyard By Marriott Taiyuan Hotel is the first international high-end brand hotel established by Marriott international in Taiyuan. Located in Longcheng High Tech Zone, a core area of Taiyuan’s urban development, it is a bright pearl embedded in the time-honored Taiyuan at the heart of the southern part of New Town. With great location and perfect surrounding facilities, Courtyard By Marriott Taiyuan Hotel is the ideal place for elites to handle their business, travel, and experience the latest trends in. With high-end fashionable rooms, award-winning chef team, multi-functional conference venue of over 1000 square meters, first-class banquet facilities, and surround sound audio-visual equipment, Courtyard By Marriott Taiyuan Hotel is the best choice to enjoy your life in.

description.textZh: Hotel has 246 rooms with more room category which including superior room, deluxe room, executive rooom and studio room. All dinning restaurant, 24 hours for fitness center and mini-market.Free Wi-Fi in every rooms and public area.
description.textEn: As the first hotel with the brand of Fairfield By Marriott in Shanxi Province, the hotel not only provide outstanding service for an easy and comfortable stay at an exceptional value and also we are always ready to welcome you to our thoughtfully designed guest rooms with plenty of room to work and relax. Free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel will keep you connected during your stay and our fitness center will help you stay on track. Spread out in our vibrant lobby with spaces to gather, relax and work. Jump-start each day with our breakfast. Guest can easy to get the Railway station by walking distance and 10 minutes by car to the Airport. You will always find the courteous service you deserve plus all the little things you expect from Fairfield by Marriott® during your stay.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Taiyuan Downtown
records.name_zh: 太原城市中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: “一座晋阳城，半部中国史。”下榻于亲贤北街的福朋喜来登，便是入住晋阳古今交融的时空交点。窗外是亲贤不夜天的繁华星河，脚下是承载三千年文明的晋阳故地。我们以现代工业风融入晋文化精髓的设计礼敬历史，让唐风晋韵在每一处细节中隐约可闻。此处兼具都市风尚与人间烟火，亲贤街一站式满足所有需求，毗邻太原广场、天美新天地、茂业天地等繁华地标，夜幕低垂，楼下几步之遥的酒吧与夜市街，霓虹璀璨、烟火缭绕，蕴藏着太原极为鲜活的夜韵。若偏爱静谧，您也可安居客房，独览窗外星河，遥想千年晋阳的盛世风韵。自此，在交通畅通条件下，自驾或打车探柳巷钟楼街约需18分钟车程，去感受千年商脉的繁华变迁；达太原站、太原高铁南站及武宿国际机场亦仅需约15与19分钟车程，助您高效连接世界。酒店全日制餐厅融合晋地风味，多功能宴会厅适配多样需求。于此，您可白日探寻华夏初曦的文明沉淀，夜晚拥揽龙城不夜天的璀璨入怀。福朋常相伴，邀您沉浸于晋阳的日夜风华。愿您在此，尽享龙城的厚重历史与当代繁华。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Taiyuan Downtown is in Taiyuan’s core Qinxian Commercial District. A classic mid-scale select-service Marriott hotel, it offers comfortable stays for business, meeting and leisure guests.Adjacent to Maoye World and Wangfujing, it has easy access to Liuxiang Bell Tower Area and Jinyang Lake Exhibition Center, with convenient transport to Taiyuan Wusu Airport and South Railway Station.Surrounded by Jinci Park, Tianlongshan Grottoes, Twin Pagoda Temple and Mengshan Giant Buddha, guests enjoy Jinyang’s history and scenery.The hotel features modern rooms with branded bedding, high-speed internet, smart controls and panoramic windows. Dining blends Shanxi and international flavors, plus a fitness center, 24-hour laundry and meeting rooms.With prime location, full facilities and thoughtful service, it’s an ideal choice for Taiyuan visitors.

records.name_zh: 太原 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 太原JW万豪酒店矗立于亲贤北街核心地带，坐拥城市中心繁华商圈，地理位置优越，交通十分便捷，距离太原武宿国际机场约11公里，距离太原南站约8公里。得益于太原悠久的历史文化，酒店的设计巧妙融合了中国古代传统文化精髓与现代奢华的精致格调。酒店拥有308间客房，透过全景落地窗可将太原气势磅礴的城市天际线尽收眼底。3间独具风格的餐厅及酒吧，为宾客呈现风味各异的特色美食体验。酒店还设有2,214㎡开阔灵活的宴会及会议空间。太原JW万豪酒店秉承“心之所归，自在此间”的品牌精髓，在这座锦绣古城以非凡服务，让宾客尽情享受当下时光，由内而外，焕发身心。
description.textEn: Taiyuan JW Marriott Hotel positions prominently on Qinxian North Street, the prosperous commercial hub of the city. Ensuring seamless accessibility, the hotel's prime position places Taiyuan South Railway Station just under 8 kilometers away and Taiyuan Wusu Airport a short 11-kilometer journey. The hotel boasts 308 guest rooms, each adorned with floor-to-ceiling windows that frame the awe-inspiring Taiyuan skyline. Three signature restaurants and bars present guests with unique dining experiences with different flavors and 2,214㎡ open and flexible banquet and meeting space offers guests inspired transformative conference, wedding, or business gathering.JW Marriott Hotel Taiyuan sets to deliver transformative experiences and warm hospitality that reflect the Stay in the Moment® spirit, in this beautiful ancient city with extraordinary services to let guests enjoy the moment and find the balance between spirit, body and soul.

description.textZh: 喜来登酒店注重以开放直观的设计理念为宾客与惊喜体验的“灵活聚会空间”创造条件。在此基础上，太原喜来登的设计与建筑完美融合，室内空间设计采用全国各地备受喜爱的新中式元素，并在传统设计的基础之上增添了时尚与现代的冲击感。太原喜来登酒店位于山西转型综改示范区建设的主区域。距离太原铁路南站8.5公里，约12分钟车程。距离太原武宿国际机场10公里，约15分钟车程。紧邻地铁2号线龙城公园站。隔街相望太原南部最大的城市公园--龙城公园。毗邻太原著名的汾河景区，晋阳湖公园。太原喜来登酒店拥有宽敞舒适豪华与时尚的融合酒店客房，更配备有4个餐厅，秉持本地+创新的理念，开启您全新的味觉感知，美馔之旅。太原喜来登酒店拥有超过1,200平方米的商务会议空间，包括1间挑高8米的无柱豪华大宴会厅，6间多功能厅及1间VIP室，另有可享360度的绝佳视野的620平方米户外平台。会议空间均配备专业的宴会及视听设施以及经验丰富的会议服务团队。丰富灵活的活动风格，无论白天夜晚，邂逅美景，纵享人生。
description.textEn: Sheraton Hotel focuses on the open and intuitive design concept to create conditions for guests and surprise experience of the "flexible gathering space". On this basis, the design and architecture of Sheraten Taiyuan are well integrated, and the interior space design adopts the new Chinese elements that are popular across the country, and adds a sense of fashion and modern impact on the basis of traditional design.

description.textZh: Courtyard Jiangsu Taizhou is located in the Taizhou Medical New and Hi-Tech Industrial Development Zone, and offers complimentary Wi-Fi and other business amenities. The hotel also features excellent dining and 21,000 square feet of event space.
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Taizhou is located in the core area of Taizhou Medical High-tech Zone. The hotel has 313 well-appointed guest rooms,9 multi-functional meeting rooms of different sizes and a total of 1,930 square meters. At the trendy all-day restaurant Wan Hui Xuan and the unique Chinese dining box, renowned Huaiyang and Western chefs combine local customs and customs to lead guests into the "food style" of Taizhou. Courtyard by Marriott Taizhou is committed to bringing a unique meeting, dining and stay experience to every business person and guest.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻台州喜来登酒店，酒店地理位置优越，坐落永宁江畔，毗邻天佑城购物中心，驱车约15分钟即可到达台州西站。酒店拥有283间客房及套房，透过视野开阔的落地窗将悠长江景一览无余。餐饮体验独具特色，采悦轩中餐厅精选当地时令鲜材烹制地道地方风味，以台州海鲜成就当地特色风味，带您体验历史悠久的渔家文化；从国际风味特色美食到地方风味菜品，从零点到缤纷自助晚餐，食光全日制餐厅为您打造非凡用餐体验；&More by Sheraton咖啡吧和秘境酒吧将派对氛围和艺术风格巧妙融合在一起，为您打造一处惬意聚会和交友的休闲之所。1200平方米的无柱式自然采光宴会与会议空间，灵活适配各类活动。500平方米户外婚礼草坪及专业婚礼管家，助您成就理想婚礼。此外，室内恒温游泳池与24小时健身中心，助您在旅途中保持身心平衡，焕活能量。
description.textEn: Sheraton Taizhou Hotel's 283 guest rooms and suites feature expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in plenty of natural light and offer unobstructed views of the long Yongning River. The new generation of dining facilities and service experience is a highlight of your stay. In addition to two distinctive restaurants, there is also a bar, café and marketplace, the &More by Sheraton Coffee Bar, and an intimate, elegantly designed Speciality Bar, offering a diverse range of local and international cuisine. The indoor heated swimming pool and 24-hour fitness centre are also available to help you rejuvenate after a productive day at work.

records.name_zh: 桃园大溪笠复威斯汀度假酒店

description.textZh: 桃园大溪笠复威斯汀度假酒店邻近大台北区远近闻名的大溪高尔夫乡村俱乐部，是一处静谧安宁之地，供您逸享非凡逍遥游。我们家庭适宜的豪华酒店拥有204间舒适客房和套房，均设有私人阳台和备受认可的威斯汀天梦之床；酒店还拥有迷人的热带风室外泳池、威斯汀天梦水疗中心、24小时威斯汀健身馆、综合娱乐设施、地道中西餐厅等非凡设施。欢迎莅临下榻我们的桃园豪华度假酒店，开启难忘逍遥游，逸享身、心、灵焕活体验。
description.textEn: Located right next to the prestigious TaShee Golf & Country Club in the greater Taipei area, The Westin Tashee Resort, Taoyuan Taiwan is a place where guests can truly escape and immerse themselves in a world of serenity and peace. This luxurious family-friendly hotel in Taoyuan features 204 comfortable hotel rooms and suites with private balconies, a stunning tropical outdoor swimming pool, acclaimed Westin Heavenly® Bed, Heavenly Spa By Westin™, a 24-hour gymnasium WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio, comprehensive recreational facilities, authentic Chinese and western dining and much more. Visit our luxury resort in Taoyuan, Taiwan for a truly unforgettable and relaxing getaway and the total rejuvenation of mind, body and spirit.

description.textZh: 桃园喜来登酒店位于航空城，交通四通八达，约 10 分钟即可抵达桃园国际机场，约 20 分钟即至高铁桃园站。这家国际旅游酒店可轻松满足商务、度假和转机等需求。内有 190 间客房，设计时尚同时兼顾安全性，先进的减振缓冲系统足以应对八级地震，缔造安心无虞的住宿体验。除了精美客房和套房，酒店还拥有禧粤楼中餐厅、U Kitchen、Hanamizuki 日本餐厅、酒廊、绿洲俱乐部、宴会厅和会议室，竭力满足宾客的休闲和商务需求。
description.textEn: Sheraton Taoyuan Hotel is located in the Aerotropolis with convenient transportation; Taoyuan International Airport can be reached in 10 minutes, while the HSR Taoyuan Station can be reached within 20 minutes. It is an international tourist hotel with business, holiday and transit functionalities. With 190 rooms and a modern design, safety is of the utmost concern; state of the art shock absorbing system able to offset an 8-point earthquake ensures maximum safety for our guests. In addition to exquisite guestrooms and suites, with regards to their business and recreational needs, we also provide the Hee Yuet Lau Chinese Restaurant, U Kitchen, Hanamizuki Japanese Cuisine, Lounge bar, Oasis Club, banquet hall, conference room.

records.name_en: Renaissance Tianjin TEDA Convention Centre Hotel
records.name_zh: 天津万丽泰达酒店及会议中心

description.textZh: 天津万丽泰达酒店及会议中心地处天津滨海新区繁华的经济技术开发区 (TEDA) 中心，设施齐全，东西方元素得以水乳交融，深受会议代表与商务旅客的推崇。凭借自身现代化的装潢以及 6,109 平方米附带先进高科技设备及精致餐饮的开阔活动空间，天津万丽泰达酒店及会议中心宏伟的会议酒店可轻松举办各种活动。天津万丽泰达酒店及会议中心的宾客可以在万丽餐厅的开放式厨房品尝诱人的美酒佳肴。来设施完备的健身俱乐部锻炼一下或者到 25 米长的泳池游一圈，解除您一天的疲惫。客房宽敞大方、装修精美，均配备舒适床上用品及高速上网连接，为您卸下整日的疲惫。
description.textEn: Set in the heart of the prosperous Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area, TEDA, of Tianjin Binhai New Area, China, Renaissance Tianjin TEDA Convention Centre Hotel has earned a reputation among conference delegates and business travelers for its distinctive level of deluxe and artful blend of Eastern and Western hospitality. With its contemporary interiors and expansive 6,109 square meters of event space complemented by technologically advanced features and fine catering, this impressive meeting and conference hotel easily hosts a variety of events. At our Tianjin 5-star hotel, you can sample a tantalizing choice of food and wine from the open kitchen of Renaissance Brasserie. Unwind from the rigors of the day at the impressive health club or with a swim in the 25-metre pool. And when the day is done, retreat to a spacious guest room featuring tasteful decor, plush designer bedding and high-speed Internet connections. A stay at our 5-star hotel in Tianjin, China is truly an extraordinary one.

description.textZh: 天津陆家嘴万怡酒店坐落于天津城市中心区域，步行3分钟即可到达西北角地铁站，驾车约7分钟即达天津西站，毗邻天津之眼、古文化街等津门地标性景区，同时陆家嘴商业圈内配置丰富，集合商业中心、餐饮娱乐及购物为一体，为您的商务出行和休闲度假提供便利。酒店拥有257间设计现代舒适的客房，身处其中尽享轻松愉悦的私人时光。万荟轩自助餐厅提供丰富营养的早晚自助餐和午餐零点服务，中西美味、本地佳肴汇聚于此，是您享受美食或商务聚餐的品质之选。6个灵活精致的活动场地，配备了先进的视听设备，不论是商务会谈或私人派对，皆可尽情精彩。酒店3楼的健身中心，让您在公务之余，畅想运动的愉悦。
description.textEn: The arrival of the Courtyard by Marriott Tianjin Hongqiao, the brand’s first foray into the city, draws business and leisure travelers from around the globe. Catering to this discerning group, the hotel offers a location within the Lujiazui Business Center, moments from the XIBEIJIAO Metro station and traditional Muslim Food Street. 7 minutes from the West Railway station. A state-of-the-art lobby is both a place of welcome and gathering with free Wi-Fi and flexible seating. A breakfast buffet is offered each morning at the Pavilion, where all day dining is available. Dining is also available in-room, where guests can work peacefully at a large desk or settle into a cozy sofa. The hotel offers six event spaces and select meeting and business services. To break from work, guests can head to the fitness center. Spring flowers, summer music, nighttime glow along the river, winter tea and crosstalk. For Specific details, please contact the hotel at 86 22 58985555.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Tianjin Jiefang Bridge
records.name_zh: 天津解放桥福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 在天津母亲河海河之畔，一座承载着城市记忆的历史建筑，经岁月雕琢后焕发新生。天津市和平区解放北路 10 号，天津解放桥福朋喜来登酒店静立于此，与天津火车站仅一河之隔，毗邻解放桥、世纪钟等标志性景点，将海河的旖旎风光尽收眼底。这座由原信托邮储银行历史风貌建筑改建而成的酒店，宛如一本厚重的历史书卷，等待着每一位宾客翻开，探寻其中的故事与传奇。​它的建筑风格融合了当时的流行元素，承载着无数人的回忆与情怀。如今，在保留建筑原有历史风貌的基础上，注入现代奢华与舒适的元素。踏入酒店，仿佛穿梭于时光隧道，古老的楼梯承载着岁月的痕迹，每一级台阶都诉说着过往的故事。酒店共设有 6 种房型，97 间精心设计的客房与套房，每一间都将福朋喜来登品牌的舒适与时尚完美融合。客房内采用温馨雅致的色调，搭配高品质的床品，柔软的床垫、蓬松的羽绒被以及多款特色靠枕，为宾客打造一夜好眠。房间内智能化设备：便捷的灯光、温度调节系统，满足宾客个性化需求，迷你吧、咖啡机等设施更是为旅居生活增添惬意。​
description.textEn: Standing quietly at No. 10 Jiefang North Road, Heping District, Tianjin, Four Points by Sheraton Tianjin Jiefang Bridge is just across the river from Tianjin Railway Station and adjacent to landmark attractions like Jiefang Bridge and Century Clock, offering a stunning view of the Haihe River's charming scenery.Converted from the historic building of the former Trust Postal Savings Bank, the hotel is like a decorous history book, waiting for every guest to open it and explore the stories and legends within. The hotel has 6 room types with 97 carefully designed guest rooms and suites, each perfectly integrating the comfort and fashion of the Four Points by Sheraton brand. The rooms adopt warm and elegant colors, paired with high-quality bedding soft mattresses, fluffy duvets and a variety of characteristic pillows to create a good night's sleep for guests.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Tianjin National Convention and Exhibition Center
records.name_zh: 国家会展中心天津福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 若您想在天津国家会展中心附近寻得一处放松休憩之地，国家会展中心天津福朋喜来登酒店便是您的理想选择。酒店地处天津大道与地铁1号线国瑞路地铁站旁，距离机场和火车站都不到30分钟车程，交通十分便利。复古现代的室内设计，灵感来自水手们的港口生活，301间简约雅致的客房可让宾客尽享舒适与惬意。“玩啤食社”作为品牌的新概念餐饮，是集多种功能与一体的灵活多元化空间，除了享用地道美食，亦可来杯现磨咖啡、点杯当地精酿啤酒、与挚友聊天或是游戏聚会。有会议或活动需求的宾客拥有6个灵活场地可以选择，方便活动策划师为您量身定制活动方案。酒店与国家会展中心天津万豪酒店毗邻而居，使得宾客能够充分利用额外的设施设备，比如餐厅，健身中心，游泳池和会议空间。
description.textEn: If you are looking for a place to kick back and wind down by the Tianjin National Convention & Exhibition Center, Four Points by Sheraton, Tianjin National Convention and Exhibition Center is just the ideal choice. Set beside Tianjin Avenue and Guoruilu Metro station of Line 1, the hotel is within 30 minutes’ drive to the airport or train station. With a vintage modern interior design here inspired by the life of sailors at the port, an easy and comfortable relaxing time could be spent in one of our 301 guest rooms. As a new Food & Beverage concept outlet, The Mesh offers a flexible and diversified space with a variety of functions. For meetings and events, a total of 6 flexible event spaces awaits to cater guests with different needs. The hotel is connected with Tianjin Marriott Hotel National Convention and Exhibition Center, which allows guests to take advantage of extra amenities such as corridor to the Convention Center, restaurants, fitness center and event spaces.

records.name_zh: 天津泰达万豪行政公寓

description.textZh: 天津泰达万豪行政公寓位于天津滨海新区核心地区，与非凡酒店共享豪华设备设施的同时拥有居所的隐私空间。连接到五星级的天津万丽泰达酒店,并 配有享誉全球的餐厅，健身中心和室内游泳池,水疗是您理想的长期居所。毗邻金融街，天津自由贸易区。对于家庭, 天津泰达万豪行政公寓的儿童俱乐部和近在咫尺的天津国际学校和天津枫叶国际学校。对于入住的客人有一居室，两居室及三居室的酒店式公寓供选择,每间公寓均配备设施设备齐全的厨房,洗碗机，微波炉，烤箱，高速无线上网,卫星电视，除此还包括购物、客房服务以及随需应变的豪华租车服务。还可以为您提供可举办非凡的商务会议宴会的12间多功能厅，以及逾6000平米的会议宴会场地。
description.textEn: The TEDA, Tianjin-Marriott Executive Apartments combines the amenities of a luxury hotel with the privacy of a residence in the affluent Tianjin Economic Technological Development Area of Tianjin Binhai New Area. Connected to the 5-star Renaissance Tianjin TEDA Convention Centre Hotel, our 15-story hotel is ideal for long stays with world-class dining, a health club and indoor pool, a relaxing spa and a central location near Financial Street and corporations in the Free Trade Zone. For families, we offer a kid’s club and easy access to the prestigious Tianjin International School and Tianjin Maple Leaf International High School. We offer studio and one, two and three-bedroom furnished apartments, each with a full kitchen, free Wi-Fi and satellite TV, as well as housekeeping, grocery shopping, room service and on-demand limousine services. We also provide an upscale venue for business meetings with gourmet dining, a meeting butler and 12 multi-function rooms with over 64,000 sq. ft. of event space.

records.name_en: The Lakeview, Tianjin -- Marriott Executive Apartments

description.textZh: 酒店配备各类便利设施，缔造商务与休闲之间的平衡，是您在逗留中国天津期间的非凡长住场所。天津万豪行政公寓为您提供繁华金融区中心地带的宁静一隅，随时恭迎您的莅临。天津万豪行政公寓提供单卧室、双卧室及三卧室服务式公寓，每间公寓均配有设施完备的厨房、公寓内洗衣设施、高清电视、高速上网和私人保险箱等等。酒店内设健身俱乐部，提供出色的健身设施和健身场地。更有室内恒温泳池和按摩水池供您畅游一番、放松身心；并可在室内模拟高尔夫球场过一把高尔夫瘾。还可在天津万豪行政公寓内的草坪花园中沿着彩虹跑道漫步，悠享轻松片刻。该服务式公寓位于天津市中心，双地铁环绕，地理位置优越，毗邻天津文化中心博物馆、美术馆、大剧院、万象城、奥林匹克体育中心和梅江会展中心，是到天津商务差旅、家庭度假和长期住宿的理想下榻之选。
description.textEn: Discover the perfect venue from which to balance business and leisure during extended stays in Tianjin, China. The Lakeview Tianjin, Marriott Executive Apartments welcomes you as a quiet oasis of calm within the Central Financial District. Choose from one, two and three-bedroom serviced apartments each equipped with a full kitchen, in unit laundry, HDTV, high speed Internet, private safe, and more. Take advantage of our health club. Swim in our indoor pool, unwind in three whirlpools, and even indoor simulated golf. Enjoy tennis throughout the year in our unique indoor facilities, or take a soothing lakefront stroll through our garden. Moments from downtown and the airport, near the Tianjin Museum, Tianjin Grand Theatre and Tianjin Olympic Sports Center.Our serviced apartments are positioned at the city's focal point, ideal for business, relocation, and long stays in Tianjin China.

records.name_en: Tianjin Marriott Hotel National Convention and Exhibition Center
records.name_zh: 国家会展中心天津万豪酒店

description.textZh: 国家会展中心天津万豪酒店与天津国家会展中心相连通，东方韵味与欧洲典雅并存，是您恢复活力、探索美食、激发灵感的理想之地。坐落于天津大道与1号线国瑞路地铁站旁，30分钟内车程即可抵达机场或火车站，从酒店到达交通枢纽十分便捷。389间宽敞现代并精心设计的客房搭配全景落地玻璃窗，令房间内拥有充足的自然光线并同时将迷人的城市天际线尽收眼底。品牌特色的万豪中餐厅，主理粤菜、新京菜和淮扬菜，餐厅设有10间雅致的私人包厢，是亲朋聚餐、商务宴请的理想之选；贡厨全日制餐厅提供零点菜单及品类丰富、食材新鲜的本地和国际自助美食，宾客还可享用开放式厨房现场烹制的各类海鲜以及西式和亚洲风味精选。室内半无边星空穹顶泳池及24小时健身房可供宾客度过惬意的闲暇时光，万豪贵宾廊更为尊贵的会员提供私人空间、创造专属体验。1196平米的津韵大宴会厅以及其他10个灵活场地，可满足商务会议、社交活动和精致婚礼等各种需求。酒店与国家会展中心天津福朋喜来登酒店毗邻而居，使得宾客能够享用额外的餐饮和会议空间。
description.textEn: With a direct entrance to Tianjin National Convention and Exhibition Center, Tianjin Marriott Hotel National Convention and Exhibition Center is set next to Tianjin Avenue and Guoruilu Metro station of Line 1, its convenient to reach the airport or train station that are both within 30 minutes drive. Each of the 389 guestrooms have been thoughtfully designed with floor-to-ceiling windows allow sufficient natural light and offer the captivating view of the city skyline. Chinese restaurant Man Ho serves authentic Cantonese cuisines, Beijing cuisine with a modern twist and Huai Yang cuisines in an elegant interior with ten appointed private dining rooms. All-day-dining restaurant Goji Kitchen+Bar serves local and international delicacies with a la carte menu and buffet features live cooking station. Kicking back and relaxing at the beautiful indoor swimming pool or work up a sweat at 24-hours gym. A 12,874-square-feet Grand Ballroom and 10 function meeting spaces ideal for various meetings and events.

description.textZh: 万丽天津宾馆位于河西区宾水道16号，距离天津滨海国际机场15公里，驾车约30分钟；距离天津站8公里，驾车约15分钟；从酒店出发，步行2分钟即可到达天津地铁5/6号线“天津宾馆站”C出口，轻松抵达天津文化中心，天津万象城、天津奥体中心、梅江会展中心等休闲购物场所。酒店拥有近万平方米的私享户外湖畔花园，是都市中的天然氧吧。368 间客房设计现代时尚，城市景观客房视野开阔，远眺城市霓虹穿梭；湖景景观客房，凭窗而望湖畔花园朝飞暮卷。饕廊西餐厅，浓舍扒房，天宾楼中餐厅，以及澜庭聚大堂吧，三间风格迥异的餐厅为饕客奉上寰宇风味美食、地道“津”味美食；在澜庭聚体验“夜·万丽”的精彩。超过3900 平方米的宴会及会议场地，为您提供灵动会议组合空间。健身中心，室内游泳馆及网球场让您尽享休闲时光。万丽相信，每一次旅程都是一个故事，有转折、有惊喜、有不期而遇，让旅程的点滴在此酝酿成新的灵感。
description.textEn: Renaissance Tianjin Lakeview Hotel is strategically situated in He Xi District, No 16 Bin Shui Road, It is only 5 kilometers away from Tianjin Binhai International Airport, approximately 30 minutes by car; 8 kilometers away from Tianjin Station, about 15 minutes by car. To establish Renaissance Tianjin Lakeview Hotel as the hotel of choice for leisure and business traveler with the unique selling points, such as our central location near by Tianjin Municipal Government and Tianjin Metro subway station, surrounded by Tianjin Cultural Center and Mix-city, where a place for premier shopping, family fun activities, a large variety of dining options and entertainment theatre. We will leverage the unique garden view and large meeting spaces to assist us in fulfilling our goals

description.textZh: 这家天津闻名的酒店沿优美的海河而建, 以齐全的设施与周到的服务静候您的光临。酒店邻近火车站, 距金街购物区、风格雅致的津湾广场也仅有数步之遥。您可在 瑞吉酒吧尽情享用鸡尾酒, 或欣赏周围的动人景致。酒店内设多间备受欢迎的餐厅, 供应美味国际美食。您亦可在室内泳池放松身心。如果您追求个性化的非凡风格, 定会爱上我们宽敞宜人的住宿空间、手工精选的家具以及 268 间客房与套房的典雅室内装潢。瑞吉管家凭借卓越非凡的优雅风范和细致周到的贴心服务, 竭诚满足您的各项需求。
description.textEn: Reside in the splendor of Tianjin's most coveted address, along the picturesque Hai River. Within walking distance of Gold Street shopping, the elegance of Jinwan Square, the hotel offers easy train access as well. Sip a cocktail and bask in the view from The St. Regis Bar. Indulge in impeccable international cuisine at one of our favored restaurants. Relax by the sumptuous indoor pool. Connoisseurs of bespoke distinction will savor the generous living spaces, hand-selected furnishings and elegant interiors of the 268 rooms and suites. St. Regis Butlers attend to your every need with impeccable grace and forethought.

description.textZh: 丽思卡尔顿酒店为商务及休闲旅客提供优雅舒适的住宿体验。追求理想的待客之道是酒店一贯崇尚的服务理念，近乎苛刻的准则为宾客们打造非同凡响的豪华体验。 天津丽思卡尔顿酒店地理位置优越，酒店所处区域是天津市的政治、经济和文化中心。 酒店位于天津中央商务区的中心地带，距离天津滨海国际机场约 30 分钟车程，邻近该市的历史和文化地标。酒店提供颇具传奇色彩的传统服务，助您轻松打造美好难忘的聚会、会议或行业展会。 会议空间面积总计约 1,600 平米。
description.textEn: The Ritz-Carlton sets the standard in elegance for business and leisure travelers worldwide. We have been perfecting the art of hospitality and have developed an approach to luxury that has never been duplicated. The Ritz-Carlton, Tianjin is strategically situated in the political, economic and cultural center of Tianjin. Within the heart of the city’s central business district, the hotel is 30 minutes away from the Tianjin Binhai International Airport and in close proximity to the city’s historical and cultural landmarks. The hotel applies a tradition of legendary service to create memorable gatherings from meetings to industry exhibitions. Choose from 1,600 sqm of meeting space.

description.textZh: 天津君隆威斯汀酒店位于市中心，矗立于热闹的历史和商务区。天津君隆威斯汀酒店毗邻著名的五大道风景区，这里以别具一格的建筑风格与雅致迷人的街道而闻名遐迩。在威斯汀健身馆畅享活力运动，或在室内泳池清凉畅泳。酒店内设各类特色餐厅及酒吧，为宾客提供环境时尚的休闲、社交和用餐场地。酒店拥有275间光线充足的客房，均配有特色天梦之床，为您提供舒适的住宿环境和畅通的网络。
description.textEn: The Westin Tianjin is located in downtown, rising above lively historic and business districts. The Westin Tianjin is nestled among the city's famed WUDADAO avenues, renowned for their unique architecture and charming streets. Stay fit in the WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio, cool off in the indoor pool. Our eclectic restaurants and bars offer numerous ways to unwind, connect with friends and dine in style. Stay comfortable and connected in one of our 275 light-filled guest rooms, which feature our signature Heavenly Bed.

description.textZh: 天水，一座有着“陇上江南”美称的秀丽小城，华夏文明的重要发祥地，一座古老而神秘的城市。天水福朋喜来登酒店，位置优越，30分钟内可达天水市重要的交通枢纽及市内各个景点名胜，深度体验天水深厚历史文化底蕴。酒店设计融合天水古老神秘的本地元素于永恒经典的现代风格中。为入住宾客营造出一种轻松舒心的氛围，时刻感受神秘与摩登的碰撞。
description.textEn: The Four Points by Sheraton Tianshui Hotel is located to the east of the Qilidun Qinmai Expressway Exit and to the north of Tianhe Square in Qinzhou District, Tianshui City. It is an important transportation hub connecting the two districts of Qinmai and enjoys a prime location. It takes only 15 minutes to reach Tianshui Airport and Tianshui South Railway Station, and 25 minutes to reach Tianshui Railway Station. The tram is within walking distance and can take you directly to enjoy the scenery along the way in both areas. You can reach all the scenic spots and historical sites in the city within half an hour and deeply experience the profound historical and cultural heritage of Tianshui.The hotel's spatial design interweaves traditional and modern artistic charm, creating a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere for guests and allowing them to constantly feel the invitation of classic and modern.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Urumqi Beijing Road
records.name_zh: 乌鲁木齐北京路万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 近地铁 1 号线三工/宣仁墩站（步行可达），公交密集；到乌鲁木齐地窝堡机场约 15 分钟、到高铁站约 27分钟、到红山公园 / 市中心约35分钟，自驾 / 打车 / 地铁全覆盖；位于高新商务集群，周边写字楼、企业总部密集，紧邻铁路局 / 小西沟商圈，是商务出行首选，通勤与接待效率高乌鲁木齐国家高新区(新市区)酒店早餐厅提供营养均衡的中西式自助早餐及融合本地特色的精致佳肴。餐厅采用嵌入式明档布局，巧妙划分取餐与就餐区域，营造温馨有序的用餐氛围，让每一次用餐都成为享受。位于大堂的万枫小铺全天候开放，提供各类零食、饮品和便捷简餐。无论您是需要快速补充能量，还是为旅途准备小食，这里都能满足您快节奏的出行需求
description.textEn: Within walking distance of Sangong and Xuanrendun Stations on Metro Line 1 with convenient bus access. It takes about 15 minutes to Urumqi Diwopu Airport, 27 minutes to the high-speed rail station, and 35 minutes to Hongshan Park and downtown, reachable by car, taxi or metro.Located in Urumqi National High-tech Zone (New Urban District), it is surrounded by office buildings and corporate headquarters, close to Railway Bureau and Xiaoxigou business areas, making it an ideal choice for efficient business travel and reception.The hotel offers a balanced Chinese and Western buffet breakfast with local specialties in an open, well-organized dining space for a pleasant experience.The lobby’s Fairfield Shop is open , providing snacks, drinks and light meals to meet the needs of fast-paced travelers

records.name_zh: 乌鲁木齐中建福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: At Four Points® by Sheraton Urumqi, our guest rooms feature comfortable beds, productive workspaces and fast, free Wi-Fi. We offer delicious food, a fitness center and everything you need to host business events and special gatherings.
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Urumqi in the Olympic Sports Center in Urumqi, Xinjiang, China, is the ideal place to stay when exploring the Western Regions, whether for business or leisure. The hotel's modern, industrial-retro style features, stylish guest rooms and comfortable bedding, with warm, unassuming tones that create a relaxing atmosphere to help you unwind. The global buffet and Xinjiang specialties will satisfy your taste buds. The unique landscape of Tianshan Mountain and rich and diversified sports activities also create a brand new living experience for hotel guests. With the beauty of Xinjiang, you can explore the city's famous attractions with the style and service you desire.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhou Peninsula
records.name_zh: 神州半岛福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 万宁神州半岛福朋喜来登酒店位于海南东部的神州半岛度假区，这里依山傍海，终年亚热带海洋气候舒爽宜人。酒店地处神州半岛的乐涛湾上，多彩多姿的海滨活动近在咫尺。福朋酒店的建筑面向蜿蜒在热带园林中的3100平米礁湖泳池与乐涛湾的碧海金沙，共328间景色与大小不一的舒适型客房与套房可多重满足不同出行者的个性化入住选择与需求。无边靠海长达500米的礁湖泳池绵延在热带椰林丛中，让您的度假时光仿佛置身于一个热带度假天堂中。酒店内设的儿童俱乐部在每日开展多种童趣益智活动。除此之外，在福朋的全日制宜客乐餐厅里您可以享用到丰富多样的自助早餐也在品尝到亚洲或欧式美味的午晚餐美食甄选，亦可在傍晚三五好友一同在休闲吧来一杯本地精酿的醇饮优选，不亦乐乎。这里全年均是您与家人畅游戏水的理想之选，优美的自然环境与完整的超大与会设施也亦是您开会或活动选择海滨目的地的理想选择。
description.textEn: Located on the beautiful cove - Festival Beach of Hainan’s Shenzhou Peninsula, our resort features a comfortable subtropical climate year-round. The hotel sits by the mountains and borders on the coastline, only steps away from the PGA Level golf course – The Dunes, designed by internationally-renowned Tom Weiskopf. Nearby, Shenzhou Beach Club, a one-stop premium water sport. They provide our guests with a comfortable resort with never-ending recreation and sports activities. Plus the fully equipped Kids Club ensures that children also have their fair share of good fun at the beach resorts. The Four Points by Sheraton resort in Greater China, Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhou Peninsula combines tropical gardens and integrates funky and contemporary styles to the architecture.

records.name_en: Le Méridien Shimei Bay Beach Resort & Spa

description.textZh: 探索美丽的石梅湾，尊享五星级酒店体验，欢迎入住石梅湾艾美度假酒店，这所拥有着优美景色的海南酒店位于万宁市东南部的石梅湾，坐拥 182 亩郁郁葱葱、精心修葺的美景，且距波光粼粼的中国南海仅咫尺之遥，毗邻诸多知名景点，是值得探索的海南度假酒店。作为一所五星级的万宁酒店，每间宽敞别墅都经过精心设计，配设可饱览海南风光的阳台，提供各类尊贵的礼遇服务。您可在此尊享五星级度假体验，包括四个餐厅和一个大堂吧、设备齐全的健身中心、标准的网球场、宁谧的水疗中心、两个室外游泳池以及各类丰富有趣的活动。这里不仅可满足您的度假需求，还有专业会议设施和工作人员为您服务，更是您举办海南商务会议和海景婚礼的心仪之地。
description.textEn: Allow Le Méridien Shimei Bay Beach Resort & Spa to raise the bar for a 5-star hotel visit. We are ideally situated on Hainan Island, China's breathtaking Shimei Bay, southeast of Wanning. Our resort is set on 30 acres of lush, immaculately maintained landscape, steps away from the sparkling South China Sea and close to many notable attractions. Each of our spacious villas features exquisite design touches, a balcony with outstanding views of Hainan and a wealth of premium perks. You'll be thrilled with our hotel's 5-star amenities, which include private beach access, six first-class restaurant and bar options, a well-stocked fitness center, a tranquil spa, two outdoor pools and a host of exciting family activities and water sports. Select our hotel to host your business meeting or wedding here in Hainan, take advantage of versatile indoor-outdoor venues, an opulent ballroom and knowledgeable planning and catering teams. Discover your own version of paradise at Le Méridien Shimei Bay Beach Resort and Spa.

records.name_zh: 神州半岛喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: 万宁神州半岛喜来登度假酒店位于海南岛东部神州半岛度假区内乐涛湾，面向一望无际的南中国海的神州半岛喜来登共有306间宽敞宜人的豪华客房与套房，在酒店的大部分房间内也可观赏到南中国海的壮丽景色，令人心旷神怡。喜来登酒店的开放海滩区域与2100平米的超大无边海滨泳池区也是您在此休闲放松或亲子娱乐的好选择。另外，在全日制的喜来登招牌式盛宴西餐厅，这里开放式的厨房设计烘托出热烈地互动气氛与精心烹制地异域舌尖美味相碰撞，别有一番风味。主打地道海南及传统粤菜风味的采悦轩中餐厅也能给予您在此度假时对传统中式美食的另一种别具一格定义。除此之外，你亦可在喜来登海景大堂吧俯瞰沙滩落日，啜饮一杯特调鸡尾酒。在神州半岛喜来登度假酒店，不论是何种美食需求，还是小型会议或商业大型宴会的承办，完善的与会硬件设施与细致的“喜越期待”式服务都将为宾客打造每一次的难忘的活动。
description.textEn: Nestled on a 3-kilometer golden sandy beach, our resort welcomes guests to share a memorable vacation with us. Facing to the South China Sea, it features expansive garden architecture, 306 capacious and comfortable guest rooms and suites, all of which offer Smart TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, spacious bathrooms and private balconies with breathtaking ocean or garden views. With access to restaurants and bars, ranging from casual to fine dining, there are plenty of cuisines to explore. The beauty of our tropical surroundings inspires our indoor and outdoor function space. The hotel has totally over 900 square meters of function space including a 440 square meters Pillar-less Shenzhou Ballroom featuring State-of-the-art deco covers as well as 6 other variable-sized function rooms and a well-equipped Business Center. Moreover, for the fitness enthusiast, the 24-hour Sheraton Fitness programmed has been specially created to meet the guest’s needs for a simple yet effective solution to health and fitness.

records.name_zh: 石梅湾威斯汀度假酒店

description.textZh: 石梅湾威斯汀度假酒店是探索海南岛风景迷人的原始区域（包括酒店附近的青梅林）的理想下榻地点。酒店位于海南省东南岸万宁市新兴的石梅湾休闲区, 坐落在绵延约 6 公里的天然海滨之上, 地理位置便利。我们酒店是家庭逍遥游的理想下榻之地。您可以体验正宗中式待客之道，各种卓越设施营造出豪华氛围，让您尽情放松身心、恢复活力。酒店拥有 398 间装潢精美的客房、套房和 25 套别墅，置身其中，尽享舒适与优雅，忘却纷扰烦忧。
description.textEn: The Westin Shimei Bay Resort is an excellent base to explore this fascinating unspoiled area of Hainan, including Vatica Mangachapoi Forest, adjacent to our resort. We are conveniently located on 6 kilometers of pristine beachfront in the emerging leisure area of Shimei Bay, Wanning, on Hainan’s south-east coastline. We are perfect for a family escape! Stay relaxed and revitalized in a luxurious ambiance with upscale amenities and authentic Chinese hospitality. Leave the world behind and surround yourself in the comfort and elegance of one of our 398 beautifully appointed guest rooms, suites and 25 villas.

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels & Resorts®, it's our mission to make every business trip a pleasure and every vacation the trip of a lifetime. Enjoy amenity-filled guest rooms, superb dining, exemplary meeting facilities and our time-honored 'spirit to serve®'.
description.textEn: Wenzhou Airport Marriott Hotel locates in Wenzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone. Hotel is only 10mins drive from Wenzhou Longwan International Airport and it offers free airport shuttle bus for hotel guests. Featuring 259 modern and comfortable guestrooms and suites equipped with keyless entry, hotel provides 24/7 access to Gym Center and indoor swimming pool. Goji Kitchen + Bar and The Lounge offer delicate food and beverage. Pillarless halls with various space options satisfy all kinds of events and meetings. For both leisure and business purpose trip, Wenzhou Airport Marriott Hotel is devoted to delight our guests with outstanding service and experience.

description.textZh: Wenzhou Marriott Hotel, situated in a contemporary landmark building of the Binjiang District's vibrant CBD, featuring 311 spacious, modern rooms and suites with a captivating Ou River and city view.
description.textEn: Wenzhou Marriott Hotel, situated in a contemporary landmark building of the Binjiang District's vibrant CBD, featuring 311 spacious, modern rooms and suites with a captivating Ou River and city view. From retreats to business, Wenzhou Marriott Hotel is your destination for relaxation and vitalizing journey.

description.textZh: 温州喜来登酒店地处繁华的市中心，地理位置优越，方便宾客轻松无忧地探索这座城市；酒店毗邻政府政务中心、高雅购物场所和繁华的中央商务区。能为想在温州寻觅商机的商务旅客提供一处理想的现代化下榻之所，令我们倍感自豪。酒店设有302间客房，整体装潢雅致考究，尽览温州城市景致。您可与亲朋好友在此相聚，一同探索附近景点的特色魅力，发现精彩纷呈的中国浙江。该地区自然风光壮阔秀美，周边景点涵盖江心屿、雁荡山、楠溪江、南麂岛、泽雅、瑞安等地。酒店设有先进的健身中心和桑拿设施，助您焕发身心活力；酒店内餐厅精心烹制美食，供您惬意大快朵颐；场地空间尽显华丽格调，是举办难忘活动的理想之选，非凡住宿体验尽在此间。欢迎莅临温州喜来登酒店，获享精彩纷呈的特色体验。
description.textEn: Primely located in the bustling downtown, Sheraton Wenzhou Hotel allows for stress-free exploration of the city; our hotel is moments from the Government Administration Center, premium shopping and the central business district. We proudly offer a modern home base for business travelers wishing to discover the opportunities in Wenzhou. Showcasing 302 hotel rooms, all accommodation boasts elegant decor and striking Wenzhou, China views. Gather with friends and family and soak up some of the wondrous nearby scenery in China's famed Zhejiang Province. The area is widely known for its magnificent natural beauty, and nearby attractions include Jiangxi Island, Yandang Mountain Nanxi River, Nanji Islands, Zeya Ruian and more. Enhance your hotel stay in Wenzhou, China at our cutting edge fitness center, rejuvenate in our sauna, treat yourself to skillfully crafted fare at our on-site restaurants, or host an unforgettable event in our opulent venue space. Discover the difference at Sheraton Wenzhou Hotel.

It is approximately 2 kilometers from the South Wenzhou Coach Terminal and Wenzhou Railway Station, and 25minutes away from the Wenzhou South Railway Station and Longwan International Airport.The hotel has 346 rooms including 16 suites with a variety of room types to suite guests' different needs. The overall decoration style of the guest rooms is natural yet elegant, with different spaces creating a warm experience of simplicity without losing the sense of luxury.

description.textEn: Surrounded by architecturally striking towers, majestic mountains and the shimmering East China Sea coast, The Westin Wenzhou is a sanctuary of wellness and renewal. Set on the 35th to 52nd floors of one of the areas skyscrapers, our new hotel reflects the citys focused design and free form nature, creating an exceptional business meets leisure experience. Revitalize your senses in scenic rooms with modern technologies, high speed WiFi and signature Heavenly beds. Savor delectable Cantonese fare, bountiful buffets and flavorful international cuisine at our hotel restaurants. Surround yourself with great shopping, dining and nightlife along the streets of Nantang, Wuma and Wenzhou. Host flawless meetings, magical weddings and unforgettable social affairs in sophisticated event space. Punctuate your day with a workout in our WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio or a swim in our sparkling pool. With signature comforts and a coveted location our new hotel is a refreshing oasis in a vibrant travel destination.

They offer a unique combination of quality, timeless European design, comfort and true authenticity. It's a whole new way to travel. Stylish Hotels for Urban Spirits, a new way to connect to the city.

With locally-inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free Wi-Fi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive!

description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Wuhan Hankou is located in Changfa Technology Building, Qiaokou District, Wuhan. Adjacent to Gutian Second Road Station of Metro Line 1 and closely connected to the planned Metro Lines 14 and 23, its transportation advantages will be further highlighted in the future. It takes only 10 minutes to reach Hankou Railway Station and 25 minutes to Tianhe Airport from the hotel. Additionally, ecological landscapes such as Wuhan Garden Expo Park and Jinyin Lake Wetland Park are nearby. The hotel has 155 stylish and minimalist guest rooms on the 19th - 23rd floors. The floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows offer stunning views of the majestic Changfeng Bridge and the beautiful Hanjiang River, allowing guests to enjoy Wuhan's scenery while resting. The guest rooms, designed with modernity and comfort, create a warm and pleasant living space for guests.

description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Wuhan Dongxihu is Located in the Hankou CBD business district of Wuhan. description.textZh: At Four Points® by Sheraton hotels, our guest rooms feature comfortable beds, productive workspaces and fast, free Wi-Fi. We offer delicious food, a pool and workout room and everything you need to host business events and meetings.
description.textEn: Get what you are looking for with the style and service you want all at a great price. Our lakefront hotel in Wuhan Jiangxia is conveniently situated in Liantou plaza business center near Tangxun lake. It is only 3 minutes walk from Metro Line 7, approximately 28km from Wuchang Railway Station and 45.5km from Tianhe Airport. You will also find free Internet, free bottled water in your room, great local beer with Best Brews and much more. Whether you are in town for work or just for fun, you are in for a great stay with us.

description.textZh: 武汉卓尔万豪酒店是万豪国际集团入驻武汉的第一家万豪品牌酒店。酒店位于武汉汉口CBD商圈。其外部建筑设计以别具中国红特色的现代感典籍叠摞造型为武汉客厅增添了别具一格的文化气息。酒店拥有368间精致典雅的客房，设有别具特色的中餐厅、武汉厨房全日餐厅、炙公馆特色扒房及大堂酒廊，将世界佳肴美馔汇聚于此，为宾客开启美食之旅。同时还设有24小时健身中心、室内恒温泳池及水疗吧等休闲配套设施。酒店拥有一个可随时分隔成3部分的大型宴会厅、1个宴会休息大厅及6个多功能厅，是进行商务洽谈、举办宴会及会议活动的理想场地。酒店距天河机场及汉口火车站仅25分钟车程。酒店与地铁站相邻，前往2、3及8号线地铁换乘中心非常便捷。此外，客人轻松可达武汉商圈，娱乐场所，湖北省博物馆及黄鹤楼。
description.textEn: Located in China's Dongxihu District, Wuhan Marriott Hotel Hankou is the first Marriott hotel to be built in Wuhan. Resting in the new CBD of Hankou, the building exterior design is a mix of modern aesthetics and Chinese traditional red color. Its design is also uniquely portrayed in the shape of a pile of books. Our hotel in Wuhan is equipped with 368 exquisite and elegant guest rooms as well as a variety of distinctive restaurants, such as Wuhan Kitchen and Maison Rib-Eye, to lead customers on an incredible culinary journey. In addition, our hotel also features leisure facilities such as our 24-hour fitness center, spa and indoor heated swimming pool. Whether you are venturing to China for a wedding, business meeting or banquet, our hotel boasts a variety of event spaces. This includes a large ballroom that can be divided into 3 parts for any kind of event with a banquet lounge and 6 extra function rooms. An ideal venue for gatherings of all sorts, make Wuhan Marriott Hotel Hankou your home-away-from-home.

description.textZh: 武汉光谷万豪酒店共有 326 间客房，空间宽敞，设施齐全，其中包括 14 间套房和 1 间总统套房。浴室设计别具匠心，配备独立淋浴和浴缸，着力缔造惬意沐浴体验。同时，酒店还提供众多餐饮服务选择，你可于此尽享别具一格的餐饮体验。Goji Kitchen + Bar 是一间全日制餐厅，不限量供应各种精选国际和地区美食。Chu Yue 中餐厅设有 4 间私人包房。供应粤菜、川菜和湖北菜。Smoki Moto 餐厅供应各种新鲜烹制的美食，以及地道的韩式料理。The Lounge 是一处倍受欢迎的社交场所，白天供应咖啡和糕点，晚上则供应创意鸡尾酒和小吃，更有现场乐队助兴。约 1,050 平米的会议区设有 720 平米左右的大宴会厅，配备高清液晶屏幕、3 间多功能厅，以及适合举办各种宴会和会议的顶阁。
description.textEn: Wuhan Marriott Hotel Optics Valley features 326 well-appointed spacious rooms including 14 suites and Presidential suite. Uniquely designed bathrooms with separate shower and tub for your comfort.For distinctive dining experiences, guests can choose from a variety of dining options. Goji Kitchen+Bar is an all-day dining restaurant which is featuring an endless selection of international and regional cuisines. Chu Yue is Chinese restaurant features with 4 private rooms. Serving Cantonese Cuisine, Hubei Cuisine, Sichuan Cuisine. Smoki Moto serves a variety of fresh food with traditional Korean cuisine. The Lounge, a popular social hub serves coffee and pastries during the day and transitions to creative cocktails and snacks with live band at night.Featuring 1050-square-meter meeting area is including 720-square-meter Grand Ballroom with HD LED screen and 3 function rooms and a special Top House for kinds of banquet and meeting.

description.textZh: 武汉襄投万豪酒店，缔造繁华都市之心的雅致生活。酒店坐落于武昌中北路金融主轴的地标建筑-高约263米的襄阳大厦内，邻近楚河汉街，西临沙湖，东眺东湖，交通便利，地下直通地铁站。既是一览两湖盛景的云端艺邸，亦是城市天际线上的璀璨钻石。301间雅致客房及套房均位于酒店45-66层，坐落云端之上，一览曼妙湖景，逸享旅途中的每个时刻。酒店设计从楚汉文化、三国文化中汲取灵感，一步一景无不展现东方美学和西方经典风格的巧妙结合。酒店始终秉承万豪非凡的待客之道，为宾客的每一段旅程带来别样灵感。
description.textEn: Ideally located in the landmark - CCFC, a 263-meter-tall building on the Zhongbei Road in Wuchang, adjacent to Chu River Han Street and surrounding with Sand Lake and East Lake. Convenient transportation with direct access to Metro station. 301 exquisite rooms and suites are situated on the 45th to 66th floors with enchanting lake or city views, delivering you an amazing journey over the clouds. The hotel design inspired by Chu-Han and Three Kingdoms culture, beautifully reveal the combination of Eastern aesthetics and Western classic styles in every aspect. With the extraordinary Marriott hospitality, ensure a unique inspiration to your delightful journey.

description.textZh: Renaissance Wuhan Hotel is a contemporary destination in the heart of Wuhan city center on Xudong Avenue. Enjoy easy access to local transportation and attractions, thoughtfully designed guest rooms and suites and several dining outlets.
description.textEn: From location to accommodation, all of the elements come together at Renaissance Wuhan Hotel. Ideally located at Xudong Avenue, close to the popular attractions like East Lake, Hubei Provincial Museum, Chu River, Han Street and Wuhan's high-speed railway station, our hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travel in the Wuchang District. True to the Renaissance ethos, we invite our hotel guests discover the soul of Wuhan; savor authentic local delicacies along Shahu Road, enjoy the natural scenery when cycling along East Lake Greenway or appreciate the chime melody in Hubei Museum. Dine one of our three restaurants and bars, and unwind each evening in our well-appointed guest rooms and suites. Our hotel also boasts a 24-hour concierge service, in-room dining and adaptable venue spaces, perfect for meetings, weddings and special events in Wuhan, China.

records.name_zh: 武汉汉口喜来登大酒店

description.textZh: 武汉汉口喜来登大酒店位于武汉中央商务区, 地处众多名企驻地、零售商场、博物馆和历史地标之间, 欢迎下榻尊享非凡住宿体验。酒店拥有 500 间布置温馨的客房, 坐拥壮美城市景观, 并配备现代化舒适用品、特色设施以及 LED 电视和 iPod 基座等高科技便利设备, 为您缔造现代豪华享受。别具一格的餐厅供应美味湖北菜, 让您尽享口腹之悦。酒店周边景点云集, 包括万达范湖广场、王家墩公园和汉口火车站。酒店提供精致优雅的活动空间, 配以专业策划者和定制餐饮服务, 助您举办圆满会议、婚礼和社交活动。一整天繁忙的商务办公、购物或观光之余, 不妨到我们的水疗中心惬意享受水疗护理, 重焕身心活力。酒店商务休闲两相宜, 是您畅游中国武汉期间理想的豪华下榻之所。
description.textEn: Located in the Wuhan Central Business District, CBD, Sheraton Grand Wuhan Hankou Hotel offers 5 star accommodations amid prestigious corporate offices, retail malls, museums and historic landmarks. Experience contemporary deluxe in 500 stylishly appointed accommodations with warm comforts, signature amenities, scenic city views and convenient technologies such as LED TVs. Ignite your senses with delectable Chinese Hubei cuisine at our distinctive restaurants. Surround yourself with diverse attractions including Wanda Fanhu Plaza, Wangjiadun Park and Hankou Railway Station. Host flawless meetings, weddings and social affairs in sophisticated event space, enhanced by expert planners and custom catering professionals. Punctuate a full day of business, shopping or sightseeing with a restorative treatment at our rejuvenating spa. A luxury haven for business and leisure travelers, our Wuhan hotel is the perfect home base for your visit to China.

description.textZh: Soaring above Hankou’s skyline, The Ritz-Carlton, Wuhan offers 204 elegant rooms with river and city views, refined dining, a tranquil spa, and versatile event spaces-standing as a new symbol of sophistication in the heart of Central China.
description.textEn: Anchored in the Yangtze River basin, Wuhan stands as both a cultural cradle and a dynamic metropolis. From its perch atop the International Finance Center, The Ritz-Carlton, Wuhan features 204 guest rooms and suites overlooking the Yangtze River and city skyline, alongside four distinguished dining venues, sophisticated event spaces, and a sky-high wellness sanctuary integrating a spa, fitness center and swimming pool.The hotel is a around 45-minute drive from Wuhan Tianhe International Airport and a 30-minute drive from Wuhan Railway Station, and 20-minute from Hankou Railway Station. Situated in the city's commercial core, the hotel places guests within effortless reach of luxury shopping malls, cultural attractions and vibrant urban leisure destinations. The legendary service of The Ritz-Carlton curates an immersion into the spirit of Wuhan, from its historic waterways to its landmark skyline.

description.textZh: 武汉汉阳威斯汀酒店坐落于汉阳区商务核心地段，地理位置优越，坐拥龙阳湖秀美的景致，周边商圈林立，从酒店前往城中的人文景点也十分便捷，约10分钟车程轻松抵达武汉动物园、武汉美术馆 (琴台馆)，15分钟车程轻松抵达4A景区归元禅寺、3A景区晴川阁，23分钟车程抵达5A景区黄鹤楼。从酒店步行500米即可轻松抵达地铁王家湾站 (3号线和4号线交汇站)，为宾客前往武昌和汉口提供便利高效的出行方式。酒店由万豪国际集团管理，拥有现代的客房和套房，设计特色呼应威斯汀品牌“生物亲和”的设计理念，营造一隅静谧的都市绿洲。所有客房内均配有品牌标志性的威斯汀天梦之床 (Heavenly® Bed) 和天梦之浴（Heavenly® Bath）。2间特色鲜明的餐厅和1间大堂酒廊，为宾客提供难忘的美食珍飨。总面积1814平方米的会议空间，满足各式会议、婚宴、展会的需求。健身中心配有设备齐全的健身房和恒温泳池。
description.textEn: Located at the downtown and commercial Center, The Westin Wuhan Hanyang is an ideal place for business, leisure travelers and weddings. Hotel is surrounded by shopping centers such as Wuhan MALL. Next to Subway Station Wangjiawan which is the exchange station of Line 3 & 4. Famous attractions like Guiyuan Temple and Yellow Crane Tower are within a 30-min driving distance from hotel. Hotel has 332 exquisite guest rooms where guest may sink into the signature Heavenly Bed. The Market All Day Dining Restaurant serve buffet breakfast and a la carte. Yunting Chinese Restaurant features Cantonese cuisine. And Lobby Lounge will be your first choice to relax after shopping. Feel free to plan your business events or weddings at our 1,066m² Grand Ballroom and several function rooms. After a busy day, have a wonderful time in our expansive indoor swimming pool, refreshing sauna room or 24-hour gym, being invigorated while traveling.

description.textZh: 武汉富力威斯汀酒店坐落于武昌滨江商务核心地段，仅一街之隔，纵览一线长江盛景，两江四岸的旖旎风光尽收眼底。紧邻美食街区，可便利抵达黄鹤楼、武汉长江大桥、昙华林、东湖、湖北省博物馆等众多城市文化地标景点，让您轻松徜徉于都市繁华与历史沉淀之间。酒店波浪型的玻璃幕墙在阳光的照耀下熠熠生辉，与长江的波光粼粼相映成趣，灵动非凡。酒店设计巧妙融合了长江、黄鹤楼、楚天台、江汉关等武汉特色文化元素。305 间景色各异的客房缔造舒畅身心的活力体验，威斯汀天梦之床助您舒享酣然好梦。酒店内的中西餐厅供应营养美味的武汉本地小吃和湖北特色美食。5 楼的江景露台酒吧是您放松身心的理想之地。华灯初上，璀璨夜景与长江灯光秀交相辉映，为您的旅程增添缤纷活力。
description.textEn: The Westin Wuhan Wuchang is located in Central Business District of Wuchang, with relaxing views overlooking the Yangtze River. The hotel is next to food street, and also conveniently near many cultural landmarks of the city, such as the Yellow Crane Tower, Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge, Tanhualin Culture Street, East Lake, and the Hubei Provincial Museum. The design fully integrates the cultural characteristics of Wuhan. The hotel features 305 guest rooms with varying views, some rooms overlook the city or Yangtze River. Each of the room is providing signature Westin Heavenly Bed. Savor the sensory pleasures in our Chinese restaurants and buffet restaurants, which serving delicious Wuhan local food and Hubei specialties. You can enjoy the light show of the Yangtze River in our 5th Floor Lane 96 Balcony Bar.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_en: Courtyard by Marriott Wuxi Lihu Lake

description.textZh: Located next to scenic Lihu Lake, the hotel provides you a serenity place that you can enjoy the evening wind of the sun setting, listen to the song of waves, enjoy the idyllic lifestyle and escape far away from hurly burly city.
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Wuxi Lihu Lake is located next to scenic place of Lihu Lake. Three-mirror lake side, craft specific view of Lihu Lake. The architectural of garden southern Yangtze Delta, creates a true outdoor art gallery, presenting a unique exhibition of difference architectonic style and sculpture. The strategic location offers exclusivity while at the same time being just 10 minutes drive from downtown. 97 spacious rooms and suites, an all day dinning restaurant Pavilion with six themed private dining rooms and a Lobby Lounge, offer an unforgettable living experience. An array of conference facilities including a pillar-less Grand Ballroom, 5 function rooms and spacious lawn cater to events of all kinds.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Wuxi Liangxi
records.name_zh: 无锡梁溪福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于无锡市中心繁华地带（梁溪区），酒店地理位置优越，毗邻无锡站与无锡中央汽车站，并紧靠地铁1号线胜利门站，2号线东林广场站，出行便捷高效。周边商业氛围浓厚，生活配套设施完善，餐饮选择丰富多样。酒店距离南禅寺、清名桥古运河景区（南长街）、惠山古镇（锡惠公园）等热门景点仅约10分钟车程，也可便捷乘坐地铁1号线直达，轻松领略无锡自然与人文魅力。酒店9-18层共有186间客房及套房，简约明亮，可俯瞰都市繁华美景。酒店内设玩啤食社大堂吧和玩啤食社餐厅，分别位于1楼和3楼。另外，配备了2间多功能厅：A厅216 m²，B厅210m²。两厅空间开阔通透，且布局灵活多变，均可根据您的需求，轻松变换多种布局。24小时休闲区位于酒店3楼，为您全天候的活力与放松需求而准备。健身中心助您开启酣畅淋漓的活力篇章；一旁的儿童乐园则是一座奇趣天地，等待着孩子们探索发现。
description.textEn: The hotel is Located in the bustling area of Wuxi,boasting a prime location adjacent to Wuxi Railway Station and Wuxi Central Bus Station,with access to Shenglimen Station (Line 1) and Donglin Plaza Station (Line 2),ensuring efficient and convenient transportation.Popular attractions such as Nanchan Temple and Huishan Ancient Town are only about a 10 minutes drive away or accessible via Metro Line 1,allowing guests to effortlessly explore Wuxi’s natural and cultural charms.The hotel features 186 bright and minimalist guest rooms and suites,offering stunning views of the bustling city.Inside,guests can enjoy D by The MESH on the 1st floor and The MESH on the 3rd floor. Additionally,the hotel offers two versatile function rooms: function room A (216 m²) and function room B (210 m²),and flexibly designed to accommodate various layouts according to your needs.The fitness center helps kick-start an invigorating workout.

description.textZh: 无锡绿发万豪酒店邻近风景秀丽的蠡湖，距市中心区域仅约 10 分钟车程，环境氛围轻松愉悦，卓越的服务可满足您的各种需求。酒店之外，别致的江南园林彷如一座室外美术馆，各式建筑风格和雕塑汇集成展。度假酒店风格的客房和套房适合家庭住宿，配备豪华床品、高速网络、平面电视和整洁时尚的浴室，舒适体验尽在此间。酒店内设 Man Ho 餐厅、Wuxi Kitchen 全日制餐厅和大堂吧，提供丰富的用餐选择。酒店设有室内泳池和漩涡池、瑜伽室以及设施齐全的健身中心，助您轻松保持健康。酒店拥有一间无柱式大宴会厅、八间多功能厅和宽敞的草坪，是您在无锡筹办活动的理想之选。酒店地处滨湖区，让您可以便利前往周边地区探索游览。
description.textEn: Located next to scenic Lihu Lake yet just a 10 minute drive from the downtown district Wuxi Marriott Hotel Lihu Lake offers everything you need for a visit that is both relaxing and exciting. Step outside our doors and experience a true outdoor art gallery in the southern Yangtze Delta garden, with its different architectural styles and sculptures. Make yourself comfortable in one of our resort-style, family-friendly rooms and suites, which feature deluxe bedding, high speed internet, flat-screen TVs and sleek bathrooms. Dining options range from Chinese cuisine at Man Ho to all-day dining at Wuxi Kitchen and the Lobby Lounge at The Great Room. Maintain your health with hotel facilities including an indoor swimming pool and whirlpool, a Yoga Room and a well-equipped Fitness Center. For those planning an event in Wuxi China we offer a pillarless Grand Ballroom, eight function rooms and a spacious lawn. Should you wish to discover the area our location within Binhu District makes exploration easy.

records.name_en: Grand House, Jiangyin, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
records.name_zh: 江阴霞客湾观堂臻品之选酒店

description.textZh: 江阴霞客湾观堂臻品之选酒店以“游圣”徐霞客文化为核心IP，将传统东方美学与现代简约风格融合，让宾客在舒适居停中感受“身居一室，心游万仞”的文化体验。 酒店周边配套丰富，有国家地理研学、航天科技体验中心（含徐霞客游记VR体验）等研学项目，还有隐札迹营地、霞客探索乐园等，兼具研学、露营与儿童玩乐功能。 店内设182间客房（33-338㎡），部分含私人泡池、湖景或露台；康乐设施含24小时健身中心、沿湖户外无边泳池及儿童俱乐部；餐饮有4个餐厅（含1间特色餐厅）和6间茶室，全日餐厅享180度环湖景，中餐厅主打粤、淮扬菜；宴会空间含2间无柱大宴会厅（982㎡、726㎡）、5间多功能厅及户外派对草坪。依托德胧观堂与万豪臻品之选双品牌，酒店兼具文化深度与高端服务。
description.textEn: Grand House, Jiangyin, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel takes Xu Xiake culture as its core IP, blending traditional Oriental aesthetics with modern minimalism, letting guests enjoy the cultural experience of “staying in a room, mind roaming far” during their stay. Around the hotel are rich facilities: National Geographic research, Aerospace Technology Experience Center, plus Yinzhaji Campsite, Xiake Exploration Park, combining research, camping and children’s play functions. Inside, there are 182 rooms, some with private spas, lake views or terraces; a 24-hour fitness center, lakeside outdoor infinity pool and children’s club; catering covers 4 restaurants and 6 tea houses—the all-day dining has a 180°lake view, and the Chinese restaurant focuses on Cantonese and Huaiyang cuisines. Banquet spaces include 2 column-free ballrooms, 5 multi-function halls and outdoor party lawns. Backed by Delonix Grand House and Marriott Tribute Portfolio, it integrates cultural depth and high-end service.

description.textZh: 西安蓝海风万怡酒店，作为古城西安万豪旗下万怡品牌，以其睿智活力的品牌文化，现代简约的品质设计，细致周到的人性化服务，为商务人士和城市旅行家提供舒畅的商务旅行新体验。酒店拥有各式豪华客房及套房共262间。每一间豪华客房均拥有明亮的观景落地窗，任宾客饱览城市美景。酒店开放式餐饮将为宾客提供全新美食体验，不论是将设计功能与现代艺术相互融合的酒店大堂吧，还是将国际美食与本地佳肴自如切换的万荟轩，西安蓝海风万怡酒店为商务人士和旅行家们提供一个集城市休闲与商务出行为一体的非凡场所。此外，酒店800平方米无柱式大宴会厅及六个多功能厅将全方位满足客人不同的宴会需求。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Xi'an North, making the brand’s first hotel in Xi'an, features the brand’s vibrant culture, modern design and personalized service, which provide business and leisure travelers with a truly refreshing experience. The hotel is located on 2nd Fengcheng Road, within a 25-minute drive from Xi'an Xianyang International Airport, a 15-minute drive from Xi’an North Railway Station and Xi’an Railway Station, as well as a short walking distance to the metro station. Guest rooms are modern, both in their décor and their amenities, including free Wi-Fi and a large-screen HDTV. Hotel restaurants offer a mix to match your mood with private dining, international buffets, grab-and-go fare and cocktails. Meeting and event space totals nearly 13,000 sq. ft. and includes a large, pillar-free ballroom ideal for all-day conferences.

description.textZh: 西安沣东新城万怡酒店坐落于大西安新中心的核心区域西咸新区沣东新城，也是该区域率先引进的国际品牌酒店。酒店北邻西安国际足球中心，南邻连霍高速，西侧紧依沣河沿岸，东靠西安绕城高速，从酒店出发步行3分钟可至地铁16号线，仅需5分钟车程可至西安西站，约30分钟车程可至西安咸阳国际机场，随时开启便捷的商务及休闲旅行。酒店客房以现代舒适为设计理念，配备精致卫浴和全景落地窗，提供卓越高效的入住体验。无柱式大宴会厅及多功能会议室，可满足宾客多样的会议需求。无论是以健康为核心理念的万荟轩亦或灵动空间为设计理念的大堂吧，均是悠闲聚会和商务会客的理想之地。从这里出发，在万怡品牌特有的现代、经典和舒适的环境氛围中，开启一段“燃情并进”的自在旅程。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Xi’an West is located in the west of Sci-Tech Center, new center axis of Greater Xi’an, in core area of natural and oxygen enriched ecological district. It is adjacent to International Football Center and Fenghe River Park, the only 3 minutes’ walk to Metro Station Line 16 and only 5 minutes’ arrival to Xi’an Xi Railway Station, It is about 30 minutes’ arrival to Xi’an Bei Railway Station and 35 minutes’ arrival to Xianyang international airport. Convenience access to the city’s business district and attractions. There are 291 contemporary guest rooms and suites, 1200 square-meters venue and 250 square-meters outdoor laws, 2 distinctive restaurants and 1 the lounge, 24-hours fitness center. Enjoying more and embarking on a journey of "Passion Moves us Forward" in a modern, comfortable and classic environment that is unique to the Courtyard by Marriott.

description.textZh: 西安德尔塔酒店坐落于西安城北核心商业区，紧邻地铁2号线步行仅3分钟，距高铁站路程仅15分钟，直通机场高速仅需30分钟到达机场，乘坐地铁仅需10分钟可到达市中心钟楼、回民街等，交通便利，位置优越。酒店紧邻高端商业综合体——印象城及静安荟奥特莱斯。西安德尔塔酒店秉承德尔塔品牌承诺, 专注于宾客所需的核心设施与服务, 为宾客带来轻松舒心的旅程。这间全新的酒店设有282间精心设计的客房, 可从不同视角俯瞰城北商圈的夜景, 带您领略城市之美。简约的设计中融合Delta品牌的专属配色和丰富的设计理念。优质床品以及完善的设施, 为您带来温馨舒适的旅行体验, 畅享美妙住宿时光。酒店处处展现品牌标志性的简洁美学理念, 核心设施和用品一应俱全, 包括免费Wi-Fi和便捷高效的工作空间。酒店设有24小时健身中心，焕活身体，治愈一切疲惫与喧嚣。觅·餐厅&酒吧以欧式复古风为设计特色, 将东西方饮食巧妙交融, 敞亮的开放式厨房则成为大厨们烹制诱人佳肴的舞台, 为宾客呈现甄选的丰盛新鲜食材，每日提供自助早餐。禧·中餐厅从“采珠”中获得灵感, 设计运用云朵, 海浪等纹饰, 突出餐厅主题。“以鲜为最”主打传统融合菜系, 结合本地风味, 烹制出独具特色的美食佳肴。行政酒廊拥有寓所风格厨房, 能够全天供应美食, 高雅空间及安静舒适的环境, 并配有独立的小型会议室, 为入住行政楼层的客人和尊贵级别万豪旅享家会员提供商务洽谈和聚会休闲的理想之所。
description.textEn: Delta Hotels by Marriott Xian is determined to deliver the Delta Hotels promise to offer guests a frictionless journey by laser focusing on the truly meaningful elements that guests need during their stays. The new hotel features 282 rooms and suites featuring the brands modern approach to design inspired by true craftsmanship with city views. The premium facilities including plush bedding, complimentary high-speed WiFi and a separate working spaces for a seamless and streamlined stay.

records.name_zh: 西安渭水园万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店坐落于西安大兴医院渭水园院区内，为万豪万枫品牌旗下旅居空间。品牌源起万豪家族万枫庄园，承袭庄园静谧归心、质朴好客的精神内核，以温暖如归的待客之道，延续全球统一品质标准。酒店毗邻渭河生态景观带、西安湖、紫薇湖，自然静谧、景致宜人；与医疗、康养区域零距离联动，精准适配诊疗陪护、康养休养与院内接待需求，便捷安心。酒店设149间品质客房，配套完善、细节贴心；餐厅提供均衡膳食与康养定制餐食，贴心守护家属、康养人士与医护人员。酒店覆盖免费高速WiFi，开业可享万豪旅享家会员权益，将万枫庄园的静谧温情、生态旅居的惬意与医养便捷相融，以品质与温度，为每一位宾客打造归家般的安心居停。
description.textEn: Choose Fairfield By Marriott Xi'an Weiyang, and enjoy a peaceful medical and health care time by the Weishui River; Marriott's premium quality accompanies medical living, and the ecological beauty of Weishui hides warmth. Located within Xi'an Daxing Hospital Weishui Park, it is a residential space under Fairfield by Marriott, inheriting the tranquility, peace of mind and hospitality of Marriott's Courtyard Manor and adhering to global quality standards. Adjacent to Weishui River Ecological Landscape Belt, Xi'an Lake and Ziwei Lake with pleasant scenery, it connects seamlessly with medical and health care areas, meeting the needs of medical accompanying, health care and on-campus reception. With 149 quality guest rooms, a restaurant offering balanced and customized health meals, free high-speed WiFi and Marriott Bonvoy benefits upon opening, it integrates ecological comfort and medical convenience to create a home-like stay.

description.textZh: 西安浐灞万枫酒店坐落位于西安浐灞自贸中心C座，邻近西安国际会展中心、西安奥体中心，同时有浐灞国家湿地公园、西安世博园、华夏文旅海洋公园等多个公园环伺，坐拥滨水休闲的绿色生态宜居环境。酒店地理位置优越，距离西安高铁北站仅需20分钟车程，距离西安咸阳国际机场仅需35分钟车程，地铁三号线务庄站步行可达。 酒店设计采用温暖的大地色系，运用纯粹的天然材料，彰显万枫品牌“简约之美”。184间温馨怡人的客房提供去繁就简、自在舒适的入住体验。万枫餐厅供应品类丰富、新鲜美味的健康早餐。此外，酒店还配备24小时开放的万枫小铺、自助健身房、自助洗衣房等便捷设施，所有区域都可免费使用高速WIFI，竭诚为您缔造舒适高效之旅。
description.textEn: Situated in the Xian Chanba Free Trade Center bordering the Xian International Convention and Exhibition Center and Xian Olympic Sports Center, Fairfield by Marriott Xian Chanba is conveniently located 20 minutes drive from Xian North Railway Station and 35 minutes drive from Xian Xianyang International Airport. Surrounded by imposing Chanba National Park and Xian Expo Park our hotel is an ideal destination for both leisure and business travelers. Decorated with warm color and natural materials to highlight its modern and simplistic design style it features 184 inspired guestrooms, 24 hr Fairfield Market, self service Fitness Center and Laundry Room with our friendly service and comfortable spaces. Our breakfast is always served with fresh ingredients and a variety of options to suit any taste at Fairfield Restaurant. With the complimentary high speed WiFi you can seamlessly connect business with efficiency and the city with pleasure.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious and fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

description.textZh: 2019年 ，万枫品牌完成了全球超1000家酒店的里程碑式的发展。万枫品牌秉承万豪独有的传统理念 ， 旨在为客人打造一个轻松惬意的入住体验 ，为所有贵宾提供亲切友好 ， 熟悉温馨的周到服务。我们相信友善熟悉的氛围和服务 ，能为宾客带来舒心安全的入住体验 ， 当客人走进酒店大堂 ， 迎接他的是热情友好的员工 ， 以及 温 暖、惬意的氛围。入住万枫的客人可以保持他们的工作及生活习惯 ， 在享受优质睡眠 ， 健康饮食的同时 ， 更可展开卓越高效的商务工作。 这是万枫的承诺 ， 一如预期 ， 简约舒适。酒店隶属万豪(Marriott)国际集团旗下品牌-万枫酒店。自1987年成立以来，以流畅、可靠和乐观的核心价值观为宾客提供热情细致的服务体验，为追求生活平衡保持节拍的商旅人士提供物有所值的全面贴心照顾，让宾客安心自在，保持高效活动。酒店位于曲江新区核心地带，坐拥商圈，方便宾客前往各大公司企业以及自然和文化景点，地理位置十分优越，是商务旅行和休闲旅行的非凡之选。酒店拥有115间简约而温馨的客房及套房，去繁就简，让宾客感到轻松自在，宾至如归。
description.textEn: The hotel is set to open its doors in 2024. Surrounding the hotel, a harmonious blend of natural and cultural landscapes unfolds like a captivating tapestry. On one hand, there are picturesque natural scenic spots, where rolling hills, crystal-clear lakes, and lush forests create a serene and enchanting atmosphere that soothes the soul. On the other hand, there are profound cultural sites brimming with historical significance. These places are like living museums, bearing witness to the passage of time and the rich heritage of the region.For guests staying at the hotel, convenience is at their fingertips. With just a leisurely stroll, they can easily reach the Subway Line 8 station in a short while. This seamless connectivity allows them to effortlessly explore the vibrant city, whether it's for business or leisure, making their stay truly enjoyable and hassle-free. The hotel has 115 simple and warm rooms and suites, to make guests feel relaxed and at home.
