description.textZh: 酒店位于西安市中心旅游区，周边有钟楼、鼓楼以及回民街美食街等景点。酒店拥有 214 间豪华客房，能让客人欣赏到西安标志性景观、古老街区以及城市风光的全景。我们的“精选啤酒”计划（提供现场供应当地特色精酿啤酒）——我们所做的一切都体现了我们对卓越设计的尊重以及对当地文化的认同。从美味的早餐开始你的每一天，享受独特的当地美食体验，晚上在轻松的现代餐饮环境中放松身心，而且酒店内提供免费无线网络覆盖，让客人在高效工作的同时还能保持社交联系。此外，在舒适的住宿体验中，锻炼活动不仅限于健身房。酒店的设计旨在为商务客人和家庭旅行者提供所有放松和休闲所需的基本设施。
description.textEn: This hotel is located in the main tourist area of Xi'an, such as the Bell Tower, Drum Tower and the Muslim Street food street. The hotel has 214 luxurious guest rooms, allowing guests to enjoy panoramic views of Xi'an's iconic landscapes, ancient neighborhoods and the city's scenery.Our "Selected Beers" program (offering on-site supply of local specialty craft beers) - everything we do reflects our respect for excellent design and our identification with local culture. Start your day with a delicious breakfast, enjoy a unique local food experience, have a relaxing modern dining option in the evening, and enjoy free Wi-Fi coverage throughout the hotel, allowing guests to maintain social connections while working efficiently. Additionally, in the Four Points accommodation experience, exercise activities are not limited to the gym. The design of Four Points hotels is intended to provide all the basic facilities needed for relaxation and leisure for business guests and families traveling

The surrounding facilities are complete, there are many attractions nearby, the transportation is convenient, and the geographical location is excellent. In the future, it will become a new landmark in Xi'an, Yanta District! description.textZh: 西安高新区福朋喜来登酒店设有203间客房，1个全日制餐厅和1个大堂吧与4个中餐包间，拥有灵活的会议空间，并配备健身房等休闲设施。致力于让宾客放松身心，同时通过品牌标志性的“醇饮优选”计划畅享富有当地特色的精酿啤酒。酒店拥有203间面积从40平米-76平米不同规格的豪华客房和套房。经典设计与潮流时尚相得益彰。房间配备全景 落地窗，有广阔的视野和充足的自然采光，同时免费无线网络及精心挑选的客房设施确保宾客尽享舒适与惬意。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beerson taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Deliciousbreakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifithroughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Pointsworkouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personaltraining and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler inmind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: At JW Marriott® Hotels, we create elegantly curated experiences, stripping away the unnecessary to reveal the exceptional.Experience our passion for personal service, settings of timeless sophistication, gracious dining and a welcoming unpretentiousness.
description.textEn: Blending the ancient beauty of Chang’an with the sophistication of the JW Marriott brand, JW Marriott Hotel Xi’an is dedicated to providing guests a distinctive travel experience with the intriguing Xi’an history. The hotel is located in the CBD area of Xi’an Economic and Technological Development Zone, adjacent to the administrative center of the city, with direct access to the Wenjing Road Subway Line 4. The modernistic design of the hotel reflects the contemporary character of this world-famous city and the refinement of the local culture. Standing in the hotel lobby on the 38th floor or in any of the 333 guestrooms, you will be presented with a large panoramic mesmerizing portray of the city view and feel the extraordinary energy of Chang’an city.

records.name_zh: 西安高新 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: Incorporating the beauty of the ancient city of Xi'an with sophistication and warmth, the hotel offers an immersive experience and a commitment to holistic well-being.
description.textEn: Uniquely located in the heart of the Xian business district with views of vibrant skyscrapers and the Tang Dynasty Wall Site Park, our hotel offers an immersive experience inspired by our surroundings that are full of historical stories. This blend of traditional elements with modern luxury creates a one-of-a-kind nurturing environment for our guests to find the balance between spirit, body and soul.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻西安浐灞艾美酒店，解锁超凡机遇。酒店地理位置便利，紧邻西安市生态区内的河流，对寻求真正非凡体验的好奇宾客而言，这里可谓理想之选。从鼓楼广场到大雁塔和西安城墙，西安众多值得一游的景点都可轻松到达。酒店设施齐全，包括室内泳池、健身中心和儿童娱乐中心。舒适的客房和套房配备免费Wifi、豪华睡床和精美卫浴用品，并提供客房送餐服务，还可躺在浴缸内欣赏河景。下榻期间，可在酒店三间餐厅享用中餐、火锅和其他全球特色美食。活动场地陈设优雅，光线充足，还提供坐拥秀美河景的室外草坪，令在中国举办活动的宾客惊喜连连。无论您是商务还是休闲旅客，西安浐灞艾美酒店都能满足您的各种需求，为您缔造非凡住宿体验。
description.textEn: Unlock the opportunities that await you at Le Méridien Xi’an Chanba. Conveniently located next to the river in the city's ecological district, our hotel is the ideal choice for curious guests seeking a truly unique experience. Many of Xi'an's noteworthy points of interest are within reach - from Drum Tower Square to Big Wild Goose Pagoda and Xi'an City Wall. Enjoy the many amenities our hotel offers, including an indoor pool, a fitness center and a children’s play center. Comfortable guest rooms and suites feature complimentary Wi-Fi, ultra-plush bedding, premium bath amenities and room service - as well as river views from the bathtub. Sample Chinese, Hot Pot and other global specialties at one of our three restaurants during your stay. Guests who host an event here will be thrilled with our gracefully appointed, light-filled venues and an outdoor lawn boasting scenic river vistas. Whether traveling for business or leisure, Le Méridien Xi'an, Chanba has everything you need to make your stay perfect.

records.name_en: The Fairway Place, Xi'an - Marriott Executive Apartments

description.textZh: 西安万豪行政公寓坐落于西安古都核心地段，巧妙融合家庭出游的温馨与商务出行的高效，为追求品质的旅客提供理想下榻之选。公寓地理位置优越，步行可达地铁3号线及8号线（环）线延平门站，轻松抵达大雁塔、钟楼等著名景点或重要产业园及各大办公驻地。周边大型购物中心与传统文化街区并存，让家庭观光与商务活动完美衔接。公寓提供从开放式豪华间至三居室套房等多种房型，每间均配有设施齐全的厨房、生活区及洗衣烘干设备。宽敞空间让全家入住从容自在，商务人士亦可享安静办公环境。此外，24小时健身房、会议室，双宜设施，为宾客提供多元的休闲与商务洽谈选择，而位于公寓1层的悦餐厅则是享用美食、给清晨加满活力的好去处。西安万豪行政公寓以“You don't stay here, you live here”为理念，无论是长住还是短憩，致力于让每一位宾客在奔波中尽享家的温馨与从容。
description.textEn: Located in the heart of the ancient city of Xi’an, Executive Apartments the Fairway Place-Xi'an seamlessly blends the warmth of a family-friendly retreat with the efficiency required for business travel, offering an ideal choice for discerning guests. The apartments boast a prime location within walking distance of Yanpingmen Station on Metro Lines 3 and 8 (Loop Line), providing convenient access to iconic landmarks such as the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda and the Bell Tower, as well as key industrial parks and major office complexes. The surrounding area harmoniously combines large shopping malls with traditional cultural blocks, making it easy to balance family sightseeing with business commitments.A variety of room types are available, from deluxe studios to three-bedroom suites, each featuring a fully equipped kitchen, a separate living area, and a washer-dryer. The spacious layouts ensure a comfortable stay for families while offering business travelers a quiet and productive environment.

description.textZh: At Marriott Hotels®, we thoughtfully consider each detail so you can feel at home as you explore the world. We invite you to unwind in sophisticated spaces thoughtfully designed to make you feel at home®.
description.textEn: In the vibrant heart of Xi’an’s Hi-tech CBD, where innovation meets heritage, a journey of seamless connection begins. Thoughtfully woven into the city’s transport network—with metro, sky shuttle, airport express, and ring highways—the hotel redefines efficient travel. From Xi’an Xianyang International Airport, arrive with ease in just 40 minutes. From here, the city’s bustling commercial districts are within a swift 15-minute reach.Every detail, every gesture, is guided by our heartfelt service philosophy—so you can focus on what matters most and embrace every enriching experience.

description.textEn: Moxy Xi'an Downtown is located in the cultural block of Xi'an Yisu Theatre Cultural District at the intersection of Beida jie Street and Dongda jie Street (near entrance D of line 6 and line 2).lt only takes 100 meters to reach the Bell Tower. The geographical location is very convenient and is locatedin the core of Xi'an city. Rooted in the local culture of the ancientcapital Xi'an, the hotel effectively integrates the design concept of Moxy tide brand with the elements of Qin Opera and the location landmarks such as the Bell Tower and city wall.There are 84 guestrooms with restaurants, bars and small entertainment facilities.

description.textZh: 西安这座古城的悠久历史可追溯到约 3,100 年前，在这里，您有机会透过现代视野，近距离体验中华文化发源地的璀璨光辉。西安五星级商务酒店 - 万丽酒店是社会发现者的真正目的地，既迎合了思维超前旅行者的偏好，又蕴藏着昔日辉煌的足迹。住宿环境现代时尚，功能齐全，中国元素的装饰设计和各种便利设施充分满足商务宾客的需求。餐厅采用了富有创意的现代装饰风格，主打粤菜、川菜、西安菜和新疆菜等中国知名菜系，着力为您提供丰富多彩的用餐体验。其他五星级酒店礼遇包括，提供现场娱乐演出和特色鸡尾酒的全天候 R 酒吧、室内泳池以及行政楼层酒廊。酒店拥有设施先进的会议和活动场地，热情周到的服务传统让您的活动变得分外出彩。酒店位于曲江，毗邻国际会议中心，距离地标秦始皇兵马俑景区约 30 分钟路程。
description.textEn: With a history dating back 3,100 years, the ancient city of Xi'an offers the opportunity to experience the birthplace of Chinese culture through a modern lens. Renaissance Xi'an Hotel is an authentic destination for Social Discoverers, addressing the needs and tastes of forward-thinking travelers while shining a light on the past. Accommodations are fashionable and functional, with touches of Chinese-inspired decor and amenities that cater to business travelers. Restaurants feature creative, contemporary decor with menus focused on some of China's noteworthy cuisines, including Cantonese, Sichuan, Xi'an and Xinjiang. Other perks include the day-to-night R Bar, with its live entertainment and specialty cocktails, an indoor swimming pool and a Club Floor lounge. State-of-the-art meeting and event venues are supported by a tradition of warm, attentive service. And our Qujiang hotel location places guests adjacent to the International Conference Center and within 30 minutes of the iconic Terracotta Army.

description.textZh: 西安浐灞喜来登酒店坐落于浐灞自贸中心C座，我们优越的地理位置让您能够轻松前往西安国际会展中心、华夏文化旅游海洋公园、西安砂之船奥特莱斯，秦始皇兵马俑及华清宫等地并且仅需步行即可到达地铁3号线。酒店设计融合了喜来登品牌焕新理念与盛唐长安文化元素。228间时尚舒适的客房为您提供温润典雅的居家之感。在我们的&More by Sheraton大堂吧、食光全日餐厅、面肆特色餐厅、悦厨中餐厅和秘境酒吧尽情享用精致丰盛的珍馐美馔。逾1730平米的活动空间包括一个1018平米无柱式大宴会厅和4间多功能会议室，均配备前沿设备和高速Wi-Fi，是举办商务宴会、浪漫婚礼和社交聚会的理想场所。您还可以在酒店顶层的喜来登健身中心和游泳池畅快锻炼，放松身心，一览城市美景。
description.textEn: Situated in Block C of Xi'an Chanba Free Trade Center, Sheraton Xi'an Chanba's prime location gives you easy access to Xi'an International Convention and Exhibition Center, Huaxia Cultural Tourism Ocean Park, SASSEUR (Xi’an) Outlets,Terracotta Warriors and convenient transportation to Metro Line 3. Our hotel features Sheraton's new brand vision with the cultural elements of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty. 228 stylish and comfortable rooms provide you with a warm and elegant feeling of home. Dining at our &More by Sheraton lobby bar, Daily Social all day Restaurant, SooNoodles, YUE Chinese Restaurant and UNSPOKEN Bar to celebrate healthful and flavorful abundance. Over 1730㎡event space includes a 1018 ㎡pillar-less grand ballroom and 4 multi-functional meeting rooms, all equipped with cutting-edge equipment and high-speed Wi-Fi, ideal for business banquets, romantic weddings and social gatherings. You can also rejuvenate and relax in Sheraton Fitness and Swimming Pool on the top floor with magnificent city view.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻西安喜来登大酒店，亲身体验十三朝古都的悠久历史。这家备受认可的酒店位于中国陕西省，邻近西安热门的高科技产业开发区，是各类旅客的理想目的地。轻松前往附近企业参加会议，或探索当地的丰富文化，附近有名的景点包括城墙和书院门古街。酒店设施豪华，包括现代化健身房、室内恒温泳池、宁静的水疗中心和美味的酒店内餐厅。晚上，返回优雅的客房，享受豪华特色床上用品，欣赏广阔的城市景观。如果您是出于活动策划原因下榻我们的酒店，我们才华横溢的策划者将为您提供帮助，确保您的家庭聚会、贵宾商务会议或大型会议取得圆满成功。西安喜来登大酒店为您提供诚挚周到的服务，欢迎莅临下榻。
description.textEn: Immerse yourself in the history of 13 Chinese dynasties from our Sheraton Xi'an Hotel. Located in Shaanxi Province of China near Xi'an's popular Hi-Tech Industries Development Zone, our 5-star hotel offers an ideal destination for all types of travelers. Easily attend meetings at nearby corporations or explore our culturally-rich area near notable attractions, including the City Wall and Shu Yuan Men Ancient Street. Or, take advantage of our hotel's deluxe amenities, including a modern gym, a heated indoor pool, a tranquil spa and delicious onsite restaurants. In the evening, retreat to elegant guest rooms with plush signature bedding and expansive city views. If visiting our impressive hotel for event planning reasons, our talented planners are here to help ensure that your next family reunion, VIP business meeting or a large-scale convention is a perfect success. We look forward to welcoming you with attentive service at Sheraton Xi'an Hotel.

records.name_zh: 西安赛瑞喜来登大酒店

description.textZh: 西安赛瑞喜来登大酒店（城北），位于西安市未央路迎宾大道32号，地铁2号线龙首原站近在咫尺，乘地铁仅约20分钟至高铁北客站。约5分钟可步行至大明宫国家遗址公园。酒店毗邻西安城北经济技术开发区，距西安咸阳国际机场仅约40分钟车程，乘坐地铁可轻松抵达钟楼、回民街等城市热门景点。酒店拥有487间别具魅力的客房和套房，包括27间服务式复式公寓；3个风格各异的风味餐厅及时尚酒廊将满足客人不同的口味和环境需求；近1800平方米的宴会厅包括一个626平方米的麟德大宴会厅，10个会议室及独立的会议接待区域，可轻松容纳1200人；拥有室内恒温游泳池、健身中心以及炫逸水疗。完善别具一格的客房设施及高品质的服务水平，无论是休闲度假或是商务旅行，这里都将成为你的倾心之选。
description.textEn: Sheraton Xi’an North City Hotel, the second Sheraton and modern upscale hotel in this ancient city of China, is located in downtown district, near the municipal administrative region. Our 5-star hotel is within 17 minutes to the main railway station, 20 minutes to the North Station by subway, 40 minutes to the airport, 20 minutes to downtown and walking distance to the beloved Daming Palace National Heritage Park. Our stylish Xi'an hotel features 487 comfortably-appointed guest rooms and suites, three restaurants, bars and lounge, 1,800 square meters of flexible meeting and function space, a indoor heated swimming pool and a fitness center. We make our guests feel comfortable and relaxed during their stay at our 5-star hotel in Xi'an, China. Sheraton Xi'an North City Hotel is a destination for those seeking relaxing days, colorful nights and exciting business opportunities. At Sheraton, we believe life is better when it's shared.

records.name_zh: 西安高新区喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 西安高新区喜来登酒店位于陕西省西安市高新区软件园核心地带。酒店拥有321间时尚现代的客房，设有2间餐厅、咖啡吧、特色酒廊、带泳池的健身中心和面积约1208平方米的灵活宴会和会议空间。西安高新区喜来登酒店别具新的喜来登品牌特色风情，旨在打造一处让宾客可以舒心自在办公、聚会或放松的环境。
description.textEn: Sheraton Xi’an South is located at the core area of software park in Hi-tech zone, Xian city, Shaanxi province. Features with 321 stylish guestrooms, two restaurants, a Coffe Bar and a distinctive Bar, fitness center with swimming pool and over 1,208 square meters of flexible spaces for banquets and conferences. Sheraton Xian South boasts Sheraton’s new signature key elements that aim to create an environment where guests can feel comfortable and at ease, whether working, meeting or relaxing.

description.textZh: The Ritz-Carlton, Xi’an is the ideal base for experiencing this vibrant, ancient capital. Merging traditional elements with modern luxury, the hotel offers a collection of amenities that appeals to every type of traveler.
description.textEn: Home to 13 imperial Chinese dynasties, Xian today is a mix of eras and influences, where the UNESCO World Heritage-protected Terracotta Army lives among a thriving tech culture. Honoring both sides of the city is The Ritz-Carlton, Xian, set within the central business district. Contemporary accommodations offer city views. Dining includes three restaurants and a rooftop bar. And 31,000 sq. ft. of meeting space can host meetings and celebrations.

description.textZh: 西安W酒店以现代设计视角诠释古都新韵，约10万平方米体量成为城市时尚地标。从盛唐文化中提炼灵感，通过先锋艺术手法与西安历史文脉交织，营造充满张力的沉浸式体验。372间客房及套房位于酒店5至26层。细节处皆融合当代美学与长安古韵。大胆的色彩碰撞与定制艺术品编织出充满想象力的旅居叙事。三处独具个性的餐厅与酒吧：全味餐厅、飨艳中餐厅及WOOBAR酒吧，从环球美馔到夜幕降临时分的创意调酒，打造兼具私密性与社交感的味觉之旅。2,330平方米风华厅，1,128平方米风尚厅以及不同规格的会议室，无论是商务活动、品牌发布或婚宴庆典，皆可在此实现精准而富有格调的呈现。AWAY®水疗以五感疗愈重塑身心平衡，WET®碧波泳池化身都市绿洲。配备高端器材的FIT有型健身中心与WIRED商务空间，打造潮奢生活方式。
description.textEn: Rising from the edge of the storied Qujiangchi Lake, W Xi’an dares to disrupt the ancient rhythm of the city with a fresh beat of style, energy, and indulgence. Spanning over 100,000 square meters and crowned with a soaring 17-meter-high Living Room, this is where the unexpected comes to play.With 372 stylish guestrooms and suites from the 5th to 26th floor, every room features a spacious private balcony — your personal perch to soak in panoramic views.Fuel your cravings at three dining destinations —— WEI, YEN Chinese Restaurant and WOOBAR®, each serving up bold flavors and vibrant vibes. Then, take the plunge in the indoor/outdoor WET®, push limits at FIT, and surrender to the scene-stealing AWAY® Spa for that glow-up moment.Craving a show-stopping backdrop? From lavish weddings to next-level launches, our Great Room, Mega Room, Studios, and Strategy spaces are anything but business as usual.W Xi’an: live it up lakeside, and let the city’s pulse match yours.

description.textZh: 西安威斯汀大酒店是位于城市核心处的都市休憩之所，为您打造一处精致优雅的休闲秘境。酒店坐落于大唐不夜城内，与拥有约1,300年历史的大雁塔隔街相望，在这座十三朝古都，为您打造一场豪华度假之旅。酒店客房采用大唐风格设计，空间开阔，格调雅致。我们悉心关注您居停体验的每一处核心细节，确保您每一次到访，都能尽享舒适休憩、美味珍馐与贴心呵护。温馨客房和创意餐饮选择，为您打造自在随心的居停体验。下沉花园中的银杏树亭亭如盖，为您打造远离都市喧嚣的静谧休憩天地。欢迎莅临酒店内设的中国艺术博物馆，馆内珍藏2,000余件珍贵文物，邀您沉浸艺术盛宴。
description.textEn: Discover a sanctuary of refinement at The Westin Xi’an, an urban retreat in the heart of the city. Situated directly opposite the 1,300-year-old Giant Wild Goose Pagoda within the Grand Tang Ever-Bright City, the hotel offers luxury getaway experience in the capital of 13 dynasties in China.The hotel features spacious and stylish rooms in grand Tang dynasty design. Careful attention is paid to the most important elements of your stay to ensure each visit leaves you exceptionally well rested, nourished and cared for. Inviting guest rooms and innovative dining options let you create your own experience. Find tranquility in the Sunken Garden, where Feng-Shui-inspired Ginkgo trees offer a serene escape from the modern bustle. You are invited to explore the on-site Chinese fine arts museum, which houses an extraordinary collection of over 2,000 artifacts.

description.textZh: Stay & play in style at Aloft Xiamen Xiang'an. Socially connect in our vibrant open space over cocktails and music. Step out for more entertainment at Capital Outlets Mall or Minlan City Plaza -all with the backdrop of the Huandong Romantic Coast.
description.textEn: Designed for music enthusiasts and producers, this vibrant destination invites you to connect over cocktails and live beats in our energetic open social spaces. Unwind with complimentary WiFi and cutting-edge tech while soaking in the creative atmosphere. Our collection of 334 urban-inspired sea-view rooms and suites sets the stage for unforgettable moments—whether gathering with friends, hosting business associates, or enjoying family escapes.Fuel your rhythm at our DEPOT all-day dining restaurant, then craft the night away at the w xyz™ Bar. Both venues transform ordinary meetups into extraordinary experiences.Experience your passion amplified at Aloft Xiamen Xiang'an - where every stay harmonizes inspiration, connection, and coastal energy.

description.textZh: A modern hotel with ocean views, Courtyard Xiamen offers modern guest rooms and suites. All-day dining, lounge, private dining rooms. Fitness center, pool, spa. Meeting and event space totals 11,754 sq. ft. Three miles from Gao Qi International Airport.
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Xiamen is located on the northern coastline of the airport in Xiamen Island. As a selected brand under Marriott, it is characterized by comfort, convenience, and practicality. The hotel is built by the sea and only a 10 minute drive from Xiamen Gaoqi International Airport .The hotel combines modern and stylish minimalist design with a warm and comfortable accommodation experience. The deluxe rooms are 45-49 square meters, the suites are 76-81 square meters. 65% of the rooms have sea views, and in the sea view rooms, guests can see a 180-degree unobstructed view of the sea, truly allowing guests to experience the surprise of seeing the sea when opening the door. The hotel is decorated mainly in gray tones, with clever space design, creating a tranquil and comfortable atmosphere that is suitable for both work and leisure.

description.textZh: Discover city center from Courtyard Xiamen Haicang. Directly attached to Marriott Hotel Haicang, we boast roomy ocean-view accommodation, a range of great dining options, a stylish lounge and 17,000 square feet of adaptable venue space.
description.textEn: No matter your reason for visiting China, Courtyard Xiamen Haicang sets the stage for a memorable experience. Featuring a brand-new, state-of-the-art lobby and intuitive design, our hotel offers many creative spaces for working or relaxing. Unwind in your spacious, modern lodging, which provides helpful amenities like complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi access, a flat-screen TV, plush bedding, a mini-fridge and a well-lit workspace. In addition, most hotel rooms boast magnificent views of Xiamen city center and Haicang Bay. Keep in shape at our 24-hour fitness center, take a swim in our ocean-view infinity pool, sample the flavors of China at our terrific hotel restaurants or reconnect with friends, family or colleagues at our sophisticated lounge. Connected to Marriott Hotel Haicang, we're a superb choice for a business event here in Xiamen, China. Enjoy 17,000 square feet of venue space, a ballroom and on-site planning and catering. Courtyard Xiamen Haicang is committed to delivering an exceptional hotel stay.

description.textZh: Whether for business or coastal escape, Courtyard by Marriott® Xiamen Xiang’an delivers success: sea-view rooms with smart comforts; vibrant breakfast spreads at Substance; and steps to the metro, expo center, olympic sports center and sandy beaches.
description.textEn: At Courtyard by Marriott Xiamen Xiang'an, work and rest blend seamlessly. Our 308 sea-view guest rooms, equipped with plush bedding, flexible workspaces, and Wi-Fi, cater to both productivity and relaxation. Dynamic guest rooms connect effortlessly with collaborative public areas, ensuring a smooth transition between tasks and downtime.Take a break at The Lounge for classic cocktails, or savor seasonal dishes at Substance. Whether you're catching up with colleagues or friends, you can choose to dine in or take your meal to go. When it’s time to recharge, our outdoor swimming pool offers a tranquil escape, while the fitness center helps you stay active. We know your stay here is more than just a trip—it’s an experience that propels you forward. Every corner of our hotel is designed to support your dynamic lifestyle, enabling you to be your best self.

description.textZh: 欢迎来到位于厦门滨海旅游浪漫线的厦门同安源宿酒店，尽享滨海旖旎风光，步行可达阳光小镇商业购物中心，紧邻BRT（快速公交）东亭站，距离厦门北站、高崎机场约12公里，距离集美学村、陈嘉庚纪念胜地约6.8公里，可便捷到达各大交通枢纽及旅游景点。漫步滨海彩虹跑道，赏绵延数十公里的壮美海岸线愉悦身心；探访集美学村，观闽南风情建筑，感受人文气息浓厚的钟灵毓秀之地；更有闽南古早美味让你大快朵颐。在这里，恣享欢乐时光。厦门同安源宿酒店拥有140间客房，房间内设有特色天梦之床、配备能源之星电器的厨房以及内设雨淋花洒与天然沐浴用品的水疗浴室，让你以活力满满的状态迎接每一天。灵活多变的人性化办公区配有超大办公桌、人体工学座椅以及便捷的电源与数据连接装置，可供你轻松处理商务事宜。此外，你还可观看86英寸纯平宽屏高清电视播放的节目，悠度惬意时光。源宿客房拥有超大空间和充足的自然光线，采用简约的设计风格，营造出活力四射的开放式环境。我们的客房不仅仅是供你进行思考、工作或社交的场所，更是您专享的自我生活空间。
description.textEn: Inspired by Westin® Hotels & Resorts, Element Hotels encourages a sense of wellbeing through a nature-influenced environment. Intuitively constructed with an efficient use of space, and with a focus on sustainability, Element helps you stay connected, feel alive and balanced while you're away. Reflecting the smart design of urban residences, the flowing layouts of our guest rooms were created to maximize space and enable you to use the room in multiple ways. Wake up to our signature Rise complimentary breakfast, guests start the morning off right with healthful options including a hot item, fresh granola, whole fruits, premium coffee and more.

description.textZh: 厦门艾美酒店位于城市中山林公园内，坐落于广阔空间和葱郁植被间，为您打造都市便利和绿意避世的平衡休憩之所。酒店位于湖里区仙岳公园的迷人山坡之上，距厦门国际机场8.6公里以及国际邮轮码头（游客前往鼓浪屿）仅3.7公里，交通便利。酒店比邻海上世界（3.3公里）、屿见闽南（4公里）、东渡山海健康步道（3.8公里），轻松潮玩厦门地标。周末及节假日酒店还提供穿梭巴士服务，送宾客前往中山路、邮轮码头、海上世界等地。酒店四周环绕着茂密的山林及壮观优美的自然景观。在这里您可以回归自然，小憩休闲。在酒店旁的迷人山坡之上，精致典雅的双层别墅将为您带来舒适住宿。345间别致高雅的客房与套房包括13间各类别墅套房，一间一景一阳台，所有的房间都有面向山景或庭景的开放私人阳台。超过2000平方米的宴会及会议场地包含了大宴会厅在内的10个不同的会议室，850平方米的自然采光无立柱大宴会室顶高10米给您足够的空间和高度释放思想。酒店有各式餐厅及酒吧共三间，带您领略及发现非同凡响的各国佳肴。全日制新食谱西餐厅提供早餐、午餐、晚餐和小点，充满动感的现场烹饪台为您提供各国风情美食。时尚气派的中餐厅为您提供原汁原味的粤式精品，12间单独包房让您的用餐更具舒适性。北纬 24 大堂酒吧位于酒店正中央，充满浪漫情调，可在此尽享精致酒品和各式小点。厦门艾美酒店先进的设施设备还包括了艺术感十足的健身房，配备专业健身器械，室内温水游泳池，温水智能按摩池，水疗康体会所，户外儿童乐园，围绕着仙岳公园的慢跑及步道。厦门艾美酒店邀请您来探索！
description.textEn: Surrounded by open spaces and lush manicured gardens and walkways, the low-rise hotel is nestled on the slope of Xianyue Hill. 8.6km from the airport and 3.7km from international cruise center. The hotel commands breathtaking views of the city skyline and the natural lush greenery. The hotel offers a wide range of recreational and culinary delights that include a heated indoor pool, steam/sauna, Gym Spa, outdoor kid playground and scenic jogging trails. Food and beverage selections include an International All-Day Dining and Le Mei, a Chinese restaurant serving Cantonese and regional favorites, Latitude 24 offers a vibrant venue to relax during the day and selections of international wines and cocktails. All guest rooms offer private balconies overlooking the Garden Courtyard or hillsides complemented by exclusive semi-detached villas adjacent to the hotel, villa rooms and suites are split level and with private patios and gardens offering extra privacy and space.

records.name_zh: 厦门万豪酒店及会议中心

description.textZh: 酒店位于福建省，从本土文化传统中汲取灵感，集当地丰厚悠远的茶文化、优雅的白鹭和自然美景等元素于一身。厦门万豪酒店及会议中心坐落于中国福建同安湾，内有众多卓越设施，提供非比寻常的服务，堪称商务休闲两相宜的上佳之选。住宿环境典雅精美，设有阳台，可饱览海景；住宿多样，可选择带有私人泳池和草坪的别墅。酒店餐厅采用周到入微的精致设计，内含私人餐饮空间，更有主厨为客人精心料理的地区菜肴、日式佳肴和国际美食。酒店拥有 4,000 平米左右精致优雅的活动空间，包括宴会厅和贵宾室。度假酒店设施包括健身中心、四个室内外泳池、水疗中心、网球场和保龄球馆。酒店还设有儿童俱乐部，提供众多活动，携带儿童出行的客人可在此尽享欢乐。搭乘附近的高铁和快速公交，轻松开启厦门探索之旅。酒店位于中国厦门，不论您为何而来，我们都期待为您缔造弥久难忘的非凡住宿体验。
description.textEn: Our hotel in Fujian province draws inspiration from its locale, incorporating elements of the area’s rich tea culture, elegant egrets and natural beauty. Xiamen Marriott Hotel & Conference Centre, set along Tong’an Bay in Fujian, China offers amenities that appeal to business and leisure travelers. Accommodations feature balconies and ocean views and include villas with private pools and lawns. Our hotel restaurants highlight regional, Japanese and international cuisines with an emphasis on private dining and thoughtful design. Our 4,000 square meters of sophisticated event space includes ballrooms and a VIP room. Resort amenities include a fitness center, four swimming pools. Families feel at home with the Kid’s Club, a cheerful space with special activities. Explore Xiamen easily via the nearby high-speed railway and Bus Rapid Transit. No matter what brings you here, we look forward to making your stay at our hotel in Xiamen, China truly memorable.

description.textZh: 在厦门泰地万豪酒店，我们的宗旨是让您的每一次商务旅行都轻松愉快，让您的每一次度假都终生难忘。无论因工作或娱乐来此，均可在本酒店获得您所需要的设施及服务，畅享舒适的高质量住宿体验。酒店地理位置优越，地处海沧区中央商务区，位于风景如画的海沧大道沿线，可一览海沧湾和鼓浪屿的优美全景。设施齐全的宽敞客房内均配有平面电视、办公桌和私人浴室齐全设施，更提供免费Wi-Fi，令您大获裨益。酒店内还提供多种餐饮选择，包括每日提供的欧式早餐、自助早餐以及各种当地美味佳肴。在闲暇时间，不妨利用酒店提供的各种设施休闲放松一番，例如健身中心和室内泳池。厦门泰地万豪酒店热诚期待您的光临。
description.textEn: At Xiamen Marriott Hotel Haicang its our mission to make every business visit a pleasure and every vacation the trip of a lifetime. Whether you are in China for work or play, you’ll find that our hotel has what you need to facilitate a comfortable and high-quality stay. We are strategically located in the CBD area of Haicang District, along the picturesque promenade of Haicang Avenue, with spectacular views of Haicang Bay and Gulangyu Island. Take advantage of our spacious and amenity-filled guest rooms; each is equipped with a flat-screen TV, a desk, a private bathroom and complimentary WiFi access. We also feature several on-site dining options, including our daily continental and buffet-style breakfasts, which serves up a taste of tantalizing cuisine. In your down time, you can explore the many facilities our hotel offers, including a fitness center and an indoor pool. We look forward to your visit at Xiamen Marriott Hotel Haicang.

description.textZh: 厦门万丽酒店毗邻厦门环东海域西海岸，坐拥优美迷人的海景、细腻柔软的白色沙滩。酒店的设计充分体现了厦门传统渔村文化的历史渊源。酒店将现代感和亲切感呈现在设计结构之中，并与当地自然环境融为一体。酒店拥有包括7栋豪华别墅在内的207间客房，所有客房均拥有宽敞私人阳台，可以远眺迷人的海景或直接步入环礁泳池。三间餐厅和一个酒吧，为宾客提供创新而丰富的用餐选择，满足宾客的味蕾享受。酒店同时配备会议活动空间和设施，其中包括两间面积分别为810平方米及360平方米的无柱式宴会厅，以及七个多功能会议室。酒店外绵延细软的白沙滩及绿意盎然的草坪，为宾客打造心仪的浪漫婚礼。不仅如此，酒店拥有五个不同主题的室外游池，一个室内恒温游池以及特别设计的儿童乐园，为宾客打造出活力惬意的亲水度假方式，更为亲子出行增添欢乐时光。
description.textEn: Overlooking Tongan Bay and set along the Huandong West coastline, the Renaissance Xiamen Hotel honors the local fishing heritage through striking design. Sail-inspired installations, colors and patterns that borrow from the ocean and a playful interaction of light and shadow are reflections of the true source of beauty: the sea itself. The water can be admired from nearly every space in the hotel. Accommodations offer views from private balconies and bathtubs; floor-to-ceiling windows capture diners’ attention at R Bar while Waterfront restaurant places guests right on the shore; and the fitness center inspires guest to push themselves harder with the promise of a refreshing dip in full view. The sea is not the only place for respite: there are six swimming pools including five outdoors with distinct themes. Shopping and a cinema are also nearby. The colorful seafront setting lends itself to weddings and events and the hotel offers nine beautifully designed venues including two pillar-free ballrooms.

records.name_zh: 厦门集美喜来登大酒店

description.textZh: 厦门集美喜来登大酒店坐落于集美CAZ中央活力区，毗邻海上自行车道，有“城市绿肺”美誉的杏林环湾绿道，是宾客探索集美人文风景的门户。酒店距厦门高崎国际机场或厦门北站约15分钟车程，距集美学村、厦门园林博览苑等景点约10分钟车程。酒店拥有370间设计精雅的客房和套房，临湖而居，可一览集美湾畔景观或城市景观。采用焕新设计的&More by Sheraton咖啡吧，食光全日餐厅，悦厨中餐厅、秘境酒吧，以及超过4,500平方米活动空间包括1,700平方米无柱大宴会厅，是庆祝生活中大小喜事的理想之选。
description.textEn: Sheraton Grand Xiamen Jimei is nestled in a residential community and commercial center with stunning parks by the bay and a marine bicycle lane, is your gateway exploring Jimei heritage and attractions. It’s about 15 minutes’ drive from Xiamen Gaoqi International Airport and Xiamen North Railway station, and 10 minutes from Jimei School Village, Tan Kah Kee Memorial Museum and Horticulture Expo Garden. The hotel features 370 exquisitely designed guest rooms and suites with broad views, overlooking either the landscape of Jimei Bay or the cityscape. All guest rooms are equipped with facilities to help guests work conveniently and efficiently. The hotel boasts over 4,500 square meters of event space, including a grand ballroom of 1,700 square meters that can accommodate up to 1,600 people, a 600 square meters ballroom, an 840 square meters sky garden, 8 functional meeting room on the second floor to bring guests an extraordinary conference and event experience.

description.textZh: 厦门喜来登酒店地理位置便利，地处市中心商业零售区，无论您如何安排日程，这里都是您探索周边迷人风景的理想出发地。从这家现代化酒店驱车约15分钟即可到达厦门国际机场和厦门火车站。从酒店出发，约20分钟就能抵达渡轮码头，方便您前往迷人的鼓浪屿。靠近主要景点和交通枢纽，意味着在旅行路途中耗费更少时间，这样就有更多时间在这迷人的沿海地区欣赏壮观的景色，倾听美妙的声音。我们拥有358间舒适客房，每一间都是为了能让您住得舒心而精心设计，房内配有高速上网接入、直拨电话、国内外电视频道以及闻名遐迩的喜来登特色睡眠体验之床，还提供客房送餐服务，是您休闲度假的理想下榻之选。酒店拥有一间约600平米的宴会厅和五间其他会议室。所有多功能厅均位于五楼。
description.textEn: Sheraton Xiamen Hotel has a convenient location, at the heart of the citys business, retail and commercial hub makes it the ideal place from which to discover the fascinating surroundings and beyond, no matter what the guest’s agenda. This contemporary hotel is less than a 15 minute drive from Xiamen International Airport and Xiamen Railway Station. The ferry to the charming Gulangyu island is only 20 minutes away. Its proximity to major attractions and transportation links means less time traveling and more time enjoying the sights and sounds of this exciting coastal region. Retreat to the 358 guest rooms, each created for a wonderful night or day in with High Speed Internet Access, direct dialing, wide selection of local and foreign channels, room service and the famous Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. The hotel features a 600 sqm ballroom and five additional meeting rooms. All function rooms are located on the fifth floor.

description.textZh: 厦门W酒店位于厦门的东部商圈（思明区）, 是一座非凡精彩的光色声影万花筒, 引领宾客探索“海上花园”的最新动态。286间时尚的客房与套房在W酒店品牌标志性的潮玩风趣性格之中融入福建当地文化, 繁华商圈的活力氛围与您只有咫尺之遥。旅行者可以在设施先进的FIT健身中心释放压力, 或者前往闲适自在的WET®碧波泳池纵情愉悦。1,000平方米的宴会厅为厦门各类隆重活动设定了华美的舞台。三间活力纷呈的餐厅与酒吧供应诱人的创新佳肴和丰富多样的饮品。五魁九里全日餐厅的互动式烹饪台现场烹调国际美食，潮堂悦境在时髦的环境中呈现酷感鸡尾酒和沁爽饮品，而在HEAT特色酒吧, 客人可以躺在热水浴池中品饮香槟, 沉浸在DJ打造的动感节拍之中。如果有任何其他需要, W酒店的“随时/随需®服务”将满足宾客的心愿。
description.textEn: A brilliant kaleidoscope of sound and color in the heart of East Business District, W Xiamen celebrates WHAT’S NEW/NEXT in the ‘Garden by the Sea’. Stay close to downtown action at our 286 stylish guest rooms and suites mixing Fujian culture with W Hotels’ iconic tongue-in-cheek touches. Detox in our state-of-the-art FIT, then redox with a dip and sip in WET® the pool. The 1,000-square-meter Great Room sets the stage for epic events in downtown Xiamen. Three vibrant restaurants and bars captivate with innovative fare and eclectic beverage offerings. NINE’s interactive cooking stations serve up fresh international fare, SOUNDSCAPE mixes cool cocktails and refreshing brews in stylish surroundings, while destination bar HEAT serves Champagne in a hot tub and the latest DJ club anthems. For anything else, just ask Whatever/Whenever®.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani® Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, Chobani® Greek yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and salsato sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_zh: 忻州忻府万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Fairfield By Marriott Xinzhou Xinfu,located in Xinfu District,Xinzhou,With 164 well-appointed rooms,a 24/7 fitness center and laundry service.The hotel's restaurant offers a diverse Chinese-Western breakfast.Two meeting spaces,accommodating 20-70 people.
description.textEn: Fairfield By Marriott Xinzhou Xinfu, located in Xinfu District, Xinzhou, is committed to delivering exceptional service. With 164 well - appointed rooms featuring premium amenities, a 24/7 fitness center and laundry service, guests enjoy seamless comfort. The hotel's restaurant offers a diverse Chinese - Western breakfast.Two flexible meeting spaces, accommodating 20 - 70 people, cater to various events. Nestled north of Yunzhong River Scenic Area with easy access, it allows guests to conveniently visit the nearby Xinzhou Ancient City, a national AAAA - level attraction. Fairfield By Marriott Xinzhou Xinfu is the ideal choice for an unforgettable stay, and we look forward to welcoming you.

description.textZh: Wutai Mountain Marriott Hotel is the 90th property of Marriott International and the 25th under the flagship brand in China. Set in the southern gateway of Mount Wutai, our hotel offers premium accommodations, a pool, gym, on-site dining and event space.
description.textEn: Retreat to Wutai Mountain Marriott Hotel. Our modern hotel is located in the highly acclaimed Mount Wutai Area in Xinzhou. Settle into one of our 360 guestrooms which feature breathtaking views of Mount Wutai. Our hotel also has more than 2,000 square meters of meeting space, including a 1,049-square-meter, pillarless Grand Ballroom, which can be divided into four rooms. Guests can enjoy a variety of local and international culinary delights at our two restaurants and lounge located in the hotel. We also offer a variety of facilities and amenities to allow guests to indulge and rejuvenate. These include an indoor swimming pool, a 24- hour gym center, KTV rooms and more. Explore nearby attractions in Xinzhou and the surrounding area, including Encore Mount Wutai Theater, Baoding, Taiyuan, Beijing and the southern entrance of the scenic spot. Make plans to experience the attractions and beauty of Wutai Mountain in spectacular fashion at our Xinzhou hotel.

description.textZh: 徐州万豪酒店是江苏省苏北地区及淮海经济区首家万豪品牌酒店。酒店坐落于徐州市中心区域的5A级景区云龙湖畔，坐拥千年龙脉云龙山，俯瞰云龙湖万顷碧波，得天独厚的地理位置是商务出差与旅游休闲的理想选择。酒店拥有282间客房及套房，将时尚设计与低调优雅风格完美平衡，同时，还为宾客配备设有24小时健身中心及室内恒温游泳池。酒店臻厨全日制餐厅、豪雅中餐厅、韩舍餐厅、大堂酒廊风格各异，满足各式用餐需求。风景优美的户外草坪，以及总面积近1600平方米的宴会及会议空间，无论是举办企业会议、婚礼、社交宴会亦或是主题派对，皆是品质与格调之选。
description.textEn: As the first Marriott International hotel in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province, Xuzhou Marriott Hotel Lakeview is strategically located adjacent to Yun long Lake, the national 5A scenic spot. Xuzhou Marriott Hotel Lakeview is a mere 30 minutes’drive from the Xuzhou High-speed Railway Station and 8 minutes from the Xuzhou City Center. The hotel offers 282 spacious guest rooms and suites, 4 food and beverage outlets, a complete fitness center with indoor swimming pool, and a 1,600 square meter function space of one grand ballroom, two mid-sized ballrooms, four function rooms and one board room.

description.textZh: 徐州喜来登位于历史名城“千年汉都”徐州市铜山区，毗邻徐州最高学府中国矿业大学南湖校区，与泉山森林公园相接，驾车10分钟即可轻松领略云龙湖风光，15分钟可到达徐州博物馆感受徐州厚重的文化脉络。酒店地理位置优越，是城市探索和商务下榻的卓越选择。
description.textEn: Sheraton Xuzhou Hotel is located in Tongshan District Xuzhou a city known as the Thousand Year Han Capital. Situated adjacent to China University of Mining and Technology South Lake Campus and neighboring Quanshan Forest Park, the hotel offers easy access to the Yunlong Lake with just a 10 minute drive and is a mere 15 minutes away from Xuzhou Museum, where you can experience the rich cultural heritage of the city. With its prime location the hotel is an excellent choice for both urban exploration and business stays.

records.name_zh: 长白山福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: Located in Chang-Yan Industrial Park, just 10 minutes from the railway station, we offer 105 comfortable guest rooms, a well-equipped fitness center, and a self-service laundry—delivering a seamless and comfortable stay for every traveler.
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Yancheng Dafeng is the first Marriott International-branded hotel in Dafeng District, thoughtfully designed to Marriott’s global brand standards, offering a seamless stay experience with exceptional service and warm hospitality.Ideally located in the heart of Changyan Industrial Park, the hotel enjoys excellent connectivity—just a 10-minute drive from Yancheng Dafeng Railway Station and about 40 minutes from Yancheng Nanyang International Airport—making it a smart choice for both business and leisure travelers.The hotel features 105 well-appointed guest rooms, a cozy self-service breakfast restaurant, a fully equipped fitness center, and a self-service laundry room. Whether you’re on the road for work or exploration, Fairfield ensures a comfortable, balanced stay that lets you stay productive and relaxed.

description.textEn: The hotel has 177 stylish and comfortable rooms and suites.The MESH: There are 149 partitioned seating and 7 Chinese dining private rooms, where guests can enjoy delicious food, and complete their work and enjoy a special beer, catering to different functions such as a short break, takeout packaging, all day dining, and flexible workplace.24 hours fitness centerSeveral meeting rooms with state-of-the-art audio-visual equipment. Elegant outdoor lawns can be arranged into various venue spaces to meet the various needs of clients.

description.textZh: Suited in the State-owned Trade Center, and only 25 minutes driving from Yancheng Nanyang International airport, We provide 300 restorative accommodations with 4 dinning outlets, a refreshing fitness center and sophisticated event spaces.
description.textEn: Yancheng marriott hotel is the first international premium brand hotel with full-equipped service and facilities to debut in Yancheng. Hotel is ideally situated in the city center and the State-owned Trade Center Commercial Complex. As the city landmark, it is adjacent to one of the Top 10 City Scenic Spots - NFA Memorial Hall, with minutes walking distance from Golden Engle international shopping center, and it takes only 25 minutes driving to Yancheng Nanyang International airport. Hotel provides 300 modern designed rooms located between 33th to 47th floor featuring captivating city view. With 3 distinctive restaurants and 1 lounge, just pamper yourself into gastronomic temptations ranging from classical Asian cuisine to modern Western fusion, typically as authentic Cantonese cuisine, International favorites, flavorful Korean cuisine, etc.

description.textZh: 富有威斯汀风情的源宿酒店，环境布设崇尚自然理念，致力于呈献怡人的康乐体验。 源宿酒店在建造理念上倡导高效利用空间，注重可持续性，提供便利的上网设施助您轻松保持在线，为您缔造身心平衡、富有活力的旅行体验。 客房借鉴城市住宅的精巧设计，采用流线型布局设计，挖掘空间潜能，为您呈献丰富的客房功能体验。 清晨醒来，乐享源宿酒店的 Rise 健康热早餐，有新鲜格兰诺拉麦片、水果以及优质咖啡等更多美食，开启活力满满的一天。 Motion 健身中心Motion健身中心空间宽敞、采光充足，配备众多先进的力健有氧运动器械、力量训练器械，全天候开放，供您按照自己的节奏锻炼健身。 提供24小时自助洗衣房。 会议空间在我们宽敞明亮的会议室内高效办公。
description.textEn: Rich in Westin style, the Yuanshu hotel is dedicated to providing a pleasant recreational experience with a natural environment. Yuanjuku Hotel is built to promote efficient use of space, focus on sustainability, and provide convenient Internet facilities to help you stay online easily, creating a balanced and vibrant travel experience for you. Drawing on the exquisite design of urban residences, the room adopts a streamlined layout design to tap the space potential and present you with a rich guest room functional experience. Start your day with Rise Healthy Hot Breakfast at Genjuku Hotel with fresh granola, fruit, quality coffee and more. Motion Fitness Center The Motion Fitness Center is spacious and full of light, equipped with a large number of advanced cardio machines, strength training machines, open 24/7, for you to work out at your own pace. A 24-hour laundromat is available. Meeting space Work efficiently in our spacious and bright meeting rooms.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Yangjiang City Center
records.name_zh: 阳江中心福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 阳江中心福朋喜来登酒店坐落于景色优美的燕山湖畔，三面环湖，空气清新，自然环境得天独厚。酒店距阳江高铁站约7公里，优越的地理位置为入住宾客创造便利的出行条件。从酒店出发，宾客可以便捷前往“中国十大美丽海岛”之一的海陵岛，尽情探索旖旎的海滨风光；抑或前往广东海上丝绸之路博物馆，感受独特的人文景观。酒店拥有276间温馨、宽敞的客房及套房，整体风格融合现代美学和时尚元素，通过匠心独运的空间设计为当代旅行者带来一种宾至如归之感。所有客房均配备舒适床品、55英寸液晶电视、独立淋浴间、高速无线网络等完善设施，以及可饱览湖光山色的户外观景阳台。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beerson taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Deliciousbreakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifithroughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Pointsworkouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personaltraining and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler inmind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: 扬州万怡酒店位于扬州文昌CBD中心区域, 是您探索这座“淮左名都，竹西佳处”的历史文化名城的理想休憩之所！步行约15分钟即可抵达5A级风景名胜区蜀冈-瘦西湖风景区，周边遍布购物中心、中国大运河博物馆、东关街、何园、个园等热门景点同样相距不远，让您的休闲之旅更为缤纷多彩。酒店拥有296间舒适客房和套房，为您缔造轻松愉悦体验。酒店内全日制西餐厅供应环球风味及本地时令自助美食, 东园茶社中餐厅为您奉上地道淮扬美馔和淮扬特色早茶。在我们1200多平米的会议和多功能空间内发挥创意灵感，是您举办各种规模的会议、婚礼及社交活动的理想选择。此外, 酒店还拥有健身中心, 在忙碌一天之后放松身心。
description.textEn: Hotel is in the heart of Yangzhou Wenchang CBD district, is the ideal hotel to experience the city known its unique garden art. It is conveniently close to local major attractions and shopping center. We are just 15 minutes to the Slender West Lake, 5-12minutes to the Siwang Pavilion and Wenchang Pavilion by walk. The strategic location offers conveniently close to both China Grand Canal Museum, Dongguan street, and the Chinese-style garden and other attractions can be reached in a few minutes by car that make your leisure trip more colorful. Our 296 hotel rooms and suites with famous brand bedding, a flat-screen TV, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi . While here, guests can embark on a culinary journey, with a choice of fine restaurants serving authentic Huaiyang cuisine at Chinese restaurant and All Day Dining restaurant to enjoy international casual dining. Get inspired by our over 1200 square meters of meeting and function space. In addition, guests can enjoy fitness center to relax your body.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Yangzhou Slender West Lake
records.name_zh: 扬州城市中心万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Yangzhou Slender West Lake is located in the Slender West Lake Scenic Area, with a total construction area of ​​4,580 square meters. There are 78 well-crafted guest rooms in the hotel.
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Yangzhou Slender West Lake is located in the Slender West Lake Scenic Area, with a total construction area of ​​4,580 square meters. There are 78 well-crafted guest rooms in the hotel. The interior uses warm earth tones as the main color, and the modern design style is used to reflect the simple beauty of Fairfield, providing a variety of flexible open spaces for guests' business travel experience. Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh and free breakfast options, including Omelets, bacon,local noodles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, yogurt and sweet breads. Wind down a satisfying day in downtown area with an exhilarating workout in our modern fitness center. Discover refined function in stylishly appointed hotel rooms featuring contemporary essentials like the ultra-comfortable Fairfield Signature Sleep Experience. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

description.textZh: 雅乐轩酒店专为音乐爱好者和具有前瞻性的商务、休闲旅行者而设，距离蓬莱国际机场仅20分钟车程，交通便利。酒店设有350间客房，将科技与时尚美学相结合，以及在充能站全日餐厅享用琳琅满目的国际自助早餐。该品牌的标志性设施包括WXYZ酒吧，一个充满活力的空间，为热衷于科技和音乐的旅行者提供服务，以及全天候的Re:fuel。酒店还设有6间多功能厅，专业的会议销售团队及会议服务团队，为宾客提供一站式服务。
description.textEn: Designed for music fans and the growing tribe of hyper-connected, design-driven business and leisure travelers, Aloft Yantai is conveniently located a 20-minute drive from the Penglai International Airport. The hotel features 350 rooms that combine technology trends with design aesthetics, as well as an extensive international breakfast buffet at the Depot by AloftSM. The brand's signature facilities include W XYZ® bar, a vibrant, eclectic space for travelers keen on technology and music, and an all-day grab-and-go inspired Re:fuel. The hotel is also featured with 6 function rooms. Our professional catering team will always be at your service to ensure every detail of your event is a success.

description.textZh: 烟台万豪万枫酒店位于黄渤海新区海滨路36号，毗邻金沙滩景区，拥有齐全的商旅及旅游配套设施。酒店交通便利，步行约1分钟即可抵达国家4A级金沙滩景区，驱车约6分钟即可抵达中央商务区。酒店采用简约而温馨的设计理念，去繁就简，让宾客感到轻松自在、宾至如归。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Yantai is located at No. 36, Haibin Road, Huang-Bohai New Area, adjacent to Golden Beach, with perfect business and tourism facilities. The hotel is conveniently located 1 minute' walk to the National 4A Golden Beach and 6 minutes' drive to the central business districtThe hotel adopts a warm and simple design concept to make guests feel relaxed and at home.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Yantai Zhifu
records.name_zh: 烟台芝罘福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 烟台芝罘福朋喜来登酒店位于市中心核心位置，出行便捷。酒店距离大型购物中心及烟台火车站仅咫尺之遥，商旅皆宜。拥有107间精心设计的客房，为您提供舒适下榻体验。每日早晨，您可在酒店享用丰盛早餐，开启活力一天。酒店还配备了设施完善的健身房，让您随时保持健康状态，同时提供自助洗衣房服务，为您的旅途增添便利。无论是商务出行还是休闲探索，烟台芝罘福朋喜来登都是您便捷舒适的理想选择.
description.textEn: Ideally situated in downtown Yantai, Four Points by Sheraton Yantai Zhifu puts you steps away from major shopping centers and the Yantai Railway Station. Our 107 well-appointed guest rooms ensure a comfortable stay. Start your day right with our breakfast offerings. For your convenience, the hotel features a fitness center and a self-service laundry room. Ready to exceed your expectations for convenience and comfort during your business or leisure trip.

description.textZh: 烟台鑫广万豪酒店坐落于烟台经济技术开发区核心位置，背靠渤海湾，倚枕金沙滩，环抱黑松林是一家外形如贝壳的美学酒店。酒店集商务和度假休闲于一体，闹中取静，拥有313间雅致客房，部分客房带有观景阳台。身处优质客房及豪华套间中，私人观景阳台可180度纵览迷人金沙滩的秀美景色或城市黑松林景观。酒店拥有高水准的餐厅，包括万豪中餐厅、臻厨全日餐厅和大堂酒廊, 配有逾5,540平方米的多功能会议空间，配备高清LED显示屏的1000平方米的大宴会厅与650平方米的户外草坪相连，所有会议空间均配备具有完善音响设备。180 °全海景室内恒温泳池，24小时海景健身中心配有世界一流的健身器材，所有区域均可享受高速上网，烟台鑫广万豪酒店是您的优选。
description.textEn: Located on the coast of Shandong China in the YEDA zone the newly opened Yantai Marriott Hotel offers warm service, stunning views and elegant finishing touches. Our modern hotel offers a variety of accommodation featuring stunning sea or garden views, plush bedding, complimentary amenities and WiFi. Those looking to host a business meeting or special occasion in Yantai China, can hire one of our versatile venues, including large picturesque lawn, meeting rooms and sea-view grand ballroom with floor-to-ceiling windows to enjoy natural lighting. For relaxation unwind in our hotel's 24-hour fitness center, enjoy time in our heated indoor pool or visit some of the nearby sights in Yantai such as Changyu Castle. Visitors have an array of dining options to choose from, including Chinese and international restaurants, as well as room service. Additional hotel facilities include valet dry-cleaning, car rental and foreign exchange.

records.name_zh: 烟台金沙滩喜来登度假酒店

description.textZh: 备受认可的烟台金沙滩喜来登度假酒店设计风格时尚，装饰精致优雅，拥有迷人的海景客房、充足的会议设施，还提供非凡餐饮服务。酒店 350 间客房和套房均可欣赏迷人海景，配备便利设施，包括高速上网接入和喜来登特色睡眠体验之床。三间别具特色的餐厅供应中餐、日本料理和全球美食；而活力四射的休闲酒吧则供应手工鸡尾酒和清淡小吃。其他酒店设施包括现代化健身中心、室内恒温泳池和网球场。七间多功能会议室和宴会厅可容纳多达 900 位宾客，提供商务友好服务，包括往返机场的班车服务，是举办活动的理想之选，为您留下难忘回忆。无论您到中国是商务旅行还是休闲度假，烟台金沙滩喜来登度假酒店都是您理想的休闲之所。
description.textEn: Designed in the chicest style with sophisticated décor, the 5-star Sheraton Yantai Golden Beach Resort showcases stunning ocean-view accommodation, ample conference facilities and world-class cuisine. All of our 350 hotel rooms and suites feature inspiring sea views and intuitive amenities including high-speed internet access and the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. Our three distinguished restaurants offer Chinese, Japanese and global fare; a lively lounge bar serves craft cocktails and light bites. Additional hotel facilities include a modern fitness center, an indoor heated pool and tennis courts. Seven multi-functional conference rooms and ballrooms provide a memorable backdrop for events of up to 900 guests; business-friendly services include a shuttle to and from the airport. Whether you're in China for business or leisure, you'll find Sheraton Yantai Golden Beach Resort to be the perfect place for your retreat.

description.textZh: 烟台威斯汀酒店是一家注重健康的酒店，地处经济技术开发区，与八角湾国际会展中心近在咫尺，距离烟台蓬莱国际机场仅需20分钟车程，位置便利，风景宜人。酒店提供时尚现代的住宿环境和美味可口的特色佳肴。步入原生态设计的客房和套房, 享受充满活力的住宿体验。欢迎前往酒店餐厅, 乐享风味正宗的健康餐饮体验, 从琳琅满目的国际自助餐和口味纯正的传统中餐, 到地道精致的日本料理，让美食餮客们流连忘返。酒店设有室内恒温泳池、威斯汀健身馆和天梦水疗， 助您在旅途中保持更佳健康状态。酒店配有逾 4,000 平米的活动场地, 是举办婚礼、会议和会展活动的理想之选。
description.textEn: The Westin Yantai is a wellness-focused hotel with modern accommodations, fantastic dining experience and a convenient location which is a 20-minute drive to the Penglai International Airport. Step into original ecological designed rooms and suites to keep you fresh and energized during your stay. From a variety of international buffet and traditional Chinese to exquisite Japanese, you will enjoy healthful, authentic dining at our hotel restaurants. Enhance your well-being by visiting our heated indoor pool, WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio or Heavenly Spa. The hotel also offers over 4,000 square meters of event venues ideal for weddings, meetings or MICE events.

description.textZh: 烟台福朋喜来登酒店以“创造美好生活”为目标，精致复古、轻松舒适，致力于成为建设“美好生活”的实践者和引领者。酒店地理位置优越，交通便利，可方便前往孤独的鲸、张裕卡斯特酒庄、时光塔等热门景点，距离金沙滩公园仅5分钟车程。277间客房带您感受烟台当地的葡萄酒故事与现代工业风融合，远眺烟台海景的同时更可将福莱山公园、磁山等优美景色尽收眼底。体验福朋喜来登品牌特色的“醇饮优选”计划，从各种国际自助餐到精致下午茶，感受当地真实而亲切的环境氛围。时尚现代的健身中心，可以让运动爱好者放松身心、释放压力。酒店还提供超过1,000平方米的活动场地，可进车的大宴会厅及两间会议室，是您举办宴会、会议以及婚礼的理想之选。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Yantai takes "creating a better life" as its goal, is Sophisticated retro, relaxed and comfortable, and is committed to becoming a practitioner and leader in building "a better life". Conveniently located, the hotel offers access to popular attractions such as Whale Sculpture, Changyu Castor Winery, Hour Tower, and Golden Beach Park is a 5-minute drive away. With 277 rooms, you can experience the local wine stories and modern industrial, overlooking the sea of Yantai, but also have a beautiful view of the Fulai Hill Park, Cishan. Experience the Four Points Sheraton brand's unique "Best Brews" program, from a variety of international buffets to exquisite afternoon tea, and feel the authentic and intimate atmosphere of the local environment. The fitness center is an ideal place for sports to relax. Approximate 1000m2 of meeting space, cargo access to grand ballroom and two meeting rooms, ideal for banquet, meeting and wedding venue.

records.name_zh: 宜宾产城竹颂万怡酒店

description.textZh: 宜宾产城竹颂万怡酒店坐落于宜宾市叙州区竹颂生态城，作为率先在川南亮相的万豪国际品牌酒店，将现代美学、巴蜀建筑与当地竹元素进行巧妙组合, 与其时尚而有活力的品牌文化融合，辅以细致周到的服务，为商务和休闲宾客打造理想下榻之选。酒店拥有230间现代风格设计的客房及套房，其精心设计的客房配有舒适的床品和灵活的办公及休闲空间，为宾客打造轻松愉和焕活身心的入住体验。全日餐厅供应环球美馔和本地风味, 约800平米灵动的会议及宴会空间将满足宾客的不同会议及宴会需求。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Yibin is situated in Zhusong Ecological City, Xuzhou District, Yibin. As the first debut of Marriott International's brand in southern Sichuan, the hotel combines its smart and vibrant brand culture with an ingenious integration of modern aesthetics, Bashu architecture and local bamboo elements. Complemented by meticulous service, it creates an ideal stay for both business and leisure guests. The hotel features 230 modern-style guest rooms and suites, creating a comfortable and natural atmosphere while showcasing the cultural charm of bamboo poetry and the historical transformation of this famous city. The all-day dining restaurant offers a variety of global and local delicacies, and the 800-square-meter meeting space can meet the diverse needs of banquet and conference guests.

description.textZh: 宜昌三峡艾美酒店坐落于长江三峡起点的西陵峡口风景区, 毗邻三游洞与昭君渡, 坐拥壮丽的江山景致。酒店配备217间客房，由多栋错落有致的低层独栋建筑组成，将东方优雅风范与现代时尚魅力融合, 填补了“两坝一峡”区域高端酒店的空白。客房坐拥蜿蜒江景, 部分房型更配备私人温泉。悬挑式玻璃无边际泳池, 为您打造水天相接的景致。酒店内设4处活动场地以及超过1600平米的灵活宴会及会议空间，可满足餐饮、休闲及商务等多元需求。作为万豪旗下高端酒店品牌, 我们秉持“探索世界，揭秘目的地”理念, 融合三峡风光与本土文化, 邀宾客尽情“品味美好生活”。
description.textEn: Le Méridien Yichang Sanxia is situated in Xiling Gorge, the gateway to the Three Gorges. Adjacent to Sanyou Cave and Zhaojun Park, the hotel boasts stunning mountain and river views. The hotel features 217 guest rooms in low-rise buildings, blending Eastern elegance with modern charm and filling the gap for premium hotels in the "Two Dams and One Gorge" area. Rooms overlook the winding river, with select room types equipped with private hot springs. The cantilevered glass infinity pool creates a seamless blend of water and sky. With 4 event venues and over 1,600 sqm of flexible banquet and meeting space, it caters to dining, leisure and business needs. As a premium brand of Marriott International, it embodies the philosophy of "Destination Unlocked", integrating Three Gorges landscapes and local culture to invite guests to "Savour the Good Life".

description.textZh: 宜昌威斯汀酒店凌江而立，坐落于宜昌地标建筑—高约220米的中建宜昌之星顶端（36-51层），举步即达江滩公园。位居伍家岗城市中轴。275间云端客房皆以全景落地窗为画框，将长江奔涌之势、滨江公园的十里翠屏尽收眼底。酒店内部设计师从长江的壮阔与三峡的奇伟中吸取灵感，将山水形韵及树石景观融入设计，打造丰富且充满活力的旅居空间。无论您为三峡山水而来，还是寻求一方静谧，这里都能让身心重焕活力，在商务差旅中保持高效，休闲度假时尽享惬意。
description.textEn: Rising 220 meters above the Yangtze River, The Westin Yichang occupies the pinnacle floors (36-51) of the CSCEC Star of Yichang, all 274 rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows with Yangtze River views.offering immediate access to the riverside promenade. Inspired by Yiling's iconic Natural Pagoda, the hotel's architectural design unfolds like a cascading scroll, while interiors reflect the Three Gorges' grandeur through organic textures and mountain-water motifs—creating a vibrant wellness retreat where business travelers stay productive and leisure guests find rejuvenation amidst breathtaking river panoramas.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Yilan Jiaoxi
records.name_zh: 宜兰礁溪福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店位于宜兰礁溪，距礁溪火车站约 700 米，距台北市约 50 分钟车程，距桃园国际机场约 80 分钟车程。宜兰礁溪福朋喜来登酒店的每间客房均设有卡隆酸温泉。酒店一层的 Chushixuan 餐厅供应宜兰当地名吃，樱桃烤鸭。Shi Chao 提供福朋醇饮优选当地精酿啤酒。畅享室外泳池、健身中心、商务中心和设有不同主题儿童游乐场的趣味乐园，开启惬意度假时光。
description.textEn: Located in Yilan Jiaoxi, 700 metres from Jiaoxi Railway Station, around 50mins drive from Taipei City, and 80mins away from Taoyuan International Airport. Four Points by Sheraton Yilan Jiaoxi provides every accommodation room with Caronic Acid Hot Spring. Yilan well-known cuisine, Cherry Duck, is offered on Level One Chushixuan Restaurant. Four Points Best Brews local craft beer served in Shi Chao. An outdoor swimming pool, fitness centre, business centre and Fun Paradise with block themed children's playgrounds are here for you during your vacation.

records.name_zh: 宜兰力丽威斯汀度假酒店

description.textZh: 宜兰力丽威斯汀度假酒店位于宜兰的一座日式老建筑内，走进禅式风格的大门之后，即可一窥时尚简约的内部设计。酒店内设水疗中心、桑拿室、烤炉、健身中心和室外泳池，缔造理想下榻体验。优雅别致的设计伴您开启精彩度假之旅。酒店拥有 85 间客房和套房以及 6 栋别墅，设有独立泳池和水疗泳池，且每间客房均提供高速上网接入、50 英寸液晶纯平电视、免费瓶装水、天梦之床以及天梦之浴白茶系列沐浴用品，休闲体验尽此间。Mai 日式餐厅有着宽大的落地窗，柚木和柏树成就设计亮点，除了单人座位之外，亦贴心地设有可容纳 6 至 10 人的私人包房。 Seasonal Tastes 餐厅是一间摩登风尚的全日制餐厅及咖啡厅，是休闲用餐的理想去处
description.textEn: Based on the Japanese-style old buildings in Yilan, the Westin Yilan Resort provides one entrance with a Zen-style layout with a modern and simple design. Guests are welcomed to enjoy our SPA facilities, sauna, oven chambers, fitness center, and outdoor swimming pool to experience the best stay with us.With an elegant and unique design, the Westin Yilan Resort makes a perfect getaway. Boasting 85 guest rooms, suites, and even six villas, as well as independent swimming pools and SPA pools, each room is equipped with high speed internet access, 50-inch LCD flat screen TVs, free bottled water, Heavenly® Bed, and white tea Heavenly® Bath amenities, to provide all travelers with a relaxing experience.With large floor-to-ceiling windows, designed with teak and cypress, Mai Japanese Restaurant not only offers individual seating, but also offers separate private rooms from 6 to 10 persons. Modern designed Seasonal Taste all day dining restaurant and Cafe lounge are perfect place to enjoy and relax

description.textZh: Whether traveling for business or fun,Courtyard by Marriott® makes all of your travels successful by providing exactly what you need: spacious,thoughtful guest rooms;a hot breakfast buffet and services that help you be more productive and comfortable.
description.textEn: The new state-of-the-art lobby at Courtyard provides greater flexibility and choices for our guests. At the center of it all is The Bistro, your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You'll also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, free Wi-Fi throughout and easy access to the latest news, weather and airport conditions via our GoBoard technology. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center, indoor pool and whirlpool will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be more comfortable, more productive and more enjoyable than ever before!

records.name_zh: 银川兴庆区万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 银川兴庆区万豪万枫酒店坐落于银川市兴庆区兰傒谷商务广场，酒店距火车站14公里，银川河东机场30公里，集“酒店集群、商业购物、会议会展、人才公寓”为一体的经济“新商圈”、城市“新地标”，也是西北地区座落城市中心规模较大的商务酒店集群。酒店拥有239间舒适宽敞的客房，配备舒适亲肤床品，秉承了万枫庄园的舒适设计和热情好客服务，为旅客们提供高效且经济的旅居体验。室内设计采用暖色系并搭配现代风格的家具，灯光及色调均经过专业团队精心设计和调试，为宾客营造温馨舒适的氛围；55英寸高清液晶电视机、高速无线网络、可调节灯光和多种电源接口等便利设施，可满足宾客的多元化需求。
description.textEn: Located in Lanxi Valley Business Plaza, Xingqing District, Yinchuan, it is a new economic business district integrating "commercial shopping, conferences and exhibitions, and talent apartments". Meanwhile, it is also a large-scale cluster of business hotels in the city. With convenient transportation and a modern commercial environment, it has become an ideal choice for business trips and conferences.The hotel has 239 comfortable guest rooms of various types, and will provide guests with a simple and beautiful accommodation experience with attentive services. The fitness center and self-service laundry room on the second floor of the hotel are open 24/7, ensuring that guests can rejuvenate during their journey. In addition, the hotel is equipped with a 165-square-meter multi-functional conference room and a tea break area for activities, which can meet the needs of small and medium-sized meetings and easily satisfy business conference requirements.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Yinchuan Xingqing
records.name_zh: 银川兴庆福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Located at Lanxigu Business Plaza,featuring a classic and modern design, comfortable and contemporary facilities, and warm, genuine service, the hotel provides business and leisure travelers with a convenient and relaxing new accommodation choice.
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 银川 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: At JW Marriott® Hotels, we create elegantly curated experiences, stripping away the unnecessary to reveal the exceptional.Experience our passion for personal service, settings of timeless sophistication, gracious dining and a welcoming unpretentiousness.
description.textEn: The JW Marriott brand carries on the Marriott heritage of excellence and personal attention to detail that represents J. Willard Marriott, a true entrepreneur who expressed genuine warmth and affection for both his guests and associates.JW Marriott Hotel Yinchuan is located in the Jinfeng District which is the administration center of the city. Adjacent to landmark buildings such as Yinchuan People's Square, Yinchuan International Exhibition Center, Ningxia Museum and etc.A total of 279 designed fashion and elegant guest rooms and 2 food and beverage outlets enable you to get ultimate taste feast experience. Covering an area of 2910 sqm, ballrooms and meeting rooms can sufficiently meet your actual needs. Fully-equipped gym and in-door heated swimming pool allow you to stay fresh and healthy.

description.textZh: Stay at Sheraton Yinchuan for a delightful visit to China. Our modern new hotel features deluxe rooms, international dining, a lush lobby lounge, an indoor pool, a gym, a games room and over 19,000 square feet of venues.
description.textEn: Experience the new Sheraton Yinchuan, setting the standard for superior hotels in Yinchuan, China. Set against the backdrop of the Helan Mountains, our contemporary hotel boasts an ideal combination of world-class amenities with a location close to business centers and attractions. Visit the Yinchuan Green Expo Garden, Lanshan Park, mosques, temples and museums, all nearby. Within our hotel, you'll find spacious rooms, each with upscale products, marble bathrooms and views of Yinchuan. Enjoy delicious international dining in our restaurants, go for a swim in our indoor pool, workout in the gym or relax with family and friends in our inviting games room. If you are planning a meeting or an event, our extensive venues are equipped with advanced audio-visual technologies and offer our expert meeting and wedding planning services and custom catering. Whether staying with us for business or enjoying a vacation, we look forward to welcoming you soon to our hotel in Yinchuan, China.

description.textZh: The hotel is located in the core area of Yili's capital, adjacent to Liuxing Street and Kazanqi. It is equipped with a 24-hour convenience store, a laundry room, a fitness center and a banquet hall, meeting the needs of business and leisure travelers.
description.textEn: The Marriott Fairfield Inn & Suites Yining is ideally located in the core area of Yili Prefecture's capital, adjacent to cultural landmarks such as Liuxing Street and Kazanqi. With a distance of approximately 7 kilometers from Yining International Airport and 3 kilometers from Yining Railway Station, the hotel offers convenient transportation access. Boasting 130 modern and minimalist guest rooms and suites, the property features a 24-hour convenience store, self-service laundry, fitness center, and multifunctional banquet hall, catering to the needs of both business and leisure travelers. Surrounding attractions include Sailimu Lake (approximately 143 kilometers away) and Nalati Grassland (approximately 254 kilometers away), allowing guests to easily explore the charm of Central Asian culture and natural wonders.

description.textZh: 伊宁福朋喜来登酒店将永恒的经典设计和当地元素细节相融。酒店位于伊宁市区，将舒适与便利相结合，是您商务出行或度假旅游的品质之选。在入住舒适客房和套房的同时，还可以享受柔软的床上用品、高速Wi-Fi 和智能设施。在启程探索壮丽的风景和传统的西部文化之余，还可在酒店 THE MESH (玩啤食社)全日制餐厅品尝我们精选的结合本地特色和国际风味的自助餐，以及“纯饮优选”计划享受正宗的本地啤酒，或者在我们全天候的健身中心锻炼，帮助您放松身心。我们的多功能厅还可以组织小型聚会、颁奖典礼或社交活动。无论是什么将您带到伊犁，在伊宁福朋喜来登酒店，您都可以随心所欲地旅行。
description.textEn: The Four Points by Sheraton Yining combines timeless classic design and modern details with local elements. Our hotel in downtown Yining is perfect for business or vacations, offering a blend of comfort and convenience. Settle into comfortable rooms and suites featuring plush bedding, free Wi-Fi and high-end amenities. Before you explore the glorious sceneries and traditional western culture, please taste our selection of local and international buffet at THE MESH, enjoy genuine local beers through Best Brews or work out in our 24 hours fitness center. Organize a small-scale gathering, award ceremonies or social events in our multifunctional indoor venues. The essentials are here at our hotel to help you unwind.No matter what brings you to Yili, travel the way you like at Four Points by Sheraton Yining.

description.textZh: 义乌万豪万枫酒店拥有141间舒适宜人的客房和套房，客房设备齐全，包括高速无线网、65英寸飞利浦高清液晶电视、迷你冰箱、金可儿床垫、并配有松下智能马桶和科勒独立淋浴设施等，同时通过备受信赖的服务以及温馨舒适丶热情好客的住宿氛围，全心全意为您提供无微不至的下榻体验。酒店餐厅能满足100-120名宾客的就餐需求，为宾客提供丰富的膳食选择；全天候万枫小铺供应零食饮品，作为外带简餐。此外，配备先进器材的健身中心为宾客全天候开放，帮助宾客在旅行中保持节拍，重焕活力，此外酒店还配备了全天候自助式洗衣房供宾客使用，为入住的商旅宾客提供更便捷的服务。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Yiwu have 141 comfortable and pleasant guest rooms and suites. The guest room is fully equipped, including high-speed wireless network, 65-inch Philips high-definition LCD TV, mini fridge, King Koil mattresses,Panasonic intelligent closestool, and Kohler bathroom facilities, etc. At the same time, through the highly trusted service and warm, comfortable, and hospitable accommodation atmosphere, we are wholeheartedly dedicated to providing you with meticulous staying experience. The hotel restaurant can meet the dining needs of 100-120 guests; the All-Day 24-hour Fairfield Market supplies snacks and drinks, as takeaway simple meals. In addition, the fitness center equipped with advanced equipment is open 24 hours a day for guests, helping guests keep the pace and rejuvenate during the trip. In addition, the hotel is also equipped with a 24-hour self-service laundry room for guests to use, providing more convenient services for the business guests staying.

records.name_en: The International Trade City, Yiwu - Marriott Executive Apartments

description.textZh: The International Trade City, Yiwu - Marriott Executive Apartments boasts a fantastic hotel location in the CBD and spacious, strikingly decorated apartments for travelers to China. Benefit from exceptional dining and a state-of-the-art fitness center.
description.textEn: Yiwu Marriott Hotel and The International Trade City, Yiwu–Marriott Executive Apartments are located in the heart of CBD and neighboring to The International Trade City and Yiwu International Sculpture Park. 195 expansive, gorgeously styled apartments of The International Trade City, Yiwu–Marriott Executive Apartments are located on floors 8-18, which welcome you with a full kitchen and panoramic views of either the downtown Yiwu skyline or the adjacent Yiwu International Sculpture Park. In addition, one bedroom apartment suites are equipped with household appliances such as refrigerators and washing machines. The travelers will appreciate our location and convenient transportation. The hotel and apartments are only 20 minutes' drive from Yiwu Airport and Yiwu Railway Station. It takes only 30 minutes to drive from the hotel and apartments to Hengdian World Studios. It takes only 30 and 90 minutes from Yiwu to Hangzhou and Shanghai by high-speed train.

description.textZh: Located in the lively CBD, near a range of attractions, Yiwu Marriott Hotel welcomes you to China with spacious, brilliantly decorated rooms, delectable dining, a fitness center, a pool and 1,950 square feet of modern event space.
description.textEn: No matter your reason for traveling to China, Yiwu Marriott Hotel will set a great tone for a fantastic visit. Unwind with ease after an exhilarating day in the city center in your spacious, contemporary accommodation; our 281 hotel rooms and suites feature an impressive assortment of useful amenities and many boast picturesque views of the Yiwu CBD or the adjacent wetland park in yiwu city. Indulge in the distinctive flavors of China with expertly crafted fare at our signature restaurant, stay fit and focused at our well-equipped hotel gym or take a rejuvenating swim in our heated indoor pool. Boasting 1,950 square feet of venue space, including a lavish pillarless Grand Ballroom, we can provide you with what you desire for a remarkable business or social gathering here in China. In addition, our unparalleled location places you near terrific shopping and dining and close to the airport. Allow Yiwu Marriott Hotel to redefine the stay experience when you visit Yiwu.

description.textZh: 我们明亮而魅力十足的豪华客房既经典舒适又具有现代旋律。通过窗墙（俯瞰宜兴湖或城市景观），每间客房都沐浴在和煦的阳光之下。安装窗户的载体可选择木饰板墙壁，并且超大的镜子给人一种宽阔开放的感觉。奶白灰色条纹软色调形成温馨雅致的氛围 - 光亮的红木家具和引人注目的当代中国艺术品更加强调了这种氛围。躺在窗户旁边的躺椅上可享受阅读之乐，而带数据端口的宽敞办公桌、电话和人体工学办公桌椅为您处理商务事宜提供众多便利。一台 42 英寸液晶电视、免费高速上网接入、iPod 基座和集成多媒体中心为您休闲娱乐和与外界连接提供便利。两张双人艾美睡床或一张特大号艾美睡床 - 铺有纯白床单、摆放多个枕头和轻盈羽绒被 - 定能让您一夜酣眠。精美别致的浴室设有宽敞的大理石台面装饰的梳妆台、深浸泡浴缸和独立玻璃封闭式雨林淋浴间，为您提供高品质的沐浴体验。内部百叶窗可让您从浴缸观察卧室动静，并有自然光透过百叶窗洒入。充足的艾美酒店特色卫浴用品、毛绒浴袍和柔软拖鞋贴心呵护您的体验。新食谱餐厅、乐美中餐厅和北纬31度大堂吧三处烹饪舞台将新旧、生动和朴质、传统和现代元素融合，邀请客人领略一次美食文化之旅。凭借 2,625 平米的宜人活动空间，宜兴富力艾美酒店可提供各种精彩可能。酒店场地装潢精美、陈设雅致，包含一间适合举办大型活动的大宴会厅、一间可用于举办行政会议的私人贵宾董事会议室以及多间令人难忘并可满足您各种需求的灵活多功能厅。我们的工作人员随时用心打理每一细节，而活动组织和餐饮专业团队将通过精确的执行和卓越的才能把您的创意变成现实。
description.textEn: An exemplary urban retreat Le Meridien Yixing offers proximity to downtown and natural surroundings. Near commercial offices, retail malls and historic and natural attractions this inspiring hotel facilitates the discovery of cultural experiences. Well travelled guests will find stimulating choices for relaxation. The health club and indoor heated pool are designed for transformative workouts and tranquil swimming respectively. Outstanding international cuisines are served in 2 restaurants. Our spacious 270 guest rooms and 14 suites blend a sophisticated contemporary style with distinctive traditional Chinese motifs and vibrant local artwork. State of the art entertainment centres and High Speed Internet Access are seamlessly integrated into the chic design.

records.name_zh: 益阳宝基福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻益阳宝基福朋喜来登酒店，畅游长沙周边的众多小城。我们酒店位于益阳中心地带，距益阳高铁站约 6.5 公里（约 14 分钟车程），距益阳火车站约 3 公里（约 6 分钟车程）。我们酒店距长沙仅约 40 分钟车程，拥有 183 间客房及 9 间套房，配备 55 寸飞利浦 LCD 电视，选用国际卫浴品牌 Mervin 的产品以及来自 Active 的洗涤用品。套房配备咖啡机、戴森吹风机等家电。位于一楼的 Mesh 功能灵活又直观简约，宾客可在此轻松找到用餐、办公、小酌和玩乐的惬意空间，活力开启新一天。自选外带角全天供应各种外带美食，还设有移动办公空间。各种宴会场地均可分隔或组合使用，以满足不同会议群体的需求，为您打造灵活会议空间。
description.textEn: A tour of niche cities around Changsha begins at Four Points by Sheraton Yiyang. This hotel is located in the central area of Yiyang, 6.5 km from Yiyang high-speed Railway station, about 14 minutes drive and 3 km from Yiyang Railway station, about 6 minutes drive. Distances from the hotel to Changsha only have 40 minutes drive.Our hotel has 183 guestrooms and 9 suites, where equipped with 55 inch Philip LCD TV, use the famous international bathroom brand - Mervin, wash-supplies from Active, and the suite has coffee machine, Dyson hair dryer, etc. You can open you fresh day life in the Mesh which located in 1st floor is functional and straight forward, as you can easily find your way around, Dine & Work; Drink & Play. The Grab & Go corner offers a variety of take away food all day food offering and mobile office space. For the flexibility meeting space, all kinds of banquet venues can be split or combined use to meet the needs of different meeting groups.

description.textZh: 温州乐清万怡酒店坐落于 218 米新地标——中能天际东方，距离乐清总部经济园、江南里商业步行街仅数步之遥。酒店地理位置优越，交通便利，驱车仅 50 分钟左右即可到达龙湾国际机场，约 25 分钟可达乐清高铁站，30 分钟左右可达雁荡山 5A 级景区。酒店拥有 214 间优雅客房和套房，坐拥壮美城景或海景。内设全日餐厅和 24 小时健身房，让您畅享舒适生活。酒店卓越的服务备受商务和休闲旅客青睐，为乐清酒店业带来新风尚。
description.textEn: Located in the 218-meter new landmark Zhongneng Tianji Dongfang Courtyard by Marriott Wenzhou Yueqing is a stone’s throw away from Yueqing Headquarters Economic Park, Faith-Trust IN-JIANGNAN Commercial Pedestrian Street. Excellent location, convenient transportation, our hotel is only 50 minutes’ drive from the Longwan international airport, 25 minutes’ drive from Yueqing High-speed Railway Station, and also just 30 minutes’ drive from the National 5A Scenic Spot Yandang Mountain. Our hotel offers 214 elegant guestrooms and suites featuring the spectacular city or sea views.Offering All-day Dining Restaurant, 24-hours gym, the hotel would dramatically satisfy guests’ pursuit of comfortable life. our hotel provides an ideal hotel experience for business and leisure travel and reshape the fresh air of Yueqing Hotel industry.

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Yulin has 203 spacious, bright quest rooms. It also has a gym, meetingrooms and Fairfield restalirant . Its breakfast offers rich options plusaromatic coffee, satisfying both business and leisure stays.
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Yulin is situated in the Yulin Kechuang New City. The hotel is approximately 7 kilometers from Yulin Railway Station and about 20 kilometers from Yulin Yuyang Airport, in proximity to renowned attractions such as Zhenbeitai, Hongshi Gorge, and Hengshan Polo Ancient Fortress. Drawing inspiration from Marriott’s signature “Manor Moment” concept, the hotel incorporates minimalist and balanced design elements, blending the leisurely philosophy of estate living into the modern pace of life. This allows guests to enjoy moments of physical and mental repose amid their busy schedules. The understated yet rustic design reflects the harmonious integration of historical and contemporary charm, embodying the distinctive allure of Yulin as the "Kuwait of the East."

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Yulin High-Tech Zone
records.name_zh: 榆林高新区福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 结束了整日的奔波，当您踏入客房的那一刻便尽是舒心惬意。酒店拥有 125 间明亮轩敞的客房与套房将家的温馨舒适尽数收纳其中，为您妥帖备好旅途所需的一切伴您尽享无忧住宿时光。您可以惬意地陷在福朋酒店特色睡床的柔软怀抱中卸下一身疲惫；也可以随心出门探寻榆林高新区的万般景致，每间客房均配备免费高速无线网络，助您随时与外界畅快相连；每日换新的免费瓶装水，亦为您的旅居增添一份贴心。我们力求化繁为简，为您拂去旅途的琐碎烦扰，让您真正拥有宾至如归的体验。酒店地理位置优越，距榆林榆阳机场仅 25 公里，驱车 30 分钟即可抵达。期待您的莅临，愿与您共度一段舒适惬意、物超所值的美好时光。
description.textEn: After a long day, stepping into your guest room is pure relief. Our 125 bright, spacious guest rooms and suites offer all the comforts of home, with everything you need for a seamless stay. Sink into the plush comfort of the Four Points signature bed, or venture out to explore all that Yulin Hi-Tech Zone has to offer. Stay connected effortlessly with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi available in every room, and enjoy daily replenished free bottled water. We keep things simple—leaving travel hassles at the door so you can truly make yourself at home. We look forward to welcoming you for a relaxing, great-value stay. Conveniently located just 25 km from Yulin Yuyang Airport, the hotel is only a 30-minute drive away.

records.name_zh: 云浮新兴筠城喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 云浮新兴筠城喜来登酒店优雅迷人、舒适便利，欢迎莅临下榻。酒店位于新兴县城中心，专为商务旅客及寻访佛教大鉴禅师慧能故乡的宾客而设计。宽敞现代的客房几乎均可俯瞰新兴江美景；其内设施体贴周到，包括免费 Wi-Fi 和喜来登特色睡眠体验之床。在这里，不妨前往酒店之内的盛宴标帜餐厅享用国际风味自助餐，或到采悦轩中餐厅品鉴新鲜烹饪的各式粤菜。置身于云浮期间，您可在配备齐全的现代化健身中心挑战自我，或在恒温室内泳池畅游一番。若您计划在此举办活动，酒店还配备约 2100 平米的场地空间，其中包括一间无柱式宴会厅。若您想游览景点，国恩寺和龙山温泉均距酒店附近。
description.textEn: Sheraton Yunfu Xinxing Hotel welcomes you with a seamless combination of comfort, elegance and convenience. Located in Xincheng, China, our hotel is designed for business travelers and guests seeking to discover the hometown of Buddhist figure Master Dajian Huineng. Settle in to spacious, modern accommodations, nearly all of which overlook the Xinxing River; thoughtful amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi access and the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. Elsewhere at the hotel, savor international buffet cuisine at Feast Signature Restaurant, or join us for seasonal, freshly prepared Cantonese dishes at Yue. Challenge yourself to a workout while in Yunfu at our contemporary on-site gym, which is furnished with a full range of equipment, or take a dip in the heated indoor pool. Those hosting events in West Guangdong can choose from 2,100 sqm of venue space, including a pillar-free ballroom. If you’d like to explore, attractions including Guo'en Temple and Loshan Hot Spring are within reach.

description.textZh: The hotel features a spacious, modern lobby filled with natural light. All 170 guestrooms offer smart contemporary designs, and are equipped with LED TVs, high speed Wi-Fi and comfortable furniture to fulfill different needs of guests.
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Yuyao is a select hotel brand of Marriott, the global leader in select business travel brands, the Maple Hotel brand adheres to Marriott's consistent "comfort and reliability" brand services, and is dedicated to creating a simple, friendly and carefree experience for the new generation of business travelers. Welcomes guests with a spacious, contemporary lobby with plenty of natural light. Each room features a contemporary décor with a clean colour scheme and natural wood furnishings for a comfortable, minimalist design. With removable desks, guests can organise their workspace to suit their habits. Fully equipped for your business travels.

description.textZh: 滕州喜来登酒店位于滕州市北辛街道政务商务核心区，紧邻滕州市政府和吾悦广场购物中心，距滕州东站10公里、滕州站4.5公里，距枣庄翼云机场47公里。酒店位置通达优越，可轻松造访滕州博物馆、六塔一馆等历史文化地标。酒店拥有 200 余间格调雅致的客房及套房，均配备国际品牌床品和高端卫浴设施；酒店配备无柱式豪华宴会厅，挑高开阔的空间可灵活承接大型会议、高端婚宴与品牌发布会等多元活动；风格各异的特色餐厅汇聚中西美味，满足多元用餐需求。依托国际品牌标准与贴心服务，全方位满足商旅出行、休闲度假、宴请聚会等多元需求。
