description.textEn: Sheraton Tengzhou is located in the core government and business district of Beixin Street, Tengzhou, adjacent to the Tengzhou Municipal Government and Wuyue Plaza Shopping Centre, 10 kilometres from Tengzhou East Railway Station, 4.5 kilometres from Tengzhou Railway Station, and 47 kilometres from Zaozhuang Yiyun Airport. The hotel enjoys a prime location with convenient access to historical and cultural landmarks such as Tengzhou Museum and Liuta Yiguan. The hotel features over 200 elegantly styled rooms and suites, all equipped with international brand bedding and high-end bathroom facilities. It offers a column-free luxury banquet hall with a spacious high ceiling, suitable for large conferences, high-end weddings, and brand launch events. Various themed restaurants offer a variety of Chinese and Western cuisines to meet diverse dining needs. Leveraging international brand standards and attentive service, the hotel fully caters to business travel, leisure vacations, banquets, and gatherings.

description.textZh: 张家港万豪酒店位于张家港汇金国际购物和娱乐中心，便利舒适的均衡体验尽在此间。酒店位于张家港的经济和文化中心，步行片刻即可抵达张家港的各大景点，包括万达购物广场、张家港文化中心、保利大剧院和梁丰生态园。320 间客房和套房空间宽敞，设有落地窗和开放式浴室，可赏揽天际线景观。酒店设有中餐厅和海鲜自助餐厅，供应丰盛可口的美食；大堂休闲酒吧可谓工作和放松两相宜。健身设施包括一间 24 小时健身中心，其中设有瑜伽工作室和室内恒温泳池。这间现代化的新酒店设有两间无柱式宴会厅、四间会议室、一间多功能厅、一间董事会议室和一个室外花园，适合举办各类会议和婚礼。欢迎莅临下榻中国张家港国际商务酒店，体验卓尔不凡的尊贵感受。
description.textEn: Convenience and comfort are well balanced at the Zhangjiagang Marriott Hotel, located within the Hui Jin International Center shopping and entertainment complex. Set in the economic and cultural center of Zhangjiagang, China, our hotel is walking distance to the city’s major attractions including Wanda Shopping Mall, Zhangjiagang Cultural Center, Poly Theatre and Liangfeng Ecological Park. The 320 guest rooms and suites feature spacious layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows, skyline views and open-plan bathrooms. Dining is a discovery of cuisines with Chinese and seafood buffet restaurants; work and relaxation intersect at the lobby lounge and bar. Wellness amenities include a 24-hour fitness center with a yoga studio and an indoor heated pool. For meetings and weddings, our modern, new hotel offers two pillar-free ballrooms, four meeting rooms, a function room, a boardroom and an outdoor garden. A stay at our international business hotel in Zhangjiagang, China, is truly an extraordinary one.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Zhangjiajie Tianmen Mountain
records.name_zh: 张家界天门山万豪万枫酒店

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Zhangjiajie Tianmen Mountain
records.name_zh: 张家界天门山福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: Located near the visitor center of Zhangjiajie Tianmenshan Scenic Area, the hotel is perfect for leisure vacations and business travels, dedicated to bringing guests a comfortable and delightful stay amidst charming mountain scenery.
description.textEn: Nestled in the central core of Yongding District, downtown Zhangjiajie, our hotel is approximately 2 kilometers from Tianmen Mountain National Forest Park Tourist Center (Cableway Lower Station). Accessible on foot or via a short drive, it offers easy access to explore Tianmen Mountain and immerse yourself in its breathtaking natural scenery.The hotel features 171 guest rooms equipped with Four Points Comfort Beds, creating a tranquil and relaxing retreat for all guests. It also provides around 300 square meters of flexible meeting space with comprehensive conference services, ideal for small business meetings and team seminars, perfectly combining leisure and business travel.With thoughtful service and an elegant environment, we sincerely welcome you to enjoy a delightful stay surrounded by the charming landscapes of Zhangjiajie.

description.textZh: 崇礼万怡酒店位于阿那亚·崇礼滑雪小镇内，酒店距离崇礼高铁站仅3.5公里，高速太子城出口19公里。酒店纵享自有阿那亚私属滑雪场，宾客可随时体验“滑进滑出”的乐趣，雪场中目前配备6条滑雪道：包含初级道、中级、高级道、蘑菇道以及专门为单板爱好者设计的单板道等，满足中高阶滑雪爱好者的滑雪需求，更对初学者以及亲子类家庭非常友好。在春夏时分，与家人和朋友度假避暑，体验山林野趣，全新融于自然的度假方式和逐渐丰富的小镇设施，将为宾客带来全新的度假享受。酒店拥有255间客房与套房，宾客可在酒店的万荟轩和大堂吧品尝丰富的美食和饮品，或在健身中心，瑜伽室，恒温泳池等多种休闲设施中，体会潜在能量被重新激发的畅快，悦享轻松舒适的假日时光。酒店配备4个多功能宴会厅，其中410平米的无柱宴会厅可同时容纳400位宾客，并设有200个地下车位，车库电梯直升大堂，便捷满足泊车需求。
description.textEn: The hotel has a total of 255 guest rooms and suites, exclusive space and new facilities to achieve leisure. The Pavilion and The Lounge provide perfect places with a wide variety of delicious food for casual conversation with friends. The GYM is also a good option to unwind after a hectic day. Courtyard by Marriott Chongli provides the best hotel experience for the business and leisure guests, so they can purse their personal and professional passion. The rooms are stylishly and thoughtfully designed, featuring a personized work area. Every detail iscarefully chosen to create a feeling of perfect harmony. The meeting space is located on G floor with total areaof 800 square meter, includes 410 square-meter ballroom and 5 different sizes multi-function rooms, all of the meeting rooms are equipped advanced audio visual equipment and high-speed wired.

description.textZh: 欢迎来到崇礼源宿酒店，探索群山环绕、活力四射的新滑雪胜地。清晨醒来，专注于健康生活方式和探索体验。24 小时外带餐厅是全天候提供营养美味的理想选择。在我们的室内自然咸水泳池尽情畅泳或自由漂浮。特色天梦之床、经“能源之星”认证且设施齐备的厨房、带雨淋花洒和全天然卫浴用品的水疗风格浴室伴您度过精彩每一天。人性化办公区设有超大办公桌、人体工学座椅和简单易用的电源及数据接口，以及一体式扩展坞、42 英寸高清平板电视等娱乐设施。欢迎下榻太舞滑雪度假村崇礼源宿酒店。 在崇礼源宿酒店，我们为您提供更多亲近自然的空间，让您尽情思考、办公、参加社交活动，乐享活力生活体验。
description.textEn: Discover Chinas newest ski destination at Element Chongli a vibrant ski area surrounded by mountains. Wake up and thrive with focus on the health lifestyles and exploration. 24 hour grab and go pantry is ideal for nourishing and delicious options around the clock. Swim or just float away in our all natural saline indoor pool. Feel your best everyday with the signature Heavenly Bed, a fully equipped kitchen with ENERGY STAR rated appliances and spa inspired bathrooms with rainfall shower heads and all natural amenities. Enjoy the flexibility of a user friendly work space, featuring an over sized desk, ergonomic chair and easy access to power and data connections and the instant entertainment of all in one connectivity station, flat screen 42 inch HDTV and more. Come to stay at Element Chongli at the Thaiwoo Ski Resort. At Element Chongli we give you more room to think, work, socialize close to nature, more space to live your energetic life.

description.textZh: Sheraton Zhanjiang Hotel located in Zhanjiang's prime Jinsha Bay area with sea views, we offer perfect blend of business facilities and coastal getaway. Experience Sheraton's signature hospitality with premium accommodations and authentic local cuisine.
description.textEn: Sheraton Zhanjiang, nestled along the picturesque Jinsha Bay, offers breathtaking ocean views and seamlessly blends modern luxury with coastal charm. The hotel features elegantly designed guest rooms and suites, all equipped with Sheraton’s signature Sleep Experience, while select rooms boast panoramic sea vistas. Multiple dining venues and bars serve authentic Cantonese delicacies and international cuisine. A 1,440-square-meter pillar-free grand ballroom and versatile meeting spaces cater to premium business and social events. With an outdoor pool, fitness center, and kids’ club, guests can effortlessly transition between work and leisure. Whether for business or pleasure, Sheraton Zhanjiang delivers unforgettable coastal luxury with its signature hospitality.

description.textZh: 肇庆鼎湖区喜来登酒店位于肇庆市鼎湖新区的中心地带。酒店宾客可饱览新区的众多美丽景色，如长利涌、湿地公园和其他水滨景观。酒店靠近众多知名景点，如鼎湖山、九龙湖和砚洲岛。酒店配备卓越的商务旅行和观光配套设施，商务和休闲宾客可便利享用。酒店交通便利。驱车 10 分钟左右可达肇庆高铁东站，25 分钟左右可至市中心，70 分钟左右可至广州白云国际机场。酒店设有超过 398 间舒适客房和套房，客房空间设计巧妙融入品牌理念。客房温馨舒适，配备高速 Wi-Fi、平板高清电视以及各种现代设施设备。
description.textEn: Sheraton Zhaoqing Dinghu is located in the core area of Dinghu New District, Zhaoqing City. It is integrated with the most beautiful landscape belt of the New District, such as Changli River, wetland park and other waterfront landscapes. The hotel is close to famous scenic spots such as Dinghu Mountain, Jiulong lake and Yanzhou island. It has perfect business travel and tourism supporting facilities, which can be easily reached by business guests and leisure tourists. The hotel has convenient transportation. It takes 10 minutes drive to Zhaoqing High-speed Railway East station, 25 minutes drive to city center, and 70 minutes drive to Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. The hotel has more than 398 comfortable rooms and Suites, and the brand concept is skillfully integrated into the room space design. The guest rooms are equipped with high-speed WiFi, flat-panel HD TV and other facilities, which are warm and comfortable, but also have complete modern facilities and equipment.

description.textZh: 欢迎入住地处中国内陆商业中心核心地带的郑州上街雅乐轩酒店，展现自我风格。 从酒店出发，短途步行即可抵达周边众多娱乐场所，而短途行程还可前往闻名遐迩的少林寺和被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产的洛阳龙门石窟参观游览。 您可在我们的 w xyz 酒吧交朋识友，在 24 小时开放的雅乐轩能量：站餐厅大快朵颐，品尝各式点心或健康小吃，还可在我们的中转：站大堂休闲娱乐。 此外，还可通过酒店的免费有线和无线高速网络与世界联通！ 欢迎来到我们的雅乐轩客房放松身心，客房配有舒适的特色睡床、步入式淋浴间、Bliss 水疗中心定制用品以及更多的便利设施供您享受。 即插即用的连接站可为您的各类电子设备充电，并可将其连接到 42 英寸液晶电视，为工作和娱乐提供额外便利。
description.textEn: Celebrate your style at Aloft Zhengzhou Shangjie, located in the heart inland China's business center. We are a short stroll to endless entertainment options and a quick trip to the Shaolin Temple and the UNESCO World Heritage destination, the Luoyang Longmen Grottoes. Meet & mingle with friends at our w xyzSM bar, grab a sweet, savory or healthy snack from re:fuel by AloftSM, our 24 hour pantry or play in our remixSM lounge. Plus you can always stay connected with hotel-wide wired and wireless High Speed Internet Access! Breeze into one of our Aloft rooms, featuring our ultra-comfortable signature bed, walk-in shower, custom amenities by Bliss Spa and more. Our plug and play connectivity station charges all your electronics and links to the 42 inch LCD TV to maximize work and play.

description.textZh: 郑州机场万怡酒店坐落于被誉为华夏文明发源地的河南省，欢迎下榻该酒店，宾客可现场体验酒店所呈现的历史与当下文化的交融。酒店内提供宽敞的客房、免费 Wi-Fi 网络、全天候餐饮服务和 24 小时健身中心等设施，可满足旅客的一切需求。酒店大堂温馨迷人，配备各种休闲的公共设施，吸引了众多宾客前来放松、聚会或办公，而酒店宴会场地设有宽敞的宴会厅，是举办大型和正式活动的理想场地。从酒店可轻松前往河南省知名的旅游景点和风景名胜，如河南少林寺、龙门石窟和河南博物院，对于想探索辉煌中华历史文化的宾客来说，这里是理想下榻之选。酒店可为需要帮助的宾客提供游客咨询服务，帮助制定合适的活动日程或预订风景名胜门票。宾客可轻松前往任何旅游计划中的景点尽情游览。酒店提供24小时接送机服务，为宾客的行程提供方便。
description.textEn: Courtyard Zhengzhou Airport offers visitors the chance to experience a cross-section of the past and present. Located in Henan province, known as the birthplace of Chinese civilization, our hotel is a memorable destination for business and leisure travel. Enjoy amenities designed to cater to all of your needs, including spacious guest rooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, all-day dining and a 24-hour fitness center. An inviting lobby encourages you to relax, meet or work in a casual, communal setting, while event spaces including an expansive ballroom are well suited to larger, more formal events in Zhengzhou. Those looking to explore China's rich history and culture have easy access to the province’s important sites and attractions, including the Shaolin Temple, Longmen Grottoes and Henan Museum. Our hotel team will be happy to provide assistance to those who need help crafting an ideal itinerary or booking attraction tickets. The hotel provides 24-hour airport pick-up service.

description.textZh: 郑州汇艺万怡酒店坐落于郑东火车站商务区中心地带，以现代风格为主题，将复杂精美的设计融入到传统商务酒店之中。The Lounge 设有优雅的木家具，融汇戏剧艺术和令人惊叹的织物元素，营造时尚典雅的不凡氛围，诚邀酒店客人在郑东度过欢乐一天后到此享用咖啡和鸡尾酒，享受交朋识友的社交乐趣。客房和套房也同样精致，提供宽大办公区、高速 Wi-Fi、客房送餐服务和整洁的大理石浴室。预订行政楼层套房，可享免费早餐和酒廊商务设施。酒店邻近郑州火车东站，拥有八处灵活场地和一间豪华宴会厅，在备受欢迎的万怡轩餐厅还设有包厢，适合举办别具一格的商务会议或社交活动。欢迎莅临郑州汇艺万怡酒店，享受精彩纷呈的中国之旅。
description.textEn: Ideally situated in the heart of the Zhengdong Railway Station Business District, Courtyard Zhengzhou East blends the delicate with the refined to offer a modern interpretation of the traditional business hotel. Elegant wooden furnishings, dramatic art and breathtaking textiles create a stylish lobby setting, where The Lounge invites hotel guests to meet and mingle with coffee and cocktails after a fun day in Zhengzhou, China. The same sophistication carries into our guest rooms and suites, which boast a large workspace, high-speed WiFi, room service and a sleek marble bathroom. Book an Executive-level hotel suite to enjoy access to complimentary breakfast and business amenities at our lounge. If you are looking to host a distinctive business meeting or social event here in China, our hotel features eight adaptable venues, a lavish ballroom, private dining at popular Wan Yi Xuan and close proximity to Zhengzhou East Railway Station. A sensational visit to China awaits you at Courtyard Zhengzhou East.

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Zhengzhou Shuanghe Lake
records.name_zh: 郑州双鹤湖万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 郑州双鹤湖万豪万枫酒店是万豪国际集团旗下于郑州区域的首家万豪万枫品牌酒店，酒店由OLI建筑设计事务所及PLD联袂打造。秉承着“简约之美”的品牌理念，建筑以“莲”为意，寓意着连接和友谊，连接世界的空中丝绸之路，由此开启。酒店拥有189间温暖舒适的客房，1间餐厅，健身房和自助洗衣房，以高效舒适的空间和热情贴心的服务，让您的每次一停驻，都舒适尽意。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Zhengzhou Shuanghe Lake, as the first Fairfield by Marriott hotel under Marriott International in Zhengzhou, the property is jointly designed by OLI Architecture and PLD. Embracing the brand philosophy of "Beauty in Simplicity", the building draws inspiration from the lotus, symbolizing connection and friendship, and heralding the launch of the Aerial Silk Road that links the world.The hotel features 189 warm and comfortable guest rooms, one restaurant, a fitness center and a self-service laundry. With its efficient and cozy spaces as well as warm and attentive service, it ensures a thoroughly comfortable stay for every guest.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Zhengzhou East Railway Station
records.name_zh: 郑州东站福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 酒店雄踞中原高铁枢纽核心，与郑州东站贯通，是商务客群高效出行之首选。作为万豪旅享家旗下成员，酒店以现代设计元素，营造出兼具效率与品味的旅居空间。客房设计现代简约，为商旅与休闲客人提供宁静惬意的休憩空间。玩啤食社提供融入本地特色的美食自助早餐；醇饮优选啤酒吧则是社交放松的理想场所，供应福朋品牌标志性的精酿啤酒与轻食。24小时健身中心配备有氧与力量训练设备，满足日常锻炼需求。酒店还拥有多个灵活的会议空间，配备先进视听设备，可支持各类商务会议与社交活动。下榻于此，宾客既可感受万豪国际的标准化服务，又能便捷探访少林寺、河南博物院、只有河南等文化地标。这里不仅是商旅客群的高效驿站，更成为领略“天地之中”华夏文明的当代门户。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

records.name_zh: 郑州绿地 JW 万豪酒店

description.textZh: 郑州绿地 JW 万豪酒店的建筑设计理念源自拥有 1,500 年历史的嵩岳塔，内部功能完善、设施齐全，可满足现代旅客的各种需求，属于郑东新区地标性建筑。该酒店位于郑东新区中央商业区的会展中心和河南艺术中心之间，高达 280 米，属于国内外旅客前往当地的理想下榻之选。无论是夜间庆祝、周末逍遥游，还是举办会议或婚宴，JW万豪酒店都是您不容错过的理想选择。 您可在郑州绿地 JW 万豪酒店 Grill 烧烤餐厅进行商务谈判，也可在万豪中餐厅与家人享用别具特色的美味粤菜佳肴，酒店内设 8 间装潢考究的活动空间，包括一间面积达 1,000 平方米的 JW 大宴会厅，是举办各种活动的理想场地。 劳累的国际旅行或一整天会议之后，您可在装潢雅致的郑州绿地 JW 万豪酒店客房内放松休息，客房色调温和，内设宽敞整洁的浴室，配备舒适的床上用品，更可欣赏城市天际线和如意湖的美丽景致。
description.textEn: At the landmark JW Marriott Hotel Zhengzhou, inspiration comes in many forms, from the architectural design that mirrors the 1,500 year-old Songyue Pagoda to amenities that were created with the modern traveler in mind. Set in the heart of Zhengdong New District CBD between the Convention and Exhibition Center and Henan Art Center, this 280 meter-tall luxury hotel is a destination for both domestic and international visitors. Whether looking for a celebratory night out, a weekend away or a meeting or wedding space, this luxury hotel offers the perfect venue. Close a big deal over dinner at The Grill; treat the family to a special meal at Man Ho Cantonese restaurant; or host guests in one of 8 stunning event spaces including the 1,000-square-meter JW Grand Ballroom. After an international flight or an all-day meeting, escape to an elegant room featuring a soothing color palette, spacious bathroom, sumptuous bedding and commanding views over the city skyline and Ruyi Lake.

description.textZh: 入住郑州建业艾美酒店，发现历史底蕴与现代潮流水乳交融的中国。我们现代化的酒店位于河南省的省会城市郑州，地处市中心的黄金地段，可方便您尽情探索这一洋溢着摩登创想的城市内外。这座典雅精致的门户大厦紧邻郑东新区，邻近一家购物中心和电影院，还靠近古代遗迹和地标。酒店充满活力，设有时尚现代的餐厅，供应中式、日式及欧式特色美食，并设有酒吧、鸡尾酒吧和咖啡厅。宾客可抽空到纯真水疗中心休闲放松，这里是我们的身体与精神的绿洲。酒店活动场地包括大宴会厅，适合筹办会议、社交活动和婚礼。酒店设有 337 间客房和套房，通过一系列拥有质朴触感和简约设计的前沿技术为旅行常客们打造美妙难忘的住宿体验。欢迎莅临下榻我们位于中国郑州的酒店，不论是商务旅行、探险娱乐还是家庭度假，这里均是理想之选。
description.textEn: Discover modern and historic China from Le Méridien Zhengzhou. Situated in the forward-thinking capital of Henan Province, our modern hotel in Jinshui District is centrally located for exploring the city and beyond. This sophisticated gateway is adjacent to Zhengzhou Eastern New District, with a shopping center and cinema next door, yet close to ancient ruins and landmarks. Within our vibrant hotel, you'll find Chinese, Japanese and European specialties served in contemporary restaurants, as well as a wine room, cocktail bar and a coffee hub. Take time to relax at Pure Spa, our oasis for body and spirit. Plan meetings, social functions and weddings in our event venues, including our Grand Ballroom. Each of our hotel's 337 guest rooms and suites features an inspired blend of rustic touches with cutting-edge technology in a minimalist design bound to impress the seasoned travelers. Whether traveling for work, adventure or a family vacation, we look forward to welcoming you to our Zhengzhou, China hotel.

records.name_zh: 郑州美盛喜来登大酒店

description.textZh: 为您的中国郑州之旅预订理想下榻之处欢迎下榻郑州美盛喜来登大酒店, 乐享宽敞舒适的空间和令人耳目一新的卓越服务。酒店客房时尚大方, 配备豪华床品、免费 Wi-Fi 等一众周到设施, 并可欣赏郑州市中心美景。对更大空间有要求的宾客可升级至宽敞套房, 可额外尊享行政酒廊礼遇。提供先进的休闲设施供宾客休闲放松, 包括 24 小时健身房、室内恒温泳池。宾客可选择各类在售的国际和当地美食, 包括我们的日式料理餐厅和中餐厅的私人餐饮, 并享受 24 小时客房送餐服务。酒店位置便利, 地处郑东新区中心位置, 邻近郑州国际会展中心, 提供鼓舞人心的活动空间, 以及智能技术和定制策划服务, 方便您成功举办商务会议或特殊活动。
description.textEn: Refreshing service and elevated spaces await you at Sheraton Grand Zhengzhou Hotel, China. Stylish hotel rooms feature thoughtful amenities, plush bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi and views across downtown Zhengzhou. Those looking for more space can upgrade to a spacious suite with Executive Lounge access for added benefits. Guests can relax with our state-of-the-art leisure facilities, including a 24-hour gym, heated indoor pool and 'Kids Corner' indoor playground. Visitors can select from a variety of international and local food options on offer, including private dining at our Japanese and Chinese restaurants, as well as 24-hour room service. Take advantage of our hotel's central location in the Zhengdong New District, adjacent to Zhengzhou International Conference and Exhibition Center, to host a successful business meeting or special occasion in one of our inspiring event spaces, complete with smart technology and bespoke planning services. Additional hotel services include on-site laundry and parking.

description.textZh: 镇江苏宁万豪酒店位于镇江京口区核心商圈，矗立于 76 层地标建筑之上，紧邻苏宁广场，交通便捷。酒店 328 间云端客房尽揽江、城、山全景，配套完善餐饮、会议及休闲设施。57–58 层汇集国际美食、精致淮扬菜与高空酒廊，1532㎡灵活会议空间适配各类活动，24 小时健身中心与恒温泳池满足康养需求。酒店近邻金山、西津渡等名胜，以万豪卓越服务，融合千年江南底蕴，打造高端商旅与城市度假之选。
description.textEn: Perched atop a 76-story landmark in Jingkou District’s core commercial area, Zhenjiang Marriott Hotel is directly linked to Suning Plaza with easy access to transportation and local attractions. It offers 328 sky-high rooms with panoramic river, city and mountain views. Guests enjoy diverse dining, 1,532 sqm versatile event space, a 24-hour fitness center and an indoor heated pool. Blending Jiangnan’s heritage with Marriott hospitality, it delivers a premium experience for business and leisure travelers.

records.name_zh: 镇江康华汇利喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 镇江康华汇利喜来登酒店位于中国江苏省，采用精巧时尚的设计，配备现代化的设施，地理位置优越，恭迎您的光临。酒店位于镇江市中心，邻近万达广场，靠近火车站，距离机场也仅短途车程。客房宽敞优雅，提供免费 Wi-Fi 接入和喜来登特色睡眠体验之床，并可饱览城市或山峦美景。酒店内设三间餐厅，供应中餐、日本料理和国际美食。入住期间，您可以到酒店健身房享受健身锻炼，或在室内恒温泳池畅游几个来回。如果您在江苏举办活动，我们可以提供近 1,672 平米的多功能场地，其中包括一间 1200 平方米的无柱大宴会厅。如果您想要探索游览一番，西津渡古街和焦山亦近在咫尺。欢迎莅临镇江康华汇利喜来登酒店，开启非同一般的住宿之旅！
description.textEn: Sheraton Zhenjiang Hotel welcomes you to Jiangsu Province, China with stylish design, modern amenities and a convenient location. You'll find our hotel adjacent to Wanda Plaza in the heart of downtown Zhenjiang; the railway station is steps away, and the airport is easily reachable by car. Settle in to spacious, gracefully designed accommodation with complimentary Wi-Fi access, city or mountain views and our iconic Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. Savor Chinese, Japanese and international dining at one of our three hotel restaurants. Maintain your fitness at our on-site gym, or enjoy a swim in the heated indoor pool. If you're hosting an event in Jiangsu, we offer nearly 18,000 square feet of versatile venue space, including an expansive Grand Ballroom. Should you wish to explore, our hotel is just a short distance from attractions including Xinjin Ferry Street and Jiao Mountain. We look forward to making your stay special at Sheraton Zhenjiang Hotel.

description.textZh: 欢迎下榻中山保利艾美酒店，探索中山市魅力风情。中山保利艾美酒店位于中山北站附近，酒店风格时尚现代，周围汇聚众多当地企业、购物中心和餐厅。从酒店经短途车程即可到达众多纪念碑、寺庙、现代购物中心和绿意盎然的湿地公园，体会古典与现代融合的韵味，尽情探索中山市的风土人情。酒店内有三家餐厅，从自助早餐到精致中餐，供应丰盛美食，带您开启美食之旅。酒店可提供近 1,100 平米会议及活动空间，包括一间无柱式大宴会厅，是您举办婚礼和商务活动的理想之选。前往我们的健身俱乐部挥洒汗水，或在格调质朴的室内泳池中畅游，恢复身心活力。酒店客房和套房配备豪华睡床、液晶电视和视野非凡的落地窗，让您在繁忙的一天结束后，尽情放松休闲。我们竭诚为您提供难忘的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Discover cosmopolitan Zhongshan, China with a stay at the enticing Le Méridien Zhongshan. Located near North Zhongshan Station, Le Méridien Zhongshan is a contemporary hotel close to local businesses, shopping and dining. Explore Zhongshan City, a short drive away, and its unexpected blend of ancient and modern, with monuments, temples, shopping malls and verdant wetland parks. Indulge your culinary side at one of our three hotel restaurants, featuring sumptuous offerings ranging from a breakfast buffet to a refined take on Chinese cuisine. With almost 1,100 square meters of meeting and event space, including a pillar-free Grand Ballroom, our hotel is an exceptional venue for both weddings and business functions. Recharge at our health club or enjoy an invigorating swim in our pristine indoor pool. At the end of the day, retreat to your room or suite and indulge in plush bedding, an LCD TV and floor-to-ceiling windows offering exceptional views. We look forward to making your hotel stay a memorable one.

description.textZh: 欢迎莅临下榻中山喜来登酒店，体验舒适、时尚和服务的理想融合。这家别具一格的新颖海滨酒店位于一处娱乐和零售综合体内，信步可至购物和餐饮场所以及景点。这家高级酒店位于中山市中心，设有 362 间舒适客房，包括 44 间精心设计套房，适合各种场合，是您家庭度假和商务住宿的理想目的地。乐享酒店餐厅供应的正宗时尚美食，包括 Yue 中餐厅的粤菜和盛宴餐厅的丰盛自助餐与国际美食。一天结束后，特色睡床将您旅途的疲惫一扫而空，智能设施助您放松休闲，高速上网让您保持通畅联络 — 提供各种必需设施与服务，让您在中山市中心舒适下榻。酒店格调时尚现代，位于中山市中心，坐拥河滨风光和夜晚华灯初上的城市美景，必会为您打造令人意犹未尽的难忘住宿体验。
description.textEn: Experience the ideal blend of comfort, style and service at Sheraton Zhongshan Hotel. Our chic, new waterfront hotel is located in an entertainment and retail complex, within walking distance to shopping, dining and attractions. Situated in downtown Zhongshan, China, our upscale hotel offers 362 comfortable guest rooms, including 44 uniquely designed suites, and is the ideal destination for every occasion, from family getaways to business stays. Enjoy our hotel restaurants with authentic and genuine style cuisines, including Cantonese at Yue and a sumptuous buffet and international dishes at Feast. When your day is finished, recharge in our signature bed after your travels, kick back with smart amenities and stay connected with high-speed Internet – all the essentials for an effortless stay in the city center of Zhongshan, China. With riverfront views and the city lighting up at nights, our modern hotel in downtown Zhongshan will surely leave you in awe and wanting more!

description.textZh: 城市新地标中山利和威斯汀酒店坐落于珠江三角洲西岸，从酒店出发可轻松直达中山港码头和港珠澳大桥。酒店拥有277间客房及25间套房为宾客打造一个舒适放松的氛围，帮助他们释放旅行的倦意。所有客房均可提供开阔的视野，宾客可在此欣赏充满活力的城市景观和珠江西岸美景。所有客房均配备品牌标志天梦之床（Heavenly® Bed）、天梦之浴、酣然好梦薰衣草精油（Sleep Well Lavender Balm）和酣然好梦菜单（Sleep Well Menu），帮助宾客享有整晚好梦并享受充满健康活力的入住体验。酒店设有室内恒温泳池及配备全套新晋有氧运动及健身设备的威斯汀健身中心（WesitnWORKOUT Fitness Studio），帮助宾客在旅途中保持健康与活力。中山利和威斯汀酒店拥有三家餐厅及一间大堂酒廊并提供多元的餐饮体验。全日制知味餐厅可提供琳琅满目的自助及零点美食；逸峰餐厅及酒吧呈现手工调制的经典鸡尾酒，宾客可在此一边细品美酒同时将窗外的城市美景尽收眼底；大堂酒廊提供多款香醇咖啡，主题下午茶套餐，精选啤酒和葡萄酒，是与商务伙伴品茗或与家人朋友小酌的理想之选。此外，酒店的厨师团队专注于提供健康及原汁原味的食材，通过威斯汀营养美味菜单（Eat Well Menu），帮助宾客及儿童在享用美味的同时保持健康活力，以充沛精力迎接旅途中的每一天。
description.textEn: In the heart of China lighting capital, The Westin Zhongshan Guzhen shines a light on style, comfort and wellbeing. Set along the west bank of the Pearl River Delta, the hotel draws on its Greater Bay location to offer a distinct experience. Guest rooms overlook the city or river and feature signature Westin touches including Heavenly Bed and Heavenly Bath amenities. This attention to wellness carries into WestinWORKOUTTM, the 24-hour fitness center, providing everything for working out while on the road. Dining includes an all-day buffet restaurant and the inviting Lobby Lounge, where guests connect over a menu of curated beverages. The hotel’s location near the Guzhen Convention and Exhibition Center and adjacent to the Lihe Lighting Expo Center makes it ideal for meetings and social gatherings. More than 28,000 sq. ft. of event space includes a pillar-free ballroom with a large LED screen, state-of-the-art lighting and space for 1500 guests.

description.textZh: Fairfield by Marriott Zhoushan Daishan
description.textEn: Business Hotel Offering Warm Hospitality & Modern Comfort

records.name_en: Fairfield by Marriott Zhoushan New City
records.name_zh: 舟山新城万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 舟山新城万豪万枫酒店坐落于浙江省舟山市普陀区东港街道，坐拥山海相拥的滨海生态资源，是舟山普陀的城市核心与文旅门户，汇聚多元高品质滨海文旅资源；与国家5A级景区普陀山、观音法界、沈家门渔港等多处文旅地标相邻，尽览海岛人文与自然胜境。酒店周边交通便捷，路网通达，轻松畅达蜈蚣峙码头、普陀山机场、普陀客运中心等交通枢纽，便捷往来各热门景点；周边凯虹广场、普陀天地等商业综合体环伺，一站式满足休闲购物、餐饮娱乐等多元需求。酒店拥有96间舒适的客房，采用简约而温馨的设计理念，去繁就简，让宾客感到轻松自在、宾至如归。
description.textEn: Nestled in Donggang Subdistrict, Putuo District, Zhoushan, the hotel enjoys a prime location amid mountains and sea, at the heart of Putuo’s cultural-tourism hub. Near iconic spots including Mount Putuo (National 5A Scenic Area), Guanyin Dharma Realm and Shenjiamen Fishing Port, it showcases rich island scenery and culture.With easy access to Wugongzhi Wharf, Zhoushan Putuo Airport and Putuo Bus Terminal, the hotel offers convenient travel to major attractions. It is also close to commercial complexes like Kaihong Plaza and Putuo Tiandi, providing one-stop shopping, dining and entertainment.It features 96 comfortable guest rooms with a simple, warm design for a relaxed, home-like stay.

records.name_zh: 舟山普陀万豪万枫酒店

description.textZh: 酒店地理位置优越，毗邻武岭湿地公园和莲花洋公园，与普陀山风景区隔海相望。酒店为客人提供了一个与自然和宁静重新连接的机会。位于普陀区的心脏，方便客人往返市中心与酒店。酒店距市区购物中心仅10分钟步行路程，距舟山普陀山机场6公里，距舟山蜈蚣峙码头5.5公里。休闲旅游的客人也方便往返酒店与旅游景点普陀山和桃花岛。作为舟山首家万豪万枫酒店。酒店为商务及休闲客人提供优质、专业的服务，让您享受难忘的住宿体验。酒店设有136间客房，配备55英寸LED电视，步入式淋浴和免费高速Wi-Fi，以满足客人的不同需求。万枫餐厅有65个座位。客人可以享受中西式自助早餐。客人还可以从自助服务的“24/7市场”购买小吃和点心。此外，酒店的全天候设备齐全的健身中心，让客人保持锻炼，即使在旅行中保持活力与激情;全天候自助洗衣机也为客人提供了更多的便利和灵活性。
description.textEn: The first Fairfield by Marriott Brand hotel in Zhoushan. The hotel offers excellent and professional service for business and leisure guests to enjoy an unforgettable residential experience. The hotel features 136 guestrooms which equipped with 55 inch LED TVs, walk-in showers and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi to fulfill different needs of guests. The Fairfield Restaurant comes with 65 seats. Guests can enjoy buffet breakfast with a variety options. Guests can also purchase snacks and refreshments from the all-day self-service “24/7 Market”. Besides, hotel’s 24/7 well-equipped fitness center allows guests to maintain their exercise routine even while traveling; the 24/7 self-service laundry machine also provides guests with more convenience and flexibility.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Zhoushan Dinghai
records.name_zh: 舟山定海福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 海滨之城：尊享商务与滨海旅居体验 时光沉淀的复古风物，舌尖跃动的本土醇香——从经年甄选的老物件陈设，到主打本地精酿生啤的「醇酿之选」特色项目，每一处细节，都藏着我们对卓越品质的极致追求，与对本土风情的深深眷恋。清晨，用一份热气腾腾的美味健康早餐唤醒活力；夜幕降临，感受舟山本地特色美食烟火气，慰藉味蕾。酒店全域覆盖免费高速WiFi，让社交联络不间断，商务办公更高效，旅途从容不设限。运动的热情，从不应被空间束缚！在福朋喜来登，我们携手「悦训健身」打破健身房边界，随时随地，想动就动，让活力时刻在线。始终以旅行者的需求为初心，福朋喜来登集齐所有松弛感必备——在这里，卸下疲惫，自在放松，每一刻都是惬意时光。
description.textEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

description.textZh: 在舟山喜来登绿城酒店，即使远离家门也可与家中保持联系。利用我们的高速上网接入与朋友和同事保持联系，或在温馨宜人的酒店大堂与旅行同伴相互交流。欢迎来到我们设施先进的喜来登健身中心焕发活力，或在自然光充足的室内恒温泳池（设有一间桑拿室和蒸汽室）中悠然畅游。我们的礼宾服务还可为您提供邮件和快递服务、短信传达、机票确认、行李寄存、餐厅预订以及一般信息服务。我们的全套服务商务中心提供高速上网接入（收费）、打印、复印、电话与设备租赁、快递、秘书及翻译/口译服务。入住喜来登行政客房的客人还享有喜来登行政酒廊的特别使用权。
description.textEn: At the Sheraton Zhoushan Hotel, out of town doesn’t mean out of touch. Connect with friends and colleagues with High Speed Internet Access, and connect with fellow travelers in our welcoming lobby. Recharge with a workout at the top-of-the-line Sheraton Fitness or take a calming dip in our indoor heated swimming pool with natural light, a sauna and a steam room. Our concierge will be happy to assist you with mail and courier services, messages, airline confirmations, luggage storage, restaurant bookings and general information. Our full service business center offers High Speed Internet Access, fees apply, printing, photocopying, telephones, equipment rentals and courier, secretarial and translation/interpretation services. Sheraton Club Room guests have special access to the Sheraton Club Lounge.

records.name_zh: 舟山朱家尖绿城威斯汀度假酒店

description.textZh: 舟山朱家尖绿城威斯汀度假酒店坐落于中国东海舟山群岛 1,390 座岛屿中的第五大岛，邻近许多自然和文化景点。我们的度假酒店距离金色沙滩仅数步之遥，可饱览广阔无垠的大海和苍绿的大山风光。您也可以纵身跃入我们的室内或室外泳池尽情畅游，更可以前往威斯汀健身馆®肆意挥洒汗水，或在静谧祥和的威斯汀天梦水疗中心重焕身心活力。而威斯汀儿童俱乐部探索室则汇聚了众多适合儿童娱乐的活动。我们的 263 间客房（包括 12 套别墅）均配备精致的阳台，住客可远眺蔚蓝的大海和崇俊的大山，是理想的休憩之所。先在大理石浴室享受舒适淋浴，尽情松松，然后躺入天梦之床，缓缓地进入甜美的梦乡。
description.textEn: Situated in the East China Sea on the fifth largest of Zhoushan's 1,390 islands, The Westin Zhujiajian Resort, Zhoushan is close to a wealth of natural and cultural attractions. Our seaside resort is steps from golden sand beaches and boasts views of the sea and mountainside. Take a refreshing dip in our indoor or outdoor pools, recharge with a session in our WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio or renew mind and body in the tranquility of our Heavenly Spa by Westin. For younger guests, the Westin Kids Club Discovery Room offers engaging activities. Our 263 guest rooms, including 12 villas, are refined retreats that offer inspiring views of the sea or mountainside from elegant furnished balconies. Rest well in a Heavenly Bed and refresh with a soothing rainforest shower in our marble bathrooms.

description.textZh: Sheraton Hsinchu Hotel is the 2nd largest hotel in Taiwan with 770 rooms, 11 ballroom/function rooms and 10 meeting rooms for break out discussions. With THSR Hsinchu station adjacent to the hotel, which offers guests fast and convenient transportation.
description.textEn: The Sheraton Hsinchu Hotel is a Deluxe International Hotel, located in the heart of Zhubei Citys shopping and business district, where the Hsinchu County Government and commercial district are situated. Known as Taiwan’s Silicon Valley, Hsinchu is the hub of IT technology and higher education. With an easy access to Taiwan High Speed Railway station and Express Way No. 1 and only 48 kilometers to Taoyuan International Airport, we are conveniently connected to other major cities in Taiwan. Our hotel is located in Hsinchu which is near by the Hsinchu station of THSR Taiwan High Speed Rail within 5 mins by Taxi. Since Hsinchu is a High-Tech city, the transportation is very convenient between Taipei and Hsinchu that only take 30 mins by THSR. It only takes 40 minutes to 1 hour between Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport and our hotel as well.

description.textZh: 雅乐轩酒店在空间外设与格调塑造上秉承开放性原则，环境布设雅致清新而又别有深意，活动空间处处充满活力。我们是新一代的潮流酒店，凭借科技和设计追随客人的快步节奏，竭力呈献不断优化的住宿体验。
description.textEn: Aloft Hotels is open in space and spirit, offering Fresh, purposeful environments and vibrant spaces that bring people together. We are the next generation of hotel, using technology and design to enhance experiences and move at the fast pace of our guests.

description.textZh: 珠海万怡酒店位于十字门中央商务区核心地段，酒店地理位置优越，毗邻珠海国际会展中心、横琴口岸与横琴粤澳深度合作区。酒店与新兴商业中心——十字门华发商都无缝衔接。酒店交通便捷，十字门轻轨站举步可达，距离湾仔口岸、拱北口岸分别约为3公里和9公里，距离珠海金湾机场约30公里。酒店所处建筑联通十字门轻轨站，便捷通达横琴口岸与港珠澳大桥珠海公路口岸，为往来粤港澳大湾区的宾客提供高效出行体验。宾客可轻松探索珠海主题度假区、圆明新园、珠海渔女等热门景点，感受滨海魅力。新酒店的设计巧妙融入本地海洋元素与渔村文化。大堂公区以“珍珠：至简中蕴含至繁”的特质为设计灵感，温暖典雅的色调搭配贝壳纹理装饰，打造兼具艺术性与实用性的公区空间。酒店拥有188间现代简约的客房与套房，均配备舒适床品、高清电视、灵活便捷的办公区及免费高速无限网络等现代化设施，兼顾高效商务和深度休憩。同时，宾客于房内即可远眺澳门繁华景致、壮丽海岸线及葱郁山景，惬享独具魅力的海滨风光。
description.textEn: Courtyard by Marriott Zhuhai is located in the core area of the Shizimen Central Business District. The hotel enjoys a superior location, adjacent to the Zhuhai International Convention and Exhibition Center, Hengqin Port and Hengqin Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone. The hotel is seamlessly connected to the emerging commercial center, Shizimen Huafa Commercial City. The hotel has convenient transportation and is within walking distance of Shizimen Light Rail Station. The hotel building is connected to the Shizimen Light Rail Station, with convenient access to Hengqin Port and Zhuhai Highway Port of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, providing guests traveling to and from the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area with an efficient travel experience. Guests can easily explore popular attractions such as Zhuhai Chimelong International Ocean Resort, Yuanmingyuan New Garden, Zhuhai Fisher Girl, and experience the charm of the seaside.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: Fuel up for the day and start your day right. We offer a healthy mix of delicious, fresh breakfast options. Choose from a wide variety of morning favorites like fresh fruit, omelets, mini waffles, sweet breads, yogurt and bacon. Then, add your choice of toppings, ranging from shredded cheese and sliced almonds and agave syrup. Everything you need to stay productive while on the road.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Zhuhai Nanwan
records.name_zh: 珠海南湾福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 珠海南湾福朋喜来登酒店拥有163间融合经典设计及本地元素的客房及套房，亦设有儿童主题套房。酒店拥有一个将全日餐厅、大堂吧及社交空间融为一体的多功能共享空间“玩啤食社”，除了提供丰富的自助早餐、品牌标志性“醇饮优选”计划中的本地精酿啤酒，还提供精选咖啡、中式品茗、儿童菜单、甜品、小食、简餐及客房送餐等服务，满足宾客多样化需求。182㎡的多功能会议场地配以专业的视听设施与支持团队，能满足会议、宴会及活动所需。24小时开放的健身中心和自助洗衣房，以及免费地下停车场，为宾客出行提供了便利。下榻珠海南湾福朋喜来登酒店，开启一段真诚舒适的旅程。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Zhuhai Nanwan features 163 guestrooms and suites blending classic design with local elements as well as the themed suites for children. The multifunctional shared space “The Mesh” integrates an all-day dining restaurant, lobby lounge, and social area. The Mesh offers abundant buffet breakfast, local craft beers from the Best Brews® program, as well as selected coffee, Chinese tea, a children's menu, desserts, snacks, A La Carte, room service and so on to meet guests’ diverse needs. The 182 ㎡ multifunctional meeting space, equipped with professional audiovisual facilities and dedicated support team, accommodates conferences, banquets, and events. The 24-hour fitness center, self-service laundry room and complimentary underground parking lot provide convenience for guests.Immerse yourself in an honest and comfortable stay at our hotel in Zhuhai.

records.name_en: Zhuhai Dong'ao Island Marriott Resort and Spa
records.name_zh: 珠海东澳岛万豪度假酒店

description.textZh: Situated atop the hill at the northernmost tip of Dong’ao Island, the location is flanked by mountains and overlooks the sea. Xiaozhu Bay lies to the west, while Dazhu Bay lies to the east. To the south, the view encompasses the Honey Moon Pavilion.
description.textEn: The hotel features 256 rooms with ocean view ranging from 45-439 square meters, 3 distinctive outlets; 1,883 square meters of banquet and event areas, including an 800-square-meter ballroom and a 450-square-meter outdoor lawn. It is an exceptional destination for meetings and corporate events, which is a sought-after location for memorable weddings and celebrations. Rejuvenate your body and enrich your spirit in the Spa, sweat it out in Fitness Centre with professional equipment. Enjoy bonding time at the Kids Club, take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool by the beautiful views of the ocean and sky. During your stay, explore more famous attractions on Dong’ao Island.

description.textZh: Zhuhai Marriott Hotel is a family-friendly downtown hotel with spacious rooms and suites, free Wi-Fi and ocean views. Among its amenities are six restaurants and bars, an Executive Lounge, modern venues, an outdoor pool, a fitness center and free parking.
description.textEn: Zhuhai Marriott Hotel welcomes guests traveling through China to its family hotel with friendly service, thoughtful amenities and an ideal setting. The downtown hotel sits beside the rich flora and fauna of Jingshan Park, overlooking the Hongkong-Zhuhai-Macao bridge. We are near the famous Zhuhai Fisher Girl statue, the Zhuhai Light Rail Station, Jiuzhou Ferry Terminal and Zhuhai Airport. Recharge in our spacious hotel rooms or suites while enjoying amenities like our indulgent beds, marble bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, ample workstations and free Wi-Fi, as well as enticing ocean and Zhuhai views. Executive rooms and suites have access to the Executive Lounge and special amenities, including complimentary afternoon tea. Savor delicious cuisine and custom cocktails in the four restaurants and the lobby bar in the hotel or take advantage of our outdoor pool and gym. For those planning events, the hotel features seven upscale venues, including our Marriott Ballroom. We look forward to your stay at Zhuhai Marriott

description.textZh: 酒店拥有 296 间宽敞舒适的客房和套房，坐拥中心湖风光和繁华城景。臻厨全日餐厅位于 22 层，可欣赏壮美的城市天际线，带领宾客踏上精彩的赏味之旅。大堂吧位于同一楼层，行政酒廊位于 20 层，均是商务会谈和休闲聚会的卓越之选。位于 5 层的万豪中餐厅是宾客探索珠海当地风味的起点。艺术中心景观草坪和室外泳池均坐落于 6 层，宾客可于此感受微风拂面的惬意感觉。酒店拥有两个宴会厅，珠海厅位于 3 层，面积约为 900 平方米, 配备约 80 平方米的高清 LED 屏幕；金湾厅位于同一楼层，面积约 400 平方米；酒店 5 层还配备有 5 间多功能厅，为您举办婚礼、社交聚会和商务会议等提供理想场地。
description.textEn: The hotel boasts 296 spacious and comfortable guest rooms and suites with city and Central Lake views. The all-day dining restaurant, ZHUHAI KITCHEN, located on the 22nd floor, is the ideal place to taste delicious food while gazing out at the gorgeous skyline. THE LOUNGE on the same floor and the M Club on the 20th floor are excellent options for business meetings and casual gatherings. The Chinese restaurant, MAN HO, on the 5th floor is the starting point for guests to explore local cuisine and taste Zhuhai. The Art Center View Lawn and outdoor pool, which are both on the 6th floor, are must-see places for guests who want to relax and feel the breeze. The hotel's 900-square-meter Zhuhai Ballroom, which is located on the 3rd floor, has an 80-square-meter high-definition LED screen. It also has a 400-square-meter Jinwan Ballroom on the same floor and 5 conference rooms on the 5th floor, making it an ideal location for weddings, social events, and business meetings.

description.textZh: 珠海中海万丽酒店拥有316间航海风格的时尚客房，透过房内的全景落地玻璃，即可欣赏270°前山妩媚河畔，又可远眺澳门地标性建筑新葡京及澳门塔。两间风格独特的餐厅与一个大堂吧，宾客在此品味珍馐佳肴，面积超过4,000平方米的室内外活动空间，酒店专业的宴会统筹团队竭力为宾客带来个性化的会议体验。此外，酒店还配有恒温泳池，24小时健身中心，以及室内外儿童游乐场等休闲娱乐设施，私享静谧，身处其中，纵享珠中澳山河城海桥五景合一天际线。
description.textEn: Renaissance Zhuhai Hotel is located on the riverside of Qianshan River, in Uni Park complex with modern facilities and convenient access to transportation. The hotel has 316 marine-themed stylish rooms. Through the panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms, guests could enjoy the charming riverside view, as well as the New Lisboa and Macao Tower - the landmarks of Macau. The hotel features two unique restaurants and an R lounge. It’s also facilitated with indoor and outdoor event spaces spanning more than 4,000 square meters where the hotel’s professional banquet planning team strives to bring a personalized meeting experience to guests. Additionally, the hotel is equipped with a heated swimming pool, a 24-hour fitness center, children's playgrounds, and other leisure and entertainment facilities. Guest can enjoy the five panoramic views of the Zhuhai-Zhongshan-Macau-Mountain-River city and sea bridge from the balcony of our Club Lounge.

description.textZh: 珠海华发喜来登酒店是一家位于中国广东省珠海市的海景酒店，共有 544 间舒适的客房，包括 76 间设计别具一格的套房。无论是家庭度假还是商务住宿，酒店的时尚住宿选项都能满足您的需求。酒店共有三家特色餐厅，无需四处搜寻，在酒店内就能尽享美味。酒店坐落在珠海海边，正对澳门特别行政区，地理位置非常优越。结束漫长的日间观光行程后，喜来登特色睡眠体验之床将您一天的疲惫一扫而空，包括平板电视在内的智能设施助您放松休闲，高速网络让您保持通畅联络，各种常用设施与服务也很齐全，让您在珠海无忧下榻。酒店休闲设施丰富，设有网球场、健身中心和室内外泳池，让您度过充实的闲暇时光。无论您缘何选择珠海华发喜来登酒店，我们都将为您提供超乎预期的卓越服务。
description.textEn: Located in China's Guangdong Province, Sheraton Zhuhai Hotel has 545 comfortable guest rooms, including 76 uniquely-designed suites. Our hotel provides a stylish destination for everything from family getaways to business stays. You never have to venture far to find delicious cuisine; we feature three distinctive restaurants on-site. One of our exceptional features is our hotel location, with Macau located just in front of us. After a long day of exploring, you can recharge in our Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience after your travels, kick back with smart amenities including flat-screen TVs and stay connected with high-speed internet – all the essentials for an effortless stay in Zhuhai. We offer plenty of activities to keep you occupied during your down time, including a tennis court, fitness center and both indoor and outdoor swimming pools. Whatever the reason for joining us, Sheraton Zhuhai Hotel is sure to exceed your expectations.

description.textZh: 珠海是一座风光旖旎的海滨城市，素有“中国里维埃拉”的美称。毗邻湾仔口岸的地标建筑珠海中心大厦的41 至 72 层，便是珠海豪华海景酒店 - 瑞吉酒店所在地，这里坐拥大湾区的辽阔景致，珠澳两地的城市风光可一览无余，是名副其实的海景酒店。在这里，瑞吉酒店用悉心周到的特色管家服务与丰厚礼遇，引领宾客踏上一场充满魅力的旅程。您可于酒店餐厅尽情享用美食，前往游览长隆海洋王国和圆明新园，还可选择酒店内面积逾 1,500 平米的场地空间举办优雅活动。忙碌一日之余，前往酒店内的铱瑞水疗惬意享受按摩、美容和健康护理。在珠海瑞吉酒店，我们用现代方式为您重新诠释经典。
description.textEn: Rising over the clouds in a beautiful coastal city, The St. Regis Zhuhai leads guests on a compelling journey curated with St. Regis' signature Butler service and rituals. Taking up the top 31 floors of the iconic, 72-story Zhuhai Tower, our hotel is a waterfront haven in Wanzai, a beautiful coastal city known as “Chinese Riviera.” Find an upscale haven in elegantly styled accommodations with signature amenities, refined design elements and breathtaking views of the vast Greater Bay and Zhuhai and Macao landscape. Thrill your palate with diverse and delectable cuisine at our hotel restaurants. Explore compelling attractions including Chimelong Ocean Kingdom and The New Yuan Ming Palace. Celebrate and succeed in more than 1,500 square meters of sophisticated event space. Punctuate your day with a restorative massage, beauty or wellness treatment at our luxurious hotel spa. Recraft the classics in a modern way at The St. Regis Zhuhai in China.

description.textZh: 诸暨万枫酒店大堂宽敞现代，自然采光充足。119 间客房提供智能的现代设计，配有 LED 电视，高速无线网和舒适的家具，满足宾客的不同需求。每个房间还包括一个精心设计的工作区，配有可调照明灯和多个电源插座，以满足宾客每日需求。通过可移动办公桌，宾客可以根据自己的习惯安排自己的工作空间。宾客可以享受健康的早餐，选择广泛，如燕麦片、炒鸡蛋、香肠、自制面条和其他健康的选择，如水果、酸奶、全麦麦片和面包。宾客还可在全天候营业的万枫小铺自助选购零食饮品作为外带简餐。24小时健身房可以帮助宾客在旅行中进行日常的锻炼。
description.textEn: Fairfield by Marriott Zhuji features a spacious, modern lobby filled with natural light. All 119 guestrooms offer smart contemporary designs, and are equipped with LED TVs, high speed Wi-Fi and comfortable furniture to fulfill different needs of guests. Each room also includes a well-designed work area with adjustable lighting, task lights, and multiple electrical outlets to facilitate the needs of today’s guests. With a curved, mobile desk, guests can arrange their own workspace according to their habits. Guests can enjoy healthy breakfast with a wide selection of oatmeal, scrambled eggs, sausage, make-your-own noodles, and other healthy choices, such as fruit, yogurt, and whole grain cereals and breads. Guests can also purchase snacks and refreshments from the all-day self-service 24 hour Market for easy meals on-the-go. The hotels 24-hour gym also allows guests to maintain their exercise routine even while traveling.

description.textZh: 作为万豪国际集团旗下于湖南率先开设的酒店，株洲美的万豪酒店地理位置优越，位于株洲高科技工业园中，此处是湖南的两大重点开发区之一。酒店距高铁站仅约十分钟车程，距市中心约十分钟行程，距长沙黄花国际机场约四十五分钟行程。株洲美的时代广场位于酒店附近，是一处购物娱乐综合体。株洲美的万豪酒店拥有 301间宽敞优雅的客房和套房，可欣赏株洲市的非凡美景或宁静的花园景观。位于 24 层的行政酒廊为行政楼层宾客和万豪尊贵会员提供个性化服务和专享礼遇。宴会及会议空间共 1,500 平米左右,包括一间约 1,000 平米的无柱式宴会厅和 5 间多功能厅。欢迎莅临丰富多彩的火车之城株洲。
description.textEn: As the first Marriott International Brand Hotel in Hunan province, Zhuzhou Marriott Hotel is strategically located in the Zhuzhou Hi-Tech Park, One of the two national development zones in Hunan. The Hotel is a mere ten minutes drive from the high-speed railway station, ten minutes from the City Center and forty-five minutes form the Changsha Huanghua international airport . There is Midea Time Square nearby, is shopping and entertainment complex. Zhuzhou Marriott Hotel offers 311 elegant and spacious rooms and suites, with distinctive views of Zhuzhou City or serene garden views. The Executive Lounge on the 24th floor extends personalized service and exclusive benefits for Executive floor guests and Marriott Elite members. The total banquet and meeting space covers over 1,500 square meters, including a 1,000-square-meter pillar less ballroom and five function rooms. We looking forward to welcoming you to The Train Dynamic City-Zhuzhou.

description.textZh: Warm up to our expanded hot breakfast menu. Omelets, bacon and mini waffles have joined our long list of morning favorites including fresh fruit, Chobani Greek yogurt and sweet breads. It's just what you need for a delicious start to your day.
description.textEn: The hotel is owned by Marriott International. The hotel is located in the core of the high-tech development zone with a business area, which is convenient for guests to go to various companies and enterprises as well as natural and cultural attractions. The location is very advantageous. Guests can walk to Torch Park and Intime Department Store, about 20 minutes by car from the Cultural Center and Xiaofu River Wetland Park, about 20 minutes by car from Zibo Railway Station, about 12 minutes by car from High speed Railway North Station. About 1 hour drive from Jinan Airport, convenient transportation is a special choice for business travel and leisure travel.

records.name_en: Four Points by Sheraton Zibo Zichuan
records.name_zh: 淄博淄川福朋喜来登酒店

description.textZh: 淄博淄川福朋喜来登酒店，植根于淄川蒲松龄商业圈的核心地带，地理位置得天独厚。距蒲松龄故居聊斋城仅需 10 分钟车程，抬脚便能探寻《聊斋志异》的奇幻世界；距淄博火车站约 18.8 公里，便捷交通让旅途往来从容不迫。​136 间客房融经典底蕴与时尚巧思于一体，完善设施勾勒出舒适惬意的休憩天地，每一处细节都藏着对宾客的贴心考量。​1 个多功能厅与 3 个会议室组成灵活的活动空间，无论是商务会议的严谨高效，还是婚礼庆典的浪漫温馨，都能在此完美呈现。​餐厅 “玩啤食社” 是味蕾的欢乐场 —— 丰富美食与特调啤酒碰撞出奇妙滋味，轻松氛围里，每一口都是惬意时光的注脚。​自助洗衣房以高效服务拂去旅途疲惫，健身房则凭借国际先进器材，让活力在旅途中从不缺席。在这里，便捷与品质同行，每一段停留都值得回味。
description.textEn: Four Points by Sheraton Zibo Zichuan is located in the Pu Songling commercial area. It is only about 10 minutes' drive from Pu Songling's Former Residence - Liaozhai City. It is approximately 18.8 kilometers away from Zibo Railway Station. The hotel has 136 rooms that combine classic and modern styles, providing guests with complete facilities to enjoy comfort and relaxation. The hotel has 1 multi-functional hall and 3 meeting rooms, which can meet the needs of various business meetings, wedding celebrations and other events. The hotel's restaurant"The Mesh", offers guests a variety of delicious food and special beers, allowing guests to enjoy a delicious time in a relaxed atmosphere. The hotel is equipped with a self-service laundry room, providing convenient and efficient laundry services for guests, making their travel more relaxed and enjoyable! The hotel's gym is equipped with a variety of advanced international fitness equipment to help guests maintain vitality during their travels.

description.textZh: 淄博喜来登酒店位于张店市中心，毗邻万象汇购物中心，地理位置优越，交通便利，距淄博火车站约10分钟车程，济南遥墙机场约90分钟车程；邻近主要旅游景点，步行5分钟即可到达八大局市场；距淄博陶瓷博物馆约3公里，距齐盛湖海岱楼钟书阁约12公里，距周村古商城约20公里，距齐文化博物馆约30公里。淄博是齐国故都、陶瓷名城，也是世界足球（蹴鞠）发源地，位于酒店2楼的文化长廊，将齐文化精髓淋漓展现。在这里，您可以欣赏到春秋战国时期的出土文物照片，如西周青铜鼎、春秋时期的人形足铜墩等，也可以领略古代齐都的辉煌，探索追溯齐都3000多年前的历史。酒店二楼盛宴自助餐厅汇聚100多种风味美食，海鲜刺身、中西热菜、手工甜品一应俱全，酒水饮品畅饮不限量，晚餐更配有外籍乐队为现场燃情助兴；二楼采悦轩中餐厅设私密包间，主打传统博山菜，涵盖博山脆皮硬炸肉，精葱烧鲍鱼，宫保虾球等，开放式厨房现点现做、食材新鲜、色香味俱全。酒店高达180米，拥有270间豪华客房及套房，以及超过2,356平方米的大型宴会及多功能会议厅。1,100平方米的无柱式豪华大宴会厅及8个多功能会议厅，配备先进的视听音响设备和无线会议设施，是举办大型婚宴、时尚盛会、商务会议以及婚宴的理想之选。为满足宾客对健身娱乐的需求，酒店配备多样的健身娱乐设施，帮助宾客在一天的高效工作之后放松和恢复元气。酒店设有商务中心、免费停车场等便利设施方便您的商务及私人出行。
description.textEn: Sheraton Zibo Hotel is located in the city center adjacent to the MixC shopping center , prime location and convenient transportation, 10 minutes drive to Zibo Railway Station，90 minutes to Jinan Yaogiang Airport. Close to the major tourist attractions. About 5-minute walk to the Badaju Market, approximately 3 km from the Zibo Ceramics Museum, about 20 km from Zhoucun Ancient City and 30 km from Qi Heritage Museum, Hotel 2nd floor offering guests easy access to explore Zibo‘s rich historical and cultural attractions. Here you will find a collection of photos featuring unearthed cultural relics like the photo of bronze ding from Wertern Zhou, the photo of Bronze dui from Spring and Autumn Period.Through these images, you can appreciate the glory of the ancient Qi capital and explore the history dating back over 3,000 years ago.
